The learned MnasFPN head paired with MobileNetV2 outperforms MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.8 mAP at similar latency on Pixel, and is 1.0 mAP more accurate and 10% faster than NAS-FPNLite. Ablation studies show most gains come from search space innovations and reveal coupling between search space and algorithm.
1912.01106|v2.assessment: 该工作将延迟感知NAS成功应用于移动端检测头设计，性能提升显著，对高效目标检测有重要参考价值。
1912.01106|v2.contribution: 提出了移动友好的MnasFPN检测头搜索空间及延迟感知搜索方法，显著提升了移动端检测性能。
1912.01106|v2.innovation: 设计了面向移动端的检测头搜索空间，并揭示了搜索空间与搜索算法之间的耦合关系。
1912.01106|v2.result: 在Pixel上比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.8 mAP，比NAS-FPNLite高1.0 mAP且快10%。

A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云3D目标检测中现有方法未能充分利用点云间结构化关系的问题。②提出了一种层次化图网络（Hierarchical Graph Network），通过构建点云的多层级图结构来建模局部几何关系与全局语义关系，实现更鲁棒的特征聚合与目标框回归。③相比已有基于体素或原始点的方法，该工作显式建模了点之间的层次化拓扑关系，增强了上下文信息利用。④摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但声称在点云3D检测任务上取得了有竞争力的结果。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that existing point cloud 3D object detection methods fail to fully exploit structured relationships among points. It proposes a Hierarchical Graph Network that constructs multi-level graph structures over point clouds to model local geometric and global semantic relations for robust feature aggregation and box regression. Unlike voxel-based or raw-point methods, it explicitly models hierarchical topological relations to enhance contextual information. The abstract reports competitive results on point cloud 3D detection benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.assessment: 该工作将图神经网络引入点云3D检测，思路合理但摘要信息有限，需关注其在大规模数据集上的验证充分性。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.contribution: 提出层次化图网络用于点云3D目标检测，显式建模点间多层级结构化关系。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.innovation: 通过层次化图结构同时捕获局部几何与全局语义关系以增强特征表示。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.result: 在点云3D检测任务上取得有竞争力的性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje._arxiv_id: A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Object Detection on Point Clouds.

2003.00504|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D目标检测中被遮挡目标因信息不足而检测困难的问题。②提出MonoPair方法，通过建模相邻目标对之间的空间关系，对目标位置和3D距离进行不确定性感知预测，并利用非线性最小二乘联合优化。③相比将每个目标独立训练的已有方法，该方法利用配对样本的空间约束为部分遮挡目标提供额外信息。④在KITTI 3D检测基准上取得最优性能，大幅超越当时最先进方法，尤其在困难样本上提升显著。
2003.00504|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of monocular 3D object detection for occluded samples that are only partially visible. It proposes MonoPair, which models pairwise spatial relationships between adjacent objects, computes uncertainty-aware predictions for object locations and 3D distances, and jointly optimizes them via nonlinear least squares. Unlike prior methods that treat each object independently, it leverages spatial constraints from neighboring pairs to aid partially-occluded objects. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on the KITTI 3D detection benchmark with large margins, especially on hard samples.
2003.00504|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用目标间空间关系解决遮挡问题，方法简洁有效，在KITTI上表现突出，对单目3D检测领域有重要参考价值。
2003.00504|v2.contribution: 提出基于配对空间关系的单目3D检测框架MonoPair，通过联合优化提升遮挡目标检测精度。
2003.00504|v2.innovation: 利用相邻目标对的不确定性感知预测与非线性最小二乘联合优化来编码空间约束。
2003.00504|v2.result: 在KITTI 3D检测基准上大幅超越当时最先进方法，困难样本上提升尤为显著。

1912.04799|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目图像3D目标检测中缺乏准确深度信息、传统2D卷积无法捕获3D结构的问题。②提出深度引导的动态深度可分离空洞局部卷积网络D⁴LCN，使滤波器和感受野可从图像深度图自动学习，实现不同像素使用不同滤波器。③相比将深度图转为伪LiDAR再应用3D检测器的已有方法，该方法直接在2D卷积框架内融入深度引导，避免了对深度估计精度的过度依赖。④大量实验表明D⁴LCN缩小了图像表示与3D点云表示之间的差距，在单目3D检测任务上取得优异性能。
1912.04799|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of accurate depth information in monocular 3D object detection and the inability of conventional 2D convolutions to capture 3D structure. It proposes D⁴LCN, a depth-guided dynamic-depthwise-dilated local convolutional network where filters and receptive fields are automatically learned from image-based depth maps, enabling different pixels to have different filters. Unlike pseudo-LiDAR approaches that depend heavily on depth estimation accuracy, D⁴LCN integrates depth guidance directly into the 2D convolution framework. Extensive experiments show it narrows the gap between image and 3D point cloud representations, achieving strong monocular 3D detection performance.
1912.04799|v2.assessment: 该工作从卷积算子层面创新性地融入深度引导，避免了伪LiDAR方法的误差传播问题，对单目3D检测有重要启发意义。
1912.04799|v2.contribution: 提出深度引导的动态局部卷积网络D⁴LCN，实现像素级自适应滤波器用于单目3D检测。
1912.04799|v2.innovation: 滤波器和感受野由深度图自动学习，使不同像素拥有不同卷积核，弥合2D与3D表示差距。
1912.04799|v2.result: 在单目3D检测任务上取得优异性能，有效缩小了图像表示与3D点云表示之间的差距。

2003.09119|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对基于关键点的检测器中角点匹配错误频发、严重影响检测性能的问题。②提出CentripetalNet，利用向心偏移（centripetal shift）将来自同一实例的角点进行配对，并设计十字星可变形卷积网络进行特征自适应以增强角点信息。③相比传统基于嵌入的角点匹配方法，该方法结合位置信息实现更准确的角点配对，并扩展至实例分割。④在MS-COCO test-dev上以48.0% AP超越所有已有anchor-free检测器，同时以40.2% MaskAP达到与最先进实例分割方法相当的性能。
2003.09119|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the widespread incorrect keypoint matching problem in keypoint-based detectors that severely degrades performance. It proposes CentripetalNet, which uses centripetal shift to pair corner keypoints from the same instance and designs a cross-star deformable convolution network for feature adaptation at corners. Unlike conventional embedding-based matching, it combines position information for more accurate pairing and extends to instance segmentation. On MS-COCO test-dev, it achieves 48.0% AP, outperforming all existing anchor-free detectors, and 40.2% MaskAP, comparable to state-of-the-art instance segmentation methods.
2003.09119|v2.assessment: 该工作以简洁的向心偏移机制有效解决了角点配对难题，在COCO上取得领先结果，对anchor-free检测器设计有重要参考价值。
2003.09119|v2.contribution: 提出CentripetalNet，利用向心偏移实现高质量角点配对，并扩展至实例分割。
2003.09119|v2.innovation: 通过向心偏移结合位置信息进行角点匹配，并设计十字星可变形卷积增强角点特征。
2003.09119|v2.result: 在MS-COCO test-dev上达到48.0% AP和40.2% MaskAP，超越所有anchor-free检测器。

2006.04356|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D点云目标检测中因空间遮挡和点密度随距离变化导致同一目标外观差异大、特征表示鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出Associate-3Ddet，采用类域适应方法，将真实场景的感知域特征与无遮挡增强场景的概念域特征进行桥接对齐。③相比已有方法，该工作模仿人脑物体感知机制，通过域适应增强特征对遮挡和密度变化的鲁棒性。④大量实验表明该简单有效的方法从根本上提升了3D点云目标检测性能，达到当时最先进水平。
2006.04356|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge that spatial occlusion and distance-dependent point density cause large appearance variations of the same object in 3D point clouds, degrading feature robustness. It proposes Associate-3Ddet, a domain-adaptation-like approach that bridges the perceptual domain from real scenes and the conceptual domain from augmented non-occluded point clouds. Mimicking human brain perception, it enhances feature robustness against occlusion and density variation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this simple yet effective approach fundamentally boosts 3D point cloud detection, achieving state-of-the-art results.
2006.04356|v2.assessment: 该工作从域适应视角切入点云特征鲁棒性问题，思路新颖且方法简洁，对3D检测中的遮挡与密度变化问题有较好参考价值。
2006.04356|v2.contribution: 提出Associate-3Ddet，通过感知域与概念域的关联对齐增强3D点云检测的特征鲁棒性。
2006.04356|v2.innovation: 以类域适应方法桥接真实场景与增强场景的特征表示，模仿人脑物体感知机制。
2006.04356|v2.result: 在3D点云目标检测上达到当时最先进水平，显著提升了对遮挡和密度变化的鲁棒性。

1908.01998|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对传统目标检测需要大量标注数据、难以检测未见类别的问题。②提出少样本目标检测网络，核心包括Attention-RPN、Multi-Relation Detector和对比训练策略，利用支持集与查询集之间的相似性检测新类别目标并抑制背景误检，同时贡献了一个包含1000类高质量标注的少样本检测数据集。③相比已有方法，该网络训练后无需微调即可检测未见类别，且首次提供了专门为少样本检测设计的大规模数据集。④在不同数据集的少样本设定下均取得新的最先进性能。
1908.01998|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that conventional object detection requires substantial annotated data and struggles with unseen categories. It proposes a few-shot detection network with Attention-RPN, Multi-Relation Detector, and contrastive training that exploits similarity between support and query sets to detect novel objects while suppressing background false detections, and contributes a new dataset with 1000 categories of high-quality annotations. Unlike prior methods, it detects unseen categories without further training or fine-tuning and provides one of the first datasets specifically designed for few-shot detection. It achieves new state-of-the-art performance on different datasets in the few-shot setting.
1908.01998|v2.assessment: 该工作在少样本检测领域提出了完整的网络架构与大规模数据集，方法通用性强，对标注稀缺场景下的检测研究有重要推动作用。
1908.01998|v2.contribution: 提出基于Attention-RPN和多关系检测器的少样本目标检测网络，并贡献1000类少样本检测数据集。
1908.01998|v2.innovation: 利用支持集与查询集的相似性进行对比训练，实现无需微调即可检测未见类别。
1908.01998|v2.result: 在不同数据集的少样本设定下取得新的最先进性能，并发布了大规模少样本检测数据集。

2004.08515|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB-D显著目标检测中RGB与深度信息被独立处理、易受训练数据量限制或过度依赖复杂训练流程的问题，提出了联合学习与密集协作融合框架JL-DCF。方法上采用Siamese网络同时学习RGB和深度输入，包含联合学习（JL）模块提供鲁棒显著性特征学习，以及密集协作融合（DCF）模块发现互补特征。在六个挑战性数据集上，JL-DCF在S-measure指标上平均超越当时最优的D3Net约1.9%，展现出良好的泛化能力。
2004.08515|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses RGB-D salient object detection where RGB and depth are typically treated independently, leading to data-hungry or training-sensitive models. It proposes JL-DCF, a Siamese-network-based joint learning and densely-cooperative fusion framework comprising a Joint Learning module for robust saliency feature learning and a DCF module for complementary feature discovery. Experiments on six challenging datasets show an average improvement of ~1.9% in S-measure over the top-1 D3Net model, demonstrating strong generalization.
2004.08515|v2.assessment: 该工作在多模态融合策略上有一定新意，但RGB-D显著性检测与自动驾驶BEV/3D感知任务关联有限，可作为跨模态融合的参考。
2004.08515|v2.contribution: 提出联合学习与密集协作融合框架JL-DCF，实现RGB-D显著目标检测中跨模态互补特征的有效利用。
2004.08515|v2.innovation: 通过Siamese网络联合学习RGB与深度信息，并设计DCF模块发现互补特征，避免独立处理两模态的局限。
2004.08515|v2.result: 在六个数据集上S-measure平均超越D3Net约1.9%，展现出鲁棒的RGB-D显著性检测性能与良好泛化能力。

1912.05384|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对FPN在多尺度特征学习中存在的设计缺陷，即不同尺度特征间语义鸿沟大、最高层特征信息丢失以及RoI特征选择不够自适应的问题，提出了AugFPN特征金字塔架构。方法包含三个组件：一致性监督（Consistent Supervision）在融合前缩小不同尺度特征的语义差距；残差特征增强（Residual Feature Augmentation）提取比例不变上下文信息以减少最高层特征图的信息损失；软RoI选择（Soft RoI Selection）在融合后自适应学习更好的RoI特征。将Faster R-CNN中的FPN替换为AugFPN后，在ResNet50和MobileNet-v2骨干下分别取得2.3和1.6个点的AP提升。
1912.05384|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies design defects in FPN for multi-scale feature learning and proposes AugFPN, a new feature pyramid architecture with three components: Consistent Supervision to narrow semantic gaps before fusion, Residual Feature Augmentation to extract ratio-invariant context and reduce information loss at the highest pyramid level, and Soft RoI Selection for adaptive RoI feature learning after fusion. Replacing FPN with AugFPN in Faster R-CNN yields 2.3 and 1.6 points higher AP with ResNet50 and MobileNet-v2 backbones, respectively.
1912.05384|v2.assessment: AugFPN对FPN的改进系统且有效，三个组件针对性强，在标准检测基准上验证充分，对自动驾驶中的多尺度目标检测有直接参考价值。
1912.05384|v2.contribution: 提出AugFPN特征金字塔架构，通过一致性监督、残差特征增强和软RoI选择三个组件改进多尺度特征学习。
1912.05384|v2.innovation: 系统分析FPN设计缺陷并针对性设计三个互补组件，在融合前后分别解决语义鸿沟、信息丢失和RoI选择问题。
1912.05384|v2.result: 在Faster R-CNN框架下，ResNet50和MobileNet-v2骨干分别取得2.3和1.6个点的AP提升。

2003.11818|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有目标检测NAS方法仅搜索检测器某一组件（如骨干或特征融合层）而其余组件仍手动设计，导致搜索组件与手动设计组件间不一致、限制性能提升的问题，提出了层次化三位一体搜索框架Hit-Detector。方法上以端到端方式同时搜索检测器的骨干、颈部和头部三个组件的架构，并发现不同组件偏好不同算子，因此设计了自动筛选不同子搜索空间的方案以高效进行端到端搜索。搜索得到的Hit-Detector在COCO minival集上以27M参数量达到41.4% mAP。
2003.11818|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing NAS methods for object detection that search only one component while leaving others manually designed, causing inconsistency and suboptimal performance. It proposes a hierarchical trinity search framework, Hit-Detector, that simultaneously discovers architectures for backbone, neck, and head in an end-to-end manner, with a novel scheme to automatically screen different sub-search spaces for different components. The searched architecture achieves 41.4% mAP on COCO minival with 27M parameters.
2003.11818|v2.assessment: 该工作将NAS从单组件搜索推进到检测器全组件联合搜索，思路清晰且实验扎实，对自动化检测器设计有参考意义，但与自动驾驶特定场景的关联需进一步验证。
2003.11818|v2.contribution: 提出层次化三位一体搜索框架Hit-Detector，首次以端到端方式同时搜索目标检测器的骨干、颈部和头部架构。
2003.11818|v2.innovation: 发现不同检测器组件偏好不同算子，并设计自动筛选子搜索空间的方案，实现全组件高效联合搜索。
2003.11818|v2.result: 搜索得到的Hit-Detector在COCO minival集上以27M参数量达到41.4% mAP。

Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.summary_cn: 该论文针对单阶段点云3D目标检测中结构信息利用不足的问题，提出了结构感知的单阶段3D检测方法。由于摘要为空，无法确认其具体方法细节、改进点和实验数据。从标题判断，该工作应聚焦于在单阶段检测框架中引入点云结构感知能力以提升3D检测精度，但缺乏摘要信息使得无法评估其技术方案与效果。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient exploitation of structural information in single-stage point cloud 3D object detection. As the abstract is missing, the specific methodology, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be assessed. The title suggests a structure-aware single-stage 3D detection approach, but technical details and effectiveness remain unavailable.
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.assessment: 该方向与自动驾驶3D感知高度相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法创新性与实验充分度，建议获取全文后进一步判断。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.contribution: 提出结构感知的单阶段点云3D目标检测方法（具体贡献因摘要缺失无法确认）。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.innovation: 创新点因摘要缺失无法确认。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.result: 效果因摘要缺失无法确认。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D._arxiv_id: Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object Detection From Point Cloud.

1912.04986|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR等3D传感器数据本质上是2.5D、而主流表示（如PointNet）将其当作真3D点集处理从而丢失自由空间（freespace）信息的问题，提出通过3D raycasting高效恢复可见性（visibility）信息，并将其作为体素化可见性图（voxelized visibility map）作为额外输入流融入基于体素的检测网络。该方法还可与虚拟物体合成数据增强和多帧LiDAR时序聚合这两种SOTA检测器常用技巧结合。在NuScenes 3D检测基准上，加入可见性输入流显著提升了检测性能（摘要中具体数值被截断）。
1912.04986|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that LiDAR data is inherently 2.5D, yet popular representations such as PointNet treat it as truly 3D point sets, thereby discarding hidden freespace information. The authors propose to efficiently recover visibility via 3D raycasting and incorporate it as a voxelized visibility map fed as an additional input stream to voxel-based detectors, and show it composes with synthetic virtual-object augmentation and temporal LiDAR aggregation. On the NuScenes 3D detection benchmark, adding the visibility stream significantly improves detection performance.
1912.04986|v2.assessment: 该工作从2.5D数据本质出发重新审视表示问题，思路简洁且与现有体素检测器及数据增强/时序聚合兼容，对自动驾驶3D感知有实际参考价值。
1912.04986|v2.contribution: 提出将3D raycasting得到的体素化可见性图作为额外输入流，使体素检测网络显式利用自由空间信息。
1912.04986|v2.innovation: 指出2.5D传感器数据被当作真3D点集处理会丢失可见性信息，并给出可批量梯度学习的可见性恢复与融合方案。
1912.04986|v2.result: 在NuScenes 3D检测基准上，加入可见性输入流显著提升了检测性能，并与虚拟物体增强和多帧时序聚合兼容。

2011.09094|v2.summary_cn: DETR 从零训练需要超长训练周期和大量数据，本文提出无监督预训练方法 UP-DETR，通过随机查询块检测的 pretext task 预训练 transformer。具体做法是从图像中随机裁剪 patch 作为 decoder 的 query，让模型从输入图像中检测这些 query patch，并解决了多任务学习和多查询定位两个关键问题（冻结 CNN backbone、引入 attention mask 的多查询检测）。相比从零训练，UP-DETR 显著加速收敛并提升检测性能，同时为微调检测和 one-shot 检测提供统一视角。
2011.09094|v2.summary_en: DETR suffers from long training schedules and large data requirements due to training transformers from scratch. This paper proposes UP-DETR, an unsupervised pre-training method with a random query patch detection pretext task, where randomly cropped patches are fed as decoder queries and the model learns to detect them. By freezing the CNN backbone and introducing multi-query patch detection with attention masks, UP-DETR accelerates convergence and improves detection performance, also offering a unified view for fine-tuning and one-shot detection.
2011.09094|v2.assessment: 首次将无监督预训练引入 DETR 类检测器，思路清晰且对后续 DETR 预训练工作有启发意义。
2011.09094|v2.contribution: 提出随机查询块检测的无监督预训练范式，解决 DETR 训练慢、依赖大数据的问题。
2011.09094|v2.innovation: 将 NLP 中 transformer 预训练思想迁移到 DETR，设计多查询 patch 检测 pretext task 并配合 attention mask。
2011.09094|v2.result: 显著加速 DETR 收敛并提升检测性能，同时支持 one-shot 检测的统一微调。

Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.summary_cn: 该论文提出 Dynamic DETR，旨在通过动态注意力机制实现端到端目标检测。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点和实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是让 DETR 的注意力在解码过程中动态调整，以提升检测精度和效率。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.summary_en: This paper proposes Dynamic DETR for end-to-end object detection with dynamic attention. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed. The title suggests it dynamically modulates attention during decoding to improve detection accuracy and efficiency.
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.assessment: 主题与 DETR 改进方向相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献与实验充分度。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.contribution: 提出 Dynamic DETR，探索动态注意力在端到端目标检测中的应用。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.innovation: 将动态注意力机制引入 DETR 解码过程。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.result: 因摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio._arxiv_id: Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detection with Dynamic Attention.

2010.04159|v2.summary_cn: DETR 虽简化了检测流程，但存在收敛慢和特征空间分辨率受限的问题，根源在于 Transformer 注意力处理图像特征图的局限。本文提出 Deformable DETR，其注意力模块仅关注参考点周围少量采样点，从而在更少训练轮次下取得更优性能。在 COCO 基准上，Deformable DETR 以 10 倍更少的训练 epoch 超越 DETR，尤其在小目标上提升明显。
2010.04159|v2.summary_en: DETR suffers from slow convergence and limited feature spatial resolution due to the limitations of Transformer attention on image feature maps. This paper proposes Deformable DETR, whose attention modules attend only to a small set of key sampling points around a reference, achieving better performance than DETR with 10× fewer training epochs, especially on small objects. Extensive COCO experiments demonstrate its effectiveness.
2010.04159|v2.assessment: Deformable DETR 是 DETR 系列里程碑式工作，极大加速收敛并提升小目标性能，对后续检测与 BEV 感知影响深远。
2010.04159|v2.contribution: 提出可变形注意力模块，使 DETR 在 10 倍更少训练轮次下取得更优检测性能。
2010.04159|v2.innovation: 将可变形卷积的稀疏采样思想引入 Transformer 注意力，仅关注参考点周围少量采样点。
2010.04159|v2.result: 在 COCO 上以 10 倍更少训练 epoch 超越 DETR，小目标检测提升显著。

2104.02628|v2.summary_cn: 显著目标检测（SOD）与伪装目标检测（COD）任务目标相反，本文提出利用两者的矛盾信息互相增强检测能力。方法上先用 COD 数据集的易正样本作为 SOD 的难正样本提升鲁棒性，再引入相似性度量模块显式建模两任务的矛盾属性，并针对标注不确定性提出对抗学习网络实现高阶相似性度量和网络置信度估计。在基准数据集上，该方法在两个任务上均达到 SOTA。
2104.02628|v2.summary_en: Salient object detection (SOD) and camouflaged object detection (COD) have contradictory goals. This paper leverages their contradictory information to enhance both tasks: easy positives from COD serve as hard positives for SOD, a similarity measure module models their contradicting attributes, and an adversarial learning network handles labeling uncertainty for higher-order similarity and confidence estimation. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on both tasks.
2104.02628|v2.assessment: 任务组合新颖，但属于通用视觉检测范畴，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
2104.02628|v2.contribution: 提出联合 SOD 与 COD 的范式，利用矛盾信息互相增强两个任务的检测能力。
2104.02628|v2.innovation: 用 COD 易正样本增强 SOD 鲁棒性，并通过对抗学习建模矛盾属性与标注不确定性。
2104.02628|v2.result: 在 SOD 和 COD 基准数据集上均取得 SOTA 性能。

2104.02323|v2.summary_cn: 单目 3D 目标检测中，现有方法对所有目标采用统一处理策略，忽略了目标分布差异，导致截断目标性能受限。本文提出灵活框架 MonoFlex，显式解耦截断目标并自适应融合多种深度估计方法：将特征图边缘解耦以预测长尾截断目标，避免影响正常目标优化；同时将目标深度估计建模为直接回归深度与多组关键点求解深度的不确定性引导集成。在 KITTI 测试集上，中等难度相对提升 27%、困难难度提升 30%，并保持实时效率。
2104.02323|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular 3D detectors treat all objects uniformly, limiting performance on truncated objects. This paper proposes MonoFlex, a flexible framework that explicitly decouples truncated objects and adaptively combines multiple depth estimation approaches: decoupling feature map edges for long-tail truncated objects, and formulating depth estimation as an uncertainty-guided ensemble of direct regression and keypoint-solved depths. It outperforms state-of-the-art by 27% (moderate) and 30% (hard) on KITTI while maintaining real-time efficiency.
2104.02323|v2.assessment: 针对单目 3D 检测中截断目标这一痛点提出解耦与不确定性集成方案，KITTI 提升显著且实时，对自动驾驶单目感知有直接参考价值。
2104.02323|v2.contribution: 提出 MonoFlex 灵活框架，解耦截断目标并自适应融合多种深度估计方法。
2104.02323|v2.innovation: 将特征图边缘解耦处理长尾截断目标，并用不确定性引导集成直接回归与关键点求解深度。
2104.02323|v2.result: KITTI 测试集中等难度相对提升 27%、困难难度提升 30%，保持实时效率。

2103.11402|v2.summary_cn: 监督目标检测依赖大量人工标注，半监督目标检测（SSOD）可利用无标注数据提升性能。本文提出 Instant-Teaching，一个完全端到端的 SSOD 框架，在每次训练迭代中使用即时伪标签和扩展的弱-强数据增强进行教学；并进一步提出基于协同矫正的 Instant-Teaching* 以缓解确认偏差、提升伪标注质量。在 MS-COCO 上使用 2% 标注数据时超越 SOTA 4.2 mAP，全监督设置下仍超出约 1.0 mAP；在 PASCAL VOC 上通过 VOC07 提升超过 5 mAP。
2103.11402|v2.summary_en: Semi-supervised object detection (SSOD) leverages unlabeled data to reduce annotation cost. This paper proposes Instant-Teaching, a fully end-to-end SSOD framework using instant pseudo labeling with extended weak-strong augmentations at each iteration, and Instant-Teaching* with a co-rectify scheme to alleviate confirmation bias. It surpasses state-of-the-art by 4.2 mAP on MS-COCO with 2% labels, still outperforms by ~1.0 mAP under full supervision, and achieves >5 mAP improvement on PASCAL VOC.
2103.11402|v2.assessment: 端到端半监督检测框架设计简洁有效，在低标注场景提升显著，对降低自动驾驶数据标注成本有实用价值。
2103.11402|v2.contribution: 提出完全端到端的半监督目标检测框架 Instant-Teaching 及其协同矫正版本。
2103.11402|v2.innovation: 即时伪标签配合扩展弱-强数据增强，并通过协同矫正缓解确认偏差。
2103.11402|v2.result: MS-COCO 2% 标注下超 SOTA 4.2 mAP，全监督下仍超约 1.0 mAP，PASCAL VOC 提升超 5 mAP。

2104.07434|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱半监督目标检测中标注成本高的问题，提出了一种新的点标注设置，即少量全标注图像加大量点标注图像。为此设计了Point DETR，在DETR基础上增加点编码器以充分利用点标注。在MS-COCO上，使用20%全标注数据时达到33.3 AP，比FCOS基线高2.0 AP，且点标注在多个AR指标上带来超过10个点的提升。
2104.07434|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a point-annotated setting for weakly semi-supervised object detection, combining a small fully annotated set with a large point-annotated set. It proposes Point DETR, which extends DETR with a point encoder to better exploit point annotations. On MS-COCO with 20% fully labeled data, it achieves 33.3 AP, outperforming FCOS by 2.0 AP, and point annotations bring over 10 points in AR metrics.
2104.07434|v2.assessment: 该工作为降低目标检测标注成本提供了新思路，点标注设置实用且方法有效，实验充分，值得关注。
2104.07434|v2.contribution: 提出了点标注的弱半监督检测设置及Point DETR检测器。
2104.07434|v2.innovation: 在DETR中引入点编码器，有效利用点标注信息。
2104.07434|v2.result: 在COCO上20%全标注数据下达到33.3 AP，超越FCOS 2.0 AP，AR指标提升超10点。

2103.17202|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中NMS仅在推理阶段使用导致训练与推理不匹配的问题，提出了GrooMeD-NMS，一种分组可微NMS。将NMS公式化为矩阵操作，并通过分组和掩码获得闭式表达，使网络能够端到端训练并优化NMS后的框。在KITTI基准上取得了单目3D检测的最优结果，性能与基于视频的方法相当。
2103.17202|v2.summary_en: To address the mismatch between training and inference in monocular 3D detection due to NMS being used only at inference, this paper proposes GrooMeD-NMS, a grouped mathematically differentiable NMS. It formulates NMS as a matrix operation with a closed-form expression via grouping and masking, enabling end-to-end training with a loss on post-NMS boxes. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection on KITTI, comparable to video-based methods.
2103.17202|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将NMS可微化并集成到训练中，解决了训练推理不一致问题，对单目3D检测有重要推动。
2103.17202|v2.contribution: 提出了可微的GrooMeD-NMS并用于单目3D检测的端到端训练。
2103.17202|v2.innovation: 将NMS表达为分组矩阵操作，实现可微且闭式。
2103.17202|v2.result: 在KITTI上达到单目3D检测最优，性能媲美视频方法。

2012.04355|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测标注成本高的问题，提出了3DIoUMatch，一种适用于室内外场景的半监督3D检测方法。采用教师-学生互学习框架生成伪标签，并引入基于预测物体性和类别概率的置信度过滤，进一步提出使用估计的3D IoU作为定位度量并设置类别自适应阈值过滤低质量伪标签。在室内VoteNet和室外KITTI上均取得一致提升。
2012.04355|v2.summary_en: To reduce the annotation burden in 3D object detection, this paper proposes 3DIoUMatch, a semi-supervised method for both indoor and outdoor scenes. It uses a teacher-student mutual learning framework to generate pseudo-labels, with confidence-based filtering and a novel 3D IoU-based localization metric with category-aware self-adjusted thresholds. It consistently improves performance on indoor (VoteNet) and outdoor (KITTI) datasets.
2012.04355|v2.assessment: 该工作有效利用3D IoU进行伪标签过滤，显著提升了半监督3D检测性能，对降低标注成本有重要意义。
2012.04355|v2.contribution: 提出了基于3D IoU的半监督3D检测框架3DIoUMatch。
2012.04355|v2.innovation: 引入3D IoU作为定位度量并设计类别自适应阈值过滤伪标签。
2012.04355|v2.result: 在室内外数据集上均取得一致的性能提升。

2106.11346|v2.summary_cn: 针对不同下游任务对预训练模型的需求差异，提出了GAIA，一个目标检测迁移学习系统。该系统能自动提供强大的预训练权重、根据延迟约束和数据域选择模型，并为数据稀缺的任务收集相关数据。在COCO、Objects365、Open Images等多个数据集上取得良好结果，例如在COCO上能高效生成覆盖广泛延迟范围的模型。
2106.11346|v2.summary_en: To address diverse downstream requirements in object detection, this paper presents GAIA, a transfer learning system that automatically provides pre-trained weights, selects models based on latency and domain, and collects relevant data for tasks with few datapoints. It achieves promising results on COCO, Objects365, Open Images, and other datasets, efficiently producing models covering a wide range of latency constraints.
2106.11346|v2.assessment: GAIA作为一个实用的迁移学习系统，能自动化适配不同需求，对工业应用有较大价值，但学术创新性相对有限。
2106.11346|v2.contribution: 提出了自动化目标检测迁移学习系统GAIA。
2106.11346|v2.innovation: 集成预训练权重提供、模型选择和自动数据收集。
2106.11346|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得良好结果，能高效生成满足不同延迟的模型。

2106.13381|v2.summary_cn: 针对距离图像中的3D目标检测，提出了一种直接从距离图像视图学习3D表示的方法。设计了一种2D卷积网络架构，在网络中携带每个像素的3D球坐标，并可使用任意卷积核（如Transformer、PointNet、Edge Convolution）来利用局部几何。在Waymo开放数据集上，行人检测AP从69.7%提升至75.5%，且最小模型比PointPillars在质量和效率上更优，FLOPS和参数量少180倍。
2106.13381|v2.summary_en: For 3D object detection in range images, this paper proposes learning a 3D representation directly from the range image view. It designs a 2D convolutional network that carries 3D spherical coordinates and can use arbitrary convolution kernels (Transformer, PointNet, Edge Convolution) to exploit local geometry. On Waymo Open Dataset, it improves pedestrian AP from 69.7% to 75.5%, and its smallest model outperforms PointPillars with 180x fewer FLOPS and parameters.
2106.13381|v2.assessment: 该方法在距离图像上高效地实现了3D检测，性能提升显著且计算效率高，对自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
2106.13381|v2.contribution: 提出了在距离图像上使用图卷积核的3D检测方法。
2106.13381|v2.innovation: 在网络中携带3D球坐标并支持多种卷积核。

2103.12605|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中依赖难以获取的物体几何真值的问题，提出了MonoRUn，一种自监督学习密集对应和几何的检测框架，仅需简单的3D框标注。采用区域重建网络回归像素相关的3D物体坐标，并引入不确定性感知。通过将预测的3D坐标投影回图像平面，提出Robust KL损失最小化不确定性加权的重投影误差。测试时利用不确定性传播，使用不确定性驱动的PnP算法估计物体位姿及协方差。在KITTI上取得了有竞争力的结果。
2103.12605|v2.summary_en: To address the reliance on hard-to-obtain object geometry ground truth in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes MonoRUn, a framework that learns dense correspondences and geometry self-supervisedly with only 3D bounding box annotations. It employs a regional reconstruction network with uncertainty awareness and a Robust KL loss to minimize uncertainty-weighted reprojection error. During testing, uncertainty is propagated through an uncertainty-driven PnP for pose and covariance estimation, achieving competitive results on KITTI.
2103.12605|v2.assessment: MonoRUn通过自监督和不确定性传播，减少了对几何真值的依赖，提升了单目3D检测的实用性，值得关注。
2103.12605|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督学习密集对应和几何的单目3D检测框架MonoRUn。
2103.12605|v2.innovation: 引入不确定性感知的重建网络和Robust KL损失，以及不确定性驱动的PnP。
2103.12605|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得了有竞争力的单目3D检测结果。

Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.summary_cn: ①针对单样本目标检测（one-shot object detection）中查询图像与目标图像外观差异大、难以泛化的问题；②提出自适应图像Transformer（Adaptive Image Transformer），通过动态调整注意力机制来对齐查询与目标特征；③相比固定注意力或元学习的方法，能更灵活地适应新类别；④摘要未提供具体数据集上的量化结果，但声称在多个基准上取得改进。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.summary_en: This paper addresses one-shot object detection where large appearance gaps between query and target images hinder generalization. It proposes an Adaptive Image Transformer that dynamically adjusts attention to align query and target features. Compared to fixed-attention or meta-learning approaches, it adapts more flexibly to novel categories, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.assessment: 将Transformer的自适应机制引入单样本检测，思路新颖，但缺乏实验数据支撑，需进一步验证。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.contribution: 提出自适应图像Transformer用于单样本目标检测。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.innovation: 动态调整注意力以对齐查询与目标特征。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot._arxiv_id: Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot Object Detection.

2103.16148|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测模型对抗攻击鲁棒性差、现有防御方法多针对分类任务的问题；②提出类感知鲁棒对抗训练范式，生成同时攻击图像中所有目标的通用对抗扰动，并将总损失分解为类加权损失以平衡各类影响；③相比先前防御方法，能更均匀地提升所有类别的鲁棒性；④摘要未给出具体数值，但声称有效且均衡地提升了对抗鲁棒性。
2103.16148|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of robustness of object detectors against adversarial attacks, noting that prior defenses focus on classification. It proposes a class-aware robust adversarial training paradigm that generates universal perturbations to attack all objects simultaneously and decomposes the total loss into class-wise losses normalized by class object counts. Compared to previous defenses, it improves robustness more evenly across all classes, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2103.16148|v2.assessment: 针对目标检测对抗鲁棒性的系统性工作，类加权损失设计合理，对自动驾驶安全有实际意义。
2103.16148|v2.contribution: 提出类感知鲁棒对抗训练范式用于目标检测。
2103.16148|v2.innovation: 通用对抗扰动与类加权损失分解相结合。
2103.16148|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称有效提升各类别鲁棒性。

2103.17220|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中数据增强策略依赖人工设计、自动化搜索效率低的问题；②提出Scale-aware AutoAug，定义尺度感知搜索空间（图像级和框级增强），并设计Pareto Scale Balance搜索指标以高效搜索；③相比现有多尺度训练和自动增强方法，搜索成本更低且策略可迁移；④在RetinaNet、Faster R-CNN、Mask R-CNN、FCOS上取得显著且一致的提升，搜索策略可迁移至实例分割和关键点估计。
2103.17220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design and inefficiency of data augmentation policies for object detection. It proposes Scale-aware AutoAug, which defines a scale-aware search space with image- and box-level augmentations and a Pareto Scale Balance metric for efficient search. Compared to multi-scale training and prior AutoAugment methods, it achieves lower search cost and transferable policies, yielding significant and consistent improvements on RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, and FCOS, and transferring to instance segmentation and keypoint estimation.
2103.17220|v2.assessment: 自动化增强在检测任务上的重要进展，搜索空间和指标设计有针对性，实验充分且策略可迁移。
2103.17220|v2.contribution: 提出尺度感知自动增强策略Scale-aware AutoAug。
2103.17220|v2.innovation: 尺度感知搜索空间与Pareto Scale Balance搜索指标。
2103.17220|v2.result: 在多个检测器上取得显著提升，搜索成本低于先前方法。

2007.06919|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测模型在边缘设备上低比特量化时性能严重下降且硬件效率难以验证的问题；②提出AQD（Accurate Quantized object Detection），在所有层（卷积、归一化、跳跃连接）使用定点运算，实现纯整数推理；③相比现有量化方法，在极低比特（如2-bit）下仍保持与全精度相当甚至更好的性能；④在MS-COCO上，RetinaNet和FCOS在极低比特下达到与全精度相当或更优的性能，具有实际部署价值。
2007.06919|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses severe performance degradation and unverifiable efficiency of low-bit quantization for object detection on edge devices. It proposes AQD, which uses fixed-point operations in all layers (convolution, normalization, skip connections) to enable integer-only inference. Compared to prior quantization methods, AQD achieves comparable or even better performance than full-precision counterparts under extremely low-bit schemes (e.g., 2-bit) on MS-COCO with RetinaNet and FCOS, demonstrating practical value.
2007.06919|v2.assessment: 面向边缘部署的实用量化方案，全整数推理设计彻底，实验验证充分，对自动驾驶感知部署有参考价值。
2007.06919|v2.contribution: 提出全整数推理的量化目标检测方案AQD。
2007.06919|v2.innovation: 所有层采用定点运算实现纯整数推理。
2007.06919|v2.result: 在MS-COCO上极低比特下达到与全精度相当或更优性能。

2103.13886|v2.summary_cn: ①针对数据增强在目标检测中潜力未被充分挖掘、分类器增强收益在检测微调后消失的问题；②提出在检测器微调阶段引入对抗样本作为模型相关数据增强，动态选择来自分类和定位分支的更强对抗图像，并随检测器进化；③相比AutoAugment等模型无关增强，该方法能更好地泛化到不同检测器；④在COCO上使EfficientDets提升+1.1 mAP，并改善鲁棒性。
2103.13886|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored potential of data augmentation for object detection and the diminishing gains from classifier augmentations after fine-tuning. It proposes augmenting the fine-tuning stage with adversarial examples as model-dependent data augmentation, dynamically selecting stronger adversarial images from classification and localization branches and evolving with the detector. Compared to model-agnostic AutoAugment, it generalizes better across detectors, boosting EfficientDets by +1.1 mAP on COCO and improving robustness.
2103.13886|v2.assessment: 将对抗学习与数据增强结合用于检测微调，方法简洁有效，实验提升明显，对鲁棒检测有启发。
2103.13886|v2.contribution: 提出基于对抗学习的检测微调增强方法。
2103.13886|v2.innovation: 动态选择分类与定位分支的对抗样本作为模型相关增强。
2103.13886|v2.result: 在COCO上提升EfficientDets +1.1 mAP并改善鲁棒性。

2104.06114|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D检测中Hough投票方法仅能获得部分表面投票且存在严重离群投票、信息利用不充分的问题；②提出BRNet（Back-tracing Representative Points Network），从投票中心反向回溯代表点并重新访问周围互补种子点，以捕获原始点云中潜在物体的精细局部结构；③相比现有投票策略，通过自底向上再自顶向下的策略强制预测投票中心与原始表面点之间的一致性；④摘要未提供具体数值，但声称实现更可靠和灵活的物体定位。
2104.06114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of Hough voting in point cloud 3D detection, where only partial surface votes and severe outliers are obtained, hindering full utilization of input information. It proposes BRNet, which back-traces representative points from vote centers and revisits complementary seed points to capture fine local structures from raw point clouds. Compared to existing voting strategies, the bottom-up then top-down approach enforces mutual consistency between predicted vote centers and raw surface points, achieving more reliable and flexible object localization, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2104.06114|v2.assessment: 针对点云投票检测的痛点提出回溯策略，思路清晰，对3D检测研究者有参考价值。
2104.06114|v2.contribution: 提出回溯代表点网络BRNet用于点云3D检测。
2104.06114|v2.innovation: 从投票中心反向回溯并重访互补种子点以增强局部特征。
2104.06114|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称实现更可靠定位。

2106.08322|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对目标检测头中分类与定位耦合、缺乏统一视角的问题，提出Dynamic Head框架，将尺度感知（特征层级间）、空间感知（空间位置间）和任务感知（输出通道内）三种自注意力机制统一到检测头中。相比已有检测头改进方法，该方法不增加额外计算开销即可显著提升表示能力。在COCO基准上，使用ResNeXt-101-DCN骨干达到54.0 AP的新SOTA，结合Transformer骨干和额外数据进一步将最佳结果推至60.6 AP。
2106.08322|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified view for object detection heads by proposing the Dynamic Head framework, which coherently combines scale-aware, spatial-aware, and task-aware self-attention mechanisms within the detection head without computational overhead. On COCO, it achieves a new state-of-the-art of 54.0 AP with ResNeXt-101-DCN, and further pushes the best result to 60.6 AP with a transformer backbone and extra data.
2106.08322|v2.assessment: 该工作以简洁的注意力统一视角显著提升检测头表示能力，且不增加计算量，对检测领域具有重要参考价值。
2106.08322|v2.contribution: 提出统一尺度、空间与任务注意力的Dynamic Head检测头框架。
2106.08322|v2.innovation: 在检测头中无额外开销地融合三种自注意力机制。
2106.08322|v2.result: COCO上达到54.0 AP，结合Transformer骨干和额外数据达60.6 AP。

2103.02340|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对检测蒸馏方法泛化性弱且过度依赖GT、忽略实例间关系信息的问题，提出通用实例蒸馏（GID），不区分GT正负样本，通过通用实例选择模块（GISM）综合利用特征、关系和响应知识进行蒸馏。相比已有方法，GID在不同检测框架上均能显著提升学生模型AP，甚至超越教师。在COCO上，ResNet-50的RetinaNet使用GID达到39.1% mAP，超过基线36.2%达2.9%，并优于ResNet-101教师模型的38.1% AP。
2103.02340|v2.summary_en: To address weak generalization and heavy GT reliance in detection distillation, this paper proposes General Instance Distillation (GID), which selects discriminative instances without GT-based positive/negative distinction and distills feature-, relation-, and response-based knowledge via a general instance selection module. On COCO, RetinaNet with ResNet-50 achieves 39.1% mAP, surpassing the 36.2% baseline by 2.9% and even outperforming the ResNet-101 teacher at 38.1% AP.
2103.02340|v2.assessment: 该工作提出不依赖GT的通用实例蒸馏框架，在多种检测器上验证有效，对模型压缩与检测蒸馏研究有实用价值。
2103.02340|v2.contribution: 提出不依赖GT正负区分的通用实例蒸馏方法GID。
2103.02340|v2.innovation: 通过通用实例选择模块融合特征、关系与响应知识进行蒸馏。
2103.02340|v2.result: RetinaNet ResNet-50在COCO上达39.1% mAP，超基线2.9%并超越教师模型。

2104.01108|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对共显著目标检测（Co-SOD）问题，提出组协作学习框架GCoNet，通过组亲和模块挖掘组内紧凑性以捕捉共显著目标的共享属性，并通过组协作模块增强组间可分性以抑制噪声目标影响，同时引入辅助分类监督优化嵌入空间。在CoCA、CoSOD3k和Cosal2015三个基准上，GCoNet以16ms实时速度超越10个前沿模型并达到新SOTA。
2104.01108|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses co-salient object detection by proposing the Group Collaborative Learning framework (GCoNet), which mines intra-group compactness via a group affinity module and enforces inter-group separability via a group collaborating module, with auxiliary classification supervision. On CoCA, CoSOD3k, and Cosal2015, GCoNet outperforms 10 cutting-edge models and achieves new state-of-the-art at 16ms real-time speed.
2104.01108|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦共显著目标检测，与自动驾驶/3D感知领域相关度较低，但方法设计简洁有效，在Co-SOD任务上表现突出。
2104.01108|v2.contribution: 提出组协作学习框架GCoNet用于共显著目标检测。
2104.01108|v2.innovation: 通过组亲和与组协作模块同时优化组内紧凑性和组间可分性。
2104.01108|v2.result: 在三个基准上超越10个模型，达到新SOTA，推理速度16ms。

2105.09491|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对少样本目标检测中仅关注新类性能而忽略基类遗忘的问题，提出Retentive R-CNN，包含Bias-Balanced RPN以去偏预训练RPN，以及Re-detector以在不遗忘旧知识的情况下检测少样本类。相比已有方法，该方法在所有设置下整体性能显著超越SOTA，在少样本类上取得竞争性结果且完全不降低基类性能。
2105.09491|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting in few-shot object detection, this paper proposes Retentive R-CNN, consisting of a Bias-Balanced RPN to debias the pretrained RPN and a Re-detector to detect few-shot classes without forgetting base knowledge. Extensive experiments show it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on overall performance across all settings, achieving competitive few-shot results without degrading base class performance.
2105.09491|v2.assessment: 该工作强调少样本检测中不遗忘基类的重要性，提出的Retentive R-CNN简单有效，对实际部署中的增量检测有参考意义。
2105.09491|v2.contribution: 提出Retentive R-CNN实现少样本目标检测且不遗忘基类。
2105.09491|v2.innovation: 通过Bias-Balanced RPN和Re-detector解耦少样本学习与基类保持。
2105.09491|v2.result: 在所有设置下整体性能超越SOTA，基类性能无下降。
