2203.15118|v2.summary_en: This paper targets LiDAR-based 3D object detection under snowfall, where collecting and annotating training data is difficult. It proposes a physically based simulation that samples snow particles in 2D for each LiDAR line and modifies beam measurements via induced geometry, additionally simulating ground wetness. Training detectors on the resulting partially synthetic snowy data yields consistent and significant gains on the real snowy STF dataset over clear-weather baselines and competing simulation approaches.
2203.15118|v2.assessment: 物理建模的降雪模拟为恶劣天气鲁棒3D检测提供了低成本数据增广方案，实验在真实雪天数据上验证有效，实用性强。
2203.15118|v2.contribution: 提出基于物理的LiDAR降雪与地面湿滑模拟方法，用于生成雪天训练数据提升3D检测鲁棒性。
2203.15118|v2.innovation: 按LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并据其几何修改各激光束测量，同时建模地面湿滑效应。
2203.15118|v2.result: 在真实雪天STF数据集上，相比晴天基线与竞争模拟方法均取得显著性能提升。

2203.10314|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对点云3D目标检测中体素化方法计算量大、稀疏卷积感受野受限的问题，提出Voxel Set Transformer（VoxSeT），将体素特征建模为集合到集合的Transformer范式。方法在体素集合上应用自注意力以捕获长程依赖，并通过分组与采样策略控制计算开销，从而在保持高效的同时扩大有效感受野。该工作为点云3D检测提供了Transformer化的体素处理新思路，在主流检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度与效率表现。
2203.10314|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation and limited receptive fields of voxel-based 3D detection by proposing Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSeT), which formulates voxel feature processing as a set-to-set Transformer. Self-attention over voxel sets captures long-range dependencies, while grouping and sampling strategies keep computation tractable. The approach offers a Transformer-based alternative for voxel processing in point cloud 3D detection with competitive accuracy and efficiency.
2203.10314|v2.assessment: 将Transformer集合建模引入体素3D检测，兼顾长程依赖与效率，是该方向有代表性的架构探索。
2203.10314|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Set Transformer，以集合到集合的Transformer范式处理体素特征用于点云3D检测。
2203.10314|v2.innovation: 在体素集合上施加自注意力并配合分组采样策略，在可控计算量下扩大感受野。
2203.10314|v2.result: 在主流点云3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度与效率表现。

2203.05662|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云中目标点密度随距离剧烈变化、影响体素特征表达与3D检测精度的问题，本文提出点密度感知的体素方法（Point Density-Aware Voxels）。方法显式估计并利用体素内的点密度信息来调制体素特征编码与检测头预测，使网络对不同距离、不同稀疏程度的目标具有自适应能力。该设计可集成到现有体素检测框架中，在LiDAR 3D检测基准上相比密度无关的基线取得稳定提升。
2203.05662|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the strong distance-dependent variation of point density in LiDAR point clouds, which degrades voxel feature representation and 3D detection accuracy. It proposes point density-aware voxels that explicitly estimate and exploit per-voxel point density to modulate voxel feature encoding and detection head predictions, making the network adaptive to targets at varying ranges and sparsity levels. The design integrates into existing voxel-based detectors and yields consistent gains over density-agnostic baselines.
2203.05662|v2.assessment: 点密度是LiDAR检测中长期被忽视的关键因素，本文的密度感知建模思路简洁有效，对远距离目标检测有实际意义。
2203.05662|v2.contribution: 提出点密度感知的体素特征编码与检测方法，显式利用体素内点密度信息提升LiDAR 3D检测。
2203.05662|v2.innovation: 将逐体素点密度估计引入特征调制与检测头预测，使网络自适应不同距离与稀疏程度的目标。
2203.05662|v2.result: 在LiDAR 3D检测基准上相比密度无关基线取得稳定性能提升。

Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_cn: 该论文研究多LiDAR传感器布局对自动驾驶3D目标检测性能的影响。作者通过在不同车辆位置配置多个LiDAR并采集数据，系统评估了传感器数量、位置和视角对检测精度的影响。相比已有工作通常只关注单LiDAR或固定布局，本文首次全面量化了多LiDAR布局的增益与冗余。实验表明合理的多LiDAR布局能显著提升检测性能，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_en: This paper investigates how multi-LiDAR placement affects 3D object detection for autonomous driving. The authors systematically evaluate the impact of sensor number, position, and viewpoint by configuring multiple LiDARs at different vehicle locations. Unlike prior work focusing on single or fixed LiDAR setups, this work quantifies the gains and redundancy of multi-LiDAR layouts, showing that proper placement significantly improves detection performance.
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.assessment: 为多传感器融合和自动驾驶感知系统设计提供了重要的实证指导，值得传感器配置研究者关注。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.contribution: 系统量化了多LiDAR布局对3D目标检测性能的影响。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.innovation: 首次全面评估传感器数量、位置和视角对检测精度的联合作用。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.result: 合理的多LiDAR布局能显著提升检测性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR._arxiv_id: Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR Placement on Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

2203.10981|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中依赖外部深度估计器带来的额外计算负担和深度先验不准确问题，本文提出MonoDTR，一种端到端的深度感知Transformer网络。其核心包括深度感知特征增强模块（DFE）和深度感知Transformer模块（DTR），前者通过辅助监督隐式学习深度特征而无需额外计算，后者全局整合上下文与深度特征；同时引入深度位置编码（DPE）替代传统像素位置编码。在KITTI数据集上，该方法超越了此前最优的单目方法，且模块可即插即用。
2203.10981|v2.summary_en: To address the extra computation and inaccurate depth priors from off-the-shelf depth estimators in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes MonoDTR, an end-to-end depth-aware transformer network. It consists of a Depth-Aware Feature Enhancement (DFE) module that implicitly learns depth features with auxiliary supervision, and a Depth-Aware Transformer (DTR) module that globally integrates context and depth features, along with a novel depth positional encoding (DPE). Experiments on KITTI show it outperforms previous state-of-the-art monocular methods, and the modules are plug-and-play.
2203.10981|v2.assessment: 在单目3D检测中巧妙融合深度信息与Transformer，性能提升明显且方法通用性强，值得关注。
2203.10981|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度感知Transformer网络MonoDTR，无需额外深度估计器。
2203.10981|v2.innovation: 深度感知特征增强与深度位置编码，隐式利用深度线索并全局整合。
2203.10981|v2.result: 在KITTI上超越此前最优单目方法，模块可即插即用。

3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中的域泛化问题，提出3D-VField方法，通过对点云进行对抗性增强来提升模型在未见域上的泛化能力。作者设计了一种可变形点云生成策略，在保持物体语义的同时模拟不同传感器和场景的分布变化。相比传统数据增强，该方法能更有效地缩小域间差距。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但表明在多个域泛化基准上取得了改进。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_en: This paper addresses domain generalization in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-VField, an adversarial augmentation method for point clouds. It generates deformable point clouds that preserve object semantics while simulating distribution shifts across sensors and scenes. Compared to conventional data augmentation, it better bridges domain gaps, though specific experimental numbers are not provided in the abstract.
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.assessment: 为点云域泛化提供了新颖的对抗增强思路，对自动驾驶跨域部署有参考价值。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.contribution: 提出对抗性点云增强方法3D-VField以提升3D检测域泛化。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.innovation: 通过可变形点云生成模拟域偏移，保持语义的同时增强泛化。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.result: 在多个域泛化基准上取得改进，但摘要未给出具体数据。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P._arxiv_id: 3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of Point Clouds for Domain Generalization in 3D Object Detection.

2205.14882|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测与2D多目标跟踪分离导致不确定性无法传递和跟踪误差无法回传的问题，本文提出Time3D，首次实现从单目视频端到端联合训练3D检测与3D跟踪。核心是时空信息流模块，利用Transformer的自注意力聚合单帧空间信息，交叉注意力建模时序帧中所有物体的关联与相似度，并引入时序一致性损失将3D目标运动建模融入学习。在KITTI等数据集上，该方法在检测和跟踪指标上均优于分离式基线。
2205.14882|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that separate monocular 3D detection and 2D tracking cannot propagate uncertainty or back-propagate tracking errors, this paper proposes Time3D, the first end-to-end joint training of 3D detection and 3D tracking from monocular videos. It introduces a spatial-temporal information flow module using transformer self-attention for spatial aggregation and cross-attention for temporal association, along with a temporal consistency loss for 3D motion modeling. Experiments on KITTI show improvements over decoupled baselines in both detection and tracking metrics.
2205.14882|v2.assessment: 首次实现单目3D检测与跟踪的端到端联合学习，思路新颖且性能提升显著，值得跟踪领域研究者关注。
2205.14882|v2.contribution: 提出端到端联合单目3D检测与3D跟踪框架Time3D。
2205.14882|v2.innovation: 时空信息流模块与时序一致性损失，实现检测与跟踪的双向信息传递。
2205.14882|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上检测和跟踪指标均优于分离式基线。

2205.15938|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中体素特征融合问题，提出Voxel Field Fusion方法，通过在不同体素场之间进行特征融合来提升检测精度。作者设计了一种跨体素场的特征交互机制，有效结合了稀疏与密集体素表示的优势。相比单一体素表示，该方法能更充分地利用空间信息。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但表明在多个3D检测基准上取得了性能提升。
2205.15938|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses voxel feature fusion in 3D object detection by proposing Voxel Field Fusion, which fuses features across different voxel fields. It designs a cross-field feature interaction mechanism that combines the strengths of sparse and dense voxel representations. Compared to single voxel representations, it better exploits spatial information, though specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
2205.15938|v2.assessment: 为3D检测中的体素特征融合提供了新视角，对点云检测研究者有参考价值。
2205.15938|v2.contribution: 提出跨体素场特征融合方法Voxel Field Fusion。
2205.15938|v2.innovation: 设计跨体素场的特征交互机制，结合稀疏与密集表示优势。
2205.15938|v2.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得性能提升，但摘要未给出具体数据。

2205.09373|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度线索利用不充分导致可靠性不足的问题，本文提出一种充分利用深度线索的方法，强调多样性在深度估计中的重要性。作者设计了多源深度线索融合策略，通过多样化的深度预测与不确定性建模来提升检测可靠性。相比仅依赖单一深度估计的方法，该工作显著增强了深度信息的鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数据，但表明在KITTI等基准上取得了领先性能。
2205.09373|v2.summary_en: To address insufficient exploitation of depth cues in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes a method that fully leverages depth clues and emphasizes the importance of diversity. It designs a multi-source depth cue fusion strategy with uncertainty modeling to improve detection reliability. Compared to methods relying on a single depth estimator, it significantly enhances depth robustness, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2205.09373|v2.assessment: 强调深度线索多样性，为单目3D检测的可靠性提升提供了新思路，值得关注。
2205.09373|v2.contribution: 提出充分利用深度线索的可靠单目3D检测方法。
2205.09373|v2.innovation: 多源深度线索融合与多样性建模，提升深度估计鲁棒性。
2205.09373|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得领先性能，但摘要未给出具体数据。

2203.08195|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中激光雷达点云与相机图像融合不充分、现有方法仅在BEV或单阶段做简单拼接的问题，提出DeepFusion框架，包含可学习的对齐与融合模块（Learnable Alignment）以及InverseAug数据增强以缓解几何错位。相比PointPainting等只在点级或BEV级融合的方法，DeepFusion在特征层级实现点-像素的语义对齐融合。在nuScenes和Waymo上取得显著提升，Waymo上mAP相对提升约6.7%，nuScenes上也有稳定增益，并可作为通用插件提升多种基线。
2203.08195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient lidar-camera fusion in multi-modal 3D detection, where prior methods fuse only at the point or BEV level. It proposes DeepFusion with a learnable alignment-and-fusion module and InverseAug to handle geometric misalignment. It outperforms PointPainting-style baselines, improving Waymo mAP by roughly 6.7% and consistently boosting nuScenes results as a plug-in.
2203.08195|v2.assessment: 多模态3D检测的经典工作，融合模块设计简洁通用，实验覆盖Waymo/nuScenes两大基准，对自动驾驶感知研究者有直接参考价值。
2203.08195|v2.contribution: 提出可学习的点-像素对齐融合模块与InverseAug增强，构建通用多模态3D检测框架。
2203.08195|v2.innovation: 在特征层级实现点云与图像的可学习语义对齐融合，而非简单的点级或BEV级拼接。
2203.08195|v2.result: 在Waymo上mAP相对提升约6.7%，nuScenes上稳定增益，可作为插件提升多种基线。

2203.08563|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计与语义信息耦合不足、几何约束弱的问题，提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何的代价体（Joint Semantic and Geometric Cost Volume），通过迭代细化同时优化深度与语义特征。相比仅依赖几何或仅依赖语义的代价体方法，MonoJSG在KITTI上取得领先，3D检测AP较基线提升明显（约1-2个点），并在nuScenes上验证了泛化性。
2203.08563|v2.summary_en: This paper targets weak coupling of depth and semantics in monocular 3D detection. It proposes MonoJSG, a joint semantic and geometric cost volume with iterative refinement of depth and semantic features. It outperforms geometry-only or semantics-only cost-volume methods, achieving leading KITTI 3D AP with roughly 1-2 point gains and demonstrating generalization on nuScenes.
2203.08563|v2.assessment: 单目3D检测中代价体设计的代表性改进，语义与几何联合建模思路清晰，KITTI结果有竞争力。
2203.08563|v2.contribution: 提出联合语义与几何的代价体用于单目3D检测。
2203.08563|v2.innovation: 将语义特征与几何深度代价体联合迭代细化，缓解单一信息源的歧义。
2203.08563|v2.result: 在KITTI上3D检测AP较基线提升约1-2个点，nuScenes上验证泛化性。

Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中几何一致性建模不足、深度与2D-3D投影约束未被充分利用的问题，提出显式探索几何一致性的方法，通过构建几何一致性约束与损失来提升定位精度。相比依赖额外深度网络或伪激光雷达的方法，该方法更轻量且直接约束几何关系。在KITTI基准上取得有竞争力的结果，3D检测AP提升明显，尤其在中远距离目标上改善显著。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient geometric consistency modeling in monocular 3D detection. It explicitly explores geometric consistency constraints and losses to improve localization. Unlike methods relying on extra depth networks or pseudo-lidar, it is lightweight and directly enforces geometric relations, achieving competitive KITTI 3D AP with notable gains at medium-to-far ranges.
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.assessment: 几何一致性是单目3D检测的关键痛点，该工作提供了直接且有效的约束思路，对相关研究者有启发。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.contribution: 显式建模并利用几何一致性约束提升单目3D检测定位精度。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.innovation: 以几何一致性损失直接约束2D-3D投影关系，避免依赖额外深度估计网络。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.result: 在KITTI上取得有竞争力的3D AP，中远距离目标改善显著。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometric Consistency for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对3D点云检测中全监督标注成本高昂的问题，提出稀疏监督设定SS3D，仅需少量标注框即可训练检测器。方法通过稀疏监督下的伪标签生成与一致性约束，结合稀疏到稠密的训练策略提升检测性能。相比半监督或弱监督方法，SS3D在极少标注下仍保持较高精度，在KITTI上使用约2%标注即可接近全监督性能。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost of fully supervised 3D point cloud detection by proposing SS3D, a sparsely-supervised setting requiring only a few labeled boxes. It combines pseudo-label generation and consistency constraints with a sparse-to-dense training strategy. It approaches fully-supervised performance on KITTI with roughly 2% labels, outperforming semi-/weakly-supervised counterparts.
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.assessment: 降低3D检测标注成本是实用方向，稀疏监督设定新颖，结果对数据高效感知研究有参考价值。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出稀疏监督3D点云检测设定及配套伪标签与一致性训练方法。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.innovation: 在极少标注框下通过稀疏到稠密策略与一致性约束实现高效检测。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.result: KITTI上约2%标注即可接近全监督性能。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud.

2204.02251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中从稀疏点云提取判别性特征困难、现有方法依赖体素或点采样导致信息损失的问题，提出RBGNet，基于射线（ray）进行分组，沿射线聚合点特征以保留几何结构。相比基于体素或球查询的方法，RBGNet在KITTI和Waymo上取得领先结果，KITTI 3D AP提升明显，Waymo上也有稳定增益。
2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of extracting discriminative features from sparse point clouds, where voxel or point-sampling methods lose information. It proposes RBGNet, which groups points along rays and aggregates ray-based features to preserve geometry. It achieves leading results on KITTI and Waymo, with clear KITTI 3D AP gains and consistent Waymo improvements over voxel/ball-query baselines.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 射线分组为点云特征提取提供了新视角，KITTI/Waymo双基准验证，对3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线的分组模块用于点云3D检测特征提取。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 沿射线聚合点特征以保留几何结构，替代传统体素或球查询采样。
2204.02251|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上取得领先3D检测精度。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中弱监督标注（如仅2D框或点级标注）质量低、监督信号弱的问题，提出Back to Reality框架，利用形状引导的标签增强（Shape-guided Label Enhancement）从弱标注中恢复高质量3D框。相比直接使用弱标注训练的方法，该方法通过形状先验与标签增强显著提升检测精度。在KITTI上弱监督设定下取得优于现有弱监督方法的3D AP。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper targets low-quality weak supervision (e.g., 2D boxes or point-level labels) in 3D detection. It proposes Back to Reality, a shape-guided label enhancement framework that recovers high-quality 3D boxes from weak annotations. It outperforms prior weakly-supervised methods on KITTI, achieving higher 3D AP under weak supervision.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 弱监督3D检测的实用探索，形状引导标签增强思路合理，但实验规模与提升幅度相对有限。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强框架用于弱监督3D检测。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 利用形状先验从弱标注中恢复高质量3D框以增强监督信号。
2203.05238|v2.result: 在KITTI弱监督设定下3D AP优于现有弱监督方法。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: ①现有自动驾驶3D感知数据集多集中于车载视角，路侧视角（roadside）数据稀缺，导致路侧单目3D检测研究受限。②本文提出Rope3D，一个大规模路侧感知数据集，包含超过5万帧图像、150万个3D标注框，覆盖多种道路场景与天气条件，并定义了路侧单目3D目标检测任务。③相比已有车载数据集（如KITTI、nuScenes），Rope3D从固定路侧视角采集，视角差异大、遮挡严重，更贴近真实路侧监控场景，填补了该领域数据空白。④基于该数据集，作者提供了单目3D检测基线方法，实验表明现有方法在路侧场景下性能显著下降，凸显了该任务的挑战性。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: ① Existing autonomous driving 3D perception datasets are predominantly collected from vehicle-mounted views, leaving roadside-view data scarce and limiting research on roadside monocular 3D detection. ② This paper introduces Rope3D, a large-scale roadside perception dataset containing over 50,000 frames and 1.5 million 3D bounding box annotations across diverse road scenarios and weather conditions, and defines a roadside monocular 3D object detection task. ③ Unlike existing vehicle-centric datasets such as KITTI and nuScenes, Rope3D is captured from fixed roadside viewpoints with large view discrepancies and severe occlusion, better reflecting real-world roadside surveillance scenarios. ④ Baseline experiments show that existing monocular 3D detectors suffer significant performance degradation on Rope3D, highlighting the challenges of this new task.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该论文填补了路侧视角3D感知数据集的空白，为自动驾驶路侧感知研究提供了重要基准，值得关注。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 构建了大规模路侧感知数据集Rope3D并定义了路侧单目3D检测任务。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 首次从固定路侧视角大规模采集并标注3D目标，揭示了现有单目3D检测方法在路侧场景下的性能瓶颈。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 数据集包含5万+帧图像和150万+ 3D标注框，基线实验表明现有方法在路侧场景下性能显著下降。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: ①现有视觉中心自动驾驶感知方法推理延迟过高（多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms），而传统基准只做离线评估、忽略推理时延，导致研究与实际部署脱节。②本文提出ASAP基准，这是首个评估视觉中心感知在线性能的自动驾驶基准：基于2Hz标注的nuScenes，设计标注扩展流水线为12Hz原始图像生成高帧率标签，并构建SPUR（受限计算下的流式感知）评估协议。③相比离线评估基准，ASAP首次量化了性能与效率的权衡，将12Hz输入用于流式评估。④该工作填补了理想研究与真实应用之间的评估空白，为流式感知提供了标准化评测平台。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: Vision-centric autonomous driving perception suffers from high inference latency (most camera-based 3D detectors exceed 300ms), yet conventional benchmarks evaluate offline and ignore time delay. This paper proposes ASAP, the first benchmark for online streaming perception in autonomous driving, built on a 2Hz-annotated nuScenes with an annotation-extending pipeline to generate high-frame-rate labels for 12Hz raw images, plus the SPUR evaluation protocol. It quantifies the performance-efficiency trade-off and bridges the gap between ideal research and real-world deployment.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 首个面向视觉中心流式感知的基准，对关注实际部署时延与在线评测的自动驾驶研究者具有重要参考价值。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出首个评估视觉中心自动驾驶在线流式感知性能的ASAP基准及SPUR评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 通过标注扩展流水线生成12Hz高帧率标签，并引入受限计算下的流式感知评测。
2212.08914|v2.result: 建立了量化性能与效率权衡的标准化流式感知评测平台。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: ①本文针对自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测这一核心任务进行系统性综述。②由于摘要缺失，从标题判断，论文梳理了环视视觉3D检测的方法体系、技术路线与挑战。③相比单目或单一视角方案，环视视觉3D检测利用多相机覆盖360度场景，综述有助于厘清该方向的发展脉络。④具体实验数据与结论因摘要缺失无法引用。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: This survey addresses surround-view vision-based 3D detection for autonomous driving. It systematically reviews the methodological landscape, technical routes, and open challenges of multi-camera 3D detection. As a survey, it helps clarify the development of 360-degree visual perception, though specific quantitative results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 环视视觉3D检测是当前BEV感知的热点方向，该综述可为入门与梳理脉络提供参考，但需注意其时效性。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统综述了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 对环视视觉3D检测的技术路线与挑战进行归纳整理。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为环视视觉3D检测研究提供了系统性文献梳理。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: ①多视角相机3D目标检测中，如何利用多视角一致性提升定位精度是关键问题。②本文提出VEDet框架，基于query-based transformer架构，用3D透视几何的位置编码增强图像特征，并在输出层设计视角条件query，训练时生成多个虚拟视角帧，通过强制多视角一致性学习视角等变性。③相比已有方法，VEDet在输入层注入多视角几何位置编码、在损失层正则化，为3D检测提供丰富几何线索。④在nuScenes基准上取得state-of-the-art性能，代码与模型已开源。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces VEDet, a 3D object detection framework that exploits 3D multi-view geometry for viewpoint awareness and equivariance. It augments image features with positional encodings from 3D perspective geometry and designs view-conditioned queries to generate virtual frames during training, enforcing multi-view consistency. VEDet achieves state-of-the-art performance on the nuScenes benchmark, with code and models released.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 将视角等变性引入多视角3D检测，几何建模思路清晰且nuScenes上SOTA，对BEV/多相机感知研究者很有价值。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出利用3D多视角几何实现视角等变性的VEDet多视角3D检测框架。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 通过视角条件query与虚拟视角训练强制多视角一致性以学习视角等变性。
2303.14548|v2.result: 在nuScenes基准上取得state-of-the-art的3D检测性能。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: ①LiDAR擅长捕捉3D形状，Radar提供更远探测距离和速度信息，但Radar数据极度稀疏且缺乏高度信息，直接将其特征融入LiDAR检测网络并非最优。②本文提出双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion：先用LiDAR分支学习重要细节以丰富Radar局部特征，缓解高度缺失与稀疏问题；再在统一BEV表示中融合LiDAR特征与增强后的Radar特征。③相比单向融合，双向设计更充分利用两种模态互补性。④在nuScenes和ORR数据集上，Bi-LRFusion在动态目标检测上取得state-of-the-art性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional LiDAR-Radar fusion framework for 3D dynamic object detection. It first enriches sparse Radar features lacking height information by learning details from the LiDAR branch, then fuses LiDAR features with the enhanced Radar features in a unified bird's-eye-view representation. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and ORR show state-of-the-art performance for detecting dynamic objects.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 针对LiDAR-Radar互补融合的稀疏与高度缺失难题提出双向融合方案，在nuScenes/ORR上SOTA，对多模态3D检测有参考意义。
2306.01438|v2.contribution: 提出双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion用于3D动态目标检测。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 用LiDAR分支增强Radar局部特征并在统一BEV表示中双向融合。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上动态目标检测达到state-of-the-art。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: ①现有基于体素的3D检测器通常依赖稀疏卷积后接密集检测头，计算开销大且难以兼顾检测与跟踪。②本文提出VoxelNeXt，一种全稀疏的VoxelNet，直接在稀疏体素上预测目标，无需密集特征图或锚框，可同时用于3D检测与跟踪。③相比需要密集化处理的方案，全稀疏设计更高效且天然适配跟踪任务。④具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用，但该工作为稀疏体素检测与跟踪提供了统一框架。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: This paper proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet for 3D object detection and tracking. It directly predicts objects on sparse voxels without dense feature maps or anchors, enabling a unified framework for both detection and tracking. The fully sparse design improves efficiency and naturally suits tracking, though quantitative results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏体素检测与跟踪的统一框架，思路简洁高效，对3D检测与跟踪研究者有较高参考价值。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出全稀疏VoxelNet框架VoxelNeXt统一3D检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 直接在稀疏体素上预测目标，无需密集特征图或锚框。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 为3D检测与跟踪提供了高效的全稀疏统一方案。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: ①掩码自编码器在单模态上表现优异，但多模态（点云与RGB图像）交互的预训练研究较少。②本文提出PiMAE自监督预训练框架，从三方面促进3D-2D交互：用投影模块互补对齐两模态的掩码与可见token；设计双分支MAE流水线并引入共享解码器促进掩码token的跨模态交互；设计跨模态重建模块增强两模态表征学习。③相比已有跨模态方法，PiMAE更充分地挖掘点-图交互。④在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等大规模RGB-D场景理解基准上进行了大量实验，验证了交互式学习点-图特征的有效性。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework that promotes 3D-2D interaction for point cloud and RGB image data. It complementarily aligns mask and visible tokens via a projection module, uses a two-branch MAE pipeline with a shared decoder for cross-modality interaction in mask tokens, and designs a cross-modal reconstruction module. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 demonstrate the effectiveness of interactively learning point-image features.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 将掩码自编码器拓展到点云-图像多模态交互预训练，设计细致且在大规模RGB-D基准上验证，对多模态自监督研究者有价值。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出促进点云与图像交互的自监督预训练框架PiMAE。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过掩码对齐、共享解码器与跨模态重建三方面增强3D-2D交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等基准上验证了跨模态表征学习的有效性。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV 3D检测方法将多视角相机特征聚合到沿高度维压平的BEV网格，忽略了不同高度上目标（如低处路障与高处卡车）的信息差异。本文提出BEV Slice Attention Network（BEV-SAN），沿高度维采样构建全局与局部BEV切片，用注意力机制聚合与融合切片特征，再经Transformer融合全局与局部BEV特征。相比直接压平BEV空间的做法，该方法显式建模高度维信息，在nuScenes上取得优于基线的检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV 3D detectors flatten the BEV space along the height dimension, failing to emphasize informative features at different heights. This paper proposes BEV-SAN, which samples global and local BEV slices along the height dimension, aggregates camera features into slices, merges them via attention, and fuses global and local BEV features with a transformer. It improves detection accuracy over flattening-based baselines on nuScenes.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 针对BEV特征构建中高度维信息丢失这一被忽视的问题提出切片注意力方案，思路新颖且对多相机BEV检测有直接参考价值。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出沿高度维构建全局/局部BEV切片并用注意力与Transformer融合的BEV-SAN框架。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 用高度维切片注意力替代传统BEV空间压平，显式保留不同高度的目标特征。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于压平式BEV基线方法的3D检测精度。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 点云3D检测器精度不断提升但计算效率常被忽视，本文提出itKD，一种基于互换迁移的知识蒸馏框架用于3D检测。方法采用自编码器式结构对教师与学生网络特征做通道压缩与解压，通过压缩表示损失绑定二者的通道压缩知识作为正则，并将解压特征反向互换迁移以缩小重构差距，同时用头注意力损失对齐多头自注意力提取的3D检测信息。实验表明该方法能训练出与3D点云检测任务良好对齐的轻量模型，在KITTI等数据集上验证了优越性。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes itKD, an interchange transfer-based knowledge distillation framework for point-cloud 3D object detection. It uses an autoencoder-style channel-wise compression/decompression with a compressed representation loss and bidirectional feature interchange, plus a head attention loss to align multi-head self-attention detection cues. Experiments show it trains lightweight detectors well-aligned with 3D detection tasks.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏引入3D点云检测以兼顾精度与效率，互换迁移与注意力对齐设计有一定新意，对轻量化检测研究有参考价值。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出面向3D点云检测的互换迁移式知识蒸馏框架itKD。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 用共享自编码器通道压缩与双向特征互换迁移，并引入头注意力损失对齐检测信息。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上训练出与3D检测任务对齐的轻量模型并验证其优越性。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器对恶劣天气、传感器噪声等真实世界损坏缺乏鲁棒性，威胁自动驾驶安全。本文针对LiDAR与相机输入设计27种常见损坏类型，在公开数据集上合成并建立KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，对24个多样化3D检测模型进行大规模评测。结论包括：运动级损坏威胁最大导致所有模型性能显著下降；LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好；纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱，凸显LiDAR点云的必要性。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: This paper benchmarks the corruption robustness of 3D detectors by designing 27 common corruption types for LiDAR and camera inputs and building KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, and Waymo-C. Large-scale experiments on 24 diverse 3D detectors reveal that motion-level corruptions are most threatening, LiDAR-camera fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are extremely vulnerable to image corruptions.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 首个系统性的3D检测损坏鲁棒性基准，覆盖多模态多数据集与大量模型，结论对自动驾驶感知安全研究极具指导意义。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建27种损坏类型与KITTI-C/nuScenes-C/Waymo-C三个3D检测鲁棒性基准并完成24模型评测。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 面向LiDAR与相机输入系统化设计真实场景损坏并大规模评测3D检测鲁棒性。
2303.11040|v2.result: 揭示运动级损坏最致命、融合模型更鲁棒、纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱等关键发现。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 基于LSS的多视角3D检测在BEV上用卷积检测器处理特征，但普通卷积忽略BEV特征的径向对称性，增加优化难度。本文提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）与方位角等变锚点，AeConv采样网格始终沿径向从而学习方位角不变BEV特征，锚点使检测头学习预测与方位角无关的目标，并引入相机解耦虚拟深度统一不同相机内参的深度预测，构成AeDet。在nuScenes上AeDet达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes AeDet, which introduces an azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) with radial sampling grids and an azimuth-equivariant anchor to preserve the radial symmetry of BEV features, plus a camera-decoupled virtual depth to unify depth prediction across intrinsics. AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth by a large margin.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 从BEV特征径向对称性出发重新设计卷积与锚点，理论动机清晰且nuScenes结果显著，对多视角BEV检测有重要参考价值。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积、等变锚点与相机解耦虚拟深度的AeDet多视角3D检测器。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计方位角等变卷积与锚点以降低检测器优化难度。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 现有多帧点云检测器多采用Detect-and-Fuse框架，对每帧提取特征再融合，因相邻帧高度相关而产生冗余计算。本文提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF，先在当前帧生成3D候选框并按估计速度传播到前序帧，从序列中池化兴趣点并编码为候选特征，再用双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块促进跨帧候选特征交互，并用体素采样优化点云池化使百万级点可在数毫秒内处理。MSF在效率与精度上均优于现有方法。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF) to avoid the redundant computation of Detect-and-Fuse multi-frame detectors. It generates proposals on the current frame, propagates them to preceding frames via estimated velocities, pools points-of-interest as proposal features, and aggregates them with a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation module, while voxel-based sampling speeds up pooling. MSF achieves better efficiency and accuracy than prior methods.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 以运动引导的候选框传播替代逐帧特征提取，有效缓解多帧检测冗余计算，对实时点云序列检测有实用价值。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导序列融合MSF与双向特征聚合BiFA的高效多帧3D检测方法。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 利用目标运动连续性传播候选框并跨帧聚合兴趣点特征，配合体素采样加速池化。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在保持精度的同时显著提升多帧点云3D检测效率，优于现有方法。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 本文提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用目标检测框架NeRF-RPN，给定预训练NeRF模型即可检测场景中所有物体的3D包围框。方法利用融合多尺度3D神经体素特征的新型体素表示，无需在任何视角渲染NeRF即可直接回归3D包围框，且框架通用、可在无类别标签下检测物体。作者测试了多种骨干、RPN头和损失函数并均可端到端训练，同时构建了包含合成与真实数据的新基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: This paper presents NeRF-RPN, the first object detection framework that directly operates on a pre-trained NeRF. By exploiting a novel voxel representation with multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features, it regresses 3D bounding boxes without rendering the NeRF at any viewpoint, and is class-agnostic. The authors benchmark various backbones, RPN heads, and losses, and release a new dataset with synthetic and real data.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 开辟了在NeRF表示上直接做3D检测的新方向，通用性强并配套数据集，对神经渲染与检测交叉研究有启发意义。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行、无需渲染的通用3D目标检测框架NeRF-RPN及配套基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 用融合多尺度3D神经体素特征的新型体素表示在NeRF中直接回归3D包围框。
2211.11646|v2.result: 多种骨干与RPN头均可端到端训练并估计高质量3D包围框，同时发布合成与真实数据基准。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，特别是现有方法对点云密度变化敏感、跨域性能下降的挑战。提出了一种密度不敏感的无监督域适应框架，通过密度感知的特征对齐和自适应采样策略，缓解源域与目标域之间的密度差异。相比已有工作，该方法在稀疏和密集点云场景下均能保持稳定的检测性能。在多个跨域基准上取得了显著的性能提升，验证了其有效性。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses the density sensitivity issue in unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection, where performance degrades across domains with varying point cloud densities. It proposes a density-insensitive adaptation framework with density-aware feature alignment and adaptive sampling. Compared to prior arts, it maintains stable detection performance under both sparse and dense point clouds, achieving notable improvements on multiple cross-domain benchmarks.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该工作切中3D检测域适应中的关键痛点，方法设计合理，实验充分，对自动驾驶感知的鲁棒性有实际意义。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的无监督域适应框架，解决点云密度变化导致的跨域性能下降问题。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 引入密度感知的特征对齐与自适应采样策略，增强模型对点云密度变化的鲁棒性。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在多个跨域3D检测基准上取得显著性能提升，验证了方法的有效性。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR与相机融合在3D目标检测中多粒度特征融合困难的问题，特别是现有方法在将2D语义提升到3D空间时对深度信息利用不足，导致融合不可靠。提出了MSMDFusion框架，包含多深度反投影（MDU）模块和细粒度跨模态交互机制，充分利用深度信息并实现体素级的精细融合。相比已有方法，该框架在深度感知和跨模态交互上均有显著改进。在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的检测性能，验证了其有效性。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of fusing multi-granularity geometric and semantic features from LiDAR and camera for 3D object detection, where depth information is underutilized when lifting 2D semantics to 3D. It proposes MSMDFusion, featuring a Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) module and fine-grained cross-modal interaction for voxel-level fusion. Compared to prior arts, it better exploits depth and achieves finer interactions, attaining state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like nuScenes.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该工作在多模态3D检测中深度利用和细粒度融合方面有重要创新，实验充分，性能领先，值得关注。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出MSMDFusion框架，通过多深度反投影和细粒度跨模态交互提升LiDAR-相机融合的3D检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 设计深度感知的多深度反投影模块和体素级细粒度跨模态交互机制。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的检测性能，验证了方法的有效性。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 该论文针对多相机3D目标检测中模型压缩与知识迁移的问题，特别是跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段的知识蒸馏尚未充分探索。提出了X3KD框架，在模态（LiDAR到相机）、任务（检测到分割）和阶段（教师到学生）三个维度上进行知识蒸馏。相比已有工作，该方法更全面地利用了多源知识，提升了学生模型的检测性能。在nuScenes基准上取得了显著的性能提升，验证了其有效性。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge distillation for multi-camera 3D object detection, exploring distillation across modalities, tasks, and stages. It proposes X3KD, which distills knowledge from LiDAR to camera, from detection to segmentation, and from teacher to student. Compared to prior arts, it more comprehensively leverages multi-source knowledge, achieving notable performance gains on nuScenes.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该工作在多相机3D检测的知识蒸馏方面进行了系统性探索，方法新颖，实验充分，对模型压缩和跨模态学习有参考价值。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出X3KD框架，实现跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段的知识蒸馏，提升多相机3D检测性能。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 首次在模态、任务和阶段三个维度上联合进行知识蒸馏。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 在nuScenes基准上取得显著性能提升，验证了多维度蒸馏的有效性。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中跨模态融合的精度问题，特别是局部与全局特征融合不充分导致检测性能受限。提出了LoGoNet，通过局部到全局的跨模态融合策略，结合点级和体素级特征，实现更精确的3D检测。相比已有方法，该框架在特征融合的层次和范围上均有改进。在Waymo和nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的检测性能，验证了其有效性。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-modal fusion for accurate 3D object detection, where local and global features are not sufficiently integrated. It proposes LoGoNet, which performs local-to-global cross-modal fusion combining point-level and voxel-level features. Compared to prior arts, it improves both the hierarchy and scope of feature fusion, achieving state-of-the-art performance on Waymo and nuScenes.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该工作在跨模态融合的局部-全局策略上有创新，实验充分，性能领先，对3D检测研究有重要参考价值。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出LoGoNet，通过局部到全局的跨模态融合策略提升3D目标检测精度。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 设计点级与体素级特征结合的局部到全局融合机制。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes等基准上取得领先的检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 该论文重新审视了LiDAR点云3D目标检测中的局部点聚合器设计，发现简单的pillar模型在精度和延迟上表现惊人。通过引入2D检测中的成功经验（如扩大感受野）和现代化架构与训练设计，提出了PillarNeXt。相比复杂几何建模方法，该工作挑战了精细几何建模对高性能3D检测必要性的直觉。在Waymo和nuScenes基准上取得了state-of-the-art性能，验证了其有效性。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits local point aggregators for LiDAR-based 3D object detection and finds that simple pillar-based models perform surprisingly well in both accuracy and latency. By modernizing architecture and training with 2D detection insights (e.g., enlarging receptive field), it proposes PillarNeXt. Challenging the intuition that detailed geometry modeling is essential, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on Waymo and nuScenes.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该工作对3D检测中的主流设计提出质疑，方法简洁高效，实验充分，性能领先，具有重要的启发意义。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 提出PillarNeXt，证明简单pillar模型结合现代化设计可达到state-of-the-art 3D检测性能。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 挑战精细几何建模必要性，引入2D检测成功经验（如扩大感受野）和现代化训练策略。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes基准上取得state-of-the-art性能，兼顾精度与延迟。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中遮挡和远距离物体检测困难的问题，利用点云序列数据中的时序信息进行改进。提出了MoDAR方法，将运动预测输出作为一种虚拟模态，通过传播物体信息到目标帧生成虚拟点，增强LiDAR点云。相比已有工作，该方法能有效利用超长序列（如18秒）的运动预测，且计算开销小。在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升了现有检测器的性能，达到新的state-of-the-art。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range object detection in 3D by leveraging point cloud sequences. It proposes MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to augment LiDAR point clouds by propagating object information to a target frame as virtual points. Compared to prior arts, it efficiently utilizes extra-long sequences (e.g., 18 seconds) with minimal overhead, significantly improving existing detectors and achieving new state-of-the-art on Waymo Open Dataset.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将运动预测作为虚拟模态增强点云，方法简洁有效，实验充分，对时序3D检测有重要参考价值。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出MoDAR，利用运动预测生成虚拟点增强LiDAR点云，提升遮挡和远距离物体检测性能。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将运动预测输出作为虚拟模态，通过虚拟点传播时序信息，且计算开销小。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器性能，达到新的state-of-the-art。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督信号梯度不理想、定位优化不稳定的问题，提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法，通过分析IoU损失梯度并对其进行修正来改善优化过程。相比已有IoU-based损失，方法在梯度层面进行更合理的加权与校正，从而提升3D框回归精度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，但主题属于3D检测优化的重要方向。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses suboptimal gradient behavior in IoU-based supervision for 3D object detection and proposes a gradient-corrected IoU supervision scheme to improve localization optimization. By analyzing and correcting the gradients of IoU losses, the method yields more stable and effective 3D box regression than existing IoU-based losses. The abstract does not report specific datasets or numerical gains, but the work targets a core optimization issue in 3D detection.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 聚焦3D检测中IoU监督的梯度优化问题，思路直接且对定位精度有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验验证是否充分。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法以改进3D目标检测的定位优化。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 从梯度层面分析并校正IoU损失的监督信号。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，预期可提升3D框回归精度。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测训练依赖LiDAR点云标注、训练与推理不一致的问题，提出仅使用图像2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法。方法利用投影一致性、多视角一致性和方向一致性设计弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法以指导旋转方向预测。实验表明其弱监督方法性能可与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练时显著优于对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on LiDAR-based 3D annotations in monocular 3D detection, which causes a train-inference inconsistency, by proposing a weakly supervised method trained only with 2D image labels. It exploits projection, multi-view, and direction consistency to build a weakly supervised architecture and introduces a new 2D direction labeling scheme for accurate rotation prediction. Experiments show performance comparable to some fully supervised methods and significant gains over fully supervised baselines when used as pre-training.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 弱监督单目3D检测方向重要且实用，利用多视角与方向一致性摆脱3D标注依赖，实验显示可媲美全监督并提升预训练效果，值得关注。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签训练的弱监督单目3D检测框架。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 融合投影、多视角与方向一致性，并提出2D方向标注指导旋转预测。
2303.08686|v2.result: 弱监督性能可比部分全监督方法，作为预训练显著优于全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交车）定位不准的问题，作者指出其根源在于鸟瞰图（BEV）分割中前景/背景像素的极端不平衡。提出SeaBird方法，在BEV空间引入分割监督并采用Dice Loss替代交叉熵，以缓解类别不平衡并提升大物体的BEV特征质量。相比已有仅依赖2D/3D回归或普通分割损失的单目方法，该工作将分割损失与检测头解耦并专门优化大物体。在KITTI上大幅提升了大物体（Car、Truck等）的3D AP，尤其对大型车辆提升显著。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor localization of large objects in monocular 3D detection, attributing it to extreme foreground-background imbalance in bird's-eye-view (BEV) segmentation. It proposes SeaBird, which adds BEV segmentation supervision with Dice Loss instead of cross-entropy to alleviate imbalance and improve BEV features for large objects. Compared with prior monocular methods relying only on 2D/3D regression or standard segmentation losses, it decouples the segmentation loss and specifically targets large objects, achieving significant 3D AP gains on KITTI, especially for large vehicles.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该工作从损失函数角度切入单目3D检测的痛点，思路清晰且实验提升明显，对大物体检测有实际价值。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出在BEV空间使用Dice Loss进行分割监督以改善单目3D检测中大物体的定位。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 将Dice Loss引入BEV分割并解耦检测头，专门解决前景/背景极端不平衡导致的大物体检测差的问题。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI上显著提升了大物体（如Car、Truck）的3D AP，尤其对大型车辆提升明显。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: 针对时序3D目标检测中现有方法计算量大、难以高效利用长时序信息的问题，提出Point-Trajectory Transformer（PTT）。该方法将点云序列压缩为点轨迹表示，并用Transformer在轨迹级别进行时序建模，从而在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算开销。相比已有基于多帧点云拼接或BEV时序融合的方法，PTT更高效且能捕捉长时序运动线索。在nuScenes上取得了有竞争力的3D检测精度，同时推理速度显著优于同类时序方法。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of temporal 3D object detection and the difficulty of efficiently exploiting long-term temporal information. It proposes the Point-Trajectory Transformer (PTT), which compresses point cloud sequences into point trajectories and performs trajectory-level temporal modeling with a Transformer, greatly reducing computation while maintaining accuracy. Compared with prior multi-frame concatenation or BEV temporal fusion, PTT is more efficient and captures long-term motion cues, achieving competitive 3D detection accuracy on nuScenes with significantly faster inference.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该工作提出点轨迹表示来高效建模时序，兼顾精度与速度，对自动驾驶时序3D检测有较强实用价值。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出Point-Trajectory Transformer，用点轨迹表示和Transformer实现高效时序3D目标检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 将点云序列压缩为点轨迹并在轨迹级别做时序建模，大幅降低时序融合的计算量。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上取得有竞争力的3D检测精度，同时推理速度显著优于同类时序方法。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中模态对齐和融合策略不够自适应的问题，提出GAFusion，一种带多重引导的自适应融合框架。该方法通过多层次的引导机制（如深度引导、语义引导等）动态调整LiDAR与相机特征的融合权重，使融合过程更鲁棒。相比已有固定融合或简单拼接的方法，GAFusion能更好地处理模态缺失和噪声。在nuScenes和Waymo等数据集上取得了领先的3D检测精度，尤其在远距离和小物体上提升明显。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adaptive alignment and fusion between LiDAR and camera in 3D detection. It proposes GAFusion, an adaptive fusion framework with multiple guidance mechanisms (e.g., depth and semantic guidance) that dynamically adjusts fusion weights between LiDAR and camera features for robustness. Compared with fixed or simple concatenation fusion, GAFusion better handles modality missing and noise, achieving state-of-the-art 3D detection accuracy on nuScenes and Waymo, especially for distant and small objects.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 该工作通过多重引导实现自适应LiDAR-相机融合，思路新颖且实验充分，对多模态3D检测有参考价值。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出GAFusion，一种带多重引导的自适应LiDAR-相机融合框架用于3D目标检测。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 引入深度和语义等多重引导机制，动态调整LiDAR与相机特征的融合权重。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上取得领先的3D检测精度，远距离和小物体提升明显。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: 针对近期稀疏查询式BEV方法流行而稠密BEV框架被忽视的问题，作者重新审视稠密BEV检测框架，提出BEVNeXt。该方法通过改进的BEV编码器、长时序融合和更有效的训练策略，使稠密BEV框架在精度和效率上重新具备竞争力。相比稀疏查询方法，BEVNeXt在保持简洁结构的同时避免了查询设计的复杂性。在nuScenes上取得了与稀疏方法相当甚至更优的NDS和mAP，同时推理速度更快。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: This paper revisits dense BEV frameworks for 3D detection, which have been overshadowed by recent sparse query-based methods. It proposes BEVNeXt, which improves the BEV encoder, long-term temporal fusion, and training strategy to make dense BEV competitive again in both accuracy and efficiency. Compared with sparse query methods, BEVNeXt maintains a simple structure while avoiding complex query design, achieving comparable or better NDS and mAP on nuScenes with faster inference.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该工作为稠密BEV框架正名，通过系统改进证明其仍具竞争力，对BEV检测研究有重要参考意义。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出BEVNeXt，通过改进编码器、时序融合和训练策略复兴稠密BEV检测框架。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 系统性地重新设计稠密BEV框架的编码器与时序融合，使其在精度和效率上媲美稀疏查询方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes上取得与稀疏方法相当或更优的NDS和mAP，且推理速度更快。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中不同数据集和场景下物体表示不统一的问题，提出UniMODE，一个统一的单目3D检测框架。该方法通过统一的查询设计和多数据集联合训练，使模型能同时处理多种物体类别和场景，并提升跨域泛化能力。相比已有针对单一数据集设计的方法，UniMODE在多个数据集上均表现良好。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo等数据集上取得了领先的单目3D检测精度，并展现出较强的零样本迁移能力。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified object representation across datasets and scenarios in monocular 3D detection. It proposes UniMODE, a unified monocular 3D detection framework with unified query design and multi-dataset joint training, enabling handling of diverse object categories and improving cross-domain generalization. Compared with methods designed for a single dataset, UniMODE performs well across multiple datasets, achieving leading monocular 3D detection accuracy on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo with strong zero-shot transfer.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 该工作提出统一的单目3D检测框架，强调跨数据集泛化，对实际部署和多场景应用有较大价值。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出UniMODE，一个统一的单目3D目标检测框架，支持多数据集联合训练和跨域泛化。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 通过统一查询设计和多数据集联合训练，实现单一模型在多个数据集上的统一单目3D检测。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上取得领先的单目3D检测精度，并展现较强零样本迁移能力。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: 针对雷达与相机融合在BEV空间中进行3D检测时特征对齐和融合困难的问题，提出RCBEVDet。该方法在BEV空间中对雷达和相机特征进行对齐与融合，利用雷达的深度和速度信息弥补相机的不足。相比已有仅在图像或点云空间融合的方法，RCBEVDet在BEV空间融合更高效且鲁棒。在nuScenes上取得了领先的3D检测精度，尤其在恶劣天气和远距离场景下优势明显。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of aligning and fusing radar and camera features in BEV space for 3D detection. It proposes RCBEVDet, which aligns and fuses radar and camera features in BEV space, leveraging radar's depth and velocity information to compensate for camera limitations. Compared with fusion in image or point cloud space, RCBEVDet is more efficient and robust, achieving leading 3D detection accuracy on nuScenes, especially in adverse weather and long-range scenarios.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 该工作将雷达-相机融合放到BEV空间，利用雷达的深度和速度优势，对低成本自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间实现雷达-相机融合的3D目标检测方法。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 在BEV空间中对齐并融合雷达与相机特征，利用雷达深度和速度信息提升检测鲁棒性。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测精度，在恶劣天气和远距离场景下优势明显。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、现有方法依赖密集点云标注的问题，本文提出VSRD（实例感知体素轮廓渲染），通过可微体素轮廓渲染将实例级监督信号引入弱监督训练。相比已有仅使用场景级或框级弱标签的方法，VSRD利用实例感知的轮廓渲染实现更精确的几何约束。在KITTI等基准上，VSRD在弱监督设定下取得了显著优于现有弱监督方法的检测精度，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in 3D object detection by proposing VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering framework for weakly supervised 3D detection. Unlike prior methods relying on scene-level or box-level weak labels, VSRD introduces differentiable volumetric silhouette rendering to provide instance-level geometric supervision. Experiments on KITTI show that VSRD substantially outperforms existing weakly supervised methods and narrows the gap to fully supervised counterparts.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该工作将可微渲染与弱监督3D检测结合，思路新颖，对降低3D标注成本具有实际意义，值得关注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体素轮廓渲染框架，实现弱监督下的高质量3D目标检测。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 将可微体素轮廓渲染引入弱监督3D检测，提供实例级几何监督信号。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著超越现有弱监督方法，缩小与全监督方法的差距。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中跨视角上下文信息利用不充分的问题，本文提出多视角注意力上下文化（Multi-View Attentive Contextualization, MVAC）方法。该方法通过注意力机制在多个相机视角之间建立上下文关联，增强特征表达以提升3D检测精度。相比已有仅依赖单视角特征或简单拼接的方法，MVAC更有效地融合跨视角信息。在nuScenes等基准上取得了有竞争力的检测性能。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient cross-view context exploitation in multi-view 3D object detection by proposing Multi-View Attentive Contextualization (MVAC). The method establishes attentive contextual associations across camera views to enhance feature representations for 3D detection. Compared with prior approaches relying on single-view features or naive concatenation, MVAC achieves more effective cross-view fusion and competitive performance on nuScenes.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 该工作聚焦多视角上下文融合这一关键问题，方法设计合理，对多相机BEV感知研究有参考价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视角注意力上下文化方法，增强跨视角特征融合以提升3D检测。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 利用注意力机制在多个相机视角间建立上下文关联，替代简单拼接融合。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的多视角3D检测性能。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确、缺乏空间几何约束的问题，本文提出学习占用（Occupancy）来辅助单目3D检测。方法通过预测场景的3D占用表示，为单目检测提供显式的空间几何先验，从而改善深度估计和目标定位。相比已有仅依赖2D特征或隐式深度的方法，显式占用学习带来了更准确的3D定位。在KITTI等基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation and lack of spatial geometric constraints in monocular 3D object detection by learning occupancy representations. The proposed method predicts 3D occupancy to provide explicit spatial geometric priors, improving depth estimation and object localization. Compared with methods relying solely on 2D features or implicit depth, explicit occupancy learning yields more accurate 3D localization and significant gains on KITTI.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占用预测引入单目3D检测是当前热点方向，方法有效且实验充分，对单目3D和占用感知研究者均有较高参考价值。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出利用占用学习为单目3D检测提供显式空间几何先验。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 将3D占用预测与单目3D检测结合，用显式几何约束改善深度估计。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得显著的单目3D检测性能提升。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测与位姿估计中不确定性建模不足的问题，本文提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型进行单目3D检测和位姿估计。方法将检测与位姿估计建模为扩散去噪过程，通过迭代细化生成更准确的3D框和朝向。相比已有确定性回归方法，扩散模型更好地处理了单目固有的深度和位姿不确定性。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的检测和位姿估计精度。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient uncertainty modeling in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by proposing MonoDiff, which leverages diffusion models. The method formulates detection and pose estimation as a diffusion denoising process, iteratively refining 3D boxes and orientations. Compared with deterministic regression methods, MonoDiff better handles inherent depth and pose uncertainty, achieving competitive accuracy on KITTI.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 将扩散模型引入单目3D检测与位姿估计是新颖尝试，对不确定性建模有启发，值得关注。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D检测与位姿估计框架MonoDiff。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 将3D检测与位姿估计建模为扩散去噪过程，迭代细化3D框和朝向。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力的检测与位姿估计精度。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视角下基于视觉的BEV 3D目标检测中体素池化效率低、空间信息损失的问题，本文提出BEVSpread，一种用于BEV表示的扩散体素池化方法。该方法通过扩散式体素池化将3D特征更有效地投影到BEV空间，减少信息损失并提升表示质量。相比已有体素池化方法，BEVSpread在路侧3D检测场景下取得了更好的检测精度和效率。在相关路侧数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient voxel pooling and spatial information loss in vision-based roadside BEV 3D object detection by proposing BEVSpread, a spread voxel pooling method for BEV representation. The approach projects 3D features into BEV space more effectively via spread voxel pooling, reducing information loss and improving representation quality. Compared with existing voxel pooling methods, BEVSpread achieves better detection accuracy and efficiency on roadside datasets.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 该工作聚焦路侧BEV感知这一重要且具挑战性的场景，体素池化改进思路实用，对BEV和路侧感知研究者有参考价值。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出BEVSpread扩散体素池化方法，提升路侧视觉BEV 3D检测表示质量。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 通过扩散式体素池化减少3D到BEV投影中的空间信息损失。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧数据集上取得更好的检测精度和效率。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对室外无监督3D目标检测中缺乏标注且伪标签质量低的问题，本文提出常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）方法。该方法利用常识先验构建目标原型，指导无监督3D检测中的伪标签生成和聚类，提升检测质量。相比已有无监督方法，常识原型的引入有效缓解了伪标签噪声问题。在室外3D检测基准上取得了优于现有无监督方法的性能。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations and low-quality pseudo-labels in outdoor unsupervised 3D object detection by proposing a Commonsense Prototype method. The approach leverages commonsense priors to construct object prototypes that guide pseudo-label generation and clustering. Compared with existing unsupervised methods, the commonsense prototype effectively mitigates pseudo-label noise and achieves superior performance on outdoor 3D detection benchmarks.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 将常识先验引入无监督3D检测是新颖思路，对降低标注依赖有实际意义，值得关注。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出常识原型方法，利用常识先验提升室外无监督3D目标检测质量。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 将常识先验构建的目标原型用于指导无监督3D检测的伪标签生成与聚类。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在室外3D检测基准上优于现有无监督方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中标注极少导致训练信号不足的问题，本文提出HINTED框架。方法上通过混合密度特征融合（Mixed-Density Feature Fusion）增强稀疏区域的特征表达，并设计难例增强检测器（Hard Instance Enhanced Detector）挖掘高价值训练样本。相比已有稀疏监督方法，HINTED在极少标注下显著提升了检测召回与定位精度。在KITTI等基准上，使用仅少量标注即达到接近全监督的性能，验证了方法的有效性。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where extremely limited annotations weaken training signals. It proposes HINTED, which combines mixed-density feature fusion to enrich sparse regions and a hard-instance enhanced detector to exploit informative samples. Compared with prior sparsely-supervised methods, it achieves substantially better recall and localization under scarce labels, approaching fully-supervised performance on benchmarks such as KITTI.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测是降低标注成本的关键方向，HINTED在特征融合与难例挖掘上的设计具有实用价值，值得关注。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出混合密度特征融合与难例增强的稀疏监督3D检测框架HINTED。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 将难例挖掘与混合密度特征融合结合，缓解稀疏标注下的特征稀疏与训练信号不足。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在极少标注下取得接近全监督的3D检测性能。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足的问题，本文提出3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散模型特征进行3D检测。方法将预训练扩散模型提取的几何感知特征迁移到3D检测任务，通过特征对齐与几何约束提升检测精度。相比传统基于RGB或点云的方法，扩散特征提供了更强的几何先验。实验表明该方法在多个3D检测基准上取得领先性能，尤其在几何复杂场景下优势明显。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient geometric exploitation in 3D object detection by proposing 3DiffTection, which leverages geometry-aware diffusion features. It transfers geometry-aware features from pretrained diffusion models to 3D detection with feature alignment and geometric constraints. Compared with RGB- or point-cloud-based methods, it provides stronger geometric priors and achieves leading performance on multiple 3D detection benchmarks, especially in geometrically complex scenes.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型特征引入3D检测是新颖且有前景的方向，几何感知特征对自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出利用几何感知扩散特征进行3D目标检测的3DiffTection方法。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 首次将几何感知扩散模型特征迁移至3D检测，增强几何先验表达。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得领先性能，复杂几何场景优势显著。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确导致定位误差的问题，本文提出MonoCD，通过互补深度（Complementary Depths）提升深度预测精度。方法利用不同深度线索的互补性进行融合，缓解单一深度估计的偏差。相比已有单目3D检测方法，MonoCD在深度估计与3D框定位上均有改进。在KITTI基准上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了互补深度策略的有效性。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoCD, which improves depth prediction via complementary depths. It fuses complementary depth cues to mitigate bias from single-source depth estimation. Compared with existing monocular 3D detectors, MonoCD improves both depth estimation and 3D box localization, achieving competitive results on the KITTI benchmark.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 单目3D检测的深度估计是核心瓶颈，互补深度思路简洁有效，对单目感知研究有参考价值。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出基于互补深度的单目3D目标检测方法MonoCD。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 利用互补深度线索融合缓解单目深度估计偏差。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI上取得有竞争力的单目3D检测性能。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离3D目标检测因点云稀疏而性能下降的问题，本文提出利用2D框监督来改进远距离3D检测。方法通过2D框标注提供额外监督信号，辅助远距离目标的3D定位与分类。相比仅依赖3D标注的方法，该策略在远距离场景下显著提升检测召回。实验表明在远距离目标上取得明显改进，缓解了点云稀疏带来的检测困难。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper addresses degraded 3D detection for distant objects due to sparse point clouds by leveraging 2D box supervision. It uses 2D box annotations as auxiliary supervision to aid 3D localization and classification of distant objects. Compared with methods relying solely on 3D labels, it substantially improves recall in distant scenarios, mitigating detection difficulties caused by point sparsity.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 远距离检测是自动驾驶感知的难点，利用2D框监督降低标注依赖并提升远距离性能，具有实用意义。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D目标检测的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 引入2D框监督信号辅助远距离3D检测，缓解点云稀疏问题。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 在远距离目标检测上取得明显召回与精度提升。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中实例与场景信息融合不充分的问题，本文提出IS-Fusion，实现实例-场景协同融合。方法通过实例级与场景级特征的协同交互，增强多模态（如LiDAR与相机）信息的互补表达。相比已有融合方法，IS-Fusion在特征交互与上下文建模上更充分。在nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能，验证了协同融合的有效性。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient fusion of instance and scene information in multimodal 3D detection by proposing IS-Fusion, an instance-scene collaborative fusion framework. It enables collaborative interaction between instance-level and scene-level features to enhance complementary multimodal representations. Compared with existing fusion methods, it achieves more thorough feature interaction and context modeling, delivering leading performance on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶3D检测的核心，IS-Fusion的实例-场景协同思路新颖且性能领先，值得重点关注。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合的多模态3D检测框架IS-Fusion。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 通过实例级与场景级特征协同交互增强多模态互补表达。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的3D检测性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中域适应困难的问题，本文提出伪标签精炼（Pseudo Label Refinery）方法用于无监督域适应。方法通过精炼伪标签质量，减少域偏移带来的噪声监督，提升跨数据集迁移性能。相比已有域适应方法，伪标签精炼显著降低了错误伪标签的影响。实验表明在跨数据集3D检测上取得明显提升，增强了模型的泛化能力。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D object detection by proposing a Pseudo Label Refinery. It refines pseudo-label quality to reduce noisy supervision caused by domain shift, improving cross-dataset transfer. Compared with existing domain adaptation methods, it significantly mitigates the impact of erroneous pseudo-labels, yielding clear improvements in cross-dataset 3D detection and generalization.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 跨数据集域适应对自动驾驶落地至关重要，伪标签精炼思路实用，能有效提升泛化性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出用于跨数据集3D检测无监督域适应的伪标签精炼方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 通过精炼伪标签质量降低域偏移带来的噪声监督。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在跨数据集3D检测上取得明显性能提升。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: 针对现有全稀疏3D目标检测器在远处或稀疏区域因特征采样不足导致性能下降的问题，本文提出SAFDNet。该方法通过混合稀疏卷积和密度感知特征采样策略，在保持全稀疏架构高效性的同时增强稀疏区域的特征表达。相比已有全稀疏方法，SAFDNet在不引入密集计算的情况下显著提升了检测精度。在nuScenes数据集上，SAFDNet取得了与密集方法相当的精度，同时保持高推理速度。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of fully sparse 3D object detectors in distant or sparse regions due to insufficient feature sampling. It proposes SAFDNet, which employs hybrid sparse convolution and density-aware feature sampling to enhance feature representation in sparse areas while maintaining the efficiency of a fully sparse architecture. Compared to existing fully sparse methods, SAFDNet significantly improves detection accuracy without introducing dense computation, achieving accuracy comparable to dense methods on nuScenes while maintaining high inference speed.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该工作为全稀疏3D检测提供了简单有效的解决方案，平衡了精度与效率，对自动驾驶感知有实际价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出了一种简单有效的全稀疏3D检测网络SAFDNet，通过密度感知特征采样提升稀疏区域检测性能。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 结合混合稀疏卷积与密度感知采样，在不增加密集计算的前提下增强稀疏特征表达。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在nuScenes上达到与密集方法相当的精度，同时保持高推理速度。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: 针对轻量级3D目标检测模型在压缩后精度下降的问题，本文提出CaKDP框架，结合类别感知知识蒸馏与剪枝。该方法根据类别重要性动态调整蒸馏权重，并联合优化剪枝策略，以在压缩模型的同时保留关键类别检测能力。相比传统蒸馏或剪枝单独使用，CaKDP在轻量化3D检测上取得了更好的精度-效率权衡。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，CaKDP在显著减少参数量的同时保持了较高的检测精度。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy drop in lightweight 3D object detection models after compression by proposing CaKDP, a category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning framework. It dynamically adjusts distillation weights based on category importance and jointly optimizes pruning to preserve detection capability for critical categories. Compared to using distillation or pruning alone, CaKDP achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off, maintaining high detection accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes while significantly reducing parameters.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作将类别感知引入蒸馏与剪枝的联合框架，为轻量化3D检测提供了新思路，但实验规模有限。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出了类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP，用于轻量化3D目标检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 根据类别重要性动态调整蒸馏权重，并与剪枝策略联合优化。

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: 针对半监督单目3D目标检测中伪标签质量不高的问题，本文提出解耦伪标签方法。该方法将伪标签生成解耦为定位和分类两个独立分支，分别进行置信度校准和筛选，以减少错误传播。相比传统半监督方法，解耦策略显著提升了伪标签的可靠性。在KITTI数据集上，该方法在仅使用少量标注数据时达到了与全监督方法相近的精度。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the low quality of pseudo-labels in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection by proposing a decoupled pseudo-labeling method. It decouples pseudo-label generation into separate localization and classification branches with independent confidence calibration and filtering to reduce error propagation. Compared to conventional semi-supervised methods, the decoupled strategy significantly improves pseudo-label reliability, achieving accuracy close to fully supervised methods on KITTI with only a small fraction of labeled data.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 该工作通过解耦伪标签生成有效提升了半监督单目3D检测的性能，对降低标注成本有重要意义。

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高且点云稀疏的问题，本文提出Prompt3D。该方法利用随机提示辅助弱监督学习，通过随机采样点云子集并生成提示来引导检测器训练，从而在仅有少量标注的情况下提升检测性能。相比现有弱监督方法，Prompt3D在标注效率上更具优势。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，Prompt3D在弱监督设置下取得了优于基线方法的检测精度。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and sparse point clouds in weakly-supervised 3D object detection by proposing Prompt3D. It leverages random prompts to assist weakly-supervised learning by randomly sampling point cloud subsets and generating prompts to guide detector training, improving detection with limited annotations. Compared to existing weakly-supervised methods, Prompt3D offers better annotation efficiency, achieving superior detection accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes under weak supervision.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 该工作探索了随机提示在弱监督3D检测中的应用，为降低标注依赖提供了新途径，但方法通用性有待验证。

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机融合中图像到BEV变换因深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题，提出基于query的RaCFormer框架，从BEV和原始图像两个视角自适应采样实例相关特征。方法上引入极坐标下的自适应圆形分布优化query初始化（按距离调整query密度），并用雷达引导的深度头改进图像到BEV的变换，同时利用雷达多普勒效应设计隐式动态捕捉器建模BEV时序信息。在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测精度，验证了query式融合优于朴素BEV特征拼接。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: RaCFormer addresses the misalignment in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate image-to-BEV depth estimation by proposing a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views. It introduces an adaptive circular distribution in polar coordinates for query initialization, a radar-guided depth head to refine image-to-BEV transformation, and an implicit dynamic catcher exploiting radar Doppler for temporal BEV modeling. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art 3D detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 针对雷达-相机融合中深度错位这一核心痛点提出query式自适应采样方案，设计思路清晰且nuScenes结果有竞争力，对多传感器BEV感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出query-based雷达-相机融合框架RaCFormer，通过双视角自适应采样规避图像到BEV变换的深度错位问题。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 极坐标自适应圆形query初始化与雷达多普勒驱动的隐式动态捕捉器。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测精度。

V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_cn: 该论文针对车路协同（V2X）场景下LiDAR与4D雷达融合的3D目标检测问题，提出V2X-R框架。方法上利用去噪扩散模型处理多模态、多视角传感器数据的融合与噪声抑制，以提升协同感知的鲁棒性与精度。由于摘要缺失，具体改进点与实验数据无法确认，但从标题看其核心在于将扩散去噪引入V2X LiDAR-4D雷达融合。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_en: This paper targets cooperative 3D object detection in V2X scenarios by fusing LiDAR and 4D radar, proposing the V2X-R framework. It leverages denoising diffusion to handle multimodal, multi-view sensor fusion and noise suppression for more robust cooperative perception. Due to the missing abstract, specific improvements and quantitative results cannot be verified.
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.assessment: 将去噪扩散引入V2X LiDAR-4D雷达融合是较新的组合，协同感知与4D雷达均为热点方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法细节与实验充分度。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.contribution: 提出面向V2X协同感知的LiDAR-4D雷达融合检测框架V2X-R。

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有室内3D检测数据集在规模、精度和物体多样性上的不足，论文提出CA-1M数据集，在1000多个高精度激光扫描场景上详尽标注超40万个3D物体，并与3500多个手持第一视角采集精确配准。方法上提出全Transformer的CuTR基线，直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框而非在点/体素表示上操作。实验表明CuTR配合CA-1M可准确召回超62%的3D物体，优于基于点的方法，且对商品级LiDAR深度图的噪声与不确定性更鲁棒，并具备纯RGB性能。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: To address the limited scale, accuracy, and object diversity of existing indoor 3D detection datasets, this paper introduces CA-1M, exhaustively labeling over 400K 3D objects across 1K+ laser-scanned scenes registered to 3.5K handheld egocentric captures. It further proposes CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline that predicts 3D boxes directly from 2D RGB(-D) features rather than point/voxel representations. CuTR recalls over 62% of objects in 3D, outperforming point-based methods and being more robust to commodity depth noise.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集与建模双贡献，CA-1M的规模与配准精度对室内3D检测社区有长期价值，CuTR验证了无3D归纳偏置的Transformer在大规模数据下的可行性。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模高精度室内3D检测数据集CA-1M并提出全Transformer检测基线CuTR。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 直接从2D RGB(-D)特征预测3D框、摆脱3D归纳偏置的Transformer检测范式。
2412.04458|v2.result: CuTR在3D中准确召回超62%的物体，优于基于点的方法且对深度噪声更鲁棒。

FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中稀疏卷积网络感受野受限、难以捕获长程上下文的问题，提出全稀疏混合网络FSHNet。方法上在保持全稀疏计算效率的前提下，引入长程上下文建模能力以增强稀疏检测器的表达能力。由于摘要缺失，具体模块设计与实验数据无法确认，但从标题看其核心在于稀疏架构与长程建模的混合设计。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited receptive field and weak long-range context modeling of sparse convolutional networks in 3D object detection by proposing FSHNet, a fully sparse hybrid network. It aims to enhance the representational capacity of sparse detectors while preserving fully sparse computational efficiency. MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测精度不足的问题，提出助教知识蒸馏框架MonoTAKD。方法上引入"助教"网络作为教师与学生之间的中间桥梁，缓解单目检测器容量有限导致的蒸馏困难，从而更有效地传递LiDAR等强模态教师的知识。由于摘要缺失，具体蒸馏策略与实验数据无法确认，但从标题看其核心在于多级蒸馏的助教机制。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_en: This paper targets the limited accuracy of monocular 3D object detection by proposing MonoTAKD, a teaching-assistant knowledge distillation framework. It introduces a teaching-assistant network as an intermediate bridge between teacher and student to ease distillation into capacity-limited monocular detectors, thereby transferring knowledge from stronger modalities such as LiDAR more effectively. Due to the missing abstract, specific distillation strategies and results cannot be verified.

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点分布复杂（取决于目标类别、尺寸和朝向）而现有雷达-相机融合方法以黑盒网络隐式处理的问题，论文提出RICCARDO，显式利用雷达点分布模型辅助融合。方法上先以单目检测器输出的目标属性为条件预测雷达点分布，再将该分布作为核在实际雷达点邻域内匹配并生成匹配分数，最后融合阶段结合上下文与核检测器精修匹配分数。在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机检测性能，代码已开源。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: RICCARDO addresses the complex, property-dependent distribution of radar hits that existing radar-camera fusion methods handle only implicitly via black-box networks. It explicitly predicts radar hit distributions conditioned on object properties from a monocular detector, uses the predicted distribution as a kernel to match measured radar points and produce matching scores, and refines these scores in a fusion stage combining context and the kernel detector. It achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera detection performance on nuScenes.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 用可解释的雷达点分布模型替代黑盒融合，思路新颖且nuScenes SOTA结果有说服力，对雷达-相机融合研究者有较高参考价值。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出显式雷达点分布建模的相机-雷达融合检测方法RICCARDO。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 以单目检测目标属性为条件预测雷达点分布并作为核进行点匹配。
2504.09086|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机检测性能。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器跨域泛化差的问题，现有域泛化方法仅依赖全局几何特征（笛卡尔坐标），导致模型过度关注绝对位置。本文提出GBlobs，用高斯球编码点云邻域的显式局部结构，无需额外参数且高效。将其集成到现有检测器中，在单源DG基准上大幅超越SOTA：Waymo→KITTI提升21 mAP，KITTI→Waymo提升13 mAP，nuScenes→KITTI提升12 mAP，且不损失域内性能；多源DG也分别提升17、12、5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors, which typically rely on global geometric features. It proposes GBlobs, an efficient parameter-free encoding of local point cloud neighborhoods using Gaussian blobs, integrated into existing detectors. GBlobs outperforms state-of-the-art single-source DG by over 21 mAP (Waymo→KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI→Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes→KITTI) without sacrificing in-domain performance, and also improves multi-source DG by 17, 12, and 5 mAP.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的局部结构编码显著提升跨域3D检测性能，方法通用且无需额外参数，对域泛化研究有重要参考价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出GBlobs，一种基于高斯球的显式局部点云结构编码，用于提升LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 首次利用高斯球编码局部邻域结构作为域泛化特征，替代对全局几何特征的过度依赖。
2503.08639|v2.result: 在多个单源和多源DG基准上大幅超越SOTA，最高提升21 mAP，且不损失域内性能。

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中透视投影导致的深度误差问题，即边界框高度无法准确表示实际投影中心高度，从而削弱几何深度有效性。本文提出MonoDGP，采用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，并系统讨论几何误差机制，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代。此外，解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器，提供2D先验并初始化查询。在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses depth errors in monocular 3D detection caused by perspective projection, where bounding box height fails to represent the projected central height. It proposes MonoDGP, a Transformer-based method that uses perspective-invariant geometry errors to modify the projection formula, serving as a simple alternative to multi-depth prediction. It also decouples the depth-guided decoder and constructs a 2D decoder for visual features, achieving competitive results on benchmarks like KITTI.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 该工作深入分析了单目3D检测中的几何误差问题，提出的解耦查询和几何误差先验方法简洁有效，对单目3D检测有重要推进。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出MonoDGP，利用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，并解耦深度引导解码器与2D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 引入几何误差作为多深度预测的替代，并设计仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器来初始化查询。
2410.19590|v2.result: 在KITTI等单目3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D目标检测中标注成本高的问题，首次研究室内主动学习，提出一个综合不确定性和多样性的框架。不确定性准则同时考虑错误检测和未检测目标，多样性准则通过类感知自适应原型（CAP）库联合优化类别分布和场景类型多样性。在室内数据集上有效减少标注量并保持检测性能。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first study on active learning for indoor 3D object detection, addressing high annotation costs. It proposes a framework incorporating uncertainty and diversity criteria: uncertainty accounts for inaccurate detections and undetected objects, while diversity maximizes class and scene type diversity via a Class-aware Adaptive Prototype (CAP) bank. It effectively reduces annotation while maintaining detection performance on indoor datasets.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了室内3D检测主动学习的空白，提出的不确定性与多样性联合框架针对室内挑战设计，具有实用价值。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个室内3D目标检测主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性准则。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 设计类感知自适应原型库（CAP）来联合优化类别和场景多样性，并考虑未检测目标的不确定性。
2503.16125|v2.result: 在室内数据集上有效减少标注成本并保持检测性能。

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏标注下3D目标检测器特征判别能力不足的问题，本文提出SP3D，利用大型多模态模型生成的跨模态语义提示来增强检测器。方法包含置信点语义迁移（CPST）模块通过边界约束中心聚类选择生成准确语义提示，动态聚类伪标签生成（DCPG）模块从多尺度邻域点几何形状产生伪监督信号，并设计分布形状分数（DS score）筛选高质量监督信号用于初始训练。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上验证了该方法在稀疏标注设置下能有效提升检测性能，超越现有稀疏监督方法。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where accurate labels are extremely scarce. It proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models to boost feature discrimination. Specifically, a Confident Points Semantic Transfer module generates accurate prompts via boundary-constrained center cluster selection, and a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module yields pseudo-supervision from multi-scale neighbor geometry, with a Distribution Shape score selecting high-quality signals. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo show improved performance under sparse annotation.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 将LMM跨模态语义提示引入稀疏监督3D检测，思路新颖，实验充分，对标注成本敏感的场景有实用价值。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用LMM跨模态语义提示增强稀疏监督3D检测的SP3D框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 通过CPST和DCPG模块将LMM语义提示转化为高质量伪监督信号，并设计DS分数筛选。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上验证了稀疏标注下检测性能的显著提升。
