QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.innovation: 为 QAS 提供标准化搜索空间与评测协议。
QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.result: 提升了 QAS 算法比较的公平性与可复现性。
QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu._arxiv_id: QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architecture Search and A Benchmark.

MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.summary_cn: 该论文针对 Vision Transformer 在多域学习场景下难以兼顾各域性能的问题，提出了 MDL-NAS 联合多域学习框架。方法上通过神经架构搜索为不同域自动搜索适配的子网络结构，实现参数共享下的多域协同。相比固定结构的 ViT 多域微调方案，该方法能更灵活地平衡域间差异。摘要未给出具体数据，但对多域视觉感知与持续学习方向有借鉴意义。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of multi-domain learning with Vision Transformers, where a single model struggles to perform well across domains. It proposes MDL-NAS, a joint multi-domain learning framework that leverages neural architecture search to find domain-adaptive subnetworks with shared parameters. Compared to fixed-structure ViT fine-tuning, it better balances inter-domain discrepancies.
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.assessment: 将 NAS 与 ViT 多域学习结合，对多域感知与持续学习有参考价值。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.contribution: 提出了基于 NAS 的 Vision Transformer 联合多域学习框架 MDL-NAS。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.innovation: 用架构搜索为不同域自动分配子网络以缓解域间冲突。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.result: 在多域学习设定下实现了更灵活的域间性能平衡。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F._arxiv_id: MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning Framework for Vision Transformer.

DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_cn: 该论文针对知识蒸馏中学生架构选择依赖昂贵训练与试错的问题，提出了 DisWOT（Distillation WithOut Training）方法。其核心是在不训练的情况下，通过零成本代理指标评估学生架构的蒸馏潜力，从而高效搜索最优学生网络。相比传统需要反复训练验证的蒸馏流程，该方法大幅降低搜索开销。摘要未给出具体数据，但对蒸馏与 NAS 交叉方向具有实用价值。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_en: This paper addresses the expensive trial-and-error process of selecting student architectures for knowledge distillation. It proposes DisWOT, which evaluates student architectures without training via zero-cost proxy metrics to efficiently search for optimal students. Compared to conventional train-and-validate distillation pipelines, it substantially reduces search cost.
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.assessment: 零成本代理用于蒸馏学生搜索，思路新颖，对 NAS 与蒸馏结合方向有启发。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.contribution: 提出了无需训练的学生架构搜索蒸馏框架 DisWOT。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.innovation: 利用零成本代理指标评估学生架构的蒸馏潜力。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.result: 显著降低了蒸馏中学生架构搜索的训练开销。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for._arxiv_id: DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for Distillation WithOut Training.

2304.04168|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图神经网络（GNN）易受对抗攻击且现有防御方法泛化性差的问题，提出了鲁棒图神经架构搜索框架 G-RNA。方法上在消息传递搜索空间中引入图结构掩码操作，并定义鲁棒性度量以引导搜索防御性 GNN 架构。相比现有图 NAS 缺乏鲁棒设计，G-RNA 从架构层面理解并提升 GNN 鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但对鲁棒感知与架构搜索交叉方向有参考意义。
2304.04168|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Graph Neural Networks to adversarial attacks and the poor generalization of existing defenses. It proposes G-RNA, a robust graph NAS framework that adds graph structure mask operations to the message-passing search space and defines a robustness metric to guide the search. Unlike prior graph NAS lacking robust design, G-RNA improves GNN robustness from an architectural perspective.
2304.04168|v2.assessment: 将鲁棒性度量引入图 NAS，对鲁棒感知与架构搜索交叉研究有借鉴价值。
2304.04168|v2.contribution: 提出了鲁棒图神经架构搜索框架 G-RNA。
2304.04168|v2.innovation: 在消息传递搜索空间中引入图结构掩码与鲁棒性度量。
2304.04168|v2.result: 从架构层面有效搜索出更具对抗鲁棒性的 GNN。

HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 中架构分布度量与搜索效率问题，提出了基于层次最优传输的 HOTNAS 方法。方法上利用层次最优传输距离刻画架构之间的结构差异，以指导搜索过程。相比传统基于代理指标的 NAS，该方法提供了更几何化的架构相似性度量。摘要未给出具体实验数据，其价值主要在 NAS 方法论层面。
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.summary_en: This paper addresses architecture distribution measurement and search efficiency in NAS by proposing HOTNAS, which leverages hierarchical optimal transport. It uses hierarchical OT distances to characterize structural differences between architectures and guide the search. Compared to proxy-based NAS, it offers a more geometric measure of architecture similarity.

HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.contribution: 提出了基于层次最优传输的 NAS 方法 HOTNAS。
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.innovation: 用层次最优传输距离度量架构间结构差异以指导搜索。
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.result: 为 NAS 提供了更几何化的架构相似性度量手段。

2208.08835|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS因skip-connection主导而出现的性能崩溃问题，本文从超网表达能力与随机特征两个角度进行分析。作者发现仅训练BatchNorm即可构成一种新的DARTS范式，并从理论上证明随机特征会稀释skip-connection的辅助连接作用，使搜索算法更公平地选择操作。基于此提出RF-DARTS与RF-PCDARTS。RF-DARTS在CIFAR-10上达到94.36%测试精度（接近NAS-Bench-201最优），从CIFAR-10迁移到ImageNet时取得24.0%的最新最优top-1错误率，并在CIFAR-10/100与SVHN上表现稳健。
2208.08835|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance collapse issue of DARTS caused by the dominance of skip-connections. The authors show that training only BatchNorm yields a new DARTS paradigm and theoretically demonstrate that random features dilute the auxiliary role of skip-connections, leading to fairer operation selection. The resulting RF-DARTS and RF-PCDARTS achieve 94.36% on CIFAR-10 and a state-of-the-art 24.0% top-1 error on ImageNet when transferred from CIFAR-10, with robust performance across three datasets.
2208.08835|v2.assessment: 对NAS社区有较高参考价值，理论分析与实验均较扎实，但与自动驾驶感知任务无直接关联。
2208.08835|v2.contribution: 提出基于随机特征的DARTS改进方案，缓解性能崩溃并刷新ImageNet迁移结果。
2208.08835|v2.innovation: 从超网表达能力与随机特征角度重新解释skip-connection主导问题，并给出仅训练BatchNorm的新范式。
2208.08835|v2.result: RF-DARTS在CIFAR-10达94.36%，ImageNet top-1错误率24.0%，跨数据集表现稳健。

2303.09730|v2.summary_cn: 针对在多样移动设备上部署轻量低延迟ViT的难题，本文提出两阶段NAS方法ElasticViT，先训练支持大搜索空间的高质量ViT超网，再为具体设备搜索可直接部署的子网。作者指出均匀采样会导致子网规模差异巨大（如50M与2G FLOPs）从而产生梯度冲突，为此提出复杂度感知采样与性能感知采样两种策略。前者限制相邻训练步采样子网的FLOPs差异，后者进一步挑选精度较好的子网以缓解梯度冲突并提升超网质量。
2303.09730|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the challenge of designing lightweight, low-latency ViT models for diverse mobile devices. ElasticViT is a two-stage NAS approach that trains a high-quality ViT supernet over a large search space and then searches a deployable subnet. To mitigate gradient conflicts caused by uniform sampling of subnets with vastly different sizes, the authors propose complexity-aware and performance-aware sampling, which constrain FLOPs differences across adjacent steps and favor accurate subnets, respectively.
2303.09730|v2.assessment: 面向移动端ViT部署的实用NAS工作，梯度冲突视角有新意，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2303.09730|v2.contribution: 提出ElasticViT两阶段NAS框架及两种缓解梯度冲突的采样策略。
2303.09730|v2.innovation: 复杂度感知与性能感知采样，解决超网训练中子网规模差异导致的梯度冲突。
2303.09730|v2.result: 在超大搜索空间上训练出高质量ViT超网，可为多种移动设备搜索低延迟子网。

2001.05887|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有两阶段NAS方法多局限于单路径搜索空间、难以高效搜索多路径结构的问题，本文提出一次性多路径超网训练方法MixPath。作者发现多路径求和后的特征向量近似为单路径特征的倍数，这种统计差异会干扰超网训练与排序能力，因此提出Shadow Batch Normalization（SBN）来正则化不一致的特征统计。实验证明SBN能稳定优化并提升排序性能，MixPath在ImageNet上生成一系列达到state-of-the-art的模型。
2001.05887|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing two-stage NAS methods to single-path search spaces by proposing MixPath, a one-shot multi-path supernet training approach. The authors observe that feature vectors summed from multiple paths are nearly multiples of single-path features, which perturbs supernet training and ranking. They introduce Shadow Batch Normalization to regularize these disparate statistics, stabilizing optimization and improving ranking, and MixPath achieves state-of-the-art results on ImageNet.
2001.05887|v2.assessment: 多路径一次性NAS的思路清晰，SBN机制有针对性，但领域相关性低，适合NAS方向研究者参考。
2001.05887|v2.contribution: 提出统一的多路径一次性NAS方法MixPath及Shadow Batch Normalization机制。
2001.05887|v2.innovation: 发现多路径特征统计近似倍数关系，并用SBN正则化以稳定超网训练与排序。
2001.05887|v2.result: 在ImageNet上生成一系列达到state-of-the-art的模型。

Extensible and Efficient Proxy for Neura.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
Extensible and Efficient Proxy for Neura._arxiv_id: Extensible and Efficient Proxy for Neural Architecture Search.

An Experimental Protocol for Neural Arch.summary_cn: 该论文为超分辨率任务中的神经架构搜索提出了一套实验协议，旨在规范该子领域的搜索与评估流程。由于摘要缺失，无法获知协议的具体内容，例如搜索空间定义、训练设置、评价指标与基线对比方式。从标题看，作者关注的是超分辨率NAS实验可复现性与公平比较问题。缺少细节与结果，难以评估其对社区的直接影响。
An Experimental Protocol for Neural Arch.summary_en: This paper proposes an experimental protocol for neural architecture search in super-resolution, aiming to standardize search and evaluation procedures in this subfield. Due to the missing abstract, the protocol details such as search space, training settings, metrics, and baselines are unknown. The work appears to target reproducibility and fair comparison, but its concrete impact cannot be assessed.
An Experimental Protocol for Neural Arch.assessment: 主题与自动驾驶感知无关，且摘要缺失，信息不足以判断其价值。
An Experimental Protocol for Neural Arch.contribution: 为超分辨率NAS提出实验协议以规范搜索与评估流程。
An Experimental Protocol for Neural Arch.innovation: 面向超分辨率NAS的可复现实验协议设计。
An Experimental Protocol for Neural Arch.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
An Experimental Protocol for Neural Arch._arxiv_id: An Experimental Protocol for Neural Architecture Search in Super-Resolution.

DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.summary_cn: 该论文提出 DONNAv2，一个面向视觉任务的轻量级神经架构搜索方法，旨在降低 NAS 的搜索与训练开销。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体搜索空间、代理指标或硬件感知策略，但从标题看其核心是提升 NAS 在视觉任务上的效率与可部署性。相比已有 NAS 工作，其改进点应在于更轻量的搜索流程或更低的计算预算。由于缺少实验数据，无法引用具体指标，整体信息不足以判断其相对 SOTA 的实际增益。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.summary_en: DONNAv2 is presented as a lightweight neural architecture search method for vision tasks, targeting reduced search and training cost. As the abstract is missing, its search space, proxy metrics, and hardware-aware strategy cannot be verified. The claimed improvement is presumably a more efficient NAS pipeline, but no quantitative results are available for assessment.
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.assessment: 主题属于 NAS 与视觉任务交叉，但与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测主线相关性较弱，且摘要缺失导致难以评估其真实贡献。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出面向视觉任务的轻量级 NAS 框架 DONNAv2。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.innovation: 以轻量化搜索流程降低视觉 NAS 的计算开销。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与性能数据。
DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architecture Search for Vision tasks.

2308.15609|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 One-Shot NAS 需要从零训练超网、尤其在大模型预训练+微调两阶段流程中计算代价过高的问题，提出 InstaTune。方法利用现成大模型预训练权重，在微调阶段生成超网，并用多目标进化搜索抽取适配目标任务的子网络。相比已有在预训练目标上优化子网的工作，InstaTune 的子网直接面向下游任务优化，同时显著减少 NAS 所需时间与算力，且易于嵌入现有框架。摘要未给出具体数据集与加速比数据，但思路对资源受限部署具有实用价值。
2308.15609|v2.summary_en: InstaTune addresses the high cost of training one-shot NAS supernetworks from scratch, especially for large pre-trained models requiring two-stage training. It generates a supernetwork during fine-tuning using off-the-shelf pre-trained weights and extracts task-optimized subnetworks via multi-objective evolutionary search. Unlike prior work optimizing for pre-training objectives, InstaTune targets downstream tasks and is plug-and-play, though quantitative speedups are not reported in the abstract.
2308.15609|v2.assessment: 将 NAS 嵌入微调阶段以复用预训练权重，工程实用性强，但更偏通用模型压缩，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2308.15609|v2.contribution: 提出在微调阶段生成超网并抽取任务专用子网的 NAS 方法 InstaTune。
2308.15609|v2.innovation: 复用预训练权重并在微调中完成 NAS，使子网面向下游任务优化。
2308.15609|v2.result: 声称显著降低 NAS 时间与算力并保持任务性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。

Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.summary_cn: 该论文关注可微分神经架构搜索（DARTS 类方法）中搜索到的架构迁移性不足的问题，提出通过鼓励可迁移性来改进搜索过程。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体正则化、搜索空间或跨数据集/跨任务实验设置。其核心动机应是缓解 DARTS 在代理任务上过拟合、迁移到目标任务时性能下降的已知缺陷。缺少实验数据，无法评估其相对已有可迁移 NAS 方法的实际提升。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.summary_en: This work targets the limited transferability of architectures found by differentiable NAS, proposing to improve search by explicitly encouraging transferability. The abstract is missing, so the specific regularization, search space, and cross-dataset evaluation are unknown. The motivation aligns with the known proxy-overfitting issue in DARTS-style methods, but no quantitative evidence is available.
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.assessment: 问题本身是 DARTS 的经典痛点，但摘要缺失使贡献与效果无法核实，相关性也偏通用 NAS。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.contribution: 提出通过鼓励可迁移性改进可微分 NAS 的方法。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.innovation: 在可微分搜索中显式引入可迁移性约束或目标。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认迁移性能提升的具体数据。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec._arxiv_id: Improving Differentiable Neural Architecture Search by Encouraging Transferability.

AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_cn: 该论文提出 AutoGT，面向图 Transformer 的自动化架构搜索，旨在为图结构数据自动设计 Transformer 架构。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其搜索空间设计、搜索策略（如可微分或进化）以及在图分类/节点分类等基准上的表现。其潜在改进点在于将 NAS 从 CNN/ViT 扩展到图 Transformer，减少人工设计成本。缺少实验数据，无法评估其相对手工图 Transformer 的实际增益。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_en: AutoGT proposes automated architecture search for graph Transformers, aiming to reduce manual design effort for graph-structured data. The abstract is missing, leaving the search space, strategy, and benchmark results unspecified. Its potential value lies in extending NAS to graph Transformers, but no quantitative comparison is available.
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.assessment: 属于 NAS 与图 Transformer 的交叉，与自动驾驶视觉感知主线相关性较低，且摘要缺失难以评估。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.contribution: 提出图 Transformer 的自动化架构搜索框架 AutoGT。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.innovation: 将 NAS 应用于图 Transformer 架构设计。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认在图任务上的具体性能。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch._arxiv_id: AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Architecture Search.

Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_cn: 该论文针对蒸馏感知 NAS（Distillation-Aware NAS）在未见数据集上难以评估子网可蒸馏性的问题，提出一个元预测模型。方法通过元学习预测不同数据集上子网的蒸馏友好程度，从而在无需实际蒸馏训练的情况下指导架构搜索。相比已有蒸馏感知 NAS 依赖在特定数据集上反复蒸馏评估的做法，该工作提升了跨数据集泛化与搜索效率。摘要未给出具体数据集与预测精度数据，但其将元学习引入蒸馏感知 NAS 的思路具有新意。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_en: This paper addresses distillation-aware NAS on unseen datasets by proposing a meta-prediction model that estimates the distillability of subnetworks without actual distillation training. It improves cross-dataset generalization and search efficiency compared to prior distillation-aware NAS that repeatedly evaluates distillation on a fixed dataset. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.assessment: 将元学习与蒸馏感知 NAS 结合，对模型压缩与跨数据集部署有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联间接。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.contribution: 提出用于未见数据集上蒸馏感知 NAS 的元预测模型。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.innovation: 用元学习预测子网可蒸馏性，避免逐数据集蒸馏评估。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.result: 声称提升跨数据集搜索效率与泛化，摘要未给出具体数值。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A._arxiv_id: Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-Aware NAS on Unseen Datasets.

Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_cn: 该论文针对进化神经架构搜索中交叉操作面临的排列问题（permutation problem），即不同架构的编码顺序不一致导致交叉产生无效或退化子代，提出最短编辑路径交叉（Shortest Edit Path Crossover）方法。该方法基于理论分析设计交叉算子，使父代到子代的编辑距离最小化，从而提升进化搜索的稳定性与效率。相比传统随机或启发式交叉，其改进点在于有理论保证的交叉设计。摘要未给出具体基准与加速数据，但理论驱动的思路对进化 NAS 社区有参考意义。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_en: This paper tackles the permutation problem in evolutionary NAS crossover, where inconsistent architecture encodings yield invalid or degraded offspring. It proposes Shortest Edit Path Crossover, a theory-driven operator that minimizes the edit distance between parents and offspring. Compared with heuristic crossover, it offers theoretical grounding, though quantitative benchmark results are not reported in the abstract.
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.assessment: 对进化 NAS 的交叉算子给出理论化解决方案，方法学上有价值，但与自动驾驶视觉感知的直接相关性较弱。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.contribution: 提出基于最短编辑路径的交叉算子以解决进化 NAS 的排列问题。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.innovation: 用理论驱动的编辑距离最小化替代启发式交叉设计。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.result: 声称提升进化搜索稳定性与效率，摘要未给出具体实验数据。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d._arxiv_id: Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-driven Solution to the Permutation Problem in Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.

PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_cn: 针对 one-shot NAS 中权重共享导致的排序不一致与搜索效率问题，提出 PreNAS，通过“偏好”机制在超网训练中优先采样更有潜力的子网并抑制劣质子网对共享权重的干扰。方法在多个基准上验证，相比常规 one-shot 方法在搜索速度与最终精度之间取得更好折中。改进点在于缓解了权重共享带来的评估偏差，使搜索到的架构更接近独立训练性能。实验显示在保持或提升精度的同时显著降低搜索开销。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_en: PreNAS targets the ranking inconsistency and inefficiency in one-shot NAS caused by weight sharing. It introduces a preference mechanism that prioritizes promising subnets during supernet training while suppressing interference from inferior ones. Experiments show improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs over standard one-shot baselines.
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.assessment: 对 NAS 权重共享偏差问题给出了实用改进，但与本领域（自动驾驶/3D 感知）关联较弱。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.contribution: 提出基于偏好的 one-shot 超网训练策略以缓解权重共享偏差。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.innovation: 在超网训练中显式引入子网偏好采样以提升排序一致性。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.result: 在多个 NAS 基准上取得更优的精度-搜索开销折中。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa._arxiv_id: PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towards Efficient Neural Architecture Search.

QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_cn: 针对变分量子算法（VQA）中量子电路结构设计依赖人工经验的问题，提出 QuantumDARTS，将可微分架构搜索扩展到量子电路，实现量子门与连接结构的自动搜索。方法在若干量子任务上验证，相比人工设计电路取得更好或相当的优化效果。改进点在于把 DARTS 的可微分松弛适配到量子门参数化与噪声约束下。实验显示自动搜索电路在收敛速度与最终目标值上具有优势。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_en: QuantumDARTS addresses the manual design of quantum circuits in variational quantum algorithms by extending differentiable architecture search to quantum gates and connectivity. It adapts DARTS-style relaxation to quantum parameterization and noise constraints. Experiments show improved convergence and objective values over hand-crafted circuits.
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.assessment: 跨学科探索有价值，但与视觉/自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.contribution: 将可微分架构搜索引入变分量子算法电路设计。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.innovation: 面向量子门与噪声约束的可微分搜索松弛。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.result: 在多个量子任务上优于或持平人工设计电路。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc._arxiv_id: QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search for Variational Quantum Algorithms.

Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_cn: 针对图神经网络（GNN）架构搜索训练成本高的问题，提出一种无需训练的线性 NAS 方法，通过线性代理指标直接评估 GNN 架构质量。方法利用图结构的线性化近似避免完整训练，从而大幅降低搜索开销。改进点在于将 NAS 从训练密集型转为免训练评估。实验表明在多个图基准上以极低开销获得有竞争力的架构性能。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_en: This work targets the high training cost of GNN architecture search by proposing a training-free linear NAS that evaluates architectures via a linear proxy. It avoids full training through linearized graph approximations. Experiments show competitive GNN performance at drastically reduced search cost.
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.assessment: 免训练 NAS 思路有趣，但应用面窄，与感知领域关联低。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.contribution: 提出免训练的线性 GNN 架构搜索方法。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.innovation: 用线性代理指标替代完整训练评估 GNN 架构。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.result: 在多个图基准上以极低开销取得有竞争力性能。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite._arxiv_id: Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Architecture Search of Graph Neural Networks.

EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索空间与代码级实现难以自动生成的问题，提出 EvoPrompting，利用大语言模型进行代码级神经架构搜索，通过进化式提示迭代生成并优化网络代码。方法将 LLM 作为变异与交叉算子，在代码层面探索架构。改进点在于把 NAS 从固定搜索空间扩展到开放代码空间。实验显示在多个任务上生成的架构优于人工设计与传统 NAS 基线。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_en: EvoPrompting tackles code-level NAS by leveraging large language models with evolutionary prompting to generate and refine network code. LLMs act as mutation and crossover operators, expanding search beyond fixed spaces. Experiments show generated architectures outperform hand-designed and conventional NAS baselines.
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.assessment: LLM 驱动 NAS 是新兴方向，思路新颖，但与 3D 感知直接相关性有限。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.contribution: 提出基于 LLM 进化提示的代码级神经架构搜索。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.innovation: 将 LLM 作为进化算子实现开放代码空间搜索。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.result: 在多个任务上生成的架构优于人工设计与传统 NAS。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L._arxiv_id: EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-Level Neural Architecture Search.

Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: 针对多任务学习中任务间冲突导致共享架构次优的问题，提出任务感知的图神经架构搜索，结合任务协作与课程学习自动发现任务特定与共享结构。方法通过任务感知协作模块与课程调度缓解负迁移。改进点在于将 NAS 与多任务协作、课程学习统一建模。实验在多个多任务基准上优于单任务与共享架构基线。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper addresses task conflicts in multi-task learning by proposing a task-aware graph NAS with collaboration and curriculum learning to discover shared and task-specific structures. It mitigates negative transfer via task-aware collaboration and curriculum scheduling. Experiments outperform single-task and shared-architecture baselines.
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 多任务 NAS 思路合理，但与视觉感知任务关联较弱。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 提出任务感知协作与课程学习的多任务图 NAS。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 将任务协作与课程学习融入图架构搜索。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多个多任务基准上优于单任务与共享架构基线。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Search with Task-aware Collaboration and Curriculum.

Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索空间设计依赖人工、表达能力受限的问题，提出基于上下文无关文法（CFG）构建分层神经架构搜索空间，使搜索空间可组合、可扩展且表达力更强。方法用文法规则生成分层架构，并支持跨任务迁移。改进点在于以形式化文法替代手工搜索空间定义。实验表明该空间在多个基准上能发现更强架构并具良好泛化性。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_en: This work addresses the manual and limited design of NAS search spaces by constructing hierarchical spaces based on context-free grammars. CFG rules generate hierarchical architectures that are composable and transferable. Experiments show stronger discovered architectures and better generalization across benchmarks.
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.assessment: 搜索空间形式化设计有方法论价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.contribution: 提出基于上下文无关文法的分层 NAS 搜索空间构建方法。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.innovation: 用 CFG 形式化生成可组合的分层搜索空间。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.result: 在多个基准上发现更强架构并具良好泛化性。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch._arxiv_id: Construction of Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search Spaces based on Context-free Grammars.

Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_cn: 该论文针对知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing）任务中Transformer架构设计依赖人工经验、搜索空间与训练成本高的问题，提出了一种面向Transformer的进化神经架构搜索方法。方法通过进化算法在Transformer的层数、注意力头数、维度等结构维度上进行搜索，以提升知识追踪的预测性能。相比已有手工设计的Transformer或通用NAS方法，该工作将搜索空间定制到知识追踪场景，并利用进化策略降低搜索开销。摘要未提供具体数据集与性能提升数据，因此效果无法量化评估。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design burden of Transformer architectures for knowledge tracing by proposing an evolutionary neural architecture search method. It searches over Transformer structural dimensions such as layer count, attention heads, and hidden size to improve knowledge tracing prediction. Compared with hand-crafted Transformers and generic NAS approaches, the method tailors the search space to knowledge tracing and employs evolutionary strategies to reduce search cost. The abstract provides no concrete datasets or quantitative improvements, so the empirical gains remain unverified.
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知、3D检测、BEV、VLM等目标领域几乎无关，仅共享NAS这一外围主题，对视觉感知研究者的参考价值有限。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.contribution: 提出了一种面向知识追踪任务的Transformer进化神经架构搜索方法。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.innovation: 将进化NAS的搜索空间定制到知识追踪场景中的Transformer结构设计。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与性能数据，效果无法量化。

2501.03782|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在分布外（OoD）场景下泛化能力差、且缺乏系统性架构设计指导的问题，构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准OoD-ViT-NAS。该基准包含3000个不同计算预算的ViT架构，在8个常见OoD数据集上进行评估，并系统分析了影响OoD泛化的架构因素。研究发现：ViT架构设计显著影响OoD泛化；ID准确率往往是OoD准确率的糟糕指标，提示仅针对ID性能优化架构存在风险；此外，作者首次研究了面向ViT OoD鲁棒性的NAS，分析了9种免训练NAS方法，发现这些方法虽擅长预测ID准确率，却基本无法预测OoD准确率，而Param、Flop等简单代理指标反而优于复杂免训练NAS方法。
2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OoD-ViT-NAS, the first systematic benchmark for ViT NAS targeting out-of-distribution generalization, comprising 3000 ViT architectures evaluated on 8 OoD datasets. It reveals that ViT architecture design significantly affects OoD generalization, that ID accuracy is often a poor proxy for OoD accuracy, and that existing training-free NAS methods largely fail to predict OoD accuracy, with simple proxies like Param or Flop surprisingly outperforming complex ones.
2501.03782|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了ViT架构搜索与OoD泛化交叉领域缺乏基准的空白，其反直觉发现（ID准确率不可靠、简单代理优于复杂NAS）对自动驾驶等安全敏感场景的架构设计具有重要警示价值。
2501.03782|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向ViT OoD泛化的NAS基准，并系统揭示了架构设计与NAS代理指标在OoD场景下的失效规律。
2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次将NAS鲁棒性研究从ID扩展到OoD，并发现简单代理指标（Param/Flop）在预测OoD准确率上优于复杂免训练NAS方法。
2501.03782|v2.result: 在3000个架构、8个OoD数据集上的实验表明，ID准确率与OoD准确率弱相关，现有免训练NAS方法预测OoD准确率基本无效。

Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of simultaneously improving order-preserving property and transferability in Neural Architecture Search. It proposes a joint architecture refined search and fine-tuning approach, though specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.

Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.innovation: 将架构精炼搜索与微调进行联合优化，以缓解排序不一致与迁移性能下降的问题。

AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.summary_en: This paper proposes AZ-NAS, which assembles multiple zero-cost proxies to improve architecture evaluation in Neural Architecture Search. Specific proxy combination strategies and experimental results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.assessment: 零成本代理的集成是提升NAS效率与可靠性的实用方向，该工作思路合理，但缺乏摘要信息难以评估其集成策略的有效性与实验充分度。

SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.summary_en: This paper proposes SNED, a Superposition Network Architecture Search method for efficient video diffusion models. Specific search space design, superposition mechanism, and experimental results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.
SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.assessment: 视频扩散模型的高效化是生成领域的热点问题，将NAS与叠加机制结合具有一定新意，但缺乏摘要信息难以判断其实际加速效果与生成质量。

SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_cn: 针对联邦学习场景下设备端推理的NAS搜索成本高、通信开销大的问题，提出SuperFedNAS，将联邦NAS与超网训练结合，在联邦端只训练一次超网并共享，各客户端在本地做架构搜索。相比逐客户端独立搜索的FedNAS，显著降低搜索与通信成本，同时保持或提升设备端精度。实验在多个数据集上验证了其成本-精度权衡优势。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses the high search and communication cost of federated NAS for on-device inference. SuperFedNAS trains a single supernet in a federated manner and shares it across clients, which then perform local architecture search. It reduces search and communication overhead compared with per-client federated NAS while maintaining or improving on-device accuracy.
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.assessment: 将超网与联邦NAS结合以降低端侧搜索成本，思路清晰，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.contribution: 提出一种成本高效的联邦超网NAS框架SuperFedNAS。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.innovation: 在联邦端共享训练一次超网，客户端本地搜索，避免重复搜索开销。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.result: 在多个数据集上以更低搜索与通信成本取得与逐客户端NAS相当或更优的设备端精度。

Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_cn: 针对无训练生成式架构搜索中代理指标依赖人工设计、跨任务泛化差的问题，提出Auto-GAS，自动发现适用于生成模型的代理指标。方法通过自动化搜索代理的组合与形式，替代手工代理，从而在无需训练的情况下评估生成架构。相比手工代理，Auto-GAS在多个生成任务上取得更稳定、更优的搜索性能。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_en: This paper targets the manual design and poor cross-task generalization of proxies in training-free generative architecture search. Auto-GAS automatically discovers proxies for generative models, replacing hand-crafted ones. It achieves more stable and better search performance across generative tasks than manual proxies.
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.assessment: 自动化代理发现对无训练NAS有普适价值，但面向生成模型，与感知检测任务距离较远。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.contribution: 提出自动代理发现方法Auto-GAS用于无训练生成式架构搜索。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.innovation: 以自动化方式搜索生成模型的代理指标，减少人工先验依赖。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.result: 在多个生成任务上取得比手工代理更稳定且更优的搜索性能。

Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_cn: 针对无训练蒸馏感知架构搜索中代理指标需人工设计、跨任务不稳定的问题，提出Auto-DAS，自动发现蒸馏感知的代理指标。方法通过自动化搜索代理形式，在无需训练的情况下评估面向知识蒸馏的架构。相比手工代理，Auto-DAS在多个任务上取得更一致、更优的搜索效果。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design and instability of proxies in training-free distillation-aware architecture search. Auto-DAS automatically discovers distillation-aware proxies to evaluate architectures without training. It yields more consistent and better search results than hand-crafted proxies across tasks.

Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.contribution: 提出自动代理发现方法Auto-DAS用于无训练蒸馏感知架构搜索。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.innovation: 自动化搜索蒸馏感知代理指标，降低人工设计成本。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.result: 在多个任务上取得比手工代理更一致且更优的搜索性能。

Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS中架构参数与操作之间依赖关系被忽略、搜索不稳定与次优的问题，提出依赖感知可微NAS，显式建模操作间的依赖关系。方法在可微搜索框架中引入依赖建模，使架构参数更新更合理。相比标准DARTS类方法，缓解了搜索退化并提升了最终架构性能。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.summary_en: This paper targets the ignored dependencies among operations in differentiable NAS, which cause unstable and suboptimal search. It proposes a dependency-aware differentiable NAS that explicitly models operation dependencies within the differentiable framework. Compared with standard DARTS-style methods, it alleviates search degeneration and improves final architecture performance.
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.assessment: 对可微NAS的依赖建模是有意义的改进，但属于通用NAS方法，与感知任务关联有限。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.contribution: 提出依赖感知的可微神经架构搜索方法。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.innovation: 在可微搜索中显式建模操作间依赖关系。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.result: 缓解搜索退化，在标准基准上取得优于DARTS类方法的架构性能。

Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.summary_cn: 针对自监督Transformer架构搜索中缺乏有效无训练评估信号的问题，提出掩码蒸馏方法，将掩码建模与蒸馏结合用于架构评估。方法利用掩码蒸馏信号指导自监督ViT的架构搜索，无需完整训练即可评估候选架构。相比已有无训练指标，在自监督Transformer搜索上取得更优的下游性能。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of effective training-free evaluation signals in self-supervised Transformer architecture search. It proposes masked distillation that combines masked modeling with distillation to guide architecture search for self-supervised ViTs. It achieves better downstream performance than existing training-free metrics.
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.assessment: 与Vision Transformer和自监督相关，对感知骨干搜索有一定借鉴意义。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.contribution: 提出掩码蒸馏以推进自监督Transformer架构搜索。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.innovation: 将掩码建模与蒸馏信号结合用于无训练架构评估。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.result: 在自监督Transformer搜索上取得优于已有无训练指标的下游性能。

2403.07591|v2.summary_cn: 针对无训练NAS中单一代理指标跨任务估计能力不稳定、且与真实性能存在差距的问题，提出RoBoT算法。方法先用贝叶斯优化从现有无训练指标中搜索最优组合，得到跨任务更稳健的代理，再用贪心搜索在该代理上做利用以缩小估计差距。相比单一指标，RoBoT在多样任务上取得更稳健且更优的搜索性能。
2403.07591|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the unstable cross-task estimation of single training-free metrics and their gap to true architecture performance in training-free NAS. RoBoT first uses Bayesian optimization to find an optimized combination of existing training-free metrics for robustness, then applies greedy search on the new metric to bridge the estimation gap. It achieves more robust and better search performance across diverse tasks than single metrics.
2403.07591|v2.assessment: 对无训练NAS的稳健性问题给出系统解法，方法扎实，但属通用NAS，与感知任务关联一般。
2403.07591|v2.contribution: 提出稳健化并增强的无训练NAS算法RoBoT。
2403.07591|v2.innovation: 用贝叶斯优化组合多个无训练指标，并以贪心搜索缩小估计差距。
2403.07591|v2.result: 在多样任务上取得比单一无训练指标更稳健且更优的搜索性能。

2402.03500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）时代变分量子算法（VQA）中电路架构选择困难的问题，提出了一种基于课程学习的强化学习量子架构搜索算法（CRLQAS）。方法上引入了三维架构编码、环境动力学限制以及课程学习策略，以在硬件噪声条件下探索电路搜索空间。相比已有QAS工作忽略了噪声对架构搜索的影响，该工作首次系统性地将噪声因素纳入搜索过程。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但声称能应对真实VQA部署中的挑战。
2402.03500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of circuit architecture selection for variational quantum algorithms in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum era. It proposes a curriculum-based reinforcement learning quantum architecture search (CRLQAS) algorithm incorporating 3D architecture encoding, environment dynamics restrictions, and curriculum learning to explore circuit search spaces under hardware noise. Unlike prior QAS work that neglects noise effects on architecture search, this work explicitly models noise during the search process. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2402.03500|v2.assessment: 该论文属于量子计算与NAS的交叉方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知领域几乎无关，仅对量子架构搜索研究者有参考价值。
2402.03500|v2.contribution: 提出了课程学习驱动的强化学习量子架构搜索算法CRLQAS，将噪声因素纳入搜索过程。
2402.03500|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地研究硬件噪声对量子架构搜索的影响，并引入3D编码与课程学习策略。
2402.03500|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，仅声称能应对真实VQA部署中的噪声挑战。

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中预测器性能受架构编码方式影响的问题，系统性地将神经编码分为结构编码、学习编码和分数编码三类，并提出了统一编码（unified encodings）以支持跨搜索空间的预测器。基于在超过150万个架构（涵盖NB101、NB201、NB301、NDS、TransNASBench-101）上的实验分析，作者提出了FLAN（Flow Attention for NAS）预测器，整合了预测器设计、迁移学习和统一编码的关键洞见。FLAN将训练成本降低了一个数量级以上，在多个NAS基准上取得了优异效果。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper systematically categorizes neural architecture encodings into structural, learned, and score-based types, and introduces unified encodings that extend NAS predictors to multiple search spaces. Drawing on experiments over 1.5 million architectures across NASBench-101, NB201, NB301, NDS, and TransNASBench-101, the authors propose FLAN (Flow Attention for NAS), which integrates insights on predictor design, transfer learning, and unified encodings. FLAN achieves more than an order of magnitude cost reduction for training while maintaining strong performance.

2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS过程中高碳排放的问题，提出了碳高效NAS框架CE-NAS。方法上利用强化学习智能体根据时间序列Transformer预测的碳强度动态调整GPU资源，以平衡节能采样与耗能评估任务，并结合多目标优化器缩减搜索空间。在HW-NasBench数据集上，CE-NAS将碳排放降低最多7.22倍，同时保持与原始NAS相当的搜索效率；在CIFAR-10上以仅1.68M参数达到97.35% top-1准确率，碳排放仅38.53磅CO2。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high carbon cost of NAS by proposing CE-NAS, a carbon-efficient NAS framework. CE-NAS employs a reinforcement-learning agent to dynamically adjust GPU resources based on carbon intensity predicted by a time-series transformer, balancing energy-efficient sampling and energy-intensive evaluation, and leverages a multi-objective optimizer to reduce the search space. On HW-NasBench, CE-NAS reduces carbon emissions by up to 7.22X while maintaining search efficiency; on CIFAR-10, it achieves 97.35% top-1 accuracy with only 1.68M parameters and 38.53 lbs of CO2.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该工作关注NAS的碳排放问题，具有实际工程意义，但与自动驾驶视觉感知的核心问题关联较弱，仅对关注绿色AI的研究者有参考价值。
2406.01414|v2.contribution: 提出了碳高效的NAS框架CE-NAS，通过动态GPU资源调度和多目标优化降低碳排放。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 将碳强度预测与强化学习资源调度结合，实现NAS过程的碳效率优化。
2406.01414|v2.result: 在HW-NasBench上碳排放降低最多7.22倍，CIFAR-10上以1.68M参数达到97.35% top-1准确率，碳排放38.53磅CO2。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: 现有零成本（ZC）NAS 代理大多局限于卷积搜索空间，难以适用于 Vision Transformer。本文构建了基于 Autoformer 搜索空间、覆盖 6 个任务的基准，并提出 L-SWAG 指标，利用逐层逐样本的激活与梯度信息刻画卷积与 Transformer 架构，在 14 个任务上验证其通用性；同时提出 LIBRA-NAS 通过低信息增益与偏置重对齐来组合互补代理。相比已有 ZC 代理，L-SWAG 首次将零成本代理系统扩展到 ViT 搜索空间，并在多任务上取得更稳定的排序相关性。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: Existing zero-cost (ZC) NAS proxies are mostly confined to convolutional search spaces and do not transfer well to Vision Transformers. This paper introduces a benchmark on the Autoformer search space across 6 tasks and proposes L-SWAG, a layer- and sample-wise activation-with-gradient metric that characterizes both convolutional and transformer architectures over 14 tasks. It further presents LIBRA-NAS to combine complementary proxies via low information gain and bias re-alignment, extending ZC-NAS to ViTs with improved ranking fidelity.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 将零成本 NAS 代理从 CNN 推广到 ViT 并给出多任务基准，对 NAS 与 ViT 交叉方向有参考价值。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向 Vision Transformer 的零成本 NAS 代理 L-SWAG 及配套基准与 LIBRA-NAS 组合方法。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 用逐层逐样本的激活-梯度统计量统一刻画卷积与 Transformer 架构的零成本可训练性。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在 14 个任务上验证代理通用性，并在 Autoformer 搜索空间 6 个任务上建立新基准。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: N-shot NAS 的 supernet 通常对所有子网采用统一训练策略，导致训练偏向低复杂度子网（不公平）且动量更新噪声大。本文提出子网感知的动态 supernet 训练：复杂度感知学习率调度器 CaLR 按子网复杂度自适应控制学习率衰减，动量分离技术 MS 将结构相似的子网分组并各自维护动量。该方法可低成本嵌入多种 N-shot NAS，显著提升搜索性能。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: N-shot NAS trains all subnets in a supernet with a static strategy, biasing training toward low-complexity subnets and producing noisy momentum updates. This paper proposes subnet-aware dynamic supernet training with a complexity-aware LR scheduler (CaLR) and a momentum separation technique (MS) that groups structurally similar subnets. The approach is plug-and-play for various N-shot NAS methods and substantially improves search performance at marginal cost.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 针对 supernet 训练偏差与动量噪声的工程性改进，思路清晰但领域相关性一般。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出复杂度感知学习率调度与动量分离的子网感知 supernet 训练方案。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 按子网复杂度自适应调整学习率衰减，并按结构相似性分组维护独立动量。
2503.10740|v2.result: 可低成本应用于多种 N-shot NAS 方法并大幅提升搜索性能。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: NAS 的主要瓶颈是需从头训练每个候选架构，计算代价极高。本文提出基于 Fisher 信息的无训练代理，用于估计给定深度网络的期望图像分类精度，具有统计学理论支撑，从而显著降低 NAS 计算成本。该代理在三个公开数据集、两个搜索空间上取得当时最优结果，并在作者新提出的评价指标下同样表现领先。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: NAS is prohibitively expensive because each candidate architecture must be trained from scratch. This paper proposes a training-free proxy based on Fisher Information, with a statistical theoretical foundation, to estimate the expected classification accuracy of a network without training. It achieves state-of-the-art results on three public datasets and two search spaces, under both prior metrics and a newly proposed metric.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 理论动机扎实的无训练 NAS 代理，对降低搜索成本有实用意义。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Fisher 信息的无训练图像分类精度代理。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 将 Fisher 信息引入零成本 NAS 代理并给出统计学理论解释。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在三个数据集、两个搜索空间上取得 SOTA 的无训练代理表现。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: 性能预测器可降低 NAS 评估成本，但其效果高度依赖损失函数选择，而回归、排序与加权损失的作用尚未被系统研究。本文首次对预测器损失函数进行综述式实证研究，将八种损失分为回归、排序与加权三类，在五个搜索空间、13 个任务上用多种 NAS 相关指标评估。结果表明特定类别的损失函数可有效组合以提升基于预测器的 NAS，并给出实践指导。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: Performance predictors reduce NAS evaluation cost, yet the choice of loss function remains under-studied. This paper conducts the first comprehensive empirical study of predictor losses, categorizing eight losses into regression, ranking, and weighted types, and evaluating them on 13 tasks across five search spaces with NAS-relevant metrics. It finds that specific loss categories can be effectively combined to improve predictor-based NAS and offers practical guidance.
2506.05869|v2.assessment: 系统性实证研究，结论对做 NAS 预测器的工作有直接指导价值。
2506.05869|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究并分类 NAS 性能预测器的损失函数。
2506.05869|v2.innovation: 在统一基准上跨 5 个搜索空间、13 个任务对比回归/排序/加权损失并给出组合策略。
2506.05869|v2.result: 发现特定损失类别组合可提升预测器型 NAS 性能并给出实践指南。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标神经架构搜索中Pareto前沿刻画需要为每个硬件约束重复搜索、计算代价高昂的问题，提出一种将用户偏好向量与硬件特征编码进超网络的NAS算法，通过条件化联合架构分布实现单次搜索即可覆盖多设备多目标的代表性架构。相比以往把硬件约束并入目标函数、需逐约束重搜的做法，本方法支持对新设备的零样本迁移。实验覆盖多达19种硬件设备和3种目标，验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS, where each hardware constraint typically requires a separate search. It proposes a hypernetwork that conditions the joint architectural distribution on hardware features and preference vectors, enabling diverse, representative architectures across devices in a single search run with zero-shot transfer to new devices. Experiments on up to 19 hardware devices and 3 objectives demonstrate effectiveness and scalability.
2402.18213|v2.assessment: 把偏好条件化超网络用于多目标NAS并实现跨设备零样本迁移，思路清晰、实验规模较大，对关注NAS与硬件感知部署的研究者有参考价值。
2402.18213|v2.contribution: 提出一种偏好与硬件条件化的超网络NAS方法，单次搜索即可刻画多设备多目标的Pareto前沿。
2402.18213|v2.innovation: 将用户偏好向量与硬件特征联合编码进架构分布，实现跨设备零样本迁移的Pareto前沿刻画。
2402.18213|v2.result: 在多达19种硬件设备与3种目标上验证了有效性与可扩展性，无需为每个约束重复搜索。

2004.00543|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测器易受对抗攻击、而现有对抗研究多局限于2D图像的问题，本文提出生成可物理实现的通用3D对抗物体以欺骗LiDAR检测器。方法将对抗物体放置于目标车辆车顶，使其在点云表示下被检测器完全忽略，并在多种点云输入表示的检测器上验证攻击效果。相比已有2D对抗工作，本文首次系统性地将对抗攻击拓展到3D LiDAR感知并强调物理可实现性，攻击成功率达80%。此外还初步探索了基于数据增强的对抗防御。
2004.00543|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of LiDAR-based 3D object detectors to adversarial attacks, which has been far less explored than 2D image attacks. It proposes physically realizable universal 3D adversarial objects that, when placed on a vehicle rooftop, hide the vehicle from LiDAR detectors with an 80% success rate across detectors using various point cloud representations. A pilot study on adversarial defense via data augmentation is also conducted.
2004.00543|v2.assessment: 该工作将对抗攻击从2D拓展到物理可实现的3D LiDAR感知，攻击成功率高且覆盖多种检测器，对自动驾驶感知安全性研究具有重要参考价值。
2004.00543|v2.contribution: 提出可物理实现的通用3D对抗物体，实现对LiDAR检测器的有效欺骗。
2004.00543|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在3D LiDAR点云上生成物理可部署的对抗物体并验证跨检测器迁移性。
2004.00543|v2.result: 在多种点云表示的检测器上实现80%的车辆隐藏攻击成功率。

2005.07178|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云内存占用大、单辆车每天采集840亿点的问题，本文提出OctSqueeze深度压缩算法以降低点云存储与传输开销。方法先将点云编码为八叉树，再设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，从而编码为紧凑比特流。相比此前最优方法，在相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，且在相同比特率下下游3D分割与检测任务表现更优。该工作为自动驾驶车载与离线点云存储提供了高效压缩方案。
2005.07178|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the large memory footprint of LiDAR point clouds by proposing OctSqueeze, a deep compression algorithm that encodes points into an octree and models octree symbol probabilities with a tree-structured conditional entropy model. It reduces bitrate by 10-20% at equal reconstruction quality over prior state-of-the-art, and outperforms other compressors on downstream 3D segmentation and detection at the same bitrate.
2005.07178|v2.assessment: 该工作将深度熵建模引入LiDAR点云压缩，兼顾压缩率与下游任务性能，对自动驾驶数据存储与传输具有实际工程价值。
2005.07178|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树结构条件熵模型的LiDAR点云深度压缩算法。
2005.07178|v2.innovation: 设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，实现高效稀疏点云压缩。
2005.07178|v2.result: 相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，相同比特率下下游分割与检测任务优于其他压缩算法。

2003.06754|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中需要同时可靠感知物体存在与运动行为的问题，本文提出MotionNet，从3D点云序列联合执行感知与运动预测。方法以LiDAR扫描序列为输入，输出BEV地图，每个网格单元编码物体类别与运动信息，骨干为新颖的时空金字塔网络以分层提取深层时空特征，并引入空间与时间一致性损失正则化预测平滑性。实验表明该方法整体优于包括最新场景流和3D目标检测方法在内的现有工作，可作为基于边界框系统的备份并为运动规划器提供互补信息。
2003.06754|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MotionNet, an efficient deep model that jointly performs perception and motion prediction from LiDAR sweep sequences, outputting a BEV map encoding object category and motion per grid cell. Its spatio-temporal pyramid backbone extracts hierarchical spatial and temporal features, regularized by novel spatial and temporal consistency losses. Experiments show it overall outperforms state-of-the-art scene-flow and 3D object detection based methods.
2003.06754|v2.assessment: 该工作以BEV网格统一建模感知与运动预测，时空金字塔与一致性损失设计合理，可作为检测系统的互补备份，对自动驾驶感知与规划衔接有参考价值。
2003.06754|v2.contribution: 提出联合感知与运动预测的MotionNet，输出编码类别与运动的BEV地图。
2003.06754|v2.innovation: 设计时空金字塔网络与空间/时间一致性损失，实现分层时空特征提取与平滑预测。
2003.06754|v2.result: 整体优于最新场景流与3D目标检测方法，为运动规划提供互补信息。

1911.10455|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有驾驶员注意力预测仅依赖人类注视信息而忽略场景语义的问题，本文提出SAGE（语义增强注视）检测方法，在原始注视基础上捕获驾驶特定上下文信息。基于此设计完整显著性预测框架SAGE-Net，融合物体距离（深度）、自车速度与行人过街意图等关键因素修正初始预测。在四个流行显著性算法上的实验表明，在49/56（87.5%）的情况下SAGE优于现有技术，且训练过程无额外计算开销。
1911.10455|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses driver attention prediction that relies solely on human gaze while ignoring scene semantics, proposing the Semantics Augmented GazE (SAGE) approach that combines gaze with driving-specific contextual information. The SAGE-Net saliency prediction framework further incorporates depth, ego speed, and pedestrian crossing intent. Experiments across four saliency algorithms show SAGE outperforms existing techniques in 49/56 (87.5%) cases without additional training overhead.
1911.10455|v2.assessment: 该工作将场景语义与驾驶上下文引入驾驶员注意力预测，思路新颖且实验覆盖多场景，对自动驾驶人机交互与安全研究有一定参考价值。
1911.10455|v2.contribution: 提出融合场景语义与驾驶上下文的SAGE注视检测方法及SAGE-Net显著性预测框架。
1911.10455|v2.innovation: 将深度、自车速度与行人过街意图等驾驶关键因素融入注视增强的显著性预测。
1911.10455|v2.result: 在49/56（87.5%）情况下优于现有技术，且无额外训练计算开销。

Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶决策中观察-动作映射难以泛化的问题，本文提出将观察-动作规则内化到网络中的可建议学习框架。方法通过从专家驾驶数据中提取规则并约束策略网络，使模型在未见场景下也能给出合理建议动作。相比纯端到端模仿学习，该方法提升了决策的可解释性与泛化能力。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但实验表明在多个驾驶场景下优于基线。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of observation-to-action mappings in autonomous driving by proposing an advisable learning framework that internalizes expert rules into the policy network. The method extracts rules from expert data and constrains the policy, improving interpretability and generalization over pure end-to-end imitation learning. Experiments show gains over baselines across driving scenarios, though no specific numbers are reported in the abstract.
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.assessment: 将规则内化与端到端学习结合，对自动驾驶决策的可解释性有参考价值，但缺乏具体量化结果。
