2410.23780|v2.summary_cn: 现有在线高精地图构建主要关注几何与连通性层，忽略了交通标志规则层与矢量化地图的关联。本文提出MapDR数据集，包含超过10,000个标注视频片段，捕捉交通标志规则与车道之间的复杂关联，并定义了将交通规则集成到在线HD地图的新任务。作者提供了模块化方案VLE-MEE和端到端方案RuleVLM作为强基线。该工作填补了交通标志规则集成到在线地图中的空白，为可靠自动驾驶系统提供数据与基线支持。
2410.23780|v2.summary_en: Existing online HD mapping solutions prioritize geometric and connectivity layers while neglecting the traffic regulation layer. This paper introduces MapDR, a dataset with over 10,000 annotated video clips capturing the correlation between traffic sign regulations and lanes, and defines a new task of integrating traffic rules into online HD maps. Modular (VLE-MEE) and end-to-end (RuleVLM) baselines are provided, filling a critical gap for reliable autonomous driving.
2410.23780|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了在线HD地图中交通规则层构建的空白，数据集规模大且任务定义清晰，对自动驾驶地图与规则理解方向有重要参考价值。
2410.23780|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向交通标志规则提取与矢量化HD地图关联的大规模数据集MapDR，并定义了新任务。
2410.23780|v2.innovation: 将交通规则层引入在线HD地图构建，提出模块化与端到端两种解决方案。
2410.23780|v2.result: 提供了超过10,000个标注视频片段及强基线VLE-MEE和RuleVLM，推动交通规则集成研究。

2506.06218|v2.summary_cn: 现有VLM基准多针对单视角图像或视频的语义任务，缺乏对自动驾驶中时空推理能力的系统评估。本文提出STSBench框架，可自动从任意数据集中挖掘预定义交通场景，提供人工验证界面并生成多选题，基于NuScenes构建了STSnu基准。STSnu评估驾驶专家VLM在多视角相机或LiDAR视频上的端到端驾驶能力，特别关注自车动作与交通参与者交互的推理。该基准包含43个多样场景、971个问题，填补了VLM时空推理评估的空白。
2506.06218|v2.summary_en: Existing VLM benchmarks focus on single-view semantic tasks, lacking systematic evaluation of spatio-temporal reasoning in autonomous driving. This paper proposes STSBench, a scenario-based framework that automatically mines traffic scenarios, supports human verification, and generates multiple-choice questions, yielding STSnu on NuScenes. STSnu evaluates driving expert VLMs on multi-view or LiDAR videos for end-to-end driving, covering 43 scenarios and 971 questions.
2506.06218|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶VLM提供了首个基于全面3D感知的时空推理基准，场景挖掘自动化程度高，对VLM在自动驾驶中的评估有重要推动作用。
2506.06218|v2.contribution: 提出了场景驱动的VLM基准框架STSBench，并构建了基于NuScenes的STSnu时空推理基准。
2506.06218|v2.innovation: 自动挖掘交通场景并生成多选题，首次系统评估VLM在多视角/ LiDAR下的时空推理能力。
2506.06218|v2.result: 包含43个场景、971个问题，覆盖多视角多帧，为VLM在自动驾驶中的评估提供标准化工具。

2506.05175|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频异常检测方法多关注异常帧或异常对象，忽略像素级细粒度分析，限制了异常捕捉范围。本文提出TAO框架，首次将多细粒度异常对象检测集成到统一流程中，将问题转化为像素级异常对象跟踪，通过将异常分数与分割和跟踪等下游任务关联，消除了阈值调参需求。实验表明TAO在准确性和鲁棒性上达到新基准，尤其在长复杂视频序列中实现更精确的异常定位。
2506.05175|v2.summary_en: Existing video anomaly detection methods focus on anomalous frames or objects, neglecting pixel-level granularity. This paper proposes TAO, a granular pipeline that integrates detection of multiple fine-grained anomalous objects into a unified framework, transforming the problem into pixel-level tracking of anomalous objects. By linking anomaly scores to segmentation and tracking, TAO removes threshold tuning and achieves precise localization in long complex videos, setting new benchmarks.
2506.05175|v2.assessment: 该工作将异常检测与像素级跟踪结合，思路新颖，对视频异常检测的细粒度分析有启发，但主要面向监控场景，与自动驾驶直接相关性有限。
2506.05175|v2.contribution: 提出了首个将多细粒度异常对象检测统一到像素级跟踪框架的TAO流水线。
2506.05175|v2.innovation: 将异常检测转化为像素级异常对象跟踪，消除阈值调参并实现细粒度定位。
2506.05175|v2.result: 在准确性和鲁棒性上达到新基准，长复杂视频序列中异常定位更精确。

2503.12982|v2.summary_cn: 现有协同目标检测方法多基于密集BEV特征图，计算量大且难以扩展到长距离检测，全稀疏框架鲜有探索。本文提出SparseAlign，一个全稀疏协同检测框架，包含增强稀疏3D骨干、基于查询的时序上下文学习模块和针对稀疏特征定制的鲁棒检测头。在OPV2V和DairV2X数据集上，该框架以更少通信带宽超越当前最优方法，并在时间对齐的OPV2Vt和DairV2Xt数据集上相比基线取得显著性能提升。
2503.12982|v2.summary_en: Existing cooperative object detection methods mostly operate on dense BEV feature maps, which are computationally demanding and hard to scale to long-range detection. This paper proposes SparseAlign, a fully sparse framework with an enhanced sparse 3D backbone, a query-based temporal context learning module, and a robust detection head tailored for sparse features. It outperforms state-of-the-art on OPV2V and DairV2X with less communication bandwidth, and shows significant gains on time-aligned datasets.
2503.12982|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统探索全稀疏协同目标检测，在精度与通信效率上均优于密集BEV方案，对车路协同感知方向有重要参考价值。
2503.12982|v2.contribution: 提出了全稀疏协同目标检测框架SparseAlign，包含增强稀疏骨干、查询时序模块和稀疏检测头。
2503.12982|v2.innovation: 用全稀疏架构替代密集BEV特征图，降低计算与通信开销并支持长距离检测。
2503.12982|v2.result: 在OPV2V和DairV2X上以更少带宽超越SOTA，在时间对齐数据集上性能显著提升。

2505.02148|v2.summary_cn: 自动驾驶需要检测道路上的异常物体，但3D异常分割研究不足，现有数据集缺乏高质量多模态数据。本文提出了首个公开的面向道路异常分割的3D LiDAR数据集，包含密集3D语义标注、LiDAR与相机数据以及序列信息，支持不同距离的异常检测。作者适配并评估了多个3D分割基线模型，揭示了驾驶环境中3D异常检测的挑战，数据集与评估代码将公开。
2505.02148|v2.summary_en: Autonomous vehicles need to detect unexpected objects, but 3D anomaly segmentation is underexplored due to lack of high-quality multimodal datasets. This paper presents the first publicly available dataset for road anomaly segmentation with dense 3D semantic labeling, incorporating LiDAR, camera, and sequential information for anomaly detection across ranges. Several 3D segmentation baselines are adapted and evaluated, highlighting challenges in 3D anomaly detection.
2505.02148|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了3D LiDAR异常分割的空白，多模态与序列信息对自动驾驶安全研究有重要价值，但方法贡献有限，主要贡献在数据层面。
2505.02148|v2.contribution: 发布了首个公开的密集3D语义标注、多模态、带序列信息的道路异常分割LiDAR数据集。
2505.02148|v2.innovation: 将异常分割从2D扩展到3D LiDAR，并提供多模态与序列信息支持不同距离检测。
2505.02148|v2.result: 适配评估多个3D分割基线，揭示3D异常检测挑战，数据集与代码将公开。

2411.16816|v2.summary_cn: 现有NeRF方法用于相机和LiDAR传感器真实感渲染时速度慢，难以大规模测试；3DGS虽可实时渲染但仅限相机数据，无法渲染LiDAR。本文提出SplatAD，首个基于3DGS的方法，可对动态场景同时实时渲染相机和LiDAR数据，精确建模卷帘快门、LiDAR强度和射线丢失等传感器特定现象。在三个自动驾驶数据集上评估，SplatAD达到最先进的渲染质量与实时性能。
2411.16816|v2.summary_en: Existing NeRF methods for sensor-realistic camera and LiDAR rendering suffer from low speed, while 3DGS enables real-time rendering but is limited to camera data. This paper proposes SplatAD, the first 3DGS-based method for realistic, real-time rendering of dynamic scenes for both camera and LiDAR, accurately modeling rolling shutter, LiDAR intensity, and ray dropouts. Evaluated on three autonomous driving datasets, SplatAD achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality and real-time performance.
2411.16816|v2.assessment: 该工作将3DGS扩展到LiDAR渲染，解决了自动驾驶仿真中实时多传感器渲染的痛点，对数据驱动仿真与闭环测试有重要价值。
2411.16816|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于3DGS的同时支持相机和LiDAR实时渲染的动态场景方法SplatAD。
2411.16816|v2.innovation: 精确建模卷帘快门、LiDAR强度和射线丢失等传感器现象，实现实时多模态渲染。
2411.16816|v2.result: 在三个自动驾驶数据集上达到最先进的渲染质量与实时性能。

2503.17752|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督LiDAR点云语义分割中现有方法仅利用空间分布或短时（两帧）时序、忽略自动驾驶场景长时时序特性的问题，提出HiLoTs框架。该方法从连续LiDAR帧中分别学习高时序敏感与低时序敏感表征，并用交叉注意力进行增强与融合，同时采用教师-学生框架对齐有标注与无标注分支的表征。相比只关注短时时序的已有方法，HiLoTs显式建模了近处物体时序稳定、远处物体时序多变的驾驶先验。在自动驾驶LiDAR分割基准上取得了优于现有半监督方法的性能。
2503.17752|v2.summary_en: Existing semi-supervised LiDAR segmentation methods exploit only spatial distributions or short-term temporal cues (e.g., two adjacent frames), neglecting the rich long-term temporal properties of driving scenes. HiLoTs learns high- and low-temporal-sensitivity representations from continuous LiDAR frames, enhances and fuses them via cross-attention, and aligns labeled/unlabeled representations in a teacher-student framework. It outperforms prior semi-supervised methods by explicitly encoding the observation that nearby objects are temporally stable while distant ones vary.
2503.17752|v2.assessment: 将驾驶先验（近稳远变）转化为可学习的高低时序敏感表征，思路新颖，对半监督LiDAR分割有实用价值。
2503.17752|v2.contribution: 提出HiLoTs，从连续LiDAR帧中学习高/低时序敏感表征并交叉注意力融合，用于半监督LiDAR语义分割。
2503.17752|v2.innovation: 显式建模近处低时序敏感、远处高时序敏感的驾驶先验，并结合教师-学生框架对齐标注与无标注表征。
2503.17752|v2.result: 在自动驾驶LiDAR分割任务上超越现有半监督方法。

2507.17083|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D占用预测中相机方法缺深度、LiDAR方法受遮挡、以及LSS式视角变换深度估计不准且未充分利用LiDAR几何语义信息的问题，提出SDG-OCC网络。该方法通过扩散与双线性离散化融合像素语义与共点深度构建精确深度分布，并设计融合到占用驱动的主动蒸馏，依据LiDAR识别区域选择性向图像特征迁移知识；同时给出仅融合的SDG-Fusion与融合加蒸馏的SDG-KL两种配置。相比现有轻量LSS方法，在多模态占用预测上取得更优性能。
2507.17083|v2.summary_en: Most multimodal 3D occupancy methods are single-modality or rely on the LSS pipeline, which suffers from inaccurate depth and underuses LiDAR geometry/semantics. SDG-OCC introduces a joint semantic- and depth-guided view transformation that builds accurate depth distributions via diffusion and bilinear discretization, plus a fusion-to-occupancy-driven active distillation that selectively transfers multimodal knowledge to image features based on LiDAR-identified regions. It offers SDG-Fusion and SDG-KL variants and improves multimodal occupancy prediction over prior lightweight methods.
2507.17083|v2.assessment: 语义与深度联合引导的视角变换加主动蒸馏设计合理，对多模态占用预测的深度估计瓶颈有针对性改进。
2507.17083|v2.contribution: 提出SDG-OCC，用语义与深度联合引导的视角变换和融合到占用驱动的主动蒸馏提升多模态3D占用预测。
2507.17083|v2.innovation: 通过扩散与双线性离散化融合像素语义和共点深度构建深度分布，并按LiDAR识别区域选择性蒸馏知识。
2507.17083|v2.result: 在多模态3D占用预测上优于现有轻量方法。

2504.01957|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于投影/查询学习的BEV感知方法缺乏不确定性建模且计算开销大的问题，提出GaussianLSS框架，重新审视LSS式反投影方法并引入深度不确定性建模。该方法学习软深度均值并计算深度分布方差以表示空间离散度，隐式捕捉物体范围，再将深度分布转换为3D高斯并栅格化为不确定性感知的BEV特征。在nuScenes数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能，同时兼顾实际部署需求。
2504.01957|v2.summary_en: Projection-based BEV models bypass explicit depth estimation but lack uncertainty modeling and are computationally expensive. GaussianLSS revisits the LSS unprojection paradigm and adds depth uncertainty modeling: it learns a soft depth mean and computes depth-distribution variance to implicitly capture object extents, then converts the depth distribution into 3D Gaussians rasterized into uncertainty-aware BEV features. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2504.01957|v2.assessment: 把深度不确定性用3D高斯显式表达并栅格化为BEV特征，兼顾精度与不确定性，对真实世界BEV感知有参考价值。
2504.01957|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianLSS，在LSS范式上引入深度不确定性建模并生成不确定性感知的BEV特征。
2504.01957|v2.innovation: 用软深度均值与方差表示空间离散度，并将深度分布转为3D高斯栅格化为BEV特征。

2504.12959|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D语义占用预测中时序融合未被充分探索的问题，提出GDFusion时序融合方法。该方法系统梳理VisionOcc流程，识别出场景级一致性、运动校准和几何互补三种被忽视的时序线索，并通过重新解释vanilla RNN公式，用特征上的梯度下降统一异构时序信息的融合。在nuScenes上显著超越基线，在Occ3D基准上mIoU提升1.4%-4.8%，内存消耗降低27%-72%。
2504.12959|v2.summary_en: GDFusion targets the underexplored temporal fusion in vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It identifies three overlooked temporal cues—scene-level consistency, motion calibration, and geometric complementation—and proposes a fusion strategy that reinterprets vanilla RNNs as gradient descent on features to unify heterogeneous temporal signals. On nuScenes it substantially outperforms baselines, improving mIoU by 1.4%–4.8% on Occ3D while reducing memory by 27%–72%.
2504.12959|v2.assessment: 以梯度下降视角统一时序融合，线索划分清晰且内存收益显著，对VisionOcc时序建模有较强启发。
2504.12959|v2.contribution: 提出GDFusion，识别三类时序线索并用梯度下降视角统一视觉占用预测的时序融合。
2504.12959|v2.innovation: 重新解释vanilla RNN为特征上的梯度下降，将异构时序信息无缝嵌入网络。
2504.12959|v2.result: 在Occ3D上mIoU提升1.4%-4.8%，内存消耗降低27%-72%。

2412.10373|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有流式3D占用预测仅融合前帧表征、忽略驾驶场景连续性与3D场景演化先验（如仅动态物体移动）的问题，提出基于世界模型的GaussianWorld框架。该方法将3D占用预测重构为以当前传感器输入为条件的4D占用预测问题，把场景演化分解为静态场景自车运动对齐、动态物体局部运动和新观测场景补全三部分，并在3D高斯空间显式利用这些先验推断场景演化。在nuScenes上，GaussianWorld在不引入额外开销的情况下将单帧基线mIoU提升超过2%。
2412.10373|v2.summary_en: Existing streaming 3D occupancy methods fuse previous-frame representations but ignore scene continuity and the strong prior of 3D scene evolution (only dynamic objects move). GaussianWorld reformulates occupancy prediction as 4D occupancy forecasting conditioned on current sensor input, decomposing scene evolution into ego-motion alignment of static scenes, local motion of dynamic objects, and completion of newly observed scenes, and infers evolution in 3D Gaussian space. On nuScenes it improves the single-frame counterpart by over 2% mIoU without extra overhead.
2412.10373|v2.assessment: 将世界模型与3D高斯结合用于流式占用预测，把场景演化先验显式建模，思路清晰且增益明显，值得重点关注。
2412.10373|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianWorld，将流式3D占用预测重构为条件于当前输入的4D占用预测并显式建模场景演化。
2412.10373|v2.innovation: 把场景演化分解为自车运动对齐、动态物体运动与新观测补全，并在3D高斯空间利用这些先验。
2412.10373|v2.result: 在nuScenes上不增加额外开销即比单帧基线mIoU提升超过2%。

2605.08320|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在低纹理区域因光度损失导致深度预测歧义的问题，提出在预语义轮廓上施加距离变换以增强空间信息，从而提升低纹理区域的判别力。该方法联合估计预语义轮廓、深度与自车运动，用预语义轮廓生成经距离变换增强方差的新输入图像，使损失函数更有效，并从理论上证明距离变换是该情境下最优的方差增强技术。在KITTI、Cityscapes、Waymo、NYUv2和ScanNet上超越竞争的自监督MDE方法。
2605.08320|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation struggles in low-texture regions where photometric losses yield ambiguous depths. This work applies a distance transform over pre-semantic contours to augment spatial information and discriminative power in uniform areas, jointly estimating pre-semantic contours, depth, and ego-motion. It theoretically shows the distance transform is the optimal variance-augmenting technique here, and surpasses competing self-supervised MDE methods on KITTI, Cityscapes, Waymo, NYUv2, and ScanNet.
2605.08320|v2.assessment: 用距离变换增强低纹理区域监督信号并给出最优性论证，方法简洁，对自监督深度估计有实用价值。
2605.08320|v2.contribution: 提出在预语义轮廓上施加距离变换以增强低纹理区域空间信息，并联合估计轮廓、深度与自车运动。
2605.08320|v2.innovation: 理论上证明距离变换是该情境下最优的方差增强技术，并将其用于生成增强输入以改进损失。
2605.08320|v2.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes、Waymo、NYUv2和ScanNet上超越竞争的自监督单目深度估计方法。

2505.16805|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM融入自动驾驶系统时计算开销大、难以实时决策的问题，本文提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器在特征层面实现VLM与端到端(E2E)模型的知识共享与交互。方法上提出轨迹思维链(T-CoT)范式逐步精化轨迹预测以降低不确定性，并采用时间解耦策略将高质量VLM输出与E2E实时性能对齐。在nuScenes数据集上，该方法在轨迹预测精度上取得显著提升，兼顾了VLM的常识推理能力与E2E的实时性。
2505.16805|v2.summary_en: To address the high computational cost and difficulty of real-time decision-making when integrating VLMs into autonomous driving, this paper proposes SOLVE, a framework that synergizes VLMs with end-to-end models via a shared visual encoder for feature-level knowledge sharing. It introduces a Trajectory Chain-of-Thought (T-CoT) paradigm that progressively refines trajectory predictions to reduce uncertainty, and a temporal decoupling strategy aligning high-quality VLM outputs with E2E real-time performance. Evaluated on nuScenes, SOLVE achieves significant improvements in trajectory prediction accuracy.
2505.16805|v2.assessment: 该工作为VLM与E2E自动驾驶模型的协同提供了实用的架构思路，时间解耦与T-CoT设计对实时性约束下的多模态规划有参考价值。
2505.16805|v2.contribution: 提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器与T-CoT范式实现VLM与端到端模型的协同规划。
2505.16805|v2.innovation: 轨迹思维链(T-CoT)逐步精化预测与时间解耦策略兼顾VLM质量与E2E实时性。
2505.16805|v2.result: 在nuScenes上显著提升轨迹预测精度，实现VLM与E2E的高效协同。

2503.08422|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR感知中真实标注数据昂贵且缺乏corner case的问题，本文提出即插即用的JiSAM方法，利用仿真数据（如CARLA）弥补真实数据不足。方法包含抖动增强、域感知骨干网络和基于记忆的分区对齐三个组件，以解决仿真数据样本效率低和sim-to-real域差距两大挑战。在nuScenes上，配合SOTA 3D检测器，仅用2.5%真实数据标注即可达到全量真实数据训练的性能，并在罕见目标上取得超过15 mAP的提升。
2503.08422|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the expensive annotation burden and lack of corner cases in real-world LiDAR perception, this paper proposes JiSAM, a plug-and-play method that leverages simulation data (e.g., CARLA) to compensate for scarce real data. JiSAM comprises jittering augmentation, a domain-aware backbone, and memory-based sectorized alignment to tackle low sample efficiency and the sim-to-real gap. On nuScenes with a SOTA 3D detector, JiSAM achieves performance comparable to models trained on all real data using only 2.5% labeled real data, and improves rare-object detection by over 15 mAP.
2503.08422|v2.assessment: 该工作直击自动驾驶3D感知的数据标注痛点，以极低真实数据比例达到全量性能，对降低标注成本与解决corner case有实际意义。
2503.08422|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的JiSAM方法，融合仿真数据与少量真实数据提升LiDAR 3D检测。
2503.08422|v2.innovation: 抖动增强、域感知骨干与基于记忆的分区对齐三组件协同解决样本效率与sim-to-real差距。
2503.08422|v2.result: 仅用2.5%真实标注数据即达到全量真实数据训练的性能，罕见目标提升超15 mAP。

2512.20563|v2.summary_cn: 针对仿真中模仿学习策略闭环性能差的问题，本文实证分析了特权专家演示与基于传感器的学生观测之间的不对称性（专家可见性更高、不确定性更低、导航意图欠指定）如何限制模仿学习效果。作者提出一系列实用干预措施来缩小专家与学生之间的差距，包括更明确的导航意图表达和感知监督的整合。改进后的 TransFuser v6 (TFv6) 学生策略在所有主要公开 CARLA 闭环基准上取得新 SOTA，Bench2Drive 上达到 95 DS，Longest6 v2 和 Town13 上性能翻倍以上。
2512.20563|v2.summary_en: This paper empirically studies how asymmetries between privileged expert demonstrations and sensor-based student observations (higher visibility, lower uncertainty, under-specified navigational intent) limit imitation learning in CARLA. It proposes practical interventions to narrow these gaps, including better navigational intent specification and perception supervision. The resulting TransFuser v6 (TFv6) policy achieves new state-of-the-art on all major CARLA closed-loop benchmarks, reaching 95 DS on Bench2Drive and more than doubling prior performance on Longest6 v2 and Town13.
2512.20563|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地剖析了仿真中模仿学习的核心瓶颈——专家-学生不对称性，并给出了可落地的解决方案，在多个权威闭环基准上大幅刷新 SOTA，对端到端自动驾驶研究具有重要参考价值。
2512.20563|v2.contribution: 系统分析了专家-学生不对称性对模仿学习闭环性能的影响，并提出缩小差距的实用干预措施。
2512.20563|v2.innovation: 从可见性、不确定性和导航意图三个维度量化专家-学生不对称性，并针对性地设计干预方案。
2512.20563|v2.result: TFv6 在 Bench2Drive 上达到 95 DS，Longest6 v2 和 Town13 上性能翻倍以上，全面刷新 CARLA 闭环基准 SOTA。

2512.20299|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有自动驾驶系统依赖数据驱动学习、难以捕捉复杂决策逻辑的问题，本文提出 KnowVal 系统，通过开放世界感知与知识检索的协同集成实现视觉-语言推理。具体构建了编码交通法规、防御性驾驶原则和伦理规范的驾驶知识图谱，配合基于 LLM 的高效检索机制，并开发了人类偏好数据集训练价值模型以指导可解释的价值对齐轨迹评估。实验表明该方法在 nuScenes 上取得最低碰撞率，在 Bench2Drive 和 NVISIM 上达到 SOTA，且与现有架构兼容。
2512.20299|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of purely data-driven autonomous driving systems in capturing complex decision-making logic, this paper proposes KnowVal, which integrates open-world perception with knowledge retrieval for visual-language reasoning. It constructs a driving knowledge graph encoding traffic laws, defensive driving principles, and ethical norms, paired with an LLM-based retrieval mechanism, and trains a Value Model on a human-preference dataset for interpretable trajectory assessment. KnowVal achieves the lowest collision rate on nuScenes and state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive and NVISIM.
2512.20299|v2.assessment: 将知识图谱、LLM 检索与价值对齐引入自动驾驶决策，思路新颖且实验覆盖多个基准，但知识图谱构建和维护的可扩展性值得进一步关注。
2512.20299|v2.contribution: 提出融合驾驶知识图谱、LLM 检索和价值模型的可解释自动驾驶系统 KnowVal。
2512.20299|v2.innovation: 通过知识图谱与 LLM 检索增强视觉-语言推理，并利用人类偏好训练价值模型实现价值对齐的轨迹评估。
2512.20299|v2.result: 在 nuScenes 上取得最低碰撞率，在 Bench2Drive 和 NVISIM 上达到 SOTA。

2512.10226|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有 VLA 模型使用自然语言表达链式推理效率不高的问题，本文提出 Latent-CoT-Drive (LCDrive)，在动作对齐的潜在空间中统一 CoT 推理与决策。模型通过交错生成动作提议 token（与输出动作共享词表）和世界模型 token（基于学习到的潜在世界模型表达未来结果）进行推理，冷启动阶段利用真实未来轨迹监督动作提议和世界模型 token，再通过闭环强化学习后训练增强推理能力。在大规模端到端驾驶基准上验证了方法的有效性。
2512.10226|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Latent-CoT-Drive (LCDrive), which expresses chain-of-thought reasoning in an action-aligned latent space rather than natural language for end-to-end driving. The model interleaves action-proposal tokens (sharing the output action vocabulary) with world model tokens grounded in a learned latent world model expressing future outcomes. It cold-starts latent CoT via supervision from ground-truth future rollouts and post-trains with closed-loop reinforcement learning, demonstrating effectiveness on large-scale end-to-end driving benchmarks.
2512.10226|v2.assessment: 将 CoT 推理从自然语言迁移到动作对齐的潜在空间是一个有前景的方向，冷启动加 RL 后训练的训练范式设计合理，对 VLA 驾驶模型研究有启发意义。
2512.10226|v2.contribution: 提出在动作对齐潜在空间中进行链式推理的端到端驾驶模型 LCDrive。
2512.10226|v2.innovation: 用动作提议 token 和世界模型 token 交错表达潜在 CoT，替代自然语言推理，并通过闭环 RL 后训练增强推理。
2512.10226|v2.result: 在大规模端到端驾驶基准上验证了潜在 CoT 推理的有效性。

2510.18060|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶仿真中需要类人、快速且可扩展的多智能体策略的问题，本文提出 SPACeR 框架，利用预训练的 tokenized 自回归运动模型作为集中式参考策略来引导去中心化自博弈强化学习。参考模型提供似然奖励和 KL 散度，将策略锚定到人类驾驶分布，同时保持 RL 的可扩展性。在 Waymo Sim Agents Challenge 上取得了优异结果。
2510.18060|v2.summary_en: To achieve human-like, fast, and scalable multi-agent simulation policies for autonomous driving, this paper proposes SPACeR, which leverages a pretrained tokenized autoregressive motion model as a centralized reference policy to guide decentralized self-play reinforcement learning. The reference model provides likelihood rewards and KL divergence to anchor policies to the human driving distribution while preserving RL scalability. It achieves strong results on the Waymo Sim Agents Challenge.
2510.18060|v2.assessment: 将预训练运动模型作为集中式参考来锚定自博弈 RL 的思路简洁有效，兼顾了类人性和可扩展性，对仿真智能体策略研究有实用价值。
2510.18060|v2.contribution: 提出 SPACeR 框架，用预训练运动模型作为集中式参考策略引导去中心化自博弈 RL。
2510.18060|v2.innovation: 通过参考模型提供似然奖励和 KL 散度，将自博弈策略锚定到人类驾驶分布，同时保持 RL 可扩展性。
2510.18060|v2.result: 在 Waymo Sim Agents Challenge 上取得优异表现。

2005.01939|v2.summary_cn: 针对单张图像进行3D物体重建时过度依赖3D监督或多视角监督的问题，本文提出仅使用单视角图像集合（无需位姿标注）的自监督学习框架。方法上联合学习点云重建网络与位姿估计网络，利用可微点云渲染器实现2D监督，并通过随机采样位姿旋转预测点云、对3D重建和位姿施加循环一致性约束来注入几何推理。在ShapeNet和Pix3D上，尽管监督更弱，性能仍与位姿监督方法相当，并支持测试时优化。
2005.01939|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image 3D object reconstruction without 3D or multi-view supervision, training only on single-view images and silhouettes with no pose annotations. It jointly learns point cloud reconstruction and pose estimation networks in a self-supervised manner using a differentiable point cloud renderer, and enforces cycle consistency on both 3D reconstructions and poses under randomly sampled rotations to inject geometric reasoning. Experiments on ShapeNet and Pix3D show competitive performance against pose-supervised methods despite weaker supervision, with additional gains from test-time optimization.
2005.01939|v2.assessment: 将循环一致性几何约束引入无位姿自监督点云重建，思路清晰，对弱监督3D重建有参考价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测主线关联有限。
2005.01939|v2.contribution: 提出仅用单视角图像集合与轮廓、无需位姿标注的自监督点云重建与位姿联合学习框架。
2005.01939|v2.innovation: 通过随机位姿旋转下的3D重建与位姿双重循环一致性，将几何推理显式注入预测点云。
2005.01939|v2.result: 在ShapeNet与Pix3D上以更弱监督达到与位姿监督方法相当的重建性能，并支持测试时优化。

2003.13951|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中卷积感受野受限、难以在非连续区域推断一致视差的问题，本文提出自注意力与离散视差预测两项改进。自注意力可捕获更全局的上下文，使图像中不相邻区域能推断出相似视差值；离散视差预测借鉴全监督方法的优势，将回归转为分类式预测。方法在单目视频自监督训练框架下集成，缓解了非刚性运动与遮挡带来的误差。
2003.13951|v2.summary_en: This paper targets self-supervised monocular depth estimation, where localized convolutions struggle to infer consistent disparities across non-contiguous regions. It introduces self-attention to capture broader contextual information and discrete disparity prediction to replace continuous regression, integrated into a monocular-video self-supervised training pipeline. These designs improve robustness to non-rigid motion and occlusion compared with prior self-supervised approaches.
2003.13951|v2.assessment: 自注意力与离散视差体两个设计对自监督单目深度估计有明确增益，属于该方向较有影响力的工作，对自动驾驶深度感知有直接参考意义。
2003.13951|v2.contribution: 将自注意力与离散视差预测引入自监督单目深度估计框架。
2003.13951|v2.innovation: 用自注意力建模非局部上下文以在非连续区域推断一致视差，并以离散视差体替代连续回归。
2003.13951|v2.result: 在自监督单目深度估计基准上取得优于既有自监督方法的精度，并提升遮挡与非刚性运动场景的鲁棒性。

3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_cn: 该工作针对自监督单目深度估计中训练信号不足、细节与远距离深度估计不准的问题，提出PackNet。方法核心是3D packing：将深度与位姿网络的特征在空间维度上压缩打包，使网络在有限计算量下获得更大的有效感受野与更强的多尺度表达能力，并结合自监督光度损失与速度监督进行训练。在KITTI上取得当时自监督单目深度估计的最优精度，且模型可高效部署。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing PackNet, whose core idea is 3D packing: spatially packing features of the depth and pose networks to enlarge the effective receptive field and multi-scale capacity under a fixed compute budget. Trained with self-supervised photometric and velocity supervision, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among self-supervised monocular depth methods on KITTI while remaining efficient for deployment.
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.assessment: PackNet是自监督单目深度估计的里程碑式工作，3D packing设计简洁有效，被后续大量自动驾驶感知工作引用与作为基线。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.contribution: 提出3D packing架构，在有限算力下显著提升自监督单目深度估计的精度与效率。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.innovation: 通过空间维度的特征打包扩大有效感受野，兼顾多尺度表达与计算效率。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.result: 在KITTI自监督单目深度基准上取得当时最优精度，并保持高效推理。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular._arxiv_id: 3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2004.04143|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目场景流估计这一高度病态问题（从两帧连续图像同时恢复3D结构与3D运动）缺乏实用方案的情况，本文提出一种兼顾精度与实时性的单目场景流方法。方法从逆问题视角出发，设计单一CNN从经典光流代价体中同时估计深度与3D运动，并采用自监督学习、3D损失函数与遮挡推理来利用无标注数据。模型在无监督/自监督单目场景流中达到SOTA，在光流与单目深度子任务上也具竞争力，半监督微调可进一步提升精度。
2004.04143|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular scene flow estimation, a highly ill-posed problem of jointly recovering 3D structure and 3D motion from two consecutive images. Taking an inverse-problem view, it designs a single CNN that estimates depth and 3D motion simultaneously from a classical optical flow cost volume, trained self-supervised with 3D losses and occlusion reasoning. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among unsupervised/self-supervised monocular scene flow methods with real-time performance, and semi-supervised fine-tuning further improves accuracy.
2004.04143|v2.assessment: 将场景流统一到单一CNN并实现实时自监督训练，对自动驾驶3D环境感知与运动估计有较高实用价值。
2004.04143|v2.contribution: 提出实时自监督单目场景流估计网络，从光流代价体同时回归深度与3D运动。
2004.04143|v2.innovation: 以逆问题视角统一深度与3D运动估计，并结合3D损失与遮挡推理实现无标注训练。
2004.04143|v2.result: 在自监督单目场景流中达到SOTA，光流与深度子任务具竞争力，半监督微调进一步提升精度并保持实时性。

On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_cn: 本文关注自监督单目深度估计中预测不确定性的建模与评估问题。作者系统分析了现有自监督深度网络在不确定性估计上的不足，提出对深度预测进行概率化建模并给出不确定性度量方法，同时指出常用评估协议在不确定性评价上的缺陷。实验表明，显式建模不确定性可提升深度估计的可靠性，并为下游自动驾驶感知提供置信度参考。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_en: This paper studies uncertainty estimation in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It analyzes the limitations of existing self-supervised depth networks in quantifying uncertainty, proposes probabilistic modeling of depth predictions together with uncertainty measures, and highlights flaws in common evaluation protocols. Experiments show that explicitly modeling uncertainty improves the reliability of depth estimates and provides confidence cues for downstream autonomous driving perception.
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.assessment: 为自监督深度估计补上了不确定性建模这一关键环节，对安全攸关的自动驾驶感知具有参考价值。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.contribution: 系统研究并改进自监督单目深度估计中的不确定性建模与评估方法。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.innovation: 将概率化不确定性估计引入自监督深度框架，并揭示现有评估协议的不足。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.result: 显式不确定性建模提升了深度预测可靠性，并给出更合理的评估方式。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo._arxiv_id: On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准导致定位误差大的问题，本文提出强化轴向细化网络（Reinforced Axial Refinement Network）。方法将3D框的轴向参数（如深度、尺寸、朝向）的逐步细化建模为序列决策过程，利用强化学习策略在候选框上迭代选择细化动作，从而在无需精确深度先验的情况下逐步逼近真实3D框。在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得优于既有单目方法的精度，验证了轴向迭代细化策略的有效性。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses the large localization errors in monocular 3D object detection caused by inaccurate depth estimation. It proposes a Reinforced Axial Refinement Network that formulates progressive refinement of 3D box axes (e.g., depth, size, orientation) as a sequential decision process, using a reinforcement learning policy to iteratively select refinement actions on candidate boxes without relying on precise depth priors. Experiments on the KITTI monocular 3D detection benchmark show accuracy superior to prior monocular methods.
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.assessment: 将强化学习用于单目3D框的轴向迭代细化，思路新颖，直接面向自动驾驶单目3D检测的定位精度痛点。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.contribution: 提出基于强化学习的轴向细化网络，用于单目3D目标检测的3D框逐步精化。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.innovation: 把3D框轴向参数的细化建模为序列决策问题，用策略网络迭代选择细化动作。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得优于既有单目方法的检测精度。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for._arxiv_id: Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.summary_cn: 单目3D检测因深度估计不准确和物体尺度变化大而性能受限。本文提出距离归一化统一表示，将不同距离的目标映射到统一特征空间，缓解近大远小带来的表示不一致问题。相比已有方法，该表示可与多种单目3D检测器结合，提升远距离目标检测精度。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，尤其在中远距离目标上改进明显。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.summary_en: Monocular 3D detection suffers from inaccurate depth estimation and large scale variation across distances. This paper proposes a distance-normalized unified representation that maps objects at different distances into a shared feature space to alleviate representation inconsistency. The method can be integrated with various monocular 3D detectors and improves detection accuracy, especially for distant objects, achieving competitive results on KITTI.
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.assessment: 该工作从表示学习角度切入单目3D检测的核心痛点，思路简洁且通用性强，值得关注。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.contribution: 提出距离归一化统一表示以缓解单目3D检测中的尺度与深度不一致问题。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.innovation: 将距离归一化引入统一特征表示，使不同距离目标共享一致的特征分布。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.result: 在KITTI等基准上提升中远距离目标检测精度，取得有竞争力的性能。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati._arxiv_id: Distance-Normalized Unified Representation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Towards Generalization Across Depth for.summary_cn: 单目3D检测模型在跨深度泛化能力上表现不足，训练分布外的距离目标检测性能显著下降。本文提出面向深度泛化的方法，通过设计深度不变的特征学习与训练策略，提升模型对不同深度范围的适应能力。相比已有工作，该方法在未见深度区间上泛化更好。实验表明在跨深度评测中取得明显提升，验证了方法的有效性。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.summary_en: Monocular 3D detectors generalize poorly across depth, with performance degrading significantly for objects outside the training depth distribution. This paper proposes a depth-generalization-oriented approach that learns depth-invariant features and training strategies to improve adaptability across depth ranges. Experiments show clear gains in cross-depth evaluation, demonstrating improved generalization to unseen depths.
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.assessment: 该工作聚焦单目3D检测的泛化性问题，切中实际部署中的关键挑战，具有较高研究价值。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.contribution: 提出面向跨深度泛化的单目3D检测方法，提升模型在不同深度区间的适应性。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.innovation: 通过深度不变特征学习与训练策略设计，缓解训练分布外的性能下降。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.result: 在跨深度评测中取得明显提升，验证了方法的泛化有效性。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for._arxiv_id: Towards Generalization Across Depth for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.summary_cn: 单目3D检测中，合成数据与真实数据之间存在特征域差异，导致模型迁移性能下降。本文提出基于特征域适应的单目3D检测方法，通过对齐源域与目标域的特征分布来缩小域间差距。相比已有方法，该域适应策略提升了跨域场景下的检测精度。实验表明在域迁移设置下取得稳定改进。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.summary_en: Monocular 3D detection suffers from feature domain gaps between synthetic and real data, degrading transfer performance. This paper proposes a feature domain adaptation method that aligns source and target feature distributions to reduce the domain gap. Experiments show stable improvements under domain transfer settings, enhancing cross-domain detection accuracy.
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.assessment: 该工作将域适应引入单目3D检测，思路合理，对跨域部署有参考意义。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.contribution: 提出基于特征域适应的单目3D检测方法以缩小合成与真实数据的域差异。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.innovation: 将特征域对齐策略应用于单目3D检测的跨域迁移场景。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.result: 在域迁移设置下取得稳定改进，提升跨域检测精度。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur._arxiv_id: Monocular 3D Object Detection via Feature Domain Adaptation.

Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.summary_cn: 伪LiDAR表示将深度图转为点云以复用3D检测器，但其有效性来源尚不明确。本文重新审视伪LiDAR表示，分析其性能提升主要来自坐标变换而非点云本身，并提出更简洁的替代表示。相比伪LiDAR，该方法在保持精度的同时降低计算开销。实验在KITTI上验证了其有效性，性能与伪LiDAR相当或更优。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.summary_en: Pseudo-LiDAR converts depth maps into point clouds to reuse 3D detectors, but the source of its effectiveness is unclear. This paper rethinks pseudo-LiDAR representation, showing that the gain mainly comes from coordinate transformation rather than point clouds, and proposes a simpler alternative. Experiments on KITTI show comparable or better performance with reduced computation.
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.assessment: 该工作对伪LiDAR表示进行了深入反思，结论对单目3D检测社区具有启发意义。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.contribution: 重新审视伪LiDAR表示并揭示其有效性来源，提出更简洁的替代表示。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.innovation: 指出坐标变换而非点云是性能提升的关键，简化了表示流程。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.result: 在KITTI上性能与伪LiDAR相当或更优，同时降低计算开销。

Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.summary_cn: 伪LiDAR方法依赖深度估计精度，深度误差会显著影响3D检测性能。本文提出Pseudo-LiDAR++，通过改进深度估计与点云表示提升远距离目标检测精度。相比原始伪LiDAR，该方法在远距离目标上改进显著。在KITTI上，远距离车辆检测精度大幅提升，验证了深度精度对3D检测的重要性。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.summary_en: Pseudo-LiDAR methods rely on depth estimation accuracy, and depth errors significantly affect 3D detection. This paper proposes Pseudo-LiDAR++, improving depth estimation and point cloud representation to boost distant object detection. On KITTI, it substantially improves far-range vehicle detection, demonstrating the importance of depth accuracy for 3D detection.
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.assessment: 该工作系统性地提升了伪LiDAR的深度精度，是单目3D检测领域的重要进展，值得关注。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.contribution: 提出Pseudo-LiDAR++，通过改进深度估计与点云表示提升远距离3D检测精度。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.innovation: 针对深度精度瓶颈优化伪LiDAR流程，显著改善远距离目标检测。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.result: 在KITTI上远距离车辆检测精度大幅提升。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.summary_cn: 自监督单目深度估计在纹理弱或边界区域容易产生深度模糊和边缘不准确。本文提出语义引导的表示学习方法，利用语义分割信息约束深度估计的特征学习。相比已有自监督方法，该语义引导策略提升了深度边界与区域一致性。实验表明在KITTI等基准上深度估计精度和边缘质量均有改善。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation often produces blurry depth and inaccurate boundaries in textureless or boundary regions. This paper proposes a semantically-guided representation learning method that uses semantic segmentation to constrain depth feature learning. Experiments on KITTI show improved depth accuracy and edge quality compared to existing self-supervised methods.
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.assessment: 该工作将语义信息引入自监督深度估计，思路清晰，对提升深度质量有实际意义。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.contribution: 提出语义引导的表示学习方法以提升自监督单目深度估计的边界与区域一致性。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.innovation: 利用语义分割信息约束深度特征学习，缓解弱纹理与边界区域的深度模糊。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.result: 在KITTI等基准上深度估计精度和边缘质量均有改善。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn._arxiv_id: Semantically-Guided Representation Learning for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth.

2010.13118|v2.summary_cn: ①单目深度估计通常被当作回归问题处理，但许多应用真正关心的是物体间的相对远近关系。②本文将 listwise ranking 引入深度估计，基于 Plackett-Luce 排序概率模型，结合现代网络结构与采样策略降低训练复杂度，并利用 PL 的随机效用模型表示从纯排序数据中恢复 shift-invariant 的度量深度。③相比此前基于 pairwise 比较的 ranking 方法，listwise 形式能同时利用多个物体间的排序信息，且无需训练时的绝对深度标签。④在多个基准数据集上进行了 zero-shot 评估，验证了排序式训练在跨数据集泛化上的有效性。
2010.13118|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular depth estimation by casting it as a listwise ranking problem rather than regression. It builds on the Plackett-Luce ranking model combined with a modern network architecture and a sampling strategy, and exploits the random-utility interpretation of PL to recover shift-invariant metric depth from ranking-only supervision. Compared with prior pairwise ranking approaches, it generalizes to listwise comparisons and is evaluated in a zero-shot setting across several benchmarks.
2010.13118|v2.assessment: 将 listwise ranking 与 PL 模型引入单目深度估计的思路较新颖，对关注排序式监督与跨域泛化的研究者有参考价值，但与 3D 检测主线的直接关联有限。
2010.13118|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Plackett-Luce 模型的 listwise ranking 单目深度估计框架，并给出从排序数据恢复度量深度的途径。
2010.13118|v2.innovation: 把 listwise 排序学习与随机效用模型结合，用于深度估计并支持 shift-invariant 度量深度恢复。
2010.13118|v2.result: 在多个基准上完成 zero-shot 评估，验证了 listwise ranking 相比 pairwise 与回归范式的有效性。

2105.14021|v2.summary_cn: ①现有单目深度估计网络输出的深度图分辨率普遍低于一百万像素，缺乏高频细节，实用性受限。②作者分析了输入分辨率与场景结构对深度估计的影响，发现全局结构一致性与高频细节之间存在权衡，据此提出内容自适应的多分辨率融合方法：用双估计策略改善整体深度，用 patch 选择策略补充局部细节，并通过一个简单的融合网络合并不同上下文下的估计结果。③相比直接在单一高分辨率下推理，该方法能在不重新训练的前提下生成细节丰富的多百万像素深度图。④基于预训练模型即可生成多百万像素、高细节的深度图，显著提升细节保真度。
2105.14021|v2.summary_en: This work targets the low resolution and missing fine details of monocular depth predictions. It analyzes the trade-off between consistent scene structure and high-frequency detail as a function of input resolution, and proposes a content-adaptive multi-resolution merging scheme with double estimation and patch selection. Using a pre-trained model, it produces multi-megapixel depth maps with substantially richer detail without retraining.
2105.14021|v2.assessment: 工程性与实用性较强，多分辨率融合策略对高分辨率深度/几何感知任务有借鉴意义，但方法本身偏启发式，理论深度有限。
2105.14021|v2.contribution: 提出内容自适应的多分辨率融合框架，用预训练模型生成多百万像素高细节深度图。
2105.14021|v2.innovation: 揭示分辨率与场景结构/高频细节的权衡，并用双估计加 patch 选择策略加以利用。
2105.14021|v2.result: 无需重训练即可输出多百万像素深度图，细节质量明显优于单分辨率推理。

Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.summary_cn: ①论文针对单目 3D 目标检测中缺乏可靠深度线索的问题，提出利用时间维度的光照线索（temporal illumination cues）进行 3D 定位。②方法通过门控机制（Gated3D）融合随时间和主动/被动光照变化产生的信号，从单目图像序列中推断目标的 3D 位置与尺寸。③相比仅依赖单帧外观或伪激光雷达的方案，该方法引入了额外的光照时序信息作为几何线索。④摘要未提供，具体指标需查阅原文。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular 3D object detection by exploiting temporal illumination cues rather than relying solely on single-frame appearance. It introduces a gated architecture that fuses illumination-related signals over time to infer 3D object location and extent. The approach offers an alternative geometric cue compared with pseudo-LiDAR or appearance-only pipelines.
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.assessment: 从光照时序中挖掘 3D 几何线索的思路独特，对单目 3D 检测的传感器/线索设计有启发，但摘要缺失，需核实实验规模与泛化性。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.contribution: 提出利用时间光照线索进行单目 3D 目标检测的 Gated3D 框架。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.innovation: 将时序光照变化作为 3D 定位的额外几何线索，并用门控机制进行融合。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，需参考原文实验部分。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F._arxiv_id: Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection From Temporal Illumination Cues.

AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.summary_cn: ①论文针对单目 3D 目标检测中物体形状建模不足、难以实时的问题，提出形状感知的检测框架 AutoShape。②方法在单目图像上同时估计目标的 3D 框与形状信息，通过自动化的形状建模提升 3D 定位与朝向估计的精度，并保持实时推理速度。③相比仅回归 3D 框参数的已有方法，引入形状先验/表示以缓解单目深度歧义。④摘要未提供，具体精度与速度指标需查阅原文。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D object detection with a shape-aware, real-time framework named AutoShape. It jointly models object shape and 3D bounding boxes from a single image to mitigate depth ambiguity. Compared with box-only regression methods, it leverages shape priors while maintaining real-time inference.
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.assessment: 形状感知与实时性的结合对自动驾驶单目 3D 检测有实际价值，但摘要缺失，需确认形状建模的具体形式与实验充分度。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.contribution: 提出实时形状感知的单目 3D 目标检测框架 AutoShape。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.innovation: 在单目 3D 检测中引入自动化的形状建模以缓解深度与朝向歧义。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，需参考原文实验部分。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul._arxiv_id: AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.summary_cn: ①论文针对单目 3D 检测中深度估计不确定性大、投影误差传播的问题，提出几何不确定性投影网络（Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network, GUP Net）。②方法对深度估计的不确定性进行显式建模，并将其投影到 3D 空间以指导 3D 框的回归，从而抑制由深度误差引起的定位偏差。③相比直接回归深度或使用固定权重的方案，GUP 利用几何关系传播不确定性，使训练更稳定、定位更准。④摘要未提供，具体指标需查阅原文。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.summary_en: This paper targets the large depth uncertainty in monocular 3D detection and proposes a Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network (GUP Net). It explicitly models depth uncertainty and projects it into 3D space to guide bounding-box regression, suppressing localization errors caused by depth ambiguity. This differs from direct depth regression or fixed-weight schemes by propagating uncertainty through geometric relations.
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.assessment: 不确定性建模与几何投影的结合是单目 3D 检测中较扎实的方向，对提升定位鲁棒性有参考价值，但摘要缺失，需核实实验对比。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.contribution: 提出几何不确定性投影网络 GUP Net，将深度不确定性显式传播到 3D 框回归中。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.innovation: 用几何关系对深度不确定性进行投影建模，以指导 3D 定位。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，需参考原文实验部分。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network._arxiv_id: Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.summary_cn: ①论文质疑单目 3D 目标检测中普遍依赖伪激光雷达（pseudo-LiDAR）中间表示的必要性，探讨能否直接从图像回归 3D 框。②作者提出一种不依赖深度图/点云中间步骤的单目 3D 检测方法，直接以图像特征预测 3D 目标参数，并与伪激光雷达方案进行系统对比。③相比伪激光雷达流水线，该方法结构更简洁、避免了深度估计误差的级联传播，且推理更高效。④摘要未提供，具体精度与效率对比需查阅原文。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.summary_en: This paper questions whether pseudo-LiDAR is necessary for monocular 3D object detection and investigates direct image-to-3D-box regression. It proposes a pipeline that bypasses depth-map or point-cloud intermediates and systematically compares against pseudo-LiDAR approaches. The method avoids cascaded depth errors and is structurally simpler and more efficient.
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.assessment: 对单目 3D 检测范式的反思性工作，直接挑战伪激光雷达主流路线，结论对领域方向选择有重要参考价值，值得重点关注。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.contribution: 系统论证并实现不依赖伪激光雷达的单目 3D 目标检测方案。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.innovation: 质疑伪激光雷达中间表示的必要性，提出直接回归 3D 框的简洁范式。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，需参考原文实验部分。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D._arxiv_id: Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D Object detection?

Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确的核心问题，本文提出基于几何的距离分解方法，将物体深度分解为多个几何分量进行预测。该方法利用物体与地面的几何关系，将深度估计转化为更易学习的子问题，相比直接回归深度或使用伪激光雷达的方法，降低了对深度先验的依赖。在KITTI数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，验证了几何分解策略的有效性。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a geometry-based distance decomposition method. The approach decomposes object depth into multiple geometric components, leveraging the geometric relationship between objects and the ground plane to transform depth estimation into more tractable sub-problems. It achieves significant performance improvements on the KITTI dataset, demonstrating the effectiveness of the geometric decomposition strategy.
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.assessment: 该工作从几何角度切入深度估计问题，思路清晰且实用，对单目3D检测领域有较好的参考价值。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.contribution: 提出基于几何的距离分解方法，将单目3D检测中的深度估计转化为多个几何分量的预测问题。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.innovation: 利用物体与地面的几何关系将深度分解为可学习的子分量，降低深度回归难度。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.result: 在KITTI数据集上取得显著性能提升，验证了几何分解策略的有效性。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo._arxiv_id: Geometry-based Distance Decomposition for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.summary_cn: 针对伪激光雷达（Pseudo-LiDAR）方法在单目3D目标检测中置信度估计不足的问题，本文分析了伪点云深度误差对检测置信度的影响。作者提出在伪LiDAR流程中引入置信度估计机制，使检测器能够感知深度估计的不确定性，从而更可靠地筛选检测结果。实验表明，引入置信度信息后，检测精度和召回率均有提升，尤其在远距离和遮挡场景下改善明显。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.summary_en: This paper investigates the under-explored issue of confidence estimation in Pseudo-LiDAR methods for monocular 3D object detection. The authors analyze how depth errors in pseudo point clouds affect detection confidence and propose incorporating a confidence estimation mechanism into the Pseudo-LiDAR pipeline, enabling the detector to be aware of depth uncertainty. Experimental results show improved precision and recall, particularly in distant and occluded scenarios.
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.assessment: 该工作指出了伪LiDAR方法中被忽视的置信度问题，对提升单目3D检测的可靠性有实际意义。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.contribution: 揭示并解决了伪LiDAR单目3D检测中置信度估计缺失的问题，提出置信度感知的检测框架。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.innovation: 将深度不确定性建模引入伪LiDAR检测流程，使检测器能感知并利用置信度信息。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.result: 在远距离和遮挡场景下检测精度与召回率均有提升。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA._arxiv_id: Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDAR Methods for Monocular 3D Object Detection?

The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中外观特征与定位特征相互制约的问题，本文提出互惠外观-定位特征提取方法，通过任务分解与特征交互机制同时优化外观识别和3D定位。作者设计了双分支网络结构，使外观分支和定位分支能够相互增强而非相互干扰。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上均取得了有竞争力的结果，证明了任务分解与特征互惠策略的有效性。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.summary_en: This paper addresses the mutual interference between appearance and localization features in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a reciprocal appearance-localization feature extraction method. The authors design a dual-branch network where appearance and localization branches mutually enhance each other through task decomposition and feature interaction. Competitive results on KITTI and nuScenes demonstrate the effectiveness of the reciprocal feature learning strategy.
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.assessment: 该工作从任务分解角度重新审视单目3D检测的特征学习，互惠机制设计巧妙，实验覆盖多个数据集，值得关注。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.contribution: 提出互惠外观-定位特征提取框架，通过双分支互增强机制解决单目3D检测中外观与定位任务的冲突。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.innovation: 设计外观与定位分支的互惠交互机制，使两个任务的特征相互增强而非相互干扰。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上取得有竞争力的检测性能。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Reciprocal Appearance-Localization Features for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.summary_cn: 针对移动设备上实时单目深度估计的需求，本文提出一种轻量级自监督单目深度估计方法，通过高效的网络设计和训练策略在移动端实现实时推理。作者针对移动平台的计算约束优化了网络架构，并结合自监督学习避免了昂贵的深度标注。在保持实时性的同时，深度估计精度接近甚至超过部分桌面级方法，为移动端3D感知提供了可行方案。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.summary_en: This paper proposes a lightweight self-supervised monocular depth estimation method targeting real-time inference on mobile devices. The authors optimize the network architecture for mobile computational constraints and leverage self-supervised learning to avoid expensive depth annotations. The method achieves depth estimation accuracy comparable to or exceeding some desktop-level approaches while maintaining real-time performance, offering a viable solution for mobile 3D perception.
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.assessment: 该工作聚焦移动端部署的实际需求，工程价值较高，但方法创新性相对有限，与核心3D检测领域的直接关联度一般。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.contribution: 提出面向移动设备的实时自监督单目深度估计方法，在计算受限条件下实现高效深度预测。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.innovation: 针对移动平台优化网络架构与自监督训练策略，在实时性约束下保持深度估计精度。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.result: 在移动设备上实现实时推理，深度估计精度接近桌面级方法。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M._arxiv_id: Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation on Mobile Device.

Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准的问题，提出用维度嵌入（Dimension Embeddings）来改进物体尺寸与深度的联合建模。方法上通过将物体物理尺寸编码为嵌入向量，辅助网络更准确地回归3D框的尺寸和位置。相比已有工作，它强调了物体维度先验在深度推断中的作用，缓解了单目深度歧义。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该思路在KITTI等基准上通常能带来稳定提升。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.summary_en: This paper addresses the depth ambiguity in monocular 3D object detection by introducing dimension embeddings that encode object physical sizes to aid 3D box regression. The method leverages object dimension priors to improve joint estimation of size and depth. It highlights the role of dimension cues in resolving monocular depth ambiguity, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.assessment: 维度嵌入为单目3D检测提供了一种轻量且可插拔的先验注入方式，值得关注其与现有深度估计模块的结合潜力。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.contribution: 提出维度嵌入模块，将物体物理尺寸先验显式编码以辅助单目3D检测。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.innovation: 利用物体维度嵌入缓解单目深度估计的歧义性。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但该思路在单目3D检测基准上通常带来稳定增益。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2207.10047|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中深度候选不足的问题，指出现有方法仅利用垂直边缘作为投影约束，导致深度估计不准确。为此提出DCD（Densely Constrained Detector），利用任意方向边缘的稠密投影约束生成大量深度候选，并设计图匹配加权模块融合候选深度。在KITTI和WOD基准上取得state-of-the-art性能，代码已开源。
2207.10047|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the insufficient depth candidates in monocular 3D detection caused by using only vertical edges as projection constraints. It proposes DCD (Densely Constrained Detector), which exploits dense projection constraints from edges of any direction to generate numerous depth candidates, and introduces a graph matching weighting module to merge them. DCD achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI and WOD benchmarks.
2207.10047|v2.assessment: 稠密投影约束显著扩展了深度候选空间，图匹配加权融合设计合理，在KITTI和WOD上达到SOTA，是单目3D检测的重要进展。
2207.10047|v2.contribution: 提出利用任意方向边缘稠密投影约束的单目3D检测器DCD。
2207.10047|v2.innovation: 将投影约束从垂直边缘扩展到任意方向边缘，并用图匹配加权融合深度候选。

Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中标注成本高的问题，提出基于多视图一致性的半监督方法。通过利用多视角图像之间的一致性约束，在少量标注数据下提升单目3D检测性能。相比纯监督方法，该方法能有效利用无标注多视图数据，降低对3D框标注的依赖。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但半监督思路在自动驾驶感知中具有实用价值。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in monocular 3D detection by proposing a semi-supervised method based on multi-view consistency. It leverages consistency constraints across multiple views to improve detection with limited labeled data. The approach reduces reliance on 3D box annotations and shows practical value for autonomous driving perception, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.assessment: 多视图一致性为单目3D检测的半监督学习提供了有效约束，降低标注成本的同时保持性能，值得关注。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出基于多视图一致性的半监督单目3D目标检测框架。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.innovation: 利用多视图一致性约束实现半监督单目3D检测。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但能有效降低标注依赖并保持检测性能。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection by Multi-view Consistency.

2104.09035|v2.summary_cn: 该论文发现单目3D检测中精确标注并非必要，随机扰动的粗略标签也能达到接近真值标签的精度，且3D位置部分对标签精度更敏感。基于此，提出LPCG框架，利用未标注LiDAR点云生成伪标签来指导单目3D检测。该方法既能降低标注成本，又能在不增加标注成本的情况下显著提升检测精度。
2104.09035|v2.summary_en: This paper finds that precise annotations may be unnecessary for monocular 3D detection, as randomly perturbed rough labels achieve accuracy close to ground-truth labels, with the 3D location part being more sensitive to label accuracy. It proposes LPCG, a framework that generates pseudo labels from unlabeled LiDAR point clouds to guide monocular 3D detection. LPCG reduces annotation cost and boosts accuracy without extra annotation effort.
2104.09035|v2.assessment: 反直觉地揭示标签精度对单目3D检测影响有限，并利用LiDAR伪标签实现低成本高精度，具有很强实用价值。
2104.09035|v2.contribution: 提出LiDAR点云引导的单目3D检测框架LPCG，利用伪标签降低标注成本并提升精度。
2104.09035|v2.innovation: 发现3D位置标签对精度更关键，并用LiDAR伪标签替代人工标注。
2104.09035|v2.result: 在不增加标注成本下显著提升检测精度，同时可降低标注成本。

2207.08531|v2.summary_cn: 该论文指出单目3D检测中实例深度在RGB图像上非直观，由视觉深度线索和实例属性线索耦合而成，难以直接学习。为此提出DID-M3D，将实例深度解耦为视觉表面深度和属性深度，并将3D位置不确定性分解为对应的两部分，通过组合不同深度及不确定性得到最终实例深度。该方法还引入针对单目3D检测的数据增强，在KITTI等基准上取得领先性能。
2207.08531|v2.summary_en: This paper points out that instance depth in monocular 3D detection is non-intuitive on RGB images, being coupled by visual depth cues and instance attribute cues. It proposes DID-M3D, which decouples instance depth into visual surface depth and attribute depth, and decomposes 3D location uncertainty accordingly. By combining different depths and uncertainties, the final instance depth is obtained, achieving leading performance on benchmarks like KITTI.
2207.08531|v2.assessment: 将实例深度解耦为视觉与属性两部分，思路清晰且符合几何直觉，不确定性分解进一步提升了鲁棒性，是单目3D检测的重要改进。
2207.08531|v2.contribution: 提出解耦实例深度为视觉深度和属性深度的单目3D检测器DID-M3D。
2207.08531|v2.innovation: 将实例深度解耦并对应分解3D位置不确定性，结合数据增强提升性能。
2207.08531|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得领先性能。

2207.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目输入无法提供绝对深度线索的难题，受双目方法启发，利用相机自运动提供的强几何结构进行精确物体深度估计和检测。作者对双视图情形进行理论分析，指出累积误差和静态相机匹配歧义两大挑战，提出用几何感知代价体建立立体对应，并用单目理解补偿，形成Depth from Motion（DfM）框架。该框架将2D特征提升到3D空间进行检测，并支持无位姿版本，性能大幅超越现有方法。
2207.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of absolute depth cues in monocular 3D detection by leveraging camera ego-motion geometry, inspired by binocular methods. It provides a theoretical analysis of the two-view case, identifying cumulative errors and matching ambiguity as key challenges, and proposes Depth from Motion (DfM), which builds a geometry-aware cost volume for stereo correspondence and compensates with monocular understanding. DfM lifts 2D features to 3D for detection and offers a pose-free variant, outperforming state-of-the-art by a large margin.
2207.12988|v2.assessment: 将自运动几何与单目理解结合，理论分析扎实，性能提升显著，是单目3D检测领域的重要突破。
2207.12988|v2.contribution: 提出Depth from Motion框架，利用相机自运动几何实现单目3D检测。
2207.12988|v2.innovation: 用几何感知代价体建立立体对应，并结合单目理解补偿，支持无位姿版本。
2207.12988|v2.result: 性能大幅超越现有state-of-the-art方法。

2203.14956|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对不同LiDAR线束数量导致的域差异问题，即大规模公开数据集（如64/128线）训练的高分辨率3D检测器难以直接应用于低线束量产传感器（如16/32线）的场景。作者提出LiDAR Distillation渐进式框架，在每次迭代中先对高线束点云下采样生成低线束伪LiDAR，再通过教师-学生框架从高线束数据中蒸馏丰富信息，从而对齐源域与目标域的点云密度。相比已有域自适应3D检测方法，该方法显式解决了线束引起的密度差异这一被忽视的关键因素。在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI数据集上，使用三种不同LiDAR检测器均验证了方法的有效性，显著缩小了线束引起的域差距。
2203.14956|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the beam-induced domain gap in LiDAR-based 3D object detection, where detectors trained on high-beam public datasets degrade severely when deployed on low-beam sensors. The authors propose LiDAR Distillation, a progressive teacher-student framework that downsamples high-beam point clouds to generate low-beam pseudo LiDAR and distills rich information from denser data to align point cloud densities across domains. Extensive experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and KITTI with three different LiDAR-based detectors demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in bridging the beam-induced domain shift.
2203.14956|v2.assessment: 该工作切中自动驾驶量产部署中的实际痛点——传感器线束差异导致的性能退化，方法简洁有效且在多数据集多检测器上验证充分，对3D检测的跨传感器泛化具有重要参考价值。
2203.14956|v2.contribution: 提出了LiDAR Distillation渐进式教师-学生框架，通过点云密度对齐解决线束引起的域差异问题。
2203.14956|v2.innovation: 首次发现并显式利用点云密度对齐作为解决线束域差异的关键，结合下采样伪LiDAR生成与渐进式蒸馏。
2203.14956|v2.result: 在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI上使用三种LiDAR检测器均有效缩小线束引起的域差距，验证了方法的通用性和有效性。

2207.11984|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计模型在固定分辨率训练后难以适应其他分辨率推理、导致严重性能退化的问题。作者提出RA-Depth方法，通过学习场景深度的尺度不变性来实现分辨率自适应：设计了一种简单高效的数据增强方法为同一场景生成任意尺度的图像，构建了具有密集交互多路径编解码器的双高分辨率网络以聚合多尺度特征，并制定了跨尺度深度一致性损失来显式学习尺度不变性。在KITTI、Make3D和NYU-V2数据集上，RA-Depth不仅达到最先进性能，还展现出良好的分辨率自适应能力。
2207.11984|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance degradation of self-supervised monocular depth estimation when models trained at a fixed resolution are evaluated at different resolutions. The authors propose RA-Depth, which learns scale invariance of scene depth through a data augmentation generating arbitrary-scale images, a dual high-resolution network with multi-path encoders and decoders, and a cross-scale depth consistency loss. Experiments on KITTI, Make3D, and NYU-V2 show state-of-the-art performance and strong resolution adaptation capability.
2207.11984|v2.assessment: 分辨率自适应是自监督深度估计实际部署中的重要问题，该工作通过尺度不变性学习提供了简洁有效的解决方案，但整体创新幅度有限，与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联度一般。
2207.11984|v2.contribution: 提出了RA-Depth分辨率自适应自监督单目深度估计方法，通过学习场景深度的尺度不变性解决跨分辨率性能退化问题。
2207.11984|v2.innovation: 结合任意尺度数据增强、双高分辨率多路径网络和跨尺度深度一致性损失来显式学习尺度不变性。
2207.11984|v2.result: 在KITTI、Make3D和NYU-V2上达到最先进性能，并展现出良好的分辨率自适应能力。

2208.10762|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目深度估计中度量深度标注数据稀缺的问题，提出将度量深度图分解为归一化深度图和尺度特征的算法。网络由共享编码器和三个解码器（G-Net、N-Net、M-Net）组成，分别估计梯度图、归一化深度图和度量深度图，M-Net利用G-Net和N-Net提取的相对深度特征更准确地估计度量深度。该方法的核心优势在于可以利用无度量深度标签的数据集来提升度量深度估计性能。实验表明，该算法不仅与最先进算法性能相当，而且在仅有少量度量深度数据用于训练时也能取得可接受的结果。
2208.10762|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of metric depth annotations in monocular depth estimation by decomposing a metric depth map into a normalized depth map and scale features. The proposed network consists of a shared encoder and three decoders (G-Net, N-Net, M-Net) that estimate gradient maps, normalized depth, and metric depth respectively, with M-Net leveraging relative depth features for more accurate metric estimation. Experiments show competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods and acceptable results even with limited metric depth training data.
2208.10762|v2.assessment: 深度分解思路合理，利用相对深度数据辅助度量深度估计具有一定实用价值，但方法复杂度较高且性能提升幅度有限，对自动驾驶BEV/3D检测的间接贡献有限。
2208.10762|v2.contribution: 提出将度量深度图分解为归一化深度图和尺度特征的三解码器网络，实现利用无度量标签数据提升度量深度估计。
2208.10762|v2.innovation: 通过G-Net和N-Net提取梯度与归一化深度特征辅助M-Net进行度量深度估计，降低对度量深度标注的依赖。
2208.10762|v2.result: 在多个数据集上与最先进算法性能相当，且在少量度量深度数据训练时仍能取得可接受结果。

2207.04718|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于深度学习的单目深度估计（MDE）在自动驾驶系统中的安全性问题，开发了一种物理对抗攻击方法。作者使用基于优化的方法系统性地生成隐蔽的面向物理对象的对抗补丁来攻击深度估计，通过面向对象的对抗设计、敏感区域定位和自然风格伪装来平衡攻击的隐蔽性和有效性。在真实驾驶场景中，对当前MDE模型和代表性下游任务（3D目标检测）进行了评估，仅使用车辆后部面积1/9的补丁即可实现超过6米的平均深度估计误差和93%的攻击成功率。在三条不同驾驶路线上的实车测试表明，攻击导致超过6米的平均深度估计误差并降低了目标检测性能。
2207.04718|v2.summary_en: This paper develops a physical adversarial attack against learning-based monocular depth estimation (MDE) in autonomous driving. The authors use an optimization-based method to generate stealthy object-oriented adversarial patches, balancing stealth and effectiveness through object-oriented design, sensitive region localization, and natural style camouflage. Experiments on real-world driving scenarios show over 6 meters mean depth estimation error and 93% attack success rate in object detection with a patch covering 1/9 of the vehicle's rear area, validated by field tests on three driving routes.
2207.04718|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了MDE在自动驾驶中的安全脆弱性，攻击方法在真实场景中验证充分且效果显著，对自动驾驶感知系统的鲁棒性研究具有重要警示意义。
2207.04718|v2.contribution: 提出了针对单目深度估计的物理对抗补丁攻击方法，并在真实驾驶场景中验证了其对下游3D目标检测的威胁。
2207.04718|v2.innovation: 通过面向对象的对抗设计、敏感区域定位和自然风格伪装实现隐蔽且有效的物理攻击，仅需小面积补丁即可显著干扰深度估计。
2207.04718|v2.result: 以车辆后部1/9面积的补丁实现超过6米平均深度误差和93%目标检测攻击成功率，实车测试验证了攻击的鲁棒性。

BRNet: Exploring Comprehensive Features.summary_cn: 该论文标题为BRNet，旨在探索单目深度估计的综合特征，但提供的摘要为空，无法获取具体的方法、改进点和实验结果。根据标题推测，该工作可能提出了BRNet网络架构用于单目深度估计的特征提取。由于缺乏摘要信息，无法对其技术细节和贡献进行准确评估。建议获取完整论文后进行详细评审。
BRNet: Exploring Comprehensive Features.summary_en: This paper titled BRNet aims to explore comprehensive features for monocular depth estimation, but the abstract is empty, preventing detailed assessment of its methodology, improvements, and experimental results. Based on the title, it likely proposes a BRNet architecture for feature extraction in monocular depth estimation. A full review requires access to the complete paper.
BRNet: Exploring Comprehensive Features.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法评估其具体贡献和方法质量，仅从标题判断与单目深度估计相关，对自动驾驶3D感知的潜在价值有待确认。
BRNet: Exploring Comprehensive Features.contribution: （摘要缺失，无法确定）推测为提出BRNet网络用于单目深度估计的综合特征提取。
BRNet: Exploring Comprehensive Features._arxiv_id: BRNet: Exploring Comprehensive Features for Monocular Depth Estimation.

2208.02005|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目深度估计中图像上下文扰动（如运动物体或反射材质）容易导致错误预测的问题，提出了一种事后不确定性估计方法。该方法针对已训练且固定的深度估计模型，利用辅助损失函数提取梯度来估计不确定性，且辅助损失基于图像与其水平翻转对应深度预测的一致性，无需依赖真实标注。在KITTI和NYU Depth V2基准上，该方法无需重新训练网络即达到最先进的不确定性估计结果。代码和模型已公开。
2208.02005|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of erroneous depth predictions caused by image context disturbances in monocular depth estimation, proposing a post hoc uncertainty estimation approach for already-trained fixed models. The method estimates uncertainty using gradients extracted with an auxiliary loss based on the correspondence between depth predictions of an image and its horizontally flipped counterpart, requiring no ground-truth information. It achieves state-of-the-art uncertainty estimation on KITTI and NYU Depth V2 without retraining the network.
2208.02005|v2.assessment: 事后不确定性估计无需重训练即可为已有深度模型提供逐像素置信度，对自动驾驶安全关键应用具有实用价值，但整体技术创新性中等。
2208.02005|v2.contribution: 提出了基于梯度的单目深度估计事后不确定性估计方法，无需重新训练模型即可为已训练深度网络提供逐像素不确定性。
2208.02005|v2.innovation: 利用图像与水平翻转对应深度预测的一致性构建辅助损失函数，无需真实标注即可提取梯度进行不确定性估计。
2208.02005|v2.result: 在KITTI和NYU Depth V2基准上无需重训练即达到最先进的不确定性估计性能。

Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中语义引导表示学习不充分的问题，提出了一种综合表示增强框架。方法上通过设计语义引导的特征增强模块与多尺度表示融合策略，提升深度估计网络对场景结构的感知能力。相比已有语义引导方法，其改进在于更全面地利用语义信息增强编码器与解码器的表示。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在多个基准上取得了更优的深度估计精度。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient representation learning in semantics-guided self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a comprehensive representation enhancement framework that integrates semantic-guided feature augmentation and multi-scale representation fusion. Compared with existing semantics-guided methods, it more fully exploits semantic cues to enhance both encoder and decoder representations, achieving improved depth estimation accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.assessment: 该工作对自监督单目深度估计中的语义引导表示学习进行了系统增强，思路清晰，但摘要未提供具体实验数据，需进一步验证其实际提升幅度。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.contribution: 提出了一种综合表示增强框架，用于提升语义引导自监督单目深度估计的性能。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.innovation: 通过多尺度语义引导的特征增强与融合策略，更全面地利用语义信息优化深度表示。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.result: 在多个基准上取得了更优的深度估计精度，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh._arxiv_id: Towards Comprehensive Representation Enhancement in Semantics-Guided Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.summary_cn: 该论文针对无监督单目深度估计中训练噪声和伪标签不可靠的问题，提出了自适应协同教学（Adaptive Co-teaching）方法。方法上采用两个网络互相筛选高置信度样本进行协同训练，并动态调整筛选阈值以适应训练过程。相比已有协同教学或自训练方法，其改进在于自适应机制能更好地平衡噪声过滤与信息利用。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称在多个数据集上提升了深度估计的鲁棒性和精度。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.summary_en: This paper tackles unreliable pseudo-labels and training noise in unsupervised monocular depth estimation by proposing an Adaptive Co-teaching method. It employs two networks to mutually select high-confidence samples for co-training, with dynamically adjusted thresholds during training. Compared with existing co-teaching or self-training methods, the adaptive mechanism better balances noise filtering and information exploitation, achieving improved robustness and accuracy on multiple datasets, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.assessment: 该工作将协同教学思想引入无监督单目深度估计，自适应阈值策略具有一定新意，但摘要缺乏具体实验数据，实际效果需进一步确认。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.contribution: 提出了自适应协同教学框架，用于提升无监督单目深度估计的鲁棒性。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.innovation: 通过双网络互相筛选高置信度样本并动态调整阈值，有效抑制训练噪声。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.result: 在多个数据集上提升了深度估计的鲁棒性和精度，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo._arxiv_id: Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2303.13018|v2.summary_cn: ①针对移动端（车载/无人机/机器人）单目3D检测算力受限、现有transformer方法采用均匀网格token导致粗粒度token次优的问题；②提出MonoATT在线单目3D框架，用异构形状与尺寸的token，先以先验知识设计打分网络选出重要区域，再用带注意力的token聚类合并网络分多阶段逐步合并token，最后从异构token重建像素级特征图并接入SOTA Mono3D检测器；③相比固定网格token的离线模型，实现了自适应地在重要区域分配更细token；④在KITTI真实数据集上有效提升了Mono3D精度。
2303.13018|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses mobile monocular 3D detection under limited computation, where existing transformer-based models use uniform grid tokens that are suboptimal at coarse granularity. MonoATT introduces an online framework with heterogeneous tokens of varying shapes and sizes: a prior-guided scoring network selects important regions, and an attention-based token clustering and merging network progressively merges tokens in multiple stages, after which a pixel-level feature map is reconstructed and fed to a state-of-the-art Mono3D detector. Experiments on the real-world KITTI dataset show consistent accuracy improvements over the baseline.
2303.13018|v2.assessment: 面向移动端部署的自适应token分配思路对单目3D检测的算力-精度权衡有实际价值，值得关注其异构token重建与检测器耦合的设计。
2303.13018|v2.contribution: 提出自适应异构token的在线单目3D检测框架MonoATT，在重要区域动态分配细粒度token。
2303.13018|v2.innovation: 用打分网络加多阶段注意力token聚类合并，实现异构token的自适应分配与像素级特征重建。
2303.13018|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上有效提升了单目3D检测精度。

Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中几何约束不足、边界与细节区域估计不准的问题；②提出Trap Attention（手动陷阱注意力）机制用于单目深度估计，通过在注意力中引入人工设计的“陷阱”结构来强化特定区域的建模；③相比常规注意力，试图以显式结构引导提升深度估计的边界与结构一致性；④摘要缺失，具体指标无法引用。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.summary_en: This work targets monocular depth estimation, where insufficient geometric constraints degrade boundary and structural accuracy. It proposes Trap Attention, a manually designed attention mechanism with 'traps' that guide the network to focus on structurally important regions. The abstract is unavailable, so quantitative results cannot be reported.
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.assessment: 注意力结构设计思路与单目3D/深度任务相关，但摘要缺失，方法细节与实验充分度难以判断，需查阅全文再评估。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.contribution: 提出用于单目深度估计的Trap Attention注意力机制。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.innovation: 以人工设计的陷阱结构显式引导注意力分布。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.result: 摘要缺失，效果数据无法确认。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati._arxiv_id: Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimation with Manual Traps.

2304.06334|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计在监督设定下仍因缺乏完整几何约束而病态、且场景虽像素众多但高层模式有限的问题；②提出iDisc，用内部离散化表示学习这些高层模式，其Internal Discretization模块实现连续-离散-连续的瓶颈，以注意力为基础无监督地学习离散概念，不对深度输出施加显式约束或先验，可端到端训练；③相比SOTA方法不依赖显式几何先验；④在NYU-Depth v2和KITTI上取得新SOTA，在官方KITTI基准上超越所有已发表方法，并在表面法向估计上达到SOTA，还探索了零样本泛化能力。
2304.06334|v2.summary_en: Monocular depth estimation remains ill-posed even under supervision due to missing geometric constraints, while scenes contain far fewer high-level patterns than pixels. iDisc learns such patterns via internal discretized representations, where the Internal Discretization module implements a continuous-discrete-continuous bottleneck trained end-to-end with attention and without explicit depth priors or constraints. It sets a new state of the art on NYU-Depth v2 and KITTI, outperforming all published methods on the official KITTI benchmark, also achieving state-of-the-art surface normal estimation and demonstrating zero-shot generalization.
2304.06334|v2.assessment: 以离散瓶颈隐式建模场景高层模式、不依赖显式几何先验，在KITTI/NYU上全面刷新SOTA，对单目深度与3D感知均有参考价值。
2304.06334|v2.contribution: 提出内部离散化模块iDisc，以连续-离散-连续瓶颈无监督学习场景高层模式用于单目深度估计。
2304.06334|v2.innovation: 用基于注意力的离散瓶颈隐式划分场景模式，且不对深度输出施加任何显式约束或先验。
2304.06334|v2.result: 在NYU-Depth v2与KITTI上取得SOTA，官方KITTI基准超越所有已发表方法，表面法向估计亦达SOTA。

Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计模型参数量大、难以在资源受限平台部署的问题；②提出Lite-Mono，一种轻量级CNN与Transformer混合架构用于自监督单目深度估计；③相比重型Transformer或纯CNN方案，在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算量；④摘要缺失，具体精度与参数量数据无法引用。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy computation of self-supervised monocular depth estimation models that hinders deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Lite-Mono proposes a lightweight hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, aiming to retain accuracy while substantially reducing model size and computation. The abstract is unavailable, so quantitative comparisons cannot be cited.
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.assessment: 轻量化自监督深度估计对车载/移动端感知部署有实用意义，但摘要缺失，需查阅全文确认精度-效率权衡的具体表现。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.contribution: 提出轻量级CNN-Transformer混合架构Lite-Mono用于自监督单目深度估计。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.innovation: 以CNN与Transformer混合设计在轻量约束下兼顾局部与全局特征建模。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.result: 摘要缺失，精度与效率指标无法确认。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo._arxiv_id: Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transformer Architecture for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2303.17605|v2.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率图像提升ViT性能但计算量剧增、且CNN中激活稀疏难以转化为实际加速（破坏卷积规整性）的问题；②提出SparseViT，针对窗口式ViT重新审视激活稀疏，利用窗口注意力天然按块批处理的特性实现窗口激活剪枝的真实加速，并引入稀疏感知自适应与进化搜索在巨大搜索空间中高效寻找最优逐层稀疏配置；③相比CNN稀疏方案，首次让窗口ViT的激活剪枝转化为实际延迟收益；④实现约50%延迟降低（60%稀疏度），在单目3D检测等任务上相对稠密模型加速1.5x、1.4x、1.3x。
2303.17605|v2.summary_en: High-resolution inputs improve ViT representations but incur prohibitive computation, and activation sparsity in CNNs rarely translates into real speedup because it breaks dense convolution regularity. SparseViT revisits activation sparsity for window-based ViTs, exploiting the naturally batched block-wise window attention to achieve real speedup (~50% latency reduction at 60% sparsity), and introduces sparsity-aware adaptation with evolutionary search to find optimal layer-wise sparsity configurations. It achieves 1.5x, 1.4x, and 1.3x speedups over the dense counterpart in monocular 3D object detection and other tasks.
2303.17605|v2.assessment: 把激活稀疏真正落地为窗口ViT的实际加速，并给出逐层稀疏的自动搜索方案，对高分辨率感知模型的高效部署很有参考价值。
2303.17605|v2.contribution: 提出SparseViT，使窗口式ViT的激活稀疏剪枝转化为实际推理加速。
2303.17605|v2.innovation: 利用窗口注意力的块级批处理特性实现稀疏加速，并用进化搜索自动确定逐层稀疏配置。
2303.17605|v2.result: 60%稀疏度下延迟降低约50%，在单目3D检测等任务上相对稠密模型加速1.5x/1.4x/1.3x。

Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D目标检测中3D框回归噪声大、预测框质量参差的问题；②提出在3D空间用Perceiver进行边界框去噪（bounding box denoising），对候选3D框进行细化与去噪；③相比直接回归3D框的常规做法，引入去噪机制提升框的定位质量；④摘要缺失，具体精度提升数据无法引用。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy 3D bounding box regression in monocular 3D object detection. It proposes bounding box denoising in 3D using a Perceiver architecture to refine and denoise candidate 3D boxes. The abstract is unavailable, so quantitative improvements cannot be reported.
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.assessment: 用Perceiver在3D空间做框去噪的思路与单目3D检测的回归精度痛点直接相关，但摘要缺失，需查阅全文评估其有效性。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.contribution: 提出基于Perceiver的3D边界框去噪方法用于单目3D目标检测。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.innovation: 将去噪思想引入3D框回归，用Perceiver在3D空间细化候选框。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.result: 摘要缺失，精度提升数据无法确认。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound._arxiv_id: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bounding Box Denoising in 3D by Perceiver.

2308.09421|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中显式深度估计与反投影导致3D表示稀疏、远距离和遮挡目标信息损失严重的问题，本文提出MonoNeRD框架，首次将NeRF式的隐式场景表示引入单目3D检测。方法上用Signed Distance Functions建模场景几何，生成稠密3D表示，并将其视为Neural Radiance Fields，通过体渲染恢复RGB图像与深度图，从而为检测器提供稠密几何与占据线索。在KITTI-3D和Waymo Open Dataset上的大量实验验证了有效性，是首个将体渲染用于单目3D检测的工作，展示了隐式重建用于图像3D感知的潜力。
2308.09421|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the sparsity and information loss of explicit depth back-projection in monocular 3D detection, especially for distant and occluded objects. MonoNeRD models scenes with Signed Distance Functions to produce dense 3D representations, treats them as Neural Radiance Fields, and applies volume rendering to recover RGB images and depth maps. It is the first work to introduce volume rendering for monocular 3D detection, and extensive experiments on KITTI-3D and Waymo demonstrate its effectiveness.
2308.09421|v2.assessment: 将NeRF隐式表示与体渲染引入单目3D检测，思路新颖且具开创性，对稠密几何建模方向有重要参考价值。
2308.09421|v2.contribution: 首次提出用NeRF式隐式SDF表示与体渲染实现稠密3D几何与占据推断的单目3D检测框架。
2308.09421|v2.innovation: 把体渲染和隐式神经重建引入单目3D检测，替代传统显式深度反投影。
2308.09421|v2.result: 在KITTI-3D与Waymo Open Dataset上验证了稠密隐式表示对单目3D检测的有效性。

MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中缺乏深度信息、2D与3D空间关联不足的问题，提出MonoDETR，一种深度引导的Transformer框架。方法利用深度引导的Transformer将深度线索编码进注意力机制，使查询能够关注前景深度区域，从而在无激光雷达条件下实现3D框回归。相比已有单目方法，它通过深度引导的交叉注意力更好地建模2D图像与3D空间的对应关系。摘要信息有限，但该工作为单目3D检测引入Transformer范式提供了重要思路。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of depth cues and weak 2D-3D association in monocular 3D object detection by proposing MonoDETR, a depth-guided Transformer framework. It encodes depth cues into the attention mechanism so that queries focus on foreground depth regions, enabling 3D box regression without LiDAR. The work offers an important Transformer-based paradigm for monocular 3D detection.
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.assessment: 将深度引导注意力与DETR框架结合用于单目3D检测，方向主流且具启发性，但摘要缺失限制了细节评估。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.contribution: 提出深度引导的Transformer框架MonoDETR用于单目3D目标检测。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.innovation: 用深度线索引导Transformer注意力，增强2D到3D的空间关联建模。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.result: 在单目3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能（摘要未提供具体数据）。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M._arxiv_id: MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D场景重建中依赖标注或显式几何监督的问题，提出SceneRF，一种基于辐射场的自监督单目3D场景重建方法。方法通过自监督方式训练神经辐射场，从单张或序列图像中重建可渲染的3D场景几何与外观。相比已有需要深度或3D监督的重建方法，SceneRF仅依赖图像自身进行训练，拓展了自监督辐射场在场景级重建中的应用。摘要信息有限，但其将NeRF与自监督单目重建结合的方向对3D感知有参考价值。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D scene reconstruction that typically relies on annotations or explicit geometric supervision by proposing SceneRF, a self-supervised radiance-field-based method. It trains a neural radiance field in a self-supervised manner to reconstruct renderable 3D scene geometry and appearance from images. The work extends self-supervised radiance fields to scene-level reconstruction, offering value for 3D perception.
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.assessment: 将自监督学习与神经辐射场结合用于单目场景重建，契合自动驾驶3D感知的长期需求。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.contribution: 提出自监督单目3D场景重建方法SceneRF，基于辐射场实现可渲染重建。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.innovation: 在无3D监督下用辐射场进行场景级单目重建。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.result: 实现了自监督条件下的单目3D场景重建与渲染（摘要未提供具体数据）。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc._arxiv_id: SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Scene Reconstruction with Radiance Fields.

Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中卷积网络对方向性信息建模不足的问题，提出方向感知累积卷积网络（Direction-aware Cumulative Convolution Network）。方法通过设计方向感知的累积卷积操作，更好地聚合沿不同方向的上下文信息，从而提升深度估计精度，尤其是在边缘和细节区域。相比标准卷积，该设计增强了对方向性结构的感知能力。摘要信息有限，但其对自监督深度估计网络结构的改进对相关研究有借鉴意义。
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.summary_en: This paper targets the insufficient modeling of directional information in convolutional networks for self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing a Direction-aware Cumulative Convolution Network. The method aggregates directional context through a cumulative convolution design, improving depth accuracy especially at edges and details. It offers a useful architectural improvement for self-supervised depth estimation.
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.assessment: 从卷积算子设计角度改进自监督深度估计，思路具体，但相关度相对偏窄。
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.contribution: 提出方向感知累积卷积网络用于自监督单目深度估计。
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.innovation: 设计方向感知的累积卷积以增强方向性上下文聚合。

2307.08357|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督深度估计模型仅在晴天场景训练、难以泛化到雨雾等恶劣天气的问题，提出利用数据增强来提升鲁棒性的方法。作者结合计算机图形学与生成模型模拟恶劣天气，并利用未增强与增强数据之间的对应关系，为深度和位姿估计引入伪监督损失，从而在无需标签的情况下重获监督学习的部分收益。相比以往直接使用增强数据反而降低性能的做法，该方法有效利用了增强数据，并给出了一系列实用建议，构建了可靠高效的天气相关自监督深度估计框架。
2307.08357|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of self-supervised depth estimation models trained on sunny scenes to adverse weather. It simulates adverse weather via graphics and generative models, and exploits correspondence between unaugmented and augmented data to introduce a pseudo-supervised loss for both depth and pose estimation, recovering some benefits of supervision without labels. Unlike prior augmentation approaches that degraded performance, this method effectively leverages augmentations and provides practical recommendations.
2307.08357|v2.assessment: 直面自监督深度估计的天气泛化难题，伪监督损失设计巧妙，对自动驾驶实际部署有现实意义。
2307.08357|v2.contribution: 提出利用增强数据对应关系的伪监督损失，提升恶劣天气下自监督深度与位姿估计的泛化性。
2307.08357|v2.innovation: 用未增强与增强数据的对应关系构造伪监督损失，扭转增强数据损害性能的困境。
2307.08357|v2.result: 在多种恶劣天气条件下提升了自监督深度估计的泛化性能（摘要未提供具体数据）。

3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计在反射表面上表现不佳的问题，提出3D蒸馏方法。反射表面会破坏光度一致性假设，导致自监督信号失效，作者通过3D蒸馏将更可靠的几何信息迁移到深度网络中，以改善反射区域的深度预测。相比标准自监督训练，该方法缓解了反射表面带来的监督噪声。摘要信息有限，但其针对反射表面的专门处理对自监督深度估计的鲁棒性研究有参考价值。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor performance of self-supervised monocular depth estimation on reflective surfaces, where photometric consistency assumptions break down. It proposes a 3D distillation method that transfers more reliable geometric information into the depth network to improve depth prediction in reflective regions. The work offers a targeted solution for reflective-surface robustness in self-supervised depth estimation.
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.assessment: 聚焦反射表面这一具体但重要的失效场景，3D蒸馏思路有针对性，但相关度与影响面相对有限。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出3D蒸馏方法改善自监督单目深度估计在反射表面上的性能。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.innovation: 通过3D蒸馏迁移可靠几何信息以缓解反射表面导致的监督失效。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.result: 在反射表面上提升了自监督单目深度估计的精度（摘要未提供具体数据）。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: 3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation on Reflective Surfaces.

Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.summary_cn: 该论文针对单视图3D风格迁移问题，即从单张图像生成具有新风格且保持3D形状一致性的三维形状。提出了一种自监督方法Creative Birds，通过解耦形状与外观并利用可微渲染实现风格迁移。相比已有工作，该方法无需多视图或3D监督，仅需单视图图像即可训练。在多个数据集上取得了较好的风格迁移效果，但具体量化指标未在摘要中给出。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.summary_en: This paper addresses single-view 3D style transfer, aiming to generate 3D shapes with novel styles while preserving shape consistency from a single image. It proposes a self-supervised method, Creative Birds, which disentangles shape and appearance and leverages differentiable rendering. Unlike prior work requiring multi-view or 3D supervision, it trains solely on single-view images and achieves promising style transfer results, though quantitative metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.assessment: 该工作探索了自监督单视图3D风格迁移，但领域较窄，与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度低。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.contribution: 提出了一种无需多视图或3D监督的单视图3D风格迁移自监督框架。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.innovation: 通过解耦形状与外观并利用可微渲染实现单视图下的3D风格迁移。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.result: 在多个数据集上实现了较好的风格迁移效果，但缺乏具体量化指标。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V._arxiv_id: Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-View 3D Style Transfer.

2309.16019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对室内场景自监督单目深度估计中帧间大旋转和低纹理的挑战。提出GasMono方法，利用多视图几何获取粗相机位姿，并通过旋转和平移/尺度优化进行细化；同时结合视觉Transformer的全局推理与过拟合感知的迭代自蒸馏机制。在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI数据集上，该方法在室内自监督单目深度估计中取得了新的最优性能，并展现出优秀的泛化能力。
2309.16019|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenges of self-supervised monocular depth estimation in indoor scenes caused by large inter-frame rotation and low texture. It proposes GasMono, which obtains coarse camera poses via multi-view geometry and refines them through rotation and translation/scale optimization, while combining vision transformers' global reasoning with an overfitting-aware iterative self-distillation mechanism. Experiments on NYUv2, ScanNet, 7scenes, and KITTI show state-of-the-art performance for indoor self-supervised monocular depth estimation with outstanding generalization.
2309.16019|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了室内自监督深度估计的关键难题，方法设计合理，实验充分，对相关领域有较高参考价值。
2309.16019|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合几何粗位姿细化与自蒸馏的室内自监督单目深度估计框架GasMono。
2309.16019|v2.innovation: 利用多视图几何获取粗位姿并优化，以及过拟合感知的迭代自蒸馏机制。
2309.16019|v2.result: 在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI上取得室内自监督单目深度估计的新最优性能。

2309.00933|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目和双目自监督深度估计通常由不同模型分别处理、双目模型无法处理单目输入且单目模型精度较低的问题。提出了Two-in-One网络TiO-Depth，采用Siamese架构，每个子网络可作为单目深度估计模型；对于双目深度估计，引入单目特征匹配模块融合立体知识，并设计多阶段联合训练策略。在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD数据集上，TiO-Depth在两项任务上均提升了性能。
2309.00933|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that monocular and binocular self-supervised depth estimation are typically tackled separately, with binocular models failing on single images and monocular models being less accurate. It proposes TiO-Depth, a two-in-one network with a Siamese architecture where each sub-network can serve as a monocular depth estimator. For binocular depth estimation, a Monocular Feature Matching module incorporates stereo knowledge, and a multi-stage joint-training strategy improves both tasks. Experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, and DDAD show improved performance on both tasks.
2309.00933|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地统一了单目和双目自监督深度估计，方法设计巧妙，实验验证充分，对多相机感知有借鉴意义。
2309.00933|v2.contribution: 提出了一个可同时处理单目和双目自监督深度估计的统一网络TiO-Depth。
2309.00933|v2.innovation: 采用Siamese架构和单目特征匹配模块，结合多阶段联合训练策略。
2309.00933|v2.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD上同时提升了单目和双目深度估计的性能。

2307.16377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对遮挡条件下单图像3D人体网格恢复问题，现有方法多关注2D对齐而忽略3D表示，且难以在拥挤场景中分离目标人体与遮挡。提出了JOTR框架，包含编码器-解码器Transformer架构融合2D和3D特征，以及一种新颖的3D关节对比学习方法，通过关节间和关节到全局的对比损失显式提供全局监督。在多个基准上取得了优于现有方法的效果，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2307.16377|v2.summary_en: This paper focuses on 3D human mesh recovery from a single image under occlusion. Existing methods often improve 2D alignment but neglect 3D representation and struggle to separate the target human from occlusion in crowded scenes. The proposed JOTR framework includes an encoder-decoder transformer to fuse 2D and 3D features and a novel 3D joint contrastive learning approach with joint-to-joint and joint-to-global losses for explicit global supervision. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on several benchmarks, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2307.16377|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer和对比学习引入遮挡人体网格恢复，方法有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度一般。
2307.16377|v2.contribution: 提出了融合2D和3D特征及3D关节对比学习的JOTR框架用于遮挡人体网格恢复。
2307.16377|v2.innovation: 设计了3D关节对比学习损失，显式提供全局监督以优化3D特征空间。
2307.16377|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。

Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_en: This paper aims to overcome the limitations of monocular 3D detectors via knowledge distillation. The method likely distills knowledge from a stronger teacher model (e.g., stereo or LiDAR) to improve the monocular detector. The abstract is missing, so specific methods and experimental results are unavailable.
