Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计判别性不足的问题，本文提出深度判别度量学习（Depth-discriminative Metric Learning）。方法通过设计度量学习损失，使不同深度实例在特征空间中具有更好的可分性，从而提升深度预测精度。相比已有工作，该方法不依赖额外深度传感器或复杂网络结构，而是从特征表示层面增强深度判别能力。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的单目3D检测性能，验证了度量学习对深度估计的有效性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited depth discriminability in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a depth-discriminative metric learning approach. The method designs a metric learning loss to enhance feature separability across different depths, improving depth prediction without extra sensors or complex architectures. It achieves competitive performance on benchmarks such as KITTI, demonstrating the effectiveness of metric learning for monocular 3D detection.
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.assessment: 该工作从特征表示角度切入单目3D检测的深度判别问题，思路清晰且实用，对单目3D检测研究者有参考价值。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.contribution: 提出深度判别度量学习，增强单目3D检测中深度特征的判别性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.innovation: 将度量学习引入单目3D检测的深度估计，从特征空间提升深度可分性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力的单目3D检测性能。

3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测训练数据稀缺、真实场景物体分布不均的问题，本文提出3D Copy-Paste数据增强方法，实现物理合理的物体插入。方法通过考虑几何、光照和遮挡等物理约束，将3D物体无缝粘贴到现有场景中，生成逼真的合成训练样本。相比传统2D复制粘贴，该方法保持了3D一致性和物理合理性，有效扩充了训练数据。实验表明该方法能显著提升单目3D检测器在KITTI等基准上的性能。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_en: This paper tackles data scarcity in monocular 3D detection by proposing 3D Copy-Paste, a physically plausible object insertion augmentation. The method inserts 3D objects into scenes while respecting geometry, lighting, and occlusion constraints, generating realistic synthetic training samples. It improves monocular 3D detectors on benchmarks like KITTI, outperforming naive 2D copy-paste augmentation.
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.assessment: 该工作将数据增强与物理合理性结合，为单目3D检测的数据瓶颈提供了实用方案，值得关注。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.contribution: 提出物理合理的3D Copy-Paste数据增强方法用于单目3D检测。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.innovation: 在物体插入中引入几何、光照与遮挡等物理约束，保证3D一致性。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著提升单目3D检测器性能。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje._arxiv_id: 3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Object Insertion for Monocular 3D Detection.

MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_cn: 针对车端与路侧单目3D检测因视角差异导致性能不一致的问题，本文提出MonoUNI统一网络，同时适用于车端和基础设施侧检测。方法通过挖掘充分的深度线索（如几何先验和上下文信息），设计统一的特征提取与深度估计模块，弥合两种视角的域差异。相比分别针对车端或路侧设计的专用模型，MonoUNI在两类场景下均取得优异性能，验证了统一框架的可行性。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_en: This paper addresses the viewpoint discrepancy between vehicle-side and infrastructure-side monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoUNI, a unified network for both settings. It exploits sufficient depth clues such as geometric priors and contextual information to bridge the domain gap. MonoUNI achieves strong performance on both vehicle-side and infrastructure-side benchmarks, demonstrating the feasibility of a unified framework.
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.assessment: 该工作关注车路协同场景下的统一单目3D检测，问题新颖且实用，对自动驾驶感知研究者有启发。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.contribution: 提出统一车端与路侧的单目3D检测网络MonoUNI。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.innovation: 通过充分深度线索弥合车端与路侧视角的域差异，实现统一检测。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.result: 在车端和路侧两类场景下均取得优异检测性能。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru._arxiv_id: MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastructure-side Monocular 3D Object Detection Network with Sufficient Depth Clues.

The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_cn: 针对光流估计和单目深度估计任务，本文意外发现扩散模型（Diffusion Models）在此类密集预测任务上具有显著有效性。方法将扩散模型框架应用于光流和深度估计，通过迭代去噪过程生成高质量的密集预测结果。相比传统判别式方法，扩散模型在不确定性和细节恢复方面表现更优，在多个基准上取得领先性能。该工作揭示了扩散模型在几何视觉任务中的潜力。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_en: This paper surprisingly demonstrates the effectiveness of diffusion models for optical flow and monocular depth estimation. By applying a diffusion framework to these dense prediction tasks, the method generates high-quality predictions through iterative denoising. It outperforms traditional discriminative approaches on multiple benchmarks, revealing the potential of diffusion models for geometric vision tasks.
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.assessment: 该工作将扩散模型成功迁移到光流与深度估计，结果令人惊讶且性能领先，对单目3D检测和深度估计研究者有重要参考价值。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.contribution: 证明扩散模型在光流和单目深度估计任务上的显著有效性。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.innovation: 将扩散生成框架引入密集几何预测任务，替代传统判别式方法。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.result: 在多个光流和深度估计基准上取得领先性能。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio._arxiv_id: The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusion Models for Optical Flow and Monocular Depth Estimation.

IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中离散化深度区间划分不灵活的问题，本文提出迭代弹性区间（IEBins）方法。方法通过迭代细化深度区间边界，使区间划分自适应于数据分布，提升深度估计精度。相比固定区间或均匀划分方法，IEBins能更灵活地捕捉深度变化，在KITTI等基准上取得领先的单目深度估计性能。该工作为单目深度估计提供了新的区间划分范式。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_en: This paper addresses inflexible depth bin discretization in monocular depth estimation by proposing Iterative Elastic Bins (IEBins). The method iteratively refines bin boundaries to adapt to data distribution, improving depth accuracy. It outperforms fixed or uniform binning methods on benchmarks like KITTI, offering a new paradigm for depth discretization.
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.assessment: 该工作从深度离散化角度改进单目深度估计，方法简洁有效，对单目3D检测中的深度估计模块有借鉴意义。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.contribution: 提出迭代弹性区间（IEBins）用于单目深度估计。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.innovation: 通过迭代细化自适应深度区间边界，替代固定或均匀划分。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得领先的单目深度估计性能。

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督单目深度估计中物体边缘深度不准确、边界模糊的问题，本文提出一种边缘感知的深度细化方法，通过显式建模深度不连续区域来改善边缘处的深度预测。方法在稀疏LiDAR监督下引入边缘引导的损失或后处理模块，使物体轮廓处的深度过渡更锐利。相比已有稀疏监督方法，改进点在于专门处理深度边缘而非整体平滑优化。实验在KITTI等基准上降低了边缘区域的深度误差，提升了深度图的结构保真度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate and blurry depth edges in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation by explicitly modeling depth discontinuities. It introduces an edge-aware refinement that sharpens depth transitions at object boundaries under sparse LiDAR supervision. Compared with prior sparsely-supervised methods, it specifically targets edge regions rather than global smoothness, reducing edge depth error and improving structural fidelity on KITTI-style benchmarks.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 对依赖精确物体边界的单目深度/3D感知任务有实用价值，边缘细化思路可迁移到BEV与占据预测。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出面向稀疏监督单目深度的边缘感知细化方法，改善深度不连续区域的预测精度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 将深度边缘作为独立优化目标，显式建模物体轮廓处的深度跳变。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 在稀疏监督设定下降低了边缘区域深度误差，提升了深度图结构保真度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计泛化性差、需要大量深度标注的问题，本文提出Marigold，将预训练的Stable Diffusion图像生成器重用于仿射不变深度估计。方法通过在合成深度数据上微调扩散模型，并利用其丰富的视觉先验，在零样本设定下输出高质量深度。相比传统判别式回归方法，改进点在于把生成式扩散先验迁移到深度任务，显著提升跨数据集泛化。在多个零样本基准上取得SOTA，超越部分全监督方法。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper repurposes a pretrained Stable Diffusion image generator for affine-invariant monocular depth estimation (Marigold). By fine-tuning the diffusion model on synthetic depth data, it leverages strong visual priors to produce high-quality depth in a zero-shot manner. Compared with discriminative regression baselines, it transfers generative priors to depth, achieving state-of-the-art zero-shot generalization across multiple benchmarks and even surpassing some fully-supervised methods.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 生成式先验用于深度估计的代表性工作，零样本泛化能力强，对单目3D与BEV感知有重要启发。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 提出Marigold，将扩散图像生成器重用于仿射不变单目深度估计。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 把Stable Diffusion的生成先验迁移到深度任务，实现强零样本泛化。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 在多个零样本深度基准上达到SOTA，超越部分全监督方法。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率单目度量深度估计中全局一致性与局部细节难以兼顾的问题，本文提出PatchFusion，一种端到端的基于图块(tile)的框架。方法通过多尺度图块融合与全局-局部一致性约束，在保持高分辨率细节的同时输出度量深度。相比直接整图推理或简单分块方法，改进点在于端到端融合不同图块预测并解决块间不一致。在高分辨率基准上提升了度量深度精度与细节保真度。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_en: This paper targets high-resolution monocular metric depth estimation where global consistency and local detail are hard to balance, proposing PatchFusion, an end-to-end tile-based framework. It fuses multi-scale tile predictions with global-local consistency constraints to output metric depth while preserving fine detail. Unlike whole-image inference or naive tiling, it resolves inter-tile inconsistency end-to-end, improving metric accuracy and detail fidelity on high-resolution benchmarks.
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.assessment: 高分辨率度量深度对自动驾驶近场感知有价值，图块融合思路工程性强、可扩展。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.contribution: 提出端到端图块式框架PatchFusion，实现高分辨率单目度量深度估计。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.innovation: 通过多尺度图块融合与全局-局部一致性约束解决分块不一致问题。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.result: 在高分辨率基准上提升了度量深度精度与细节保真度。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr._arxiv_id: PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Framework for High-Resolution Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在动态物体上因运动假设失效而估计不准的问题，本文提出From-Ground-To-Objects，利用地面接触先验进行由粗到细的动态物体深度估计。方法先估计地面与静态结构，再借助物体与地面的接触关系约束动态物体深度。相比忽略动态区域或依赖额外运动网络的方法，改进点在于用地面接触先验提供几何约束。在KITTI等基准上改善了动态物体深度精度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth on dynamic objects in self-supervised monocular depth estimation, where the static-scene assumption fails, proposing From-Ground-To-Objects with a ground-contact prior. It first estimates ground and static structure, then constrains dynamic object depth via object-ground contact relations in a coarse-to-fine manner. Unlike methods ignoring dynamic regions or relying on extra motion networks, it uses ground-contact geometry, improving dynamic-object depth accuracy on KITTI-style benchmarks.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 针对自监督深度中动态物体这一痛点，地面接触先验思路新颖，对自动驾驶动态场景有参考价值。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出利用地面接触先验的由粗到细自监督单目深度估计方法，改善动态物体深度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 引入物体-地面接触几何先验约束动态区域深度估计。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 在KITTI等基准上提升了动态物体深度精度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域监督信号缺失、易被当作异常剔除的问题，本文提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号的方法。方法通过识别动态区域并构造可靠的伪监督或重加权策略，使动态物体也能参与有效训练。相比直接掩码动态区域的做法，改进点在于主动挖掘而非丢弃动态监督。在KITTI等基准上提升了动态区域及整体深度估计性能。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of supervision for dynamic regions in self-supervised monocular depth estimation, where such regions are often masked out as outliers. It mines supervision for dynamic areas by identifying them and constructing reliable pseudo-supervision or reweighting strategies so they contribute to training. Unlike masking-based approaches, it actively exploits dynamic supervision, improving both dynamic-region and overall depth accuracy on KITTI-style benchmarks.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 与[4]互补，聚焦动态区域监督挖掘，对自监督深度在真实动态场景的鲁棒性有帮助。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号的自监督单目深度估计方法。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 以主动挖掘替代掩码丢弃，使动态区域参与有效训练。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 在KITTI等基准上提升了动态区域与整体深度估计性能。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: 针对扩散模型用于单目深度估计时条件利用不充分的问题，本文提出ECoDepth，通过有效条件化扩散模型提升深度估计。方法设计了更强的条件编码与融合机制，将图像特征有效注入扩散去噪过程。相比仅用简单条件或后处理的扩散深度方法，改进点在于系统优化条件化策略以增强几何一致性。在多个深度基准上取得优于已有扩散方法的精度。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient conditioning when applying diffusion models to monocular depth estimation, proposing ECoDepth with effective conditioning. It designs stronger condition encoding and fusion to inject image features into the diffusion denoising process. Compared with diffusion-based depth methods using simple conditioning or post-processing, it systematically optimizes conditioning for better geometric consistency, achieving improved accuracy over prior diffusion approaches on multiple depth benchmarks.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 与[2]同属扩散深度方向，聚焦条件化设计，对生成式深度估计的工程落地有参考意义。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出ECoDepth，通过有效条件化扩散模型提升单目深度估计。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 系统设计条件编码与融合机制，将图像特征有效注入扩散去噪过程。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.result: 在多个深度基准上取得优于已有扩散方法的精度。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff._arxiv_id: ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation.

UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在跨场景、跨相机泛化能力差、难以输出真实公制深度的问题，本文提出 UniDepth，一个无需相机内参即可输出公制深度的通用单目深度估计器。方法通过伪球面输出表示与自提示相机模块，从图像中自估计相机内参并解耦尺度，实现零样本跨域泛化。相比依赖内参或需针对特定数据集微调的已有方法，UniDepth 在多个零样本基准上大幅领先，并可作为伪标签生成器提升下游任务。实验在十余个数据集上验证了其通用性与精度优势。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-domain generalization and metric ambiguity of monocular depth estimation. UniDepth is proposed as a universal metric depth estimator that predicts camera intrinsics via a self-prompting camera module and uses a pseudo-spherical output representation to decouple scale. It outperforms prior methods on multiple zero-shot benchmarks and can serve as a pseudo-label generator for downstream tasks.
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.assessment: 该工作系统解决了单目公制深度估计的泛化难题，零样本性能突出，对自动驾驶与3D感知具有重要参考价值。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.contribution: 提出无需相机内参、可零样本泛化的通用单目公制深度估计框架 UniDepth。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.innovation: 用伪球面输出表示与自提示相机模块从图像自估计内参并解耦尺度。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.result: 在多个零样本基准上显著超越已有方法，并可作伪标签提升下游任务。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep._arxiv_id: UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中纯视觉线索在纹理缺失或模糊区域易产生歧义的问题，本文提出 WorDepth，将语言先验以变分方式引入深度估计。方法用条件变分框架建模深度分布，并以语言描述作为先验引导，从而在视觉信息不足时提供额外约束。相比仅依赖图像的方法，WorDepth 在多个深度基准上提升了精度与鲁棒性，尤其在困难区域表现更好。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_en: This paper tackles the ambiguity of monocular depth estimation in textureless or blurred regions by introducing language priors. WorDepth employs a variational framework that models depth distributions conditioned on textual descriptions, providing additional constraints when visual cues are insufficient. It improves accuracy and robustness over vision-only baselines on several depth benchmarks.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 将语言先验以变分方式融入单目深度估计，思路新颖，对多模态感知研究有启发。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 提出用变分语言先验增强单目深度估计的 WorDepth 框架。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 以条件变分建模深度分布并引入语言描述作为先验约束。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 在多个深度基准上提升精度与鲁棒性，困难区域改善明显。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测模型在测试时遇到域偏移（如天气、相机变化）性能下降的问题，本文提出 MonoTTA，首个面向单目3D检测的全测试时自适应方法。方法在测试阶段仅用无标签目标域数据，通过设计针对深度与3D框的自适应损失与参数更新策略，在线调整模型。相比源域固定模型，MonoTTA 在多种域偏移下显著提升检测精度，且无需任何目标域标注。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of monocular 3D detectors under test-time domain shifts. MonoTTA is the first fully test-time adaptation method for monocular 3D detection, adapting the model online using only unlabeled target data via tailored depth and 3D box adaptation losses. It substantially improves detection accuracy under various domain shifts without target annotations.
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.assessment: 首次将全测试时自适应引入单目3D检测，实用性强，对自动驾驶部署鲁棒性有直接价值。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.contribution: 提出首个面向单目3D目标检测的全测试时自适应方法 MonoTTA。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.innovation: 设计针对深度与3D框的无监督测试时自适应损失与在线更新策略。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.result: 在多种域偏移下显著提升检测精度，且无需目标域标注。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for._arxiv_id: MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2407.16448|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目3D检测方法主要面向理想天气、在雾天等恶劣条件下性能骤降的问题，本文提出 MonoWAD，一个天气鲁棒的单目3D检测器。方法包含天气码本（记忆晴天知识并为任意输入生成天气参考特征）与天气自适应扩散模型（依据天气条件增强输入特征），并引入天气自适应增强损失。在多种天气条件下实验表明 MonoWAD 实现了天气鲁棒的检测性能。
2407.16448|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the degradation of monocular 3D detection under adverse weather such as fog. MonoWAD introduces a weather codebook that memorizes clear-weather knowledge to generate weather-reference features, and a weather-adaptive diffusion model that enhances input features accordingly, trained with a weather-adaptive enhancement loss. Experiments under various weather conditions demonstrate weather-robust detection.
2407.16448|v2.assessment: 聚焦恶劣天气下的单目3D检测，扩散模型与码本设计有新意，对自动驾驶全天候感知有实际意义。
2407.16448|v2.contribution: 提出天气鲁棒的单目3D检测器 MonoWAD。
2407.16448|v2.innovation: 用天气码本与天气自适应扩散模型按天气条件增强特征。
2407.16448|v2.result: 在多种天气条件下实现天气鲁棒的检测性能。

GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在尺度与地面几何上缺乏约束、导致公制深度不准的问题，本文提出 GroCo，引入地面约束实现公制自监督单目深度。方法利用场景中普遍存在的地面平面作为几何先验，构建地面一致性约束与尺度对齐机制，从而在无标注情况下恢复公制尺度。相比已有自监督方法，GroCo 在公制深度精度上取得提升，并保持自监督训练的通用性。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of scale and ground-geometry constraints in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. GroCo introduces a ground constraint that exploits the ubiquitous ground plane as a geometric prior with consistency and scale-alignment mechanisms to recover metric scale without annotations. It improves metric depth accuracy over prior self-supervised methods.
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.assessment: 利用地面先验解决自监督公制深度的尺度问题，思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶深度感知有参考价值。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.contribution: 提出基于地面约束的公制自监督单目深度估计方法 GroCo。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.innovation: 以地面平面几何先验构建一致性约束与尺度对齐恢复公制尺度。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.result: 在公制深度精度上优于已有自监督方法。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self._arxiv_id: GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self-supervised Monocular Depth.

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率、多帧等富资源输入虽能提升自监督单目深度估计但推理时往往不可得的问题，本文提出 RPrDepth，仅需单张低分辨率图像即可达到接近富资源方法的精度。方法将富资源数据离线提取为参考特征作为先验，推理时从该特征库中检索相似像素作为先验辅助深度估计。实验表明其优于其他单图方法，并可媲美甚至超过富资源输入方法。
2408.00361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unavailability of rich-resource inputs (high-resolution, multi-frame) at inference in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. RPrDepth extracts rich-resource features offline as priors and retrieves similar pixels to guide single-image depth estimation. It outperforms other single-image methods and matches or surpasses rich-resource baselines using only low-resolution single images.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 以离线先验检索弥补推理时资源不足，思路实用，对轻量化深度估计部署有参考意义。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出仅用单张低分辨率图像即可逼近富资源性能的深度估计器 RPrDepth。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 将富资源数据离线提取为参考特征并通过相似像素检索作为先验。
2408.00361|v2.result: 优于其他单图方法，并可媲美甚至超过富资源输入方法。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中自监督单帧与多帧方法割裂、多帧方法依赖位姿估计且泛化受限的问题，提出统一学习框架 Mono-ViFI。该方法通过统一的自监督训练范式同时支持单帧与多帧输入，并引入虚拟特征交互机制增强跨帧几何一致性。相比已有单帧或多帧独立训练方案，Mono-ViFI 在 KITTI 等基准上取得更优的深度精度与跨数据集泛化能力。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation between self-supervised single-frame and multi-frame monocular depth estimation, where multi-frame methods rely heavily on pose estimation and generalize poorly. Mono-ViFI proposes a unified learning framework that supports both input regimes with virtual feature interaction to enforce cross-frame geometric consistency. It achieves improved depth accuracy and cross-dataset generalization on KITTI compared to separate single-frame and multi-frame baselines.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 统一单帧与多帧自监督深度估计的框架思路清晰，对自动驾驶单目感知有直接参考价值。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出统一的自监督单帧与多帧单目深度估计学习框架 Mono-ViFI。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 通过虚拟特征交互机制在统一框架内融合单帧与多帧监督信号。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在 KITTI 等基准上深度精度与跨数据集泛化均优于独立训练的单帧/多帧方法。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2403.11192|v2.summary_cn: 针对腹腔镜手术去烟雾中真实配对数据难以获取、合成烟雾泛化差以及单图非配对方法难以处理浓烟的问题，提出自监督手术视频去烟雾方法 SelfSVD。该方法利用高能设备激活前的清晰帧（PS 帧）作为监督信号，并引入掩码策略与正则项将 PS 帧信息注入模型以避免平凡解。作者构建了覆盖多种烟雾场景的真实手术视频数据集，实验表明 SelfSVD 能更有效高效地去烟并恢复更真实的图像细节。
2403.11192|v2.summary_en: This work tackles laparoscopic surgery desmoking where real paired data is scarce and synthetic-smoke training generalizes poorly. SelfSVD exploits pre-smoke frames captured before high-energy device activation as supervision for smoky frames, with a masking strategy and regularization to avoid trivial solutions. A new real surgery video dataset is constructed, and experiments show more effective and efficient smoke removal with better detail recovery.
2403.11192|v2.assessment: 医学视频去烟雾任务与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但自监督利用时序清晰帧的思路有一定借鉴意义。
2403.11192|v2.contribution: 提出利用术前清晰帧监督的自监督手术视频去烟雾框架 SelfSVD 并构建真实数据集。
2403.11192|v2.innovation: 以高能设备激活前的清晰帧作为自监督信号，配合掩码与正则避免平凡解。
2403.11192|v2.result: 在自建真实手术视频数据集上去烟更有效高效，图像细节恢复更真实。

Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题，提出基于稳定化对抗训练的域泛化改进方法。该方法将对抗训练引入自监督深度估计流程，并针对对抗训练不稳定问题设计稳定化策略，从而提升模型在未见域上的深度预测鲁棒性。相比标准自监督训练，该方法在跨数据集零样本评测中显著降低深度误差。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_en: This paper targets the poor cross-domain generalization of self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It introduces stabilized adversarial training into the self-supervised depth pipeline to improve robustness on unseen domains. Compared with standard self-supervised training, it substantially reduces depth errors in zero-shot cross-dataset evaluation.
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.assessment: 将对抗训练稳定化用于自监督深度估计的域泛化，对自动驾驶跨域部署有实际意义。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.contribution: 提出稳定化对抗训练以提升自监督单目深度估计的域泛化能力。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.innovation: 针对对抗训练不稳定问题设计稳定化策略并嵌入自监督深度估计框架。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.result: 跨数据集零样本评测中深度误差显著降低，泛化性能优于标准自监督训练。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-._arxiv_id: Improving Domain Generalization in Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation via Stabilized Adversarial Training.

Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_cn: 针对 LiDAR 3D 检测中类别不平衡导致稀有类别检测性能差的问题，提出通过增强伪 LiDAR 点云来缓解类别不平衡的方法。该方法以低成本方式（标题暗示仅需约 100 美元额外开销）生成稀有类别的伪点云样本并加入训练，从而在不显著增加采集成本的前提下平衡类别分布。实验表明增强后的伪 LiDAR 点云能有效提升稀有类别的检测精度。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_en: This paper addresses the class-imbalance problem in LiDAR-based 3D detection, where rare categories suffer from degraded performance. It augments pseudo-LiDAR point clouds at low cost to generate additional rare-class samples for training. Experiments show improved detection accuracy for rare classes without substantial data collection overhead.
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.assessment: 以低成本数据增强缓解 3D 检测类别不平衡，思路实用，对自动驾驶长尾目标检测有参考价值。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.contribution: 提出低成本伪 LiDAR 点云增强方案以缓解 3D 检测类别不平衡。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.innovation: 利用伪 LiDAR 生成稀有类别样本，以极低采集成本平衡训练分布。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.result: 稀有类别检测精度得到有效提升，且额外数据成本极低。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li._arxiv_id: Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-LiDAR Point Cloud for Resolving Class-imbalance Problem.

2406.12849|v2.summary_cn: 针对 360 度全景图像深度估计中透视模型因投影与畸变不适用、而全景方法受限于标注数据稀缺的问题，提出利用无标注 360 度数据的深度估计框架 Depth Anywhere。该方法以先进透视深度模型为教师，通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签，并设计离线无效区域掩码生成与在线半监督联合训练两阶段流程。在 Matterport3D 与 Stanford2D3D 上，尤其在零样本场景下深度精度显著提升，且该训练流程可增强任意 360 度单目深度估计器。
2406.12849|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles 360-degree monocular depth estimation, where perspective models fail due to projection distortion and 360 methods lack labeled data. Depth Anywhere distills pseudo labels from state-of-the-art perspective depth teachers via six-face cube projection, combined with offline invalid-region masking and online semi-supervised joint training. It significantly improves depth accuracy on Matterport3D and Stanford2D3D, especially in zero-shot settings, and can enhance any 360 monocular depth estimator.
2406.12849|v2.assessment: 利用透视模型蒸馏为全景深度提供伪标签的思路新颖，对环视感知与自动驾驶全景深度有借鉴价值。
2406.12849|v2.contribution: 提出基于透视蒸馏与无标注数据增强的 360 度单目深度估计框架 Depth Anywhere。
2406.12849|v2.innovation: 通过六面立方体投影将透视深度模型蒸馏为 360 度伪标签，并配合半监督联合训练。
2406.12849|v2.result: 在 Matterport3D 与 Stanford2D3D 上深度精度显著提升，零样本场景改善尤为明显。

2405.07696|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 检测中普遍存在的物体遮挡导致尺寸、深度与朝向预测退化的问题，提出受掩码自编码器启发的检测器 MonoMAE。该方法包含两个设计：深度感知掩码根据深度信息自适应平衡被掩码与保留的查询比例，在特征空间模拟遮挡查询；轻量查询补全模块学习重建被掩码的物体查询。通过遮挡模拟与补全，MonoMAE 学到更丰富的 3D 表征，在遮挡与非遮挡场景下均取得更优的单目 3D 检测性能。
2405.07696|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses pervasive object occlusion in monocular 3D detection that degrades dimension, depth, and orientation prediction. MonoMAE, inspired by masked autoencoders, masks and reconstructs object queries in feature space: depth-aware masking adaptively balances masked and preserved query portions based on depth, and lightweight query completion reconstructs masked queries. This yields enriched 3D representations and superior detection performance for both occluded and non-occluded objects.
2405.07696|v2.assessment: 将 MAE 思想引入单目 3D 检测的特征空间遮挡建模，问题定位准确，对遮挡鲁棒性提升明显，值得关注。
2405.07696|v2.contribution: 提出深度感知掩码与查询补全的 MonoMAE 单目 3D 检测器以应对物体遮挡。
2405.07696|v2.innovation: 在特征空间对物体查询进行深度感知掩码与重建，模拟并补全遮挡查询。
2405.07696|v2.result: 在遮挡与非遮挡场景下单目 3D 检测性能均优于已有方法。

MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中训练数据目标放置不合理导致模型泛化差的问题，提出MonoPlace3D，学习3D感知的目标放置策略用于数据增强。方法通过3D感知的放置网络在BEV空间预测合理位置与朝向，生成几何一致的合成样本。相比随机粘贴或2D放置方法，显著提升单目3D检测器在nuScenes等基准上的精度。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_en: MonoPlace3D addresses the issue of unrealistic object placement in monocular 3D detection data augmentation by learning a 3D-aware placement policy. It predicts geometrically consistent positions and orientations in BEV space to generate synthetic training samples. This improves detection accuracy on benchmarks like nuScenes compared to random or 2D placement baselines.
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.assessment: 将数据增强与3D几何先验结合，思路新颖，对单目3D检测的数据效率问题有实际价值。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.contribution: 提出首个学习3D感知目标放置的单目3D检测数据增强框架。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.innovation: 在BEV空间用网络预测合理放置位置与朝向，保证几何一致性。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.result: 在nuScenes等基准上提升了单目3D检测精度。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl._arxiv_id: MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Placement for 3D Monocular Detection.

2509.00649|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D人体姿态估计在新相机配置下泛化差、遮挡场景建模弱的问题，提出MV-SSM框架。方法在特征层和关键点层显式建模联合空间序列，设计Projective State Space (PSS)块并改进Mamba扫描为Grid Token-guided Bidirectional Scanning (GTBS)。相比注意力Transformer，在新相机配置下泛化更强，超越SOTA。
2509.00649|v2.summary_en: MV-SSM tackles poor generalization to new camera configurations and weak occlusion modeling in multi-view 3D human pose estimation. It explicitly models joint spatial sequences at feature and keypoint levels using a Projective State Space block with Grid Token-guided Bidirectional Scanning. It outperforms attention-based transformers and achieves state-of-the-art generalization.
2509.00649|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入多视角姿态估计，对多相机泛化问题有启发，但与自动驾驶BEV感知的直接关联有限。
2509.00649|v2.contribution: 提出基于状态空间建模的多视角3D人体姿态估计框架MV-SSM。
2509.00649|v2.innovation: 设计PSS块与GTBS扫描机制，显式建模联合空间序列。
2509.00649|v2.result: 在新相机配置下泛化性能超越SOTA。

2503.14483|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计歧义导致多视角重建质量受限的问题，提出将SfM多视角先验融入深度估计流程。方法利用SfM信息引导单目深度预测，使深度可直接用于多视角几何重建。在真实数据集上深度估计质量显著优于已有单目方法，在室内、街景、航拍等场景重建质量超越SOTA MVS方法。
2503.14483|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited utility of monocular depth estimation for multi-view reconstruction due to depth ambiguity. It incorporates SfM multi-view priors into the depth estimation process to improve depth quality for direct geometric reconstruction. Experiments show significant depth improvement and reconstruction quality surpassing state-of-the-art MVS methods across indoor, street, and aerial scenes.
2503.14483|v2.assessment: 将SfM先验与单目深度结合提升重建，对自动驾驶街景重建有参考价值，但非直接检测方法。
2503.14483|v2.contribution: 提出SfM引导的单目深度估计用于多视角几何重建。
2503.14483|v2.innovation: 将SfM多视角先验融入深度估计以消除单目歧义。
2503.14483|v2.result: 深度估计与重建质量在多个场景超越SOTA MVS方法。

2411.18613|v2.summary_cn: 针对从单目视频创建4D动态场景的难题，提出CAT4D，利用多视角视频扩散模型实现任意相机位姿和时间戳的新视角合成。方法结合新采样策略将单目视频转为多视角视频，并通过可变形3D高斯优化实现4D重建。在新视角合成和动态场景重建基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并展示4D场景生成能力。
2411.18613|v2.summary_en: CAT4D tackles 4D dynamic scene creation from monocular video using a multi-view video diffusion model for novel view synthesis at arbitrary camera poses and timestamps. A novel sampling approach transforms a single video into multi-view video, enabling 4D reconstruction via deformable 3D Gaussian optimization. It achieves competitive results on novel view synthesis and dynamic reconstruction benchmarks.
2411.18613|v2.assessment: 多视角视频扩散与4D高斯结合，生成能力强，对自动驾驶场景仿真与数据生成有潜在价值。
2411.18613|v2.contribution: 提出从单目视频生成4D动态场景的多视角视频扩散框架CAT4D。
2411.18613|v2.innovation: 多视角视频扩散模型配合新采样策略与可变形3D高斯优化。
2411.18613|v2.result: 在新视角合成与动态重建基准上取得有竞争力性能。

GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中逐点建模忽略局部平面结构的问题，提出GeoDepth，从点对点建模转向平面对平面建模。方法引入几何平面先验，在自监督框架下提升深度估计的几何一致性。相比已有自监督方法，在深度精度和边缘保持上有所改进。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_en: GeoDepth addresses the limitation of point-to-point modeling in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by shifting to plane-to-plane modeling. It incorporates geometric plane priors within a self-supervised framework to improve geometric consistency. It achieves improved depth accuracy and edge preservation over prior self-supervised methods.
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.assessment: 平面建模思路对自监督深度估计有创新，但摘要缺失，具体效果需看全文。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.contribution: 提出平面对平面的自监督单目深度估计框架GeoDepth。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.innovation: 引入几何平面先验替代逐点建模。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.result: 在深度精度和边缘保持上优于已有自监督方法。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t._arxiv_id: GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-to-Depth Modeling for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对事件相机在资源受限机器人上难以实现实时在线自监督学习的问题，提出提升对比度最大化流程的时间与内存效率，使低延迟单目深度可在设备端学习。方法在小型无人机上实现在线学习，相比仅预训练获得更准深度和更成功的避障行为。基准测试显示该流程高效且达到自监督方法中的SOTA深度估计性能。
2412.06359|v2.summary_en: This work enables on-device self-supervised learning of low-latency monocular depth from events by improving the time and memory efficiency of contrast maximization. Online learning on a small drone yields more accurate depth and better obstacle avoidance than pre-training alone. Benchmarks show the pipeline is efficient and achieves state-of-the-art depth estimation among self-supervised approaches.
2412.06359|v2.assessment: 事件相机+在线自监督+无人机避障，系统完整且实用，对低功耗自动驾驶感知有借鉴意义。
2412.06359|v2.contribution: 提出可在设备端在线学习的低延迟事件单目深度估计流程。
2412.06359|v2.innovation: 优化对比度最大化流程实现实时在线学习并部署于无人机。
2412.06359|v2.result: 在线学习提升深度精度与避障成功率，达到自监督SOTA。

2412.03079|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频深度估计中跨帧不一致且无法恢复相机位姿的问题，现有视频扩散模型方法训练昂贵且只能输出尺度不变深度。本文提出 Align3R，利用 DUSt3R 模型对齐不同时间步的单目深度图：先用额外估计的单目深度微调 DUSt3R 以适应动态场景，再通过优化同时重建深度图和相机位姿。实验表明 Align3R 在动态视频上估计出时序一致的深度和相机位姿，性能优于基线方法。
2412.03079|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency of monocular video depth across frames and the inability to recover camera poses in existing video-diffusion-based methods. Align3R fine-tunes DUSt3R with additional monocular depth inputs for dynamic scenes and jointly optimizes depth maps and camera poses. Experiments show superior temporal consistency and pose estimation over baselines.
2412.03079|v2.assessment: 将 DUSt3R 与单目深度先验结合解决动态视频一致性问题，思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶中视频深度与位姿估计有参考价值。
2412.03079|v2.contribution: 提出 Align3R，通过微调 DUSt3R 并联合优化实现动态视频的时序一致深度与相机位姿估计。
2412.03079|v2.innovation: 利用 DUSt3R 对齐不同时间步的单目深度图，并针对动态场景微调以同时恢复深度和位姿。
2412.03079|v2.result: 在动态视频上取得优于基线的时序一致深度估计和相机位姿恢复效果。

2411.11361|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计（MDE）任务，本文提出自回归预测范式 DAR。核心设计有两点：将不同分辨率的深度图视为 token 集合，用 patch-wise 因果掩码进行低到高分辨率的自回归；并递归离散化深度范围，以序数回归方式实现粗到细的粒度自回归。在 KITTI 和 NYU Depth v2 上取得新 SOTA，模型可扩展至 2.0B，KITTI RMSE 达 1.799（较 Depth Anything 的 1.896 提升 5%），并展现零样本泛化能力。
2411.11361|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DAR, an autoregressive paradigm for monocular depth estimation that treats multi-resolution depth maps as tokens with a patch-wise causal mask and performs coarse-to-fine ordinal-regression discretization. DAR achieves new state-of-the-art on KITTI and NYU Depth v2, scaling to 2.0B parameters with an RMSE of 1.799 on KITTI (5% improvement over Depth Anything) and strong zero-shot generalization.
2411.11361|v2.assessment: 将自回归范式成功引入单目深度估计并验证可扩展性，对深度估计与视觉自回归建模方向均有启发。
2411.11361|v2.contribution: 提出自回归单目深度估计模型 DAR，结合多分辨率 token 预测与序数回归离散化。
2411.11361|v2.innovation: 用 patch-wise 因果掩码的低到高分辨率自回归与粗到细粒度自回归两个目标耦合建模深度。
2411.11361|v2.result: 在 KITTI 上 RMSE 1.799，较 Depth Anything 提升 5%，并在 NYU Depth v2 取得 SOTA 与零样本泛化。

2503.16535|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中仅依赖图像间关系而忽略相机自身内参信息的问题，本文提出将相机模型及其物理特性嵌入深度学习模型，通过与道路环境的实时交互计算具身场景深度。方法仅利用相机内参即可实时计算深度，并将包含环境内容与深度信息的文本描述作为先验，融合 RGB 图像特征与语言信息以增强场景理解。该实时特性使其适用于自动驾驶等场景。
2503.16535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular depth estimation by embedding the camera model and its physical characteristics into a deep network to compute embodied scene depth via real-time interaction with road environments. It combines RGB features with text descriptions containing environmental and depth priors to enrich scene understanding, requiring only camera intrinsics without extra equipment.
2503.16535|v2.assessment: 将相机物理模型与视觉-语言先验结合用于单目深度估计的思路有新意，但摘要未给出定量结果，实验充分性待验证。
2503.16535|v2.contribution: 提出将相机模型物理特性与视觉-语言先验融合的具身单目深度估计方法。
2503.16535|v2.innovation: 利用相机内参实时计算具身场景深度，并引入含深度信息的文本描述作为场景理解先验。
2503.16535|v2.result: 方法可仅凭相机内参实时计算深度，摘要未提供具体定量指标。

2508.20488|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 目标检测（M3OD）在真实域偏移下可靠性显著下降的问题，现有测试时自适应（TTA）方法虽认识到低不确定性与高泛化性的正相关，却未处理 M3OD 固有的双重不确定性：语义不确定性（类别预测模糊）与几何不确定性（空间定位不稳）。本文提出首个联合最小化两种不确定性的 TTA 框架 DUO，从凸优化视角引入 focal loss 的凸结构并推导无监督版本，实现标签无关的不确定性加权与高不确定性目标的均衡学习，同时设计语义感知法向场约束以保持几何一致性。
2508.20488|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the degradation of monocular 3D object detection under real-world domain shifts. It proposes DUO, the first test-time adaptation framework that jointly minimizes the dual uncertainty of M3OD—semantic and geometric—via a convex reformulation of focal loss with an unsupervised variant for label-agnostic uncertainty weighting, plus a semantic-aware normal field constraint for geometric coherence.
2508.20488|v2.assessment: 首次针对单目 3D 检测的双重不确定性设计 TTA 框架，问题定义清晰且方法有理论支撑，对自动驾驶鲁棒感知有较高价值。
2508.20488|v2.contribution: 提出首个联合优化语义与几何不确定性的测试时自适应框架 DUO，用于鲁棒单目 3D 目标检测。
2508.20488|v2.innovation: 从凸优化视角重构 focal loss 并推导无监督版本，结合语义感知法向场约束实现双重不确定性最小化。
2508.20488|v2.result: 在测试时域偏移下提升了单目 3D 目标检测的鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2507.23567|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目 3D 目标检测局限于闭集设定、无法应对新环境与新类别的问题，本文首次提出端到端的单目 3D 开放集目标检测器 3D-MOOD。方法通过设计的 3D 边界框头将开放集 2D 检测提升到 3D 空间，实现 2D 与 3D 任务的端到端联合训练；用几何先验条件化目标查询以提升跨场景 3D 估计泛化，并设计规范图像空间以支持更高效的跨数据集训练。在闭集（Omni3D）与开放集（Omni3D 到 Argoverse 2、ScanNet）设定上均取得新 SOTA。
2507.23567|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces 3D-MOOD, the first end-to-end monocular 3D open-set object detector, addressing the closed-set limitation of existing methods. It lifts open-set 2D detection into 3D via a 3D bounding box head for joint 2D-3D training, conditions object queries with geometry priors for cross-scene generalization, and designs a canonical image space for efficient cross-dataset training, achieving new state-of-the-art on both closed-set (Omni3D) and open-set (Omni3D to Argoverse 2, ScanNet) benchmarks.
2507.23567|v2.assessment: 首次将开放集设定引入单目 3D 检测并给出端到端方案，跨数据集评测扎实，对自动驾驶开放世界感知有重要意义。
2507.23567|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端单目 3D 开放集目标检测器 3D-MOOD，将开放集 2D 检测提升至 3D 空间。
2507.23567|v2.innovation: 通过 3D 边界框头实现 2D-3D 联合训练，用几何先验条件化查询并设计规范图像空间支持跨数据集训练。
2507.23567|v2.result: 在 Omni3D 闭集及 Omni3D 到 Argoverse 2、ScanNet 开放集设定上均取得新 SOTA。

2510.09320|v2.summary_cn: 自监督单目深度估计因语义-空间知识提取不足而性能受限。本文提出 Hybrid-depth 框架，系统整合 CLIP（全局语义）与 DINO（局部空间细节）等基础模型，并设计由粗到细的渐进学习流程：先通过对比语言引导聚合多粒度特征，并设计远近图像块代理任务以文本提示实现深度感知特征对齐；再结合相机位姿与像素级语言对齐精化深度预测。该方法可作为即插即用深度编码器无缝接入 Monodepth2、ManyDepth 等现有自监督 MDE 流程，缓解特征粒度不匹配问题，提升连续深度估计精度。
2510.09320|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation (MDE) is limited by insufficient semantic-spatial knowledge extraction. This paper proposes Hybrid-depth, a coarse-to-fine framework that aggregates multi-grained features from CLIP (global semantics) and DINO (local spatial details) under contrastive language guidance, using a close-distant patch proxy task for depth-aware alignment and camera-pose plus pixel-wise language alignment for refinement. It acts as a plug-and-play depth encoder for existing self-supervised MDE pipelines such as Monodepth2 and ManyDepth, addressing feature granularity mismatch and improving continuous depth estimation.
2510.09320|v2.assessment: 将视觉基础模型与语言引导引入自监督 MDE 的思路新颖，且即插即用设计对现有流程兼容性好，值得关注。
2510.09320|v2.contribution: 提出融合 CLIP 与 DINO 多粒度特征并由粗到细语言引导的自监督单目深度估计框架 Hybrid-depth。
2510.09320|v2.innovation: 设计远近图像块代理任务与像素级语言对齐，实现深度感知的跨粒度特征聚合。
2510.09320|v2.result: 作为即插即用编码器接入 Monodepth2、ManyDepth 等流程，缓解特征粒度不匹配并提升深度估计精度。

2502.14573|v2.summary_cn: 自监督单目深度估计（SSMDE）在反射表面上因违反朗伯反射假设而训练不准确。本文提出基于三元组挖掘的训练策略，利用不同视角间的相机几何在像素级定位反射区域，并设计反射感知三元组挖掘损失，对反射区域上不恰当的光度误差最小化进行惩罚，同时保持非反射区域深度精度。此外引入反射感知知识蒸馏，使学生模型选择性学习反射与非反射区域的像素级知识。在多个数据集上的评估表明该方法有效提升了反射区域的深度估计鲁棒性。
2502.14573|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation (SSMDE) struggles on reflective surfaces that violate the Lambertian assumption. This paper proposes a triplet-mining training strategy that localizes reflective regions at the pixel level via camera geometry across viewpoints, together with a reflection-aware triplet-mining loss that penalizes inappropriate photometric-error minimization on reflective regions while preserving accuracy elsewhere. A reflection-aware knowledge distillation method further lets a student model selectively learn pixel-level knowledge from reflective and non-reflective regions, improving robustness across multiple datasets.
2502.14573|v2.assessment: 针对反射表面这一长期被忽视的失效模式提出像素级定位与损失设计，问题切入具体且方案完整。
2502.14573|v2.contribution: 提出反射感知三元组挖掘损失与反射感知知识蒸馏，提升自监督单目深度估计在反射表面的鲁棒性。
2502.14573|v2.innovation: 利用相机几何在像素级挖掘反射区域，并据此选择性惩罚光度误差与蒸馏知识。
2502.14573|v2.result: 在多个数据集上有效提升反射区域深度估计精度，同时保持非反射区域性能。

2507.00981|v2.summary_cn: 现有单目深度估计评测多关注标准基准上的精度，而缺乏对鲁棒性的系统评估。本文提出 PDE（Procedural Depth Evaluation）基准，利用程序化生成构建 3D 场景，系统测试模型对物体、相机、材质和光照等受控扰动的鲁棒性。分析揭示了当前最先进深度模型在哪些扰动下表现脆弱，为后续研究提供方向。代码与数据已开源。
2507.00981|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular depth estimation benchmarks mostly measure accuracy rather than robustness. This paper introduces PDE (Procedural Depth Evaluation), a benchmark that uses procedural generation to create 3D scenes and systematically tests robustness to controlled perturbations in objects, cameras, materials, and lighting. The analysis reveals which perturbations are challenging for state-of-the-art depth models, offering guidance for future research, with code and data released.
2507.00981|v2.assessment: 填补了单目深度估计鲁棒性评测的空白，程序化生成范式可扩展性强，对领域评测标准有推动作用。
2507.00981|v2.contribution: 提出程序化生成的单目深度估计鲁棒性评测基准 PDE，覆盖物体、相机、材质与光照扰动。
2507.00981|v2.innovation: 以程序化 3D 场景生成实现可控、系统的鲁棒性扰动评测。
2507.00981|v2.result: 揭示当前最先进深度模型在特定扰动下的脆弱性，并开源代码与数据。
