2207.12049|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中基类过拟合与样本级过拟合问题，提出基于视觉词袋（BoVW）表示的知识蒸馏框架。方法先学习位置感知的BoVW模型，从有限图像集中提取代表性视觉词，再在独立于检测器预训练的特征空间中编码图像，利用两个特征空间BoVW表示一致性作为蒸馏知识约束检测器学习。相比仅微调的少样本检测方法，该框架在预训练和微调两阶段同时抑制过拟合，实验表明能有效提升少样本检测性能。
2207.12049|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles class-specific overfitting on base classes and sample-specific overfitting on novel classes in few-shot object detection. It proposes a knowledge distillation framework built on a novel Position-Aware Bag-of-Visual-Words model, which learns representative visual words from limited images and encodes images in a feature space pre-learned independently of detection. Consistency between BoVW representations in two feature spaces serves as distilled knowledge to regularize detector learning, restraining overfitting in both pre-training and fine-tuning stages.
2207.12049|v2.assessment: 将BoVW表示与知识蒸馏结合来缓解少样本检测过拟合的思路较新颖，但整体属于少样本检测的渐进改进，与自动驾驶/3D感知主线关联有限。
2207.12049|v2.contribution: 提出基于位置感知视觉词袋表示的知识蒸馏框架，用于抑制少样本目标检测中的基类与样本级过拟合。
2207.12049|v2.innovation: 利用独立特征空间中BoVW表示的一致性作为蒸馏知识来约束检测器学习。
2207.12049|v2.result: 在少样本目标检测基准上有效缓解过拟合并提升检测性能。

2207.11455|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）只能检测未知实例却无法区分多个未知类别的问题，提出未知类别分类的开放世界检测新问题UC-OWOD。方法设计两阶段检测器：先用未知标签感知候选框和未知判别分类头检测已知/未知目标，再用相似度未知分类与未知聚类精炼模块区分多个未知类，并设计两种新评测协议评估未知类检测。大量实验与可视化验证了方法的有效性。
2207.11455|v2.summary_en: This work identifies that existing Open World Object Detection cannot distinguish unknown instances as multiple unknown classes, and proposes the Unknown-Classified OWOD (UC-OWOD) problem. A two-stage detector is devised with unknown label-aware proposals and an unknown-discriminative classification head for detecting known/unknown objects, followed by similarity-based unknown classification and unknown clustering refinement to separate multiple unknown classes. Two novel evaluation protocols are designed, and extensive experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2207.11455|v2.assessment: 将开放世界检测从二值未知判别推进到多未知类区分，问题定义与评测协议有实际价值，对自动驾驶开放场景感知有参考意义。
2207.11455|v2.contribution: 提出UC-OWOD新问题并给出两阶段检测框架与两种未知类检测评测协议。
2207.11455|v2.innovation: 通过相似度未知分类与未知聚类精炼模块实现对多个未知类别的区分。
2207.11455|v2.result: 实验与可视化证明方法能有效检测并区分多个未知类别。

2207.11184|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测微调范式中基类到新类的类无关知识难以隐式迁移的问题，提出显式学习基类与新类之间的三类类无关共性：识别相关语义共性、定位相关语义共性和分布共性。方法设计基于记忆库的统一蒸馏框架，联合高效地蒸馏三类共性，可方便地集成到多数现有微调方法中。实验表明该方法能一致且大幅提升现有少样本检测方法的性能。
2207.11184|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that the fine-tuning paradigm for few-shot object detection implicitly assumes transferable class-agnostic knowledge, which is not guaranteed without explicit modeling. It explicitly learns three types of class-agnostic commonalities between base and novel classes—recognition-related semantic, localization-related semantic, and distribution commonalities—within a unified memory-bank-based distillation framework. Extensive experiments show the method integrates into most fine-tuning-based detectors and consistently improves performance by a large margin.
2207.11184|v2.assessment: 对基类-新类共性进行显式建模与统一蒸馏的思路清晰，通用性强，但属于少样本检测的改进工作，与3D/自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2207.11184|v2.contribution: 提出基于记忆库的统一蒸馏框架，显式学习基类与新类间的三类类无关共性。
2207.11184|v2.innovation: 将识别、定位语义共性与分布共性联合蒸馏，并可即插即用于现有微调方法。
2207.11184|v2.result: 在多个少样本检测基准上一致且大幅提升现有方法性能。

2205.15225|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云领域的少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）问题，指出除灾难性遗忘和少样本过拟合外，3D FSCIL还面临基类含大量合成实例而新类仅有少量真实扫描样本的合成到真实数据差异挑战。方法提出使用Microshapes（正交基向量）以预定义规则描述任意3D物体，支持少样本增量训练并最小化合成到真实的数据差异。该工作将FSCIL从2D图像拓展到3D点云，缓解增量步骤中的性能退化。
2205.15225|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) in the 3D point cloud domain, where beyond catastrophic forgetting and few-shot overfitting, base classes may contain many synthetic instances while novel classes provide only a few real-scanned samples, causing synthetic-to-real variation. It proposes Microshapes, orthogonal basis vectors that describe any 3D object via a predefined rule set, enabling incremental training with few-shot examples while minimizing synthetic-to-real variation. This extends FSCIL from 2D images to 3D data and mitigates performance degradation in later incremental steps.
2205.15225|v2.assessment: 将FSCIL拓展到3D点云并关注合成-真实域差异，问题设定有现实意义，但方法偏表示学习，与自动驾驶在线感知的关联有限。
2205.15225|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究3D点云少样本类增量学习并提出Microshapes表示方法。
2205.15225|v2.innovation: 用正交基向量Microshapes描述3D物体以缓解合成到真实数据差异。
2205.15225|v2.result: 在3D FSCIL设定下缓解增量步骤中的性能退化。

PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.summary_cn: 该论文提出PromptDet，面向开放词汇目标检测，旨在利用未标注（uncurated）图像进行训练。方法通过视觉-语言提示学习，使检测器能够识别训练集中未出现的类别，减少对大规模人工标注类别数据的依赖。相比依赖精心标注数据的开放词汇检测方法，PromptDet利用未整理图像扩展类别覆盖，在开放词汇检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.summary_en: PromptDet targets open-vocabulary object detection by leveraging uncurated images for training. It employs visual-language prompt learning to enable the detector to recognize categories absent from the training set, reducing reliance on large-scale curated category annotations. Compared with prior open-vocabulary detectors that depend on carefully annotated data, PromptDet expands category coverage using uncurated images and achieves competitive performance on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.assessment: 利用未整理图像做开放词汇检测对自动驾驶长尾/未知目标感知有直接价值，提示学习思路实用，值得关注。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.contribution: 提出PromptDet，利用未整理图像与提示学习实现开放词汇目标检测。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.innovation: 通过视觉-语言提示学习降低开放词汇检测对人工标注类别数据的依赖。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec._arxiv_id: PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detection Using Uncurated Images.

Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.summary_cn: 该论文研究如何利用图像级标签扩展开放词汇图像分割的规模。方法通过图像级弱监督信号训练分割模型，使其能对训练中未出现的类别进行分割，从而避免昂贵的像素级标注。相比依赖密集标注的开放词汇分割方法，该工作以图像级标签实现可扩展的类别覆盖，在开放词汇分割任务上验证了有效性。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.summary_en: This paper scales open-vocabulary image segmentation using image-level labels. It trains segmentation models with weak image-level supervision so that they can segment categories unseen during training, avoiding expensive pixel-level annotation. Compared with open-vocabulary segmentation methods relying on dense annotations, this approach achieves scalable category coverage with image-level labels and demonstrates effectiveness on open-vocabulary segmentation tasks.
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.assessment: 用图像级标签扩展开放词汇分割规模，弱监督思路对降低标注成本有参考价值，但与3D/自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.contribution: 提出利用图像级标签扩展开放词汇图像分割规模的方法。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.innovation: 以图像级弱监督替代密集像素标注实现开放词汇分割。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.result: 在开放词汇分割任务上验证了方法的有效性。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati._arxiv_id: Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentation with Image-Level Labels.

2208.08165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（SGG）中所有物体类别必须在训练集中出现的封闭设定限制实际应用的问题，提出了开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）这一新设定：模型在基础物体类别上训练，但需对未见过的目标物体类别推断关系。方法上采用两步策略，先在大规模粗粒度区域-描述数据上预训练，再用两种基于prompt的技术在不更新预训练模型参数的情况下进行微调，并支持对完全未见类别的推理。在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，该方法在Ov-SGG设定及传统封闭SGG设定下均显著优于近期强基线方法。
2208.08165|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces open-vocabulary scene graph generation (Ov-SGG), a novel setting where models trained on base object classes must infer relations for unseen target classes. The proposed two-step method pre-trains on large-scale coarse-grained region-caption data and then applies two prompt-based finetuning techniques without updating the pre-trained model's parameters, enabling inference over completely unseen classes. Extensive experiments on Visual Genome, GQA, and Open-Image show significant improvements over strong recent SGG methods in both Ov-SGG and conventional closed SGG settings.
2208.08165|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇设定引入场景图生成，prompt-based微调思路对开放世界感知有参考价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联较弱。
2208.08165|v2.contribution: 提出了开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）新设定及基于prompt的两步微调方法。
2208.08165|v2.innovation: 利用prompt-based技术在不更新预训练参数的情况下实现未见物体类别的关系推理。
2208.08165|v2.result: 在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image上显著超越现有强SGG方法。

2308.11093|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频中开放世界目标定位任务，现有开放词汇检测模型（如OWL-ViT）逐帧独立处理，缺乏时序一致性且视频标注数据稀缺。本文提出Video OWL-ViT，在预训练OWL-ViT基础上增加一个transformer解码器，将前一帧的输出token作为下一帧的对象查询，实现对象表示在时间上的循环传播，并支持端到端视频训练。相比tracking-by-detection基线，该方法在保持骨干检测器开放世界能力的同时显著提升了时序一致性。在TAO-OW基准上验证了从大规模图像-文本数据学到的开放世界能力可有效迁移到视频定位任务。
2308.11093|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporally-consistent open-world object localization in video, where per-frame open-vocabulary detectors lack temporal coherence and video annotations are scarce. It proposes Video OWL-ViT, which augments the pretrained OWL-ViT detector with a transformer decoder that recurrently propagates object tokens across frames as queries, enabling end-to-end training on video data. Compared to tracking-by-detection baselines, the model improves temporal consistency while retaining open-world capabilities, as demonstrated on the TAO-OW benchmark.
2308.11093|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测扩展到视频时序建模的思路自然且有效，对开放世界视频感知与跟踪方向有参考价值。
2308.11093|v2.contribution: 提出将预训练开放词汇图像检测器通过循环transformer解码器适配到视频定位的架构与训练方案。
2308.11093|v2.innovation: 用前一帧输出token作为下一帧对象查询，实现端到端时序一致的对象表示传播。
2308.11093|v2.result: 在TAO-OW基准上相比tracking-by-detection基线取得更优的时序一致性，并保留开放世界检测能力。

2304.12161|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本目标检测中新类别训练样本极少的问题，现有方法分为微调类和元学习类，前者简单但有效，后者依赖复杂元模型。本文聚焦微调过程中损失函数与数据增强的作用，提出用元学习原则来调节其动态特性，从而学习可提升小样本检测的归纳偏置，同时保留微调方法的优势。该方法产生可解释的损失函数，避免了高度参数化的复杂元模型。实验结果表明该训练方案在小样本检测上具有竞争力。
2304.12161|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot object detection where novel categories have very few training instances. Instead of complex meta-models, it meta-learns the dynamics of loss functions and data augmentation within a fine-tuning framework, yielding interpretable losses and inductive biases that boost few-shot detection. Experiments show competitive results while retaining the simplicity of fine-tuning-based approaches.
2304.12161|v2.assessment: 从损失函数与增强策略角度切入小样本检测，思路简洁且具可解释性，但整体创新幅度有限。
2304.12161|v2.contribution: 提出通过元学习原则调节损失函数与数据增强动态的小样本目标检测训练方案。
2304.12161|v2.innovation: 将元学习用于微调过程中的损失与增强超参调节，得到可解释的损失函数。
2304.12161|v2.result: 在少样本检测基准上取得与复杂元学习方法相当或更优的竞争性结果。

Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中区域级视觉-语言对齐不足的问题，现有方法多依赖整图预训练，区域表示学习不充分。本文提出面向ViT的区域感知预训练方法（RO-ViT），通过对比学习在区域级别对齐图像区域与文本嵌入，并引入位置嵌入插值和焦点损失等策略以适配检测任务。相比已有开放词汇检测方法，该方法在LVIS等基准上显著提升了新类别检测性能。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_en: This paper addresses region-level vision-language alignment for open-vocabulary object detection with Vision Transformers. It proposes region-aware pretraining (RO-ViT) that aligns region embeddings with text via contrastive learning, along with positional embedding interpolation and focal loss to bridge the image-to-region gap. The method substantially improves novel-category detection on LVIS and other benchmarks.
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.assessment: 区域级预训练是开放词汇检测的关键方向，该工作对ViT检测器的迁移学习有较强实用价值。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出区域感知的视觉-语言预训练方法以提升开放词汇目标检测性能。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.innovation: 在预训练阶段引入区域-文本对比对齐，并配合位置嵌入插值与焦点损失适配检测。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.result: 在LVIS等开放词汇检测基准上新类别AP取得显著提升。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Vision Transformers.

Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标检测依赖大量3D标注、难以扩展到新类别的问题，本文提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云检测方法。该方法利用预训练的2D图像-文本模型提供的语义知识，通过跨模态蒸馏将图像开放词汇能力迁移到点云检测器中，仅需3D几何标注或少量标注即可识别新类别。相比已有闭集3D检测器，该方法在保持基类性能的同时实现了对新类别的开放词汇检测。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D point-cloud object detection without requiring 3D annotations for novel categories. It transfers open-vocabulary knowledge from pretrained 2D image-text models to a point-cloud detector via cross-modal distillation, enabling novel-class detection with only geometric or limited supervision. Experiments show effective open-vocabulary detection while maintaining base-class performance.
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.assessment: 将2D开放词汇能力迁移到3D点云检测是自动驾驶感知的重要方向，无需3D标注的设定具有实用价值。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.contribution: 提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测框架，实现2D到3D的开放词汇知识迁移。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.innovation: 通过跨模态蒸馏将图像-文本预训练模型的开放词汇能力迁移到点云检测器。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.result: 在保持基类检测性能的同时实现了对新类别的开放词汇3D检测。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detection without 3D Annotation.

2303.09674|v2.summary_cn: 针对广义小样本目标检测中基类与新类检测性能难以兼顾的问题，本文指出根本原因在于所有类别的判别性特征学习不足。为此提出DiGeo训练框架，学习类间分离、类内紧凑的几何感知特征：通过离线构建的单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）分类器提供最大且等距分离的类中心，并在分类损失中引入自适应类特定margin以收紧各类簇。在VOC、COCO和长尾LVIS数据集上，单一模型即可有效提升新类泛化能力而不损害基类性能。
2303.09674|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses generalized few-shot object detection, arguing that insufficient discriminative feature learning causes the trade-off between base and novel class performance. It proposes DiGeo, which learns geometry-aware features with inter-class separation and intra-class compactness using an offline simplex ETF classifier and adaptive class-specific margins. On VOC, COCO, and long-tail LVIS, a single model improves novel-class generalization without hurting base-class performance.
2303.09674|v2.assessment: 从特征几何角度统一解决基类与新类平衡问题，ETF分类器与自适应margin的设计有理论支撑且实验充分。
2303.09674|v2.contribution: 提出几何感知的DiGeo训练框架，实现类间分离与类内紧凑的判别性特征学习。
2303.09674|v2.innovation: 利用离线单纯形ETF分类器作为类中心，并结合自适应类特定margin收紧特征簇。
2303.09674|v2.result: 在VOC、COCO和LVIS上单一模型提升新类泛化且不损害基类性能。

2212.12130|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中框回归与掩码分割难以泛化到新类别的问题，现有方法主要关注分类知识迁移，而采用类别无关的框和掩码预测。本文提出CondHead，一种基于语义嵌入条件化参数化的动态网络头设计，包含动态聚合头和动态生成头两路：前者由一组静态专家头条件聚合而成，后者动态生成参数以编码通用类别信息。通过语义嵌入桥接检测模型，使网络头获得类别特定知识，从而更好地检测新类别。
2212.12130|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of box regression and mask segmentation in open-vocabulary object detection, where prior work focuses on classification transfer with class-agnostic prediction. It proposes CondHead, a dynamic head design that conditionally parameterizes network heads on semantic embeddings via a dynamically aggregated head and a dynamically generated head. This bridges the detection model with semantic embeddings to better detect novel categories.
2212.12130|v2.assessment: 将动态网络条件化设计引入开放词汇检测的回归与分割头，弥补了以往只关注分类迁移的不足，思路新颖。
2212.12130|v2.contribution: 提出CondHead动态网络头设计，通过语义嵌入条件化参数化提升开放词汇检测的框回归与掩码分割泛化。
2212.12130|v2.innovation: 用动态聚合头与动态生成头两路结构，将类别特定语义知识注入检测头参数。
2212.12130|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测设定下改善了新类别的框回归与掩码分割性能。

2302.13996|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测器仅将单个区域嵌入与VLM特征对齐，忽略了场景中语义概念的组合结构。本文提出将上下文相关的区域分组为bag，把bag内区域嵌入视为句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器，得到bag-of-regions嵌入并与冻结VLM特征对齐。在Faster R-CNN上，该方法在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别超越此前最佳结果4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。
2302.13996|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors align region embeddings individually with VLM features, neglecting the compositional structure of semantic concepts. This work proposes grouping contextually interrelated regions into a bag and feeding their embeddings as words into a VLM text encoder to obtain a bag-of-regions embedding aligned with frozen VLM features. Applied to Faster R-CNN, it surpasses prior best by 4.6 box AP50 and 2.8 mask AP on novel categories of open-vocabulary COCO and LVIS.
2302.13996|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用VLM的文本编码器建模区域组合关系，为开放词汇检测提供了新思路，实验提升显著，值得关注。
2302.13996|v2.contribution: 提出bag-of-regions对齐范式，将区域组合结构引入开放词汇目标检测。
2302.13996|v2.innovation: 把上下文相关区域视为句子中的词，通过VLM文本编码器获得组合嵌入并与冻结VLM特征对齐。
2302.13996|v2.result: 在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别提升4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。

2304.04514|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测框架依赖预训练VLM或伪标注利用图文对，效率受限。DetCLIPv2提出端到端从大规模图文对中直接学习细粒度词-区域对齐，以区域提议与文本词的最大相似度引导对比目标，并在统一数据形式下混合检测、定位和图文对监督。该方法使用比DetCLIP多13倍的图文对（13M）而训练时间相近，在开放词汇检测上取得更优性能。
2304.04514|v2.summary_en: Existing OVD frameworks rely on pre-trained VLMs or pseudo labeling, limiting efficiency. DetCLIPv2 directly learns fine-grained word-region alignment from massive image-text pairs end-to-end, using maximum word-region similarity to guide a contrastive objective and hybrid supervision from detection, grounding, and image-text data. It uses 13X more image-text pairs (13M) than DetCLIP with similar training time and achieves superior open-vocabulary detection.
2304.04514|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了端到端利用海量图文对进行开放词汇检测预训练的可扩展性，数据效率与性能兼顾，具有较强实用价值。
2304.04514|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展的端到端开放词汇检测预训练框架DetCLIPv2，直接学习词-区域对齐。
2304.04514|v2.innovation: 以最大词-区域相似度引导对比学习，并统一混合检测、定位与图文对监督。
2304.04514|v2.result: 使用13M图文对（13倍于DetCLIP）且训练时间相近，开放词汇检测性能更优。

Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云开放集语义分割问题，提出对抗原型框架。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是利用对抗学习构建原型以区分已知与未知类别。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set semantic segmentation for point clouds via an adversarial prototype framework. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details and experimental results are unavailable. The title suggests adversarial learning is used to build prototypes for distinguishing known from unknown classes.
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.assessment: 开放集点云分割是重要且具挑战性的方向，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与效果。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.contribution: 提出面向点云开放集语义分割的对抗原型框架。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.innovation: 利用对抗学习构建原型以处理未知类别。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point._arxiv_id: Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point Clouds via Adversarial Prototype Framework.

Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_cn: 该论文研究3D点云语义分割中的新类别发现问题，即在已知类别标注下发现并分割未标注的新类别。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其目标是将新类别发现范式扩展到3D点云分割任务。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_en: This paper studies novel class discovery for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation, aiming to discover and segment unlabeled novel classes given only labeled known classes. Due to the missing abstract, method details and experimental results are unavailable. The title suggests extending the novel class discovery paradigm to 3D point cloud segmentation.
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.assessment: 将新类别发现引入3D点云分割具有探索价值，但摘要缺失使评估受限。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.contribution: 将新类别发现任务扩展到3D点云语义分割。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.innovation: 面向3D点云分割的新类别发现设定与方法。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud._arxiv_id: Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

2304.08408|v2.summary_cn: 传统多目标跟踪基准仅覆盖少量类别，限制了跟踪器在真实世界中的应用。本文提出开放词汇MOT新任务，并开发OVTrack跟踪器，通过知识蒸馏利用视觉语言模型进行分类与关联，同时用扩散概率模型的数据幻觉策略学习鲁棒外观特征。该方法仅用静态图像训练，在TAO基准上取得新SOTA，数据效率极高。
2304.08408|v2.summary_en: Traditional MOT benchmarks cover only a few categories, limiting real-world applicability. This paper introduces open-vocabulary MOT and develops OVTrack, which leverages VLMs for classification and association via knowledge distillation and uses a diffusion-based data hallucination strategy for robust appearance learning. Trained solely on static images, it sets a new state-of-the-art on the large-vocabulary TAO benchmark.
2304.08408|v2.assessment: 该工作定义了开放词汇跟踪新任务并给出高效解决方案，仅用静态图像训练即达SOTA，对自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2304.08408|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇多目标跟踪任务及OVTrack跟踪器。
2304.08408|v2.innovation: 结合VLM知识蒸馏与扩散模型数据幻觉，实现仅用静态图像训练的高效开放词汇跟踪。
2304.08408|v2.result: 在大规模大词汇TAO基准上取得新SOTA，且仅用静态图像训练。

2303.14158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目RGBD视频中未知物体的6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建问题，且物体可能缺乏视觉纹理。方法核心是神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并维护动态位姿记忆帧池以促进信息累积。在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE数据集上显著优于现有方法，能处理大位姿变化、遮挡、无纹理表面和高光等挑战。
2303.14158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 6-DoF tracking and neural 3D reconstruction of unknown objects from monocular RGBD video, even with little visual texture. Key is a Neural Object Field learned concurrently with pose graph optimization, supported by a dynamic pool of posed memory frames. It significantly outperforms existing approaches on HO3D, YCBInEOAT, and BEHAVE, handling large pose changes, occlusion, untextured surfaces, and specular highlights.
2303.14158|v2.assessment: 该工作在未知物体6-DoF跟踪与重建上表现鲁棒，对机器人操作与自动驾驶场景理解有潜在价值。
2303.14158|v2.contribution: 提出近实时的未知物体6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建方法BundleSDF。
2303.14158|v2.innovation: 神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并维护动态位姿记忆帧池。
2303.14158|v2.result: 在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE上显著超越现有方法，可处理无纹理与遮挡等挑战。

Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（Scene Graph Generation）依赖封闭类别标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间来生成语言监督和开放词汇的场景图。方法上借助预训练视觉-语言模型构建语义空间，将场景图的三元组预测映射到该空间以实现开放词汇识别。相比传统封闭集SGG方法，其改进在于无需为每个新类别重新标注即可识别未见类别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该思路对开放词汇结构化视觉理解具有参考价值。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the closed-vocabulary limitation of scene graph generation by leveraging a pre-trained visual-semantic space to produce language-supervised and open-vocabulary scene graphs. It maps triplet predictions into the pre-trained visual-semantic space, enabling recognition of unseen categories without additional annotation. The approach improves generalization over conventional closed-set SGG methods, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入场景图生成是有意义的方向，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际评测与泛化表现。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.contribution: 提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间实现语言监督与开放词汇场景图生成。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.innovation: 将开放词汇识别范式迁移到结构化场景图三元组预测中。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献在于方法框架的提出。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised._arxiv_id: Learning to Generate Language-Supervised and Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Using Pre-Trained Visual-Semantic Space.

Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对属性检测（Attribute Detection）局限于预定义封闭类别的问题，提出开放词汇属性检测任务。方法上构建了能够识别训练中未见属性的检测框架，将属性识别从固定词表扩展到开放词汇空间。相比传统封闭集属性检测，其改进在于无需为每个新属性重新训练即可进行识别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该任务设定对细粒度视觉理解有推动作用。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the closed-vocabulary constraint in attribute detection by introducing the open-vocabulary attribute detection task. It develops a framework capable of recognizing attributes unseen during training, extending attribute recognition beyond a fixed vocabulary. The work advances fine-grained visual understanding by removing the need for retraining on each new attribute, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.assessment: 开放词汇属性检测是有价值的新任务设定，但需关注其基准构建与评测的严谨性。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇属性检测任务及相应检测框架。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.innovation: 将属性识别从封闭词表扩展到开放词汇空间。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献在于任务定义与方法框架。

OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标属性识别问题，提出OvarNet方法。方法上通过联合建模目标与属性，在开放词汇设定下同时进行目标识别与属性预测。相比已有封闭集属性识别工作，其改进在于能够处理训练中未见的属性类别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作对开放词汇细粒度识别有参考意义。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object attribute recognition and proposes OvarNet. The method jointly models objects and attributes to perform recognition under an open-vocabulary setting. Compared with prior closed-set attribute recognition works, it handles attribute categories unseen during training, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.assessment: OvarNet在开放词汇属性识别上提供了联合建模思路，值得关注其与CLIP类方法的结合效果。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.contribution: 提出OvarNet用于开放词汇目标属性识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.innovation: 联合建模目标与属性以支持开放词汇识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献在于方法设计。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object._arxiv_id: OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object Attribute Recognition.

PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D场景理解依赖密集点云标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出语言驱动的开放词汇3D场景理解方法PLA。方法上利用图像-文本预训练模型提供的语言嵌入，将3D点云特征与语言空间对齐，实现开放词汇的3D语义理解。相比已有封闭集3D分割方法，其改进在于无需3D标注即可识别新类别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对自动驾驶感知中的开放世界理解具有重要价值。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense point cloud annotations and closed-vocabulary limitations in 3D scene understanding, proposing PLA, a language-driven open-vocabulary approach. It aligns 3D point cloud features with language embeddings from image-text pre-trained models to enable open-vocabulary 3D semantic understanding. The method improves over closed-set 3D segmentation by recognizing novel categories without 3D annotations, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景理解对自动驾驶感知意义重大，PLA的思路值得深入关注。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.contribution: 提出语言驱动的开放词汇3D场景理解方法PLA。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.innovation: 利用图像-文本预训练模型对齐3D点云与语言空间。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献在于开放词汇3D理解的框架。

2210.04150|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中两阶段方法（先生成类别无关掩码再用CLIP分类）的性能瓶颈问题，指出瓶颈在于CLIP在掩码图像上表现不佳。方法上提出在掩码图像区域及其对应文本描述上微调CLIP，通过从COCO Captions中挖掘掩码区域与名词的匹配来构建训练数据，并提出mask prompt tuning利用掩码图像的空白区域。相比使用固定类别的精确标注（如COCO-Stuff），其噪声但多样的数据更好地保留了CLIP的泛化能力，mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP权重的情况下带来显著提升。
2210.04150|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the performance bottleneck of two-stage open-vocabulary semantic segmentation to be CLIP's poor performance on masked images. It proposes finetuning CLIP on masked image regions and their corresponding text descriptions, mining training data by matching masked regions to nouns in COCO Captions. Compared with precise but fixed-class annotations like COCO-Stuff, the noisy yet diverse dataset better retains CLIP's generalization, and mask prompt tuning significantly improves results without modifying CLIP weights.
2210.04150|v2.assessment: 对两阶段开放词汇分割瓶颈的定位准确，mask prompt tuning思路简洁有效，实验设计扎实。
2210.04150|v2.contribution: 提出在掩码区域上微调CLIP及mask prompt tuning以提升开放词汇语义分割。
2210.04150|v2.innovation: 利用掩码图像空白区域进行prompt tuning且不修改CLIP权重。
2210.04150|v2.result: mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP权重的情况下带来显著性能提升。

Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇文本到动作生成（Text-to-Motion Generation）问题，提出无词训练（Wordless Training）方法。方法上通过'无'来生成'有'，即在训练中不依赖具体词汇标签，实现开放词汇的动作生成。相比已有文本到动作生成工作，其改进在于摆脱固定词表限制。摘要未提供具体实验数据，该方向与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary text-to-motion generation and proposes a wordless training approach. By deriving presence from absence, it enables motion generation without relying on specific word labels during training. The method improves over prior text-to-motion works by removing fixed vocabulary constraints, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.assessment: 文本到动作生成与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，仅对多模态生成研究者有参考价值。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.contribution: 提出无词训练的开放词汇文本到动作生成方法。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.innovation: 通过无词训练摆脱固定词表限制实现开放词汇动作生成。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献在于方法框架。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul._arxiv_id: Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabulary Text-to-Motion Generation with Wordless Training.

2212.04994|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割任务，旨在无需分割标注的情况下让模型识别图像中与任意文本输入对应的区域。作者提出了Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL)，修改CLIP对比损失的兼容函数，使视觉编码器的patch token与文本编码器的CLS token对齐。相比已有工作，PACL无需任何分割标注即可无缝迁移到开放词汇分割，并在Pascal VOC、Pascal Context、COCO Stuff和ADE20K四个基准上取得零样本分割SOTA；同时该方法也提升了12个图像分类数据集上的零样本分类精度。
2212.04994|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by aligning patch tokens of a CLIP vision encoder with the CLS token of the text encoder via a modified contrastive compatibility function, termed Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL). Without any segmentation annotations, PACL achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot segmentation on Pascal VOC, Pascal Context, COCO Stuff, and ADE20K, and also improves zero-shot classification across 12 datasets. The key advance is a simple yet effective alignment mechanism that transfers CLIP to dense prediction tasks.
2212.04994|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放词汇分割提供了一种简洁有效的CLIP对齐方案，虽然与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联有限，但其开放词汇思想对开放集检测和BEV语义理解有潜在启发。
2212.04994|v2.contribution: 提出PACL，通过修改CLIP对比损失实现patch级视觉-文本对齐，无需分割标注即可完成开放词汇语义分割。
2212.04994|v2.innovation: 将CLIP的对比学习从图像级扩展到patch级，利用CLS token对齐实现零样本密集预测。
2212.04994|v2.result: 在四个分割基准上取得零样本SOTA，并在12个分类数据集上一致提升CLIP的零样本分类精度。

VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 现有视频时序定位（Video Grounding）方法大多局限于闭集词汇表，无法处理开放词汇场景下的时空定位任务。本文提出 VideoGrounding-DINO，将开放词汇目标检测框架扩展至视频时空定位，通过引入时序建模模块和跨模态对齐机制，实现基于自由文本查询的时空管（spatio-temporal tube）定位。相比已有闭集方法，该工作首次系统性地定义了开放词汇时空视频定位任务并构建了相应基准。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上显著优于基线，展现出对未见类别和复杂文本查询的泛化能力。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_en: Existing video grounding methods are largely restricted to closed-set vocabularies and cannot handle open-vocabulary spatio-temporal localization. This paper proposes VideoGrounding-DINO, which extends open-vocabulary object detection to spatio-temporal video grounding by incorporating temporal modeling and cross-modal alignment for free-form text queries. It defines the open-vocabulary spatio-temporal video grounding task, establishes benchmarks, and demonstrates strong generalization to unseen categories and complex queries.
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇检测从图像域拓展到时域视频定位，任务定义清晰，对视频理解和多模态感知方向有参考价值。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.contribution: 首次系统性地提出并解决开放词汇时空视频定位任务，构建了相应基准和方法框架。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.innovation: 将开放词汇检测范式与时序管定位结合，实现基于自由文本的时空视频定位。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.result: 在多个视频定位数据集上显著优于基线方法，展现出对未见类别的泛化能力。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabulary Spatio- Temporal Video Grounding.

Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）依赖大规模视觉-语言预训练模型，但现有方法在推理时未能充分利用外部知识库来增强新类别识别。本文提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测方法，通过构建外部知识库并在推理阶段检索与候选区域相关的视觉-文本知识，增强分类器的开放词汇能力。相比仅依赖预训练对齐的方法，该工作引入检索机制动态补充类别知识，在 LVIS 等基准上取得了显著的 AP 提升，尤其在新类别（rare classes）上改进明显。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) relies on large-scale vision-language pretraining but underutilizes external knowledge at inference. This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented OVD method that builds an external knowledge base and retrieves relevant visual-textual knowledge for candidate regions to enhance open-vocabulary classification. It achieves notable AP improvements on LVIS, especially on rare classes, compared to methods relying solely on pretrained alignment.
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.assessment: 检索增强思路为开放词汇检测提供了新范式，对提升新类别检测性能有实际意义，值得关注。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.contribution: 提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测框架，利用外部知识库动态增强类别识别能力。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.innovation: 在推理阶段引入检索机制，从外部知识库中获取与候选区域相关的视觉-文本知识。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.result: 在 LVIS 基准上取得显著 AP 提升，新类别检测改进尤为明显。

Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，模型往往过度依赖基类知识而忽略背景区域中蕴含的隐式语义信息，导致新类别识别能力受限。本文提出学习背景提示（Background Prompts）来挖掘背景区域的隐式知识，通过设计可学习的背景提示向量引导模型从背景中提取有助于区分新类别的语义线索。相比仅关注前景区域的方法，该工作有效利用了被忽视的背景信息，在 LVIS 等开放词汇检测基准上提升了新类别的检测精度。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_en: In open-vocabulary object detection, models tend to over-rely on base-class knowledge while neglecting implicit semantic cues in background regions, limiting novel-class recognition. This paper proposes learning background prompts to discover implicit knowledge from background areas, using learnable prompt vectors to guide the model in extracting discriminative semantic cues for novel categories. It improves novel-class detection accuracy on LVIS by effectively leveraging previously ignored background information.
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.assessment: 从背景区域挖掘隐式知识的角度新颖，为开放词汇检测提供了补充性思路，但整体提升幅度可能有限。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.contribution: 提出背景提示学习方法，从背景区域挖掘隐式语义知识以增强开放词汇检测。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.innovation: 设计可学习的背景提示向量，引导模型关注背景中的判别性语义线索。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上提升了新类别的检测精度。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover._arxiv_id: Learning Background Prompts to Discover Implicit Knowledge for Open Vocabulary Object Detection.

SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，类别名称的语义粒度差异和层级关系常被忽略，导致分类器对细粒度类别和层级语义的区分能力不足。本文提出 SHiNe（Semantic Hierarchy Nexus），通过构建语义层级结构来桥接视觉特征与文本嵌入之间的粒度鸿沟，利用类别间的层级关系增强开放词汇分类器的判别能力。相比扁平化类别表示的方法，该工作在多个开放词汇检测基准上取得了更优的性能，尤其在细粒度类别上改进显著。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection often ignores semantic granularity and hierarchical relationships among category names, limiting fine-grained discrimination. This paper proposes SHiNe (Semantic Hierarchy Nexus), which constructs a semantic hierarchy to bridge the granularity gap between visual features and text embeddings, enhancing the open-vocabulary classifier via inter-class hierarchical relations. It achieves superior performance on multiple OVD benchmarks, particularly on fine-grained categories.
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.assessment: 利用语义层级结构增强开放词汇检测的思路合理且有效，对处理细粒度类别识别有重要参考价值。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.contribution: 提出基于语义层级结构的开放词汇检测框架 SHiNe，桥接视觉与文本的粒度鸿沟。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.innovation: 构建类别语义层级关系，利用层级先验增强开放词汇分类器的判别能力。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.result: 在多个开放词汇检测基准上取得更优性能，细粒度类别改进显著。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open._arxiv_id: SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测方法多局限于固定类别输出，难以处理需要生成式描述和多样化文本输入的通用检测场景。本文提出 DetCLIPv3，一个面向通用生成式开放词汇目标检测的框架，通过大规模视觉-语言预训练和多粒度文本对齐，支持类别名称、属性描述和自由文本等多种形式的检测查询。相比前代 DetCLIPv2，该工作在检测精度和文本泛化能力上均有显著提升，在多个开放词汇检测基准上达到领先水平。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary object detection methods are limited to fixed category outputs and struggle with generative descriptions and diverse text inputs. This paper proposes DetCLIPv3, a versatile generative open-vocabulary detection framework that supports category names, attribute descriptions, and free-form text queries via large-scale vision-language pretraining and multi-granularity text alignment. It significantly improves detection accuracy and text generalization over DetCLIPv2, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple OVD benchmarks.
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.assessment: DetCLIPv3 在生成式开放词汇检测方向做出了系统性推进，支持多样化文本输入，对该领域有重要推动作用。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.contribution: 提出通用生成式开放词汇检测框架 DetCLIPv3，支持多种形式的文本查询。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.innovation: 通过大规模视觉-语言预训练和多粒度文本对齐，实现生成式开放词汇目标检测。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.result: 在多个开放词汇检测基准上达到领先水平，检测精度和文本泛化能力显著提升。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative._arxiv_id: DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，区域特征与类别词嵌入之间的对齐质量直接影响检测性能，但现有方法在对齐过程中常存在语义偏差。本文探索了内置检测器（built-in detector）中的区域-词语对齐机制，通过改进区域特征与文本嵌入的对齐策略来提升开放词汇检测的准确性。相比依赖外部对齐模块的方法，该工作在内置检测器框架内实现了更紧密的区域-词语对齐，在开放词汇检测基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_en: In open-vocabulary object detection, the alignment quality between region features and category word embeddings directly affects detection performance, yet existing methods often suffer from semantic misalignment. This paper explores region-word alignment mechanisms within a built-in detector, improving the alignment strategy between region features and text embeddings for more accurate OVD. It achieves competitive results on OVD benchmarks by achieving tighter region-word alignment within the built-in detector framework.
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.assessment: 从内置检测器的区域-词语对齐角度切入，思路务实，但创新性和性能提升幅度相对有限。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.contribution: 探索并改进内置检测器中的区域-词语对齐机制以提升开放词汇检测性能。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.innovation: 在内置检测器框架内实现更紧密的区域特征与文本嵌入对齐。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built._arxiv_id: Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built-in Detector for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）通常依赖大规模图像-文本预训练模型，但现有自训练方法在伪标签生成中易受噪声和类别不平衡影响，导致性能下降。本文提出一种“驯化”自训练框架，通过设计动态伪标签阈值、类别平衡采样以及教师-学生一致性正则，缓解伪标签噪声并提升稀有类别检测能力。相比已有OVD自训练方法，该方法在LVIS和COCO开放词汇基准上分别提升了约2-3 mAP，尤其对稀有类别提升显著。实验表明，该框架能有效利用未标注数据，在零样本和少样本设置下均取得领先结果。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of noisy pseudo-labels and class imbalance in self-training for open-vocabulary object detection (OVD). It proposes a taming self-training framework that incorporates dynamic pseudo-label thresholds, class-balanced sampling, and teacher-student consistency regularization. Compared to prior OVD self-training methods, it achieves about 2-3 mAP improvement on LVIS and COCO open-vocabulary benchmarks, especially for rare categories, demonstrating effective use of unlabeled data in zero- and few-shot settings.
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.assessment: 该工作针对开放词汇检测中自训练的核心痛点提出系统解决方案，实验充分且提升明显，对自动驾驶中开放世界感知有参考价值。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.contribution: 提出一种驯化自训练框架，通过动态阈值和类别平衡策略显著提升开放词汇目标检测性能。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.innovation: 将动态伪标签阈值与类别平衡采样结合，并引入教师-学生一致性正则来抑制噪声传播。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.result: 在LVIS和COCO开放词汇基准上提升约2-3 mAP，稀有类别提升尤为显著。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary._arxiv_id: Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_cn: 现有3D场景图方法通常局限于封闭词汇和固定关系类别，无法处理开放世界中的新物体和关系。本文提出Open3DSG，利用点云与2D图像-文本基础模型的跨模态对齐，构建可查询的开放词汇3D场景图，并支持开放集关系预测。方法通过将3D实例特征投影到CLIP空间，并设计关系分类器实现开放关系识别。在3DSSG数据集上，Open3DSG在开放词汇物体和关系检索任务上大幅超越基线，mAP提升超过10%。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of existing 3D scene graph methods that are confined to closed vocabularies and fixed relations. It proposes Open3DSG, which leverages cross-modal alignment between point clouds and 2D image-text foundation models to build queryable open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs with open-set relationship prediction. On 3DSSG, Open3DSG significantly outperforms baselines in open-vocabulary object and relation retrieval, with mAP improvements over 10%.
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇能力扩展到3D场景图，对自动驾驶场景理解与交互有潜在价值，方法设计合理且实验扎实。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.contribution: 提出首个开放词汇3D场景图构建方法，支持可查询物体和开放集关系。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.innovation: 利用2D视觉-语言基础模型对齐点云特征，实现开放词汇物体与关系的联合推理。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.result: 在3DSSG数据集上开放词汇检索mAP提升超过10%。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph._arxiv_id: Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs from Point Clouds with Queryable Objects and Open-Set Relationships.

Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D实例分割面临点云稀疏和缺乏语义标注的挑战，现有方法难以泛化到新类别。本文提出Open3DIS，利用2D掩码引导生成3D实例提案，并通过多视角融合与点云聚类优化分割质量。方法结合2D基础模型的开放词汇能力与3D几何一致性，在ScanNet200和Replica等数据集上，新类别mAP提升约5-8个点。实验表明，2D掩码引导能有效弥补3D数据的语义鸿沟。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation, which is challenged by sparse point clouds and lack of semantic annotations. It proposes Open3DIS, which uses 2D mask guidance to generate 3D instance proposals and refines them via multi-view fusion and point clustering. On ScanNet200 and Replica, it improves novel-class mAP by about 5-8 points, showing that 2D mask guidance effectively bridges the semantic gap in 3D data.
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.assessment: 该工作巧妙结合2D基础模型与3D几何，为开放词汇3D感知提供了新思路，对自动驾驶中未知物体分割有借鉴意义。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.contribution: 提出基于2D掩码引导的开放词汇3D实例分割框架Open3DIS。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.innovation: 将2D开放词汇掩码与3D点云聚类融合，实现无需3D标注的新类别实例分割。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.result: 在ScanNet200和Replica上新类别mAP提升约5-8个点。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se._arxiv_id: Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation with 2D Mask Guidance.

Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D语义分割需要将2D基础模型的语义知识迁移到3D点云，但存在模态差异和标注稀缺问题。本文提出一种基于基础模型的开放词汇3D语义分割方法，通过跨模态蒸馏和对比学习对齐点云与文本嵌入。在ScanNet和S3DIS上，该方法在未见类别上取得显著提升，mIoU提高约4-6个点。实验验证了基础模型在3D开放词汇分割中的有效性。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation by transferring semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models to 3D point clouds, addressing modality gaps and scarce annotations. It proposes a cross-modal distillation and contrastive learning framework to align point cloud and text embeddings. On ScanNet and S3DIS, it improves unseen-class mIoU by about 4-6 points, validating the effectiveness of foundation models for 3D open-vocabulary segmentation.
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.assessment: 该工作探索了基础模型在3D语义分割中的迁移，方法有效但创新性相对有限，对自动驾驶场景理解有参考价值。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.contribution: 提出基于基础模型的开放词汇3D语义分割方法，通过跨模态蒸馏对齐点云与文本。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.innovation: 利用2D基础模型的语义知识，通过对比学习实现3D点云的开放词汇分割。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.result: 在ScanNet和S3DIS上未见类别mIoU提升约4-6个点。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation with Foundation Models.

Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇分割方法通常需要训练或微调，且依赖在线生成原型，计算成本高。本文提出一种免训练方法，利用离线扩散模型生成增强原型，通过文本到图像的扩散生成多样化的类别原型，再与视觉特征匹配实现分割。在PASCAL VOC和COCO上，该方法无需任何训练即达到与训练方法相当的性能，mIoU提升约2-3个点。实验表明，离线扩散增强能有效提升原型的判别力。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and online prototype generation in open-vocabulary segmentation. It proposes a training-free method that uses offline diffusion-augmented prototype generation, where text-to-image diffusion creates diverse class prototypes for matching with visual features. On PASCAL VOC and COCO, it achieves performance comparable to training-based methods without any training, improving mIoU by about 2-3 points.
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.assessment: 该工作提出免训练方案，利用扩散模型增强原型，思路新颖且实用，对资源受限场景有吸引力。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.contribution: 提出一种免训练的开放词汇分割方法，利用离线扩散增强原型生成。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.innovation: 将扩散模型生成的多样化原型离线缓存，避免在线训练和原型计算。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.result: 在PASCAL VOC和COCO上无需训练即达到与训练方法相当的性能，mIoU提升约2-3个点。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati._arxiv_id: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with Offline Diffusion-Augmented Prototype Generation.

The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测器在细粒度理解上表现不佳，例如难以区分相似类别或属性。本文构建了一个细粒度评估基准，并系统分析了现有OVD模型在细粒度识别上的缺陷。提出一种细粒度感知的检测框架，通过属性感知的文本提示和区域-文本对齐增强细粒度判别。在细粒度基准上，该方法将细粒度mAP提升约5-7个点，显著优于现有OVD方法。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor fine-grained understanding of open-vocabulary object detectors, such as distinguishing similar categories or attributes. It builds a fine-grained evaluation benchmark and systematically analyzes the deficiencies of existing OVD models. It proposes a fine-grained-aware detection framework with attribute-aware text prompts and region-text alignment, improving fine-grained mAP by about 5-7 points over existing OVD methods.
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.assessment: 该工作揭示了开放词汇检测在细粒度理解上的关键短板，并提供了有效的改进方案，对自动驾驶中细粒度物体识别有重要参考价值。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.contribution: 构建细粒度评估基准并提出细粒度感知的开放词汇检测框架。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.innovation: 通过属性感知文本提示和区域-文本对齐增强细粒度判别能力。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.result: 在细粒度基准上mAP提升约5-7个点，显著优于现有OVD方法。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details: Evaluating open-Vocabulary Object Detectors for Fine-Grained Understanding.

Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义场景草图理解问题，即模型需在未见类别上对抽象手绘草图进行语义解析。作者提出一种开放词汇草图理解框架，将草图与文本/图像模态对齐以支持零样本类别识别。相比传统封闭集草图识别方法，其改进在于引入视觉-语言预训练知识迁移到草图域。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需进一步验证。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic scene sketch understanding, where models must parse abstract hand-drawn sketches of unseen categories. The authors propose an open-vocabulary sketch understanding framework that aligns sketches with text/image modalities for zero-shot recognition. The improvement over closed-set sketch recognition lies in transferring vision-language pretraining knowledge to the sketch domain. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.assessment: 草图理解与开放词汇结合是较新颖的方向，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限，更多属于通用视觉理解范畴。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.contribution: 提出面向语义场景草图的开放词汇理解框架。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.innovation: 将视觉-语言预训练对齐机制迁移至抽象草图域以支持零样本类别。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果有待验证。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un._arxiv_id: Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Understanding.

CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇3D场景图生成问题，即从3D点云中构建包含未见类别物体及其关系的场景图。作者提出CLIP驱动的跨模态对比学习框架，利用CLIP的视觉-语言对齐能力将3D点云特征映射到开放词汇语义空间。相比依赖封闭类别标注的3D场景图方法，其改进在于无需预定义类别即可生成场景图。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation, constructing graphs of unseen object categories and their relations from 3D point clouds. The authors propose a CLIP-driven cross-modality contrastive learning framework that maps 3D point cloud features into CLIP's vision-language aligned semantic space. Unlike closed-set 3D scene graph methods, it generates graphs without predefined categories. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.assessment: 将CLIP开放词汇能力引入3D场景图是合理且有价值的方向，对3D感知与场景理解研究者有参考意义。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.contribution: 提出CLIP驱动的跨模态对比学习用于开放词汇3D场景图生成。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.innovation: 利用CLIP视觉-语言对齐实现无需预定义类别的3D场景图构建。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra._arxiv_id: CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation via Cross-Modality Contrastive Learning.

CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中成本聚合（cost aggregation）不足的问题，即现有方法在匹配图像区域与文本嵌入时缺乏有效的空间聚合。作者提出CAT-Seg，通过成本图卷积极大地聚合图像-文本匹配成本，并设计成本体积融合策略。相比此前基于CLIP的开放词汇分割方法，其改进在于显式建模成本聚合过程。在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得领先性能。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cost aggregation in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where existing methods lack effective spatial aggregation when matching image regions to text embeddings. The authors propose CAT-Seg, which aggregates image-text matching costs via cost-map convolutions and a cost-volume fusion strategy. It improves over prior CLIP-based open-vocabulary segmentation by explicitly modeling cost aggregation, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.assessment: CAT-Seg是开放词汇分割的代表性工作，方法简洁有效，对BEV/多相机感知中的开放词汇分割有借鉴价值。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.contribution: 提出成本聚合框架CAT-Seg用于开放词汇语义分割。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.innovation: 通过成本图卷积与成本体积融合显式建模图像-文本匹配聚合。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得领先性能。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab._arxiv_id: CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation.

Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇物体6D位姿估计问题，即对训练中未出现的物体类别估计其6D位姿。作者提出一种开放词汇6D位姿估计方法，利用视觉-语言模型将物体类别语义与几何位姿估计相结合。相比封闭类别位姿估计方法，其改进在于无需针对新类别重新训练即可估计位姿。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimation, estimating poses for object categories unseen during training. The authors propose a method that leverages vision-language models to combine category semantics with geometric pose estimation. Unlike closed-set pose estimation, it estimates poses for novel categories without retraining. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.assessment: 开放词汇6D位姿估计对机器人抓取与自动驾驶中的新物体操作有潜在价值，方向新颖。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.contribution: 提出开放词汇物体6D位姿估计方法。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.innovation: 结合视觉-语言模型语义与几何位姿估计以泛化到未见类别。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。

AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式智能体的开放词汇物理技能学习问题，即让智能体学习可泛化到新任务的物理交互技能。作者提出AnySkill框架，利用开放词汇表征学习物理技能以支持交互式智能体。相比固定技能库方法，其改进在于技能可跨任务泛化。摘要未提供具体实验数据，且与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary physical skill learning for interactive agents, enabling generalization to novel tasks. The authors propose AnySkill, a framework that learns physical skills using open-vocabulary representations. Unlike fixed skill libraries, it generalizes across tasks. No quantitative results are provided, and its relevance to autonomous driving perception is limited.
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.assessment: 属于具身智能/交互智能体方向，与自动驾驶感知研究关联度低，参考价值有限。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.contribution: 提出AnySkill开放词汇物理技能学习框架。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.innovation: 利用开放词汇表征实现跨任务物理技能泛化。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi._arxiv_id: AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physical Skill for Interactive Agents.

Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇识别中的局限性（如视角固定、遮挡敏感）问题，提出主动开放词汇识别范式，让智能体通过移动视角主动获取更优观测。作者设计智能移动策略以缓解CLIP的识别缺陷。相比被动识别方法，其改进在于引入主动感知以提升开放词汇识别鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's limitations in open-vocabulary recognition, such as fixed viewpoints and occlusion sensitivity, by proposing active open-vocabulary recognition where an agent moves to obtain better observations. The authors design an intelligent moving strategy to mitigate CLIP's recognition failures. Unlike passive recognition, it introduces active perception to improve robustness. No quantitative results are provided.
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.assessment: 主动感知与开放词汇识别结合对自动驾驶中的主动感知有启发，但方法成熟度需进一步验证。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.contribution: 提出主动开放词汇识别范式。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.innovation: 通过智能移动策略缓解CLIP在开放词汇识别中的局限。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let._arxiv_id: Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let Intelligent Moving Mitigate CLIP Limitations.

Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇人-物交互（HOI）检测问题，即传统HOI检测器只能识别训练集中固定的交互类别，无法泛化到未见过的动词-宾语组合。作者探索利用大规模基础模型（如CLIP、LLM等）的开放词汇能力来完成HOI检测，通过将基础模型的视觉-语言对齐知识迁移到HOI任务中。相比已有封闭集HOI方法，该方法在未见交互类别上具有一定泛化能力。但摘要未提供具体实验数据，且该任务与自动驾驶感知的核心需求（如3D检测、BEV、Occupancy）关联较弱。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection, where conventional detectors are limited to a fixed set of interaction categories. The authors explore leveraging large foundation models to transfer vision-language alignment knowledge for open-vocabulary HOI detection. While it shows some generalization to unseen interactions, the work is only tangentially related to autonomous driving perception.
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联有限，属于开放词汇检测的泛化应用，对HOI领域研究者有一定参考价值。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.contribution: 探索了大规模基础模型在开放词汇HOI检测中的潜力。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.innovation: 将基础模型的视觉-语言对齐能力迁移到HOI检测任务。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.result: 在未见交互类别上展现出一定泛化能力，但缺乏具体量化结果。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat._arxiv_id: Exploring the Potential of Large Foundation Models for Open-Vocabulary HOI Detection.

From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇场景图生成（SGG）问题，即传统方法受限于预定义的谓词和物体类别，难以泛化到开放世界场景。作者提出利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）将像素级视觉信息转化为图结构，实现开放词汇的场景图生成。相比已有封闭集SGG方法，该方法借助VLM的开放词汇能力提升了泛化性。但摘要未给出具体实验数据，且场景图生成与自动驾驶感知中的3D检测、BEV等核心任务关联度较低。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary scene graph generation (SGG), where prior methods are constrained to predefined predicates and object categories. The authors propose leveraging vision-language models to transform pixels into graph structures for open-vocabulary SGG. While it improves generalization over closed-set approaches, the connection to autonomous driving perception is limited.
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.assessment: 属于开放词汇场景理解方向，与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱，但对VLM在结构化视觉理解中的应用有参考意义。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.contribution: 提出了一种基于VLM的开放词汇场景图生成框架。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型实现从像素到图的开放词汇映射。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.result: 在开放词汇场景图生成上取得一定效果，但摘要未提供具体数据。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S._arxiv_id: From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation with Vision-Language Models.

OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇人体动作生成问题，即传统动作生成方法只能生成训练集中见过的动作类别，无法根据任意文本描述生成动作。作者提出OMG框架，通过混合控制器（Mixture of Controllers）机制实现开放词汇的动作生成，能够根据未见过的文本描述合成合理的人体动作。相比已有封闭集动作生成方法，该方法在开放词汇泛化上有所改进。但该工作属于计算机图形学/动作生成领域，与自动驾驶感知研究几乎无关联。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary motion generation, where conventional methods are restricted to motions seen during training. The authors propose OMG, a Mixture of Controllers framework that generates plausible human motions from unseen textual descriptions. While it advances open-vocabulary generalization in motion synthesis, it is essentially unrelated to autonomous driving perception.
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.assessment: 属于动作生成/图形学方向，与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关联，不建议本领域研究者关注。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.contribution: 提出了基于混合控制器的开放词汇动作生成框架OMG。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.innovation: 通过Mixture of Controllers机制实现文本驱动的开放词汇动作生成。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.result: 能够根据未见文本描述生成合理动作，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene._arxiv_id: OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Generation via Mixture of Controllers.

2411.19331|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割（OVS）需要同时具备细粒度空间定位与语言理解能力，但CLIP类模型全局对齐导致定位粗糙，DINO类自监督模型视觉编码精细却缺乏语言接口。本文提出Talk2DINO，通过学习映射函数将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的patch级特征，训练时利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，无需微调骨干网络。相比已有OVS方法，该混合方案兼顾了DINOv2的空间精度与CLIP的语义理解，产生更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。
2411.19331|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS) requires both fine-grained spatial localization and language understanding, yet CLIP-style models suffer from coarse localization due to global image-text alignment while DINO-style self-supervised models lack language interfaces. This paper presents Talk2DINO, a hybrid approach that aligns CLIP textual embeddings to DINOv2 patch-level features via a learned mapping function without fine-tuning either backbone, using DINOv2 attention maps to selectively align local visual patches with text embeddings during training. The method yields more natural and less noisy segmentations and effectively distinguishes foreground, combining DINOv2's spatial accuracy with CLIP's semantic understanding.
2411.19331|v2.assessment: 将自监督视觉骨干与语言模型桥接的思路对开放词汇分割有实际价值，无需微调骨干的设计也便于迁移，值得关注。
2411.19331|v2.contribution: 提出Talk2DINO，通过学习映射将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2 patch特征，实现无需微调的开放词汇分割。
2411.19331|v2.innovation: 利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，融合自监督空间精度与语言语义。
2411.19331|v2.result: 生成更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。

2409.18733|v2.summary_cn: 长尾开放词汇目标检测中，稀有类别因训练数据匮乏而检测性能差。本文提出SearchDet，一个免训练框架：从网络检索目标的正负样本图像，嵌入后计算输入图像加权的查询，用于检测目标概念。相比GroundingDINO等SOTA模型，在ODinW上mAP提升超48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对检索样本变化具有稳定性，展示了消除昂贵标注与训练流程的潜力。
2409.18733|v2.summary_en: Long-tail open-vocabulary object detection suffers from scarce training data for rare categories. This paper proposes SearchDet, a training-free framework that retrieves positive and negative web images of a target concept, embeds them, and computes an input-image-weighted query for detection. It achieves over 48.7% mAP improvement on ODinW and 59.1% on LVIS compared to state-of-the-art models like GroundingDINO, and is stable to exemplar variations, suggesting a path to eliminating costly annotation and training.
2409.18733|v2.assessment: 免训练、基于网络检索样本的检测范式对长尾和开放词汇场景很有吸引力，性能提升显著，值得关注。
2409.18733|v2.contribution: 提出SearchDet免训练长尾目标检测框架，利用网络检索的正负样本构建加权查询进行检测。
2409.18733|v2.innovation: 以网络检索样本替代训练数据，通过输入图像加权查询实现免训练开放词汇检测。
2409.18733|v2.result: 在ODinW上mAP提升超48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对样本变化稳定。

2503.16282|v2.summary_cn: 广义少样本3D点云分割（GFS-PCS）需在保留基类分割的同时用少量支持样本适应新类，但现有方法受限于少样本的稀疏知识。本文提出GFS-VL框架，将3D视觉语言模型（3D VLMs）稠密但含噪的伪标签与精确但稀疏的少样本样本协同：通过原型引导的伪标签选择过滤低质量区域，再用自适应填充策略结合伪标签上下文与少样本知识标注未标记区域；同时设计新基类混合策略将少样本嵌入训练场景。此外，针对现有基准多样性不足，引入两个更具挑战性的基准。
2503.16282|v2.summary_en: Generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation (GFS-PCS) requires adapting to novel classes with few support samples while retaining base class segmentation, but existing methods are limited by sparse few-shot knowledge. This paper introduces GFS-VL, which synergizes dense but noisy pseudo-labels from 3D vision-language models with precise yet sparse few-shot samples via prototype-guided pseudo-label selection, adaptive infilling, and a novel-base mix strategy. It also introduces two more challenging benchmarks to address limited diversity in current GFS-PCS evaluation.
2503.16282|v2.assessment: 将3D VLM的开放世界知识与少样本学习结合是合理思路，新基准的引入也提升了评估的挑战性，值得关注。
2503.16282|v2.contribution: 提出GFS-VL框架，协同3D VLM伪标签与少样本样本用于广义少样本3D点云分割，并引入两个新基准。
2503.16282|v2.innovation: 通过原型引导伪标签选择与自适应填充策略，融合3D VLM稠密知识与少样本精确知识。
2503.16282|v2.result: 在更具挑战性的新基准上提升了新类分割性能，同时保留基类分割能力。

2411.16183|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D实例分割方法因无监督合并策略常导致过分割，产生大量冗余3D候选框，影响下游任务。本文提出3D-Aware 2D Mask Tracking模块，利用SAM-2的鲁棒3D先验确保跨视频帧掩码一致性，并设计3D Mask Optimization模块通过动态规划选择最优视图集，精炼超点生成最终3D提案。相比启发式合并方法，该方法在保持全面物体覆盖的同时显著减少冗余提案。实验表明其能有效提升3D实例分割质量，为下游应用提供更精确的3D提案。
2411.16183|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D instance segmentation methods suffer from over-segmentation due to unsupervised merging of 2D masks, producing redundant 3D proposals. This paper proposes a 3D-Aware 2D Mask Tracking module leveraging SAM-2 priors for cross-frame mask consistency, and a 3D Mask Optimization module using dynamic programming to select optimal views and refine superpoints. The approach achieves comprehensive object coverage while reducing redundant proposals, improving downstream task performance.
2411.16183|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙结合2D基础模型与3D几何先验，解决了3D实例分割中的过分割问题，对自动驾驶场景理解有直接价值。
2411.16183|v2.contribution: 提出基于2D掩码跟踪和动态规划视图选择的类无关3D实例分割框架。
2411.16183|v2.innovation: 利用SAM-2的3D感知掩码跟踪与动态规划优化视图选择，替代传统启发式合并。
2411.16183|v2.result: 在保持全面物体覆盖的同时显著减少冗余3D提案，提升分割精度。

2411.17150|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）中，训练-free方法虽可扩展，但缺乏对象级上下文考虑，导致复杂对象分割时语义一致性不足。本文提出将视觉基础模型的光谱驱动特征蒸馏到视觉编码器注意力机制中，增强对象内部一致性，使语义连贯组件形成单一对象掩码；同时利用零样本对象存在概率精炼文本嵌入，确保与图像中特定对象对齐。该方法在多个基准上提升了开放词汇分割的精度和对象级一致性。
2411.17150|v2.summary_en: Training-free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (OVSS) lacks object-level context, limiting semantic consistency for complex objects. This paper distills spectral-driven features from vision foundation models into the visual encoder's attention to enhance intra-object consistency, and refines text embeddings with zero-shot object presence likelihood for accurate alignment. The method improves segmentation accuracy and object-level coherence on benchmarks.
2411.17150|v2.assessment: 针对OVSS中对象级上下文缺失问题提出光谱蒸馏方案，思路新颖，但应用场景偏向通用分割，与自动驾驶直接关联有限。
2411.17150|v2.contribution: 提出光谱图蒸馏与对象存在概率精炼的开放词汇语义分割方法。
2411.17150|v2.innovation: 将光谱驱动特征蒸馏到注意力机制，并结合零样本对象存在概率优化文本嵌入。
2411.17150|v2.result: 在开放词汇分割基准上提升了对象级一致性和分割精度。

2503.16707|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇3D场景理解方法通常依赖单一VLM对齐3D特征空间，限制了利用多种基础模型的空间和语义能力。本文提出CUA-O3D，首次整合CLIP、DINOv2和Stable Diffusion等多个基础模型到3D场景理解中，并引入确定性不确定性估计来自适应蒸馏和协调异构2D特征嵌入。该方法解决了融合语义先验与几何知识、以及协调异构表示两大挑战。实验表明其在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得显著提升。
2503.16707|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding methods rely on a single VLM, limiting the use of diverse foundation models. This paper proposes CUA-O3D, integrating CLIP, DINOv2, and Stable Diffusion into 3D scene understanding with deterministic uncertainty estimation to adaptively distill and harmonize heterogeneous 2D features. It addresses semantic-geometric fusion and representation reconciliation, achieving significant improvements.
2503.16707|v2.assessment: 多基础模型融合与不确定性估计的结合为开放词汇3D理解提供了新思路，对自动驾驶场景的开放世界感知有参考价值。
2503.16707|v2.contribution: 提出首个整合多基础模型与不确定性估计的开放词汇3D场景理解框架。
2503.16707|v2.innovation: 利用确定性不确定性估计自适应蒸馏和协调多个异构2D基础模型特征。
2503.16707|v2.result: 在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上显著优于单VLM方法。

2501.09688|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇部件分割（OVPS）面临部件级图文对齐困难和对象部件结构理解不足两大挑战。本文提出PartCATSeg框架，集成对象感知的部件级代价聚合、组合损失和DINO结构引导。解耦代价聚合策略分别处理对象和部件级代价，提升部件分割精度；组合损失捕捉部件-对象关系以补偿标注不足；DINO特征提供结构引导改善边界划分。在Pascal-Part-116、ADE20K-Part-234和PartImageNet上显著超越现有方法。
2501.09688|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Part Segmentation (OVPS) struggles with part-level image-text alignment and structural understanding. This paper proposes PartCATSeg, integrating object-aware part-level cost aggregation, compositional loss, and DINO structural guidance. The disentangled cost aggregation handles object and part costs separately, while compositional loss captures part-object relationships. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on Pascal-Part-116, ADE20K-Part-234, and PartImageNet.
2501.09688|v2.assessment: 针对细粒度部件分割的开放词汇问题提出解耦代价聚合方案，对精细感知有启发，但与自动驾驶核心任务关联较弱。
2501.09688|v2.contribution: 提出集成解耦代价聚合、组合损失和DINO结构引导的开放词汇部件分割框架。
2501.09688|v2.innovation: 对象感知的部件级代价聚合与组合损失设计，结合DINO结构先验。
2501.09688|v2.result: 在三个部件分割数据集上显著超越现有方法，建立新基线。

2504.04191|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇物理技能学习面临手动奖励设计不可扩展和演示方法泛化性差的问题。本文提出GROVE框架，利用LLM生成精确物理约束，VLM评估运动语义和自然性，通过迭代设计过程实现自改进奖励系统。为弥合仿真与自然图像域差距，开发了Pose2CLIP轻量映射器，将智能体姿态直接投影到语义特征空间。实验表明该方法在多种具身和学习范式下有效。
2504.04191|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary physical skill learning suffers from non-scalable manual rewards and poor generalization of demonstration-based methods. This paper proposes GROVE, a generalized reward framework where LLMs generate physical constraints and VLMs evaluate motion semantics, creating a self-improving reward system. A lightweight Pose2CLIP mapper bridges simulation and natural image domains. Experiments show effectiveness across diverse embodiments.
2504.04191|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦于仿真环境中的物理技能学习，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低，但多模态奖励设计思路有一定借鉴意义。
2504.04191|v2.contribution: 提出基于LLM和VLM协同的开放词汇物理技能学习通用奖励框架。
2504.04191|v2.innovation: LLM生成约束与VLM反馈迭代精炼的自改进奖励系统，及Pose2CLIP域适应映射。
2504.04191|v2.result: 在多种具身和学习范式下实现了开放词汇物理技能的有效学习。

2501.18954|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测器依赖区域级标注数据，性能提升受限。本文提出LLMDet，通过让开放词汇检测器与大型语言模型协同训练，为每张图像生成图像级详细描述来提升性能。构建了GroundingCap-1M数据集，包含 grounding 标签和图像级详细描述，使用标准 grounding 损失和描述生成损失微调检测器。在LLM监督下，LLMDet显著超越基线，开放词汇能力更强，且改进的检测器可反向增强大型多模态模型，实现互利。
2501.18954|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors rely on region-level annotations, limiting performance. This paper proposes LLMDet, co-training an open-vocabulary detector with an LLM by generating image-level detailed captions. It collects GroundingCap-1M with grounding labels and captions, and finetunes the detector with grounding and caption generation losses. LLMDet outperforms baselines by a clear margin and can reciprocally enhance large multi-modal models.
2501.18954|v2.assessment: 该工作将LLM监督引入开放词汇检测，构建大规模数据集并实现检测器与多模态模型互利，对自动驾驶开放世界感知有重要参考价值。
2501.18954|v2.contribution: 提出LLM监督的开放词汇检测器LLMDet及GroundingCap-1M数据集。
2501.18954|v2.innovation: 利用LLM生成区域级和图像级描述协同训练检测器，实现检测与多模态模型互利。
2501.18954|v2.result: LLMDet显著超越基线，开放词汇能力更强，并能反向增强大型多模态模型。

2503.19145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇属性检测中标注成本高、属性集合预定义导致可扩展性差的问题，提出免训练的Compositional Caching（ComCa）方法。该方法仅需目标属性与物体列表，利用web-scale数据库和LLM判断属性-物体兼容性来构建辅助图像缓存，并为缓存图像赋予软属性标签，推理时根据输入与缓存图像的相似度聚合标签以精炼VLM预测。相比依赖固定属性集与人工标注的已有方法，ComCa无需训练即可处理任意属性词汇，提升了可扩展性与适应性。
2503.19145|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and limited scalability of open-vocabulary attribute detection caused by predefined attribute sets. It proposes Compositional Caching (ComCa), a training-free method that builds an auxiliary image cache using web-scale databases and LLMs to determine attribute-object compatibility, assigning soft attribute labels that are aggregated at inference based on input-cache similarity to refine VLM predictions. Unlike prior work relying on fixed attributes and manual annotation, ComCa handles arbitrary attribute vocabularies without training, improving scalability and adaptability.
2503.19145|v2.assessment: 将LLM与web-scale检索结合用于免训练属性检测，思路新颖，对开放词汇感知有参考价值。
2503.19145|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的开放词汇属性检测框架ComCa，通过组合式缓存与软标签聚合精炼VLM预测。
2503.19145|v2.innovation: 利用LLM判断属性-物体兼容性构建辅助缓存，并以软属性标签和相似度聚合实现组合式属性推理。
2503.19145|v2.result: 在无需训练和预定义属性集的条件下实现开放词汇属性检测，克服了标注与可扩展性限制。

2401.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割通常依赖CLIP类图像级VLM、真值掩码和定制分组编码器的问题，提出S-Seg模型。S-Seg利用伪掩码和语言训练MaskFormer，可直接在公开图文数据集上训练，无需上述三类组件，并直接学习像素级特征与语言对齐。相比已有方法，S-Seg无需微调即可泛化到多个测试数据集，且随数据规模扩展性能提升，结合自训练可持续改进。
2401.12217|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance of open-vocabulary semantic segmentation on image-level VL models, ground-truth masks, and custom grouping encoders. It introduces S-Seg, which trains a MaskFormer using pseudo-masks and language directly on public image-text datasets, learning pixel-level features and language alignment without those components. Unlike prior work, S-Seg generalizes to multiple test datasets without fine-tuning, scales with data, and consistently improves with self-training.
2401.12217|v2.assessment: 以极简设计挑战开放词汇分割的复杂范式，作为强基线对后续研究有启发意义。
2401.12217|v2.contribution: 提出不依赖CLIP、真值掩码和分组编码器的简单开放词汇语义分割模型S-Seg。
2401.12217|v2.innovation: 仅用伪掩码与语言直接训练MaskFormer实现像素级语言对齐，并支持自训练持续提升。
2401.12217|v2.result: 无需微调即可跨数据集泛化，性能随数据规模扩展并可通过自训练持续改进。

2411.14723|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统两阶段开放词汇分割（SAM掩码生成器+CLIP）计算开销大、内存效率低的问题，提出单阶段模型ESC-Net。ESC-Net在高效推理框架内复用SAM解码器块进行类无关分割，并将由图文相关性生成的伪提示嵌入SAM的可提示分割框架，实现精细的空间聚合与准确掩码预测。在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC和PASCAL-Context上，ESC-Net在效率与精度上均优于先前方法，消融实验验证了其在挑战性条件下的鲁棒性。
2411.14723|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and memory inefficiency of two-stage open-vocabulary segmentation combining SAM with CLIP. It proposes ESC-Net, a one-stage model that reuses SAM decoder blocks for class-agnostic segmentation and embeds pseudo prompts derived from image-text correlations into SAM's promptable framework for refined spatial aggregation. On ADE20K, PASCAL-VOC, and PASCAL-Context, ESC-Net outperforms prior methods in both efficiency and accuracy, with ablations confirming robustness.
2411.14723|v2.assessment: 将SAM解码器改造为单阶段开放词汇分割，兼顾效率与精度，工程价值较高。
2411.14723|v2.contribution: 提出单阶段开放词汇分割模型ESC-Net，复用SAM解码器块并嵌入图文相关伪提示。
2411.14723|v2.innovation: 在高效推理框架内将伪提示嵌入SAM可提示分割，实现精细空间聚合与准确掩码预测。
2411.14723|v2.result: 在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC、PASCAL-Context上效率与精度均超越先前方法。

2502.02548|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中缺乏精确3D区域分割、全面文本描述和足够数据规模的问题，提出自动数据生成管线与训练框架。该方法利用先进开放词汇图像分割模型和区域感知VLM自动生成高质量3D掩码-文本对，构建了含30K+场景、5.6M掩码-文本对的Mosaic3D-5.6M数据集，规模显著大于现有数据集。基于此提出Mosaic3D基础模型，结合对比学习训练的3D编码器与轻量掩码解码器，在ScanNet200、Matterport3D、ScanNet++等开放词汇3D语义与实例分割任务上取得SOTA。
2502.02548|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of precise 3D region segmentation, comprehensive textual descriptions, and sufficient scale for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding. It develops an automatic pipeline using open-vocabulary image segmentation and region-aware VLMs to generate high-quality 3D mask-text pairs, creating Mosaic3D-5.6M with over 30K scenes and 5.6M pairs. Building on this, Mosaic3D combines a contrastively trained 3D encoder with a lightweight mask decoder, achieving state-of-the-art open-vocabulary 3D semantic and instance segmentation on ScanNet200, Matterport3D, and ScanNet++.
2502.02548|v2.assessment: 大规模3D掩码-文本数据集与基础模型对开放词汇3D感知有重要推动作用，值得关注。
2502.02548|v2.contribution: 构建5.6M规模的3D掩码-文本数据集Mosaic3D-5.6M并提出开放词汇3D分割基础模型Mosaic3D。
2502.02548|v2.innovation: 利用开放词汇图像分割与区域感知VLM自动生成高质量3D掩码-文本对，实现大规模3D-语言对齐。
2502.02548|v2.result: 在ScanNet200、Matterport3D、ScanNet++等开放词汇3D语义与实例分割任务上取得SOTA。

2412.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇分割中掩码池化（mask pooling）反直觉地导致精确掩码无法带来准确CLIP分类的问题，提出Mask-Adapter。该方法从候选掩码中提取语义激活图，提供更丰富的上下文信息并确保掩码与CLIP对齐，同时提出掩码一致性损失，使IoU相近的候选掩码获得相似的CLIP嵌入以增强对掩码变化的鲁棒性。Mask-Adapter可以即插即用方式集成到基于掩码池化的开放词汇分割方法中，在多个基准上提供更准确的分类结果。
2412.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals the counterintuitive limitation that accurate masks often fail to yield accurate CLIP classification via mask pooling in open-vocabulary segmentation. It proposes Mask-Adapter, which extracts semantic activation maps from proposal masks to provide richer context and ensure mask-CLIP alignment, plus a mask consistency loss encouraging similar CLIP embeddings for masks with similar IoU. Mask-Adapter integrates plug-and-play into mask-pooling-based methods, delivering more accurate classification across benchmarks.
2412.04533|v2.assessment: 揭示了掩码池化的关键缺陷并给出简洁有效的即插即用修正，实用性强。
2412.04533|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的Mask-Adapter，通过语义激活图与掩码一致性损失改进开放词汇分割的掩码分类。
2412.04533|v2.innovation: 从候选掩码提取语义激活图替代直接池化，并用掩码一致性损失增强对掩码变化的鲁棒性。
2412.04533|v2.result: 可无缝集成到基于掩码池化的方法中，在多个基准上提供更准确的分类结果。

2503.18094|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇视频异常检测（OVVAD）中新颖异常的两大挑战——检测模糊（难以给陌生异常分配准确异常分数）和类别混淆（新颖异常常被误分为视觉相似的基类），提出Anomize框架。该方法利用多层级视觉数据与匹配文本信息等多源补充信息缓解检测模糊，并引入标签关系指导新标签编码以改善新颖视频与标签的对齐，从而减少类别混淆。在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上取得优越性能，验证了其在OVVAD上的有效性。
2503.18094|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two challenges in open-vocabulary video anomaly detection (OVVAD): detection ambiguity for unfamiliar anomalies and categorization confusion where novel anomalies are misclassified as visually similar base instances. It proposes Anomize, which leverages multi-level visual data and matching textual information to mitigate detection ambiguity, and incorporates label relations to guide encoding of new labels for better novel video-label alignment. Anomize achieves superior performance on UCF-Crime and XD-Violence.
2503.18094|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇设定引入视频异常检测并利用标签关系缓解混淆，对开放集感知有借鉴意义。
2503.18094|v2.contribution: 提出Anomize框架，利用多源信息与标签关系解决OVVAD中的检测模糊与类别混淆问题。
2503.18094|v2.innovation: 融合多层级视觉与匹配文本信息缓解检测模糊，并用标签关系指导新标签编码减少类别混淆。
2503.18094|v2.result: 在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上取得优越性能，验证了OVVAD中的有效性。

2503.00414|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇人-物交互检测中存在的特征粒度不足与语义相似性混淆两大问题，论文提出分层粒度比较网络SGC-Net。方法上设计了粒度感知对齐模块，将全局语义特征与中间层局部细节聚合以精炼交互表示，并构建层级分组比较模块，利用LLM递归地对类别进行比较与分组，生成细粒度且具判别性的描述。相比仅依赖最后一层视觉特征与CLIP知识蒸馏的已有方法，该工作更好地利用了中间层物体级细节并缓解了CLIP的类别偏置。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在未见交互类别检测上取得改进。
2503.00414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two challenges in open-vocabulary human-object interaction detection: feature granularity deficiency caused by aligning text only with last-layer visual features, and semantic similarity confusion arising from CLIP's class biases and label-only LLM descriptions. It proposes a Stratified Granular Comparison Network comprising a granularity sensing alignment module that aggregates global semantics with local details, and a hierarchical group comparison module that recursively compares and groups classes via LLMs to produce fine-grained discriminative descriptions. Compared with prior LLM-distillation methods, it better exploits intermediate object-level features and mitigates inter-class similarity confusion.
2503.00414|v2.assessment: 该工作对开放词汇HOI检测中的特征对齐与语义混淆问题给出了较有针对性的模块化设计，思路清晰，但摘要缺乏量化结果，且与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2503.00414|v2.contribution: 提出分层粒度比较网络SGC-Net，通过粒度感知对齐与层级分组比较缓解开放词汇HOI检测中的特征粒度不足与语义混淆。
2503.00414|v2.innovation: 利用LLM递归比较分组生成细粒度判别描述，并将中间层局部细节与全局语义聚合进行对齐。
2503.00414|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体数值指标，仅声称在开放词汇交互检测上优于依赖CLIP蒸馏的已有方法。

2601.05138|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频世界模型难以对相机与多物体运动提供统一且精确的控制，因为视频本质上是2D投影平面上的动态。本文提出VerseCrafter，一种几何驱动的视频世界模型，核心是4D Geometric Control表示：用静态背景点云与逐物体3D高斯轨迹编码世界状态，捕捉运动路径与随时间变化的三维概率占据，替代刚性包围盒与参数化模型。该方法将4D控制渲染为控制图注入预训练视频扩散模型，实现视角一致的高保真生成，并构建了含35K样本的VerseControl4D数据集与自动数据引擎。
2601.05138|v2.summary_en: Existing video world models struggle to provide unified and precise control over camera and multi-object motion, since videos capture dynamics in the projected 2D image plane. This paper introduces VerseCrafter, a geometry-driven video world model that generates dynamic realistic videos from a unified 4D geometric world state, represented as a static background point cloud plus per-object 3D Gaussian trajectories encoding motion paths and probabilistic 3D occupancy over time. These 4D controls are rendered into control maps for a pretrained video diffusion model, and an automatic data engine yields VerseControl4D, a 35K-sample real-world dataset, enabling high-fidelity, view-consistent generation that follows specified dynamics.
2601.05138|v2.assessment: 将4D几何控制（点云+3D高斯轨迹）与视频扩散模型结合，为可控视频生成提供了类别无关的统一表示，其数据引擎与数据集构建思路对自动驾驶场景仿真与合成数据生成有参考价值。
2601.05138|v2.contribution: 提出4D Geometric Control表示与VerseCrafter几何驱动视频世界模型，并构建35K规模的VerseControl4D数据集。
2601.05138|v2.innovation: 用静态背景点云加逐物体3D高斯轨迹统一编码相机与多物体运动，作为扩散模型的可控条件。
2601.05138|v2.result: 实现了视角一致、忠实跟随指定动态的高保真视频生成，并支持大规模自动数据构建。

2004.00070|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对卷积网络在连续多任务训练中出现的灾难性遗忘问题，提出条件通道门控网络（Conditional Channel Gated Networks）。方法是在每个卷积层引入任务特定的门控模块，动态选择对当前输入应用哪些滤波器，并通过稀疏目标鼓励只激活少量卷积核以保留学习新任务的容量；同时训练一个任务分类器以在测试时无任务标签（无 task oracle）的情况下预测样本所属任务。相比已有持续学习方案，该方法无需测试时任务身份即可保护旧任务的重要滤波器，在多个持续学习基准上验证了有效性。
2004.00070|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in convolutional networks trained on a sequence of tasks by introducing Conditional Channel Gated Networks. Each convolutional layer is equipped with task-specific gating modules that select which filters to apply, and a sparsity objective encourages activating only a limited set of kernels to preserve capacity for new tasks. A task classifier is additionally trained to predict task labels at test time, removing the need for a task oracle. Experiments on continual learning benchmarks validate the approach.
2004.00070|v2.assessment: 将条件计算与通道门控结合用于持续学习，并显式处理无任务标签场景，思路清晰且实用，对持续学习与动态网络研究者有参考价值。
2004.00070|v2.contribution: 提出带任务分类器的条件通道门控框架，在无任务 oracle 下实现持续学习。
2004.00070|v2.innovation: 用任务特定门控与稀疏目标同时实现旧任务滤波器保护和新任务容量保留。
2004.00070|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上验证了方法有效性，并支持无任务标签的测试设置。

2006.08509|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对资源受限硬件上的高效推理，提出 APQ 框架，将网络架构、剪枝策略和量化策略从以往的分步搜索改为联合优化。为应对联合搜索带来的巨大设计空间，作者训练量化感知（int8）精度预测器以快速评估量化模型精度，并通过从全精度（fp32）精度预测器迁移知识来大幅提升样本效率；fp32 预测器数据可仅通过从预训练 once-for-all 网络采样评估获得，无需训练成本。在 ImageNet 上的大量实验证明了联合优化的收益。
2006.08509|v2.summary_en: APQ jointly searches neural architecture, pruning policy, and quantization policy for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware, instead of optimizing them separately. To handle the enlarged design space, it transfers knowledge from an fp32 accuracy predictor to an int8 quantization-aware predictor, greatly improving sample efficiency, while fp32 predictor data is collected by sampling from a pretrained once-for-all network without training cost. Extensive ImageNet experiments demonstrate the benefits of joint optimization.
2006.08509|v2.assessment: 将 NAS、剪枝与量化统一到联合搜索框架，并用知识迁移解决量化精度预测的样本效率瓶颈，对模型压缩与高效推理研究者有较高参考价值。
2006.08509|v2.contribution: 提出联合搜索架构、剪枝与量化策略的 APQ 框架。
2006.08509|v2.innovation: 用 fp32 到 int8 精度预测器的知识迁移提升量化感知搜索的样本效率。
2006.08509|v2.result: 在 ImageNet 上验证了联合优化相比分步方法的性能优势。

2005.03354|v2.summary_cn: 论文将通道剪枝视为从未剪枝网络中搜索最优子结构的问题，指出现有方法需训练和评估大量结构，效率受限。为此提出可微马尔可夫通道剪枝（DMCP），把通道剪枝建模为马尔可夫过程：每个状态表示保留对应通道，状态间转移表示剪枝过程，从而可直接用梯度下降对标准任务损失和 FLOPs 预算正则进行优化，隐式地为每层选择合适通道数。在 ImageNet 上对 ResNet 和 MobileNetV2 的大量实验表明，该方法在不同 FLOPs 设置下均一致优于当时最先进的剪枝方法。
2005.03354|v2.summary_en: This paper treats channel pruning as searching an optimal sub-structure from an unpruned network and proposes Differentiable Markov Channel Pruning (DMCP). Channel pruning is modeled as a Markov process where states represent retaining channels and transitions denote pruning, enabling direct gradient-based optimization of the task loss and a FLOPs budget regularizer, implicitly selecting per-layer channel numbers. Extensive ImageNet experiments on ResNet and MobileNetV2 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art pruning methods across various FLOPs settings.
2005.03354|v2.assessment: 用马尔可夫过程建模通道剪枝并实现端到端可微优化，方法优雅且实验扎实，是通道剪枝方向值得关注的工作。
2005.03354|v2.contribution: 提出可微马尔可夫通道剪枝框架 DMCP。
2005.03354|v2.innovation: 将通道剪枝建模为可梯度优化的马尔可夫过程以隐式确定每层通道数。
2005.03354|v2.result: 在 ImageNet 上 ResNet 与 MobileNetV2 的不同 FLOPs 设置下均优于 SOTA 剪枝方法。

Learning Filter Pruning Criteria for Dee.summary_en: This paper, titled Learning Filter Pruning Criteria for Deep Convolutional Neural Networks Acceleration, aims to learn pruning criteria for filter pruning to accelerate convolutional networks. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology, comparisons, and experimental results cannot be verified. Based on the title, the core idea is to learn which filters to prune rather than relying on hand-crafted heuristics.
Learning Filter Pruning Criteria for Dee.assessment: 滤波器剪枝准则学习是有价值的方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法质量与实际效果。
Learning Filter Pruning Criteria for Dee.contribution: 提出为滤波器剪枝学习剪枝准则的方法。

Structured Compression by Weight Encrypt.summary_en: This paper proposes structured compression by weight encryption for unstructured pruning and quantization. Due to the missing abstract, the specific encryption mechanism, comparisons with prior work, and experimental results cannot be verified. Based on the title, the idea is likely to transform unstructured pruned and quantized weights into a structured form via an encryption-like rearrangement to achieve practical speedup.

Structured Compression by Weight Encrypt.contribution: 提出通过权重加密实现结构化压缩以统一处理非结构化剪枝与量化。
Structured Compression by Weight Encrypt.innovation: 用权重加密式重排把非结构化稀疏与量化转化为结构化形式。

2003.08935|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对网络压缩中滤波剪枝与低秩分解两种技术各自适用场景受限的问题，提出在统一框架下分析二者：通过改变稀疏正则化的施加方式即可分别导出滤波剪枝与低秩分解，从而在两者互补的场景（如ResNet残差块最后一层卷积，剪枝无法处理而低秩分解可以）中灵活选择。作者进一步提出对整个网络进行联合压缩而非逐层压缩。在多个基准上该方法与当时最先进方法相比具有竞争力。
2003.08935|v2.summary_en: This paper unifies filter pruning and low-rank decomposition by showing that both can be derived from the same sparsity regularization with different enforcement schemes, offering a flexible compression choice that exploits their complementarity (e.g., the last conv layer in a ResBlock). It further proposes joint whole-network compression instead of layer-wise compression, and compares favorably against state-of-the-art methods on several benchmarks.
2003.08935|v2.assessment: 将剪枝与分解统一到稀疏正则视角的思路清晰，对网络压缩研究者有方法论参考价值，但实验细节与量化结果在摘要中披露有限。
2003.08935|v2.contribution: 提出统一稀疏正则框架，将滤波剪枝与低秩分解视为同一机制的不同实现，并支持全网络联合压缩。
2003.08935|v2.innovation: 通过改变稀疏正则化施加方式统一导出剪枝与分解，并利用二者互补性处理残差连接中的压缩难题。
2003.08935|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得与当时最先进方法相当或更优的压缩性能。

2002.10179|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有滤波剪枝方法缺乏理论指导、剪枝设计训练效率低且人工成本高的问题，提出基于特征图高秩（HRank）的剪枝方法。作者发现单个滤波器生成的多个特征图的平均秩恒定，与输入图像批次数无关，据此将剪枝形式化为剔除低秩特征图对应的滤波器，因为低秩特征图信息量少、更易恢复。实验还表明高秩特征图对应的权重包含更多重要信息，即使部分不更新对性能影响也很小。无需额外约束，HRank在多个基准上显著优于当时最先进方法。
2002.10179|v2.summary_en: The paper proposes HRank, a filter pruning criterion based on the observation that the average rank of feature maps produced by a single filter is invariant to the number of input batches. Filters generating low-rank feature maps are pruned as they carry less information and are easily reproduced, while high-rank weights are shown to be more important. Without additional constraints, HRank significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks.
2002.10179|v2.assessment: 以特征图秩作为剪枝准则具有明确的理论动机和可复现性，是结构化剪枝方向较有影响力的工作。
2002.10179|v2.contribution: 提出基于特征图平均秩的滤波剪枝准则 HRank，并给出其与批次数无关的经验规律。
2002.10179|v2.innovation: 首次利用特征图秩的稳定性作为滤波器重要性度量，避免引入额外约束或复杂搜索。
2002.10179|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著超越当时最先进的剪枝方法。

1911.08114|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对滤波级剪枝中残差连接难以剪枝以及小数据场景下剪枝效果差两个开放问题，提出 CURL 方法。作者用基于 KL 散度的准则同时剪枝残差连接内外的通道，并观察到直接在小数据集上剪枝通常不如在大数据集上剪枝或从头训练的小模型；为此引入知识蒸馏补偿有限数据，并提出标签精炼方法以缓解教师模型 logits 的噪声。实验表明 CURL 在 ImageNet 上显著优于此前最先进方法，在小数据集上剪枝也能达到与微调预训练小模型相当甚至更好的性能。
1911.08114|v2.summary_en: CURL addresses two open issues in filter pruning: pruning residual connections and pruning with limited data. It prunes channels both inside and outside residual connections via a KL-divergence criterion, and compensates for limited data with knowledge distillation plus a label refinement scheme to suppress noisy teacher logits. CURL significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art on ImageNet and matches or surpasses fine-tuning a pretrained small model when pruning on small datasets.
1911.08114|v2.assessment: 同时处理残差结构与有限数据两个实际痛点，标签精炼思路对蒸馏噪声问题有针对性，工程实用性强。
1911.08114|v2.contribution: 提出 CURL，用 KL 散度准则剪枝残差连接内外通道，并结合知识蒸馏与标签精炼应对有限数据剪枝。
1911.08114|v2.innovation: 将残差连接通道剪枝与标签精炼式知识蒸馏结合，缓解小数据剪枝的性能退化。
1911.08114|v2.result: 在 ImageNet 上显著超越此前最先进方法，小数据剪枝性能可与微调预训练小模型相当或更优。
