However, with no abstract provided, its specific method, comparisons, and experimental results cannot be verified, so the assessment is based solely on the title.

Automatic Neural Network Compression by.summary_cn: 该论文题为《Automatic Neural Network Compression by Sparsity-Quantization Joint Learning: A Constrained Optimization-Based Approach》，从标题看研究的是将稀疏化与量化联合学习、以约束优化方式实现自动网络压缩，属于模型压缩方向。由于摘要为空，无法确认其具体约束建模方式、与已有工作的对比以及实验数据。相关度评估为中等，质量判断存在不确定性。

As no abstract is provided, its formulation, comparisons, and empirical results cannot be verified.

Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.summary_cn: 针对深度网络压缩中知识蒸馏依赖大量训练数据、在少样本场景下难以应用的问题，本文提出少样本知识蒸馏（FSKD）框架。方法通过将教师网络的特征/激活分布建模为高斯混合模型，从少量样本中采样生成伪数据，再用这些伪数据训练学生网络。相比需要原始大数据集的传统蒸馏，FSKD 在仅有极少样本时仍能恢复接近完整数据蒸馏的精度。实验在 CIFAR 与 ImageNet 上验证，少样本条件下压缩模型精度显著优于直接微调与朴素蒸馏基线。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge distillation for network compression when only a few training samples are available. It proposes Few Sample Knowledge Distillation (FSKD), which models teacher feature/activation distributions with Gaussian mixture models and samples synthetic data to train the student. Compared with conventional distillation requiring the full dataset, FSKD recovers accuracy close to full-data distillation under extreme data scarcity, as validated on CIFAR and ImageNet.
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.assessment: 把少样本学习与蒸馏结合，思路清晰且实用，对数据受限的模型压缩场景有参考价值。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.contribution: 提出基于教师激活分布采样的少样本知识蒸馏框架，实现极少数据下的高效网络压缩。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.innovation: 用高斯混合模型建模教师特征分布并采样伪数据替代原始训练集进行蒸馏。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.result: 在极少样本下蒸馏精度接近完整数据蒸馏，明显优于朴素蒸馏与微调基线。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef._arxiv_id: Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Network Compression.

DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.summary_cn: 针对现有稀疏化方法多依赖 L1/L2 等非尺度不变正则、导致稀疏度与权重尺度耦合的问题，本文提出 DeepHoyer 可微稀疏度量。方法引入 Hoyer 度量作为尺度不变的稀疏正则项，并给出其可微实现，可直接嵌入标准训练流程实现端到端稀疏化。相比 L1 正则，DeepHoyer 在相同稀疏度下获得更高精度，且稀疏度对超参更鲁棒。在 CIFAR/ImageNet 上对多种网络结构实现了优于基线的稀疏-精度权衡。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the scale-dependence of common sparsity regularizers such as L1/L2, which couples sparsity with weight magnitude. It proposes DeepHoyer, a differentiable, scale-invariant sparsity measure based on the Hoyer metric that can be embedded into standard training for end-to-end sparsification. Compared with L1 regularization, DeepHoyer achieves better accuracy at matched sparsity and greater robustness to hyperparameters across CIFAR and ImageNet.
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.assessment: 从稀疏度量本质出发改进正则化，理论动机扎实，对剪枝与稀疏训练研究有借鉴意义。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出尺度不变的可微 Hoyer 稀疏度量，用于端到端神经网络稀疏化训练。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.innovation: 将尺度不变的 Hoyer 度量可微化并作为正则项嵌入训练，解耦稀疏度与权重尺度。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.result: 在相同稀疏度下精度优于 L1 正则基线，且对稀疏超参更鲁棒。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo._arxiv_id: DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Network with Differentiable Scale-Invariant Sparsity Measures.

Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.summary_cn: 针对稀疏数据中零值填充（zero imputation）会引入分布偏差、损害训练的问题，本文分析并量化了零填充带来的稀疏偏差。方法提出在训练中对缺失/稀疏特征进行偏差校正，通过调整梯度或引入补偿项缓解零值主导的优化偏差。相比直接零填充的常规做法，该方法在稀疏特征场景下提升了模型收敛与泛化。实验在推荐/稀疏特征数据集上验证了校正后性能的稳定提升。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.summary_en: This paper studies the sparsity bias introduced by zero imputation when training on sparse data. It analyzes and quantifies the bias and proposes a correction scheme that adjusts optimization to mitigate zero-dominated gradients. Compared with naive zero imputation, the method improves convergence and generalization on sparse-feature benchmarks.
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.assessment: 问题分析有价值，但更偏通用机器学习，与视觉感知主线关联较弱。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.contribution: 揭示零填充导致的稀疏偏差并提出训练期偏差校正方法。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.innovation: 从优化偏差角度解释零填充的负面影响并给出校正机制。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.result: 在稀疏特征任务上相比零填充基线取得稳定的性能提升。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti._arxiv_id: Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcting Sparsity Bias in Training Neural Networks.

Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_cn: 针对通道剪枝中重要性评估忽略算子类型差异、且离散剪枝不可微的问题，本文提出操作感知的可微软通道剪枝方法。方法为不同算子（卷积、深度卷积等）设计操作感知的重要性度量，并用可微掩码进行软剪枝，实现端到端优化。相比统一度量的剪枝方法，本方法在相同压缩率下保留更高精度。在 ImageNet 等基准上取得优于多种剪枝基线的压缩-精度权衡。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_en: This paper addresses channel pruning where importance criteria ignore operator-type differences and discrete pruning is non-differentiable. It proposes operation-aware soft channel pruning with differentiable masks, designing operator-specific importance measures optimized end-to-end. Compared with uniform-criterion pruning, it retains higher accuracy at matched compression on ImageNet.
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.assessment: 操作感知与可微掩码结合，工程实用性强，对高效模型部署有参考价值。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.contribution: 提出操作感知的可微软通道剪枝框架，实现端到端结构化压缩。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.innovation: 针对不同算子设计差异化重要性度量并用可微掩码联合优化。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.result: 在相同压缩率下精度优于多种通道剪枝基线。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi._arxiv_id: Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning using Differentiable Masks.

Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_cn: 针对剪枝后网络对对抗样本更脆弱的问题，本文提出对抗神经剪枝与潜在脆弱性抑制（ANP-LVS）。方法在剪枝过程中联合优化对抗鲁棒性，通过抑制中间层潜在脆弱性来提升剪枝模型的对抗防御能力。相比仅追求压缩率的剪枝方法，本方法在保持压缩的同时显著提升对抗鲁棒性。实验表明剪枝模型在对抗攻击下的精度下降明显减小。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_en: This paper tackles the increased adversarial vulnerability of pruned networks. It proposes Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent Vulnerability Suppression (ANP-LVS), which jointly optimizes pruning and adversarial robustness by suppressing latent vulnerabilities in intermediate layers. Compared with compression-only pruning, it substantially improves adversarial robustness while maintaining compression.
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.assessment: 把剪枝与对抗鲁棒性结合，视角新颖，对安全敏感的部署场景有启发。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.contribution: 提出联合剪枝与对抗鲁棒性优化的 ANP-LVS 方法。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.innovation: 通过抑制中间层潜在脆弱性来提升剪枝网络的对抗防御能力。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.result: 在保持压缩率的同时显著降低对抗攻击下的精度损失。

Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_cn: 针对彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）缺乏理论支撑的问题，本文从理论上证明剪枝的充分性。方法构造性地证明：对任意有界规模的目标网络，存在一个多项式规模的稀疏子网络，仅通过剪枝即可逼近该目标网络。相比以往仅靠实验观察的彩票假设工作，本文给出严格的理论证明，说明剪枝本身足以表达任意目标函数。结论为稀疏子网络的可表达性提供了理论保证。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_en: This paper provides theoretical grounding for the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis by proving that pruning is sufficient. It constructively shows that for any bounded-size target network there exists a polynomially-sized sparse subnetwork that approximates it via pruning alone. Unlike prior empirical studies, it gives a rigorous proof that pruning alone suffices for expressivity.
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.assessment: 理论贡献突出，为剪枝与稀疏网络研究提供了重要的可表达性保证，值得关注。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.contribution: 从理论上证明存在多项式规模的稀疏子网络可逼近任意有界目标网络。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.innovation: 首次以构造性证明给出剪枝充分性的严格理论保证。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.result: 证明剪枝即可实现任意目标网络逼近，为彩票假设提供理论支撑。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P._arxiv_id: Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: Pruning is All You Need.

DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度神经网络参数冗余、推理开销大的问题，提出 DropNet 迭代剪枝方法，通过逐轮移除对损失影响最小的滤波器/连接并微调来压缩模型。相比一次性剪枝，迭代式移除能在相同压缩率下更好保留精度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文确认在 CIFAR/ImageNet 上的压缩率-精度曲线。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundancy of deep neural networks by proposing DropNet, an iterative pruning scheme that progressively removes the least important filters/connections followed by fine-tuning. Compared with one-shot pruning, the iterative procedure better preserves accuracy at comparable compression ratios. The abstract reports no concrete dataset or numerical results, so empirical gains must be verified in the full text.
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.assessment: 属于经典的迭代剪枝思路，方法简单实用，但创新性有限，且摘要缺乏量化结果，对以检测/BEV 为主的研究者参考价值中等。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.contribution: 提出一种迭代式网络剪枝流程以在压缩模型的同时维持精度。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.innovation: 以多轮渐进移除替代一次性剪枝，缓解精度骤降。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，需正文验证压缩率与精度权衡。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex._arxiv_id: DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complexity via Iterative Pruning.

Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_cn: 该论文针对剪枝缺乏理论保证的问题，研究是否存在性能可证明的稀疏子网络，并提出基于贪心前向选择的剪枝算法（GREEDY FORWARD SELECTION）。相比依赖启发式重要性评分的剪枝，该方法在理论上证明可找到与稠密网络性能相当的稀疏子网络，并给出近似保证。摘要未列出具体精度数字，但理论贡献明确，对理解彩票假设类问题有参考价值。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of theoretical guarantees in pruning by asking whether provably good sparse subnetworks exist, and proposes a greedy forward selection algorithm for pruning. Unlike heuristic importance-based pruning, it provides provable guarantees that the selected subnetwork matches the dense network's performance. The abstract gives no explicit accuracy numbers, but the theoretical contribution is clear and relevant to lottery-ticket-style questions.
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.assessment: 为剪枝提供了可证明的性能保证，理论性强，适合关注模型压缩理论基础的读者。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.contribution: 提出带理论保证的贪心前向选择剪枝算法，证明优质稀疏子网络的存在性。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.innovation: 将剪枝建模为贪心前向选择并给出近似性能保证。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.result: 理论上证明所选子网络可达到与稠密网络相当的性能。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning._arxiv_id: Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning via Greedy Forward Selection.

Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_cn: 该论文针对离散数据（图、图像等）上随机平滑鲁棒性认证计算代价高的问题，提出稀疏感知的随机平滑方法，利用离散域的稀疏结构高效计算鲁棒性证书。相比面向连续输入的通用认证方法，该方法在离散数据上显著降低计算开销并扩展可认证范围。摘要未给出具体实验数值，但方法对图与离散图像分类的认证有实用意义，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of randomized-smoothing robustness certification on discrete data such as graphs and images by proposing a sparsity-aware randomized smoothing scheme. Exploiting discrete-domain sparsity, it computes robustness certificates far more efficiently than generic continuous-input certification. The abstract reports no explicit numbers, and the topic is only loosely related to autonomous-driving perception.
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.assessment: 在离散数据鲁棒性认证方向有方法学价值，但与检测/BEV/占用等感知任务关联度低，属于外围相关。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.contribution: 提出面向离散数据的稀疏感知随机平滑鲁棒性认证方法。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.innovation: 利用离散域稀疏结构降低认证计算复杂度。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在离散数据上高效获得鲁棒性证书。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di._arxiv_id: Efficient Robustness Certificates for Discrete Data: Sparsity-Aware Randomized Smoothing for Graphs, Images and More.

Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.summary_cn: 该论文研究矩阵流（matrix streams）中的 Schatten 范数估计问题，针对数据以流式方式到达、维度极大的场景，提出利用稀疏性实现与维度无关（dimension-free）的算法。相比传统依赖维度的估计方法，该方法在稀疏流模型下将空间与时间开销与稀疏度而非维度挂钩。摘要未给出具体误差数值，属于理论算法方向，与视觉感知任务基本无关。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.summary_en: This paper studies estimating Schatten norms in matrix streams, targeting streaming, high-dimensional settings, and proposes sparsity-exploiting algorithms whose complexity is independent of the dimension. In contrast to dimension-dependent estimators, the approach ties space and time costs to sparsity rather than dimensionality. The abstract provides no explicit error bounds, and the work is theoretical and essentially unrelated to visual perception.
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.assessment: 纯理论流式算法工作，与目标检测、BEV、占用等视觉感知方向几乎无交集，仅对稀疏优化理论感兴趣的读者有价值。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.contribution: 提出矩阵流中利用稀疏性的维度无关 Schatten 范数估计算法。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.innovation: 以稀疏度替代维度作为复杂度度量，实现 dimension-free 估计。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在稀疏流下实现与维度无关的估计。

2103.16788|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类别增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中有限内存条件下的稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，提出了一种基于动态可扩展表示的两阶段学习方法。在每个增量步骤中，冻结已学到的表示，并通过新的可学习特征提取器扩展特征维度，同时引入基于通道级掩码的剪枝策略根据新概念复杂度动态扩展表示，并设计辅助损失鼓励学习多样且具判别性的特征。在三个类别增量学习基准上，该方法以较大幅度持续超越现有方法。
2103.16788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class incremental learning under limited memory, aiming for a better stability-plasticity trade-off. It proposes a two-stage approach with dynamically expandable representation: freezing previously learned features and augmenting them with new learnable dimensions, while using channel-level mask-based pruning to adapt expansion to concept complexity and an auxiliary loss for diverse discriminative features. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show consistent and large-margin improvements over prior methods.
2103.16788|v2.assessment: 该工作为增量学习中的表示扩展与剪枝提供了有效结合，实验充分且性能提升显著，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习场景有参考价值。
2103.16788|v2.contribution: 提出动态可扩展表示与通道级掩码剪枝相结合的两阶段增量学习框架。
2103.16788|v2.innovation: 根据新概念复杂度动态扩展表示，并引入辅助损失增强特征多样性。
2103.16788|v2.result: 在三个类别增量学习基准上以较大幅度持续超越现有方法。

2011.14563|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对稀疏对应点中的运动一致性建模难题，提出了拉普拉斯运动一致性网络（LMCNet）用于对应点剪枝。作者将拟合一致运动的问题形式化为对应点图上的平滑函数，并证明该形式可通过图拉普拉斯获得闭式解，从而设计出可微层以从候选对应点中捕获全局运动一致性，再与局部层提取的局部一致性结合以鲁棒检测内点。实验表明，LMCNet在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝上均优于现有最优方法。
2011.14563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles motion coherence modeling on sparse putative correspondences for correspondence pruning. It proposes LMCNet, formulating coherent motion fitting as a smooth function on a correspondence graph with a closed-form solution via graph Laplacian, enabling a differentiable layer for global motion coherence combined with a local layer. Experiments show superior performance over state-of-the-art in relative camera pose estimation and correspondence pruning of dynamic scenes.
2011.14563|v2.assessment: 该工作将图拉普拉斯闭式解引入可微学习框架，为运动一致性建模提供了新思路，对SLAM和三维重建中的对应点筛选有参考价值。
2011.14563|v2.contribution: 提出基于图拉普拉斯闭式解的拉普拉斯运动一致性网络用于对应点剪枝。
2011.14563|v2.innovation: 将运动一致性拟合形式化为图上的平滑函数并获得闭式解，设计可微层。
2011.14563|v2.result: 在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝上超越现有最优方法。

Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像超分辨率（SR）网络推理效率低的问题，提出在SR网络中进行稀疏化以加速推理。作者设计了针对SR任务的稀疏化方法，通过分析SR网络中不同层的冗余性，对卷积核或通道进行结构化稀疏，并结合稀疏卷积实现实际加速。相比已有通用剪枝方法，该方法考虑了SR任务的特性（如残差连接、上采样结构），在保持重建质量的同时减少计算量。实验在多个SR基准和网络上取得了显著的FLOPs降低和速度提升，PSNR下降控制在较小范围内。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of image super-resolution (SR) networks by exploring sparsity for efficient inference. The authors propose a sparsity-aware method tailored to SR architectures, analyzing layer-wise redundancy and applying structured sparsity with sparse convolution for actual speedup. Compared to generic pruning methods, it accounts for SR-specific structures such as residual connections and upsampling, achieving significant FLOPs reduction and speedup with minimal PSNR drop on multiple SR benchmarks.
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.assessment: 该工作将稀疏化技术适配到超分辨率任务，对关注模型压缩与高效推理的研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.contribution: 提出了面向图像超分辨率网络的结构化稀疏化方法，实现了推理加速与重建质量的平衡。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.innovation: 针对SR网络特性（残差与上采样结构）设计稀疏化策略，而非直接套用通用剪枝。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.result: 在多个SR基准上显著降低FLOPs并提升推理速度，PSNR下降控制在较小范围。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu._arxiv_id: Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolution for Efficient Inference.

Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中全局稀疏度约束难以有效实现的问题，提出了一种有效的全局稀疏化方法。作者通过引入全局稀疏约束，将剪枝问题转化为在全局范围内分配稀疏度的优化问题，并设计了相应的训练与剪枝流程。相比逐层固定稀疏度的传统方法，全局约束能更灵活地分配各层稀疏度，从而在相同压缩率下保留更高精度。实验在多个网络和数据集上验证了该方法在压缩率和精度上的优势。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of enforcing global sparsity constraints in neural network pruning by proposing an effective global sparsification method. The authors formulate pruning as a global sparsity allocation optimization and design a training-and-pruning pipeline accordingly. Unlike layer-wise fixed-sparsity approaches, the global constraint allows flexible per-layer sparsity allocation, preserving higher accuracy at the same compression ratio, as validated on multiple networks and datasets.
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.assessment: 该工作为全局稀疏约束剪枝提供了有效方案，对模型压缩方向的研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出了基于全局稀疏约束的有效神经网络稀疏化方法。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.innovation: 将剪枝建模为全局稀疏度分配优化，突破逐层固定稀疏度的限制。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.result: 在相同压缩率下相比逐层剪枝方法取得更高精度。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo._arxiv_id: Effective Sparsification of Neural Networks With Global Sparsity Constraint.

Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端实时超分辨率的需求，提出联合神经架构搜索与剪枝搜索的方法。作者将架构搜索与剪枝策略纳入统一搜索空间，通过硬件感知的搜索目标，自动寻找在移动设备上可实时运行的SR网络。相比单独进行架构搜索或剪枝，联合搜索能更好地平衡精度与延迟。实验在移动平台上实现了实时超分辨率，并在重建质量与推理速度上优于现有方法。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_en: This paper targets on-mobile real-time super-resolution by jointly searching neural architectures and pruning strategies. The authors integrate architecture search and pruning into a unified search space with hardware-aware objectives to automatically find SR networks that run in real time on mobile devices. Compared to separate NAS or pruning, the joint search better balances accuracy and latency, achieving real-time SR on mobile with superior quality-speed trade-offs.
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.assessment: 该工作将NAS与剪枝结合用于移动端实时SR，对关注高效模型设计与硬件部署的研究者有参考价值。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.contribution: 提出了联合神经架构与剪枝搜索的方法，实现移动端实时超分辨率。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.innovation: 将架构搜索与剪枝搜索统一到硬件感知的搜索框架中。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.result: 在移动平台上实现实时SR，并在质量与速度上优于现有方法。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso._arxiv_id: Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Resolution with Neural Architecture and Pruning Search.

ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN剪枝中精度损失难以避免的问题，提出ResRep方法，通过解耦“记忆”与“遗忘”实现无损剪枝。作者将卷积核分解为记忆部分和遗忘部分，在训练中逐步抑制遗忘部分，从而在剪枝时直接移除而不影响输出。相比传统剪枝需要微调恢复精度，ResRep在移除通道后无需微调即可保持原始精度。实验在ResNet、MobileNet等网络上实现了无损压缩，显著减少参数量和计算量。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_en: This paper addresses the inevitable accuracy loss in CNN pruning by proposing ResRep, which decouples remembering and forgetting for lossless pruning. The authors decompose convolution kernels into remembering and forgetting parts, progressively suppressing the forgetting part during training so it can be removed without affecting outputs. Unlike conventional pruning that requires fine-tuning, ResRep maintains original accuracy after channel removal, achieving lossless compression on ResNet, MobileNet, and others.
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.assessment: ResRep提出了优雅的无损剪枝框架，方法简洁且效果显著，是模型压缩领域值得关注的工作。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.contribution: 提出了通过解耦记忆与遗忘实现无损CNN剪枝的ResRep方法。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.innovation: 将卷积核分解为记忆与遗忘部分，剪枝后无需微调即可保持精度。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.result: 在ResNet、MobileNet等网络上实现无损压缩，显著减少参数量与计算量。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl._arxiv_id: ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupling Remembering and Forgetting.

GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中门控机制训练不稳定的问题，提出GDP方法，通过可微分极化稳定门控剪枝。作者设计了可微分极化函数，使门控变量在训练中逐渐极化到0或1，从而稳定地决定通道保留或剪除。相比软门控或硬阈值方法，GDP在训练稳定性和剪枝效果上更优。实验在多个网络和数据集上验证了其在压缩率与精度上的竞争力。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_en: This paper addresses unstable gate training in neural network pruning by proposing GDP, which stabilizes gated pruning via differentiable polarization. The authors design a differentiable polarization function that gradually polarizes gate variables to 0 or 1, stably deciding channel retention or removal. Compared to soft-gating or hard-thresholding, GDP achieves better training stability and pruning performance, as validated on multiple networks and datasets.
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.assessment: GDP为门控剪枝提供了稳定的可微分极化方案，对模型压缩方向的研究者有参考价值。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.contribution: 提出了基于可微分极化的稳定门控剪枝方法GDP。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.innovation: 设计可微分极化函数使门控变量稳定收敛到0/1。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.result: 在多个网络和数据集上取得有竞争力的压缩率与精度。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v._arxiv_id: GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning via Gates with Differentiable Polarization.

Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中结构决策依赖人工经验的问题，提出Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder方法，将剪枝建模为图结构学习问题。作者将网络表示为图，利用图编码器-解码器自动学习各层或通道的剪枝决策。相比手工设计的剪枝准则，该方法能自动发现更优的剪枝结构。实验在多个网络上验证了其在压缩率与精度上的有效性。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual heuristics in neural network pruning by proposing an Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder approach that formulates pruning as graph structure learning. The authors represent the network as a graph and use a graph encoder-decoder to automatically learn pruning decisions for layers or channels. Compared to hand-crafted criteria, it discovers better pruning structures, with effectiveness validated on multiple networks.
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.assessment: 该工作将图学习引入剪枝决策，为自动化剪枝提供了新思路，对模型压缩方向有参考价值。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.contribution: 提出了基于图编码器-解码器的自动神经网络剪枝方法。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.innovation: 将剪枝建模为图结构学习，自动学习剪枝决策。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.result: 在多个网络上取得有效的压缩率与精度表现。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne._arxiv_id: Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Network Pruning.

Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对特征匹配中大量外点导致对应关系估计不鲁棒的问题，提出了一种基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝方法。方法通过迭代地学习局部共识并逐步剔除错误匹配，从而在保持内点的同时抑制外点。相比传统RANSAC或固定阈值剪枝，该方法能自适应地处理不同外点比例的场景。在多个标准匹配数据集上取得了优于现有方法的匹配精度和鲁棒性。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of robust correspondence estimation in the presence of a large number of outliers by proposing a progressive correspondence pruning method based on consensus learning. The method iteratively learns local consensus and gradually removes false matches while preserving inliers. It outperforms traditional RANSAC and fixed-threshold pruning on standard matching benchmarks, achieving higher matching accuracy and robustness.
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.assessment: 该工作为特征匹配中的外点剔除提供了新的学习范式，对自动驾驶中多传感器标定或SLAM有一定参考价值，但直接相关性有限。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.contribution: 提出了一种基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝框架，能自适应地剔除错误匹配。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.innovation: 将共识学习引入渐进式剪枝过程，实现了对高外点率场景的鲁棒匹配。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.result: 在多个匹配基准上取得了优于现有方法的匹配精度和鲁棒性。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co._arxiv_id: Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Consensus Learning.

Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_cn: 该论文针对冷冻电子断层扫描（Cryo-ET）体积图像去噪问题，提出了一种仅从单张噪声体积中自监督学习恢复干净体积的方法。方法利用稀疏性约束和噪声建模，无需配对干净数据即可训练去噪网络。相比需要大量干净数据或配对数据的监督方法，该方法在数据获取困难的Cryo-ET场景下更具实用性。实验表明，该方法在多个Cryo-ET数据集上有效提升了图像质量，并保留了生物结构细节。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_en: This paper tackles volumetric image restoration for cryo-electron tomography (Cryo-ET) by proposing a self-supervised method that learns from a single noisy volume with sparsity constraints. The approach requires no paired clean data, making it practical for Cryo-ET where clean references are unavailable. Experiments on multiple Cryo-ET datasets show improved image quality and preservation of biological structures.
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.assessment: 该工作属于生物医学图像恢复领域，与自动驾驶感知无关，但自监督单体积去噪思路对低数据场景下的视觉任务有启发。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.contribution: 提出了一种基于稀疏性约束的单噪声体积自监督Cryo-ET图像恢复方法。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.innovation: 无需配对干净数据，仅从单张噪声体积中学习去噪，解决了Cryo-ET数据获取难题。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.result: 在多个Cryo-ET数据集上有效提升了图像质量并保留了生物结构细节。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography Volumetric Image Restoration from Single Noisy Volume with Sparsity Constraint.

Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中计算资源消耗大的问题，提出了一种在线多粒度蒸馏方法。方法在训练过程中同时从多个粒度（如像素级、特征级、判别器级）进行知识蒸馏，实现在线压缩生成器。相比离线蒸馏或单粒度蒸馏，该方法能更灵活地平衡压缩率和生成质量。在多个GAN压缩基准上取得了优于现有方法的压缩效果和生成质量。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational cost of GAN compression by proposing an online multi-granularity distillation method. The approach performs knowledge distillation at multiple granularities (e.g., pixel, feature, and discriminator levels) during training to compress the generator online. It achieves better trade-offs between compression rate and generation quality than offline or single-granularity distillation, outperforming existing methods on multiple GAN compression benchmarks.
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.assessment: 该工作为GAN压缩提供了有效的在线蒸馏方案，对模型轻量化有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接关联较弱。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.contribution: 提出了一种在线多粒度知识蒸馏框架用于GAN压缩。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.innovation: 在训练过程中同时从多个粒度进行蒸馏，实现在线压缩并灵活平衡压缩率与生成质量。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.result: 在多个GAN压缩基准上取得了优于现有方法的压缩效果和生成质量。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo._arxiv_id: Online Multi-Granularity Distillation for GAN Compression.

2102.11535|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中训练超网或评估架构带来的巨大资源消耗和搜索偏差问题，提出了无需训练的NAS框架TE-NAS。方法通过分析神经正切核（NTK）的谱和输入空间中线性区域的数量来对架构进行排序，这两个指标分别反映网络的可训练性和表达性，且无需任何训练和标签。进一步设计了基于剪枝的搜索机制以在可训练性和表达性之间取得更优权衡。在NAS-Bench-201和DARTS搜索空间上，TE-NAS在四个GPU小时内即可找到优于现有方法的架构。
2102.11535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy resource consumption and search bias in Neural Architecture Search (NAS) by proposing a training-free framework called TE-NAS. It ranks architectures by analyzing the spectrum of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) and the number of linear regions in the input space, which reflect trainability and expressivity without any training or labels. A pruning-based search mechanism is designed to balance these two metrics. On NAS-Bench-201 and DARTS search spaces, TE-NAS finds architectures outperforming existing methods within four GPU hours.
2102.11535|v2.assessment: 该工作为NAS提供了无需训练的高效评估指标，理论动机清晰，实验充分，对自动化模型设计有重要参考价值。
2102.11535|v2.contribution: 提出了无需训练的NAS框架TE-NAS，利用NTK谱和线性区域数量评估架构。
2102.11535|v2.innovation: 首次将NTK谱和线性区域数量作为无需训练的架构评估指标，并设计剪枝搜索机制平衡可训练性与表达性。
2102.11535|v2.result: 在四个GPU小时内于NAS-Bench-201和DARTS上找到优于现有方法的架构。

2103.09377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对二值神经网络训练困难且精度损失大的问题，提出了多奖彩票假设（Multi-Prize Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）。该假设指出，一个充分过参数化的随机权重网络包含多个子网络，这些子网络无需进一步训练即可达到与训练后稠密网络相当的精度，并且对极端量化（如二值权重和/或激活）具有鲁棒性。作者提出了寻找多奖彩票（MPT）的算法，并在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上进行了实验。结果表明，随着模型加深加宽，MPT能在不训练的情况下实现高精度二值网络。
2103.09377|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty and accuracy loss in training binary neural networks by proposing the Multi-Prize Lottery Ticket Hypothesis. It states that a sufficiently over-parameterized random-weight network contains subnetworks that achieve accuracy comparable to a trained dense network without further training, and are robust to extreme quantization (binary weights and/or activations). The authors propose an algorithm to find Multi-Prize Tickets (MPTs) and validate it on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, showing that deeper and wider models yield high-accuracy binary networks without training.
2103.09377|v2.assessment: 该工作为二值神经网络和网络剪枝提供了新的理论视角，无需训练即可获得紧凑模型，对模型压缩领域有重要启发。
2103.09377|v2.contribution: 提出了多奖彩票假设，并给出了寻找无需训练即可达到高精度二值子网络的算法。
2103.09377|v2.innovation: 将彩票假设扩展到多奖场景，证明随机权重网络中存在对极端量化鲁棒且无需训练的子网络。
2103.09377|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，MPT能在不训练的情况下实现与稠密网络相当的精度，且对二值量化鲁棒。

2009.08576|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对初始化时剪枝方法（如SNIP、GraSP、SynFlow）性能不及训练后剪枝的问题，进行了深入分析。作者发现，随机打乱这些方法在每层内剪枝的权重或采样新的初始值，反而能保持或提升精度，表明这些方法的逐权重剪枝决策可被逐层剪枝比例选择所替代。这一发现揭示了初始化剪枝启发式方法的内在挑战。实验在多个数据集和网络上验证了该现象。
2009.08576|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why pruning-at-initialization methods (SNIP, GraSP, SynFlow) underperform magnitude pruning after training. The authors show that randomly shuffling the pruned weights within each layer or sampling new initial values preserves or improves accuracy, suggesting that per-weight pruning decisions can be replaced by per-layer pruning ratios. This reveals fundamental challenges in pruning heuristics at initialization. Experiments across multiple datasets and networks validate the findings.
2009.08576|v2.assessment: 该工作对初始化剪枝方法进行了批判性分析，揭示了现有方法的局限性，对网络剪枝领域的研究方向有重要指导意义。
2009.08576|v2.contribution: 系统分析了初始化剪枝方法为何不及训练后剪枝，并指出逐权重剪枝决策可被逐层比例替代。
2009.08576|v2.innovation: 通过随机打乱和重采样实验，揭示了初始化剪枝启发式方法的根本性挑战。
2009.08576|v2.result: 在多个数据集和网络上验证了初始化剪枝方法性能不及训练后剪枝，且逐权重决策可被逐层比例替代。

Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对网络剪枝初始化阶段（pruning at initialization）鲁棒性不足的问题展开研究。作者分析了现有基于初始化剪枝方法（如SNIP、GraSP）在不同初始化种子和数据批次下的不稳定性，并提出了一种更鲁棒的剪枝准则或流程。相比已有工作，该方法在多种初始化条件下能稳定选出有效子网络，减少对随机种子的敏感度。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但强调了鲁棒性提升对剪枝实际部署的重要性。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness issue of pruning at initialization, where existing methods such as SNIP and GraSP are sensitive to random seeds and data batches. The authors propose a more robust pruning criterion or pipeline that stably identifies effective subnetworks under various initialization conditions. Compared to prior work, the method reduces sensitivity to randomness, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.assessment: 该工作关注剪枝初始化阶段的鲁棒性，对模型压缩领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.contribution: 提出了一种更鲁棒的初始化剪枝方法，降低了剪枝对随机种子和数据批次的敏感性。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.innovation: 从鲁棒性角度重新审视初始化剪枝，揭示了现有方法的不稳定问题并给出改进方案。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.result: 在多种初始化条件下实现了更稳定的子网络选择，但摘要未给出具体精度或压缩率数据。

2105.03193|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对剪枝后重训练阶段中学习率重绕（learning rate rewinding）为何有效的问题展开研究。作者通过大量实验发现，学习率重绕成功的关键在于使用了较大的学习率，类似现象也出现在1-cycle学习率调度中。基于此，他们展示了随机剪枝网络在合适学习率调度下甚至能超越传统微调的方法性剪枝网络。该工作强调了学习率调度在剪枝重训练中的关键作用，为剪枝实践提供了新见解。
2105.03193|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why learning rate rewinding is effective for retraining pruned networks. Through extensive experiments, the authors find that the success stems from the use of a large learning rate, a phenomenon also observed in other schedules like 1-cycle. They further demonstrate that randomly pruned networks can outperform methodically pruned ones when retrained with the right learning rate schedule, highlighting the criticality of learning rate scheduling in pruning.
2105.03193|v2.assessment: 该工作对剪枝重训练机制给出了反直觉的深入分析，对模型压缩研究者有较高参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接关联有限。
2105.03193|v2.contribution: 揭示了学习率重绕成功的关键在于大学习率，并证明随机剪枝在合适调度下可超越方法性剪枝。
2105.03193|v2.innovation: 通过实验分析挑战了传统认知，指出学习率调度而非剪枝方法本身可能是性能提升的主因。
2105.03193|v2.result: 随机剪枝网络在合适学习率调度下性能超过传统微调的方法性剪枝网络，但摘要未给出具体精度数值。

Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于幅度的剪枝中逐层稀疏度分配不合理的问题展开研究。作者提出了一种层自适应稀疏度（layer-adaptive sparsity）方法，根据每层对剪枝的敏感度或重要性动态分配稀疏度，而非使用全局统一阈值。相比传统全局幅度剪枝，该方法能更合理地保留关键层的信息，提升剪枝后模型的性能。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但强调了层间差异对剪枝效果的影响。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of suboptimal layer-wise sparsity allocation in magnitude-based pruning. The authors propose a layer-adaptive sparsity method that dynamically assigns sparsity to each layer based on its sensitivity or importance, rather than using a global threshold. Compared to conventional global magnitude pruning, this approach better preserves critical layer information and improves pruned model performance, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.assessment: 该工作关注剪枝中逐层稀疏度分配问题，对模型压缩领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.contribution: 提出了一种层自适应稀疏度分配方法，改进了基于幅度的剪枝中逐层稀疏度不合理的问题。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.innovation: 根据层间敏感度动态分配稀疏度，而非使用全局统一阈值。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.result: 在剪枝后模型性能上优于传统全局幅度剪枝，但摘要未给出具体精度或压缩率数据。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud._arxiv_id: Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitude-based Pruning.

2210.06707|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模预训练ViT在资源受限设备上计算与内存开销大的问题，现有低比特量化ViT相比全精度模型存在显著性能下降。本文通过实证分析发现性能下降的瓶颈来自低比特量化自注意力图的信息失真，提出信息矫正模块（IRM）与分布引导蒸馏（DGD）方案，实现全量化ViT。在DeiT和Swin骨干上，Q-ViT性能大幅优于已有方法，例如理论上可将ViT-S加速6倍以上，同时保持较高精度。
2210.06707|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance degradation of low-bit quantized Vision Transformers (ViTs) on resource-constrained devices. It identifies the information distortion of quantized self-attention maps as the bottleneck and proposes an Information Rectification Module (IRM) and a Distribution Guided Distillation (DGD) scheme for fully quantized ViTs. Experiments on DeiT and Swin backbones show that Q-ViT significantly outperforms prior arts, e.g., theoretically accelerating ViT-S by over 6× while maintaining accuracy.
2210.06707|v2.assessment: 该工作对ViT低比特量化的瓶颈分析深入，提出的IRM与DGD针对性强，在主流骨干上验证充分，对模型压缩与高效部署方向有较高参考价值。
2210.06707|v2.contribution: 提出信息矫正模块与分布引导蒸馏，实现高性能全量化低比特ViT。
2210.06707|v2.innovation: 首次定位量化自注意力图的信息失真为性能瓶颈，并设计针对性矫正与蒸馏方案。
2210.06707|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin上大幅超越已有量化方法，理论上可加速ViT-S 6倍以上。

2203.09931|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模非结构化3D点云属性（如颜色、反射率）压缩与存储问题，本文提出深度压缩网络3DAC，显式压缩点云属性。方法先将属性转换为变换系数，再用深度熵模型结合属性变换与已编码属性信息建模系数概率，最终压缩为属性比特流。在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI等室内外大规模数据集上，3DAC在压缩率和重建质量上均表现优越。
2203.09931|v2.summary_en: This paper studies attribute compression for large-scale unstructured 3D point clouds and proposes a deep compression network, 3DAC, to explicitly compress point cloud attributes. It converts attributes into transform coefficients, models their probabilities with a deep entropy model leveraging attribute transforms and previously encoded attributes, and compresses them into a bitstream. Experiments on ScanNet and SemanticKITTI demonstrate superior compression rates and reconstruction quality.
2203.09931|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦点云属性压缩，与自动驾驶感知中的检测/跟踪任务关联较弱，但对点云数据存储与传输有实际意义。
2203.09931|v2.contribution: 提出深度熵模型驱动的点云属性压缩网络3DAC。
2203.09931|v2.innovation: 利用属性变换与已编码属性信息建模系数概率，实现高效属性压缩。
2203.09931|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI上取得优越的压缩率与重建质量。

2204.12684|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有点云压缩方法忽略局部密度信息、导致局部细节丢失的问题，本文提出一种保持局部密度的深度点云压缩方法。方法采用自编码器结构，编码器下采样并学习逐点特征，解码器上采样；通过密度嵌入、局部位置嵌入和祖先嵌入编码局部几何与密度，并显式预测上采样因子、方向与尺度，同时设计子点卷积层和自适应尺度上采样块。在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上取得最优率失真权衡。
2204.12684|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a density-preserving deep point cloud compression method to address the neglect of local density in existing approaches. It uses an auto-encoder that encodes local geometry and density via density, local position, and ancestor embeddings, and explicitly predicts upsampling factors, directions, and scales. A sub-point convolution layer and an adaptive-scale upsampling block are designed, achieving state-of-the-art rate-distortion trade-off on SemanticKITTI and ShapeNet.
2204.12684|v2.assessment: 该工作对点云局部密度保持的建模细致，率失真性能领先，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务（检测、跟踪）直接相关性有限。
2204.12684|v2.contribution: 提出保持局部密度的深度点云压缩方法，并设计子点卷积与自适应上采样模块。
2204.12684|v2.innovation: 通过密度嵌入与显式上采样因子预测，在压缩中保留局部密度信息。
2204.12684|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上达到最优率失真权衡。

2202.10203|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中任务间参数干扰导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出稀疏神经网络持续学习（SNCL）方法。该方法在所有层神经元激活上施加变分贝叶斯稀疏先验，仅为当前和过去任务激活稀疏神经元，为未来任务保留参数空间；同时采用全经验回放（FER）提供有效监督，并设计损失感知的蓄水池采样策略维护记忆缓冲区。方法对网络结构和任务边界均不敏感，有效缓解跨任务干扰。
2202.10203|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning caused by inter-task parameter interference. It proposes SNCL, which imposes variational Bayesian sparsity priors on neuron activations to activate only sparse neurons for current and past tasks, reserving capacity for future tasks. Full Experience Replay (FER) and a loss-aware reservoir-sampling strategy are employed, making the method agnostic to network structures and task boundaries.
2202.10203|v2.assessment: 该工作将贝叶斯稀疏性与经验回放结合，思路清晰，对持续学习中的参数干扰问题提供了有效缓解方案，但实验细节在摘要中未充分展开。
2202.10203|v2.contribution: 提出基于变分贝叶斯稀疏先验与全经验回放的持续学习框架SNCL。
2202.10203|v2.innovation: 通过稀疏神经元激活与损失感知蓄水池采样，减少任务间参数干扰。
2202.10203|v2.result: 有效缓解灾难性遗忘，且对网络结构与任务边界不敏感。

2110.08232|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有动态剪枝方法依赖稀疏正则化导致多损失平衡复杂、超参数选择不透明的问题，本文提出解耦任务损失与剪枝损失，并实现训练前FLOPs缩减估计的简单超参数选择。受神经科学Hebbian理论启发，提出基于前一层激活预测当前层top-k滤波器掩码的自监督二分类方法，k值根据热图质量动态估计。该方法简化了动态剪枝的训练流程并提升了可解释性。
2110.08232|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the complexity of balancing task and sparsity losses in dynamic pruning by decoupling them and enabling simple hyperparameter selection with pre-training FLOPs estimation. Inspired by Hebbian theory, it predicts a mask for top-k filters in a layer based on previous-layer activations, posed as a self-supervised binary classification problem, with k dynamically estimated per input. The approach simplifies dynamic pruning training and improves transparency.
2110.08232|v2.assessment: 该工作将动态剪枝转化为自监督掩码预测，解耦损失设计实用，对模型压缩方向有参考价值，但摘要未给出具体精度与FLOPs数据。
2110.08232|v2.contribution: 提出解耦任务与剪枝损失的自监督动态剪枝方法，支持训练前FLOPs估计。
2110.08232|v2.innovation: 基于Hebbian理论用前层激活预测top-k滤波器掩码，动态估计k值。
2110.08232|v2.result: 简化动态剪枝训练流程，实现透明的计算预算权衡。

Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.summary_cn: 本文重新审视随机通道剪枝在神经网络压缩中的作用。由于摘要内容缺失，无法获取具体方法与实验细节，但从标题推断，工作可能系统分析了随机通道剪枝的有效性，并在此基础上提出改进的剪枝策略或评估框架。该方向对模型压缩与高效推理有潜在参考价值。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.summary_en: This paper revisits random channel pruning for neural network compression. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental details are unavailable; however, the title suggests a systematic analysis of random channel pruning's effectiveness and potentially an improved pruning strategy or evaluation framework. The work is potentially relevant to model compression and efficient inference.
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法充分评估其方法与实验质量，但随机通道剪枝的再审视对压缩领域有一定探索意义，建议获取全文后进一步判断。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.contribution: 重新审视随机通道剪枝在神经网络压缩中的有效性与作用。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.innovation: 可能提出对随机通道剪枝的新分析视角或改进策略（摘要缺失，待确认）。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法评估。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne._arxiv_id: Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Neural Network Compression.

2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统剪枝要么在训练后剪枝（推理高效但训练开销大）、要么在初始化时剪枝（省训练成本但性能下降明显）的两难问题，提出了一种尽可能早地在训练过程中进行剪枝的策略。方法上先用少量 epoch 的稠密训练快速引导网络结构，通过神经元重要性排序持续评估主导子网络，并引入 Early Pruning Indicator（EPI），基于子网络结构相似度在结构稳定时快速触发剪枝。在 ImageNet 上的大量实验表明，EPI 能快速定位适合剪枝的早期训练阶段，在几乎不损失性能的前提下显著降低训练成本。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning, which is inference-efficient but incurs heavy training cost, and pruning-at-initialization, which saves training cost but degrades performance. It proposes a policy that prunes as early as possible during training by exploiting a few dense warm-up epochs, continuously ranking neuron importance, and introducing an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) that triggers pruning once the sub-network architecture stabilizes. Extensive ImageNet experiments show EPI identifies early pruning epochs without hurting performance.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 将剪枝时机作为核心问题来研究，EPI 指标思路清晰且实用，对训练成本敏感的场景有参考价值。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于子网络结构稳定性的早期剪枝策略与 EPI 指标，实现训练中尽早剪枝。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 用子网络架构相似度动态判断剪枝时机，而非固定剪枝点或初始化剪枝。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在 ImageNet 上实现早期剪枝且性能不降，同时显著降低训练开销。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对标准非结构化剪枝（SP）将滤波器元素置零、从而把滤波器约束在固定子空间并引入强偏置的问题，提出了 interspace pruning（IP）。IP 将滤波器表示为自适应滤波器基（FB）的线性组合，在动态 interspace 中通过将 FB 系数置零来实现剪枝，未剪枝系数与 FB 联合训练。论文给出了 IP 性能更优的数学证明，并在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上验证 IP 均优于 SP，尤其在 ImageNet 剪枝和高稀疏度等困难场景下提升明显，且运行时间与参数量开销相同。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the strong bias induced by standard unstructured pruning (SP), which constrains filters to a fixed subspace by zeroing elements. It introduces interspace pruning (IP), which represents filters as linear combinations of an adaptive filter basis and prunes by zeroing basis coefficients while jointly training the remaining coefficients and basis. Mathematical analysis and experiments show IP consistently outperforms SP across state-of-the-art unstructured pruning methods, especially on ImageNet and at high sparsity, at equal runtime and parameter cost.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 从滤波器表示空间的角度重新审视非结构化剪枝，理论分析与实验结合扎实，是一个通用且可插拔的改进工具。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出 interspace pruning，用自适应滤波器基的线性组合替代固定子空间约束来改进现有非结构化剪枝。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 将剪枝对象从滤波器元素转移到动态滤波器基系数，缓解剪枝偏置。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上均超越 SP，高稀疏度与 ImageNet 场景提升尤为显著。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究在无干净训练数据条件下检测被植入 Trojan 的 DNN 的问题，首次从稀疏性视角切入。核心观察是 Trojan 特征在网络剪枝下比良性特征更稳定，据此提出先定位一个'winning Trojan lottery ticket'——它保留几乎全部 Trojan 信息但在干净输入上仅有随机水平性能，再从中恢复嵌入的触发器。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 及多种网络架构上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Trojan DNN detection without clean training data, approaching the problem from a sparsity perspective. Its key observation is that Trojan features are significantly more stable to pruning than benign features, based on which it locates a 'winning Trojan lottery ticket' that preserves Trojan information while yielding chance-level clean accuracy, then recovers the embedded trigger. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet across architectures validate the approach.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 将 lottery ticket 假设与 Trojan 检测巧妙结合，视角新颖，对模型安全与剪枝交叉方向有启发。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏子网络的 Trojan 检测框架，可在无干净数据下定位并恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 发现 Trojan 特征对剪枝的稳定性高于良性特征，并据此分离出 Trojan 子网络。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 多种架构上有效检测 Trojan 并恢复触发器。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像复原任务中深度模型计算量过大、而现有 N:M 结构化剪枝未考虑不同层计算复杂度与性能需求差异的问题，提出了一种为每层自适应确定 N:M 稀疏剪枝比例的新方法。方法根据各层特性分配不同剪枝率，以更好地权衡效率与复原精度。在超分辨率和去模糊任务上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于已有剪枝方法，并开源了 PyTorch 实现。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of deep models for image restoration and the limitation of existing N:M structured pruning that ignores layer-wise differences in complexity and performance requirements. It proposes a pruning method that determines the N:M sparsity ratio for each layer to better balance efficiency and restoration accuracy. Extensive experiments on super-resolution and deblurring show significant improvements over prior pruning methods.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 将逐层自适应 N:M 稀疏引入图像复原，工程实用性强，但方法新颖度相对有限。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出面向图像复原的逐层自适应 N:M 结构化剪枝方法。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 按层分配不同 N:M 剪枝比例以匹配各层复杂度与精度需求。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率与去模糊任务上显著优于已有剪枝方法。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云 3D 目标检测中点占据固有的稀疏性这一核心挑战，提出了 Sparse Window Transformer（SWFormer）。方法将 3D 点转换为稀疏体素与窗口，用 bucketing 方案高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并通过多尺度特征融合与窗口移位捕捉跨窗口关联，同时提出 voxel diffusion 技术以从稀疏特征中精确检测 3D 目标。在 Waymo Open Dataset 官方测试集上，SWFormer 在车辆与行人 3D 检测上取得 73.36 L2 mAPH 的 SOTA，超越所有单阶段与两阶段模型且效率更高。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inherent sparsity of point occupancy in 3D point cloud detection by proposing Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer). It converts 3D points into sparse voxels and windows, processes variable-length sparse windows via a bucketing scheme, captures cross-window correlation through multi-scale fusion and window shifting, and introduces voxel diffusion for accurate detection from sparse features. On the Waymo Open Dataset test set, SWFormer achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH for vehicle and pedestrian detection, outperforming all prior single- and two-stage models while being more efficient.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 面向自动驾驶 3D 检测的高影响力工作，稀疏窗口 Transformer 设计优雅，Waymo 上的 SOTA 结果与效率优势使其非常值得关注。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出 Sparse Window Transformer，用稀疏窗口与 bucketing 高效建模点云并实现 SOTA 3D 检测。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: 将窗口 Transformer 与稀疏体素/bucketing 结合，并引入 voxel diffusion 处理稀疏特征。
2210.07372|v2.result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 上取得 73.36 L2 mAPH 的 SOTA，超越所有单/两阶段模型且更高效。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究多实例点云配准问题，即估计源点云多个实例在目标点云中的位姿，其难点在于某一实例的内点对应恰是其他实例的外点。现有方法依赖耗时的假设采样或空间一致性特征，性能受限。论文提出 PointCLM，先用对比学习为输入候选对应学习分布良好的深度表示，再基于该表示设计外点剪枝策略与聚类策略，高效剔除外点并将剩余对应分配给正确实例。在合成与真实数据集上大幅超越 SOTA。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-instance point cloud registration, where inlier correspondences of one instance are outliers for others, and existing methods relying on hypothesis sampling or spatial-consistency features are limited. It proposes PointCLM, which first uses contrastive learning to learn well-distributed deep representations of putative correspondences, then applies outlier pruning and clustering to remove outliers and assign correspondences to correct instances. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin on synthetic and real datasets.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 将对比学习引入多实例点云配准，思路清晰，对点云配准与 3D 感知相关研究有参考价值。
2209.00219|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比学习的多实例点云配准框架 PointCLM。
2209.00219|v2.innovation: 用对比学习表示配合外点剪枝与聚类策略替代耗时的假设采样。
2209.00219|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上大幅超越现有 SOTA 方法。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模稀疏点云压缩中熵编码效率不足的问题，本文提出基于八叉树的多级压缩框架，利用兄弟节点子节点、祖先与邻居的上下文构建熵模型，并通过体素级几何感知模块局部拟合二次曲面提供几何先验。相比已有方法，该框架能更紧凑地编码八叉树，并在解码阶段采用两步启发式策略提升重建质量。在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes上分别取得11-16%和12-14%的码率改进。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient compression of large-scale sparse point clouds by proposing an octree-based multi-level framework with a novel entropy model that exploits sibling, ancestor, and neighbor contexts, plus a voxel-based geometry-aware module fitting local quadratic surfaces as priors. A two-step heuristic decoding strategy improves reconstruction quality. It outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate improvements on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes, respectively.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 该工作将几何先验与上下文熵模型结合，在自动驾驶点云压缩上取得稳定码率收益，对感知数据存储与传输有实用价值，但与检测/BEV等核心感知任务关联较弱。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer在人体姿态估计中全局注意力计算开销大、难以扩展到高分辨率和多视角的问题，本文提出Token-Pruned Pose Transformer（PPT），先定位粗略人体掩码，仅在选定token内进行自注意力，并扩展出多视角版本及跨视角人体区域融合策略。在COCO和MPII上，PPT在保持与已有姿态Transformer相当精度的同时降低了计算量；在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上多视角PPT高效融合多视角线索并达到新的SOTA。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: To address the high computational cost of global attention in vision transformers for pose estimation, this paper proposes the Token-Pruned Pose Transformer (PPT), which locates a rough human mask and restricts self-attention to selected tokens, and extends it to multi-view estimation with a human area fusion strategy. PPT matches prior pose transformer accuracy on COCO and MPII with reduced computation, while multi-view PPT achieves new state-of-the-art on Human3.6M and Ski-Pose.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: token剪枝思路对Transformer效率优化有参考意义，但应用场景为人姿态估计，与自动驾驶感知主线相关性有限。
2209.08194|v2.contribution: 提出基于人体掩码token剪枝的姿态Transformer及其多视角扩展。
2209.08194|v2.innovation: 仅在选定人体token内做自注意力，并提出跨视角人体区域融合策略。
2209.08194|v2.result: 在COCO/MPII保持精度并降低计算，在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose达到新SOTA。

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中深度网络易发生灾难性遗忘、现有方法难以兼顾稳定性-可塑性的问题，本文受梯度提升思想启发提出两阶段学习范式FOSTER：先动态扩展新模块以拟合目标模型与原始模型输出之间的残差，再通过有效蒸馏策略移除冗余参数和特征维度以保持单主干模型。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000不同设置下，FOSTER取得state-of-the-art性能，且计算与存储开销可控。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning and the stability-plasticity dilemma of existing methods, this paper proposes FOSTER, a two-stage paradigm inspired by gradient boosting: it first dynamically expands new modules to fit the residuals between the target and the original model's output, then removes redundant parameters and feature dimensions via an effective distillation strategy to retain a single backbone. FOSTER achieves state-of-the-art performance on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000 under various settings.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 将梯度提升的残差拟合思想引入类增量学习，方法简洁且实验充分，对持续学习与自动驾驶长尾/增量场景有借鉴意义。
2204.04662|v2.contribution: 提出基于残差拟合与蒸馏压缩的两阶段类增量学习范式FOSTER。
2204.04662|v2.innovation: 用梯度提升式动态模块扩展拟合残差，再经蒸馏压缩回单主干模型。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT后训练量化（PTQ）在低比特下精度严重下降的问题，提出RepQ-ViT框架，将量化与推理过程解耦：量化时使用复杂量化器（对post-LayerNorm激活采用通道级量化、对post-Softmax激活采用log√2量化），推理时通过尺度重参数化转换为硬件友好的简化量化器。相比已有为适配硬件而牺牲量化精度的方法，该方法在保持高效推理的同时显著提升低比特精度，在多种ViT架构和比特设置下达到SOTA。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: RepQ-ViT addresses the severe accuracy degradation of post-training quantization for vision transformers in low-bit regimes by decoupling quantization from inference: complex quantizers (channel-wise for post-LayerNorm activations, log√2 for post-Softmax activations) are used during calibration and then reparameterized into hardware-friendly simplified quantizers for inference. This preserves quantization accuracy while enabling efficient deployment, outperforming prior methods that sacrifice accuracy for hardware compatibility.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 为ViT低比特PTQ提供了兼顾精度与硬件效率的实用方案，对模型压缩方向有参考价值。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出基于量化尺度重参数化的ViT后训练量化框架RepQ-ViT。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 将量化与推理解耦，通过尺度重参数化把复杂量化器转化为硬件友好形式。
2212.08254|v2.result: 在低比特设置下显著缓解精度退化，优于现有ViT PTQ方法。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT计算开销大、现有token剪枝方法因直接丢弃token造成信息损失的问题，提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块TPS：先剪枝得到保留与剪除子集，再通过单向最近邻匹配和基于相似度的融合，将被剪token的信息压缩进部分保留token。相比SOTA方法在所有剪枝强度下均更优，在DeiT-tiny/small计算预算压缩至35%时，ImageNet分类精度比基线提升1%-6%，并提升吞吐量。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: TPS tackles the information loss caused by discarding pruned tokens in ViT compression by jointly pruning and squeezing: after pruning into reserved and pruned subsets, it squeezes pruned-token information into partial reserved tokens via unidirectional nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusion. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods at all pruning intensities, improving ImageNet accuracy by 1%-6% over baselines when shrinking DeiT-tiny/small budgets to 35%, while also increasing throughput.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 以信息回收思路改进token剪枝，方法简洁有效，对ViT高效部署有实用价值。
2304.10716|v2.contribution: 提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块TPS以更激进地压缩ViT。
2304.10716|v2.innovation: 通过最近邻匹配与相似度融合将被剪token信息压缩进保留token，减少信息损失。
2304.10716|v2.result: 在35%计算预算下ImageNet精度较基线提升1%-6%，并提升吞吐量。

2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在GPU上部署困难、缺乏系统性加速研究的问题，提出GPUSQ-ViT压缩方案，充分利用GPU友好的2:4细粒度结构化稀疏与量化：先用2:4结构化剪枝将稠密模型稀疏化（FP16），再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化训练转为定点模型（整数张量可获额外加速），过程中采用混合策略知识蒸馏，并支持监督与无监督学习。实验表明模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，速度提升30.3-62倍，达到SOTA压缩效果。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: GPUSQ-ViT addresses the challenge of deploying vision transformers on GPUs by jointly exploiting GPU-friendly 2:4 fine-grained structured sparsity and quantization: dense weights are first pruned to 2:4 sparse FP16, then quantized to fixed-point via sparse-distillation-aware QAT, with mixed-strategy knowledge distillation throughout and support for both supervised and unsupervised settings. It achieves state-of-the-art compression, reducing model size by 6.4-12.7× and accelerating by 30.3-62×.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 面向真实GPU硬件加速的联合稀疏量化方案，工程落地性强，对高效ViT部署有参考意义。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出结合2:4结构化稀疏与量化的GPU友好ViT压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 将2:4稀疏、稀疏蒸馏感知量化训练与混合策略知识蒸馏统一到同一压缩流程。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，速度提升30.3-62倍，达到SOTA压缩水平。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT剪枝方法缺乏可解释性、忽视内部单元与目标类别关系而导致性能次优的问题，提出可解释剪枝框架X-Pruner：学习端到端的可解释性感知掩码以衡量每个可剪单元对各类别预测的贡献，并基于掩码值自适应搜索逐层阈值以区分保留与剪除单元、确定逐层剪枝率。在DeiT和Swin Transformer上验证，取得优于现有方法的剪枝效果。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: X-Pruner addresses the lack of explainability in existing ViT pruning methods, which overlook the relationship between internal units and target classes and thus yield suboptimal performance. It learns an explainability-aware mask end-to-end to measure each prunable unit's contribution to class prediction, and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds to separate pruned from unpruned units and determine per-layer pruning rates. Experiments on DeiT and Swin Transformer demonstrate superior pruning performance.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 将可解释性引入剪枝准则，思路新颖，为ViT压缩提供了新的视角。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出基于可解释性感知掩码与自适应阈值搜索的ViT剪枝框架X-Pruner。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 用端到端学习的可解释性掩码衡量单元对目标类别的贡献并自适应确定逐层剪枝率。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT与Swin Transformer上取得优于现有方法的剪枝性能。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: 针对半监督语义分割中标注数据稀缺、伪标签质量不高的问题，本文提出密度引导的对比学习框架。方法通过估计像素级密度来区分稀疏区域与密集区域，并设计密度感知的对比损失，使模型在稀疏目标区域也能学到判别性表征。相比已有半监督分割方法，该工作显式利用密度先验来缓解类别不平衡与边界模糊问题。在标准半监督分割基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，验证了密度引导对比学习的有效性。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotations and low-quality pseudo-labels in semi-supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a density-guided contrastive learning framework. It estimates pixel-wise density to distinguish sparse from dense regions and designs a density-aware contrastive loss that learns discriminative representations even in sparse object areas. Compared with existing semi-supervised segmentation methods, it explicitly exploits density priors to alleviate class imbalance and boundary ambiguity, achieving superior performance on standard benchmarks.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 将密度先验引入半监督分割的对比学习，思路新颖，对稀疏目标场景有参考价值。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习框架用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用像素级密度估计区分稀疏与密集区域并设计密度感知对比损失。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在标准半监督分割基准上优于现有方法。
