2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习（CIL）中旧类样本受限于内存预算只能保留少量 exemplar 的问题，本文提出通过压缩 exemplar 来突破 few-shot 限制。方法利用类激活图（CAM）生成 0-1 掩码，下采样非判别性像素，从而在固定内存中保存更多压缩后的 exemplar。为解决 CAM 阈值在覆盖度与 exemplar 数量间的权衡以及不同类别最优阈值不同的问题，提出类增量掩码（CIM）模型，并通过双层优化与 CIL 模型交替优化。大量实验表明该方法在多个 CIL 基准上取得显著提升。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the few-shot exemplar limitation in class-incremental learning (CIL) by compressing exemplars to store many-shot compressed samples within a fixed memory budget. It generates 0-1 masks on discriminative pixels from class activation maps (CAM) without manual annotation, and proposes a class-incremental masking (CIM) model optimized via bilevel optimization to handle the coverage-quantity trade-off and class-varying thresholds. Extensive experiments show significant improvements on multiple CIL benchmarks.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 以压缩 exemplar 突破内存限制的思路简洁有效，双层优化设计合理，对增量学习研究者有较高参考价值。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出基于 CAM 掩码的 exemplar 压缩方法以突破 CIL 的 few-shot 内存限制。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 用类增量掩码模型与双层优化自适应生成判别性像素掩码。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个 CIL 基准上取得显著性能提升。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 针对结构剪枝中参数分组模式因架构而异、现有方法难以泛化到新架构的问题，本文提出任意结构剪枝任务。核心难点是结构耦合，即不同层需同时剪枝且被移除参数需一致地不重要。为此提出依赖图（DepGraph）方法，显式建模层间依赖并自动对耦合参数分组。在 ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet 及 Vision Transformer 等多种架构和任务上进行了广泛评估，验证了方法的通用性与有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generalizability in structural pruning, where parameter-grouping patterns vary across architectures, by studying any structural pruning for CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. It identifies structural coupling as the key obstacle and proposes Dependency Graph (DepGraph), a fully automatic method that explicitly models inter-layer dependencies and groups coupled parameters for pruning. Extensive evaluations on ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, MobileNet, and Vision Transformer across multiple tasks demonstrate its generality and effectiveness.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: DepGraph 是结构剪枝领域的重要通用化工作，方法优雅且实验覆盖广，值得关注。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出通用自动的依赖图方法实现任意架构的结构剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 显式建模层间依赖并自动分组耦合参数以解决结构耦合问题。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在多种架构与任务上验证了通用性与有效性。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有通道剪枝方法主要面向 2D CNN、难以直接迁移到 3D 点云网络（PNN）的问题，本文提出 CP3——面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件。方法设计了坐标增强的通道重要性度量，以反映维度信息与通道特征的相关性，并回收 PNN 采样过程中丢弃的点以利用其潜在独有信息增强剪枝鲁棒性。在多种 PNN 架构上的实验表明该方法能有效降低计算与内存开销并保持精度。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of extending 2D CNN channel pruning to 3D point-based neural networks (PNNs), whose representations and architectures differ substantially. It proposes CP3, a channel pruning plug-in for PNNs, featuring a coordinate-enhanced channel importance metric that captures the correlation between dimensional information and channel features, and recycling discarded points from PNN sampling to enhance pruning robustness. Experiments on various PNN architectures show effective reduction of computation and memory with comparable accuracy.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 将通道剪枝系统性地适配到点云网络，针对点云特性的设计有实际价值。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件 CP3。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 坐标增强通道重要性度量与采样丢弃点回收机制。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种 PNN 架构上有效降低计算与内存且保持精度。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 针对特征匹配中对应关系剪枝（correspondence pruning）易受离群点影响的问题，本文提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法。方法通过逐步挖掘邻域一致性来区分内点与离群点，并据此进行对应关系剪枝。相比已有方法，该工作强调渐进式策略以更稳健地处理复杂离群分布。在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses the sensitivity of correspondence pruning to outliers in feature matching by proposing a progressive neighbor consistency mining method. It progressively mines neighbor consistency to distinguish inliers from outliers and performs correspondence pruning accordingly. Compared with existing methods, it emphasizes a progressive strategy for more robust handling of complex outlier distributions, achieving competitive results on standard benchmarks.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 渐进式邻域一致性思路对特征匹配鲁棒性有一定贡献，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 以渐进策略逐步挖掘邻域一致性区分内点与离群点。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得有竞争力结果。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: 针对深度网络易学习到有偏表征、在少数群体上性能下降的问题，本文提出用对比权重剪枝训练去偏子网络。方法通过对比学习目标识别并剪除与偏差相关的权重，从而得到更公平的子网络。相比已有去偏方法，该工作将去偏与权重剪枝结合，在保持精度的同时提升公平性。实验表明所得子网络在多个公平性指标上优于基线。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses biased representations in deep networks that degrade performance on minority groups by training debiased subnetworks with contrastive weight pruning. It identifies and prunes bias-related weights via a contrastive objective to obtain fairer subnetworks. Compared with existing debiasing methods, it combines debiasing with weight pruning, improving fairness while maintaining accuracy, as demonstrated on multiple fairness metrics.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 将对比学习与权重剪枝结合用于去偏，思路有新意，但与本领域主线相关度一般。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝训练去偏子网络。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 用对比目标识别并剪除偏差相关权重。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在多个公平性指标上优于基线且保持精度。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督学习在分布外（OOD）数据下的鲁棒性问题，即伪标签在遇到OOD样本时容易产生错误监督信号。作者提出了一种基于语义剪枝（Semantic Pruning）的框架，通过识别并剪除与任务无关或分布偏移的语义通道，来抑制OOD样本对模型训练的干扰。相比传统半监督方法，该方法在保持ID数据性能的同时显著提升了OOD检测与鲁棒性。实验在多个基准上验证了其有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness issue of semi-supervised learning under out-of-distribution (OOD) data, where pseudo-labels can produce erroneous supervision for OOD samples. The authors propose a semantic pruning framework that identifies and prunes task-irrelevant or distribution-shifted semantic channels to suppress OOD interference during training. Compared with conventional semi-supervised methods, it improves OOD robustness while maintaining in-distribution performance, though no specific numerical results are provided in the abstract.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 该工作将剪枝思想引入半监督鲁棒学习，思路新颖，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，需进一步验证其实际效果。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出了一种基于语义剪枝的鲁棒半监督学习框架，用于抑制OOD样本的干扰。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 将语义通道剪枝与半监督学习结合，以应对分布外样本带来的伪标签噪声。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在多个基准上提升了OOD鲁棒性，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上语义分割模型的高效部署问题，提出了一种基于双层优化（Bi-level Optimization）的剪枝参数化方法。传统剪枝方法通常固定剪枝率或依赖手工设计，难以在精度与效率间取得最优平衡。作者将剪枝参数学习建模为双层优化问题，自动搜索最优的通道剪枝结构。相比已有工作，该方法在边缘设备上实现了更优的精度-速度权衡，但摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper targets efficient semantic segmentation on edge devices by proposing a pruning parameterization method based on bi-level optimization. Unlike conventional pruning that fixes pruning ratios or relies on manual design, the authors formulate pruning parameter learning as a bi-level optimization problem to automatically search for optimal channel pruning structures. It achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off on edge devices, though specific experimental numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 将双层优化用于剪枝参数化，方法具有理论深度，但需更多实验验证其在语义分割任务上的实际优势。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，用于边缘设备上的高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝结构搜索建模为双层优化问题，实现自动化的通道剪枝。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在边缘设备上实现了更优的精度-速度权衡，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: 该论文针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图（Matting）中计算量过大的问题，提出了一种利用时空稀疏性的方法。传统抠图方法在高分辨率下计算成本极高，难以实时处理。作者通过挖掘视频帧间和空间上的稀疏性，仅对关键区域进行高精度计算，从而大幅降低计算量。相比已有工作，该方法在保持抠图质量的同时显著提升了处理速度，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting by exploiting spatio-temporal sparsity. Conventional matting methods are prohibitively expensive at high resolutions. The authors leverage spatial and temporal sparsity to perform high-precision computation only on key regions, significantly reducing computational load. It improves processing speed while maintaining matting quality, though no specific numbers are given in the abstract.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 利用时空稀疏性加速超高分辨率抠图，思路合理，但缺乏具体实验数据，需进一步验证其通用性。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出了一种基于时空稀疏性的超高分辨率图像/视频抠图方法。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 通过挖掘视频中的时空稀疏性，仅对关键区域进行高精度计算以降低计算量。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在保持抠图质量的同时显著提升了处理速度，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习在系统异构性下的效率问题，提出了一种自适应通道稀疏化方法。在联邦学习中，不同设备的计算能力差异导致训练效率低下。作者通过自适应地调整各设备的通道稀疏度，使其与设备计算能力匹配，从而提升整体训练效率。相比已有工作，该方法在系统异构场景下实现了更好的效率-精度权衡，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper tackles efficiency in federated learning under system heterogeneity by proposing an adaptive channel sparsity method. In federated learning, diverse device capabilities lead to inefficient training. The authors adaptively adjust channel sparsity per device to match its computational capacity, improving overall training efficiency. It achieves a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off under system heterogeneity, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 将通道稀疏化用于联邦学习系统异构场景，具有一定新意，但与视觉感知领域关联较弱。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出了一种自适应通道稀疏化方法，用于系统异构下的高效联邦学习。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据设备计算能力自适应调整通道稀疏度，以匹配系统异构性。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 在系统异构场景下实现了更好的效率-精度权衡，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频超分辨率（VSR）模型计算量大的问题，提出了一种结构化稀疏学习方法。传统VSR模型参数量大，难以在资源受限设备上部署。作者通过结构化稀疏学习对VSR网络进行剪枝，在保持超分质量的同时减少计算量。相比已有工作，该方法在VSR任务上实现了更优的精度-效率权衡，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of video super-resolution (VSR) models by proposing a structured sparsity learning method. Conventional VSR models are large and hard to deploy on resource-constrained devices. The authors apply structured sparsity learning to prune VSR networks, reducing computation while maintaining super-resolution quality. It achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off for VSR, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 将结构化稀疏学习用于视频超分辨率，方法合理，但缺乏具体实验数据，需进一步验证其有效性。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出了一种结构化稀疏学习方法，用于高效视频超分辨率。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 通过结构化稀疏学习对VSR网络进行剪枝，以降低计算量。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 在VSR任务上实现了更优的精度-效率权衡，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中知识蒸馏效果不佳的问题，提出了一种判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法。传统GAN压缩中的蒸馏方法通常只关注生成器，忽略了判别器的作用。作者利用判别器来指导特征图蒸馏，使生成器在压缩后仍能保持高质量生成。相比已有工作，该方法在GAN压缩任务上取得了更好的生成质量与压缩率权衡，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses suboptimal knowledge distillation in GAN compression by proposing a discriminator-cooperated feature map distillation method. Conventional distillation for GAN compression focuses only on the generator, ignoring the discriminator. The authors leverage the discriminator to guide feature map distillation, maintaining high generation quality after compression. It achieves a better quality-compression trade-off, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 利用判别器协同进行特征图蒸馏，思路新颖，但需更多实验验证其在GAN压缩上的实际效果。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出了一种判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法，用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器指导特征图蒸馏，提升压缩后生成器的生成质量。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 在GAN压缩任务上取得了更好的生成质量与压缩率权衡，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对紧凑型3D检测器知识蒸馏中教师与学生中间特征表示差异过大的问题，指出由于3D点云固有的稀疏性和不规则性，现有KD方法在极端紧凑3D检测器上效果有限。作者从信息瓶颈（IB）视角提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD），在特征和logits层面最小化师生提案区域对之间的差异。在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，仅用42% FLOPs即超越教师模型性能，优于现有KD方法。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the representation disparity issue in knowledge distillation for compact 3D detectors, where existing KD methods are ineffective due to the intrinsic sparsity and irregularity of 3D point clouds. It proposes a novel Representation Disparity-aware Distillation (RDD) method from an information bottleneck perspective, minimizing the disparity of proposal region pairs between student and teacher in both features and logits. Extensive experiments on nuScenes show that RDD raises CP-Voxel-S to 57.1% mAP, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该工作切中3D检测器压缩中师生表示差异这一关键瓶颈，IB视角的建模具有理论新意，且以仅42% FLOPs超越教师的结果颇具说服力，对自动驾驶部署有实际价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD），从信息瓶颈视角解决3D检测知识蒸馏中师生特征表示差异过大的问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 首次从信息瓶颈理论出发，在特征与logits双层面最小化师生提案区域对的表示差异。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上使CP-Voxel-S达到57.1% mAP，仅用42% FLOPs即超越教师模型。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、现有token剪枝方法忽略多模态对齐的问题，提出MADTP，通过多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝来加速VLT。方法利用跨模态对齐分数动态评估token重要性，并在不同层自适应剪枝。相比静态或单模态剪枝，MADTP在保持跨模态对齐的同时显著减少计算量。在多个VLT基准上实现约1.5-2倍加速且精度损失极小。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of Vision-Language Transformers (VLTs) and the limitation of existing token pruning methods that ignore multimodal alignment. It proposes MADTP, a multimodal alignment-guided dynamic token pruning framework that dynamically evaluates token importance via cross-modal alignment scores and adaptively prunes tokens across layers. Compared to static or unimodal pruning, MADTP preserves cross-modal alignment while significantly reducing computation, achieving about 1.5-2x speedup with minimal accuracy drop on multiple VLT benchmarks.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 该工作将多模态对齐引入token剪枝，思路新颖，对多模态模型加速有参考价值。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架MADTP，用于加速视觉-语言Transformer。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 利用跨模态对齐分数动态评估token重要性并分层自适应剪枝。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个VLT基准上实现约1.5-2倍加速且精度损失极小。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型剪枝通常依赖任务特定微调、难以泛化的问题，提出MULTIFLOW，实现任务无关的视觉-语言剪枝。方法通过多模态流匹配与结构化剪枝，在预训练阶段直接获得可迁移的稀疏子网络。相比任务特定剪枝，MULTIFLOW在多个下游任务上无需重新剪枝即可保持性能。实验表明其在图像-文本检索等任务上达到与任务特定方法相当甚至更优的精度。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: This paper tackles the task-specificity of existing vision-language pruning methods, which require fine-tuning per task and generalize poorly. It proposes MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic vision-language pruning approach that uses multimodal flow matching and structured pruning to obtain transferable sparse subnetworks directly at pre-training. Compared to task-specific pruning, MULTIFLOW maintains performance across multiple downstream tasks without re-pruning, matching or surpassing task-specific methods on image-text retrieval.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝对多模态基础模型部署有实际意义，方法设计合理。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言剪枝框架MULTIFLOW。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 通过多模态流匹配在预训练阶段获得可迁移的稀疏子网络。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在多个下游任务上无需重新剪枝即可保持与任务特定方法相当或更优的精度。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝中重要性度量不准确的问题，提出MoPE-CLIP，引入模块级剪枝误差度量来指导剪枝。方法将剪枝误差分解到各模块，结合CLIP架构进行结构化剪枝。相比传统基于权重或激活的度量，MoPE-CLIP能更准确地定位冗余模块。在CLIP模型上实现显著压缩且零样本分类性能下降很小。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate importance metrics in structured pruning of vision-language models by proposing MoPE-CLIP, which introduces a module-wise pruning error metric to guide pruning. The method decomposes pruning error across modules and performs structured pruning tailored to CLIP. Compared to weight- or activation-based metrics, MoPE-CLIP more accurately identifies redundant modules, achieving significant compression on CLIP with minimal zero-shot classification degradation.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量对多模态模型剪枝有方法学贡献，实验较充分。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量MoPE-CLIP用于视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 将剪枝误差分解到各模块以更准确指导CLIP结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 在CLIP上实现显著压缩且零样本分类性能下降很小。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: 针对多模态训练数据冗余大、筛选成本高的问题，提出Sieve，利用图像描述模型进行数据集剪枝。方法通过图像描述模型评估样本的语义丰富度与多样性，剔除冗余或低信息量样本。相比随机采样或基于损失的剪枝，Sieve在更小数据子集上保持甚至提升下游性能。实验表明在图像-文本检索等任务上可用更少数据达到相当精度。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundancy and high curation cost of multimodal training data by proposing Sieve, a dataset pruning method using image captioning models. It evaluates semantic richness and diversity via captioning models to remove redundant or low-information samples. Compared to random sampling or loss-based pruning, Sieve maintains or improves downstream performance on smaller subsets, achieving comparable accuracy on image-text retrieval with less data.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 数据剪枝对多模态训练效率有实用价值，但方法相对直接。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法Sieve。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用图像描述模型评估样本语义丰富度与多样性进行数据筛选。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 在图像-文本检索等任务上以更少数据达到相当精度。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: 针对ViT压缩中重要性搜索与稀疏度搜索分离导致次优的问题，提出Once for Both，在单阶段内联合进行重要性与稀疏度搜索。方法通过可微分搜索同时确定通道重要性和各层稀疏率，避免两阶段误差累积。相比分离式方法，该框架在相同压缩率下获得更高精度。在ImageNet等基准上实现优于现有ViT压缩方法的精度-效率权衡。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality of separating importance and sparsity search in ViT compression by proposing Once for Both, a single-stage framework that jointly searches importance and sparsity. It uses differentiable search to simultaneously determine channel importance and per-layer sparsity, avoiding error accumulation from two-stage pipelines. Compared to decoupled methods, it achieves higher accuracy at the same compression rate, yielding better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on ImageNet.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 联合搜索思路清晰，对ViT压缩有实际改进，实验较扎实。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合重要性与稀疏度搜索的ViT压缩框架Once for Both。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 通过可微分搜索同时确定通道重要性和各层稀疏率。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: 在ImageNet等基准上实现优于现有方法的精度-效率权衡。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: 针对ViT压缩通常需要大量训练样本的问题，提出少样本密集ViT压缩方法。方法在仅有少量样本的条件下，通过密集预测与结构化剪枝结合，实现高效压缩。相比需要完整数据集的压缩方法，该方法在少样本设定下仍能保持较好精度。实验表明在极少量样本下压缩后的ViT性能下降可控。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: This paper tackles the requirement of large training sets in ViT compression by proposing a few-sample dense ViT compression method. It combines dense prediction with structured pruning to achieve efficient compression under limited samples. Compared to full-dataset compression methods, it maintains reasonable accuracy in the few-sample regime, with controlled performance degradation under extremely limited samples.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本压缩设定有实际意义，但方法创新性相对有限。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本条件下的密集ViT压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 在极少样本下结合密集预测与结构化剪枝实现ViT压缩。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 在极少量样本下压缩后的ViT性能下降可控。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像压缩模型在持续学习新数据/新码率时容易遗忘旧知识、且难以保持与已有压缩比特流向后兼容的问题，提出了一种向后兼容的持续学习图像压缩框架。方法上通过约束潜在表示与解码器更新，使新模型仍能正确解码旧模型产生的码流，同时适应新域数据。相比直接微调或重训，该方法在避免灾难性遗忘的同时维持了跨版本兼容性。摘要未给出具体指标，但该方向对实际部署中的编解码器迭代具有参考价值。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and backward compatibility in continual learning of image compression models. It proposes a framework that constrains latent and decoder updates so that newly trained models can still decode bitstreams produced by older versions while adapting to new data. Compared with naive fine-tuning or retraining, it preserves cross-version compatibility and mitigates forgetting, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 选题贴近实际编解码器迭代需求，向后兼容约束在持续学习压缩中较少被系统研究，值得关注。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出向后兼容的持续学习图像压缩框架，兼顾新数据适应与旧码流解码。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将向后兼容约束引入图像压缩的持续学习，缓解版本迭代中的解码失效问题。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 在避免灾难性遗忘的同时保持跨版本码流兼容性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: 该论文针对StyleGAN压缩中通道剪枝容易损害生成多样性、导致模式坍塌的问题，提出了一种多样性感知的通道剪枝方法。方法通过衡量通道对生成样本多样性的贡献来指导剪枝，而非仅依赖重构误差或重要性分数。相比常规剪枝，该方法在压缩StyleGAN时更好地保留了生成样本的多样性。摘要未给出具体FID等数值，但对生成模型压缩具有实用意义。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the loss of generation diversity in StyleGAN compression caused by conventional channel pruning. It proposes a diversity-aware channel pruning method that selects channels based on their contribution to sample diversity rather than only reconstruction or importance. Compared with standard pruning, it better preserves diversity under compression, although specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 将多样性纳入生成模型剪枝准则，思路新颖，对GAN压缩研究有参考价值。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法用于StyleGAN压缩。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 以生成多样性作为通道重要性度量，缓解剪枝导致的模式坍塌。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 在压缩StyleGAN的同时更好地保持生成样本多样性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离、剪枝策略难以自适应的问题，提出通过可学习智能体引导与对齐来联合训练和剪枝CNN。方法引入可学习的agent产生剪枝决策，并通过引导与对齐机制使剪枝过程与训练目标协同优化。相比两阶段或固定准则剪枝，该方法实现了训练与剪枝的端到端联合。摘要未给出具体精度/压缩率数据，但联合优化思路具有借鉴意义。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between training and pruning in CNN compression by jointly training and pruning via learnable agent guidance and alignment. A learnable agent generates pruning decisions that are aligned with the training objective for end-to-end optimization. Compared with two-stage or fixed-criterion pruning, it unifies training and pruning, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 用可学习agent统一训练与剪枝，属于剪枝自动化方向的合理探索。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出基于可学习智能体引导与对齐的CNN联合训练与剪枝框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 以可学习agent产生剪枝决策并与训练目标对齐，实现端到端联合优化。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 实现训练与剪枝的联合优化（摘要未给出具体精度与压缩率数值）。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习中不同设备算力异构、难以用统一剪枝模型适配的问题，提出了设备感知的联邦网络剪枝方法。方法在联邦训练过程中为不同设备生成/分配适配其资源约束的剪枝子网络，并协调各子网络的聚合。相比统一剪枝或独立本地剪枝，该方法更好地兼顾了异构设备与全局模型性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但对边缘联邦部署有实际意义。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper targets heterogeneous device capabilities in federated learning, where a single pruned model cannot fit all clients. It proposes device-wise federated network pruning that produces or assigns sub-networks matched to each device's resource budget while coordinating their aggregation. Compared with uniform or purely local pruning, it better balances heterogeneous devices and global performance, though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 将剪枝与联邦学习异构性结合，面向边缘部署，问题设定有现实价值。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出面向异构设备的联邦网络剪枝方法。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 在联邦训练中为不同设备分配适配资源的剪枝子网络并协调聚合。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 在异构设备下兼顾本地资源约束与全局模型性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态剪枝与静态剪枝各自为政、难以统一的问题，提出BilevelPruning将动态与静态通道剪枝统一到一个双层优化框架中。方法通过双层优化同时学习静态通道保留结构与输入相关的动态剪枝策略。相比单独使用动态或静态剪枝，该方法在压缩率与精度之间取得更好折中。摘要未给出具体数值，但统一框架的思路对剪枝研究有参考价值。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the divide between dynamic and static channel pruning by proposing BilevelPruning, a unified bilevel optimization framework. It jointly learns a static channel retention structure and input-dependent dynamic pruning policies. Compared with using dynamic or static pruning alone, it achieves a better compression-accuracy trade-off, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 统一动态与静态剪枝的双层优化框架，思路清晰，对剪枝方法学有借鉴意义。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出统一动态与静态通道剪枝的双层优化框架BilevelPruning。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 用双层优化同时学习静态通道结构与输入相关的动态剪枝策略。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 在压缩率与精度间取得更优折中（摘要未给出具体数值）。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: 该论文针对CapsNet中胶囊冗余、路由计算开销大且特征易重叠的问题，提出OrthCaps——一种带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet。方法通过正交约束使胶囊表示去相关，并采用稀疏注意力路由降低计算量，同时引入剪枝去除冗余胶囊。相比原始CapsNet，该方法在保持或提升精度的同时减少了参数量与计算开销。摘要未给出具体数据集数值，但对胶囊网络改进有参考价值。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper addresses capsule redundancy, costly routing, and overlapping representations in CapsNets by proposing OrthCaps, an orthogonal CapsNet with sparse attention routing and pruning. It enforces orthogonality to decorrelate capsules, uses sparse attention routing to cut computation, and prunes redundant capsules. Compared with vanilla CapsNet, it reduces parameters and computation while maintaining or improving accuracy, though specific dataset numbers are not given in the abstract.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 将正交约束、稀疏注意力路由与剪枝结合改进CapsNet，方向明确，值得关注。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet（OrthCaps）。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 以正交约束去相关胶囊表示，并用稀疏注意力路由与剪枝降低冗余与开销。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 在保持或提升精度的同时减少参数量与计算开销（摘要未给出具体数值）。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: 联邦学习场景下动态剪枝面临客户端内存开销大和通信成本高的问题。FedMef 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架，通过只维护稀疏掩码和轻量级重要性评分来避免存储完整稠密模型副本。相比已有联邦剪枝方法，它降低了客户端峰值内存并减少了通信轮次。在多个基准上实现了与稠密联邦训练相当的精度，同时显著降低内存占用。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: Federated dynamic pruning suffers from high client memory overhead and communication cost. FedMef introduces a memory-efficient federated dynamic pruning framework that maintains only sparse masks and lightweight importance scores instead of full dense model replicas. It reduces client peak memory and communication rounds while matching dense federated training accuracy on several benchmarks.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 对边缘端联邦学习部署有实用价值，但与视觉感知核心任务关联较弱。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架 FedMef。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 以稀疏掩码与轻量评分替代完整稠密副本，降低客户端内存。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低内存与通信开销。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: 大模型微调阶段计算与显存开销巨大，现有剪枝方法多针对推理而非微调。本文提出面向微调的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法，在微调过程中动态识别并移除冗余结构以降低训练成本。相比静态剪枝，它能在微调中自适应调整稀疏结构。实验表明在保持下游任务性能的同时减少了训练资源消耗。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: Finetuning large models is computationally and memory intensive, yet most pruning methods target inference rather than finetuning. This work proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning approach that dynamically identifies and removes redundant structures during finetuning. It adapts sparsity throughout finetuning and reduces training cost while preserving downstream performance.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 对大规模视觉模型微调的资源优化有参考意义，但缺乏具体任务数据支撑。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向微调阶段的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 在微调过程中动态调整稀疏结构而非固定剪枝。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 在保持下游性能的同时降低微调资源消耗。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: 彩票假设中寻找稀疏子网络通常依赖昂贵的迭代训练或梯度信息。本文提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝方法，利用权重谱信息在训练前预测可保留的彩票子网络。相比传统 IMP 等迭代方法，它无需反复重训练即可定位稀疏结构。在视觉模型上以更低计算成本找到性能接近的稀疏子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: Finding lottery tickets typically requires expensive iterative training or gradient information. This paper proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning method that predicts retainable lottery subnetworks before training using weight spectrum information. It locates sparse structures without repeated retraining and achieves comparable sparse subnetworks at lower computational cost on vision models.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 为彩票假设提供了更高效的理论驱动剪枝视角，方法新颖。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出基于数据驱动谱前瞻的彩票子网络发现方法。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用权重谱信息在训练前预测稀疏子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 以更低计算成本找到性能接近的稀疏子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: RGB-D 6DoF 物体位姿估计中，表面编码与对应关系匹配的效率和精度难以兼顾。HiPose 提出分层二值表面编码与对应剪枝策略，将连续表面坐标离散化为二值编码并分层匹配。相比基于稠密对应的方法，它提升了对应匹配效率与鲁棒性。在多个 6DoF 位姿基准上取得有竞争力的精度并降低计算量。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation struggles to balance efficiency and accuracy in surface encoding and correspondence matching. HiPose proposes hierarchical binary surface encoding with correspondence pruning, discretizing continuous surface coordinates into binary codes for hierarchical matching. It improves matching efficiency and robustness over dense correspondence methods, achieving competitive accuracy on 6DoF pose benchmarks with reduced computation.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 对机器人抓取与自动驾驶中的物体位姿估计有直接参考价值，方法设计扎实。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出分层二值表面编码与对应剪枝的 RGB-D 6DoF 位姿估计方法。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 将表面坐标离散为分层二值编码以加速对应匹配。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在多个 6DoF 位姿基准上取得有竞争力精度并降低计算量。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: 源无关场景下模型知识产权保护缺乏有效手段，现有水印方法依赖源数据。本文提出 MAP，通过掩码剪枝在无源数据条件下嵌入并验证模型所有权。相比需要源数据的水印方法，它仅依赖模型参数即可完成保护与验证。实验表明在多种模型上实现了可靠的版权验证且不影响原任务性能。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: Model intellectual property protection in source-free settings lacks effective means, as existing watermarking relies on source data. This paper proposes MAP, which embeds and verifies ownership via mask pruning without source data. Unlike source-dependent watermarking, it operates solely on model parameters, achieving reliable ownership verification across models without degrading original task performance.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 对模型版权保护有实际意义，但与视觉感知任务本身关联有限。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出源无关的掩码剪枝模型知识产权保护方法 MAP。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 在无源数据条件下通过掩码剪枝嵌入所有权信息。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 实现可靠版权验证且不影响原任务性能。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: ViT 推理中大量 token 冗余导致计算浪费，现有 token 剪枝多需微调或额外训练。Zero-TPrune 提出零样本 token 剪枝方法，利用预训练 Transformer 的注意力图评估 token 重要性。相比需重训练的方法，它无需任何微调即可直接剪枝。在多个 ViT 模型上实现显著加速且精度损失很小。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: Token redundancy in ViT inference wastes computation, and existing token pruning usually requires finetuning or extra training. Zero-TPrune proposes zero-shot token pruning that leverages the attention graph of pretrained Transformers to assess token importance. It prunes directly without any finetuning, achieving notable speedups with minimal accuracy loss across multiple ViT models.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 零样本剪枝思路对 ViT 高效部署有较强实用价值，方法简洁有效。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出利用注意力图的零样本 token 剪枝方法 Zero-TPrune。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 无需微调，直接基于预训练注意力图评估并剪枝 token。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: 在多个 ViT 上显著加速且精度损失很小。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: 针对现有网络剪枝方法依赖预训练权重、难以从零训练（from scratch）的问题，本文提出 Auto-Train-Once（ATO），用控制器网络引导自动剪枝。方法在训练过程中由控制器动态决定各层稀疏结构，并联合优化权重与结构，避免了两阶段流程。相比传统从预训练模型剪枝的方案，ATO 可直接从随机初始化开始训练并达到可比甚至更优的精度-效率权衡。摘要未给出具体数据集数值，但强调在多个基准上优于从零训练的基线。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing pruning methods that rely on pre-trained weights by proposing Auto-Train-Once (ATO), a controller-network-guided automatic pruning framework that operates from scratch. A controller network dynamically determines the sparse structure of each layer and jointly optimizes weights and architecture, eliminating the two-stage pipeline. Compared with prior from-scratch and post-training pruning baselines, ATO achieves comparable or better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs without requiring pre-training.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 将控制器网络引入从零训练剪枝流程，思路清晰，对高效训练与部署有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出控制器网络引导的从零训练自动剪枝框架 Auto-Train-Once。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 用控制器网络在训练中动态决定各层稀疏结构，实现端到端的从零剪枝。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 在多个基准上取得优于从零训练基线的精度-效率权衡。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: 针对数据集剪枝（dataset pruning）中样本重要性评估不充分的问题，本文提出时序双深度评分（TDDS），跨越训练进程评估样本价值。方法在不同训练深度上对样本进行双深度打分，捕捉样本在训练早期与后期的动态重要性，从而更准确地筛选核心子集。相比仅用单一时点或单一深度评分的已有方法，TDDS 在多个数据集上以更少样本保持甚至提升训练精度。摘要未列出具体数值，但强调在跨架构与跨数据集设置下的稳健性。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient sample-importance estimation in dataset pruning by proposing Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS), which evaluates samples across training progress. TDDS scores samples at dual depths to capture their dynamic importance in early and late training stages, enabling more accurate coreset selection. Compared with single-time or single-depth scoring baselines, TDDS maintains or improves accuracy with fewer samples across multiple datasets and architectures.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 从训练时序角度改进数据集剪枝评分，方法简洁，对数据高效训练有启发，但与视觉感知任务直接相关性有限。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出跨训练进程的时序双深度评分 TDDS 用于数据集剪枝。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 在双深度上评估样本动态重要性，突破单一时点评分的局限。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 在多个数据集与架构上以更少样本保持或提升训练精度。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: 针对深度补全中稀疏深度图在不同区域稀疏度差异大、现有方法难以自适应的问题，本文提出掩码空间传播网络（Masked Spatial Propagation Network）。方法利用掩码机制引导空间传播，使网络能根据局部稀疏程度自适应地细化深度，并可与单目/多模态 3D 检测流程结合。相比固定传播策略的已有工作，该方法在稀疏度变化剧烈的场景下显著提升深度精度。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在多个深度补全基准上达到领先水平。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge that sparse depth maps exhibit highly varying sparsity across regions, which existing depth completion methods struggle to adapt to, by proposing a Masked Spatial Propagation Network. The method uses masking to guide spatial propagation so that refinement adapts to local sparsity, and it can be integrated into mono/multi-modal 3D detection pipelines. Compared with fixed propagation strategies, it substantially improves depth accuracy under strongly varying sparsity, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple depth completion benchmarks.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 稀疏自适应深度补全对单目/多模态 3D 检测有直接支撑作用，方法设计合理，值得关注。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出掩码空间传播网络实现稀疏度自适应的深度补全。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 用掩码引导空间传播，使深度细化随局部稀疏度自适应调整。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 在多个深度补全基准上取得领先精度，尤其在稀疏度变化剧烈场景下提升明显。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: 针对稀疏对抗攻击在迁移性上不足的问题，本文提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构稀疏对抗攻击方法。方法通过精确组稀疏约束训练生成结构化稀疏扰动，使攻击在不同模型间具有更强迁移性。相比逐像素稀疏攻击，结构稀疏扰动更符合语义结构，从而提升黑盒迁移成功率。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在多个模型上优于现有稀疏攻击基线。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper targets the limited transferability of sparse adversarial attacks and proposes a transferable structural sparse attack via exact group sparsity training. The method trains with exact group sparsity constraints to generate structured sparse perturbations that transfer better across models. Compared with pixel-wise sparse attacks, the structural perturbations are more semantically coherent, improving black-box transfer success rates over existing sparse attack baselines.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 从组稀疏角度提升稀疏对抗攻击迁移性，对感知模型鲁棒性评测有参考意义，但非主流感知任务。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构稀疏对抗攻击。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 用精确组稀疏约束生成结构化稀疏扰动以增强跨模型迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 在多个模型上取得优于现有稀疏攻击基线的迁移攻击效果。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: 针对 N:M 稀疏在 GPU 上加速受限、现有方法难以兼顾精度与硬件效率的问题，本文提出 MaxQ 多轴查询机制用于 N:M 稀疏网络。方法通过多轴查询在权重选择时同时考虑多个维度的重要性，从而在保持 N:M 结构化稀疏约束下提升模型精度。相比单轴评分或固定模式的 N:M 稀疏方法，MaxQ 在相同稀疏度下取得更高精度。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在多种网络与任务上验证了有效性。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy-efficiency trade-off of N:M sparsity on GPUs by proposing MaxQ, a multi-axis query mechanism for N:M sparse networks. MaxQ selects weights by querying importance along multiple axes while strictly satisfying the N:M structural constraint, improving accuracy at a fixed sparsity level. Compared with single-axis or fixed-pattern N:M sparsity methods, it achieves higher accuracy across various networks and tasks.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: N:M 稀疏是硬件友好的加速手段，多轴查询思路对高效感知模型部署有实用价值。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询机制 MaxQ 用于 N:M 稀疏网络。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 在 N:M 约束下通过多轴重要性查询优化权重选择。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 在相同稀疏度下于多种网络与任务上取得更高精度。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: 针对训练后稀疏（post-training sparsity）方法各自为政、难以统一的问题，本文提出统一框架 UniPTS。方法将多种训练后稀疏化技术纳入统一表述，分析其共性与差异，并据此设计更高效的稀疏化流程。相比单一 PTS 方法，UniPTS 在无需重训练的前提下取得更优的精度-稀疏度权衡。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在多个模型与稀疏度设置下验证了框架的通用性与有效性。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of post-training sparsity (PTS) methods by proposing UniPTS, a unified framework that formulates diverse PTS techniques under a common view. By analyzing their commonalities and differences, UniPTS designs a more effective sparsification pipeline without retraining. Compared with individual PTS methods, it achieves better accuracy-sparsity trade-offs across multiple models and sparsity settings.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 统一训练后稀疏框架有助于理解与选择稀疏化方案，对模型压缩与部署有参考价值。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的训练后稀疏框架 UniPTS。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 将多种 PTS 技术纳入统一表述并据此设计高效稀疏化流程。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 在无需重训练下于多个模型与稀疏度设置上取得更优精度-稀疏度权衡。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在边缘设备上部署时计算与存储开销大的问题，提出DeepCompress-ViT压缩框架。方法上重新思考ViT的压缩策略，可能结合剪枝、蒸馏或低秩分解等手段在保持精度的前提下降低模型复杂度。相比已有压缩工作，其改进点在于针对ViT结构特性（如注意力机制与MLP块）设计更适配的压缩方案。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合正文验证。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory cost of deploying Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing DeepCompress-ViT, a compression framework tailored to ViT architectures. It rethinks model compression strategies, likely combining pruning, distillation, or low-rank decomposition to reduce complexity while preserving accuracy. The improvement lies in adapting compression to ViT-specific components such as attention and MLP blocks, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: ViT边缘部署是实用价值较高的方向，但摘要信息有限，需关注其压缩率与精度权衡的具体表现。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出面向ViT的DeepCompress-ViT压缩框架以提升边缘部署效率。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 针对ViT结构特性重新设计压缩策略。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有目标检测方法普遍使用sRGB输入、而ISP压缩会丢失复杂光照与天气下关键信息的问题，构建了AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率真实RAW图像、135,601个标注实例、62个类别，覆盖9种光照与天气条件。基于该数据集建立了RAW与sRGB检测的综合基准，发现sRGB预训练因域差距限制了RAW检测潜力，进而提出直接在RAW域预训练，并利用sRGB预训练模型进行知识蒸馏以缓解相机噪声带来的表征学习困难。方法在多样与恶劣条件下取得显著提升，且无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces AODRaw, a large-scale RAW-domain object detection dataset with 7,785 high-resolution images, 135,601 instances, 62 categories, and 9 lighting/weather conditions, to address information loss caused by ISP compression to sRGB. It establishes a comprehensive benchmark revealing that sRGB pre-training constrains RAW detection due to domain gap, and proposes direct RAW-domain pre-training with knowledge distillation from an sRGB-pre-trained model to overcome camera noise. The method achieves substantial improvements under diverse and adverse conditions without extra pre-processing modules.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: 数据集规模大、条件覆盖广，且揭示了RAW域检测的关键问题，对自动驾驶感知在恶劣环境下的鲁棒性研究很有价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模RAW域目标检测数据集AODRaw并建立基准，提出RAW域预训练加sRGB知识蒸馏的检测方案。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在RAW域进行目标检测预训练并利用跨域知识蒸馏缓解噪声问题。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样与恶劣条件下取得显著提升，无需额外预处理模块。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）中现有方法忽视计算效率的问题，提出基于剪枝的高效CTTA-OD方法。动机源于观察到并非所有源域特征都有益，部分域敏感通道会损害目标域性能。方法引入敏感度引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像与实例两个层面量化通道对域差异的敏感度，并通过加权稀疏正则化抑制和剪除敏感通道，聚焦于不变通道的自适应；同时提出随机通道重激活机制以恢复被剪通道，缓解过早剪枝风险。在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked computational efficiency in continual test-time adaptive object detection (CTTA-OD) by proposing a pruning-based efficient method. Observing that certain domain-sensitive feature channels harm target-domain performance, it introduces a sensitivity-guided channel pruning strategy that quantifies channel sensitivity at both image and instance levels, applying weighted sparsity regularization to suppress sensitive channels while focusing adaptation on invariant ones. A stochastic channel reactivation mechanism restores pruned channels to mitigate early-pruning risks, achieving superior results on three benchmarks.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 将剪枝引入持续测试时自适应检测，兼顾效率与效果，对资源受限的自动驾驶在线部署有参考意义。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出敏感度引导剪枝与随机通道重激活的持续测试时自适应目标检测方法。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 从域敏感通道角度出发，用剪枝实现高效CTTA-OD并引入通道重激活机制。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云属性压缩中现有高斯与拉普拉斯熵模型未能充分利用神经网络估计的熵参数信息的问题，提出广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更准确地估计隐变量概率。同时指出现有方法在算术编码中对每个整数使用固定似然区间限制了性能，提出均值误差判别器（MED）判断熵参数估计是否准确并动态调整似然区间。实验表明该方法在三个基于VAE的点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能，并可推广至图像与视频压缩任务。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of entropy parameters estimated by neural networks in learned point cloud attribute compression by introducing a generalized Gaussian entropy model that controls tail shape via a shape parameter for more accurate probability estimation. It also proposes a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) to dynamically adjust likelihood intervals during arithmetic coding, replacing fixed intervals. Experiments show significant rate-distortion improvements on three VAE-based models, with applicability to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 属于点云压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知中的3D检测/BEV等任务关联较弱，但对点云数据处理有参考价值。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型与均值误差判别器用于点云属性压缩。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 用形状参数控制尾部形状并动态调整算术编码的似然区间。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在三个VAE模型上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: 该论文针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩问题，提出TopNet——一种基于Transformer的高效占用预测网络。方法利用Transformer对八叉树节点进行占用预测以提升几何压缩效率。相比已有工作，其改进点在于将Transformer引入八叉树点云几何压缩的占用预测环节。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合正文验证。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper addresses octree-structured point cloud geometry compression by proposing TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network. It leverages Transformers to predict occupancy of octree nodes for improved geometry compression efficiency. The improvement lies in applying Transformer-based occupancy prediction to octree point cloud compression, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 属于点云几何压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限，但占用预测思路与Occupancy任务有一定概念交集。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的八叉树点云几何压缩占用预测网络TopNet。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 将Transformer高效占用预测引入八叉树点云几何压缩。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本驱动3D场景编辑中现有方法依赖2D扩散模型、忽视多视图信息导致多视图不一致，以及3DGS编辑优化效率低（预训练高斯保留过多源信息阻碍优化）的问题，提出EditSplat框架，集成多视图融合引导（MFG）与注意力引导修剪（AGT）。MFG通过将多视图信息融入扩散过程，结合无分类器引导与3DGS几何结构保证多视图一致性；AGT利用3DGS显式表示选择性修剪和优化3D高斯，提升优化效率并实现精确的局部语义编辑。大量定性与定量实验验证了其效果。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view inconsistency and inefficient optimization in text-driven 3D scene editing with 3D Gaussian Splatting by proposing EditSplat, which integrates Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT). MFG ensures multi-view consistency by incorporating multi-view information into the diffusion process with classifier-free guidance and 3DGS geometry, while AGT selectively prunes and optimizes 3D Gaussians for efficient, semantically rich local editing. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments validate the approach.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 3DGS场景编辑与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，但多视图一致性与注意力引导优化思路对多相机感知有间接启发。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出集成多视图融合引导与注意力引导修剪的文本驱动3DGS场景编辑框架EditSplat。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 利用3DGS显式表示进行注意力引导修剪，并将多视图信息融入扩散过程保证一致性。
2412.11520|v2.result: 大量定性与定量实验验证了编辑效果与效率。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在高分辨率图像下视觉编码器延迟高、视觉token数量大的效率瓶颈，论文提出FastVLM，通过系统分析图像分辨率、视觉延迟、token数与LLM规模之间的权衡关系，设计了混合视觉编码器FastViTHD，直接输出更少token并显著降低高分辨率编码时间。与依赖额外token剪枝的方法不同，FastVLM仅通过缩放输入图像即可在视觉token数与分辨率之间取得最优平衡，简化了模型设计。该工作为VLM视觉编码效率优化提供了清晰的trade-off分析框架。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: FastVLM addresses the inefficiency of ViT-based visual encoders at high resolutions, where token count and encoding latency grow rapidly. It introduces FastViTHD, a hybrid vision encoder that outputs fewer tokens and reduces encoding time, achieving an optimized latency-size-accuracy trade-off solely by scaling input resolution without extra token pruning. This simplifies VLM design while maintaining high-resolution performance.

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: 论文探究VLM的视觉嵌入空间是否也像文本空间一样具有组合性结构，针对视觉数据噪声大、稀疏导致组合性分析困难的问题，提出Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE)框架，用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示。实验表明预训练VLM的视觉嵌入确实呈现组合性排列，GDE在组合分类上优于假设线性几何的对比方法，并在group robustness任务上取得更高结果。该工作为理解VLM视觉表示结构提供了新视角。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This work investigates whether visual embeddings of pre-trained VLMs exhibit compositional structure, addressing noise and sparsity challenges via a geometry-aware framework called Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE). GDE approximates image representations with compositional structures in latent space and outperforms linear-geometry counterparts in compositional classification and group robustness. It reveals that VLM visual embeddings are compositionally arranged.

2503.17142|v2.innovation: 用几何感知的可分解嵌入替代线性假设，建模视觉表示的组合结构。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类上优于线性方法，在group robustness任务上取得更高性能。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上评估不足的问题，论文提出MotionBench基准，涵盖六类运动导向问题类型并采集多源真实视频数据。实验显示现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现很差，为此作者系统研究了面向视频特征压缩的VLM架构，提出高效的Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion方法。结果表明更高帧率输入与TE Fusion能提升运动理解，但仍存在较大提升空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: MotionBench is proposed to evaluate fine-grained motion comprehension of video VLMs across six motion-oriented question types and diverse real-world sources. 2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM处理小时级长视频时受限于上下文长度与计算成本的问题，论文提出Video-XL，利用MLLM固有的KV稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入。具体引入Visual Summarization Token (VST)，对每个视频区间总结视觉信息作为其关联KV，并通过指令微调训练，采用课程学习与复合数据策展两种优化策略，结合动态压缩进一步提升压缩质量。该工作为超长视频理解提供了高效方案。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: Video-XL addresses long video understanding under limited context and high cost by leveraging MLLMs' inherent KV sparsification. It introduces a Visual Summarization Token (VST) per video interval to summarize visual information as associated KV, trained via instruction fine-tuning with curriculum learning and composite data curation, plus dynamic compression. This enables efficient hour-scale video understanding.
2409.14485|v2.assessment: 长视频理解方向的重要工作，KV稀疏化与VST设计思路清晰，对多模态长序列处理有借鉴意义。
2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL，利用VST与KV稀疏化实现小时级长视频的高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 引入Visual Summarization Token将视频区间信息压缩为KV，并结合课程学习与动态压缩。
2409.14485|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上实现高效压缩与性能提升，支持小时级视频输入。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM对图像和视频采用不同token压缩策略、难以统一处理的问题，论文提出Progressive Visual Token Compression (PVC)，将每张图像扩展为静态视频，统一图像与视频的token压缩。每帧token渐进编码并自适应压缩，以补充前帧未提取的信息，利用视频固有时间冗余高效压缩。在每帧仅64 token的默认设置下仍能保留空间细节与时间变化，实验表明模型在多种视频理解任务上达到SOTA。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: PVC unifies visual token compression for images and videos by extending each image into a static video and progressively encoding/compressing frame tokens to supplement prior frames. Exploiting temporal redundancy, it preserves spatial details and temporal changes with only 64 tokens per frame by default. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance across various video understanding tasks.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: 统一图像与视频token压缩的思路新颖且实用，对多模态长序列效率优化有参考价值。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出PVC统一图像与视频的渐进式视觉token压缩策略。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像视为静态视频，通过渐进编码与自适应压缩统一图像和视频的token处理。
2412.09613|v2.result: 在每帧64 token下保留细节与动态，多种视频理解任务达到SOTA。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理开销大的问题，已有token剪枝方法多依赖贪心启发式重要性准则，且与FlashAttention和KV cache不兼容。本文提出Libra-Merging，从重要性-冗余度与剪枝-合并的权衡角度设计加速插件，在预填充阶段一次性完成剪枝以压缩KV cache。相比已有工作，方法兼顾了剪枝与合并两种压缩范式，并显式建模冗余度。摘要未给出具体加速比与精度数据，需查阅全文确认效果。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_en: Existing visual token pruning methods for Large Vision-Language Models rely on greedy heuristic importance criteria and are incompatible with FlashAttention and KV cache. This paper proposes Libra-Merging, an acceleration plug-in that trades off importance versus redundancy and pruning versus merging, performing one-shot pruning during the prefilling stage to reduce KV cache size. The abstract does not report quantitative speedup or accuracy figures.

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: VLM推理时视觉token数量庞大导致计算与显存开销高，已有剪枝方法依赖贪心注意力准则且与FlashAttention、KV cache不兼容。本文提出TopV，将token剪枝建模为优化问题而非依赖注意力分数，在预填充阶段仅执行一次剪枝，从而同时兼容FlashAttention并有效压缩KV cache。优化框架引入视觉感知代价函数，综合考虑特征相似度与相对空间关系等因素。方法无需额外训练或微调，摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: Vision-Language Models suffer from excessive visual tokens at inference, and prior pruning methods rely on greedy attention-based criteria incompatible with FlashAttention and KV cache. TopV formulates token pruning as an optimization problem with a visual-aware cost function incorporating feature similarity and relative spatial relations, performing pruning only once during prefilling to remain FlashAttention-compatible and reduce KV cache size. It requires no additional training or fine-tuning.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: 把token剪枝形式化为优化问题并解决FlashAttention/KV cache兼容性，是VLM加速中较扎实的一步，实用价值较高。
2503.18278|v2.contribution: 提出无需训练、兼容FlashAttention与KV cache的优化式视觉token剪枝方法TopV。
2503.18278|v2.innovation: 用优化问题替代贪心注意力准则，并引入视觉感知代价函数。
2503.18278|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: LVLM处理长视觉token序列的计算开销在资源受限设备上难以承受，已有方法在LLM解码层用固定剪枝率去除冗余视觉token。本文观察到剪枝率的影响在不同LLM层和不同实例（图像-提示对）间差异显著，因此提出ATP-LLaVA，为每个LLM层自适应确定实例相关的剪枝率。核心是Adaptive Token Pruning模块，根据输入实例自适应计算重要性分数与剪枝阈值，可无缝插入任意两层LLM之间且开销可忽略，并配合Spatial Augmented Pruning策略。摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: Prior LVLM token pruning uses fixed ratios, but this paper observes that the optimal pruning ratio varies across LLM layers and instances. ATP-LLaVA introduces an Adaptive Token Pruning module that computes instance-specific importance scores and pruning thresholds per LLM layer, insertable between any two layers with negligible overhead, together with a Spatial Augmented Pruning strategy. Quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2412.00447|v2.assessment: 层间与实例自适应剪枝率的观察有说服力，模块化设计便于落地，是VLM效率方向值得关注的工作。
2412.00447|v2.contribution: 提出层间与实例自适应的视觉token剪枝框架ATP-LLaVA。
2412.00447|v2.innovation: 用自适应阈值替代固定剪枝率，并设计可插拔的ATP模块与空间增强剪枝。
2412.00447|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: VLM受限于上下文窗口和高分辨率图像/视频处理的高计算成本，已有视觉压缩方法用外部模块压缩视觉token，迫使LLM理解压缩表示，导致视觉信息损失。本文提出VoCo-LLaMA，首个用LLM自身压缩视觉token的方法：在视觉指令微调阶段引入Vision Compression token，并通过注意力蒸馏把LLM理解视觉token的方式迁移到对VoCo token的处理上。方法在576倍压缩率下性能损失极小，FLOPs减少最多94.8%，推理时间加速69.6%。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: Existing vision compression methods use external modules and force LLMs to understand compressed tokens, causing visual information loss. VoCo-LLaMA is the first approach to compress vision tokens using the LLM itself, introducing Vision Compression tokens during vision instruction tuning and distilling how the LLM comprehends vision tokens into processing VoCo tokens via attention distillation. It achieves minimal performance loss at 576x compression, up to 94.8% fewer FLOPs and 69.6% inference speedup.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: 用LLM自身完成视觉压缩并给出576倍压缩下的强结果，思路新颖且数据亮眼，是VLM效率方向的高质量工作。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用LLM自身进行视觉token压缩的方法VoCo-LLaMA。
2406.12275|v2.innovation: 引入Vision Compression token并借助注意力蒸馏将视觉理解能力迁移到压缩token上。
2406.12275|v2.result: 576倍压缩下性能损失极小，FLOPs减少94.8%，推理加速69.6%。

2503.16843|v2.summary_cn: MLLM在适配下游任务时，LoRA虽能高效获取专用知识，但在视觉指令微调中引入大量有害冗余，加剧通用知识遗忘并损害下游性能。本文提出LoRASculpt，在理论保证下向LoRA引入稀疏更新以剔除冗余参数，并提出Conflict Mitigation Regularizer细化LoRA更新轨迹，缓解与预训练权重的知识冲突。实验表明即使在≤5%的极高稀疏度下，方法仍能同时提升泛化性与下游任务表现，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
2503.16843|v2.summary_en: LoRA adaptation of MLLMs introduces harmful redundancy during visual instruction tuning, exacerbating forgetting of general knowledge. LoRASculpt introduces sparse updates into LoRA with theoretical guarantees to discard redundant parameters, plus a Conflict Mitigation Regularizer that refines the LoRA update trajectory to mitigate conflicts with pretrained weights. Even at sparsity levels of 5% or below, it improves both generalization and downstream performance.
2503.16843|v2.assessment: 把稀疏化与知识冲突缓解结合到LoRA微调中，对MLLM持续学习/微调场景有参考价值，理论保证是加分项。
2503.16843|v2.contribution: 提出LoRASculpt，通过稀疏更新与冲突缓解正则协调MLLM的通用与专用知识。
2503.16843|v2.innovation: 在理论保证下向LoRA注入稀疏更新，并设计冲突缓解正则项修正更新轨迹。
2503.16843|v2.result: 在≤5%稀疏度下同时提升泛化性与下游任务性能，缓解灾难性遗忘。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: LMM中视觉token数量庞大导致LLM输入长度剧增、推理延迟高，已有token剪枝方法要么需要大量校准与微调，要么依赖次优重要性度量，导致保留token间冗余度高。本文将token剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题（MMDP），目标是选出彼此多样性最大的token子集，再剪除其余token。DivPrune通过求解MMDP降低冗余、最大化保留token的多样性，从而在无需微调的情况下提升效率。摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: Visual tokens in Large Multimodal Models greatly increase LLM input length and inference latency, while existing pruning methods either need extensive calibration/fine-tuning or rely on suboptimal importance metrics that leave high redundancy. DivPrune formulates token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem (MMDP) to select a maximally diverse subset of tokens and prune the rest, reducing redundancy without fine-tuning. Quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: 以多样性最大化替代重要性排序来选token，视角清晰且无需微调，是LMM效率方向有竞争力的方法。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出基于多样性的视觉token剪枝方法DivPrune。
2503.02175|v2.innovation: 将token剪枝建模为最大-最小多样性问题（MMDP）并求解。
2503.02175|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMM）在低比特压缩方面研究不足的问题，论文从理论和实验上证明了多模态输入冗余导致的注意力矩阵稀疏性可以约束Query和Key权重矩阵的压缩误差。基于此提出CASP，对Q/K权重矩阵进行数据感知的低秩分解，并通过最优比特分配在所有层上进行量化。CASP与任意量化技术兼容，在图像和视频语言基准上将现有2-bit量化方法（AQLM和QuIP#）平均提升21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the under-explored problem of low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). It theoretically and experimentally shows that the sparsity of the attention matrix, induced by redundant multimodal inputs, bounds the compression error of Query and Key weight matrices. Based on this, CASP performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Q/K weights followed by optimal bit-allocation quantization, improving state-of-the-art 2-bit methods (AQLM, QuIP#) by 21% on average on image- and video-language benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 将注意力稀疏性理论引入LMM压缩，方法通用且与现有量化技术正交，对多模态模型部署有实用价值。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力稀疏性的LMM极端压缩技术CASP，实现Q/K权重的低秩分解与最优比特量化。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 从理论和实验上建立注意力矩阵稀疏性与Q/K权重压缩误差的界，并据此设计数据感知压缩流程。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在图像和视频语言基准上平均超越AQLM和QuIP#等2-bit量化方法21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: 现有MLLM难以同时处理时序和空间定位，原因在于坐标组合爆炸导致语言-视觉坐标对齐困难，以及视频特征压缩中细粒度时空信息编码困难。论文提出LLaVA-ST，包含Language-Aligned Positional Embedding（将文本坐标特殊token嵌入视觉空间）和Spatial-Temporal Packer（将时空分辨率特征压缩解耦为两个point-to-region注意力流），并构建了4.3M样本的ST-Align数据集。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLMs struggle to jointly handle temporal and spatial localization due to the combinatorial explosion of coordinates and the difficulty of encoding fine-grained spatio-temporal information during video feature compression. The paper proposes LLaVA-ST with a Language-Aligned Positional Embedding that embeds textual coordinate tokens into visual space, and a Spatial-Temporal Packer that decouples temporal and spatial feature compression into two point-to-region attention streams, along with the 4.3M-sample ST-Align dataset.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 针对视频细粒度时空理解这一难点提出系统性方案，数据集和架构设计对多模态视频理解研究者有参考价值。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出LLaVA-ST模型及ST-Align数据集，实现细粒度时空多模态理解。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入与时空解耦的point-to-region注意力压缩机制。
2501.08282|v2.result: 构建4.3M训练样本的ST-Align数据集，在细粒度时空理解任务上取得提升。

2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: 论文研究为何基于梯度的解释方法在Transformer上表现不佳，发现Transformer存在违反FullGrad完备性的梯度流不平衡问题。提出LibraGrad，一种理论驱动的后处理归因方法，通过剪枝和缩放反向路径修正梯度不平衡，不改变前向传播也不增加计算开销。在8种架构、4种模型规模和4个数据集上，LibraGrad在Faithfulness、Completeness Error和Segmentation AP三类指标上全面超越现有白盒方法。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies gradient flow imbalances in Transformers that violate FullGrad-completeness, explaining why gradient-based explanations underperform. It proposes LibraGrad, a theoretically grounded post-hoc method that corrects gradient imbalances via pruning and scaling of backward paths without altering the forward pass or adding overhead. Across 8 architectures, 4 model sizes, and 4 datasets, LibraGrad universally improves gradient-based attribution methods on faithfulness, completeness error, and segmentation AP.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 对Transformer可解释性有理论贡献，方法轻量通用，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性有限。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出修正Transformer梯度流不平衡的后处理归因方法LibraGrad。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 揭示Transformer违反FullGrad完备性的梯度不平衡问题并通过反向路径剪枝缩放修正。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在8种架构、4种规模、4个数据集上全面超越现有白盒归因方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: 3D Gaussian Splatting在复杂场景中需要数百万个高斯点，存储和内存开销大，现有剪枝方法依赖启发式组合，高压缩率下视觉保真度和前景细节严重退化。论文提出基于二阶近似的敏感性剪枝分数，通过重建误差对每个高斯空间参数的二阶近似计算重要性，并设计多轮prune-refine流程，可应用于任意预训练3D-GS模型而无需改变训练流程。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting requires millions of Gaussians for complex scenes, causing high storage and memory costs, while existing pruning heuristics degrade visual fidelity and foreground details at high compression ratios. This paper proposes a principled sensitivity pruning score computed as a second-order approximation of the reconstruction error w.r.t. each Gaussian's spatial parameters, plus a multi-round prune-refine pipeline applicable to any pretrained 3D-GS model without changing its training pipeline.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 为3D-GS压缩提供了有理论依据的剪枝准则，对3D场景表示与压缩方向有参考价值，但与BEV/检测主线相关性较低。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶重建误差近似的3D-GS敏感性剪枝方法及多轮prune-refine流程。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 用重建误差对高斯空间参数的二阶近似作为原则性剪枝分数，替代启发式组合。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在更高压缩率下保持视觉保真度和前景细节，优于现有剪枝方法。

2511.05832|v2.summary_cn: ①针对全局自注意力在高分辨率图像上计算与内存开销呈二次增长、而传统局部注意力因窗口内 token 在 1D 序列中不连续导致块稀疏核难以获得实际加速的问题。②提出基于 Hilbert 曲线构造窗口与邻域的方法：先沿 Hilbert 曲线重排图像 token，再在重排后的 1D 序列上形成窗口与邻域，从而显著提升块稀疏度，可与现有块稀疏核结合加速 2D 局部注意力。③相比传统局部注意力模式，该方法在不改变注意力语义的前提下提高了块稀疏利用率，使窗口注意力与滑动注意力分别加速约 4 倍和 18 倍。④实例化为 Hilbert Window Transformer 与 Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer，摘要称两者均取得端到端效果（具体精度数据摘要未给出）。
2511.05832|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of local attention in high-resolution vision transformers, where tokens within a window are non-contiguous in the 1D sequence, preventing block-sparse kernels from yielding real speedups. It proposes constructing windows and neighborhoods along a Hilbert curve: image tokens are reordered by the Hilbert curve and windows are formed on the reordered 1D sequence, substantially increasing block sparsity and enabling combination with existing block-sparse kernels. Experiments report roughly 4x and 18x acceleration for window attention and slide attention, respectively, and the strategy is instantiated as the Hilbert Window Transformer and Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer.
2511.05832|v2.assessment: 属于视觉 Transformer 效率优化的通用方法，思路简洁且加速比可观，但其与自动驾驶感知（检测、BEV、Occupancy 等）的关联是间接的，需自行迁移验证。
2511.05832|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Hilbert 曲线重排 token 以构造高块稀疏窗口/邻域的局部注意力加速方案。
2511.05832|v2.innovation: 利用 Hilbert 曲线的空间局部性保持特性，将 2D 局部注意力转化为 1D 序列上高块稀疏度的块稀疏计算。
2511.05832|v2.result: 窗口注意力与滑动注意力分别获得约 4 倍和 18 倍加速，并实例化为两种 Transformer 变体。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: 多视角点云配准通常采用两阶段流程：先做成对初始对齐，再做全局一致性优化，但相邻点云重叠低、对称结构和重复场景会导致初始对齐歧义。本文提出首个端到端可学习的多视角配准算法，将两阶段联合训练，利用多扫描间的循环一致性来消解歧义。在标准基准上显著优于当时SOTA，且计算开销更低，并给出消融验证各新组件。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: Multiview point cloud registration is typically solved in two stages: pairwise alignment followed by globally consistent refinement, where low overlap, symmetries, and repetitive structures make the initial alignment ambiguous. This paper proposes the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly trains both stages, exploiting cyclic consistency across scans to resolve ambiguity. It substantially outperforms the state of the art on standard benchmarks while being computationally cheaper, with ablations validating each component.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 把多视角配准的两阶段流程统一为端到端可学习框架，思路清晰且工程价值高，对3D感知中的多传感器/多帧融合有借鉴意义。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端联合学习成对对齐与全局一致性优化的多视角3D点云配准算法。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 用可微的全局循环一致性约束把两阶段配准耦合进同一训练目标，替代传统分离式优化。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在标准基准上大幅超越当时SOTA，同时计算成本更低，并通过消融实验验证了各新组件。

Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: 该论文研究多视角物体识别，标题表明其利用视角线索进行自监督与正则化学习。核心思路应是通过跨视角一致性构造自监督信号，并加入正则化以提升多视角特征的表征能力。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体网络设计、对比方法与定量结果。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper addresses multiview object recognition by exploiting clues from views through self-supervised and regularized learning. The core idea is to build self-supervisory signals from cross-view consistency and add regularization to improve multiview representations. The abstract is missing, so the exact architecture, baselines, and quantitative results cannot be verified.

GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_en: This paper proposes GeoGraph, a graph-based approach for multi-view object detection that incorporates geometric cues end-to-end. The motivation is to explicitly model inter-view relations and exploit geometry to improve detection robustness in multi-camera settings. The abstract is missing, so the graph construction, geometric cues, and quantitative gains cannot be verified.

Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_en: This paper studies multi-view action recognition via cross-view video prediction. The idea is to predict frames of one view from another, forcing the model to learn view-invariant and discriminative action representations. The abstract is missing, so the prediction objective, architecture, and benchmark accuracies cannot be verified.
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.assessment: 跨视角预测作为自监督代理任务在视频理解中较有新意，但缺少摘要无法评估其相对已有方法的增益。

Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: 该论文将对比学习扩展到图结构数据，提出多视角图表示学习框架。方法通过对图施加多种增广（如节点特征掩码、边扰动等）构造多视角，并最大化不同视角表示间的一致性来学习节点/图级表征。由于摘要缺失，无法引用具体在下游任务上的精度提升数据，但该工作在图对比学习方向影响较大。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: This paper extends contrastive learning to graph-structured data and proposes a multi-view graph representation learning framework. It constructs multiple views via graph augmentations (e.g., feature masking, edge perturbation) and maximizes agreement between view representations to learn node- and graph-level embeddings. The abstract is missing, so specific downstream accuracy gains cannot be cited, though the work has been influential in graph contrastive learning.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 多视角对比学习在图领域的代表性工作，方法范式对多模态/多传感器表征学习有迁移价值，但与自动驾驶视觉的直接相关度有限。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出面向图数据的多视角对比表示学习框架，通过图增广构造视角并最大化一致性。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.innovation: 将多视角对比学习范式系统性地引入图结构数据，明确图增广与对比目标的设计。

Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中因缺乏真实深度标签而导致的尺度模糊与精度受限问题，提出用最小期望（MED）概率体积来建模深度分布，从而在训练中更好地处理深度不确定性。方法上，作者将深度预测从单点回归改为概率体积表示，并设计相应的自监督损失，使网络能在无LiDAR监督下学习更稳健的深度估计。相比已有仅依赖光度一致性或简单不确定性的自监督方法，该工作显式建模深度概率分布，缓解了遮挡与纹理缺失区域的误差。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，但声称在多个基准上优于现有自监督深度估计器。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the scale ambiguity and limited accuracy of self-supervised monocular depth estimation caused by the absence of ground-truth depth labels. It proposes modeling depth as a minimum expected (MED) probability volume and designs a corresponding self-supervised loss, enabling robust depth learning without LiDAR supervision. Compared with existing photometric-consistency-based methods, it explicitly models depth uncertainty to reduce errors in occluded and textureless regions. The abstract claims improvements over prior self-supervised depth estimators, though specific benchmark numbers are not provided.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该工作将概率体积引入自监督深度估计，思路有一定新意，但缺少具体实验数据，需进一步验证其实际增益。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出用最小期望概率体积建模深度分布的自监督单目深度估计框架。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 将深度预测从点回归改为概率体积表示，并设计对应的自监督损失。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 摘要声称在多个基准上优于现有自监督深度估计器，但未给出具体数值。

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角多人物3D姿态估计问题，提出基于平面扫描立体（plane sweep stereo）的方法，将多相机视角的2D姿态热图通过平面扫描聚合到3D空间中进行联合推理。相比已有方法，其核心改进在于利用平面扫描体积显式建模3D空间中的多视角一致性，从而更鲁棒地处理遮挡和人物交互。在多个公开数据集上取得了优于已有方法的3D姿态估计精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by proposing a plane sweep stereo approach that aggregates 2D pose heatmaps from multiple camera views into a 3D volume for joint reasoning. The key improvement lies in explicitly modeling multi-view consistency in 3D space via plane sweep volumes, enabling more robust handling of occlusion and person interaction. It achieves superior accuracy over existing methods on several public benchmarks.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该工作将平面扫描立体引入多视角多人3D姿态估计，思路清晰，但与人/车自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限，更多属于人体姿态估计范畴。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角多人3D姿态估计框架，实现跨视角3D空间一致性建模。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 将平面扫描立体方法从深度估计迁移到多视角多人3D姿态估计，通过3D体积聚合多视角2D热图。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在多个公开数据集上取得优于已有方法的3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角人群计数问题，提出跨视角跨场景（Cross-View Cross-Scene）的多视角人群计数方法，旨在解决现有方法在视角变化和场景迁移时泛化能力不足的问题。方法通过跨视角特征对齐和跨场景域适应来提升模型在新视角和新场景下的计数精度。相比已有工作，其改进在于同时处理视角差异和场景差异两个维度的域偏移。在多个多视角人群计数数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-view crowd counting by proposing a cross-view cross-scene approach that addresses generalization across both viewpoint changes and scene variations. The method performs cross-view feature alignment and cross-scene domain adaptation to improve counting accuracy under novel views and scenes. Experiments on multiple multi-view crowd counting datasets demonstrate its effectiveness.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 该工作关注多视角人群计数的跨域泛化问题，与自动驾驶感知中的多相机BEV感知在方法论上有一定借鉴意义，但应用场景差异较大。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数框架，同时解决视角和场景两个维度的域适应问题。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 首次将跨视角与跨场景域适应统一到多视角人群计数任务中。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 在多个多视角人群计数数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角聚类（Incomplete Multi-View Clustering）问题，提出COMPLETER框架，通过对比预测（contrastive prediction）来同时恢复缺失视角数据并完成聚类。方法利用对比学习在视角间建立一致性约束，并通过预测网络推断缺失视角的表征。相比已有方法，其改进在于将缺失数据恢复与聚类目标联合优化，而非分步处理。在多个多视角聚类基准上取得了优于已有方法的聚类性能。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering by proposing COMPLETER, a framework that jointly recovers missing views and performs clustering via contrastive prediction. The method establishes cross-view consistency through contrastive learning and infers missing view representations with a prediction network. It achieves superior clustering performance over existing methods on multiple benchmarks.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 该工作属于多视角聚类与对比学习的交叉领域，与自动驾驶感知的关联度较低，但对比预测的思路对自监督表征学习有参考价值。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出COMPLETER框架，通过对比预测联合解决不完整多视角聚类中的缺失数据恢复与聚类问题。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 将对比预测机制引入不完整多视角聚类，实现缺失视角恢复与聚类的端到端联合优化。

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: 该论文针对无纹理光滑表面在未知通用反射率下的多视角3D重建问题，提出一种能够处理未知反射率的光滑表面重建方法。方法通过多视角观测联合估计表面几何和反射率参数，利用反射率模型约束重建过程。相比已有工作，其改进在于不依赖已知反射率假设，能够处理更一般的反射特性。在合成和真实数据上验证了重建精度。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown generic reflectance. The method jointly estimates surface geometry and reflectance parameters from multi-view observations, using a reflectance model to constrain reconstruction. It improves over prior work by not requiring known reflectance assumptions, and is validated on both synthetic and real data.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 该工作属于计算摄影与3D重建的交叉领域，与自动驾驶感知的关联度很低，但其对反射率建模的思路对车载传感器中的镜面反射处理有间接参考价值。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出在未知通用反射率条件下对无纹理光滑表面进行多视角3D重建的方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 联合估计表面几何与未知反射率参数，突破已有方法对已知反射率的依赖。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了重建精度。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur._arxiv_id: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Texture-Less Smooth Surface of Unknown Generic Reflectance.

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频流上的在线多视角深度预测问题，提出DeepVideoMVS方法，通过循环时空融合（recurrent spatio-temporal fusion）将历史时间步的场景几何信息高效传播到当前帧。核心设计是在轻量级编码器-解码器的瓶颈层放置ConvLSTM单元，并利用前一帧深度预测将隐藏状态warp到当前相机平面，实现几何合理的时间传播。相比已有MVS方法，其在数百个室内场景的大多数评估指标上超越SOTA，同时保持实时性能，计算和内存开销增加很小。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DeepVideoMVS, an online multi-view depth prediction approach on posed video streams that propagates scene geometry from previous time steps via recurrent spatio-temporal fusion. A ConvLSTM cell at the bottleneck compresses past information, and the hidden state is warped into the current camera plane using the previous depth prediction for geometrically plausible propagation. It outperforms state-of-the-art MVS methods on most metrics across hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 该工作将循环时空融合引入多视角立体深度估计，方法设计简洁有效，实时性能好，对自动驾驶中基于视频流的深度估计和BEV感知有较强的参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出DeepVideoMVS，通过循环时空融合实现视频流上的在线多视角深度预测。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 利用前一帧深度预测将ConvLSTM隐藏状态warp到当前相机平面，实现几何感知的时间信息传播。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在数百个室内场景的大多数指标上超越SOTA MVS方法，同时保持实时性能。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无监督非刚性表面配准问题，提出循环多视角对齐网络（RMA-Net），通过将非刚性变换表示为多个刚性变换的逐点组合来约束解空间，并采用循环框架迭代求解。方法引入可微分损失函数，在多视角2D深度投影图像上度量3D形状相似性，使整个框架无需真值监督即可端到端训练。在多个数据集上大幅超越已有SOTA方法。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration by proposing a Recurrent Multi-View Alignment Network (RMA-Net) that represents non-rigid transformations as point-wise combinations of rigid transformations, solved iteratively with a recurrent framework. A differentiable loss measuring 3D shape similarity on projected multi-view 2D depth images enables end-to-end training without ground-truth supervision. It outperforms prior state-of-the-art by a large margin on several datasets.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 该工作属于医学/图形学中的非刚性配准领域，与自动驾驶感知的关联度很低，但其多视角可微分投影损失的设计思路对多视角几何学习有间接启发。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出RMA-Net，通过循环框架和可微分多视角投影损失实现无监督非刚性表面配准。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 将非刚性变换分解为逐点刚性变换组合，并利用多视角2D深度投影的可微分损失实现无监督端到端训练。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越已有SOTA方法。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图稠密深度估计问题，本文提出可微扩散（differentiable diffusion）方法，将稀疏点集通过可微splatting（高斯建模+解析透射率）扩散为深度图，并以多视图重投影误差为损失联合优化点的位置、深度和权重。作者设计了高效优化流程，可同时优化5万+个点以重建复杂场景。相比图像处理和深度学习方法，该方法在自监督光场及宽基线图像上均降低了平均误差和离群误差，并展示了高重建质量。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing a sparse set of points whose diffusion into a depth map minimizes multi-view reprojection error under RGB supervision. It introduces differentiable splatting that models points as Gaussians with analytic transmittance, enabling joint optimization of point positions, depths, and weights, with an efficient routine handling 50k+ points. Experiments show improved average and outlier errors over image processing and deep learning baselines, with high reconstruction quality on ground-truth data.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 将经典点云扩散与可微优化结合用于多视图深度估计，思路新颖，但整体更偏图形学/优化而非自动驾驶感知主流路线。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，将稀疏点集优化为稠密深度图并联合优化点位置、深度与权重。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 用高斯建模与解析透射率的可微splatting实现端到端点集优化，支持5万+点同时优化。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在自监督光场与宽基线图像上平均误差和离群误差均优于图像处理与深度学习方法。
