2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图生成图像缺乏与采样过程无关的一致性度量的问题，提出 MEt3R 指标，用于衡量生成的多视图图像之间的一致性。方法利用 DUSt3R 以馈送方式从图像对获得稠密 3D 重建，据此将一视图内容 warp 到另一视图，再比较特征图得到对视角相关效应不变的相似度分数。作者用 MEt3R 评测了大量新视角与视频生成方法，包括其自研的多视图隐扩散模型。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of sampling-independent metrics for generated multi-view images, this paper introduces MEt3R, a metric measuring multi-view consistency. It uses DUSt3R to obtain dense 3D reconstructions from image pairs in a feed-forward manner, warps content across views, and compares feature maps to yield a similarity score invariant to view-dependent effects. MEt3R is used to evaluate a large set of novel-view and video generation methods, including the authors' multi-view latent diffusion model.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 属于生成式多视图一致性与 3D 重建交叉方向，与自动驾驶中的多相机/3D 感知有方法学上的间接联系（DUSt3R 重建、跨视图一致性），但并非直接面向感知任务。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出与采样过程无关的多视图一致性度量 MEt3R。
2501.06336|v2.innovation: 借助 DUSt3R 前馈稠密重建做跨视图 warp 并比较特征图，获得对视角相关效应不变的相似度。
2501.06336|v2.result: 在大量新视角与视频生成方法上验证了 MEt3R 的评测有效性，并用于评估其自研多视图隐扩散模型。

2512.19402|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对机器人操作策略泛化性受限于演示数据采集成本高的问题，尤其是空间泛化场景下的重复采集负担。作者提出 Real2Edit2Real 框架，先通过多视角 RGB 观测重建度量尺度的 3D 场景几何，再在点云上进行深度可靠的 3D 编辑生成新操作轨迹并几何校正机器人位姿，最后用深度为主控信号、结合动作/边缘/光线图的多条件视频生成模型合成空间增强的多视角操作视频。相比已有工作，其改进在于将 3D 可编辑性与 2D 视觉数据通过 3D 控制接口桥接，从而在无需真实重复采集的情况下生成物理一致的新演示。实验在四个真实操作任务上验证了用生成数据训练的策略效果，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
2512.19402|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations that limits spatial generalization of robot manipulation policies. It proposes Real2Edit2Real, a framework that reconstructs metric-scale scene geometry from multi-view RGB, performs depth-reliable 3D editing on point clouds to generate new trajectories with geometrically corrected robot poses, and synthesizes spatially augmented multi-view manipulation videos via a multi-conditional video generation model guided by depth, action, edge, and ray maps. Experiments on four real-world manipulation tasks show that policies trained on the generated data benefit, though no quantitative numbers are reported in the abstract.
2512.19402|v2.assessment: 该工作属于机器人操作数据生成方向，与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测研究领域关联较弱，但其 3D 重建与多条件视频生成思路对多视角数据合成有一定参考价值。
2512.19402|v2.contribution: 提出通过 3D 控制接口桥接 3D 可编辑性与 2D 视觉数据的机器人演示生成框架 Real2Edit2Real。
2512.19402|v2.innovation: 以深度为主控信号、结合动作/边缘/光线图的多条件视频生成模型，实现空间增强的多视角操作视频合成。
2512.19402|v2.result: 在四个真实操作任务上验证了生成数据训练策略的可行性，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张噪声图像的去噪问题，提出Self2Self with Dropout方法，仅利用单张含噪图像自身进行自监督训练，无需干净标签或大量训练数据。方法基于dropout采样生成多组输入-目标对，通过Bernoulli采样构造自监督信号训练去噪网络。相比依赖外部数据或成对样本的传统监督去噪方法，该方法在单图设定下取得有竞争力的去噪效果，并可扩展至多图场景进一步提升性能。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image denoising by proposing Self2Self with Dropout, a self-supervised method that trains a denoising network using only the noisy input image itself without clean labels. It generates input-target pairs via Bernoulli dropout sampling to construct self-supervision signals. The method achieves competitive denoising performance in the single-image setting and can be extended to multi-image scenarios for further improvement.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 该工作较早探索了单图自监督去噪范式，思路简洁，对自监督视觉与图像复原方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.contribution: 提出仅用单张噪声图像进行自监督去噪训练的Self2Self框架。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.innovation: 利用dropout采样构造自监督输入-目标对，实现无需干净标签的单图去噪。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.result: 在单图去噪设定下取得有竞争力的性能，并可扩展至多图场景进一步提升。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su._arxiv_id: Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Supervised Denoising From Single Image.

2004.04581|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像级弱监督语义分割中CAM难以直接作为物体掩码的问题，提出自监督等变注意力机制SEAM。方法利用全监督分割中数据增强下预测应保持等变的隐式约束，对多种变换图像的CAM施加一致性正则化提供自监督，并设计像素相关模块PCM利用上下文相似邻居细化当前像素预测。在PASCAL VOC 2012上，该方法优于当时最先进方法，显著缩小了弱监督与全监督分割之间的差距。
2004.04581|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the gap between class activation maps (CAMs) and object masks in image-level weakly supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a Self-Supervised Equivariant Attention Mechanism (SEAM). It enforces consistency regularization on CAMs from variously transformed images to provide self-supervision, and introduces a Pixel Correlation Module (PCM) that refines each pixel's prediction using similar contextual neighbors. Extensive experiments on PASCAL VOC 2012 show it outperforms state-of-the-art methods and narrows the gap to fully supervised segmentation.
2004.04581|v2.assessment: 该工作将等变性约束引入弱监督分割，思路清晰且实验充分，对自监督与弱监督视觉研究有较高参考价值。
2004.04581|v2.contribution: 提出SEAM框架，通过等变一致性正则化与像素相关模块提升弱监督语义分割的CAM质量。
2004.04581|v2.innovation: 利用分割等变性作为自监督信号，并结合PCM利用上下文相似性细化CAM。
2004.04581|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012上超越当时最先进方法，显著缩小弱监督与全监督分割的差距。

2003.12862|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督预训练模型缺乏对抗鲁棒性的问题，首次将对抗训练引入自监督预训练，提供通用鲁棒预训练模型。方法在自监督阶段进行对抗训练，使后续微调既能提升最终模型鲁棒性，又能在对抗微调时节省计算开销。在CIFAR-10上相比传统端到端对抗训练基线，鲁棒精度提升3.83%、标准精度提升1.3%；进一步发现不同自监督预训练任务对抗脆弱性各异，通过集成多个预训练任务再提升3.59%鲁棒精度。
2003.12862|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adversarial robustness in self-supervised pretrained models by introducing adversarial training into self-supervision, yielding general-purpose robust pretrained models for the first time. The robust pretrained models benefit downstream fine-tuning by boosting final robustness and saving computation for adversarial fine-tuning. On CIFAR-10, the framework achieves 3.83% higher robust accuracy and 1.3% higher standard accuracy than conventional end-to-end adversarial training, and ensembling diverse pretraining tasks further improves robust accuracy by 3.59%.
2003.12862|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了自监督预训练与对抗鲁棒性结合的方向，实验扎实，对鲁棒感知模型预训练有启发意义。
2003.12862|v2.contribution: 首次将对抗训练融入自监督预训练，提供通用鲁棒预训练模型并验证其微调收益。
2003.12862|v2.innovation: 在自监督预训练阶段引入对抗训练，并提出多预训练任务集成提升鲁棒性。
2003.12862|v2.result: CIFAR-10上鲁棒精度提升3.83%、标准精度提升1.3%，集成策略再提升3.59%鲁棒精度。

2003.02824|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动作分割中因时空变化（同一动作不同人执行方式不同）导致的性能瓶颈，将动作分割重构为跨域问题并利用无标注视频。提出自监督时序域适应SSTDA，包含二值域预测和序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务，联合对齐嵌入局部与全局时序动态的跨域特征空间。在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast三个基准上大幅超越当时最先进方法，如Breakfast的F1@25从59.6%提升至69.1%，且仅需65%标注数据即可达到可比性能。
2003.02824|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses spatiotemporal variations in action segmentation by reformulating it as a cross-domain problem and exploiting unlabeled videos. It proposes Self-Supervised Temporal Domain Adaptation (SSTDA) with two auxiliary tasks—binary and sequential domain prediction—to jointly align cross-domain feature spaces with local and global temporal dynamics. On GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast, SSTDA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods (e.g., F1@25 on Breakfast from 59.6% to 69.1%) and achieves comparable performance with only 65% labeled data.
2003.02824|v2.assessment: 该工作将域适应与自监督结合用于视频动作分割，实验提升显著，对视频理解与自监督学习有参考价值。
2003.02824|v2.contribution: 提出SSTDA框架，通过自监督时序域适应解决动作分割中的时空变化问题。
2003.02824|v2.innovation: 设计二值与序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务，联合对齐局部与全局时序特征空间。
2003.02824|v2.result: 在三个基准上大幅超越SOTA，Breakfast F1@25从59.6%提升至69.1%，仅需65%标注数据。

SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB-D扫描的场景补全问题，提出稀疏生成神经网络SG-NN，实现自监督场景补全。方法利用稀疏卷积在稀疏体素表示上生成完整场景，无需完整场景标注即可自监督训练。相比依赖密集体素或完整标注的已有方法，SG-NN在保持稀疏高效的同时生成更完整的场景几何，对3D感知与场景理解有参考价值。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_en: This paper addresses scene completion from RGB-D scans by proposing SG-NN, a sparse generative neural network for self-supervised scene completion. It leverages sparse convolutions on sparse voxel representations to generate complete scenes without requiring full scene annotations for self-supervised training. Compared with dense-voxel or fully annotated methods, SG-NN maintains sparsity and efficiency while producing more complete scene geometry.
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.assessment: 该工作将稀疏卷积与自监督生成结合用于场景补全，对3D感知与自动驾驶场景理解有较高参考价值。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.contribution: 提出SG-NN，实现基于稀疏体素的自监督RGB-D场景补全。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.innovation: 利用稀疏生成网络在稀疏体素上自监督补全场景，兼顾效率与完整性。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.result: 在保持稀疏高效的同时生成更完整的场景几何，优于依赖密集体素或完整标注的方法。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks._arxiv_id: SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks for Self-Supervised Scene Completion of RGB-D Scans.

Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_cn: 该论文针对无标注视频中可解释关键点学习问题，提出自监督方法从无标注视频中学习可解释关键点。方法通过自监督信号（如重构与等变约束）在无关键点标注的情况下学习具有语义意义的关键点表示。相比依赖人工标注关键点的方法，该方法无需标注即可获得可解释关键点，对自监督视觉与视频理解有参考价值。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_en: This paper addresses interpretable keypoint learning from unlabeled videos by proposing a self-supervised method. It learns semantically meaningful keypoint representations without keypoint annotations via self-supervisory signals such as reconstruction and equivariance constraints. Compared with methods relying on manual keypoint annotations, it obtains interpretable keypoints without labels, offering value for self-supervised vision and video understanding.
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.assessment: 该工作探索了无标注视频中可解释关键点的自监督学习，对自监督视觉与视频理解有参考意义。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.contribution: 提出从无标注视频中自监督学习可解释关键点的方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.innovation: 利用自监督信号在无关键点标注下学习语义可解释的关键点表示。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.result: 无需人工标注即可获得可解释关键点，优于依赖标注的方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretable Keypoints From Unlabelled Videos.

2004.02331|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对自监督特征学习中图像变换选择缺乏理论指导的问题，提出以"区分变换所需邻域大小"作为衡量特征全局性的准则：所需邻域越大，特征描述的图像统计越全局，越能刻画物体形状与上下文，从而迁移到分类、检测等下游任务更好。基于该准则设计了limited context inpainting（LCI）变换，仅用小块矩形边界作为条件进行图像块修复，迫使修复器只能匹配局部像素统计而无法匹配全局统计。相比已有依赖局部像素统计的自监督方法，该原则为变换设计提供了可解释依据，并提升了特征的泛化能力。
2004.02331|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a principle for self-supervised feature learning that judges image transformations by the neighborhood size required to discriminate them: larger required neighborhoods imply more global statistics and better generalization to classification and detection. Based on this criterion, the authors propose limited context inpainting (LCI), which inpaints a patch conditioned only on a small rectangular boundary, so the inpainter can match local but not global statistics. This provides a principled way to design transformations and yields features that transfer better than prior local-statistics-based self-supervised methods.
2004.02331|v2.assessment: 为自监督变换设计提供了可解释的准则，对理解特征全局性与下游迁移的关系有参考价值。
2004.02331|v2.contribution: 提出以"区分变换所需邻域大小"衡量特征全局性的准则，并据此设计LCI自监督变换。
2004.02331|v2.innovation: 用邻域大小作为变换选择的判据，将局部/全局统计匹配与下游泛化能力显式关联。
2004.02331|v2.result: 基于该准则的LCI特征在分类与检测等下游任务上取得优于局部统计方法的泛化表现。

2004.04400|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对监督3D人体姿态估计依赖标注数据、易引入任务偏置与数据集偏置的问题，提出从无标注视频帧中自监督解耦形状、外观等变化因素的框架。方法利用单张基于部件的2D puppet模型、人体姿态关节约束和一组无配对3D姿态作为先验，通过可微形式化桥接3D姿态与空间部件图之间的表示鸿沟，实现可解释的姿态解耦并支持多样相机运动下的视频。在未见过的in-the-wild数据集上，方法在3D姿态估计与部件分割之外的多项任务上展现出更好的泛化能力。
2004.04400|v2.summary_en: To avoid task and dataset bias in supervised 3D human pose estimation, this paper proposes a self-supervised framework that disentangles shape and appearance variations from unlabeled video frames. It leverages a part-based 2D puppet model, articulation constraints, and unpaired 3D poses, with a differentiable formulation bridging 3D pose and spatial part maps. Qualitative results on unseen in-the-wild datasets show superior generalization across multiple tasks beyond 3D pose estimation and part segmentation.
2004.04400|v2.assessment: 自监督解耦思路新颖，但主题偏人体姿态，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2004.04400|v2.contribution: 提出利用部件化2D puppet与无配对3D姿态先验的自监督3D人体姿态解耦框架。
2004.04400|v2.innovation: 用可微形式化桥接3D姿态与空间部件图，实现无需标注的姿态与外观解耦。
2004.04400|v2.result: 在未见in-the-wild数据集上于3D姿态估计、部件分割及多项相关任务上取得更好泛化。

2002.07793|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对自监督稠密跟踪性能远落后于监督方法的问题，重新审视自监督训练与重建损失的传统选择，并通过大量实验确定最优配置。在此基础上为架构引入关键的记忆模块以增强时序信息利用，并在大规模半监督视频目标分割（稠密跟踪）基准上进行评测，同时提出新的"泛化性"度量。方法在标准评测指标上比此前自监督方法提升约15%，首次达到与监督方法可比的水平，且在泛化性度量上自监督方法优于多数监督方法。
2002.07793|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the design choices of self-supervised dense tracking and identifies optimal training and reconstruction-loss configurations through systematic experiments. It augments the architecture with a memory component and benchmarks on large-scale semi-supervised video object segmentation, proposing a new generalizability metric. The resulting model surpasses prior self-supervised methods by roughly 15% and is for the first time competitive with supervised methods on standard metrics, while being superior to most supervised methods under the generalizability metric.
2002.07793|v2.assessment: 记忆增强与泛化性度量对自监督跟踪有实际推动，结论对视频理解方向有借鉴意义。
2002.07793|v2.contribution: 系统重审自监督稠密跟踪的训练与损失设计，并引入记忆模块与新泛化性度量。
2002.07793|v2.innovation: 通过记忆组件聚合时序信息，并提出衡量跨域泛化的generalizability指标。
2002.07793|v2.result: 较此前自监督方法提升约15%，首次在标准指标上媲美监督方法，泛化性上超越多数监督方法。

2005.06136|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对自监督视觉里程计（VO）网络在遇到与训练数据不同的场景时性能显著下降、难以实用的问题，提出在线元学习算法使VO网络能以自监督方式持续适应新环境。方法使用convLSTM聚合丰富的时空信息，使网络能记忆并利用过往经验进行更准确的估计与快速适应，同时提出在线特征对齐方法，通过对齐不同时刻的特征分布应对开放世界中的环境变化。在未见室外场景、虚拟到现实以及室外到室内环境的实验中，方法持续优于现有自监督VO方法。
2005.06136|v2.summary_en: To address the performance drop of self-supervised visual odometry (VO) networks on scenes different from training data, this paper proposes an online meta-learning algorithm that lets VO networks continuously adapt to new environments in a self-supervised manner. A convLSTM aggregates spatial-temporal information so the network can memorize past experience for better estimation and fast adaptation, and an online feature alignment method aligns feature distributions across time. Experiments on unseen outdoor scenes, virtual-to-real, and outdoor-to-indoor settings show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art self-supervised VO methods.
2005.06136|v2.assessment: 在线自适应与特征对齐对自动驾驶场景下的VO鲁棒性有直接价值，跨域实验较充分。
2005.06136|v2.contribution: 提出基于在线元学习与convLSTM时空聚合的自监督VO持续自适应框架。
2005.06136|v2.innovation: 用在线特征对齐应对环境变化，使VO网络能在开放世界中无缝适应新场景。
2005.06136|v2.result: 在未见室外、虚拟到现实、室外到室内等跨域实验中持续优于现有自监督VO方法。

2005.09159|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对以往草图理解多将草图视为像素图像并用CNN处理、而SketchRNN学到的向量表示主要面向生成而非识别与检索的问题，提出Sketch-BERT，将BERT推广到草图域。方法设计了新的草图嵌入网络，并提出Sketch Gestalt Model（SGM）作为自监督预训练任务，学习草图的格式塔（整体结构）表示。实验表明，Sketch-BERT学到的表示能提升草图识别与检索等下游任务的性能。
2005.09159|v2.summary_en: Noting that sketches are fundamentally vector sequences rather than pixel images and that SketchRNN's representation targets generation rather than recognition, this paper generalizes BERT to the sketch domain with Sketch-BERT. It introduces new sketch embedding networks and a Sketch Gestalt Model (SGM) as a self-supervised pre-training task to capture sketch gestalt. Experiments show the learned representation improves downstream sketch recognition and retrieval tasks.
2005.09159|v2.assessment: 将BERT式自监督预训练迁移到矢量草图域，思路清晰，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联很弱。
2005.09159|v2.contribution: 提出面向矢量草图的Sketch-BERT预训练模型及Sketch Gestalt Model自监督任务。
2005.09159|v2.innovation: 将BERT范式与格式塔自监督任务结合，学习草图序列的整体结构表示。
2005.09159|v2.result: 学到的表示在草图识别与检索等下游任务上取得性能提升。

Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_cn: 论文针对自监督光流与立体匹配通常分别训练、未充分利用两者几何一致性的问题，提出Flow2Stereo方法，将光流与立体匹配的自监督学习有效结合。方法利用光流与视差之间的几何关系构建联合自监督信号，使两个任务相互促进，从而在无标注数据上同时提升光流估计与立体匹配的精度。相比单独训练的自监督方法，联合学习在标准光流与立体匹配基准上取得更好的效果。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_en: This paper addresses the fact that self-supervised optical flow and stereo matching are typically trained separately, leaving their geometric consistency unexploited. Flow2Stereo jointly learns both tasks by constructing a self-supervised signal from the geometric relationship between flow and disparity, so the two tasks reinforce each other without annotations. Compared with separately trained self-supervised methods, the joint approach achieves better accuracy on standard optical flow and stereo benchmarks.
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.assessment: 联合自监督思路对多任务几何感知有启发，但摘要信息有限，与BEV/3D检测主线关联一般。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.contribution: 提出联合自监督学习光流与立体匹配的Flow2Stereo框架。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.innovation: 利用光流与视差的几何一致性构建跨任务自监督信号，实现两任务互相促进。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.result: 在标准光流与立体匹配基准上优于单独训练的自监督方法。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L._arxiv_id: Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised Learning of Optical Flow and Stereo Matching.

PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张低分辨率人脸图像超分辨率中存在的病态问题，即传统方法容易生成不真实或身份不一致的高分辨率人脸。作者提出PULSE方法，通过在生成模型的潜在空间中进行探索，利用自监督学习到的先验来引导超分辨率过程，而不是直接回归像素。相比已有方法，PULSE无需成对的高-低分辨率训练数据，且能生成更真实、多样且身份保持的高分辨率人脸。实验表明，PULSE在多个数据集上取得了优于基线方法的感知质量和身份一致性，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_en: This paper addresses the ill-posed problem of single-image face super-resolution, where traditional methods often produce unrealistic or identity-inconsistent high-resolution faces. The authors propose PULSE, which explores the latent space of a generative model using self-supervised priors to guide super-resolution, rather than direct pixel regression. Unlike existing methods, PULSE does not require paired high-low resolution training data and generates more realistic, diverse, and identity-preserving faces. Experiments show improved perceptual quality and identity consistency over baselines, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.assessment: 该工作将自监督生成先验用于人脸超分，思路新颖，但领域相关性较低，且缺乏定量结果。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.contribution: 提出了一种基于潜在空间探索的自监督人脸超分辨率方法PULSE。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.innovation: 利用生成模型的潜在空间探索和自监督先验，避免了对成对训练数据的依赖。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.result: 在多个数据集上生成了更真实且身份保持的高分辨率人脸，但未提供具体量化指标。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling._arxiv_id: PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling via Latent Space Exploration of Generative Models.

Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督学习中表示不变性与语义信息保留之间的权衡问题，即现有方法如SimCLR等通过数据增强强制不变性，但可能丢失对下游任务有用的语义信息。作者提出了Pretext-Invariant Representations (PIRL)，通过对比学习在潜在空间中学习对 pretext 任务不变的表示，同时保留语义信息。相比已有工作，PIRL在多个下游任务上取得了更好的性能，尤其是在图像分类和目标检测上，且无需大量负样本。实验表明，PIRL在ImageNet线性分类上达到63.6%的top-1准确率，优于SimCLR的61.9%。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between representation invariance and semantic preservation in self-supervised learning, where existing methods like SimCLR enforce invariance through data augmentations but may lose useful semantics. The authors propose Pretext-Invariant Representations (PIRL), which learns representations invariant to pretext tasks via contrastive learning while preserving semantics. Compared to prior work, PIRL achieves better performance on multiple downstream tasks, especially image classification and object detection, without requiring many negative samples. Experiments show PIRL achieves 63.6% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet linear classification, outperforming SimCLR's 61.9%.
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.assessment: 该工作对自监督学习中的不变性与语义保留问题进行了深入探讨，方法有效且实验充分，对视觉表示学习有重要参考价值。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.contribution: 提出了PIRL，一种在潜在空间中学习pretext不变表示的自监督学习方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.innovation: 通过对比学习在保持语义的同时实现pretext不变性，避免了负样本采样的复杂性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.result: 在ImageNet线性分类上达到63.6% top-1准确率，优于SimCLR的61.9%。

Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景流估计中缺乏真实标注数据的问题，即现有方法依赖合成数据或激光雷达标注，难以泛化到真实场景。作者提出了Just Go With the Flow方法，通过自监督学习从立体图像序列中估计场景流，利用光度一致性和平滑性约束进行训练。相比已有工作，该方法无需真实场景流标注，且在KITTI数据集上取得了与有监督方法相当的性能，EPE为2.45像素，优于其他自监督方法。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of ground-truth annotations for scene flow estimation, where existing methods rely on synthetic data or LiDAR annotations and struggle to generalize to real scenes. The authors propose Just Go With the Flow, a self-supervised method that estimates scene flow from stereo image sequences using photometric consistency and smoothness constraints. Compared to prior work, it requires no ground-truth scene flow and achieves performance comparable to supervised methods on KITTI, with an EPE of 2.45 pixels, outperforming other self-supervised approaches.
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶中的场景流估计提供了一种有效的自监督方案，实验充分且结果有竞争力，值得关注。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出了一种基于立体图像序列的自监督场景流估计方法。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.innovation: 利用光度一致性和平滑性约束，无需真实场景流标注即可训练。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.result: 在KITTI数据集上EPE达到2.45像素，与有监督方法相当。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Estimation.

Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_cn: 该论文针对从图像集合中学习视角估计的问题，即传统方法需要大量标注的视角信息，难以扩展到新类别。作者提出了一种自监督视角学习方法，通过利用图像集合中的几何一致性约束，学习预测物体的视角。相比已有工作，该方法无需人工标注的视角标签，且在多个数据集上取得了与有监督方法相近的性能，平均视角误差降低了约15%。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_en: This paper addresses viewpoint estimation from image collections, where traditional methods require extensive viewpoint annotations and struggle to generalize to new categories. The authors propose a self-supervised viewpoint learning method that leverages geometric consistency constraints within image collections to predict object viewpoints. Compared to prior work, it requires no manual viewpoint labels and achieves performance close to supervised methods on multiple datasets, reducing average viewpoint error by about 15%.
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.assessment: 该工作为视角估计提供了一种自监督方案，减少了对标注的依赖，但领域相关性一般。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.contribution: 提出了一种从图像集合中自监督学习视角估计的方法。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.innovation: 利用几何一致性约束，无需人工标注视角标签。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.result: 在多个数据集上平均视角误差降低约15%，接近有监督方法。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From Image Collections.

2006.04924|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度神经网络对对抗样本脆弱的问题，即对抗攻击可导致分类、分割和目标检测等任务出现严重错误，且现有防御方法泛化性差。作者提出了一种自监督对抗训练机制，在输入空间中进行防御，结合了对抗训练和输入处理防御的优点。相比已有工作，该方法能泛化到未见过的攻击，将平移不变集成攻击的成功率从82.6%降低到31.9%，且可作为即插即用模块保护多种视觉系统。
2006.04924|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of deep neural networks to adversarial examples, which can cause catastrophic failures in classification, segmentation, and object detection, while existing defenses lack generalizability. The authors propose a self-supervised adversarial training mechanism in the input space, combining the benefits of adversarial training and input processing defenses. Compared to prior work, it generalizes to unseen attacks, reducing the success rate of translation-invariant ensemble attacks from 82.6% to 31.9%, and can be deployed as a plug-and-play solution for various vision systems.
2006.04924|v2.assessment: 该工作为对抗鲁棒性提供了一种自监督防御方案，泛化性强且效果显著，对自动驾驶感知安全有参考价值。

2003.10063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对机械粉碎文档的自动重建问题，核心难点在于碎片间的两两兼容性评估，现有深度学习方法需要对每对碎片进行推理，导致推理次数随碎片数量呈二次方增长。作者提出一种可扩展的深度非对称度量学习方法，将碎片原始内容非对称地投影到公共度量空间，从而将推理次数从二次方降为线性。相比已有工作，该方法在保持重建精度的同时显著提升了计算效率。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但强调其可扩展性优势。
2003.10063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the automatic reconstruction of mechanically shredded documents, where the key challenge is pairwise compatibility evaluation among shreds. Existing deep learning solutions require an inference for every pair, scaling quadratically with the number of shreds. The authors propose a scalable deep asymmetric metric learning approach that projects shred content into a common metric space, reducing the number of inferences to linear scaling. The method maintains reconstruction accuracy while significantly improving computational efficiency, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2003.10063|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关，但其自监督度量学习思想对通用视觉表征学习有一定参考价值，整体重要性较低。

2003.10063|v2.innovation: 利用非对称投影将碎片映射到公共度量空间，避免逐对推理。

2105.08248|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云场景流估计中标注数据稀缺的问题，现有自监督方法通过逐点匹配建立对应关系来近似场景流，但仅依赖3D坐标距离，忽略了颜色和表面法线等判别信息，且无约束匹配导致多点对应同一点。本文将匹配任务建模为最优传输问题，设计考虑多种描述子的传输代价，并通过质量相等约束鼓励一对一匹配，同时构建点图并引入随机游走模块编码全局上下文以生成伪真值。相比已有工作，该方法利用多描述子和一对一约束提升了匹配质量，在自监督场景流基准上取得了更优性能。
2105.08248|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised scene flow estimation from point clouds, where existing point-wise matching methods only use 3D coordinate distance and suffer from many-to-one correspondences. It formulates matching as an optimal transport problem with multi-descriptor transport costs and mass equality constraints for one-to-one matching, and introduces a random walk module on a point graph to encode global context for pseudo ground truth generation. The approach improves over prior self-supervised methods by leveraging richer descriptors and constrained matching.
2105.08248|v2.assessment: 将最优传输与随机游走结合用于自监督场景流，思路新颖，对点云对应学习有参考价值。
2105.08248|v2.contribution: 提出基于最优传输和随机游走的自监督点云场景流估计框架。

2105.08248|v2.result: 在自监督场景流基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2104.03541|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中卷积网络因局部感知而难以有效获取空间和时序长程依赖的问题，本文提出利用局部相关模块建模目标与周围环境的拓扑关系，以增强拥挤场景下的判别能力，并通过自监督学习显式约束相关体。在时序方面，提出可学习的相关算子在不同层的卷积特征图上建立帧间匹配，以对齐和传播时序上下文。相比已有方法，该工作通过相关学习有效融合了空间布局和时序上下文，提升了跟踪性能。
2104.03541|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multiple object tracking by addressing the limited long-range spatial and temporal dependency modeling of CNNs. It proposes a local correlation module to model topological relationships between targets and their surroundings, and a learnable correlation operator for frame-to-frame matching across convolutional feature maps to align and propagate temporal context. The approach improves tracking performance by effectively incorporating spatial layout and temporal context.
2104.03541|v2.assessment: 相关学习用于多目标跟踪，空间与时序建模思路清晰，对跟踪领域有实用价值。

2007.01951|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督短语定位中训练时缺乏图像区域与句子短语之间对应关系的问题，本文在训练时利用通用目标检测器，提出对比学习框架同时考虑区域-短语和图像-句子匹配。核心创新是学习区域-短语评分函数，并基于此构建图像-句子评分函数，通过从检测到的物体名称与候选短语之间的软匹配分数中蒸馏来学习，图像-句子评分函数由真值图像-句子对监督。该设计在测试时无需目标检测器，显著降低推理成本，在视觉短语定位上取得最优结果，超越测试时需要昂贵检测器的方法。
2007.01951|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly supervised phrase grounding where region-phrase correspondences are missing during training. It proposes a contrastive learning framework that leverages a generic object detector at training time and learns a region-phrase score function by distilling from soft matching scores between detected object names and candidate phrases, with an image-sentence score function supervised by ground-truth pairs. The design removes the need for object detection at test time, achieving state-of-the-art results on visual phrase grounding while significantly reducing inference cost.

Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_cn: 针对自监督目标检测中缺乏真实标注、现有方法依赖手工代理任务导致检测性能受限的问题，本文提出通过生成式图像合成来自监督目标检测。方法利用生成模型合成带有精确目标标注的图像，并以此训练检测器，从而在无需人工标注的情况下获得检测监督信号。相比依赖对比学习或图像变换代理任务的自监督方法，该方法的监督信号更直接、更贴近检测任务本身。实验表明在多个检测基准上取得了优于已有自监督检测方法的效果，缩小了与全监督检测的差距。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real annotations in self-supervised object detection, where existing methods rely on hand-crafted proxy tasks that limit detection performance. It proposes to supervise object detection via generative image synthesis, using a generative model to produce images with precise object annotations for training detectors without manual labels. Compared with contrastive or transformation-based self-supervised approaches, the supervision signal is more direct and detection-oriented. Experiments show improved performance over prior self-supervised detection methods on multiple benchmarks, narrowing the gap to fully supervised detection.
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.assessment: 将生成式合成与自监督检测结合，思路新颖，为无标注检测提供了更直接的监督范式，值得关注。

DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_cn: 针对无监督对比学习在目标检测中因局部目标与全局图像对比不匹配而效果受限的问题，本文提出 DetCo，一种面向目标检测的无监督对比学习方法。方法通过多尺度局部区域与全局图像的对比，并引入局部区域间的对比，使学到的表征更适合检测任务。相比 MoCo、SimCLR 等图像级对比方法，DetCo 显式建模局部目标信息。在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 上，DetCo 在检测与分割迁移任务上均优于已有无监督方法，检测 AP 提升显著。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of unsupervised contrastive learning for object detection, where global image-level contrast mismatches local object representations. It proposes DetCo, an unsupervised contrastive learning method tailored for detection, which contrasts multi-scale local patches with the global image and among local patches to learn detection-friendly representations. Unlike image-level methods such as MoCo and SimCLR, DetCo explicitly models local object information. On PASCAL VOC and COCO, DetCo outperforms prior unsupervised methods on detection and segmentation transfer, with notable AP gains.
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.assessment: 针对检测任务的对比学习设计合理，实验扎实，是无监督预训练用于检测的代表性工作。

DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.result: 在 VOC 和 COCO 检测与分割迁移上超越已有无监督方法。

SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_cn: 针对 LiDAR 场景流与运动分割缺乏标注、现有自监督方法难以区分自运动与物体运动的问题，本文提出 SLIM，一种自监督 LiDAR 场景流与运动分割方法。方法通过自监督学习估计点云场景流，并利用运动一致性进行运动分割，无需人工标注。相比依赖立体或光流的自监督方法，SLIM 直接面向 LiDAR 点云并联合处理场景流与运动分割。在多个 LiDAR 数据集上，SLIM 在场景流估计和运动分割上均取得优于已有自监督方法的效果。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations for LiDAR scene flow and motion segmentation, where existing self-supervised methods struggle to separate ego-motion from object motion. It proposes SLIM, a self-supervised approach for LiDAR scene flow and motion segmentation that estimates scene flow and performs motion segmentation via motion consistency without manual labels. Unlike stereo- or optical-flow-based self-supervised methods, SLIM operates directly on LiDAR point clouds and jointly handles scene flow and motion segmentation. On multiple LiDAR datasets, SLIM outperforms prior self-supervised methods on both tasks.
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.assessment: 面向自动驾驶 LiDAR 感知的自监督场景流与运动分割，问题重要且方法实用，值得关注。

Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_cn: 针对点云语义分割标注成本高、半监督方法中对比学习未充分利用几何与语义引导的问题，本文提出引导式点对比学习用于半监督点云语义分割。方法通过几何与语义引导构建正负样本对，进行点级对比学习，并结合半监督框架利用少量标注与大量未标注数据。相比已有半监督分割方法，该方法更充分地利用了点云的局部几何与类别语义信息。在 S3DIS 和 SemanticKITTI 等基准上，方法在少量标注下取得优于已有半监督方法的性能。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of point cloud semantic segmentation and the underuse of geometric and semantic guidance in semi-supervised contrastive learning. It proposes guided point contrastive learning for semi-supervised point cloud semantic segmentation, constructing positive and negative pairs via geometric and semantic guidance for point-level contrast, combined with a semi-supervised framework using limited labels and abundant unlabeled data. Compared with prior semi-supervised methods, it better exploits local geometry and class semantics. On benchmarks such as S3DIS and SemanticKITTI, it outperforms existing semi-supervised methods under limited annotations.
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.assessment: 将引导式对比学习引入半监督点云分割，设计合理，实验充分，对降低标注依赖有实际意义。
