2311.17893|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视频目标分割依赖辅助模态或迭代slot attention导致通用性差、计算开销大的问题，本文提出一种简单有效的自监督VOS方法。核心洞察是DINO预训练Transformer中固有的结构依赖可建立鲁棒的时空对应关系，方法仅用一个时空Transformer块处理逐帧DINO特征，并通过自注意力建立时空依赖，再对注意力图进行层次聚类生成分割掩码。相比此前依赖光流或多模态输入的方法，该方案无需额外模态或slot attention，架构更简洁。在无监督VOS基准上取得有竞争力的分割结果，同时显著降低计算需求。
2311.17893|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised video object segmentation without auxiliary modalities or iterative slot attention, which limit generality and increase computation. It leverages the inherent structural dependencies in DINO-pretrained Transformers to build spatio-temporal correspondences via a single spatio-temporal Transformer block, followed by hierarchical clustering on attention maps to produce segmentation masks. The approach achieves competitive unsupervised VOS results with a simpler architecture and lower computational cost.
2311.17893|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了DINO自注意力中隐含的物体性，为自监督视频分割提供了极简且有效的范式，值得关注。
2311.17893|v2.contribution: 提出利用DINO注意力图进行层次聚类的自监督视频目标分割方法。
2311.17893|v2.innovation: 无需辅助模态或slot attention，仅靠DINO时空注意力即可分割。
2311.17893|v2.result: 在无监督VOS基准上取得有竞争力结果并降低计算开销。

2407.03788|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频-文本对不完全对齐及概念分布不均导致跨模态表示不准确、冷门概念下游性能差的问题，本文提出MAMA框架。方法在对比目标中引入减法角度间隔（subtractive angular margin）来正则化跨模态表示，并用MLP参数化的加权函数将损失值映射为样本权重，实现训练焦点的动态调整。训练由少量无偏元数据引导，并利用大视觉语言模型生成视频-文本数据增强。在常见视频-语言检索基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。
2407.03788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses imperfect video-text alignment and uneven concept distribution in video-language representation learning. It proposes MAMA, which uses a contrastive objective with a subtractive angular margin and an MLP-parameterized weighting function to dynamically adjust sample focus, guided by unbiased meta-data and augmented with VLM-generated video-text data. MAMA improves cross-modal representations and achieves superior performance on common video-language benchmarks.
2407.03788|v2.assessment: 该工作从数据质量与概念分布角度改进视频-语言对比学习，对多模态表示学习研究者有参考意义。
2407.03788|v2.contribution: 提出带减法角度间隔与元学习加权的视频-语言对比学习框架MAMA。
2407.03788|v2.innovation: 用MLP加权函数动态调整样本权重以应对概念分布不均。
2407.03788|v2.result: 在常见视频-语言检索基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2412.12075|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中现有基准多依赖全局语义、缺乏对细粒度线索定位能力评估的问题，本文提出CG-Bench，一个基于线索（clue-grounded）的长视频问答基准。该基准要求模型在长视频中定位回答问题所需的关键片段并给出答案，涵盖多种线索类型与问题形式。相比已有长视频QA基准，CG-Bench更强调时序定位与证据推理的结合，能更细粒度地衡量模型的长视频理解能力。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但基准设计覆盖多任务与多线索类型，为长视频理解提供了更严格的评测协议。
2412.12075|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces CG-Bench, a clue-grounded question answering benchmark for long video understanding that requires models to localize the evidence segments needed to answer each question. Unlike prior long-video QA benchmarks that mainly evaluate global semantics, CG-Bench emphasizes fine-grained temporal grounding and evidence-based reasoning. It provides a more rigorous evaluation protocol for long video understanding across diverse clue types and question formats.
2412.12075|v2.assessment: 长视频理解评测正成为热点，该基准通过线索定位约束提升了评测的细粒度与可信度，对视频理解研究者有参考价值。
2412.12075|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于线索定位的长视频问答基准CG-Bench，强调证据片段定位与推理的结合。
2412.12075|v2.innovation: 将线索定位引入长视频QA评测，要求模型显式定位回答所需的时序证据。
2412.12075|v2.result: 构建了覆盖多线索类型与问题形式的长视频QA基准，为长视频理解提供更严格的评测协议。

2502.10810|v2.summary_cn: 针对流式视频理解中缺乏多轮时序对话评测的问题，本文提出SVBench，一个包含时序多轮对话的流式视频理解基准。该基准模拟真实流式场景，要求模型在视频持续输入过程中进行多轮问答，并保持对历史对话与视频内容的时序一致性。相比传统离线视频QA基准，SVBench更贴近在线流式应用，能评估模型的时序记忆与对话连贯性。摘要未提供具体性能数据，但基准设计覆盖多轮对话与时序推理，为流式视频理解提供了新的评测维度。
2502.10810|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SVBench, a benchmark with temporal multi-turn dialogues for streaming video understanding. It simulates real streaming scenarios where models must answer multi-turn questions as video frames arrive continuously, testing temporal memory and dialogue coherence. Compared with offline video QA benchmarks, SVBench better reflects online streaming applications and provides a new evaluation dimension for streaming video understanding.
2502.10810|v2.assessment: 流式视频理解是新兴方向，该基准通过多轮时序对话填补了评测空白，对视频理解与多模态对话研究者有参考意义。
2502.10810|v2.contribution: 提出面向流式视频理解的时序多轮对话基准SVBench。
2502.10810|v2.innovation: 将多轮对话与时序流式视频输入结合，评估模型的在线时序记忆与对话连贯性。
2502.10810|v2.result: 构建了模拟真实流式场景的多轮对话视频理解基准，拓展了流式视频理解的评测维度。

TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对交通场景中缺乏统一时空视频理解基准的问题，本文提出TUMTraf VideoQA，一个面向交通场景的时空视频问答数据集与基准。该数据集覆盖多摄像头、多目标、多任务的交通场景视频，要求模型进行时空推理与问答。相比已有交通视频数据集，TUMTraf VideoQA更强调统一的时空理解与多任务评测，能更全面评估自动驾驶感知与理解模型。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但数据集与基准设计覆盖多任务与多视角，为交通场景视频理解提供了标准化评测平台。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper introduces TUMTraf VideoQA, a dataset and benchmark for unified spatio-temporal video understanding in traffic scenes. It covers multi-camera, multi-object, and multi-task traffic videos requiring spatio-temporal reasoning and question answering. Compared with existing traffic video datasets, TUMTraf VideoQA emphasizes unified spatio-temporal understanding and multi-task evaluation, providing a standardized platform for autonomous driving perception and understanding.
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.assessment: 交通场景的时空视频理解对自动驾驶至关重要，该数据集与基准为多任务评测提供了统一平台，值得关注。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.contribution: 提出面向交通场景的统一时空视频问答数据集与基准TUMTraf VideoQA。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.innovation: 将多摄像头、多任务交通场景视频统一到时空问答框架下进行评测。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.result: 构建了覆盖多任务与多视角的交通场景视频QA基准，为自动驾驶视频理解提供标准化评测。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f._arxiv_id: TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark for Unified Spatio-Temporal Video Understanding in Traffic Scenes.

Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_cn: 针对4D点云视频理解中时空建模效率低的问题，本文提出Mamba4D，利用解耦的时空状态空间模型进行高效4D点云视频理解。该方法将空间与时间建模解耦，分别用状态空间模型处理，降低计算复杂度并提升长序列建模能力。相比基于Transformer的4D点云方法，Mamba4D在保持性能的同时显著降低计算开销。摘要未给出具体数据，但解耦时空状态空间模型为4D点云视频理解提供了高效新范式。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_en: This paper proposes Mamba4D, an efficient 4D point cloud video understanding method using disentangled spatial-temporal state space models. It decouples spatial and temporal modeling with state space models to reduce computational complexity and improve long-sequence modeling. Compared with Transformer-based 4D point cloud methods, Mamba4D achieves competitive performance with significantly lower computational cost.
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.assessment: 将Mamba/状态空间模型引入4D点云视频理解，兼顾效率与长序列建模，对3D/4D感知研究者有启发。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.contribution: 提出基于解耦时空状态空间模型的Mamba4D，实现高效4D点云视频理解。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.innovation: 将空间与时间建模解耦并分别用状态空间模型处理，降低4D点云视频理解的计算复杂度。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.result: 在保持性能的同时显著降低计算开销，为4D点云视频理解提供高效新范式。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video._arxiv_id: Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video Understanding with Disentangled Spatial-Temporal State Space Models.

Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_cn: 针对预训练3D模型难以直接用于点云视频理解的问题，本文提出通过跨帧时空感知适配预训练3D模型的方法。该方法在预训练3D模型基础上引入跨帧时空感知模块，将单帧3D理解能力扩展到点云视频序列。相比从头训练的点云视频模型，该方法能利用预训练3D模型的先验知识，提升数据效率与性能。摘要未给出具体数据，但为点云视频理解提供了预训练模型适配的新思路。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_en: This paper adapts pre-trained 3D models for point cloud video understanding via cross-frame spatio-temporal perception. It introduces a cross-frame spatio-temporal perception module on top of pre-trained 3D models to extend single-frame 3D understanding to point cloud video sequences. Compared with training from scratch, this approach leverages priors from pre-trained 3D models to improve data efficiency and performance.
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.assessment: 利用预训练3D模型适配点云视频理解是实用方向，跨帧时空感知模块为数据高效的点云视频理解提供了可行方案。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.contribution: 提出通过跨帧时空感知将预训练3D模型适配到点云视频理解任务。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.innovation: 在预训练3D模型上引入跨帧时空感知模块，实现单帧到视频序列的能力扩展。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.result: 利用预训练3D模型先验提升点云视频理解的数据效率与性能。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point._arxiv_id: Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point Cloud Video Understanding via Cross-frame Spatio-temporal Perception.

2503.18223|v2.summary_cn: 针对野生动物行为监测中缺乏标注视频数据集的问题，本文提出MammAlps，一个来自瑞士国家公园9个相机陷阱的多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集。该数据集包含超过14小时带音频视频、2D分割图和8.5小时个体轨迹标注，并基于6135个单动物片段提出首个分层多模态动物行为识别基准，以及面向生态学的多视角长期事件识别基准。相比已有野生动物数据集，MammAlps在标注密度、多模态与多视角方面更丰富，为视频理解模型在生态监测中的应用提供了新平台。
2503.18223|v2.summary_en: This paper presents MammAlps, a multimodal and multi-view dataset of wildlife behavior monitoring from 9 camera traps in the Swiss National Park. It contains over 14 hours of video with audio, 2D segmentation maps, and 8.5 hours of individual tracks densely labeled for species and behavior. Based on 6135 single-animal clips, the authors propose the first hierarchical and multimodal animal behavior recognition benchmark, as well as an ecology-oriented multi-view event benchmark.
2503.18223|v2.assessment: 该数据集为视频理解在生态监测中的应用提供了丰富标注与多模态基准，虽与自动驾驶感知直接相关度低，但对多模态视频理解研究者有参考价值。
2503.18223|v2.contribution: 提出多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集MammAlps及两个行为识别基准。
2503.18223|v2.innovation: 结合音频、视频与参考场景分割图，构建分层多模态动物行为识别与生态事件识别基准。
2503.18223|v2.result: 包含超14小时带音频视频、8.5小时个体轨迹标注，基于6135个片段建立首个分层多模态动物行为识别基准。

2412.04467|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言模型中视觉token数量远超文本token、计算开销巨大的问题，观察到CLIP/SigLIP等编码器产生的视觉token存在大量冗余。提出VisionZip，一种简单有效的token选择方法，从视觉编码器输出中挑选信息量大的token输入语言模型，可广泛用于图像和视频理解及多轮对话场景。相比此前SOTA方法在几乎所有设置下性能提升至少5%，prefilling时间加速8倍，使LLaVA-Next 13B推理速度快于7B版本且效果更好。
2412.04467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant redundancy in visual tokens produced by vision encoders like CLIP and SigLIP, which inflates computational cost in VLMs. It proposes VisionZip, a simple token selection method that feeds only informative tokens to the language model, applicable to image/video understanding and multi-turn dialogue. VisionZip outperforms prior state-of-the-art by at least 5% across nearly all settings and achieves 8x faster prefilling, enabling LLaVA-Next 13B to run faster than the 7B variant with better results.
2412.04467|v2.assessment: 对VLM效率优化有实用价值，token冗余分析与选择策略简洁有效，实验充分且加速显著，值得关注。
2412.04467|v2.contribution: 提出VisionZip，通过选择信息量大的视觉token减少冗余，在保持性能的同时大幅提升VLM推理效率。
2412.04467|v2.innovation: 发现视觉token冗余并设计简单有效的token选择机制，兼顾图像/视频理解与多轮对话场景。
2412.04467|v2.result: 性能超越此前SOTA至少5%，prefilling加速8倍，LLaVA-Next 13B推理快于7B且效果更优。

2503.21483|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对大型视频语言模型在长视频理解中受限于上下文窗口、均匀帧采样在噪声场景下效率低的问题，提出BOLT方法，无需额外训练即可提升长视频理解。首先提出多源检索评估设置以更真实地评测VLM，发现均匀采样在噪声上下文中表现差；随后探索基于查询-帧相似度的多种帧选择策略，发现逆变换采样效果最佳。在Video-MME上准确率从53.8%提升至56.1%，MLVU从58.9%提升至63.4%。
2503.21483|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited context windows of large video-language models for long-form video understanding, where uniform frame sampling wastes resources on irrelevant content. It introduces BOLT, a training-free method that studies frame selection strategies, proposing a multi-source retrieval evaluation setting and finding inverse transform sampling most effective. It improves Video-MME accuracy from 53.8% to 56.1% and MLVU from 58.9% to 63.4%.
2503.21483|v2.assessment: 训练无关的帧选择策略对长视频VLM推理有实际意义，评估设置与实验分析扎实，但创新幅度相对有限。
2503.21483|v2.contribution: 提出BOLT，通过研究帧选择策略在无需训练的情况下提升大型VLM的长视频理解能力。
2503.21483|v2.innovation: 引入多源检索评估设置并发现逆变换采样在帧选择中最有效。

2412.01095|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对可解释视频异常检测中现有方法需专用推理模块或指令微调、计算与标注开销大的问题，提出VERA，一种言语化学习框架，使VLM无需修改模型参数即可进行VAD。VERA自动将复杂推理分解为对更简单引导问题的反思，将这些反思问题视为可学习参数，通过学习者与优化器VLM之间的数据驱动言语交互，利用粗标注训练数据优化。该方法在无需参数更新的情况下实现可解释的异常检测。
2412.01095|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and annotation costs of explainable video anomaly detection, where existing VLM-based methods require specialized reasoning modules or instruction tuning. It proposes VERA, a verbalized learning framework that decomposes complex reasoning into reflections on simpler guiding questions, treating them as learnable parameters optimized via verbal interactions between learner and optimizer VLMs using coarsely labeled data. VERA enables explainable VAD without modifying model parameters.
2412.01095|v2.assessment: 言语化学习思路新颖，避免参数微调与大量标注，对可解释VAD有启发，但实验规模与泛化性需进一步验证。
2412.01095|v2.contribution: 提出VERA言语化学习框架，使VLM无需参数修改即可进行可解释视频异常检测。
2412.01095|v2.innovation: 将VAD推理分解为可学习的反思问题，通过VLM间言语交互优化，无需模型微调。
2412.01095|v2.result: 在粗标注数据下实现可解释异常检测，避免专用模块与指令微调的开销。

2412.03735|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大模型在视频理解中幻觉问题研究不足的现状，观察到MLLM视觉编码器难以区分视觉不同但语义相似的视频对，提出VidHalluc——目前最大的视频理解幻觉评测基准，包含5002个配对视频，从动作、时间序列和场景转换三个维度评估幻觉。测试显示多数MLLM在这些维度上易产生幻觉，并提出免训练的DINO-HEAL方法，利用DINOv2空间显著性重加权视觉特征，平均减少3.02%的幻觉。
2412.03735|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored hallucination problem in MLLMs for video understanding, observing that visual encoders fail to distinguish visually different yet semantically similar video pairs. It introduces VidHalluc, the largest benchmark with 5,002 paired videos assessing hallucinations across action, temporal sequence, and scene transition. It further proposes DINO-HEAL, a training-free method using DINOv2 spatial saliency to reweight visual features, reducing hallucinations by an average of 3.02%.
2412.03735|v2.assessment: 视频幻觉评测基准填补空白，维度设计合理，DINO-HEAL方法简单有效，对多模态视频理解可靠性研究有参考价值。
2412.03735|v2.contribution: 构建最大视频理解幻觉评测基准VidHalluc，并提出免训练的DINO-HEAL缓解幻觉。
2412.03735|v2.innovation: 从动作、时间序列、场景转换三维度系统评测视频幻觉，并利用DINOv2空间显著性重加权特征。
2412.03735|v2.result: 多数MLLM存在幻觉，DINO-HEAL平均减少3.02%幻觉。

2411.13281|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有视频分析评测多依赖选择题、难以捕捉真实用户复杂需求且人工标注成本高的问题，提出VideoAutoArena，一个受LMSYS Chatbot Arena启发的竞技场式基准，通过用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题，自动评估LMM的视频分析能力。采用改进的ELO评分系统进行公平持续比较，并用人工标注的'金标准'子集验证自动评判系统与人类判断高度一致，同时引入故障驱动机制。
2411.13281|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of multiple-choice benchmarks for evaluating LMMs in video analysis, which lack depth and require costly human annotation. It introduces VideoAutoArena, an arena-style benchmark inspired by LMSYS Chatbot Arena that uses user simulation to generate open-ended adaptive questions and a modified ELO rating system for fair comparison. A gold-standard human annotation subset validates strong alignment with human judgment while maintaining scalability.
2411.13281|v2.assessment: 竞技场式自动评测框架为视频LMM评估提供可扩展方案，用户模拟与ELO机制设计合理，但领域相关性较低。
2411.13281|v2.contribution: 提出VideoAutoArena，基于用户模拟和ELO评分的自动化视频分析评测竞技场。
2411.13281|v2.innovation: 将Chatbot Arena框架引入视频LMM评测，用用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题并验证与人类判断一致。
2411.13281|v2.result: 自动评判系统与人工金标准高度一致，实现可扩展的公平持续比较。

2412.10360|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频LMM中视频理解驱动机制理解不足、设计决策缺乏依据且计算成本高的问题，开展全面研究。发现'缩放一致性'现象，即在小模型和数据集上做出的设计与训练决策可有效迁移到更大模型。基于此探索了视频采样、架构、数据组成、训练计划等多方面，例如证明训练时fps采样远优于均匀帧采样，并评估了最适合视频表示的视觉编码器。
2412.10360|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor understanding of what drives video understanding in LMMs, where design decisions often lack justification and computational costs are high. It presents a comprehensive study revealing Scaling Consistency, where design and training decisions from smaller models/datasets transfer effectively to larger ones. Leveraging this, it explores video sampling, architectures, data composition, and training schedules, showing fps sampling during training is vastly preferable to uniform frame sampling and identifying the best vision encoders for video.
2412.10360|v2.assessment: 系统性研究视频LMM设计要素，缩放一致性发现对降低研究成本有重要价值，实验结论对领域有指导意义。
2412.10360|v2.contribution: 通过全面研究揭示视频LMM的缩放一致性，并系统探索视频采样、架构、数据与训练策略。
2412.10360|v2.innovation: 发现缩放一致性现象，使小规模实验结论可迁移至大模型，并证明fps采样优于均匀帧采样。
2412.10360|v2.result: 为视频LMM设计提供实证指导，降低研究计算成本并明确最佳视觉编码器与采样策略。

2504.07745|v2.summary_cn: 针对Video-LLMs在细粒度视频理解（如视觉动态和细节查询）上的不足，提出自监督片段微调方法SF²T，利用视频固有特性进行训练，避免繁重标注并绕过自然语言难以捕捉复杂时空变化的局限。同时构建FineVidBench基准，在场景和片段两个层面评估Video-LLMs。相比已有工作，该方法无需人工标注即可解锁更细粒度的理解能力，但摘要未给出具体性能提升数据。
2504.07745|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited fine-grained understanding of Video-LLMs, particularly in visual dynamics and detail inquiries. It proposes Self-Supervised Fragment Fine-Tuning (SF²T), which leverages inherent video characteristics for training without labor-intensive annotations, and introduces FineVidBench for scene- and fragment-level evaluation. The method unlocks finer-grained understanding while avoiding natural language limitations, though quantitative improvements are not specified in the abstract.
2504.07745|v2.assessment: 为Video-LLM的细粒度理解提供了无需标注的微调思路和评测基准，对多模态视频理解研究者有参考价值。
2504.07745|v2.contribution: 提出自监督片段微调方法SF²T及细粒度视频理解基准FineVidBench。
2504.07745|v2.innovation: 利用视频固有特性进行自监督片段微调，绕过自然语言标注的局限。
2504.07745|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称显著提升细粒度视频理解能力。

2411.11934|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目输入合成双目视频中高质量配对数据不足和时空一致性难以保持的问题，提出自监督双目视频合成范式SpatialDreamer，基于视频扩散模型。具体包括基于深度的视频生成模块DVG，采用前向-后向渲染机制生成具有几何和时间先验的配对视频；利用DVG生成的数据提出RefinerNet及自监督合成框架；并设计一致性控制模块。相比直接应用新视角合成技术，该方法能更好地处理动态场景并减少对大量训练数据的依赖，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2411.11934|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the insufficiency of paired stereo videos and spatio-temporal consistency in monocular-to-stereo video synthesis. It proposes SpatialDreamer, a self-supervised paradigm via a video diffusion model, including a Depth-based Video Generation module (DVG) with forward-backward rendering, RefinerNet with a self-supervised synthesis framework, and a consistency control module. It improves dynamic scene handling and reduces training data requirements compared to direct NVS application, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2411.11934|v2.assessment: 将视频扩散模型与自监督学习结合用于双目视频合成，对空间计算和VR领域有潜在应用价值。
2411.11934|v2.contribution: 提出自监督双目视频合成范式SpatialDreamer及深度视频生成模块DVG。
2411.11934|v2.innovation: 利用前向-后向渲染生成几何和时间先验，结合一致性控制模块实现自监督合成。
2411.11934|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但声称能有效应对动态场景和数据不足挑战。

2506.01037|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于扩散的视频超分方法易引入复杂退化和伪影的问题，提出一种噪声鲁棒的真实世界VSR框架，将自监督学习与Mamba融入预训练潜在扩散模型。通过Video State-Space块和3D选择性扫描模块增强全局时空注意力以保证帧间内容一致性；引入自监督ControlNet，利用HR特征作为引导并通过对比学习提取退化不敏感特征；提出基于HR-LR混合视频的三阶段训练策略。在真实世界VSR基准上取得优于现有方法的感知质量，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2506.01037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses complex degradations and artifacts in diffusion-based real-world video super-resolution (VSR). It proposes a noise-robust framework integrating self-supervised learning and Mamba into pre-trained latent diffusion models, with a Video State-Space block and 3D Selective Scan for spatio-temporal coherence, a self-supervised ControlNet using HR features and contrastive learning for degradation-insensitive features, and a three-stage HR-LR mixed training strategy. It achieves superior perceptual quality on real-world VSR benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
2506.01037|v2.assessment: 将Mamba与自监督ControlNet结合用于真实世界VSR，在感知质量上超越SOTA，对视频复原研究者有参考意义。
2506.01037|v2.contribution: 提出融合自监督学习与时空Mamba的真实世界视频超分框架。
2506.01037|v2.innovation: 引入Video State-Space块与3D选择性扫描增强时空一致性，并用自监督ControlNet减少伪影。
2506.01037|v2.result: 在真实世界VSR基准上取得优于现有方法的感知质量（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2601.04068|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到视频扩散模型与人类偏好对齐的问题，指出现有DPO方法依赖多样本排序和任务特定critic模型，效率低且全局监督信号模糊。为此提出LocalDPO后训练框架，通过随机时空掩码局部破坏真实视频并用冻结基座模型仅修复掩码区域，从而以单次推理自动构建局部化偏好对，无需外部critic或人工标注。训练时引入区域感知DPO损失，将偏好学习限制在损坏区域以加速收敛。在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上实验表明，LocalDPO持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐效果。
2601.04068|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and ambiguous global supervision of existing DPO methods for aligning text-to-video diffusion models with human preferences, which rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critics. It proposes LocalDPO, a post-training framework that constructs localized preference pairs by corrupting real videos with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only masked regions using a frozen base model, enabling single-inference preference data collection without external critics or manual annotation. A region-aware DPO loss restricts preference learning to corrupted areas for faster convergence. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX show consistent improvements in video fidelity, temporal coherence, and human preference alignment.
2601.04068|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种高效的视频扩散模型偏好对齐方法，但其研究领域为视频生成而非自动驾驶感知，与用户研究方向关联度很低，仅对多模态/VLM偏好优化方法有间接参考价值。
2601.04068|v2.contribution: 提出LocalDPO，一种基于局部时空区域偏好对的视频扩散模型直接偏好优化后训练框架。
2601.04068|v2.innovation: 利用随机时空掩码局部破坏真实视频并由冻结基座模型修复，自动构建局部化偏好对，配合区域感知DPO损失实现无需critic的高效对齐。
2601.04068|v2.result: 在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐表现。

2004.07507|v2.summary_cn: 针对含 BatchNorm 层的深度网络在持续学习中的二次惩罚方法失效问题，作者指出 BN 导致样本间依赖，使标准 K-FAC 的 Hessian 近似不再成立。为此扩展 K-FAC 以建模样本间关系，并提出 BN 统计参数的权重合并与重参数化方法，以及无需源任务数据的超参选择策略。在带 BN 的 permuted MNIST 和 ImageNet→细粒度分类的 ResNet-50 序列学习上均优于基线，且完全不依赖源任务数据。
2004.07507|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the invalidity of K-FAC-based quadratic penalty in continual learning when batch normalization introduces inter-example dependencies. It extends K-FAC to account for such dependencies, proposes weight merging and reparameterization for BN statistics, and a source-data-free hyperparameter selection scheme. Experiments on permuted MNIST with BN and ImageNet-to-fine-grained ResNet-50 sequences show consistent gains over baselines without using source task data.
2004.07507|v2.assessment: 把 K-FAC 的适用边界从独立样本推广到含 BN 的真实网络，对持续学习的二阶方法有实质推进，且无需源数据的超参选择实用性强。
2004.07507|v2.contribution: 提出了考虑样本间依赖的扩展 K-FAC 近似及 BN 统计参数处理方案，实现无源数据的持续学习。
2004.07507|v2.innovation: 首次指出 BN 破坏 K-FAC 的样本独立性假设并给出修正，同时设计 BN 权重合并与重参数化。
2004.07507|v2.result: 在带 BN 的 permuted MNIST 与 ImageNet→细粒度 ResNet-50 序列任务上均超过基线，且不使用任何源任务数据。

2004.00440|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中分类层需不断扩增权重、且旧类特征分布发生漂移的问题，本文转向嵌入网络并研究其增量学习特性。提出语义漂移补偿方法，利用当前任务数据经历的漂移来估计并补偿旧任务特征的漂移，无需保存任何样本。在 CIFAR100 和 ImageNet-Subset 细粒度数据集上验证，嵌入网络受灾难性遗忘影响显著更小，且补偿后性能进一步提升。
2004.00440|v2.summary_en: This work studies class-incremental learning for embedding networks, which naturally accommodate new classes without weight augmentation, and identifies feature drift as the key issue. It proposes a semantic drift compensation method that estimates the drift of previous tasks from that observed on current task data, requiring no exemplars. Experiments on CIFAR100 and ImageNet-Subset show embedding networks suffer much less catastrophic forgetting and benefit further from the compensation.
2004.00440|v2.assessment: 无样本的漂移估计思路简洁有效，对嵌入式增量学习这一较少被关注的设定提供了清晰的分析与解法。
2004.00440|v2.contribution: 提出无需样本的语义漂移补偿方法，并系统研究嵌入网络的类增量学习特性。
2004.00440|v2.innovation: 用当前任务数据的特征漂移外推估计旧任务漂移，避免保存历史样本。
2004.00440|v2.result: 在 CIFAR100 与 ImageNet-Subset 上嵌入网络遗忘显著减轻，补偿后性能优于对比方法。

2002.00718|v2.summary_cn: 针对语义分割增量学习中背景类像素因每步仅标注部分类别而产生语义分布偏移的问题，本文重新审视经典增量学习方法。提出显式建模该偏移的蒸馏框架，并设计分类器参数初始化策略以抑制对背景类的偏置预测。在 Pascal-VOC 2012 和 ADE20K 上大幅超越当时最先进的增量学习方法。
2002.00718|v2.summary_en: The paper tackles incremental learning for semantic segmentation, identifying that background pixels undergo a semantic distribution shift since each training step annotates only a subset of classes. It proposes a distillation-based framework that explicitly models this shift and a classifier initialization strategy to avoid biased background predictions. Extensive evaluation on Pascal-VOC 2012 and ADE20K significantly outperforms state-of-the-art incremental learning methods.
2002.00718|v2.assessment: 准确抓住分割增量学习中背景语义漂移这一被忽视的关键问题，方法针对性强，在标准分割基准上提升明显。
2002.00718|v2.contribution: 提出显式建模背景语义偏移的蒸馏框架及分类器初始化策略，用于语义分割增量学习。
2002.00718|v2.innovation: 将背景类视为随任务变化的动态类别并显式补偿其分布偏移，而非沿用分类任务的通用增量策略。
2002.00718|v2.result: 在 Pascal-VOC 2012 与 ADE20K 上显著优于现有增量学习 SOTA。

2003.13191|v2.summary_cn: 针对实际应用中增量学习需在线进行、且旧类会随时间出现新观测导致概念漂移的问题，本文提出可在线运行的增量学习框架。通过改进的交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习技术同时应对灾难性遗忘和概念漂移，并首次将旧类新观测纳入考量。实验表明该方法优于当时的在线增量学习 SOTA，且训练时间显著短于需长时重训的方法。
2003.13191|v2.summary_en: This paper targets online incremental learning where new classes arrive and old classes receive new observations over time, causing both catastrophic forgetting and concept drift. It introduces a modified cross-distillation loss with a two-step learning technique to handle both issues in online mode. Results show improvements over state-of-the-art online incremental methods with much shorter training time.
2003.13191|v2.assessment: 把概念漂移与在线场景引入增量学习，问题设定更贴近真实部署，但方法层面的创新相对温和。
2003.13191|v2.contribution: 提出可在线运行的增量学习框架，同时处理新类学习和旧类新观测带来的概念漂移。
2003.13191|v2.innovation: 改进的交叉蒸馏损失结合两步学习，使增量更新可在在线模式下快速完成。
2003.13191|v2.result: 优于当时在线增量学习 SOTA，且训练时间远短于需长时间重训的现有方法。

2002.10211|v2.summary_cn: 针对多类增量学习中保留少量旧类样本的有效性高度依赖样本代表性的问题，本文提出 mnemonics 框架，将样本参数化并端到端优化。通过模型层与样本层的双层优化自动学习代表性样本，在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset 和 ImageNet 三个基准上大幅超越 SOTA。有趣的是，学到的样本倾向于落在不同类别的决策边界附近。
2002.10211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-class incremental learning where retaining a few old-class exemplars is limited by their representativeness. It proposes the mnemonics framework, parameterizing exemplars and optimizing them end-to-end via bilevel optimization at model and exemplar levels. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-Subset and ImageNet surpass state of the art by a large margin, with exemplars tending to lie on class boundaries.
2002.10211|v2.assessment: 把样本选择从启发式提升为可学习优化，双层优化框架设计清晰，边界样本的发现对回放式增量学习有启发意义。
2002.10211|v2.contribution: 提出可端到端优化的 mnemonics 样本框架，通过双层优化自动生成代表性回放样本。
2002.10211|v2.innovation: 将 exemplar 参数化并纳入双层优化，替代人工样本选择策略。
2002.10211|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset 和 ImageNet 上大幅超过 SOTA，且样本自发聚集于类边界。

1911.07053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，作者发现知识蒸馏虽能维持旧类判别性，但无法阻止模型将样本误判为新类，且最后一层全连接层权重存在严重类别偏置。②提出Weight Aligning (WA)方法，在正常训练后校正FC层的偏置权重，与KD结合使用。③相比已有工作，WA简单有效，直接解决新旧类之间的公平性问题，弥补了KD的不足。④实验表明该方法在多个基准上显著缓解遗忘，提升新旧类整体准确率。
1911.07053|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, showing that knowledge distillation (KD) maintains discrimination within old classes but fails to prevent bias toward new classes due to highly biased weights in the last fully connected layer. The authors propose Weight Aligning (WA), which corrects these biased weights after normal training, combined with KD. This simple yet effective approach improves fairness between old and new classes, significantly mitigating forgetting and boosting overall accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
1911.07053|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了FC层权重偏置是灾难性遗忘的关键因素，提出的WA方法简单且通用，对增量学习研究者有直接启发。
1911.07053|v2.contribution: 提出Weight Aligning方法校正FC层偏置权重，结合KD同时保持旧类判别性和新旧类公平性。
1911.07053|v2.innovation: 首次指出FC层权重偏置是导致模型偏向新类的主要原因，并给出简单有效的后处理校正方案。
1911.07053|v2.result: 在多个类增量学习基准上显著缓解遗忘，提升新旧类整体准确率。

Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，探索对抗训练在任务序列中的正则化作用。②提出对抗持续学习框架，通过对抗扰动增强模型对旧任务的记忆保持。③相比传统正则化方法，利用对抗样本提升泛化性。④摘要缺失，无法引用具体数据。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by investigating adversarial training as a regularizer across task sequences. It proposes an adversarial continual learning framework that enhances retention of old tasks via adversarial perturbations. Compared to standard regularization, it leverages adversarial examples to improve generalization, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 将对抗训练引入持续学习是一个有趣的方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估具体贡献和效果。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出对抗持续学习框架，利用对抗扰动缓解灾难性遗忘。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 将对抗训练与持续学习结合，作为跨任务正则化手段。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。

Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_cn: ①针对极端内存约束下的在线持续学习场景，解决模型在有限存储下难以保持旧知识的问题。②提出适用于在线学习的内存高效方法，在严格内存预算下进行增量更新。③相比离线持续学习方法，更贴近实际部署中的资源限制。④摘要缺失，无法引用具体数据。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning under extreme memory constraints, where models must incrementally update with very limited storage. It proposes a memory-efficient approach for online settings, contrasting with offline continual learning methods. The work targets practical deployment scenarios, but specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.assessment: 极端内存约束下的在线持续学习具有实际部署价值，但摘要缺失限制了对其方法细节和效果的评估。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.contribution: 提出在极端内存约束下进行在线持续学习的方法。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.innovation: 针对在线场景和严格内存预算设计持续学习策略。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning Under Extreme Memory Constraints.

Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中数据类别不平衡的问题，解决重放缓冲区采样偏差导致的遗忘加剧。②提出Partitioning Reservoir Sampling方法，对缓冲区按类别分区采样以保持类别平衡。③相比标准蓄水池采样，更好地应对不平衡数据流。④摘要缺失，无法引用具体数据。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_en: This paper tackles imbalanced data in continual learning, where replay buffer sampling bias exacerbates forgetting. It proposes Partitioning Reservoir Sampling, which partitions the buffer by class to maintain balance during sampling. Compared to standard reservoir sampling, it better handles imbalanced data streams, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.assessment: 类别不平衡是持续学习中的常见但常被忽视的问题，该工作提出了针对性的采样策略，具有一定实用价值。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.contribution: 提出Partitioning Reservoir Sampling解决持续学习中的类别不平衡问题。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.innovation: 将蓄水池采样按类别分区，以在重放中保持类别平衡。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti._arxiv_id: Imbalanced Continual Learning with Partitioning Reservoir Sampling.

GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习领域方法日益复杂但进步存疑的问题，质疑当前研究进展的真实性。②提出GDumb——一种极其简单的方法：贪婪采样并从头训练模型。③相比复杂方法，GDumb在多个基准上取得有竞争力的结果，揭示现有评估协议的缺陷。④实验表明简单方法可匹敌甚至超越复杂方法，引发对领域进展的反思。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_en: This paper questions the progress in continual learning by showing that a simple approach, GDumb, which greedily samples and trains from scratch, achieves competitive results against complex methods. It reveals flaws in current evaluation protocols and challenges the field's perceived advancements. The work serves as a critical reflection on continual learning research.
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.assessment: 该工作以极简方法挑战复杂模型，对持续学习领域的评估标准和真实进展提出了重要质疑，值得研究者关注。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.contribution: 提出GDumb简单基线，揭示持续学习领域评估协议的缺陷并质疑现有方法的实际进步。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.innovation: 用贪婪采样加从头训练的极简策略，挑战复杂持续学习方法的有效性。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.result: GDumb在多个基准上取得与复杂方法相当甚至更好的结果。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions._arxiv_id: GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions Our Progress in Continual Learning.

More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出使用多个分类器来减少遗忘。②提出一种通用的多分类器范式，为每个任务或类别组维护独立分类器。③相比单分类器方法，多分类器结构能更好地隔离新旧任务的知识。④摘要缺失，无法引用具体数据。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning by proposing a generic multi-classifier paradigm, where multiple classifiers are maintained for different tasks or class groups. Compared to single-classifier approaches, this structure better isolates knowledge across tasks. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.assessment: 多分类器范式为增量学习提供了一种通用思路，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体实现和效果。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.contribution: 提出通用多分类器范式以减少增量学习中的遗忘。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.innovation: 通过维护多个分类器隔离新旧任务知识，缓解灾难性遗忘。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen._arxiv_id: More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Generic Multi-classifier Paradigm for Incremental Learning.

PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_cn: 针对小任务增量学习（small-task incremental learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏（Pooled Outputs Distillation）在空间维度上对中间特征图的池化统计量进行蒸馏，并结合表征的L2归一化与分类器偏差校正。相比仅蒸馏最终logits或全特征图的已有方法，PODNet在多个小任务增量学习基准上取得当时最优，在CIFAR-100等数据集上显著优于LwF、iCaRL等基线，且计算与存储开销低。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in small-task incremental learning by proposing PODNet, which distills pooled statistics of intermediate feature maps (spatial pooling) rather than only final logits or full feature maps. Combined with L2 normalization of representations and a bias-correction procedure for the classifier, PODNet achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple small-task incremental learning benchmarks, substantially outperforming prior methods such as LwF and iCaRL on datasets like CIFAR-100 with low computational and memory overhead.
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.assessment: 该工作是增量学习领域被广泛引用的强基线，池化蒸馏思路简洁有效，对关注持续学习与视觉表征的研究者有较高参考价值。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.contribution: 提出基于池化输出蒸馏的增量学习方法PODNet，有效缓解小任务场景下的灾难性遗忘。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.innovation: 在空间维度对中间层特征图的池化统计量进行蒸馏，并配合表征归一化与分类器偏差校正。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.result: 在多个小任务增量学习基准上取得当时最优性能，显著超越LwF、iCaRL等基线且开销低。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for._arxiv_id: PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for Small-Tasks Incremental Learning.

Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中存储旧任务样本或特征导致内存开销大的问题，本文提出特征自适应（Feature Adaptation）方法，将旧任务特征映射到新特征空间以复用压缩后的特征表示，从而减少对原始样本的存储需求。相比直接回放原始样本或存储高维特征，该方法在保持相近精度的同时大幅降低内存占用，在多个增量学习基准上验证了内存-精度的良好折中。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_en: To reduce the memory cost of storing old-task samples or features in incremental learning, this paper proposes a feature adaptation approach that maps old-task features into the new feature space, enabling reuse of compressed representations. Compared with raw-sample replay or storing high-dimensional features, it achieves comparable accuracy with substantially lower memory footprint, demonstrating a favorable memory-accuracy trade-off across several incremental learning benchmarks.
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.assessment: 该工作聚焦增量学习的内存效率这一实际痛点，方法实用，对资源受限场景下的持续学习部署有参考意义。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.contribution: 提出通过特征自适应复用压缩特征表示的内存高效增量学习方法。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.innovation: 将旧任务特征映射到新特征空间以替代原始样本存储，降低内存开销。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.result: 在多个增量学习基准上以更低内存占用取得与回放方法相近的精度。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Through Feature Adaptation.

Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中新旧类特征空间混淆、类间拓扑结构被破坏的问题，本文提出拓扑保持（Topology-Preserving）类增量学习方法，通过约束特征空间中类间拓扑关系（如类间距离与邻接结构）在增量过程中保持一致来缓解遗忘。相比仅依赖知识蒸馏或样本回放的方法，该方法更好地维持了类间判别结构，在标准类增量基准上提升了旧类与新类的整体精度。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_en: This paper tackles feature-space confusion and disrupted inter-class topology in class-incremental learning by proposing a topology-preserving method that constrains inter-class topological relations (e.g., distances and neighborhood structure) to remain consistent during incremental updates. Compared with distillation- or replay-only approaches, it better maintains discriminative class structure and improves overall accuracy on both old and new classes on standard class-incremental benchmarks.
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.assessment: 从拓扑结构角度切入类增量学习具有一定新意，对关注特征空间保持与遗忘机制的研究者有启发。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.contribution: 提出保持类间拓扑结构的类增量学习方法以缓解特征空间混淆与遗忘。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.innovation: 在增量过程中显式约束特征空间中类间拓扑关系的一致性。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.result: 在标准类增量基准上提升了新旧类的整体分类精度。

Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据流类别分布严重不平衡导致遗忘加剧的问题，本文提出面向不平衡数据的在线持续学习方法，通过重采样/损失重加权等策略在单遍数据流下平衡新旧类学习。相比假设数据平衡的已有在线持续学习方法，该方法在类别不平衡的在线场景下显著提升了对少数类与旧类的保持能力，在标准在线持续学习基准上取得更优的平均精度。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_en: This paper addresses exacerbated forgetting in online continual learning caused by highly imbalanced class distributions in the data stream, proposing a method that balances old and new class learning under single-pass streams via resampling and loss reweighting strategies. Compared with prior online continual learning methods that assume balanced data, it substantially improves retention of minority and old classes, achieving higher average accuracy on standard online continual learning benchmarks.
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.assessment: 该工作填补了在线持续学习中数据不平衡这一被忽视的设定，问题定义清晰，对实际流式部署有参考价值。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.contribution: 提出面向类别不平衡数据流的在线持续学习方法。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.innovation: 在单遍在线数据流下结合重采样与损失重加权缓解类别不平衡导致的遗忘。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.result: 在不平衡在线持续学习基准上提升了少数类与旧类的保持能力及平均精度。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning from Imbalanced Data.

Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_cn: 针对神经主题模型（neural topic modeling）在语料随时间演化时需要反复重训练、无法持续学习新主题的问题，本文将终身学习（lifelong learning）引入神经主题建模，提出可增量适应新语料并保留旧主题知识的框架。相比每次全量重训练的传统做法，该方法在保持旧主题质量的同时学习新主题，在主题一致性与困惑度等指标上取得更优的持续学习表现。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_en: To address the need to repeatedly retrain neural topic models as corpora evolve, this paper introduces continual lifelong learning into neural topic modeling, proposing a framework that incrementally adapts to new corpora while retaining previously learned topics. Compared with full retraining, it learns new topics while preserving old ones, achieving better continual-learning performance in topic coherence and perplexity metrics.
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.assessment: 该工作将持续学习拓展到NLP主题建模领域，跨领域思路有一定价值，但与视觉感知研究领域相关度较低。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.contribution: 将终身学习引入神经主题建模，实现语料演化下的持续主题学习。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.innovation: 在神经主题模型中引入持续学习机制以保留旧主题并学习新主题。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.result: 在主题一致性与困惑度等指标上优于全量重训练基线。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif._arxiv_id: Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lifelong Learning.

Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_cn: 本文从理论角度研究持续学习的本质困难，证明在一般设定下最优持续学习需要完美记忆（perfect memory）且问题是NP-hard的，从而揭示了持续学习任务的内在计算复杂度。相比以往偏经验性的持续学习研究，该工作给出了形式化的问题定义与复杂度证明，说明不存在通用的高效最优解，为理解各类近似方法的局限提供了理论依据。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_en: This paper theoretically studies the intrinsic difficulty of continual learning, proving that optimal continual learning requires perfect memory and is NP-hard in general settings, thereby revealing the computational complexity of the problem. In contrast to predominantly empirical prior work, it provides a formal problem formulation and complexity proofs, showing that no general efficient optimal solution exists and offering theoretical grounding for the limitations of approximate methods.
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.assessment: 该理论工作为持续学习领域提供了重要的复杂度下界认知，虽不直接涉及视觉感知，但对方法设计有指导意义。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.contribution: 证明最优持续学习需要完美记忆且为NP-hard问题。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.innovation: 给出持续学习的形式化定义并建立其计算复杂度理论结果。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.result: 证明不存在通用的高效最优持续学习算法，为近似方法提供理论依据。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M._arxiv_id: Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect Memory and is NP-hard.

Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，论文提出前瞻性元学习（Look-ahead Meta Learning, La-MAML）框架。该方法将元学习与在线更新结合，通过可学习的逐参数学习率实现快速适应与长期记忆的平衡。相比已有基于经验回放或正则化的方法，La-MAML 在在线持续学习设定下无需任务边界即可工作。在多个基准上取得优于或可比于离线方法的性能，显著缓解遗忘。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing Look-ahead Meta Learning (La-MAML). It combines meta-learning with online updates and learnable per-parameter learning rates to balance fast adaptation and long-term retention. Unlike prior replay- or regularization-based methods, La-MAML operates in online settings without task boundaries, achieving competitive or superior performance on standard benchmarks.
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.assessment: 将元学习引入在线持续学习，思路新颖且实用，对无任务边界的场景有重要参考价值。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.contribution: 提出前瞻性元学习框架 La-MAML，实现在线持续学习中的快速适应与抗遗忘。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.innovation: 用可学习逐参数学习率结合元学习实现在线无任务边界的持续学习。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.result: 在多个持续学习基准上取得优于或可比于离线方法的性能，有效缓解遗忘。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L._arxiv_id: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning.

Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_cn: 针对持续学习与流式数据中如何选择代表性样本（coreset）的问题，论文提出基于双层优化的 coreset 选择方法。该方法将 coreset 选择建模为双层优化问题，外层优化模型性能，内层优化在选定子集上的训练。相比随机采样或启发式选择，该方法能更有效地保留关键信息。在持续学习和流式学习任务上取得更好的精度与效率权衡。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_en: This paper tackles coreset selection for continual learning and streaming by formulating it as a bilevel optimization problem. The outer level optimizes model performance while the inner level trains on the selected subset. Compared to random or heuristic selection, it better preserves critical information, yielding improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on continual and streaming benchmarks.
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.assessment: 将 coreset 选择与双层优化结合，为持续学习中的样本选择提供了理论化且有效的方案。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.contribution: 提出基于双层优化的 coreset 选择方法用于持续学习与流式学习。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.innovation: 将 coreset 选择建模为双层优化问题以提升样本代表性。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.result: 在持续学习和流式任务上取得更好的精度与效率权衡。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co._arxiv_id: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming.

Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_cn: 针对一般持续学习（General Continual Learning）中任务边界模糊、数据分布变化的问题，论文提出 Dark Experience Replay（DER）方法。该方法在经验回放中不仅存储样本，还存储模型在样本上的 logits，并在训练时匹配这些历史 logits 以稳定记忆。相比仅回放样本的方法，DER 能更好地保留旧知识。在多个一般持续学习基准上以简单结构取得强基线性能，显著优于现有方法。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses general continual learning with blurred task boundaries and shifting distributions by proposing Dark Experience Replay (DER). It stores both samples and their historical logits, matching them during training to stabilize memory. Compared to sample-only replay, DER better preserves old knowledge, establishing a strong simple baseline that significantly outperforms prior methods on general continual learning benchmarks.
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.assessment: 方法简单却极为有效，成为持续学习领域的强基线，值得广泛关注与借鉴。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.contribution: 提出 Dark Experience Replay，通过回放历史 logits 实现一般持续学习的强基线。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.innovation: 在经验回放中同时存储并匹配历史 logits 以稳定旧知识。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.result: 在多个一般持续学习基准上以简单结构显著优于现有方法。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le._arxiv_id: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline.

Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_cn: 针对在线快速适应与知识积累难以兼顾的问题，论文提出 OSAKA 方法。该方法将在线快速适应与长期知识积累解耦，通过元学习实现快速适应，并通过任务特定模块或正则化实现知识积累。相比传统持续学习方法，OSAKA 在在线场景下能更快适应新任务同时减少遗忘。在多个基准上取得优于现有在线持续学习方法的性能。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the tension between online fast adaptation and knowledge accumulation by proposing OSAKA. It decouples fast adaptation via meta-learning from long-term accumulation via task-specific modules or regularization. Compared to traditional continual learning methods, OSAKA adapts faster online while reducing forgetting, outperforming prior online continual learning approaches on multiple benchmarks.
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.assessment: 将快速适应与知识积累解耦的思路清晰，对在线持续学习场景有较强实用价值。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.contribution: 提出 OSAKA 方法，解耦在线快速适应与知识积累。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.innovation: 通过元学习与任务特定机制分离快速适应和长期记忆。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.result: 在多个基准上优于现有在线持续学习方法，减少遗忘。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc._arxiv_id: Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation (OSAKA): a New Approach to Continual Learning.

Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中参数更新导致遗忘的问题，论文提出在低秩正交子空间中学习的方法。该方法将任务相关的参数更新约束在低秩正交子空间内，使不同任务的更新相互正交，从而减少干扰。相比全参数更新或简单正则化，该方法能更有效地隔离任务知识。在多个持续学习基准上取得更低的遗忘率和更高的平均精度。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting caused by parameter updates in continual learning by learning in low-rank orthogonal subspaces. Task-specific updates are constrained to low-rank orthogonal subspaces so that different tasks do not interfere. Compared to full-parameter updates or simple regularization, it better isolates task knowledge, achieving lower forgetting and higher average accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.assessment: 低秩正交子空间的约束思路优雅，为持续学习提供了一种有效的参数隔离方案。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.contribution: 提出在低秩正交子空间中学习以缓解持续学习中的遗忘。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.innovation: 将任务更新约束在低秩正交子空间以实现任务间隔离。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.result: 在多个持续学习基准上取得更低遗忘率和更高平均精度。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona._arxiv_id: Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces.

Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中的遗忘问题，论文提出基于实例感知参数化的方法。该方法为不同实例动态生成或选择参数子集，使模型能针对当前输入进行自适应调整，同时保留旧知识。相比静态参数或任务级参数隔离，实例级参数化更细粒度地缓解干扰。在在线持续学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，有效降低遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_en: This paper mitigates forgetting in online continual learning via instance-aware parameterization. It dynamically generates or selects parameter subsets per instance, enabling adaptive adjustment while retaining old knowledge. Compared to static or task-level parameter isolation, instance-level parameterization reduces interference more finely, outperforming prior methods on online continual learning benchmarks.
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.assessment: 实例级参数化的粒度更细，为在线持续学习提供了新的抗遗忘视角。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.contribution: 提出实例感知参数化方法以缓解在线持续学习中的遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.innovation: 为每个实例动态生成或选择参数子集实现细粒度自适应。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.result: 在在线持续学习基准上优于现有方法，有效降低遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua._arxiv_id: Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continual Learning via Instance-Aware Parameterization.

2103.17230|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中任务边界模糊、类别重叠这一更贴近现实但研究不足的场景，论文指出情景记忆中的样本多样性是关键。提出 Rainbow Memory（RM）记忆管理策略，基于每样本分类不确定性与数据增强来挑选和扩充记忆中的多样样本。在 MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 和 ImageNet 上验证，在模糊持续学习设定下大幅超越当时 SOTA，且方法简单。
2103.17230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the realistic but under-studied 'blurry' continual learning setting where tasks share classes and boundaries are ambiguous, arguing that sample diversity in episodic memory is crucial. It proposes Rainbow Memory (RM), a memory management strategy that selects and augments diverse samples based on per-sample classification uncertainty and data augmentation. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet show large accuracy gains over state-of-the-art methods in blurry continual learning despite the method's simplicity.
2103.17230|v2.assessment: 把持续学习从人为的 disjoint-class 设定推向更现实的模糊边界设定，记忆多样性视角有启发性，实验扎实，值得关注。
2103.17230|v2.contribution: 提出基于不确定性与数据增强的 Rainbow Memory 记忆管理策略，用于模糊任务边界的持续学习。
2103.17230|v2.innovation: 首次强调情景记忆中样本多样性对模糊持续学习的重要性，并用分类不确定性驱动样本选择。
2103.17230|v2.result: 在 MNIST/CIFAR10/CIFAR100/ImageNet 的模糊持续学习设定下大幅超越当时 SOTA。

2105.04444|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中严重遗忘与高内存开销的问题，论文从信息论视角分析遗忘根源，发现遗忘源于学习新任务时参数上旧任务信息增益的丢失。提出 Bit-Level Information Preserving（BLIP），通过参数量化在比特级别更新参数，先量化训练新任务，再估计每个参数由任务数据带来的信息增益，据此冻结相应比特以防遗忘。在分类到强化学习任务上取得优于或持平于已有方法的结果。
2105.04444|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and high memory cost in continual learning by analyzing the process through information theory, observing that forgetting stems from the loss of information gain on parameters from previous tasks. It proposes Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP), which updates parameters at the bit level via quantization: it trains a quantized network on the new task and estimates per-parameter information gain to decide which bits to freeze. Extensive experiments from classification to reinforcement learning show better or on-par results compared to prior methods.
2105.04444|v2.assessment: 用信息增益和比特级冻结来刻画并缓解遗忘，视角新颖，跨分类与强化学习的验证较全面。
2105.04444|v2.contribution: 提出基于信息论与参数量化的比特级信息保持持续学习方法 BLIP。
2105.04444|v2.innovation: 将遗忘归因于参数信息增益丢失，并用比特级冻结（量化）来保留信息增益。
2105.04444|v2.result: 在分类与强化学习任务上取得优于或持平于已有方法的表现。

2103.16597|v2.summary_cn: 针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，并进一步扩展到测试集含训练未见类别的任务增量广义零样本学习场景。提出用权重校正（weight rectification）和仿射变换来适配顺序到达的不同任务：通过校正上一任务学到的权重使其适用于新任务，校正仅用极少参数，同时对网络输出学习仿射变换以更好适配新任务。在多个数据集的零样本与非零样本任务增量设定下实验验证了有效性。
2103.16597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in task incremental learning and its harder variant where the test set contains classes unseen during training (task incremental generalized zero-shot learning). It proposes weight rectifications and affine transformations to adapt the model to sequentially arriving tasks, where rectifications are learned with very few parameters and affine transformations are applied to network outputs. Experiments on several datasets in both zero-shot and non-zero-shot task incremental settings demonstrate effectiveness.
2103.16597|v2.assessment: 把任务增量学习与广义零样本结合，权重校正参数高效，但整体创新幅度中等。
2103.16597|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重校正与输出仿射变换的任务增量（含广义零样本）持续学习方法。
2103.16597|v2.innovation: 用极少参数的权重校正适配新任务，并同时处理零样本任务增量场景。
2103.16597|v2.result: 在多个数据集的零样本与非零样本任务增量设定下验证了有效性。

Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_cn: 该论文（摘要缺失）据标题推测针对持续学习中的遗忘问题，提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法，通过对梯度进行分解以约束各层更新方向，从而在学新任务时减少对旧任务性能的破坏。由于摘要为空，无法引用具体实验数据与改进幅度。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_en: This paper (abstract unavailable) targets catastrophic forgetting in continual learning and, judging from the title, proposes a layerwise optimization scheme based on gradient decomposition to constrain per-layer updates so that learning new tasks does not degrade old-task performance. Specific experimental results and improvements cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.assessment: 梯度分解做逐层约束的思路对持续学习有参考价值，但缺少摘要信息，难以评估其实验充分度。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.contribution: 提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化持续学习方法。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.innovation: 将梯度分解用于逐层参数更新约束以缓解遗忘。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom._arxiv_id: Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition for Continual Learning.

Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_cn: 该论文（摘要缺失）据标题推测针对判别式与生成式两类持续学习任务，提出高效的特征变换方法，通过学习轻量的特征变换模块来适配顺序到达的任务，从而在减少可训练参数的同时缓解灾难性遗忘。由于摘要为空，无法引用具体实验数据与改进幅度。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_en: This paper (abstract unavailable) targets both discriminative and generative continual learning and, judging from the title, proposes efficient feature transformations that adapt to sequentially arriving tasks with lightweight learnable modules, reducing trainable parameters while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Specific results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.assessment: 统一处理判别式与生成式持续学习并强调参数高效，方向有价值，但缺摘要难以判断质量。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.contribution: 提出面向判别式与生成式任务的高效特征变换持续学习方法。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.innovation: 用轻量特征变换模块同时适配判别式与生成式持续学习。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di._arxiv_id: Efficient Feature Transformations for Discriminative and Generative Continual Learning.

Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_cn: 该论文（摘要缺失）据标题推测针对持续学习中的遗忘问题，提出在特征协方差零空间内训练网络，使新任务的参数更新不干扰旧任务已学到的特征子空间，从而在不依赖大量旧样本回放的情况下缓解灾难性遗忘。由于摘要为空，无法引用具体实验数据与改进幅度。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_en: This paper (abstract unavailable) targets catastrophic forgetting in continual learning and, judging from the title, proposes training networks within the null space of the feature covariance so that updates for new tasks do not interfere with the feature subspace learned for old tasks, mitigating forgetting without heavy replay. Specific results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.assessment: 零空间投影约束更新是持续学习中较有理论依据的思路，但缺摘要无法评估实验充分度。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.contribution: 提出在特征协方差零空间中训练网络的持续学习方法。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.innovation: 利用特征协方差零空间约束参数更新以保护旧任务特征子空间。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu._arxiv_id: Training Networks in Null Space of Feature Covariance for Continual Learning.

ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督持续学习（Semi-Supervised Continual Learning）中增量无标签数据难以有效利用的问题，提出ORDisCo框架。方法上结合了持续学习与半监督学习，通过有效且高效地利用增量无标签数据来缓解灾难性遗忘并提升新类学习能力。相比已有工作，ORDisCo在标注数据有限的情况下更好地平衡了稳定性与可塑性。实验表明该方法在多个基准上取得了优于现有半监督持续学习方法的性能。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised continual learning where incremental unlabeled data is available but underutilized. The authors propose ORDisCo, a framework that effectively and efficiently leverages incremental unlabeled data to mitigate catastrophic forgetting while learning new classes. Compared to prior work, ORDisCo better balances stability and plasticity under limited supervision, achieving improved performance on standard benchmarks.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 该工作关注持续学习中无标签数据的利用，思路实用，但摘要信息有限，需查看全文确认实验细节。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出ORDisCo框架，实现增量无标签数据在半监督持续学习中的有效利用。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 将半监督学习与持续学习结合，设计高效的无标签数据利用策略。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在多个基准上优于现有半监督持续学习方法。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本增量学习（Few-Shot Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘和特征表示难以适应新类的问题，提出持续演化分类器（Continually Evolved Classifiers）方法。核心思想是在增量学习过程中动态调整分类器，使其持续适应新类别而不遗忘旧类别。相比固定分类器的已有方法，该方法通过分类器的持续演化更好地平衡了新旧类别的识别性能。实验在标准小样本增量学习基准上取得了显著提升。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot incremental learning, where catastrophic forgetting and poor feature adaptation to new classes are major challenges. The authors propose Continually Evolved Classifiers, which dynamically adjust the classifier during incremental learning to accommodate new classes without forgetting old ones. Compared to fixed-classifier approaches, this method achieves better balance between old and new class recognition, yielding significant improvements on standard benchmarks.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: 分类器持续演化的思路简洁有效，对小样本增量学习有较好推动，值得关注。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出持续演化分类器方法，解决小样本增量学习中的分类器适应问题。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 在增量学习过程中动态演化分类器而非固定分类器。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在标准小样本增量学习基准上取得显著性能提升。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Continually Evolved Classifiers.

Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_cn: 该论文针对图像去雨（Image De-Raining）任务中模型需要适应不同雨型而容易遗忘已学知识的问题，提出基于持续学习的去雨方法。方法上将持续学习范式引入图像去雨，使模型能够顺序学习多种去雨任务而不发生灾难性遗忘。相比独立训练多个模型或联合训练的方式，该方法在保持去雨效果的同时提升了模型的可扩展性。实验表明该方法在多个去雨基准上取得了与专用方法相当的性能。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_en: This paper addresses image de-raining where models must adapt to different rain types without forgetting previously learned knowledge. The authors introduce a continual learning paradigm for de-raining, enabling sequential learning of multiple de-raining tasks without catastrophic forgetting. Compared to training separate models or joint training, this approach maintains de-raining quality while improving scalability, achieving performance comparable to specialized methods on multiple benchmarks.
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..assessment: 将持续学习引入低层视觉去雨任务，交叉方向有一定新意，但领域相关度较低。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..contribution: 首次将持续学习范式应用于图像去雨任务。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..innovation: 将持续学习与图像去雨结合，解决多雨型顺序学习中的遗忘问题。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..result: 在多个去雨基准上取得与专用方法相当的性能。

2104.08572|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出现有知识蒸馏方法在防止遗忘方面仍有不足。作者提出一种新的蒸馏方法：首先为旧模型和新模型的响应分别构建低维流形，然后沿连接两个流形的测地线最小化响应差异。相比直接最小化响应差异的已有方法，基于测地线的蒸馏具有更平滑的性质，能更有效地保留旧知识。实验表明该方法在增量学习基准上优于现有最先进的蒸馏方法。
2104.08572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning, noting that existing knowledge distillation methods remain insufficient. The authors propose constructing low-dimensional manifolds for previous and current responses, then minimizing dissimilarity along the geodesic connecting these manifolds. Compared to directly minimizing response differences, geodesic-based distillation offers smoother properties and better preserves past knowledge, outperforming state-of-the-art distillation methods on incremental learning benchmarks.
2104.08572|v2.assessment: 从流形几何角度重新审视知识蒸馏，理论动机清晰，方法优雅，值得关注。
2104.08572|v2.contribution: 提出基于测地线的知识蒸馏方法用于增量学习。
2104.08572|v2.innovation: 构建响应流形并沿测地线最小化差异，实现更平滑的知识蒸馏。
2104.08572|v2.result: 在增量学习基准上优于现有最先进的蒸馏方法。

2107.08918|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中表示优化和原型重组监督不足的问题，提出一种新的增量原型学习方案。方法包含随机情节选择策略和自提升原型精炼机制，前者使特征表示适应不同增量情节以增强扩展性，后者通过动态关系投影模块计算共享嵌入空间中的关系矩阵来引导原型更新。在三个基准数据集上分别以13%、17%和11%的幅度超越现有最先进方法。
2107.08918|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where representation optimization and prototype reorganization suffer from limited supervision. The authors propose an incremental prototype learning scheme with random episode selection to enhance feature extensibility and a self-promoted prototype refinement mechanism using a dynamic relation projection module to bootstrap prototype updates. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks outperform state-of-the-art methods by margins of 13%, 17%, and 11%, respectively.
2107.08918|v2.assessment: 原型精炼与关系投影的结合有效提升了FSCIL性能，提升幅度显著，值得关注。
2107.08918|v2.contribution: 提出自提升原型精炼方案用于小样本类增量学习。
2107.08918|v2.innovation: 设计动态关系投影模块，利用类间依赖关系引导原型更新。
2107.08918|v2.result: 在三个基准数据集上分别以13%、17%和11%的幅度超越最先进方法。

2103.04059|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中因训练样本极少而无法直接套用标准增量学习方法的问题，提出一种语义感知知识蒸馏算法。方法利用词嵌入作为廉价获取的语义信息辅助蒸馏，并设计基于注意力机制的多并行视觉嵌入对齐方法，将视觉与语义向量对齐以减少灾难性遗忘。在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100数据集上取得了新的最先进结果。
2103.04059|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where limited training examples prevent direct application of standard incremental learning techniques. The authors introduce a semantic-aware distillation algorithm that leverages word embeddings as cheap semantic information and employs an attention mechanism over multiple parallel visual embeddings to align visual and semantic vectors, reducing catastrophic forgetting. New state-of-the-art results are established on MiniImageNet, CUB200, and CIFAR100.
2103.04059|v2.assessment: 利用语义信息辅助蒸馏的思路新颖，多数据集验证充分，对FSCIL方向有较好推动。
2103.04059|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知知识蒸馏算法用于小样本类增量学习。
2103.04059|v2.innovation: 利用词嵌入语义信息和注意力机制对齐视觉-语义向量以减少遗忘。
2103.04059|v2.result: 在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100上取得新的最先进结果。

Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出数据本身对模型更新的因果效应未被显式建模。作者提出将数据的因果效应从模型参数更新中蒸馏出来，通过因果推断框架分离出与旧类知识保持相关的梯度分量，从而在增量训练新类时减少对旧类表征的破坏。相比已有正则化或回放方法，该方法从因果角度重新审视数据作用，在多个类增量基准上取得了更优的旧类保持与新类学习平衡。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by modeling the causal effect of data on parameter updates. It proposes to distill the causal effect of data, separating gradient components responsible for preserving old-class knowledge from those driving new-class adaptation. Compared with existing regularization or replay-based methods, it achieves a better stability-plasticity trade-off on standard class-incremental benchmarks.
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.assessment: 从因果推断视角切入类增量学习，思路新颖，对理解增量学习中的梯度干扰有启发意义。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.contribution: 提出蒸馏数据因果效应的类增量学习框架，显式分离旧类保持与新类学习的梯度贡献。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.innovation: 将因果推断引入类增量学习，用因果效应分解替代传统正则化或回放策略。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.result: 在多个类增量基准上优于已有方法，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas._arxiv_id: Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Class-Incremental Learning.

Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中固定网络结构难以适应新旧类分布差异的问题，提出自适应聚合网络（Adaptive Aggregation Networks）。方法通过可学习的聚合模块动态融合不同层或不同分支的特征，使网络在增量阶段自动调整表征聚合方式，从而兼顾旧类知识保持与新类适应。相比固定结构的增量学习方法，该设计在多个类增量基准上提升了分类精度并减少了遗忘。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_en: This paper tackles class-incremental learning where fixed architectures struggle to adapt to shifting class distributions. It proposes Adaptive Aggregation Networks that learn to dynamically aggregate features across layers or branches during incremental stages. Compared with fixed-structure baselines, it improves accuracy and reduces forgetting on standard class-incremental benchmarks.
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.assessment: 通过自适应聚合增强增量学习表征能力，方法简洁有效，对增量学习网络设计有参考价值。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.contribution: 提出自适应聚合网络，动态融合特征以缓解类增量学习中的稳定性-可塑性矛盾。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.innovation: 用可学习聚合模块替代固定特征融合，使网络在增量阶段自适应调整表征。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.result: 在类增量基准上提升分类精度并降低遗忘率。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-._arxiv_id: Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-Incremental Learning.

2011.14593|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度模型在增量学习中因黑盒优化导致的灾难性遗忘问题，提出基于 rate reduction 原理的白盒网络架构，每层显式计算而无需反向传播。给定预训练网络和新类数据，方法可证明地构造出等价于对所有旧类和新类联合训练的新网络。在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上，该方法分类性能衰减显著更小，大幅超越当时最先进方法，验证了白盒算法在复杂图像增量学习中的可行性。
2011.14593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning caused by black-box optimization. It proposes a white-box architecture derived from the rate reduction principle, where each layer is explicitly computed without backpropagation, and provably constructs a new network emulating joint training over all past and new classes. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 show significantly less performance decay, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.
2011.14593|v2.assessment: 理论可证明的白盒增量学习框架，为克服灾难性遗忘提供了新范式，理论深度突出。
2011.14593|v2.contribution: 提出基于 rate reduction 的白盒增量学习架构，可证明地构造等价于联合训练的网络。
2011.14593|v2.innovation: 用显式逐层计算替代反向传播黑盒优化，从原理上保证旧类知识保持。
2011.14593|v2.result: 在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上性能衰减显著更小，大幅超越当时最先进方法。

Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中旧类样本不可用导致的表征漂移问题，提出原型增强与自监督相结合的增量学习方法。方法通过为旧类生成增强原型以维持分类器边界，并引入自监督任务约束特征空间，使新旧类表征保持判别性。相比仅依赖回放或正则化的方法，该策略在多个类增量基准上提升了旧类识别精度并缓解了遗忘。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses representation drift in class-incremental learning when old-class samples are unavailable. It proposes prototype augmentation combined with self-supervision to maintain old-class classifier boundaries and constrain the feature space. Compared with replay- or regularization-only methods, it improves old-class accuracy and mitigates forgetting on standard class-incremental benchmarks.
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.assessment: 原型增强与自监督结合思路清晰，对无回放类增量学习有实用价值。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出原型增强与自监督联合的类增量学习框架，缓解旧类表征漂移。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.innovation: 用增强原型维持分类边界，并以自监督约束特征空间提升判别性。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.result: 在类增量基准上提升旧类精度并降低遗忘。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervision for Incremental Learning.

Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实世界中在线持续目标检测的挑战，指出现有持续学习方法多局限于离线分类设定，难以应对数据流式到达、类别动态增长和域偏移。作者提出 Wanderlust 基准与在线持续目标检测框架，模拟真实场景下的流式数据与开放类别，并设计相应的持续检测方法。相比已有离线增量检测工作，该设定更贴近自动驾驶等实际部署需求，为在线持续感知提供了评测平台与方法基线。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_en: This paper targets online continual object detection in the real world, where data arrives as a stream with dynamically growing classes and domain shifts. It introduces the Wanderlust benchmark and an online continual detection framework that simulates realistic streaming and open-set conditions. Compared with offline incremental detection works, it better reflects deployment needs such as autonomous driving and provides a platform and baselines for online continual perception.
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.assessment: 面向真实在线持续目标检测的基准与方法，与自动驾驶持续感知需求高度契合，值得关注。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.contribution: 提出 Wanderlust 在线持续目标检测基准与框架，模拟真实流式数据与动态类别。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.innovation: 将持续学习从离线分类拓展到在线流式目标检测，贴近真实部署场景。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.result: 为在线持续目标检测提供评测平台与基线方法，推动该方向研究。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete._arxiv_id: Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Detection in the Real World.

Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中的类增量学习问题，指出现有增量学习方法多针对静态图像，难以处理视频中时序信息与类别增长带来的遗忘。作者提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习框架，结合时序特征建模与增量学习策略以保持旧动作类知识。相比直接迁移图像增量方法，该工作更好地适应视频时序特性，在视频动作识别增量基准上取得更优的旧类保持与新类学习效果。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning for video action recognition, where existing incremental methods designed for static images struggle with temporal information and growing classes. It proposes a class-incremental framework tailored to video action recognition, combining temporal feature modeling with incremental strategies to retain old action knowledge. Compared with directly transferring image-based incremental methods, it better handles video temporal characteristics and achieves improved old-class retention and new-class learning on incremental action recognition benchmarks.
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.assessment: 将类增量学习拓展到视频动作识别，填补了时序增量学习的空白，对视频理解持续学习有参考价值。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.contribution: 提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习框架，兼顾时序建模与旧类知识保持。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.innovation: 针对视频时序特性设计增量学习策略，突破图像增量方法在视频上的局限。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.result: 在视频动作识别增量基准上取得更优的旧类保持与新类学习效果。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re._arxiv_id: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos.

Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据分布随真实世界自然漂移的问题，指出现有持续学习基准多采用人工构造的、分布突变的任务序列，无法反映真实场景。作者构建了一个基于大规模视觉数据、具有自然分布偏移的在线持续学习评测框架，并系统评估了多种现有方法在该设定下的表现。实验表明，在自然分布偏移下，现有持续学习方法的性能显著下降，且回放（replay）策略仍是最有效的缓解手段之一。该工作为持续学习研究提供了更贴近现实的评测基准，并揭示了现有方法与真实需求之间的差距。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning under natural distribution shifts, arguing that existing benchmarks rely on artificially constructed task sequences with abrupt distribution changes that fail to reflect real-world scenarios. The authors introduce an empirical evaluation framework built on large-scale visual data with naturally drifting distributions and systematically benchmark a range of continual learning methods. Results show that existing approaches degrade substantially under natural shifts, while replay-based strategies remain among the most effective mitigations. The work provides a more realistic benchmark and highlights the gap between current methods and practical requirements.
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.assessment: 该工作揭示了持续学习评测与真实场景之间的重要差距，其基准设定对后续研究具有参考价值，但方法层面的创新有限。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.contribution: 构建了基于自然分布偏移的大规模在线持续学习评测框架，并系统评估了现有方法在该设定下的表现。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.innovation: 首次系统性地将自然分布偏移引入在线持续学习评测，替代传统的人工任务序列构造方式。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.result: 实验表明现有持续学习方法在自然分布偏移下性能显著下降，回放策略仍是最有效的缓解手段。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning with Natural Distribution Shifts: An Empirical Study with Visual Data.

Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出将对比学习（contrastive learning）引入持续学习框架，以增强表征的泛化性和可迁移性。作者提出 Co2L 方法，通过在回放样本与当前样本之间构建对比损失，并结合监督对比学习与知识蒸馏，缓解任务间的表征漂移。相比已有基于回放或正则化的方法，Co2L 在多个持续学习基准上取得了更优的性能，尤其在任务顺序变化和内存受限条件下表现稳健。实验在 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet 等数据集上验证了方法的有效性，显著优于多种基线。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by incorporating contrastive learning to learn more generalizable and transferable representations. The authors propose Co2L, which constructs contrastive losses between replayed and current samples, combined with supervised contrastive learning and knowledge distillation to mitigate representation drift across tasks. Co2L outperforms existing replay- and regularization-based methods on multiple benchmarks, showing robustness to task order and limited memory budgets. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet demonstrate consistent gains over strong baselines.
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 将对比学习与持续学习结合是一个自然且有效的思路，实验充分，对表征漂移问题的分析具有启发性。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出 Co2L 框架，将监督对比学习与回放机制结合用于持续学习。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 在回放样本与当前样本间构建对比损失，并联合知识蒸馏以缓解任务间表征漂移。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet 等基准上显著优于多种回放与正则化基线，且在内存受限下表现稳健。

Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中数据流含有噪声标签的问题，指出现有回放方法在噪声数据流下会累积错误并加剧遗忘。作者提出自净化回放（Self-Purified Replay）方法，通过在线估计样本标签的可信度，对回放缓冲区中的样本进行净化与筛选，从而减少噪声标签对模型更新的负面影响。相比直接回放或简单过滤策略，该方法在多个含噪持续学习设定下取得了更好的精度与稳定性。实验表明，在 CIFAR-10/100 等数据集上，该方法在噪声率较高时仍能保持较好的持续学习性能。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning on data streams with noisy labels, where existing replay methods accumulate errors and exacerbate forgetting. The authors propose Self-Purified Replay, which online estimates label reliability and purifies/filters samples in the replay buffer to reduce the impact of noisy labels on model updates. Compared with naive replay or simple filtering, the method achieves better accuracy and stability across noisy continual learning settings. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 show that it maintains strong continual learning performance even under high noise rates.
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.assessment: 将噪声标签问题引入持续学习回放机制具有一定新意，方法设计合理，但评测规模相对有限。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.contribution: 提出自净化回放机制，在持续学习中在线净化回放缓冲区以应对噪声标签。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.innovation: 通过在线估计标签可信度对回放样本进行净化与筛选，缓解噪声标签在持续学习中的累积效应。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 等含噪持续学习设定下，高噪声率时仍保持较好的精度与稳定性。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams._arxiv_id: Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams via Self-Purified Replay.

Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本学习与持续学习中的任务间干扰问题，提出注意力独立机制（Attentive Independent Mechanisms, AIM），通过为不同任务学习独立的注意力模块来减少参数共享带来的干扰。作者将 AIM 应用于小样本分类与持续学习场景，在元学习框架下实现任务特定的特征调制。相比已有基于共享特征提取器的方法，AIM 在多个小样本与持续学习基准上取得了更优或相当的性能，同时缓解了灾难性遗忘。实验在 miniImageNet、CIFAR 等数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_en: This paper targets task interference in few-shot and continual learning by proposing Attentive Independent Mechanisms (AIM), which learn task-specific attention modules to reduce interference from parameter sharing. AIM is applied to few-shot classification and continual learning within a meta-learning framework, enabling task-specific feature modulation. Compared with shared feature extractor baselines, AIM achieves better or comparable performance on several few-shot and continual learning benchmarks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Experiments on miniImageNet and CIFAR validate the approach.
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.assessment: 任务特定注意力模块的思路简洁有效，但整体方法在持续学习领域的创新性相对一般。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.contribution: 提出注意力独立机制 AIM，用于小样本与持续学习中的任务特定特征调制。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.innovation: 通过为不同任务学习独立注意力模块来减少参数共享带来的任务间干扰。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.result: 在 miniImageNet、CIFAR 等基准上取得优于或相当于已有方法的性能，并缓解灾难性遗忘。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att._arxiv_id: Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Attentive Independent Mechanisms.

RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_cn: 该论文针对语义分割中的持续学习问题，指出现有持续学习方法多针对图像分类设计，难以直接迁移到密集预测任务。作者提出 RECALL 框架，基于回放机制，通过存储少量旧任务样本并在训练时回放，结合知识蒸馏与类别平衡策略，缓解分割模型在新旧类别上的遗忘。相比已有分割持续学习方法，RECALL 在多个分割基准上取得了更优的 mIoU，尤其在旧类别保持方面提升明显。实验在 Pascal VOC、ADE20K 等数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in semantic segmentation, noting that existing methods are mostly designed for classification and do not transfer well to dense prediction. The authors propose RECALL, a replay-based framework that stores a small number of old-task samples and replays them during training, combined with knowledge distillation and class balancing to mitigate forgetting of old and new classes. RECALL achieves higher mIoU than prior segmentation continual learning methods, especially in preserving old classes. Experiments on Pascal VOC and ADE20K validate the approach.
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.assessment: 将回放机制系统性地引入语义分割持续学习，实验扎实，对自动驾驶感知中的增量学习具有参考价值。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.contribution: 提出 RECALL 框架，将基于回放的持续学习应用于语义分割任务。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.innovation: 结合回放、知识蒸馏与类别平衡策略，缓解分割模型在新旧类别上的遗忘。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.result: 在 Pascal VOC、ADE20K 等分割基准上取得优于已有方法的 mIoU，旧类别保持提升明显。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning._arxiv_id: RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning in Semantic Segmentation.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸呈现攻击检测（face presentation attack detection）中新型攻击方式不断出现的问题，提出一种能够检测并持续学习新型攻击的方法。作者设计了一个开放集检测框架，在识别已知攻击的同时检测未知攻击，并通过持续学习机制将新发现的攻击类型增量纳入模型，而无需重训练全部数据。相比已有仅针对已知攻击的检测方法，该方法在多个数据集上对未知攻击的检测率显著提升，并在增量学习新攻击时保持对旧攻击的识别能力。实验验证了方法在开放集与持续学习设定下的有效性。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_en: This paper addresses face presentation attack detection where novel attack types continually emerge, proposing a method that both detects and continually learns new attacks. The authors design an open-set detection framework that identifies known attacks while flagging unknown ones, and incrementally incorporates newly discovered attack types via continual learning without full retraining. Compared with methods targeting only known attacks, it substantially improves unknown-attack detection rates on multiple datasets while retaining performance on old attacks during incremental learning. Experiments validate the approach under open-set and continual learning settings.
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.assessment: 将开放集检测与持续学习结合用于人脸防伪，问题设定贴近实际，对安全相关的增量感知任务有借鉴意义。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.contribution: 提出面向人脸呈现攻击的开放集检测与持续学习框架，可检测并增量学习新型攻击。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.innovation: 将开放集检测与持续学习结合，在识别已知攻击的同时检测并增量纳入未知攻击类型。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.result: 在多个数据集上显著提升未知攻击检测率，并在增量学习新攻击时保持对旧攻击的识别能力。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove._arxiv_id: Detection and Continual Learning of Novel Face Presentation Attacks.

2203.11684|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在持续学习中直接应用CNN-based方法会导致严重性能退化的问题，本文提出MEAT（Meta-Attention），即对self-attention施加注意力掩码，仅掩码部分参数以适配新任务。与Piggyback等对所有参数加掩码的方法不同，MEAT利用ViT特性实现更高效和有效的持续学习。实验表明MEAT在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法，同时保持较低的计算开销。
2203.11684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of ViT-backed continual learning when CNN-based methods are directly applied. It proposes MEAT (Meta-Attention), which masks only a portion of ViT parameters via attention to self-attention, adapting pre-trained ViTs to new tasks without forgetting. Unlike Piggyback that masks all parameters, MEAT is more efficient and effective, achieving superior performance on continual learning benchmarks.
2203.11684|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究ViT-backed持续学习，提出的MEAT方法高效且有效，对视觉Transformer在持续学习中的应用有重要推动。
2203.11684|v2.contribution: 提出MEAT，一种基于元注意力的ViT持续学习方法，仅掩码部分参数。
2203.11684|v2.innovation: 利用ViT特性，仅对部分参数进行掩码，而非全部参数，提升效率和效果。
2203.11684|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法，同时保持较低计算开销。

2201.09381|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频持续学习研究不足、现有工作存在任务间类别分布不平衡或数据集不适用的问题，本文提出vCLIMB，一个标准化的视频类增量持续学习基准。vCLIMB在不相交任务上均匀分配类别，并评估现有CL方法，发现视频数据中帧级记忆选择和未修剪训练数据影响帧采样策略两个独特挑战。提出时序一致性正则化，在未修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。
2201.09381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces vCLIMB, a standardized video class incremental continual learning benchmark, addressing the lack of exploration in video CL and issues of imbalanced class distributions in prior work. It uniformly distributes classes across disjoint tasks and evaluates existing CL methods, revealing two unique challenges: frame-level memory selection and the impact of untrimmed training data on frame sampling. A temporal consistency regularization is proposed, improving the baseline by up to 24% on untrimmed continual learning.
2201.09381|v2.assessment: 填补了视频持续学习基准的空白，提出的时序一致性正则化有效，对视频理解与持续学习交叉领域有重要价值。
2201.09381|v2.contribution: 提出vCLIMB视频类增量持续学习基准，并设计时序一致性正则化方法。
2201.09381|v2.innovation: 首个标准化视频类增量持续学习基准，揭示视频数据中的独特挑战并提出解决方案。
2201.09381|v2.result: 在未修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。

2204.02136|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中直接微调导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD），专注于从分类头和回归头弹性学习响应。ERD通过弹性响应选择（ERS）策略评估所有位置的质量并提供有价值的响应，并阐明不同响应在增量蒸馏中应赋予不同重要性。在MS COCO上的实验表明，ERD显著优于现有方法，有效缓解遗忘。
2204.02136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by proposing Elastic Response Distillation (ERD), which focuses on elastically learning responses from classification and regression heads. ERD transfers category knowledge while retaining localization information, and introduces Elastic Response Selection (ERS) to evaluate location quality and provide valuable responses. Experiments on MS COCO demonstrate significant improvements over existing methods.
2204.02136|v2.assessment: 针对增量目标检测中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出的ERD方法有效利用响应信息，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习有直接应用价值。
2204.02136|v2.contribution: 提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD）方法，用于增量目标检测。
2204.02136|v2.innovation: 弹性学习分类和回归头的响应，并通过ERS策略选择高质量响应。
2204.02136|v2.result: 在MS COCO上显著优于现有方法，有效缓解遗忘。

2112.08654|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出L2P（Learning to Prompt），一种新的持续学习范式，无需测试时任务身份即可训练更简洁的记忆系统。L2P学习动态提示预训练模型，提示为小可学习参数，维护在记忆空间中，优化以指导模型预测并管理任务不变和任务特定知识。在多个图像分类基准上，L2P持续优于先前最先进方法，甚至无需回放缓冲区即可与基于回放的方法竞争。
2112.08654|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes L2P (Learning to Prompt), a new paradigm for continual learning that trains a succinct memory system without accessing task identity at test time. L2P learns to dynamically prompt a pre-trained model, with prompts as small learnable parameters maintained in a memory space, optimizing to instruct model predictions and manage task-invariant and task-specific knowledge. L2P consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on image classification benchmarks, even without a rehearsal buffer.
2112.08654|v2.assessment: 提出了一种新颖的基于提示的持续学习范式，无需任务身份和回放缓冲区，性能优越，对持续学习领域有重要影响。
2112.08654|v2.contribution: 提出L2P，一种基于动态提示的持续学习新范式。
2112.08654|v2.innovation: 利用可学习提示指导预训练模型，无需测试时任务身份和回放缓冲区。
2112.08654|v2.result: 在多个图像分类基准上持续优于先前最先进方法，甚至与基于回放的方法竞争。

2203.15355|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中数据流标签模糊且含有噪声的问题，本文提出一种统一策略，通过标签噪声感知的多样性采样和半监督学习的鲁棒学习来管理记忆，平衡多样性和纯度。在CIFAR10、CIFAR100、mini-WebVision和Food-101N四个数据集上，该方法显著优于先前方法。
2203.15355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning from blurry data streams with corrupted labels, where existing methods struggle. It proposes a unified strategy that manages memory via label noise aware diverse sampling and robust learning with semi-supervised learning, balancing diversity and purity. Empirical validations on four datasets show significant outperformance over prior arts.
2203.15355|v2.assessment: 针对现实世界中标签噪声和模糊任务边界的在线持续学习问题，提出的方法有效且实用，对实际部署有重要意义。
2203.15355|v2.contribution: 提出一种统一策略，结合多样性采样和半监督学习，处理噪声数据流中的在线持续学习。
2203.15355|v2.innovation: 同时考虑样本多样性和纯度，利用半监督学习增强鲁棒性。
2203.15355|v2.result: 在四个数据集上显著优于先前方法。

2111.11326|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，现有动态扩展方法需测试时任务标识、参数调优复杂且任务间信息共享不足。本文提出DyTox，基于共享编码器/解码器的Transformer框架，通过动态扩展特殊token使解码器前向适配各任务分布，无需超参控制扩展。在CIFAR100和ImageNet上取得优异结果，可扩展至大量任务且内存与时间开销可忽略。
2111.11326|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, where existing dynamic expansion methods require task identifiers at test time and complex tuning. It proposes DyTox, a transformer with a shared encoder/decoder that dynamically expands special tokens to specialize each decoder forward pass per task. The method scales to many tasks with negligible overhead and achieves excellent results on CIFAR100 and state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet.
2111.11326|v2.assessment: 将动态token扩展引入Transformer持续学习，设计简洁且扩展性强，对持续学习方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2111.11326|v2.contribution: 提出基于共享编码器/解码器和动态token扩展的Transformer持续学习框架DyTox。
2111.11326|v2.innovation: 通过动态扩展特殊token实现任务特化解码，无需任务标识和超参调优即可扩展至大量任务。
2111.11326|v2.result: 在CIFAR100和ImageNet上取得优异及当时最优性能，内存与时间开销可忽略。
