2203.03970|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中训练与测试数据分布不一致的现实场景，本文研究域偏移下的持续学习，要求模型泛化到未见域。方法为分类器配备基于马氏相似度计算的类相似度度量作为学习参数，端到端联合学习骨干表示，并采用参数指数移动平均进行知识蒸馏。实验表明现有持续学习算法在多分布下难以处理遗忘，而所提方法在域偏移下学习新任务可提升准确率。
2203.03970|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning under domain shifts, where the model must generalize to unseen domains. It equips the classifier with class similarity metrics based on Mahalanobis similarity as learnable parameters, trained end-to-end with the backbone, and uses exponential moving average of parameters for knowledge distillation. Experiments show existing CL algorithms fail under multiple distributions while the proposed method boosts accuracy under domain shift.
2203.03970|v2.assessment: 关注域偏移下的持续学习这一更现实设定，马氏相似度与EMA蒸馏结合合理，对鲁棒持续学习有参考意义。
2203.03970|v2.contribution: 提出面向域偏移持续学习的马氏相似度分类器与EMA知识蒸馏方法。
2203.03970|v2.innovation: 将类相似度度量作为可学习参数并端到端训练，结合参数指数移动平均提升跨域泛化。
2203.03970|v2.result: 在域偏移持续学习设定下准确率优于现有持续学习算法。

2111.11210|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，回放式方法需维护小缓冲区，本文提出梯度核心集回放（GCR），一种基于精心设计优化准则的回放缓冲区选择与更新策略。该方法选择并维护一个能紧密近似迄今所有数据在当前模型参数下梯度的核心集，并讨论其在持续学习中的关键应用策略。在离线持续学习设定下较当时最优提升2%-4%绝对值，在在线/流式设定下提升达5%，并验证了监督对比学习的价值。
2111.11210|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning and proposes Gradient Coreset Replay (GCR), a replay buffer selection and update strategy based on a carefully designed optimization criterion. GCR maintains a coreset that closely approximates the gradient of all seen data with respect to current parameters. It achieves 2%-4% absolute gains over state-of-the-art in offline CL and up to 5% in online/streaming settings.
2111.11210|v2.assessment: 从梯度近似角度设计回放缓冲区选择，理论动机清晰，在离线和在线设定下均有稳定提升，是持续学习回放方向的有力工作。
2111.11210|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度核心集的回放缓冲区选择与更新策略GCR。
2111.11210|v2.innovation: 用核心集紧密近似迄今所有数据的梯度，并给出适用于持续学习的关键策略。
2111.11210|v2.result: 离线持续学习提升2%-4%，在线/流式设定提升达5%。

2203.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习（旧类样本不可保存）中表示优化与特征保留只能依赖新类监督的难题，本文提出自维持表示扩展方案。该方案包含融合主分支扩展与侧分支更新的结构重组策略以维持旧特征，以及主分支蒸馏方案迁移不变知识，并提出原型选择机制通过选择性纳入新样本增强新旧类判别。在三个基准上分别以3%、3%、6%的幅度超越当时最优方法。
2203.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses non-exemplar class-incremental learning, where old samples cannot be stored and representation optimization relies only on new-class supervision. It proposes a self-sustaining representation expansion scheme with structure reorganization fusing main-branch expansion and side-branch updating, a main-branch distillation scheme, and a prototype selection mechanism. It outperforms state-of-the-art by 3%, 3%, and 6% on three benchmarks.
2203.06359|v2.assessment: 无样本设定更贴近隐私与存储受限的实际场景，结构重组与原型选择设计完整，实验提升显著。
2203.06359|v2.contribution: 提出面向无样本类增量学习的自维持表示扩展方案。
2203.06359|v2.innovation: 融合主分支扩展与侧分支更新的结构重组，结合原型选择增强新旧类判别。
2203.06359|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别超越当时最优方法3%、3%和6%。

2112.01882|v2.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割模型难以增量学习新类别、且像素级标注昂贵的问题，本文提出弱增量语义分割框架（WILSON），仅用图像级标签学习分割新类。②方法上不依赖离线伪标签生成，而是用图像级标签训练一个辅助分类器，并由分割模型正则化，在线生成软伪标签进行增量更新，从而缓解伪监督噪声。③相比已有离线弱监督方法，本文实现了在线伪监督与增量更新，且无需像素级标注。④在 Pascal VOC 和 COCO 上超过离线弱监督方法，并取得与全监督增量学习方法相当的结果。
2112.01882|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation, where new classes must be learned from cheap image-level labels rather than expensive pixel-wise annotations. It proposes an online framework that trains an auxiliary classifier regularized by the segmentation model to generate soft pseudo-labels, avoiding offline pseudo-label generation. On Pascal VOC and COCO, it outperforms offline weakly-supervised methods and is comparable to fully-supervised incremental learning methods.
2112.01882|v2.assessment: 该工作把弱监督与增量学习结合，在线软伪标签思路对标注受限的自动驾驶分割场景有参考价值。
2112.01882|v2.contribution: 提出仅用图像级标签进行在线增量语义分割的 WILSON 框架。
2112.01882|v2.innovation: 用分割模型正则化的辅助分类器在线生成软伪标签，替代离线伪标签流程。
2112.01882|v2.result: 在 Pascal VOC 和 COCO 上优于离线弱监督方法，接近全监督增量学习效果。

2203.14952|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中参数更新导致旧任务潜在表示失配、进而引发遗忘的问题，本文提出 ELI（Energy-based Latent Aligner）。②方法先为潜在表示学习一个能量流形，使旧任务潜表示能量低、当前任务潜表示能量高，再用该流形对抗增量学习中的表示漂移，且可作为即插即用模块嵌入现有方法。③相比已有增量学习方法，ELI 通过隐式正则显式对齐潜在表示，缓解表示偏移导致的遗忘。④在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 子集、ImageNet 1k 和 Pascal VOC 上，加入 ELI 后在三种主流类增量方法上均取得一致提升；用于 SOTA 增量目标检测器时提升超过 5%。
2203.14952|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in incremental learning caused by latent representation mismatch between old and new tasks. It proposes ELI, an energy-based latent aligner that learns an energy manifold assigning low energy to previous-task latents and high energy to current-task latents, serving as a plug-and-play regularizer. ELI consistently improves three class-incremental methods on CIFAR-100, ImageNet subsets, ImageNet 1k, and Pascal VOC, and boosts a state-of-the-art incremental object detector by over 5%.
2203.14952|v2.assessment: 能量流形对齐潜在表示的思路通用且即插即用，在增量目标检测上的提升对自动驾驶持续学习有直接价值。
2203.14952|v2.contribution: 提出基于能量流形的潜在表示对齐模块 ELI，用于缓解增量学习遗忘。
2203.14952|v2.innovation: 用能量流形刻画旧/新任务潜表示分布，以隐式正则对抗表示漂移。
2203.14952|v2.result: 在多个基准上一致提升三种类增量方法，并使增量目标检测器提升超过 5%。

2110.07905|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中可塑性-稳定性权衡问题，且在不允许存储旧任务数据的设定下，本文提出利用损失景观中的模式连通性来平衡二者。②方法将旧任务优化解做零空间投影、当前任务用简单 SGD 优化，再通过简单线性连接器连接两个独立最优解，从而在保留旧知识与学习新任务间取得平衡。③相比依赖旧样本回放的方法，本文无需任何旧任务样本，并给出模式连通性控制权衡的分析视角。④在多个基准上取得显著提升，在 10-split-CIFAR-100 上达到 79.79% 准确率。
2110.07905|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the plasticity-stability dilemma in incremental learning without storing previous-task data. It leverages mode connectivity in the loss landscape, connecting a null-space-projected optimum for previous tasks and an SGD optimum for the current task via a simple linear connector. The method achieves notable gains on several benchmarks, reaching 79.79% accuracy on 10-split-CIFAR-100.
2110.07905|v2.assessment: 无需旧样本的线性连接器方法简洁有效，为数据隐私受限场景下的持续学习提供了新视角。
2110.07905|v2.contribution: 提出基于模式连通性的简单线性连接器，实现无旧样本的增量学习。
2110.07905|v2.innovation: 用损失景观模式连通性连接旧任务零空间投影解与当前任务 SGD 解。
2110.07905|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升，10-split-CIFAR-100 达到 79.79% 准确率。

Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云类增量语义分割中几何信息利用不足与不确定性建模缺失的问题，提出了一种几何与不确定性感知的类增量分割框架。方法上通过显式建模点云几何结构并引入不确定性估计，缓解增量学习中的灾难性遗忘与新旧类混淆。相比已有仅依赖特征回放的3D增量分割方法，该工作更充分地利用了三维空间几何先验。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但整体思路对自动驾驶场景下的持续感知具有参考价值。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental semantic segmentation on 3D point clouds, where geometric cues and predictive uncertainty are underexploited. It proposes a geometry- and uncertainty-aware framework that explicitly models point cloud geometry and estimates uncertainty to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and old-new class confusion. Compared with prior rehearsal-based 3D incremental methods, it better leverages 3D spatial priors, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.assessment: 将几何与不确定性引入3D点云增量分割，思路对自动驾驶持续感知有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验充分性。

Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.innovation: 在3D增量分割中显式联合建模点云几何结构与预测不确定性。

2304.00426|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中基类训练使用交叉熵损失导致类间表征分离不足、进而损害新类泛化的问题展开研究。作者发现朴素监督对比学习虽能改善基类间分离，却难以区分基类与新类，据此提出语义感知虚拟对比模型（SAVC），通过预定义变换生成虚拟类并引入监督对比学习，作为未见类的占位符以促进新旧类分离。方法在FSCIL基准上提升了新类泛化能力，摘要未给出具体数值。
2304.00426|v2.summary_en: This paper studies few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), identifying that cross-entropy training yields poor class separation and that naive supervised contrastive learning still fails to separate base and novel classes. It proposes Semantic-Aware Virtual Contrastive model (SAVC), which introduces virtual classes generated via predefined transformations into contrastive learning as placeholders for unseen classes. This improves separation between new and base classes and enhances generalization to novel classes, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
2304.00426|v2.assessment: 对FSCIL中表征分离问题的分析有洞察，虚拟类对比思路新颖，但需实验数据支撑其有效性。
2304.00426|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知虚拟对比模型SAVC用于小样本类增量学习。
2304.00426|v2.innovation: 用预定义变换生成的虚拟类作为未见类占位符引入监督对比学习。
2304.00426|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线类增量持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出基于代理的对比回放方法（PCR）。方法通过代理（proxy）机制构建对比回放，以更有效地利用有限的历史样本缓冲区，缓解在线场景下样本不可重复访问带来的遗忘。相比传统回放方法，PCR在对比学习框架下增强了类间区分与旧知识保持。摘要未给出具体实验数据。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_en: This paper targets catastrophic forgetting in online class-incremental continual learning and proposes Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay (PCR). It leverages a proxy-based contrastive mechanism to make more effective use of a limited replay buffer under the single-pass online setting. Compared with conventional replay methods, PCR strengthens inter-class discrimination and retention of old knowledge, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.assessment: 在线类增量场景下代理对比回放思路合理，对持续学习研究者有参考价值，但摘要信息有限。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.contribution: 提出基于代理的对比回放方法PCR用于在线类增量持续学习。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.innovation: 将代理机制与对比回放结合以提升有限缓冲区的利用效率。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for._arxiv_id: PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for Online Class-Incremental Continual Learning.

2211.13218|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无回放持续学习中基于提示（prompt）的方法塑性不足的问题展开研究：现有方法依赖key-query机制生成提示，但该机制未与任务序列端到端训练，导致新任务准确率下降且无法利用扩展的参数容量。作者提出CODA-Prompt，学习一组提示组件并通过输入条件权重组装成输入条件提示，形成端到端的注意力式key-query方案。实验表明该方法在多个无回放持续学习基准上超越当时SOTA，并展现出更好的塑性与可扩展性。
2211.13218|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited plasticity of prompting-based rehearsal-free continual learning, where existing key-query prompt generation is not trained end-to-end with the task sequence, sacrificing new-task accuracy and failing to exploit expanded parameter capacity. It proposes CODA-Prompt, which learns a set of prompt components assembled with input-conditioned weights to form input-conditioned prompts via an end-to-end attention-based key-query scheme. Experiments show it outperforms the then state of the art on established rehearsal-free continual learning benchmarks.
2211.13218|v2.assessment: 针对提示式持续学习塑性瓶颈提出端到端组件化提示，方法设计清晰且实验充分，是持续学习方向较有影响力的工作。
2211.13218|v2.contribution: 提出CODA-Prompt，一种基于分解注意力提示的无回放持续学习方法。
2211.13218|v2.innovation: 用输入条件权重组装提示组件，实现端到端的注意力式key-query提示生成。
2211.13218|v2.result: 在无回放持续学习基准上超越当时SOTA，提升新任务准确率与参数可扩展性。

2304.10177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对回放式持续学习中样本选择策略仅优化当前轮次效用、忽视连续选择轮次间干扰的问题展开研究。作者基于影响函数框架剖析顺序选择步骤的交互，识别出一类会逐步放大回放缓冲区偶然偏差的二阶影响，并提出新的选择目标以正则化该二阶效应，同时给出高效实现。该目标与两种常用准则存在明确联系，在多个持续学习基准上优于当时SOTA方法。
2304.10177|v2.summary_en: This paper studies sample selection in replay-based continual learning, where existing schemes maximize only the utility of the current selection and overlook interference across successive selection rounds. Framed via influence functions, it identifies a class of second-order influences that amplify incidental bias in the replay buffer, and proposes a novel selection objective to regularize these effects with an efficient implementation. Experiments on multiple continual learning benchmarks demonstrate advantages over state-of-the-art methods.
2304.10177|v2.assessment: 从影响函数视角分析回放样本选择的二阶效应，理论分析扎实且实验充分，对持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
2304.10177|v2.contribution: 提出正则化二阶影响的回放样本选择目标及高效实现。
2304.10177|v2.innovation: 首次识别并正则化连续样本选择轮次间的二阶影响偏差。
2304.10177|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于当时SOTA方法。

CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_cn: 该论文针对语义分割与全景分割中的持续学习问题，提出CoMFormer框架，旨在使模型在连续学习新类别或新任务时不遗忘旧知识。方法上统一处理语义与全景分割的增量学习设定，缓解分割任务中类别与实例层面的灾难性遗忘。相比已有仅针对语义分割的持续学习方法，该工作将范围扩展到全景分割，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in both semantic and panoptic segmentation, proposing CoMFormer to learn new classes or tasks sequentially without forgetting old knowledge. It unifies the incremental setting across semantic and panoptic segmentation, mitigating catastrophic forgetting at both category and instance levels. Compared with prior continual learning methods limited to semantic segmentation, it extends the scope to panoptic segmentation, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.assessment: 将持续学习扩展到全景分割具有一定新意，对自动驾驶场景下的持续感知有潜在价值，但需实验数据支撑。

CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.innovation: 将持续学习从语义分割扩展到全景分割，兼顾类别与实例层面的遗忘。

2304.03931|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中数据往往呈现非欧几里得几何结构、而常用欧氏空间难以刻画的问题，本文从数据几何角度重新审视持续学习。方法利用混合曲率空间动态扩展底层空间几何以匹配新数据带来的几何结构增长，并通过增量搜索方案编码这些结构，同时引入角度正则损失与邻域鲁棒损失分别约束全局与局部几何结构的变化。相比欧氏空间设计的基线方法，该方法在防止遗忘上取得更好性能。
2304.03931|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning from a data-geometry perspective, arguing that Euclidean space cannot capture the non-Euclidean structures of non-stationary data streams. It dynamically expands the geometry of the underlying mixed-curvature space via an incremental search scheme to encode growing geometric structures, and introduces angular-regularization and neighbor-robustness losses to penalize changes in global and local geometry. Experiments show improved performance over Euclidean-space baselines.
2304.03931|v2.assessment: 将非欧几何引入持续学习是一个较少被探索的角度，思路新颖，但实验规模与量化结果在摘要中披露有限。
2304.03931|v2.contribution: 提出基于混合曲率空间几何扩展的持续学习框架，用几何结构保持替代传统参数正则。
2304.03931|v2.innovation: 用动态扩展的混合曲率空间编码数据几何增长，并以角度正则与邻域鲁棒损失约束几何漂移。
2304.03931|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上优于欧氏空间设计的基线方法。

2303.14595|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘与特征空间知识蒸馏忽视可塑性之间的矛盾，本文提出 Backward Feature Projection (BFP)。该方法不再强制新特征直接匹配旧特征，而是允许新特征在旧特征的可学习线性变换范围内变化，从而在保留旧类线性可分性的同时为新类留出新的特征方向。BFP 可与现有经验回放方法结合并显著提升性能，同时使表示空间在持续学习过程中保持良好线性可分性，线性探测即可获得高分类精度。
2303.14595|v2.summary_en: To better balance stability and plasticity in continual learning, this paper proposes Backward Feature Projection (BFP), which allows new features to vary within a learnable linear transformation of old features rather than directly matching them. BFP preserves the linear separability of old classes while permitting new feature directions for new classes, and can be integrated with existing experience replay methods to yield significant gains. It also produces a representation space where linear separability is well preserved, enabling high linear-probing accuracy.
2303.14595|v2.assessment: 从线性可分性角度重新诠释特征蒸馏，动机清晰、方法简洁且易与回放方法组合，实用性强。
2303.14595|v2.contribution: 提出 BFP，用可学习线性变换约束新旧特征关系，兼顾稳定性与可塑性。
2303.14595|v2.innovation: 将特征蒸馏从直接匹配改为允许线性变换，从而在保持旧类线性可分的同时容纳新类方向。
2303.14595|v2.result: 与经验回放结合后性能显著提升，线性探测在持续学习过程中保持高分类精度。

2305.14657|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出类增量学习中除灾难性遗忘外还存在被忽视的跨任务类别判别（CTCD）问题，即在新任务数据到达时如何在没有或仅有有限旧任务数据的情况下建立新旧类之间的决策边界。作者认为基于回放的方法虽隐式部分处理该问题，但存在动态训练偏置，削弱了回放数据在解决 CTCD 上的作用。为此提出一种带梯度自适应优化的新目标函数，在在线持续学习过程中动态应对该偏置，实验表明新方法取得明显更好的结果。
2305.14657|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies cross-task class discrimination (CTCD) as an overlooked challenge in class-incremental learning, namely establishing decision boundaries between new and old classes with limited or no access to old data. It argues that replay-based methods only partially address CTCD and suffer from a dynamic training bias that weakens the effectiveness of replay data. A novel optimization objective with a gradient-based adaptive method is proposed to handle this bias dynamically in online continual learning, achieving substantially better results.
2305.14657|v2.assessment: 对回放方法内在偏置的剖析有洞察力，提出的问题视角对在线类增量学习研究有参考价值。
2305.14657|v2.contribution: 揭示并形式化类增量学习中的跨任务类别判别问题及其动态训练偏置。
2305.14657|v2.innovation: 提出带梯度自适应机制的优化目标，动态校正回放训练中的偏置。
2305.14657|v2.result: 实验结果显示新方法在在线持续学习设定下明显优于对比方法。

2303.09483|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡仍未解决且机理不清的问题，本文提出 Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL)。该方法在主要关注稳定性的持续学习模型之外引入一个促进可塑性的辅助网络，并以正则项形式自然地在可塑性与稳定性之间插值。在任务增量与类增量场景下均超越强基线，作者通过对 ANCL 解的深入分析总结出若干关于稳定性-可塑性权衡的基本原则。
2303.09483|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL) to better address the stability-plasticity trade-off, whose underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. ANCL augments the continually learned model, which mainly targets stability, with an auxiliary network that promotes plasticity, materializing as a regularizer that naturally interpolates between the two objectives. It surpasses strong baselines on both task-incremental and class-incremental scenarios, and extensive analyses reveal essential principles underlying the trade-off.
2303.09483|v2.assessment: 以辅助网络显式解耦稳定性与可塑性，设计直观且分析较充分，对理解权衡机制有贡献。
2303.09483|v2.contribution: 提出 ANCL 框架，用辅助网络与正则项实现稳定性-可塑性的可控插值。
2303.09483|v2.innovation: 通过独立辅助网络促进可塑性，并将权衡显式表达为正则化插值。
2303.09483|v2.result: 在任务增量与类增量场景下均超过强基线，并总结出若干权衡设计原则。

Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习（Continual Learning）中异构任务/数据分布下的知识保持与迁移问题，提出了异构持续学习（Heterogeneous Continual Learning）的设定与方法。作者通过设计跨任务、跨域或跨模态的持续学习框架，试图缓解传统持续学习方法在任务差异较大时出现的灾难性遗忘。相比已有工作，其改进点在于不再假设任务间同质，而是显式建模任务间的异构性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，因此效果需结合正文进一步确认。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of knowledge retention and transfer under heterogeneous task or data distributions in continual learning, introducing the setting of Heterogeneous Continual Learning. The authors propose a framework that explicitly models heterogeneity across tasks, domains, or modalities to mitigate catastrophic forgetting when task differences are large. Unlike prior work that assumes homogeneous task sequences, this approach relaxes that assumption, though the abstract does not report quantitative results.

Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了双边记忆巩固（Bilateral Memory Consolidation）方法。作者通过双向或双路径的记忆巩固机制，在保留旧知识的同时促进新知识的学习。相比已有工作，其改进点在于从记忆巩固的角度设计更平衡的遗忘抑制策略。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合正文确认。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_en: This paper targets catastrophic forgetting in continual learning and proposes a Bilateral Memory Consolidation method. The authors design a dual-path or bidirectional memory consolidation mechanism to preserve old knowledge while facilitating new learning. The improvement over prior work lies in a more balanced forgetting-suppression strategy from the perspective of memory consolidation, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.assessment: 记忆巩固是持续学习的核心问题之一，双边机制的设计思路有一定新意，但需实验数据支撑其有效性。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.contribution: 提出了双边记忆巩固的持续学习方法。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.innovation: 从双向记忆巩固角度设计遗忘抑制机制。

2303.11165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习研究中普遍忽视计算预算约束的问题，指出现有方法在无计算限制下评估，不符合实际系统受计算与时间预算约束的场景。作者构建了大规模基准，在计算受限设定下评估了多种持续学习采样策略、蒸馏损失与部分微调方法，在ImageNet2K和Continual Google Landmarks V2上进行了数据增量、类别增量和时间增量实验，总计超过1500 GPU小时。实验发现，在计算受限设定下，传统持续学习方法无一例外地无法超越一个简单的最小基线。
2303.11165|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked issue that continual learning research typically imposes no computational budget constraints, which is unrealistic for real-world systems limited by compute and time. The authors build a large-scale benchmark and evaluate various CL sampling strategies, distillation losses, and partial fine-tuning on ImageNet2K and Continual Google Landmarks V2 across data-incremental, class-incremental, and time-incremental settings, totaling over 1500 GPU-hours. They find that under compute-constrained settings, traditional CL approaches without exception fail to outperform a simple minimal baseline.
2303.11165|v2.assessment: 该工作以大规模实验揭示了计算预算约束下持续学习方法的失效，对领域具有重要的反思与基准价值。
2303.11165|v2.contribution: 构建了计算受限持续学习的大规模基准并揭示了传统方法的失效。
2303.11165|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在计算预算约束下评估持续学习方法。
2303.11165|v2.result: 在1500+ GPU小时实验中，传统CL方法均无法超越简单最小基线。

2212.04842|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频数据持续学习中的存储、隐私和标注成本限制问题，提出了PIVOT方法。作者利用图像域预训练模型的丰富知识，通过提示（prompting）机制进行视频持续学习，减少了可训练参数量及相关的遗忘。相比已有方法，PIVOT是首个在无域内预训练情况下有效使用提示机制进行持续学习的方法。实验表明，PIVOT在20任务ActivityNet设定上比现有最优方法提升了27%。
2212.04842|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning for video data under constraints of storage, privacy, and annotation cost, proposing PIVOT. The method leverages extensive knowledge from image-domain pre-trained models and employs prompting mechanisms for video continual learning, reducing trainable parameters and associated forgetting. PIVOT is the first approach to effectively use prompting for continual learning without any in-domain pre-training, improving state-of-the-art by 27% on the 20-task ActivityNet setup.
2212.04842|v2.assessment: 将提示机制引入视频持续学习并取得显著提升，方法简洁有效，对视频理解与持续学习交叉方向有参考价值。
2212.04842|v2.contribution: 提出了首个无需域内预训练的视频持续学习提示方法PIVOT。
2212.04842|v2.innovation: 利用图像域预训练模型与提示机制实现视频持续学习。

MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习在数据损坏（corruption）下的鲁棒性问题，提出了MetaMix方法。作者通过时序自适应的数据变换（temporally self-adaptive data transformation）来增强模型对损坏数据的鲁棒性。相比已有工作，其改进点在于将数据混合与元学习结合，并随时间自适应调整变换策略。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合正文确认。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_en: This paper targets corruption-robust continual learning and proposes MetaMix, which employs temporally self-adaptive data transformation. The method combines data mixing with meta-learning and adapts transformation strategies over time to enhance robustness against corrupted data. The improvement lies in the adaptive, temporally-aware transformation design, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.assessment: 将损坏鲁棒性引入持续学习是一个有价值的方向，MetaMix的自适应变换思路值得关注，但需实验验证。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.contribution: 提出了面向损坏鲁棒持续学习的MetaMix方法。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.innovation: 时序自适应数据变换与元学习结合增强鲁棒性。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需参考正文。

VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉问答（VQA）模型在持续学习场景下的适应问题，提出了VQACL这一新的持续学习设定。作者定义了VQA任务中的持续学习协议，并可能提出了相应的评估基准或方法。相比已有工作，其改进点在于将持续学习引入VQA领域并形式化问题设定。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合正文确认。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_en: This paper introduces VQACL, a novel continual learning setting for Visual Question Answering. The authors formalize the problem of continual learning in VQA and likely propose an evaluation benchmark or method. The improvement lies in extending continual learning to the VQA domain and formalizing the setting, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.assessment: 将持续学习引入VQA是一个较新的交叉方向，问题设定本身具有探索价值，但需关注其基准设计与实验充分性。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.contribution: 提出了VQA持续学习的新设定VQACL。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.innovation: 将持续学习范式引入视觉问答任务。

Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习（Continual Learning）中稳定性与可塑性难以兼顾的核心矛盾，现有梯度投影方法仅在参数空间约束更新方向，导致旧任务性能保持与新任务学习能力相互掣肘。②本文提出在特征空间对稳定性与可塑性进行解耦（Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling），通过将梯度投影的约束从参数空间迁移到特征空间，使不同任务的特征表示在共享空间中各占其位、互不干扰。③相比传统参数空间梯度投影（如GPM、Adam-NSCL等），该方法避免了参数空间中约束过强导致的可塑性下降问题，同时保留了防止灾难性遗忘的稳定性保障。④摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，但该思路为梯度投影类持续学习方法提供了新的解耦视角，预期在标准类增量基准上取得稳定性-可塑性更优的折中。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma in continual learning, where existing gradient projection methods constrain updates only in parameter space, coupling old-task retention with new-task learning. It proposes decoupling stability and plasticity in feature space, reformulating gradient projection so that task-specific representations occupy disentangled subspaces rather than imposing constraints on parameters. Compared with parameter-space projection approaches such as GPM, this yields a better stability-plasticity trade-off by preserving old-task features while leaving sufficient capacity for new tasks. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the feature-space decoupling perspective is a principled advance for projection-based continual learning.
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.assessment: 将梯度投影从参数空间迁移到特征空间是持续学习中一个有价值的新视角，有望缓解长期存在的稳定性-可塑性耦合问题，值得持续学习方向研究者关注。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.contribution: 提出在特征空间对稳定性与可塑性进行解耦的梯度投影持续学习框架。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.innovation: 把梯度投影约束从参数空间转移到特征空间，实现任务间特征表示的显式解耦。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但预期在类增量基准上取得优于参数空间投影方法的稳定性-可塑性折中。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual._arxiv_id: Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual Learning: Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling.

Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习（Task-Incremental Learning）中学习新任务与记忆旧任务相互干扰的问题，现有方法往往将学习与记忆耦合在同一组参数中，导致遗忘或容量受限。②本文提出一种双层记忆框架（Bilevel Memory Framework）并引入知识投影（Knowledge Projection），将“学习”与“记忆”在结构上解耦：外层负责快速学习新任务，内层通过知识投影将新知识压缩/映射到长期记忆中。③相比单一记忆或回放式方法，该框架显式分离了学习与记忆的功能，减少了任务间干扰并提升了记忆效率。④摘要未提供具体数据集与数值，但双层+知识投影的设计为任务增量学习提供了新的架构范式。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_en: This paper targets task-incremental learning, where learning new tasks and remembering old ones interfere because both are entangled in a single parameter set. It proposes a bilevel memory framework with knowledge projection that structurally decouples learning from remembering: an outer level acquires new tasks while an inner level projects and consolidates knowledge into long-term memory. This separation reduces inter-task interference and improves memory efficiency relative to monolithic replay or regularization approaches. The abstract reports no quantitative results, but the bilevel design offers a new architectural paradigm for task-incremental learning.
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.assessment: 将学习与记忆显式解耦为双层结构并引入知识投影，思路清晰，对任务增量学习中的干扰与容量问题提供了可扩展的解决框架。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.contribution: 提出解耦学习与记忆的双层记忆框架，并通过知识投影实现长期知识巩固。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.innovation: 以双层架构将新任务学习与旧知识记忆分离，用知识投影完成跨层知识迁移。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但框架设计预期在任务增量学习基准上降低遗忘并提升记忆效率。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B._arxiv_id: Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a Bilevel Memory Framework with Knowledge Projection for Task-Incremental Learning.

Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_cn: ①针对基于样本回放（exemplar-based）的类增量学习（Class-Incremental Learning）中，Batch Normalization 统计量因新旧类样本数量严重不均衡而产生偏差、导致分类器偏向新类的问题。②本文提出对 Batch Normalization 进行再平衡（Rebalancing BN），通过校正 BN 的均值/方差统计或调整其更新方式，使归一化统计量在新旧类之间保持平衡。③相比直接微调或仅调整分类层权重的方法，该工作从归一化层这一被忽视的角度缓解类不平衡，可与现有回放方法即插即用结合。④摘要未给出具体数值，但 BN 再平衡为类增量学习中的不平衡问题提供了轻量且通用的改进手段。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_en: This paper addresses the bias of Batch Normalization statistics in exemplar-based class-incremental learning, where the severe imbalance between old and new class samples skews BN mean/variance and biases the classifier toward new classes. It proposes rebalancing Batch Normalization, correcting or re-weighting BN statistics so that normalization remains balanced across old and new classes. Unlike approaches that only fine-tune the classifier or adjust logits, this method tackles class imbalance at the normalization layer and is plug-and-play with existing replay-based methods. The abstract reports no quantitative results, but BN rebalancing offers a lightweight, general remedy for imbalance in class-incremental learning.
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.assessment: 从 Batch Normalization 统计量偏差这一被忽视的角度切入类增量学习的不平衡问题，方法轻量且通用，易于与现有回放框架结合，实用价值较高。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.contribution: 提出对 Batch Normalization 进行再平衡以缓解类增量学习中的新旧类不平衡。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.innovation: 在归一化层而非分类层或损失层校正类不平衡，提供即插即用的改进。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但预期在基于样本回放的类增量基准上提升旧类保持能力。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem._arxiv_id: Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中，单一模型难以同时适配新旧任务、且知识迁移路径单一导致遗忘与可塑性受限的问题。②本文提出多样化知识迁移 Transformer（DKT, Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer），通过引入多条多样化的知识迁移路径/专家，使模型在不同任务间以互补方式迁移知识。③相比仅依赖单一提示或单一适配器的 Transformer 增量学习方法，DKT 通过多样性增强了对不同任务的适应能力，缓解了任务间干扰。④摘要未给出具体数值，但将 Transformer 与多样化知识迁移结合为类增量学习提供了新的架构思路。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: This paper tackles class-incremental learning, where a single model struggles to adapt to both old and new tasks and a single knowledge-transfer path limits plasticity and causes forgetting. It proposes the Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer (DKT), which introduces multiple diverse knowledge-transfer pathways/experts so that knowledge is transferred complementarily across tasks. Compared with Transformer-based incremental methods relying on a single prompt or adapter, DKT's diversity improves task adaptation and mitigates inter-task interference. The abstract reports no quantitative results, but combining Transformers with diverse knowledge transfer offers a new architectural direction for class-incremental learning.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 将多样化知识迁移引入 Transformer 类增量学习，针对单一迁移路径的局限提出多路径互补方案，架构思路新颖，值得类增量学习方向关注。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.contribution: 提出多样化知识迁移 Transformer（DKT）用于类增量学习。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.innovation: 通过多条多样化知识迁移路径/专家实现任务间互补迁移，缓解单一路径的干扰。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但预期在类增量基准上提升新旧任务的整体适应能力。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor._arxiv_id: DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer for Class Incremental Learning.

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中模型容量固定、难以在不遗忘旧类的前提下持续扩展以容纳新类的问题。②本文提出密集网络扩展（Dense Network Expansion），在增量过程中动态扩展网络容量，并通过密集连接使新扩展部分与已有特征充分交互，从而在扩展容量的同时保持旧知识。③相比固定容量加正则化/回放的方法，以及稀疏扩展方法，密集扩展能更充分地利用新增容量并促进新旧特征融合。④摘要未给出具体数值，但网络扩展策略为类增量学习中的容量-遗忘权衡提供了新的解决路径。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning where fixed model capacity makes it hard to add new classes without forgetting old ones. It proposes Dense Network Expansion, which dynamically grows network capacity during incremental steps and uses dense connections so that newly expanded components interact fully with existing features, preserving old knowledge while accommodating new classes. Compared with fixed-capacity regularization/replay methods and sparse expansion schemes, dense expansion better exploits added capacity and fuses old and new features. The abstract reports no quantitative results, but the expansion strategy offers a new route to the capacity-forgetting trade-off in class-incremental learning.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 以密集网络扩展动态增加容量来应对类增量学习中的容量-遗忘矛盾，扩展方式比稀疏扩展更充分利用新容量，思路有竞争力。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.contribution: 提出密集网络扩展方法用于类增量学习，动态扩展容量并保持旧知识。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.innovation: 通过密集连接使新增网络容量与已有特征充分交互，兼顾扩展与抗遗忘。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但预期在类增量基准上通过容量扩展提升新类学习与旧类保持的平衡。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm._arxiv_id: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning.

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_cn: 针对视频-语言模型在持续学习场景下缺乏统一评测基准的问题，论文提出了 ViLCo-Bench，一个面向视频语言持续学习的基准。该基准构建了多任务视频-语言数据流，系统评估现有持续学习方法在视频理解与跨模态对齐上的表现。相比以往仅关注图像或单模态的持续学习基准，ViLCo-Bench 引入了时序与跨模态双重挑战。实验揭示了现有方法在视频语言持续学习上存在显著遗忘，为后续研究提供了评测基础。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for continual learning of video-language models by introducing ViLCo-Bench. It constructs multi-task video-language data streams and systematically evaluates existing continual learning methods on video understanding and cross-modal alignment. Compared with prior image-only or unimodal benchmarks, it introduces temporal and cross-modal challenges, revealing substantial forgetting in current methods.
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.assessment: 为视频-语言持续学习提供了首个系统评测基准，对多模态与持续学习交叉方向有参考价值。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出面向视频语言持续学习的评测基准 ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将时序与跨模态对齐挑战引入持续学习评测。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.result: 揭示现有方法在视频语言持续学习上存在显著遗忘。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le._arxiv_id: ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual learning Benchmark.

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型在持续学习中灾难性遗忘的问题，论文提出基于混合专家适配器（Mixture-of-Experts Adapters）的方法。通过在预训练 VLM 中引入 MoE 适配器并设计路由与参数隔离机制，实现新旧任务知识的平衡。相比传统单一适配器或正则化方法，该方法能更有效地保留旧任务能力同时学习新任务。实验表明其在多个持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法，缓解了遗忘。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning of vision-language models by proposing Mixture-of-Experts Adapters. It introduces MoE adapters with routing and parameter isolation into pretrained VLMs to balance old and new task knowledge. Compared with single-adapter or regularization methods, it better preserves old-task ability while learning new tasks, significantly outperforming prior methods on multiple benchmarks.
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.assessment: 将 MoE 适配器引入 VLM 持续学习，思路新颖且实验充分，值得关注。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.contribution: 提出基于混合专家适配器的 VLM 持续学习方法。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.innovation: 用 MoE 适配器与路由机制平衡新旧任务知识。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.result: 在多个持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法。

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶运动预测模型在持续学习中遗忘旧场景的问题，论文提出基于元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲保留策略的方法。通过元学习提取可迁移表示，并设计最优缓冲保留策略选择代表性样本。相比常规回放方法，该方法在有限缓冲下更有效地保留旧场景知识。实验表明其在运动预测持续学习任务上降低了遗忘并保持预测精度。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting of old scenarios in continual learning for autonomous driving motion prediction by proposing meta-representation learning and an optimal memory buffer retention strategy. It extracts transferable representations via meta-learning and selects representative samples with an optimal buffer strategy. Compared with standard replay, it better retains old-scenario knowledge under limited buffer, reducing forgetting while maintaining prediction accuracy.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 将持续学习引入自动驾驶运动预测，问题设定贴近实际，方法有针对性。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出面向运动预测持续学习的元表示与缓冲保留方法。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 结合元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲保留策略。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.result: 在运动预测持续学习上降低遗忘并保持精度。

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中表示退化与遗忘问题，论文提出学习等角表示（Equi-Angular Representations）的方法。通过约束特征在超球面上均匀分布，缓解任务间表示冲突，提升在线持续学习的稳定性。相比以往基于回放或正则化的方法，该方法从表示几何角度改善可塑性-稳定性平衡。实验表明其在在线持续学习基准上取得更优性能。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: This paper targets representation degradation and forgetting in online continual learning by learning equi-angular representations. It constrains features to be uniformly distributed on a hypersphere to alleviate inter-task representation conflicts and improve stability. Compared with replay or regularization methods, it improves the plasticity-stability trade-off from a representation geometry perspective, achieving better performance on online CL benchmarks.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 从表示几何角度切入在线持续学习，思路有新意。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出等角表示学习用于在线持续学习。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 通过超球面均匀分布约束缓解任务间表示冲突。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.result: 在在线持续学习基准上取得更优性能。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo._arxiv_id: Learning Equi-Angular Representations for Online Continual Learning.

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中模型可塑性不足的问题，论文提出通过协同学习（Collaborative Learning）提升可塑性。通过引入辅助网络或同伴模型进行协同训练，缓解在线场景下因数据单遍流过导致的学习不充分。相比仅依赖回放或正则化的方法，该方法更有效地提升新任务学习能力。实验表明其在在线持续学习基准上改善了可塑性与整体性能。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient plasticity in online continual learning by proposing collaborative learning. It introduces auxiliary or peer models for collaborative training to mitigate inadequate learning caused by single-pass data streams. Compared with replay-only or regularization methods, it more effectively improves new-task learning, enhancing plasticity and overall performance on online CL benchmarks.
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.assessment: 聚焦在线持续学习的可塑性问题，协同学习思路实用。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出协同学习以提升在线持续学习可塑性。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.innovation: 用辅助/同伴模型协同训练缓解单遍数据学习不足。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.result: 在在线持续学习基准上改善可塑性与整体性能。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual._arxiv_id: Improving Plasticity in Online Continual Learning via Collaborative Learning.

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: 针对持续学习模型易受数据投毒攻击的问题，论文提出 BrainWash，一种使模型遗忘特定知识的投毒攻击方法。通过在训练数据中注入精心构造的投毒样本，诱导模型在持续学习过程中遗忘目标类别或任务。相比以往投毒攻击，该方法专门针对持续学习场景，揭示了其安全脆弱性。实验表明该攻击能有效导致目标知识遗忘，暴露持续学习的安全隐患。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of continual learning models to data poisoning by proposing BrainWash, a poisoning attack that induces forgetting of specific knowledge. It injects carefully crafted poisoned samples to make the model forget target classes or tasks during continual learning. Compared with prior poisoning attacks, it specifically targets CL scenarios, revealing security weaknesses and effectively causing targeted forgetting.
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.assessment: 从安全角度审视持续学习，揭示其脆弱性，具有警示意义。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.contribution: 提出针对持续学习的投毒攻击方法 BrainWash。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.innovation: 专门针对持续学习场景诱导目标知识遗忘。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.result: 实验表明该攻击能有效导致目标知识遗忘。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget._arxiv_id: BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget in Continual Learning.

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: 针对无回放（rehearsal-free）持续学习中提示（prompt）方法存在的任务间提示不一致问题，本文提出 Consistent Prompting（CPrompt）框架。方法通过任务特定提示与任务共享提示的协同设计，并引入提示一致性约束，使不同任务的提示在特征空间中保持对齐。相比已有无回放提示方法，CPrompt 缓解了任务间干扰与提示漂移。在多个持续学习基准上取得优于现有无回放方法的性能，具体提升幅度见原文实验。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_en: This paper addresses the prompt inconsistency problem in rehearsal-free continual learning, where task-specific prompts drift across tasks. It proposes Consistent Prompting (CPrompt), which coordinates task-specific and task-shared prompts with a consistency constraint to align prompt representations across tasks. Compared with prior rehearsal-free prompt-based methods, CPrompt reduces inter-task interference and achieves superior performance on standard continual learning benchmarks.
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.assessment: 该工作针对无回放持续学习中提示漂移这一实际痛点提出一致性约束，思路清晰，对持续学习与提示学习交叉方向的研究者有参考价值。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.contribution: 提出 Consistent Prompting 框架，通过任务特定与共享提示的协同及一致性约束缓解无回放持续学习中的提示漂移。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.innovation: 将提示一致性约束引入无回放持续学习，统一任务特定与任务共享提示的表示空间。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有无回放提示方法，验证了一致性约束的有效性。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free._arxiv_id: Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning.

Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_cn: 针对无样本（exemplar-free）持续学习中旧类因缺乏旧数据而难以保持的问题，本文提出用新数据"复活"旧类的方法。核心思路是利用新任务数据中与旧类相关的信息，通过特征/分类器重校准恢复旧类判别能力，而非依赖存储的旧样本。相比已有无样本方法，该方法在不存储旧数据的前提下显著缓解了旧类遗忘。在标准无样本持续学习基准上取得领先性能，具体数值见原文。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting of old classes in exemplar-free continual learning, where no old data can be stored. It proposes to resurrect old classes using new data by recalibrating features and classifiers with information relevant to old classes present in new-task data. Compared with existing exemplar-free methods, it substantially mitigates old-class forgetting without storing exemplars, achieving state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks.
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.assessment: 该工作提出用新数据恢复旧类判别能力，为无样本持续学习提供了新视角，方法简洁且实验扎实，值得关注。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.contribution: 提出利用新数据复活旧类的无样本持续学习方法，缓解旧类遗忘。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.innovation: 在不存储旧样本的前提下，借助新任务数据中的旧类相关信息重校准分类器。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.result: 在标准无样本持续学习基准上取得领先性能，显著减轻旧类遗忘。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f._arxiv_id: Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data for Exemplar-Free Continual Learning.

ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_cn: 针对全景分割（panoptic segmentation）持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与计算开销问题，本文提出 ECLIPSE 框架，将视觉提示微调（Visual Prompt Tuning）引入全景分割持续学习。方法通过为每个任务学习轻量提示并冻结主干，实现高效的任务增量学习，同时设计提示交互机制保持分割一致性。相比已有全景分割持续学习方法，ECLIPSE 在显著降低训练参数与开销的同时提升了分割精度。在持续全景分割基准上取得优于现有方法的结果。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and high computational cost in continual panoptic segmentation. It proposes ECLIPSE, which adapts visual prompt tuning to panoptic segmentation by learning lightweight task-specific prompts while freezing the backbone, with a prompt interaction mechanism to preserve segmentation consistency. Compared with prior continual panoptic segmentation methods, ECLIPSE improves accuracy while greatly reducing trainable parameters and training cost.
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.assessment: 将视觉提示微调扩展到全景分割持续学习，兼顾效率与精度，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习场景有直接参考价值。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.contribution: 提出 ECLIPSE 框架，将视觉提示微调用于高效的全景分割持续学习。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.innovation: 通过任务特定轻量提示与提示交互机制，在冻结主干下实现全景分割的持续学习。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.result: 在持续全景分割基准上优于现有方法，同时大幅降低可训练参数与训练开销。

InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中低秩适配（LoRA）因参数更新相互干扰导致遗忘的问题，本文提出 InfLoRA（Interference-Free Low-Rank Adaptation）。方法通过设计无干扰的低秩子空间，使新任务的学习更新与旧任务子空间正交，从而在不回放旧数据的情况下避免对旧任务的干扰。相比已有基于 LoRA 的持续学习方法，InfLoRA 从子空间正交性角度更严格地控制任务间干扰。在多个持续学习基准上取得优于现有参数高效持续学习方法的性能。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_en: This paper addresses interference-induced forgetting in LoRA-based continual learning. It proposes InfLoRA, which constructs interference-free low-rank subspaces so that updates for new tasks are orthogonal to those of old tasks, avoiding interference without replaying old data. Compared with existing LoRA-based continual learning methods, InfLoRA more rigorously controls inter-task interference via subspace orthogonality, achieving superior results on multiple continual learning benchmarks.
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.assessment: 从子空间正交性角度解决 LoRA 持续学习中的干扰问题，理论动机明确，对参数高效持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.contribution: 提出 InfLoRA，通过无干扰低秩子空间实现持续学习中的参数高效适配。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.innovation: 利用新任务更新与旧任务子空间的正交性，从根源上消除 LoRA 持续学习中的任务间干扰。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有参数高效持续学习方法。

Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_cn: 针对视觉持续学习中分类器偏向新类、旧类判别不足的问题，本文提出利用语言引导的监督信号增强持续学习。方法借助预训练视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的文本嵌入为各类别构建语义分类器，用语言引导的监督替代或补充传统 one-hot 监督，从而缓解任务间类别混淆。相比已有视觉持续学习方法，该方法在不增加回放的前提下提升了旧类保持能力。在多个持续学习基准上取得优于现有方法的结果。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_en: This paper tackles classifier bias toward new classes in visual continual learning. It proposes language-guided supervision that leverages text embeddings from pretrained vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) to construct semantic classifiers, replacing or augmenting one-hot supervision to reduce inter-task class confusion. Compared with existing visual continual learning methods, it improves old-class retention without replay, achieving superior results on multiple benchmarks.
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.assessment: 将视觉-语言模型的语义监督引入持续学习，思路新颖，对多模态与持续学习交叉方向的研究者有启发。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.contribution: 提出语言引导监督的视觉持续学习方法，利用预训练视觉-语言模型缓解分类器偏置。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.innovation: 用文本嵌入构建语义分类器替代 one-hot 监督，增强旧类判别能力。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法，提升旧类保持性能。

Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_cn: 针对视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）在部署后面对新场景时性能下降的问题，本文提出 Adaptive VIO，将在线持续学习引入深度 VIO。方法在推理过程中在线更新网络参数以适应新环境，同时设计防止灾难性遗忘的机制以保留已有场景的定位能力。相比固定权重的深度 VIO 方法，Adaptive VIO 能在不重新训练的情况下持续适应新场景。在多个数据集上取得优于固定模型与简单微调基线的定位精度。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of visual-inertial odometry (VIO) when deployed in unseen environments. It proposes Adaptive VIO, which introduces online continual learning to deep VIO, updating network parameters during inference to adapt to new scenes while preventing catastrophic forgetting of previously learned environments. Compared with fixed-weight deep VIO methods, Adaptive VIO continuously adapts without retraining, achieving better localization accuracy than fixed and naive fine-tuning baselines on multiple datasets.
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.assessment: 将在线持续学习用于深度 VIO 的场景自适应，问题设定贴近自动驾驶实际部署需求，对感知与定位方向的研究者有参考价值。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.contribution: 提出 Adaptive VIO，将在线持续学习引入深度视觉-惯性里程计以实现场景自适应。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.innovation: 在推理阶段在线更新 VIO 网络并抑制灾难性遗忘，实现无需重训的持续适应。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.result: 在多个数据集上定位精度优于固定权重模型与简单微调基线。

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_cn: 针对持续学习模型在任务序列中难以兼顾稳定性与可塑性、且推理效率低的问题，本文提出交互式持续学习框架，将快速直觉式推理与慢速深思式推理结合。方法上引入双系统（快/慢思考）机制，通过交互模块在任务间动态调度，减少灾难性遗忘。相比已有持续学习方法，该框架在保持旧任务性能的同时提升了新任务适应速度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需进一步验证其在大规模视觉任务上的有效性。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma and inference inefficiency in continual learning by proposing an interactive framework that combines fast intuitive and slow deliberative reasoning. A dual-system mechanism dynamically schedules fast and slow pathways across tasks to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Compared with existing continual learning methods, it improves adaptation speed while preserving old-task performance, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.assessment: 将认知科学中的快慢思考引入持续学习，思路新颖，但缺乏实验数据支撑，需关注其实际可扩展性。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.contribution: 提出交互式快慢思考持续学习框架，缓解稳定性-可塑性冲突。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.innovation: 首次将双系统认知理论系统性地融入持续学习任务调度。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，声称在保持旧任务性能的同时提升新任务适应速度。

Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中预训练模型微调易遗忘、提示学习泛化不足的问题，本文提出卷积提示与语言模型结合的持续学习方法。方法利用卷积提示生成任务特定特征，并借助语言模型提供语义先验，实现跨任务知识迁移。相比纯视觉提示方法，该方案在类增量场景下显著提升了对新类别的识别能力。摘要未列出具体基准与提升幅度，但思路对多模态持续学习有参考价值。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and limited generalization in prompt-based continual learning by combining convolutional prompting with language models. Convolutional prompts generate task-specific features while a language model supplies semantic priors for cross-task knowledge transfer. Compared with purely visual prompting methods, it improves new-class recognition in class-incremental settings, though specific benchmarks and gains are not reported in the abstract.
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.assessment: 将语言模型语义先验引入卷积提示持续学习，为多模态持续学习提供了新思路，值得关注。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.contribution: 提出卷积提示与语言模型协同的持续学习框架。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.innovation: 利用语言模型语义先验增强卷积提示的跨任务泛化能力。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在类增量场景下提升新类别识别能力。

Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_cn: 针对联邦持续学习中客户端数据异构且模型更新难以追溯的问题，本文提出可追溯联邦持续学习框架。方法通过记录各客户端在任务序列中的贡献与更新路径，实现模型演化的可追溯性，并缓解异构数据下的遗忘。相比传统联邦持续学习，该框架提升了模型更新的透明度与可审计性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，其实际效果需进一步验证。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_en: This paper addresses data heterogeneity and untraceable model updates in federated continual learning by proposing a traceable framework. It records each client's contribution and update path across task sequences to enable traceability and mitigate forgetting under heterogeneous data. Compared with conventional federated continual learning, it improves transparency and auditability of model updates, though experimental results are not detailed in the abstract.
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.assessment: 可追溯性为联邦持续学习提供了新的可信维度，但缺乏实验支撑，实际价值有待验证。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.contribution: 提出可追溯联邦持续学习框架，增强更新透明度。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.innovation: 在联邦持续学习中引入客户端贡献与更新路径的可追溯机制。

Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中灾难性遗忘与知识迁移不足的问题，本文提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的在线持续学习框架。方法通过多层次监督信号引导模型学习潜在专家知识，并利用反向自蒸馏将新知识回传至旧任务表示，缓解遗忘。相比已有在线持续学习方法，该框架在多个基准上取得了更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡。摘要未列出具体数值，但方法设计对在线场景有较强适用性。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and insufficient knowledge transfer in online continual learning by proposing a framework with multi-level supervision and reverse self-distillation. Multi-level supervision guides the model to orchestrate latent expertise, while reverse self-distillation transfers new knowledge back to old-task representations. Compared with existing online continual learning methods, it achieves a better stability-plasticity trade-off, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.assessment: 多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的组合设计合理，对在线持续学习场景有较强实用价值。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.contribution: 提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的在线持续学习框架。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.innovation: 利用反向自蒸馏将新知识回传至旧任务表示以缓解遗忘。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在多个基准上取得更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡。

RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_cn: 针对统一失败检测中分布外检测与误分类检测难以兼顾的问题，本文提出可靠持续学习框架RCL。方法通过持续学习策略在统一框架下同时处理OOD检测与误分类检测，并引入可靠性机制缓解任务间干扰。相比已有失败检测方法，RCL在多个基准上提升了检测可靠性。摘要未提供具体数值，但其统一失败检测思路对自动驾驶感知安全有参考意义。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of unified failure detection, where out-of-distribution detection and misclassification detection are difficult to reconcile, by proposing a reliable continual learning framework (RCL). RCL handles both tasks in a unified framework via continual learning and introduces a reliability mechanism to mitigate inter-task interference. Compared with existing failure detection methods, it improves detection reliability, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.assessment: 统一失败检测对自动驾驶安全至关重要，RCL的持续学习视角具有实际应用潜力。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.contribution: 提出可靠持续学习框架RCL，统一处理OOD与误分类检测。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.innovation: 将持续学习引入统一失败检测，缓解任务间干扰。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，声称在多个基准上提升检测可靠性。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni._arxiv_id: RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Unified Failure Detection.

Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习中特征空间固定导致新类适应差的问题，本文提出可扩展子空间集成方法。方法为每个任务学习可扩展子空间，并通过集成多个子空间实现新旧类别的有效区分。相比固定特征或单一提示方法，该方案在类增量基准上显著提升了新类识别率。摘要未列出具体数值，但其子空间扩展思路对预训练模型持续学习有较强启发。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses poor new-class adaptation in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning caused by fixed feature spaces, by proposing an expandable subspace ensemble. It learns an expandable subspace per task and ensembles multiple subspaces to effectively distinguish old and new classes. Compared with fixed-feature or single-prompt methods, it significantly improves new-class recognition on class-incremental benchmarks, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.assessment: 可扩展子空间集成为预训练模型持续学习提供了简洁有效的方案，值得关注。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.contribution: 提出可扩展子空间集成方法用于预训练模型类增量学习。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.innovation: 为每个任务学习可扩展子空间并集成以区分新旧类别。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在类增量基准上显著提升新类识别率。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra._arxiv_id: Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Trained Model-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦增量学习（Federated Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘与通信开销的矛盾，提出了一种高效的回放（replay）机制。方法上通过在客户端维护紧凑的样本回放缓冲区并结合服务器端的梯度聚合策略，在有限存储与通信预算下缓解遗忘。相比已有联邦增量学习方法，其改进在于显式优化回放样本的选择与传输效率，降低通信成本的同时保持精度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，但实验表明在多个基准上优于现有回放基线。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in federated incremental learning under limited communication and storage budgets. It proposes an efficient replay mechanism that selects and transmits compact replay samples across clients and server. Compared with prior federated incremental methods, it reduces communication overhead while maintaining accuracy, though specific benchmark numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.assessment: 联邦学习与增量学习的交叉方向，回放效率问题具有实际部署价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验规模。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.contribution: 提出面向联邦增量学习的高效回放机制以平衡通信开销与抗遗忘能力。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.innovation: 在联邦场景下联合优化回放样本选择与梯度聚合，降低通信成本。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.result: 在有限通信预算下缓解灾难性遗忘，性能优于现有回放基线。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In._arxiv_id: Towards Efficient Replay in Federated Incremental Learning.

OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中模型泛化能力不足的问题，提出 OrCo 方法，通过正交性（orthogonality）与对比学习（contrast）联合约束特征空间。方法在基类训练阶段引入正交正则与对比损失，使类间特征更可分离、类内更紧凑，从而提升新类泛化。相比已有 FSCIL 方法，其改进在于同时优化特征正交性与判别性对比结构。在 CIFAR-100、miniImageNet 等基准上取得优于 SOTA 的精度。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_en: This paper tackles poor generalization in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by proposing OrCo, which enforces orthogonality and contrastive constraints on the feature space. The method combines orthogonal regularization with contrastive loss during base training to improve inter-class separability and intra-class compactness. It outperforms state-of-the-art FSCIL methods on CIFAR-100 and miniImageNet benchmarks.
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.assessment: 正交性与对比学习的结合在 FSCIL 中思路清晰，实验较充分，对增量学习研究者有参考价值。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.contribution: 提出 OrCo，通过正交性与对比约束提升小样本类增量学习的泛化能力。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.innovation: 将特征正交正则与对比学习联合用于 FSCIL 的特征空间塑造。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 miniImageNet 等 FSCIL 基准上超越现有 SOTA。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via._arxiv_id: OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via Orthogonality and Contrast for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.

NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_cn: 该论文针对无回放（replay-free）类增量学习中旧知识遗忘严重的问题，受神经发生（neurogenesis）启发提出 NICE 上下文编码方法。方法通过动态扩展网络容量并引入上下文编码模块，在不存储旧样本的前提下保留历史类信息。相比已有无回放方法，其改进在于模拟生物神经发生机制实现容量自适应增长与上下文感知表征。在标准类增量基准上取得优于现有无回放方法的性能。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_en: This paper addresses severe forgetting in replay-free class incremental learning by proposing NICE, a neurogenesis-inspired contextual encoding method. It dynamically expands network capacity and introduces contextual encoding to preserve old-class information without storing exemplars. It outperforms existing replay-free methods on standard class-incremental benchmarks.
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.assessment: 神经发生启发的容量扩展思路新颖，无回放设定对隐私敏感场景有吸引力。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.contribution: 提出 NICE，以神经发生启发的上下文编码实现无回放类增量学习。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.innovation: 模拟神经发生机制动态扩展网络容量并引入上下文编码。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.result: 在无回放设定下优于现有类增量学习方法。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E._arxiv_id: NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual Encoding for Replay-free Class Incremental Learning.

Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的类别不平衡问题，提出梯度重加权（Gradient Reweighting）方法。方法通过分析不同类别梯度对更新的贡献差异，动态调整梯度权重以缓解头部类主导、尾部类被忽视的问题。相比已有类增量方法，其改进在于从梯度层面显式处理不平衡，而非仅依赖损失或采样策略。在多个不平衡类增量基准上提升了尾部类精度与整体性能。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_en: This paper tackles class imbalance in class-incremental learning by proposing a gradient reweighting method. It dynamically adjusts gradient contributions across classes to prevent head classes from dominating updates. Compared with prior methods, it addresses imbalance at the gradient level rather than via loss or sampling alone, improving tail-class accuracy on imbalanced class-incremental benchmarks.
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.assessment: 从梯度层面处理不平衡的思路直接有效，对增量学习与长尾问题交叉方向有参考意义。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.contribution: 提出梯度重加权方法缓解类增量学习中的类别不平衡。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.innovation: 在梯度层面动态调整类别权重以抑制头部类主导。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.result: 在不平衡类增量基准上提升尾部类与整体精度。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced._arxiv_id: Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced Class-Incremental Learning.

DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线无任务（online task-free）类增量学习场景，提出 DYSON 动态特征空间自组织方法。方法通过动态调整特征空间结构，使模型在无任务边界信息、数据流式到达的条件下自适应组织类表征。相比已有在线类增量方法，其改进在于无需任务标签即可实现特征空间的自组织与稳定更新。在在线类增量基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_en: This paper targets online task-free class incremental learning and proposes DYSON, a dynamic feature space self-organization method. It adaptively organizes class representations as data streams in without task boundaries. Compared with existing online class-incremental methods, it achieves self-organization and stable updates without task labels, outperforming prior methods on online benchmarks.
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.assessment: 在线无任务设定更贴近真实部署，特征空间自组织思路有创新性，值得关注。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.contribution: 提出 DYSON，实现无任务边界条件下的在线类增量特征空间自组织。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.innovation: 在无任务标签的流式数据下动态自组织特征空间。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.result: 在在线类增量基准上超越现有方法。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi._arxiv_id: DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization for Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning.

FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_cn: 该论文针对无样本（non-exemplar）类增量学习中旧类知识难以保留的问题，提出特征校准与分离（FCS）方法。方法通过特征校准模块修正因新类学习导致的旧类特征漂移，并通过特征分离增强类间判别性。相比已有无样本类增量方法，其改进在于同时处理特征漂移与类间混淆两个问题。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 等基准上取得优于 SOTA 的性能。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of preserving old-class knowledge in non-exemplar class incremental learning by proposing Feature Calibration and Separation (FCS). It calibrates drifted old-class features caused by new-class learning and enhances inter-class discrimination via feature separation. It outperforms state-of-the-art non-exemplar methods on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet benchmarks.
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.assessment: 特征校准与分离的组合针对性强，无样本设定实用，实验较充分。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.contribution: 提出 FCS，通过特征校准与分离提升无样本类增量学习性能。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.innovation: 联合特征校准与特征分离以同时缓解特征漂移与类间混淆。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 等基准上超越现有 SOTA。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation._arxiv_id: FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation for Non-Exemplar Class Incremental Learning.

2505.10649|v2.summary_cn: 针对多实例学习（MIL）模型在病理全切片图像（WSI）分析中缺乏对演进数据集的适应性问题，作者分析了注意力MIL模型在持续学习下的遗忘模式，发现遗忘主要集中在注意力层。为此提出注意力知识蒸馏（AKD）与伪包记忆池（PMP）两个组件：AKD在会话间保留注意力层知识以缓解灾难性遗忘，PMP通过仅存储最具信息量的patch（伪包）降低内存占用。实验表明该方法在多个WSI数据集上同时提升了准确率与内存效率。
2505.10649|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of multiple instance learning (MIL) models for whole slide image analysis under evolving datasets. The authors analyze continual learning in attention-based MIL and find that forgetting concentrates in attention layers, then propose Attention Knowledge Distillation (AKD) and a Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool (PMP) to retain attention knowledge and reduce memory footprint. Experiments on diverse WSI datasets show improved accuracy and memory efficiency.
2505.10649|v2.assessment: 将持续学习引入MIL并定位遗忘来源的思路清晰，但领域偏医学影像，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2505.10649|v2.contribution: 提出针对注意力MIL持续学习的AKD与PMP组件，缓解遗忘并降低内存。
2505.10649|v2.innovation: 通过分析定位遗忘集中于注意力层，并据此设计注意力知识蒸馏与伪包记忆池。
2505.10649|v2.result: 在多个WSI数据集上同时提升准确率与内存效率。

2403.18886|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型（PTM）的持续学习方法在固定适配器集合上受限、周期性新增模块导致线性增长与知识复用不足的问题，本文提出SEMA（自扩展预训练模型与模块化适配）。SEMA在不同表征层级检测到无法处理的显著分布偏移时，自动决定复用还是新增适配器模块，其模块由功能适配器与表征描述符组成。该方法旨在更精细地控制稳定性-可塑性平衡，提升持续学习能力。
2403.18886|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited continual learning ability of PTM-based methods that rely on a fixed set of adapters or grow linearly with task-specific modules. It proposes SEMA, which automatically reuses or adds modular adapters on demand based on detected distribution shifts at different representation levels, with each module comprising a functional adapter and a representation descriptor. The approach aims to better balance stability and plasticity in continual learning.
2403.18886|v2.assessment: 按需扩展适配器的思路对持续学习有参考价值，但摘要未给出量化结果，说服力有限。
2403.18886|v2.contribution: 提出按需复用或新增模块化适配器的SEMA框架。
2403.18886|v2.innovation: 依据不同表征层级的分布偏移自动决定适配器复用或扩展。
2403.18886|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称增强稳定性-可塑性平衡。

Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.summary_cn: 该论文题为《Online Task-Free Continual Learning via Dynamic Expansionable Memory Distribution》，针对在线无任务边界的持续学习场景，提出动态可扩展记忆分布方法。但由于摘要内容缺失，无法确认其具体方法细节、与已有工作的对比以及实验效果。仅从标题判断，其关注点在于无需任务标识的在线持续学习与记忆管理。

Based on the title alone, it concerns task-free online continual learning and memory management.

Online Task-Free Continual Learning via.innovation: 推测为动态可扩展的记忆分布机制（因摘要缺失无法确认）。

2503.23283|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中缓解灾难性遗忘与保持可解释性难以兼顾的问题，本文提出语言引导的概念瓶颈模型（CBM）框架。方法利用概念瓶颈层，与CLIP模型对齐语义一致性，学习可跨任务泛化的人类可理解概念。通过聚焦可解释概念，该方法在保留知识的同时提供透明的决策依据。实验在多个数据集上取得优于现有最优方法的表现，提升幅度最高达一定数值（摘要截断）。
2503.23283|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dual challenge of mitigating catastrophic forgetting and maintaining interpretability in continual learning. It introduces a language-guided Concept Bottleneck Model framework that aligns a concept bottleneck layer with CLIP to learn human-understandable, cross-task generalizable concepts. Experiments on several datasets show superior performance over state-of-the-art methods with improvements up to a reported margin.
2503.23283|v2.assessment: 将概念瓶颈与CLIP结合提升持续学习可解释性，思路新颖，但摘要截断影响效果评估。
2503.23283|v2.contribution: 提出语言引导的概念瓶颈模型框架，兼顾持续学习性能与可解释性。
2503.23283|v2.innovation: 利用概念瓶颈层与CLIP对齐学习跨任务可泛化的人类可理解概念。
2503.23283|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有最优方法，提升幅度最高达摘要所述数值。

2505.24816|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习（CIL）中基于适配器的方法为每个新任务新建适配器导致参数冗余且无法利用跨任务共享知识的问题，本文提出CL-LoRA，一种双适配器架构，结合任务共享适配器学习跨任务知识与任务特定适配器捕捉新任务独有特征。共享适配器采用随机正交矩阵并利用带梯度重分配的知识蒸馏保留共享知识，任务特定适配器引入可学习块级权重以缓解任务间干扰并保持可塑性。实验表明CL-LoRA在无样本回放的类增量学习上取得一致优势。
2505.24816|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses parameter redundancy and poor cross-task knowledge sharing in adapter-based rehearsal-free class-incremental learning. It proposes CL-LoRA, a dual-adapter architecture combining task-shared adapters for cross-task knowledge and task-specific adapters for unique features, where shared adapters use random orthogonal matrices with knowledge distillation and gradient reassignment, and task-specific adapters use learnable block-wise weights. Experiments demonstrate consistent advantages in rehearsal-free CIL.
2505.24816|v2.assessment: 双适配器与梯度重分配蒸馏设计合理，对PEFT持续学习有较强参考价值。
2505.24816|v2.contribution: 提出结合任务共享与任务特定适配器的CL-LoRA双适配器架构。
2505.24816|v2.innovation: 共享适配器用随机正交矩阵与梯度重分配知识蒸馏，任务特定适配器用块级权重。
2505.24816|v2.result: 在无样本回放的类增量学习基准上取得一致性能提升。

2503.21076|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中线性分类器难以在学习新任务时维持稳定分类空间的问题，受Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）在简单持续回归任务中保持学习稳定性的启发，本文提出Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器（KAC）。作者深入研究了KAN样条函数的影响，并引入径向基函数（RBF）以更好兼容持续学习，将多个近期方法中的线性分类器替换为KAC。在多个持续学习基准上的实验均显示性能提升，验证了KAC的有效性与鲁棒性。
2503.21076|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of linear classifiers in maintaining a stable classification space during continual learning. Inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) for learning stability, it introduces the Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier (KAC), studies the impact of KAN spline functions, and adopts Radial Basis Functions (RBF) for better continual learning compatibility. Replacing linear classifiers with KAC in several recent methods yields consistent improvements across benchmarks.
2503.21076|v2.assessment: 将KAN引入持续学习分类器是新颖且通用的思路，可即插即用地替换线性分类器，实用性强。
2503.21076|v2.contribution: 提出基于KAN结构的Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器（KAC）用于持续学习。
2503.21076|v2.innovation: 引入RBF替代样条函数以提升KAN在持续学习中的兼容性，可替换线性分类器。
2503.21076|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上替换线性分类器后均取得性能提升。

2503.18371|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文借鉴Ebbinghaus遗忘曲线理论，提出view-batch模型来调整学习调度，优化同一批样本再训练的召回间隔。具体给出两种实现：保证最优召回间隔的回放方法，以及基于自监督学习的策略，使网络在足够'休息'后从相同样本中学习广泛知识。相比传统回放方法，该工作从认知科学角度重新设计了回放时序，强调间隔长度对长期记忆保持的作用。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但为持续学习提供了新的理论视角。
2503.18371|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by drawing on Ebbinghaus' forgetting curve theory. It introduces a view-batch model that adjusts learning schedules to optimize the recall interval between retraining the same samples, implemented via an optimal-interval replay method and a self-supervised learning approach. The key insight is that sufficient rest between repeated exposures to the same data enhances long-term retention, offering a cognitively inspired alternative to conventional replay strategies.
2503.18371|v2.assessment: 从认知科学遗忘曲线角度切入持续学习，视角新颖，但摘要缺乏实验数据支撑，实际效果有待验证。
2503.18371|v2.contribution: 提出基于遗忘曲线的view-batch学习调度模型及两种实现方法。
2503.18371|v2.innovation: 将Ebbinghaus遗忘曲线的'学习-休息'间隔理论引入神经网络持续学习的回放调度设计。
2503.18371|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，仅声称能有效缓解灾难性遗忘。

2503.18985|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本持续学习（EFCL）中特征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出Drift-Resistant Space（DRS），无需显式特征建模或存储旧任务样本即可应对特征漂移。核心方法LoRA Subtraction（LoRA-）在处理新任务前，从预训练初始权重中减去旧任务的LoRA权重来构建DRS，从而增强稳定性并简化实现。相比依赖静态特征或过时统计量的现有EFCL方法，LoRA-能动态适应特征空间的演化，避免性能随时间退化。该方法参数高效，兼具稳定性和效率优势。
2503.18985|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles feature drift in exemplar-free continual learning (EFCL) by proposing Drift-Resistant Space (DRS), which requires neither explicit feature modeling nor storage of previous task samples. The key method, LoRA Subtraction (LoRA-), subtracts old-task LoRA weights from the initial pre-trained weights before processing new tasks, establishing a drift-resistant space for training. Compared to existing EFCL methods relying on static features or outdated statistics, LoRA- dynamically adapts to feature space evolution while being parameter-efficient and simple to implement.
2503.18985|v2.assessment: 将LoRA与持续学习结合，通过权重减法构建抗漂移空间，思路简洁有效，参数高效且无需样本回放，实用性强。
2503.18985|v2.contribution: 提出LoRA Subtraction方法构建Drift-Resistant Space，实现无样本持续学习中的抗特征漂移。
2503.18985|v2.innovation: 通过从预训练权重中减去旧任务LoRA权重来动态构建抗漂移特征空间，无需存储旧样本或显式特征建模。
2503.18985|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集上的量化结果，但声称有效缓解了性能随时间退化的问题。

2412.18177|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（OCL）中现有回放方法忽视模型适应性问题，本文提出即插即用模块S6MOD，可集成到大多数现有方法中直接提升适应性。S6MOD在骨干网络后增加额外分支，通过离散化混合（mixture of discretization）选择性调整选择性状态空间模型中的参数，丰富选择性扫描模式。进一步设计类条件路由算法进行基于不确定性的动态调整，并实现对比离散化损失进行优化。大量实验表明S6MOD显著增强模型适应性，带来实质性性能提升。
2412.18177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked model adaptability in online continual learning (OCL) by introducing S6MOD, a plug-and-play module integrable into most existing methods. S6MOD adds a branch after the backbone where a mixture of discretization selectively adjusts parameters in a selective state space model, enriched by a class-conditional routing algorithm and a contrastive discretization loss. Extensive experiments demonstrate that S6MOD significantly enhances model adaptability and yields substantial performance gains across various base methods.
2412.18177|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入在线持续学习，即插即用设计具有较好的通用性，但摘要未给出具体提升数值。
2412.18177|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用模块S6MOD，通过离散化混合和类条件路由提升在线持续学习的模型适应性。
2412.18177|v2.innovation: 将选择性状态空间模型与离散化混合机制结合，设计类条件路由和对比离散化损失用于在线持续学习。
2412.18177|v2.result: 大量实验表明S6MOD显著增强适应性并带来实质性性能提升，但摘要未披露具体数值。

2503.12053|v2.summary_cn: 针对高频数据流中在线持续学习（OCL）需在变化的内存约束下实现实时学习的问题，本文提出Ferret框架。Ferret采用细粒度流水线并行策略结合迭代梯度补偿算法，确保高频数据的低延迟处理并有效应对并行训练中的陈旧梯度问题；同时通过自动化模型分区和流水线规划适应不同内存预算。在20个基准和5种OCL算法上的实验表明，Ferret达到相同在线精度时内存开销最多降低3.7倍，并在不同内存预算下持续优于对比方法。
2503.12053|v2.summary_en: This paper presents Ferret, a framework for online continual learning (OCL) under varying memory constraints in high-frequency data streams. Ferret combines fine-grained pipeline parallelism with an iterative gradient compensation algorithm to handle high-frequency data with minimal latency while counteracting stale gradients, and employs automated model partitioning and pipeline planning to adapt to memory budgets. Experiments across 20 benchmarks and 5 OCL algorithms show up to 3.7× lower memory overhead to reach the same online accuracy, consistently outperforming competing methods across diverse memory budgets.
2503.12053|v2.assessment: 系统性工程贡献突出，实验覆盖20个基准和5种算法，3.7倍内存效率提升具有实际部署价值。
2503.12053|v2.contribution: 提出Ferret框架，通过流水线并行和梯度补偿实现内存自适应的高效在线持续学习。
2503.12053|v2.innovation: 将细粒度流水线并行与迭代梯度补偿结合，配合自动化模型分区实现内存约束下的实时OCL。
2503.12053|v2.result: 在20个基准和5种OCL算法上，达到相同在线精度时内存开销最多降低3.7倍，且在不同内存预算下持续优于对比方法。

Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频类增量学习（Video Class-Incremental Learning）中时空表征随任务更新而漂移、旧类别易遗忘的问题，提出学习条件化的时空提示分布（Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions）。方法通过为不同任务/类别生成条件化的时空 prompt 分布，将可学习参数集中在提示空间而非骨干网络，从而在保持预训练视频模型时空建模能力的同时适配新类别。相比固定 prompt 或单一 prompt 池的方法，条件化分布建模能更灵活地覆盖视频中动作的时空多样性，缓解灾难性遗忘。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in video class-incremental learning, where spatio-temporal representations drift as new tasks arrive. It proposes learning conditional space-time prompt distributions that adapt a frozen pre-trained video backbone to new classes while preserving prior knowledge. Compared with fixed or single-pool prompting, the conditional distribution better captures the spatio-temporal diversity of actions, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.assessment: 将 prompt 分布建模引入视频增量学习是有新意的方向，但摘要信息有限，需关注其与图像域增量方法的差异与实验规模。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.contribution: 提出条件化时空提示分布用于视频类增量学习。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.innovation: 以条件分布而非固定提示建模视频任务的时空多样性。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D._arxiv_id: Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions for Video Class-Incremental Learning.

Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于预训练模型的域增量学习（Domain-Incremental Learning）中，模型在连续跨域更新时既遗忘旧域知识又难以充分利用预训练先验的问题，提出双重巩固（Dual Consolidation）框架。方法从参数与表征两个层面同时巩固：一方面约束关键参数/子空间偏移以保留预训练知识，另一方面对齐新旧域特征分布以稳定决策边界。相比仅做参数正则或仅做特征回放的已有方法，双重巩固在预训练模型设定下更均衡地兼顾可塑性与稳定性。摘要未给出具体数值。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_en: This paper targets domain-incremental learning with pre-trained models, where sequential domain updates cause forgetting of both pre-trained priors and previously seen domains. It proposes a Dual Consolidation framework that jointly regularizes parameter drift and aligns cross-domain representations. Compared with parameter-only regularization or replay-only approaches, it better balances plasticity and stability under the pre-trained setting, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.assessment: 预训练模型下的域增量学习是当前热点，双重巩固思路合理，但需看其与 prompt/adapter 类方法的对比。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.contribution: 提出参数与表征双重巩固的域增量学习框架。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.innovation: 在预训练模型设定下同时巩固参数子空间与跨域特征分布。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model._arxiv_id: Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model-Based Domain-Incremental Learning.

2503.17677|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中基于原型的方法存在表征能力不足与特征重叠严重、导致类间混淆的问题，提出 Confusion-REduced AuTo-Encoder 分类器（CREATE）。方法为每个类在隐子空间学习一个轻量自编码器以刻画紧凑流形，约束样本仅在语义正确的自编码器上重建良好，从而增强类分布的表征稳定性；并进一步提出混淆感知的隐空间分离损失，使样本在对应低维流形上聚集、同时远离其他类特征分布。相比原型类方法，CREATE 通过流形重建与显式分离缓解类间混淆，摘要称其展现出更强性能但未给出具体数值。
2503.17677|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles class-wise confusion in prototype-based class-incremental learning, caused by limited representation capacity and overlapping features. It proposes CREATE, which learns a compact latent manifold per class via lightweight auto-encoders so that samples reconstruct well only on the semantically correct one, plus a confusion-aware latent separation loss that pulls samples toward their own manifold and pushes them away from others. It claims stronger performance than prototype-based baselines, without reporting specific numbers in the abstract.
2503.17677|v2.assessment: 用类专属自编码器流形替代点原型是较新颖的表征思路，对缓解类间混淆有针对性，值得关注其与 replay-free 方法的对比。
2503.17677|v2.contribution: 提出基于类专属自编码器流形与混淆感知分离损失的 CIL 分类器 CREATE。
2503.17677|v2.innovation: 以紧凑流形重建替代点原型，并引入混淆感知隐空间分离损失。
2503.17677|v2.result: 摘要称性能更强，未给出具体量化数据。

Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中多模态特征在增量阶段发生偏移、导致新旧类判别性下降的问题，提出免训练的双层模态校准（Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration）。方法在不额外训练的情况下，从模态级与样本级两个层次对特征分布进行校准，使增量阶段的多模态表征与基类阶段保持一致。相比需要额外微调或重训练的校准方案，该方法免训练、开销低且易于嵌入现有 FSCIL 流程。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_en: This paper addresses representation drift in few-shot class-incremental learning, where multimodal features shift during incremental sessions and degrade discrimination between old and new classes. It proposes a training-free bi-level modality calibration that aligns features at both modality and sample levels without additional training. Compared with fine-tuning-based calibration, it is cheaper and plug-and-play, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.assessment: 免训练校准在 FSCIL 中实用性强，但需验证其在多模态设定下的增益幅度与泛化性。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.contribution: 提出免训练的双层模态校准方法用于小样本类增量学习。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.innovation: 在模态级与样本级同时进行免训练特征校准。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea._arxiv_id: Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning via Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration.

2412.18219|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中现有方法在推理时间与精度之间难以兼顾、且随任务数增长推理开销膨胀的问题，提出 ACMap（Adapter Merging with Centroid Prototype Mapping）这一无样本框架。方法将各任务专属 adapter 合并为单一 adapter，构建对齐任务表征的共享子空间以缓解遗忘，并通过质心原型映射在该子空间内持续适配表征以保持精度；同时引入早停策略限制任务增多时的 adapter 合并规模以提升可扩展性。在五个基准数据集上，ACMap 达到与 SOTA 相当的精度，同时推理时间与最快方法相当，实现跨任务恒定推理开销。
2412.18219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy-versus-inference-time trade-off in exemplar-free class-incremental learning, where inference cost grows with the number of tasks. It proposes ACMap, which merges task-specific adapters into a single shared-subspace adapter to align representations and mitigate forgetting, and uses centroid prototype mapping to maintain accuracy within that subspace, with early stopping to bound merging as tasks accumulate. On five benchmarks, ACMap matches state-of-the-art accuracy while keeping inference time comparable to the fastest existing methods.
2412.18219|v2.assessment: 同时解决遗忘与可扩展性且给出五个基准的完整实验，工程价值与可复现性（开源代码）都较好，是该方向值得参考的工作。
2412.18219|v2.contribution: 提出无样本、恒定推理开销的 adapter 合并与质心原型映射 CIL 框架 ACMap。
2412.18219|v2.innovation: 将任务 adapter 合并为共享子空间并结合质心原型映射与早停策略。
2412.18219|v2.result: 在五个基准上精度匹配 SOTA，推理时间与最快方法相当。

Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习（PTM-based CIL）中，预训练知识在增量微调过程中被覆盖、而新任务知识又难以有效沉淀的问题，提出知识记忆与反刍（Knowledge Memorization and Rumination）机制。方法通过显式记忆预训练阶段的关键知识，并在增量学习过程中周期性“反刍”这些知识以约束表征漂移，从而在适配新类的同时保留预训练先验。相比仅依赖 prompt 或 adapter 隔离参数的方法，该机制更直接地维护预训练知识通路。摘要未给出具体数值。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_en: This paper targets pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning, where incremental fine-tuning overwrites pre-trained knowledge while new-task knowledge is hard to consolidate. It proposes a knowledge memorization and rumination mechanism that explicitly stores pre-trained knowledge and periodically revisits it during incremental updates to constrain representation drift. Unlike prompt- or adapter-based isolation, it directly maintains the pre-trained knowledge pathway, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.assessment: 以“记忆—反刍”类比处理预训练知识保持，思路直观，但需看其与主流 prompt/adapter 方法的实证对比。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.contribution: 提出知识记忆与反刍机制用于基于预训练模型的类增量学习。
