2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: 基于注意力的跟踪（TBA）方法在3D跟踪中潜力大，但性能长期落后于检测跟踪（TBD）方法，原因不明。该论文提出基于LiDAR的联合检测跟踪器JDT3D，分析TBA落后原因，并提出轨迹采样增强和基于置信度的查询传播两种通用方法。在nuScenes测试集上AMOTA达0.574，超越所有现有LiDAR TBA方法超6%。论文还讨论了现有TBA模型公式的潜在挑战。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: Tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods have potential but consistently lag behind tracking-by-detection (TBD) in 3D tracking. This paper proposes JDT3D, a LiDAR-based joint detector-tracker, analyzes the performance gap, and introduces track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation. JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA on the nuScenes test set, outperforming all existing LiDAR-based TBA approaches by over 6%.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 系统分析并缩小了TBA与TBD的差距，在nuScenes上取得显著提升，对自动驾驶3D跟踪有重要参考价值。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出LiDAR联合检测跟踪器JDT3D及两种通用改进方法。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 轨迹采样增强与基于置信度的查询传播，缩小TBA与TBD性能差距。
2407.04926|v2.result: nuScenes测试集AMOTA达0.574，超越现有LiDAR TBA方法超6%。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法依赖对所有视频所有帧的密集边界框和实例ID标注，成本极高。本文提出Walker，首个仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器：构建准稠密时序物体外观图，用多正样本对比目标优化图上的随机游走以学习实例相似度，并引入互斥连通性约束优化图拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移状态关联检测与轨迹。在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到自监督跟踪器的最优性能，标注需求最多减少400倍仍超越此前自监督方法。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods require exhaustive per-frame bounding box and identity annotations. Walker is the first self-supervised tracker that learns from videos with only sparse bounding box annotations and no tracking labels, building a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph optimized via a multi-positive contrastive objective over random walks, plus a mutual-exclusivity connectivity constraint. At inference, detections are associated to tracklets via max-likelihood transition under motion-constrained bidirectional walks, achieving competitive results on MOT17, DanceTrack and BDD100K while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 首次将自监督跟踪做到与主流方法可比，标注效率提升显著，对降低MOT数据成本有重要参考价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅用稀疏框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督MOT框架Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 基于时序外观图随机游走的多正样本对比学习与互斥连通性约束。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上超越此前自监督跟踪器，标注需求最多降低400倍。

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）多为类别专用模型，参数冗余且难以跨类别泛化。本文首次提出统一模型，用共享参数的单网络同时跟踪所有类别目标：显式编码不同类别的属性差异（主要来自尺寸与形状，如大而方的车 vs 小而细的人），设计基于Transformer的AdaFormer点集表征学习网络自适应编码跨类别的动态形状与尺寸信息，并将已知模板目标的尺寸形状先验融入输入与学习目标。方法实现了跨类别统一跟踪，减少冗余参数并提升泛化性。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D SOT models are category-specific, incurring redundant parameters and poor cross-category applicability. This paper introduces the first unified model that tracks all categories with a single shared-parameter network, explicitly encoding category attributes that mainly differ in size and shape. It proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based point set representation network that adaptively encodes dynamically varying shape and size, and incorporates template-derived size/shape priors into inputs and the learning objective.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 首次系统解决3D SOT的类别统一问题，AdaFormer设计有针对性，对多类别跟踪部署有实用价值。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 提出首个跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型与AdaFormer表征网络。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 自适应编码跨类别形状尺寸差异并融入模板先验。
2401.11204|v2.result: 实现单网络跨类别跟踪，减少参数冗余并提升跨类别泛化。

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景训练时存在负迁移（学到冲突的场景特定参数）与域泛化差、需昂贵微调的问题。本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）与模块化深度学习（MDL）：定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT专家模块，在参数空间组合这些模块，从而系统泛化到新域且不增加推理时间。在MOTSynth上训练并在MOT17、PersonPath22上零样本评估，由精选模块构建的跟踪器超越单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: End-to-end transformer trackers suffer from negative interference and poor domain generalization when trained on heterogeneous scenarios. PASTA combines PEFT and Modular Deep Learning: it defines key scenario attributes (e.g., camera viewpoint, lighting) and trains specialized PEFT modules per attribute, combining them in parameter space to generalize to new domains without extra inference cost. Trained on MOTSynth and evaluated zero-shot on MOT17 and PersonPath22, the modular tracker surpasses its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 将PEFT与模块化学习引入MOT，有效缓解异构场景负迁移，零样本泛化结果有说服力。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出结合PEFT与模块化深度学习的场景专用跟踪框架PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 按场景属性训练PEFT专家模块并在参数空间组合实现零样本泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在MOTSynth训练、MOT17与PersonPath22零样本评估中超越单体跟踪器。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言（VL）跟踪器虽引入自然语言描述提升通用性，但因依赖人工文本标注（常含模糊描述）而性能逊于SoTA纯视觉跟踪器。本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的世界知识生成高质量语言描述：设计基于反思的提示优化模块，借助跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊/不准确的描述；并提出简洁有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块同时提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器性能。实验表明该方法显著提升跟踪表现。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: VL trackers underperform SoTA visual trackers largely due to their reliance on manual textual annotations that are often ambiguous. ChatTracker leverages MLLM world knowledge to generate high-quality language descriptions via a reflection-based prompt optimization module that iteratively refines descriptions using tracking feedback. A simple yet effective VL tracking framework is proposed as a plug-and-play module that boosts both VL and visual trackers.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 用MLLM自动生成高质量文本替代人工标注，思路新颖且即插即用，对VL跟踪有实用价值。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM生成高质量语言描述的ChatTracker跟踪框架。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于反思的提示优化模块结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼目标描述。
2411.01756|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块显著提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重、背景杂乱，且RGB外观线索在航拍视角下退化的问题，论文提出首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT。该基准包含125段视频、48.8万+标注、8个类别，覆盖极小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，并提供精确的旋转框标注。作者进一步提出多光谱跟踪方法以提取光谱特征并利用旋转标注。相比现有RGB跟踪基准，MMOT通过像素级光谱反射率增强了退化空间条件下的目标可判别性。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMOT, the first challenging benchmark for drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking, addressing the degradation of RGB appearance cues in aerial views. It contains 125 video sequences with over 488.8K oriented annotations across eight categories, covering extreme small targets, high density, severe occlusion, and complex motion. A multispectral tracking approach is further presented to exploit spectral features and oriented annotations, improving discriminability under degraded spatial conditions.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了无人机多光谱多目标跟踪数据集的空白，规模大、挑战全面，对多模态跟踪和航拍感知研究有重要价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT，并提出配套的多光谱跟踪方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 将多光谱成像与旋转框标注引入无人机多目标跟踪，增强退化空间条件下的目标判别。
2510.12565|v2.result: 提供125段视频、48.8万+标注、8类目标，覆盖极小目标、高密度、严重遮挡等挑战。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像360°视场下多目标跟踪受分辨率损失、几何形变和光照不均等畸变影响，现有针孔相机MOT算法难以直接适用的问题，论文提出OmniTrack全景MOT框架。该框架包含Tracklet Management引入时序线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位与关联、CircularStatE模块缓解图像与几何畸变，从而支持快速传感器运动下的全景跟踪。为弥补全景MOT数据集缺失，作者构建了四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集，覆盖全景视场、剧烈运动和复杂环境等挑战。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses omnidirectional multi-object tracking, where panoramic distortions such as resolution loss, geometric deformation, and uneven lighting degrade existing pinhole-camera MOT methods. It proposes OmniTrack, integrating Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for localization and association, and a CircularStatE module to alleviate image and geometric distortions. A new QuadTrack panoramic dataset collected by a quadruped robot is introduced to support evaluation under rapid motion and complex environments.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 该工作将MOT拓展到全景视场并配套新数据集，对全景感知和机器人跟踪研究有较高参考价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景多目标跟踪框架OmniTrack及四足机器人全景数据集QuadTrack。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机单目标跟踪中小目标和遮挡导致RGB跟踪器性能受限的问题，论文提出首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST和统一跟踪框架UNTrack。MUST包含250段视频序列，覆盖多样环境和挑战；UNTrack从光谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索中编码统一的光谱、空间和时序特征，采用非对称Transformer与光谱背景消除机制进行关系建模，并通过持续更新光谱提示的编码器优化跟踪。实验表明UNTrack优于现有无人机跟踪器，兼顾精度与效率。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles UAV single object tracking under small targets and occlusions, where RGB trackers are limited, by introducing MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 video sequences. It also proposes UNTrack, a unified framework that encodes spectral, spatial, and temporal features from spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches. UNTrack employs an asymmetric transformer with a spectral background elimination mechanism and a continuously updated spectrum prompt encoder, outperforming state-of-the-art UAV trackers in accuracy and efficiency.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 该工作同时贡献了多光谱无人机跟踪数据集和统一框架，对多模态跟踪和无人机视觉研究有较高价值。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST，并提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 利用光谱提示、非对称Transformer和光谱背景消除机制统一建模光谱、空间与时序特征。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在250段视频序列上验证，UNTrack在精度和效率上均优于现有最先进无人机跟踪器。

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线多目标跟踪（Online MOT）中轨迹关联易受遮挡、外观变化和检测噪声干扰的问题，提出以轨迹为中心（focusing on tracks）的关联策略。方法上可能通过增强轨迹级特征建模或轨迹预测来提升数据关联的鲁棒性，而非仅依赖逐帧检测框匹配。相比已有工作，其改进点在于将跟踪重心从检测驱动转向轨迹驱动，缓解了检测器性能波动对跟踪的传导影响。摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果，效果需结合全文实验判断。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-object tracking by shifting the focus from detection-centric association to track-centric modeling, aiming to improve robustness against occlusion, appearance variation, and detection noise. It proposes a track-focused association strategy that enhances trajectory-level feature representation or prediction. The main improvement over prior work lies in reducing the propagation of detector errors into the tracking pipeline. Quantitative results are not available in the provided abstract.

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有one-stream视觉跟踪器中单一ViT难以同时处理不同图像块间关系建模（背景需抑制、前景边界需强调）的问题，提出SPMTrack，基于为跟踪任务定制的混合专家（TMoE）实现多样化关系建模。方法将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文，并利用TMoE作为参数高效微调手段，大幅减少可训练参数。相比已有工作，其改进在于以多专家灵活处理异构关系建模并保持预训练模型泛化能力，可在不同规模上高效训练。摘要未给出具体基准数据，但强调以极小参数增量提升跟踪精度。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation that a single Vision Transformer in one-stream trackers cannot simultaneously handle heterogeneous patch-wise relation modeling, where background regions require suppressed attention while foreground boundaries need emphasis. It proposes SPMTrack with a tracking-specific mixture-of-experts (TMoE) that flexibly handles diverse relation modeling and extends it from image pairs to spatio-temporal context. TMoE also serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, substantially reducing trainable parameters while preserving pretrained generalization, enabling efficient training across scales.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将混合专家与参数高效微调引入视觉跟踪，兼顾精度与训练效率，思路新颖且实用。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于跟踪定制混合专家的SPMTrack跟踪器及参数高效微调方案。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 用TMoE灵活处理异构关系建模并将关系建模扩展到时空上下文。
2503.18338|v2.result: 以极小参数增量提升跟踪精度，摘要未给出具体基准数值。

The improvement over prior work lies in extending pretraining from static image pairs to autoregressive sequence modeling, enhancing transferability to downstream tracking. 2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）数据集规模小、类别少、模态单一，难以支撑通用场景下的鲁棒跟踪研究。本文提出GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个物体类别，每个序列同时提供点云、RGB图像和深度三种模态，支持单模态与多模态3D SOT任务，所有帧均经多轮人工精细标注。作者评估了8个代表性点云跟踪模型，发现它们在GSOT3D上性能大幅下降，表明现有方法在通用3D跟踪上仍有很大提升空间。该工作是目前面向多种通用3D跟踪任务的最大基准，为后续研究提供了重要平台。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D single object tracking (SOT) benchmarks are limited in scale, category diversity, and modality, hindering generic tracking research. This paper introduces GSOT3D, a benchmark with 620 sequences, 123K frames, and 54 object categories, each providing point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities to support single- and multi-modal 3D SOT. Eight representative point cloud trackers are evaluated and shown to degrade heavily on GSOT3D, revealing substantial room for improvement in generic 3D tracking.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该基准规模大、模态丰富、标注精细，填补了通用3D单目标跟踪评测的空白，对推动鲁棒3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大、覆盖54类、多模态的通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，并系统评测了8个代表性点云跟踪器。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供同时包含点云、RGB和深度的多模态3D SOT基准，支持单模态与多模态跟踪任务。
2412.02129|v2.result: 8个代表性点云跟踪模型在GSOT3D上性能显著下降，表明现有方法难以应对通用场景下的3D跟踪。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）现有方法主要依赖实例级检测与关联，忽略了轨迹信息在关联稳定性和分类准确性中的关键作用，尤其在遮挡和类别模糊时表现不佳。本文提出TRACT跟踪器，引入轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略提升目标身份与类别一致性，并设计即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，通过轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义丰富（TSE）充分利用轨迹信息。该方法在开放词汇跟踪场景下提升了关联稳定性和分类精度，增强了对新类别的适应能力。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OV-MOT) methods rely mainly on instance-level detection and association, overlooking trajectory information that is crucial for association stability and classification under occlusion and category ambiguity. This paper proposes TRACT, which introduces a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement (TCR) strategy and a plug-and-play trajectory classification module TraCLIP with Trajectory Feature Aggregation (TFA) and Trajectory Semantic Enrichment (TSE). The method improves both association and classification in OV-MOT, enhancing adaptability to novel classes.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地将轨迹信息引入开放词汇跟踪，思路新颖，对提升遮挡和类别模糊场景下的跟踪鲁棒性有实际意义。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息增强关联与分类的开放词汇跟踪器TRACT，包含TCR策略和TraCLIP模块。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 将轨迹一致性强化与轨迹语义丰富相结合，用于开放词汇多目标跟踪的关联与分类。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在开放词汇跟踪场景下提升了关联稳定性和分类精度，增强了对新类别的适应能力。

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 现有单目3D点跟踪器受深度模糊和遮挡困扰，而多相机方法通常需要20个以上相机且需逐序列优化，难以实用。本文提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，仅需4个相机即可前馈预测3D对应关系，实现鲁棒在线跟踪。方法融合多视角特征为统一点云，结合k近邻关联和Transformer更新估计长程3D对应，在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，并可泛化到1-8视角、24-150帧的视频。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular 3D point trackers suffer from depth ambiguity and occlusion, while multi-camera methods require over 20 cameras and tedious per-sequence optimization. This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that uses a practical number of cameras (e.g., four) to directly predict 3D correspondences in a feed-forward manner. It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud with k-NN correlation and a transformer-based update, achieving median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, and generalizing to 1-8 views and 24-150 frames.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作首次实现数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪，仅需少量相机即可在线运行，精度高且泛化性好，对动态场景3D理解有重要价值。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，仅需4个相机即可前馈预测3D对应关系。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征为统一点云，结合k近邻关联与Transformer更新实现鲁棒长程3D点跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8视角、24-150帧。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 多模态数据可提升视觉跟踪鲁棒性，但传感器同步问题常导致模态在时间上不完整，现有跟踪器因架构刚性而性能显著下降。本文首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪性能，提出一种灵活的多模态跟踪框架，通过异构混合专家融合机制（Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts）根据缺失率动态激活计算单元，并结合视频级掩码策略保证时间一致性和空间完整性。该模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整，在缺失模态情况下保持鲁棒跟踪。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: Multimodal data improves visual tracking robustness, but sensor synchronization issues often cause temporally incomplete modalities, and existing trackers degrade significantly due to rigid architectures. This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracking with temporally incomplete multimodal data and proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism that dynamically activates computational units based on missing rates, coupled with a video-level masking strategy for temporal consistency and spatial completeness. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity, maintaining robust tracking under missing modalities.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统研究时间不完整多模态跟踪问题，提出的自适应混合专家框架针对性强，对实际部署中传感器不同步场景有重要实用价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，并提出自适应混合专家融合框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 异构混合专家融合机制根据缺失率动态激活计算单元，结合视频级掩码策略保证时空一致性。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型能适应不同缺失率和场景复杂度，在模态缺失情况下保持鲁棒跟踪性能。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联依赖手工启发式规则、难以端到端优化的问题，提出 LA-MOTR，将关联过程建模为可学习的模块并嵌入 Transformer 端到端跟踪框架。方法通过可微的关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配中的固定代价设计，使检测、特征提取与关联联合优化。相比 MOTR 等端到端跟踪器，改进点在于关联策略不再固定而是随数据自适应学习。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文确认在 MOT17/MOT20 等基准上的提升幅度。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted heuristics for data association in multi-object tracking, which hinders end-to-end optimization. It proposes LA-MOTR, which formulates association as a learnable module within a Transformer-based tracking pipeline, enabling joint optimization of detection, feature extraction, and association. Compared with prior end-to-end trackers such as MOTR, the association strategy becomes data-adaptive rather than fixed. Quantitative results on standard MOT benchmarks are not provided in the abstract.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 将数据关联从固定代价匹配转为可学习模块是端到端跟踪的合理演进方向，但需关注其是否真正优于精心调参的匈牙利匹配基线。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习的关联模块 LA-MOTR，实现检测与关联的端到端联合优化。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 用可微、可学习的关联预测替代传统手工代价矩阵与固定匹配策略。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 摘要未报告具体指标，效果需以正文实验为准。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇 3D 实例分割（OV-3DIS）中已有概念彼此互补却未被有效整合的问题，提出一套将多种概念组合并精炼的两阶段方案：3D 提议生成与实例分类。方法采用基于 3D 跟踪的提议聚合生成候选，并通过迭代合并/移除消除重叠与残缺提议；分类阶段用 Alpha-CLIP 替代标准 CLIP，以对象掩码作为 alpha 通道抑制背景噪声，同时提出标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数归一化文本-提议相似度以过滤假正例。相比已有 OV-3DIS 方法取得新的 SOTA，摘要未给出具体数值但强调精度提升。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS), observing that existing concepts are complementary rather than mutually exclusive. It proposes a two-stage recipe combining 3D proposal generation via tracking-based aggregation with iterative merging/removal, and instance classification using Alpha-CLIP with object masks as an alpha channel plus a standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score for false-positive filtering. The approach achieves new state-of-the-art results on OV-3DIS benchmarks.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 工程整合度高、细节打磨扎实，Alpha-CLIP 与 SMS 的设计对开放词汇 3D 感知有直接借鉴价值。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出整合多种互补概念的 OV-3DIS 两阶段方案，达到新的 SOTA。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 用 Alpha-CLIP 掩码增强的对象中心表征与 SMS 相似度归一化提升开放词汇分类精度。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在 OV-3DIS 基准上取得新的最优性能，有效抑制假正例。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对动态城市场景建模与渲染中高质量方法依赖昂贵人工目标轨迹标注、而自监督方法难以准确捕捉动态物体运动并正确分解场景导致渲染伪影的问题，提出 AD-GS 自监督框架。核心是可学习运动模型，将局部感知 B 样条曲线与全局感知三角函数结合，实现灵活且精确的动态物体建模；无需完整语义标注，仅用简化伪 2D 分割自动划分物体与背景，用动态高斯与双向时序可见性掩码表示物体，并引入可见性推理与物理刚性正则提升鲁棒性。实验表明该无标注模型显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high-quality dynamic urban scene rendering, where existing methods rely on costly manual object tracklet annotations while self-supervised approaches fail to capture dynamic motion and decompose scenes properly. AD-GS introduces a learnable motion model combining locality-aware B-spline curves with global-aware trigonometric functions, automatic object/background segmentation via simplified pseudo 2D segmentation, dynamic Gaussians with bidirectional temporal visibility masks, and visibility reasoning plus physical rigidity regularization. The annotation-free model significantly outperforms prior annotation-free methods and is competitive with annotation-dependent ones.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 在无标注条件下逼近有标注方法的渲染质量，对自动驾驶仿真数据生成有实用价值。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工轨迹标注的自监督 B 样条高斯泼溅框架 AD-GS。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 局部 B 样条与全局三角函数的混合运动模型，配合双向时序可见性掩码与刚性正则。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著超越现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法性能相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中现有跟踪器受框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立、模态交互不足，导致开放词汇分类与跟踪性能受限的问题，提出 OVTR——首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略，为后续帧建立多个高层类别先验以实现稳定分类与连续跟踪；引入双分支结构增强泛化能力与深度多模态交互，并在解码器中加入保护性策略。实验表明其在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越此前跟踪器，同时推理更快、显著减少计算开销。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary multiple object tracking, where existing trackers suffer from rigid framework structures, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modality interaction. OVTR is the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker jointly modeling motion, appearance, and category, featuring a Category Information Propagation (CIP) strategy that builds high-level category priors for subsequent frames, a dual-branch structure for generalization and deep multimodal interaction, and protective strategies in the decoder. It surpasses prior trackers on the open-vocabulary MOT benchmark with faster inference and substantially reduced computation.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 把开放词汇能力与端到端跟踪统一建模，CIP 策略对跨帧类别一致性有实际意义，值得跟踪方向研究者关注。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器 OVTR，统一建模运动、外观与类别。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播策略为后续帧提供高层类别先验，配合双分支多模态交互与解码器保护策略。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越已有跟踪器，推理更快且计算量显著降低。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中长序列、像素级稠密 3D 运动跟踪受限于计算效率或稀疏跟踪的问题，提出 DELTA，可高效跟踪视频中每个像素的 3D 运动。方法采用全局-局部联合注意力在低分辨率下跟踪，再用基于 Transformer 的上采样器恢复高分辨率预测；同时系统探究深度表示对跟踪性能的影响，发现 log-depth 为最优选择。实验表明 DELTA 比此前方法快 8 倍以上，并在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪多个基准上取得新的 SOTA。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles dense 3D motion tracking from monocular videos, where existing methods are limited by computational inefficiency or sparse tracking. DELTA tracks every pixel in 3D using joint global-local attention at reduced resolution followed by a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions, and identifies log-depth as the optimal depth representation. It runs over 8x faster than prior methods and achieves new state-of-the-art results on both 2D and 3D dense tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 在效率与精度上同时取得突破，log-depth 的分析对 3D 感知中的深度表示选择有参考价值。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密长程 3D 像素级跟踪方法 DELTA。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 全局-局部联合注意力加 Transformer 上采样的两阶段架构，并系统验证 log-depth 表示的优势。
2410.24211|v2.result: 推理速度较此前方法提升 8 倍以上，在 2D/3D 稠密跟踪基准上均达 SOTA。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对从互联网教学视频中提取被操作物体时序一致的 6D 位姿轨迹这一难题——拍摄条件不可控、物体运动细微且动态、且未知物体精确网格——提出一套完整方案。方法首先在无物体先验下估计 6D 位姿：从大规模模型库检索相似 CAD 模型、与输入图像做 6D 对齐、并基于场景标定物体绝对尺度；其次跨帧跟踪检测物体以提取平滑 6D 轨迹，再通过轨迹优化重定向到机械臂配置空间。在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上进行了充分评估与消融。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses extracting temporally consistent 6D pose trajectories of manipulated objects from Internet instructional videos, where uncontrolled capture conditions, subtle dynamic motion, and unknown object meshes pose major challenges. The method retrieves a similar CAD model from a large-scale database, performs 6D alignment with the input image, and grounds absolute scale, then tracks objects across frames to obtain smooth 6D trajectories that are retargeted to a robot manipulator via trajectory optimization. It is thoroughly evaluated and ablated on YCB-V, HOPE-Video, and a new dataset.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 面向机器人操作的真实视频 6D 位姿跟踪，问题设定贴近实用，但与本领域核心感知任务的交集有限。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出从互联网视频中无先验提取物体 6D 位姿轨迹并重定向至机械臂的完整流程。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 结合 CAD 模型检索、6D 对齐与绝对尺度标定的无先验位姿估计，及轨迹优化重定向。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上完成充分评估与消融验证。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂场景（群舞、团队运动、动物群体）中多目标跟踪面临的目标协同运动、相互遮挡与长时轨迹依赖建模难题，现有方法难以同时建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时序遮挡。本文提出 Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多条轨迹各自的选择性状态空间（Mamba）实现多轨迹联合建模，自回归预测每条序列的未来 track query 并保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆；并将其嵌入 tracking-by-propagation 框架形成 SambaMOTR，同时提出处理不确定观测的 MaskObs 技术。在 DanceTrack、SportsMOT 等数据集上取得领先性能，显著提升了对协同运动与遮挡场景的跟踪鲁棒性。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multiple object tracking in complex scenarios where objects move in coordinated patterns, occlude each other, and exhibit long-term trajectory dependencies, which existing methods struggle to model jointly. It introduces Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-space (Mamba) recurrences to jointly process tracklets, autoregressively predicting future track queries while maintaining synchronized long-term memory across tracklets. Integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework as SambaMOTR, together with a MaskObs technique for uncertain observations, it achieves state-of-the-art results on challenging benchmarks such as DanceTrack and SportsMOT.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 将 Mamba 状态空间模型引入多目标跟踪并显式同步多轨迹记忆，思路新颖，对协同运动与遮挡场景的跟踪有实质推进，值得关注。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出线性时间的同步集合序列模型 Samba 及跟踪框架 SambaMOTR，统一建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 用同步的多选择性状态空间（Mamba）联合建模多条轨迹，并设计 MaskObs 处理不确定观测。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在 DanceTrack、SportsMOT 等复杂运动跟踪基准上取得领先性能，显著提升遮挡与协同运动场景下的跟踪鲁棒性。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中检测与跟踪通常分阶段进行，且运动模型多依赖线性假设，难以应对复杂非线性运动。该论文提出同时检测与跟踪的框架，并引入运动建模（Motion Modelling）以联合优化检测与轨迹关联。相比已有两阶段方法，其改进在于将检测与运动预测耦合，减少误差累积。在 MOT 基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度（如 MOTA/IDF1 提升），具体数据需参见原文。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object tracking (MOT) where detection and tracking are typically decoupled and motion models rely on linear assumptions. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework with motion modelling to jointly optimize detection and trajectory association. Compared with two-stage pipelines, it reduces error accumulation and achieves competitive tracking accuracy on MOT benchmarks.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 将检测与运动建模联合优化，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有实际参考价值。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出同时检测与跟踪并融合运动建模的 MOT 框架。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 把运动模型嵌入检测-跟踪联合优化，缓解分阶段误差累积。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪精度。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: 该论文研究多目标跟踪（MOT）的对抗攻击问题，指出仅攻击检测器不足以破坏跟踪，因为跟踪器可通过关联恢复目标。作者提出针对 MOT 的对抗攻击方法，同时干扰检测与数据关联。相比仅攻击检测的已有工作，其改进在于揭示跟踪系统的额外脆弱性。实验表明该攻击能显著降低跟踪性能（如 MOTA/IDF1 下降），具体数值见原文。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper studies adversarial attacks on multi-object tracking (MOT), showing that fooling detection alone is insufficient because trackers can recover targets via association. It proposes an attack that simultaneously disrupts detection and data association. Compared with detection-only attacks, it exposes additional vulnerabilities of tracking systems and significantly degrades tracking performance.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 从对抗安全角度审视 MOT，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性研究有启发。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出同时攻击检测与关联的 MOT 对抗攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 证明仅攻击检测不足以破坏跟踪，需联合干扰关联。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 攻击显著降低 MOT 跟踪性能。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中的轨迹关联可建模为图优化问题，但传统方法难以处理轨迹分裂与合并。该论文提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型，将多目标跟踪转化为带约束的路径优化问题。相比已有图优化方法，其改进在于能更灵活地处理轨迹间的复杂交互。在 MOT 数据集上验证了关联精度提升，具体指标见原文。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper formulates multi-object tracking as a graph optimization problem and proposes a Lifted Disjoint Paths model to handle trajectory splitting and merging. Compared with existing graph-based methods, it more flexibly models complex interactions among trajectories. Experiments on MOT datasets demonstrate improved association accuracy.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 为 MOT 关联提供新的组合优化视角，适合关注跟踪底层建模的研究者。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型用于多目标跟踪关联。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 将轨迹分裂/合并纳入统一路径优化框架。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 在 MOT 数据集上提升关联精度。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏局部归纳偏置、局部细节建模不足的问题，本文提出Doubly-Fused ViT，通过双重融合机制将局部表示信息注入ViT。方法在ViT的注意力计算与特征聚合两个层面融合卷积或局部窗口特征，以增强局部建模能力。相比已有仅单路融合局部信息的ViT变体，双重融合更充分地结合全局自注意力与局部表示。摘要未给出具体实验数据，需查看正文验证在分类/检测等任务上的增益。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of local inductive bias in Vision Transformers by proposing Doubly-Fused ViT, which fuses local representation information into ViT at two levels. The method injects convolutional or local-window features into both attention computation and feature aggregation to strengthen local modeling. Compared with prior ViT variants that fuse local information only once, the doubly-fused design more fully combines global self-attention with local representations.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 思路直观，对关注ViT局部-全局建模的研究者有参考价值，但需正文实验数据支撑其有效性。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出双重融合局部表示的ViT架构，缓解ViT局部建模不足。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 在注意力与特征聚合两个层面同时融合局部信息。

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: 针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习依赖像素级伪造位置标注、而此类标注难以获取的问题，本文提出无监督不一致感知方法UIA-ViT。方法仅使用视频级标签，利用ViT自注意力图中patch间关系天然表示一致性关系，设计了无监督Patch一致性学习（UPCL）与渐进式学习等组件。相比需要合成数据或成对真假图像差分生成伪标签的已有方法，UIA-ViT无需像素级标注且标签更连续。摘要未给出具体指标，但声称在泛化性上优于依赖像素级标注的方法。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: To overcome the reliance on pixel-level forgery annotations for intra-frame inconsistency learning in face forgery detection, this paper proposes UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method based on Vision Transformer. Using only video-level labels, it exploits the self-attention map among patch embeddings to represent consistency relations, with components including Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning and progressive learning. Unlike prior methods that need synthesized data or paired real-fake differences for pseudo labels, UIA-ViT requires no pixel-level annotations and yields more continuous labels.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 将ViT自注意力用于无监督不一致性建模的思路较新颖，但与人脸伪造检测相关，对自动驾驶感知领域相关度有限。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出仅用视频级标签的无监督不一致感知ViT人脸伪造检测框架。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力图天然表示patch一致性关系，免去像素级标注。
2210.12752|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 针对ViT决策过程不透明、缺乏可解释性的问题，本文提出ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合，实现可解释的视觉Transformer。方法在ViT特征之上构建神经树结构，使分类决策可沿树路径追溯，从而给出可解释的推理过程。相比已有可解释方法（如注意力可视化或事后解释），ViT-NeT将可解释性内嵌于模型结构中。摘要未提供具体实验数据，需正文验证在保持精度的同时提供解释的能力。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: To address the lack of interpretability in Vision Transformers, this paper proposes ViT-NeT, which combines ViT with a neural tree decoder to build an interpretable vision transformer. A neural tree is constructed on top of ViT features so that classification decisions can be traced along tree paths, yielding interpretable reasoning. Unlike post-hoc explanation or attention visualization methods, ViT-NeT embeds interpretability into the model architecture.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 将神经树与ViT结合以提升可解释性，对关注可解释视觉模型的研究者有参考价值。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出结合神经树解码器的可解释ViT框架ViT-NeT。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 以神经树结构内嵌可解释推理路径，而非事后解释。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对主流ViT检测器依赖多尺度层级设计、结构复杂的问题，本文提出一种简单的单尺度ViT用于目标检测与实例分割。方法去除多尺度金字塔结构，采用单一尺度的ViT骨干并配合相应检测/分割头，简化整体架构。相比Swin等多尺度ViT检测器，该设计更简洁且易于实现。摘要未给出具体数据，但声称在检测与实例分割任务上取得有竞争力的结果。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: To address the complexity of multi-scale hierarchical designs in mainstream ViT detectors, this paper proposes a simple single-scale Vision Transformer for object detection and instance segmentation. It removes the multi-scale pyramid and adopts a single-scale ViT backbone with corresponding detection/segmentation heads. Compared with multi-scale ViT detectors such as Swin, the design is simpler and easier to implement while remaining competitive.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 单尺度ViT检测器的简洁设计对检测与自动驾驶感知研究者有较高参考价值。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出用于目标检测与实例分割的简单单尺度ViT架构。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 去除多尺度层级结构，以单尺度ViT简化检测器设计。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: 针对自注意力随图像尺寸二次增长、难以作为通用视觉骨干的问题，本文提出多轴注意力（multi-axis attention），由分块局部注意力与空洞全局注意力组成，在任意分辨率下以线性复杂度实现全局-局部空间交互。进一步将注意力与卷积融合，提出分层骨干MaxViT，可在整个网络（包括高分辨率早期阶段）实现全局感知。在ImageNet-1K上无额外数据达到86.5% top-1，ImageNet-21K预训练后进一步提升，并在分类、检测、分割等多任务上取得领先结果。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: To address the quadratic scaling of self-attention with image size, this paper introduces multi-axis attention, composed of blocked local and dilated global attention, enabling global-local spatial interactions at arbitrary resolutions with linear complexity. Blending this attention with convolutions yields a hierarchical backbone, MaxViT, which can 'see' globally throughout the network including high-resolution stages. MaxViT attains 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 without extra data and state-of-the-art results across classification, detection, and segmentation.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: MaxViT是通用视觉骨干的重要工作，线性复杂度的多轴注意力对检测、BEV等下游任务具有直接借鉴价值。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出线性复杂度的多轴注意力及分层骨干MaxViT。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 分块局部+空洞全局注意力与卷积融合，实现全网络全局感知。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K无额外数据86.5% top-1，多任务达到SOTA。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（online CL）中无任务边界数据流下灾难性遗忘与稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，本文提出对比视觉Transformer框架CVT。方法设计了隐式捕获历史任务信息的外部注意力机制、每类可学习focus以累积旧类知识，并基于focus设计focal对比损失以重平衡新旧类对比学习，同时采用双分类器结构解耦当前类学习与已观测类平衡。实验表明在在线CL基准上以更少参数取得SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: To tackle catastrophic forgetting and the stability-plasticity trade-off in online continual learning without task boundaries, this paper proposes Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT). It designs an external attention mechanism that implicitly captures previous task information, learnable per-class focuses that accumulate prior knowledge, a focal contrastive loss to rebalance new-versus-past class contrastive learning, and a dual-classifier structure decoupling current-class learning from balancing observed classes. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 将ViT与对比学习结合用于在线持续学习，对关注持续学习与Transformer的研究者有参考价值。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出基于ViT的focal对比学习在线持续学习框架CVT。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 外部注意力+可学习类focus+focal对比损失+双分类器结构。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在线CL基准上以更少参数取得SOTA并缓解遗忘。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏归纳偏置、训练数据效率低和局部语义表征弱的问题，本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观设计对分层ViT性能的影响，重点分析token embedding层（即卷积嵌入CE）如何注入归纳偏置。作者将最优CE配置应用于4个最新SOTA ViT并构建了CETNets系列通用骨干网络。在ImageNet-1K上CETNets取得84.9% Top-1准确率，验证了卷积嵌入对分层ViT的显著增益。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how the macro architecture of hybrid CNN/ViT models enhances hierarchical ViTs, focusing on the role of convolutional embedding (CE) in injecting inductive bias. The optimal CE configuration is applied to four recent state-of-the-art ViTs, yielding a family of generic backbones named CETNets. CETNets achieve 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, demonstrating the effectiveness of convolutional embedding.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 对ViT骨干网络设计有参考价值，尤其适合需要高效视觉backbone的感知系统，但未直接涉及自动驾驶任务。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了卷积嵌入在分层ViT中的作用并提出了CETNets通用骨干网络。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面研究卷积嵌入对ViT归纳偏置的注入机制。

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: 针对vanilla自注意力机制依赖预定义固定计算维度、缺乏面向上下文的泛化能力的问题，本文提出Scalable Self-Attention（SSA），利用两个缩放因子释放Q/K/V矩阵维度并与输入解绑，同时提出Interactive Window-based Self-Attention（IWSA）通过重新合并独立value token和聚合相邻窗口空间信息建立非重叠区域间的交互。交替堆叠SSA和IWSA构成ScalableViT，在ImageNet-1K上ScalableViT-S比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%、比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) that uses two scaling factors to decouple query/key/value dimensions from the input, and Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) that re-merges independent value tokens to enable cross-window interaction. Stacking SSA and IWSA yields ScalableViT, which outperforms Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 对ViT注意力机制的可扩展性设计有启发，但属于通用视觉骨干改进，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力和交互窗口自注意力机制构建ScalableViT。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过缩放因子解绑Q/K/V维度实现面向上下文的泛化。

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT因token-to-token比较带来巨大计算负担、现有硬丢弃token方法在高丢弃率下会丢失关键token的问题，本文提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT。具体设计了Token Slimming Module（TSM）通过动态token聚合将冗余token软整合为少量信息量大的token，并引入Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD）框架，利用反向TSM（RTSM）以自编码器方式灵活重校准非结构化token。该方法在高瘦身率下仍能保持判别性token关系，提升ViT推理效率。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes SiT, a generic self-slimmed learning approach for ViTs, featuring a Token Slimming Module (TSM) that softly aggregates redundant tokens into fewer informative ones via dynamic token aggregation. A Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with a reverse TSM is introduced to recalibrate unstructured tokens. SiT maintains discriminative token relations even at high slimming ratios, improving inference efficiency.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: 对ViT推理加速有实用价值，token软聚合思路可迁移至自动驾驶实时感知中的高效骨干设计。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出自瘦身学习框架SiT实现ViT的token动态聚合与特征重校准。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 用软聚合替代硬丢弃token，并通过反向TSM蒸馏重校准非结构化token。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高瘦身率下仍保持判别性token关系，有效提升ViT推理效率。

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉关系推理中需同时解决实体识别、语义关系推断与系统性泛化三个难题，本文以ViT为基座，提出概念特征字典，使训练时可用概念键灵活检索图像特征，并据此设计全局关系推理与局部物体中心对应两个概念引导辅助任务。为评估系统性泛化，作者为HICO和GQA构建了系统性划分。RelViT在关系推理与系统性泛化上优于基线ViT，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This work tackles visual relational reasoning, which jointly requires entity identification, semantic relation inference, and systematic generalization. It introduces a concept-feature dictionary enabling flexible image feature retrieval with concept keys, and two concept-guided auxiliary tasks for global relational reasoning and local object-centric correspondence. Systematic splits for HICO and GQA are proposed to evaluate generalization, and RelViT improves over ViT baselines, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 将概念字典与ViT结合提升关系推理与系统性泛化的思路有新意，但任务偏认知视觉，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的ViT（RelViT）及概念特征字典与两个辅助任务，并给出HICO/GQA的系统性泛化划分。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 用概念键在训练时检索图像特征，以全局与局部辅助任务同时促进关系推理和物体中心对应学习。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在关系推理与系统性泛化上优于基线ViT，摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在ImageNet训练后过度依赖局部纹理、形状信息利用不足、难以泛化到分布外真实数据的问题，本文在ViT输入层加入由矢量量化编码器产生的离散token，与连续像素token互补。离散token对小扰动不变且单token信息量低，促使ViT学习不变的全局信息。在四种架构变体上，该方法在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上最高提升12%鲁棒性，同时保持ImageNet精度。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses ViTs' over-reliance on local textures and poor shape utilization, which harms out-of-distribution generalization. It augments ViT's input layer with discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder, whose perturbation invariance and lower per-token information encourage learning invariant global features. Across four architecture variants, the method improves robustness by up to 12% on seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks while maintaining ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 改动简单但有效，鲁棒性提升幅度可观且不损失精度，对需要分布外鲁棒性的感知模型有借鉴意义。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在ViT输入层引入矢量量化离散token的简单架构修改以增强鲁棒性。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用离散token的扰动不变性与低信息量特性，引导ViT学习不变的全局表示。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上最高提升12%，同时保持ImageNet精度。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: 针对ViT中自注意力计算复杂度随token数平方增长、且缺乏显式聚类结构的问题，本文提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention（PaCa），将patch token与可学习的簇中心进行注意力交互以降低计算量并增强语义聚合。方法通过聚类式注意力替代标准全局注意力，在保持精度的同时减少计算开销。相比已有稀疏/窗口注意力方案，PaCa在分类与检测任务上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告在ImageNet等基准上优于基线ViT。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention in Vision Transformers by proposing Patch-to-Cluster Attention (PaCa), which performs attention between patch tokens and learnable cluster centers. The method reduces computation while enhancing semantic aggregation, offering a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than sparse or windowed attention. Experiments on ImageNet and downstream tasks show improvements over baseline ViTs.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 为ViT注意力机制提供了一种聚类式高效替代方案，思路清晰，对高效视觉骨干设计有参考价值。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention，将patch与簇中心进行注意力交互以降低复杂度。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 用可学习簇中心替代全token注意力，兼顾效率与语义聚合。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在ImageNet等基准上取得优于基线ViT的精度-效率权衡。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: 针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题，本文提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将标准softmax自注意力切换为线性角度注意力（linear-angular attention），从而压缩计算量。方法通过训练时保留标准注意力、推理时替换为线性近似，实现无需重训练的高效推理。相比已有线性注意力方法，Castling-ViT在保持精度的同时显著降低推理FLOPs。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告在ImageNet上精度损失极小。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: This paper tackles the high inference cost of self-attention in ViTs by proposing Castling-ViT, which switches standard softmax attention to linear-angular attention at inference time. The approach preserves accuracy while reducing inference FLOPs without retraining, outperforming prior linear attention methods. Experiments on ImageNet show minimal accuracy drop.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 提出了一种推理时注意力切换策略，对ViT部署加速有实用价值，但创新性相对有限。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出Castling-ViT，在推理时将softmax注意力切换为线性角度注意力以压缩计算。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 训练与推理注意力解耦，推理时无需重训练即可线性化。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 在ImageNet上以极小精度损失显著降低推理FLOPs。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时存储与计算开销大、且现有dyadic算术仅适用于CNN同质性条件而无法处理ViT非线性组件的问题，本文提出I-ViT，一种面向ViT的整数量化方案。方法对线性操作（MatMul、Dense）采用dyadic算术的整数流水线，对非线性操作（Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm）提出轻量级整数近似方法（如Shiftmax、ShiftGELU），实现全整数推理。相比已有量化方法，I-ViT首次实现ViT全计算图的整数算术与位移操作，无任何浮点运算。实验在ImageNet上达到与浮点模型相当的精度，并显著加速推理。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of integer-only inference for Vision Transformers, where dyadic arithmetic designed for CNNs fails on non-linear components. I-ViT proposes an integer-only quantization scheme that uses dyadic arithmetic for linear operations and lightweight integer approximations (Shiftmax, ShiftGELU) for non-linear ones, enabling the entire inference graph with integer arithmetic and bit-shifting. It achieves accuracy comparable to floating-point models on ImageNet with significant inference speedup.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 解决了ViT整数量化的关键开放问题，方法系统且实验充分，对边缘部署有重要实用价值。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出I-ViT，首个实现ViT全计算图整数-only推理的量化方案。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 为Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm等非线性操作设计轻量整数近似方法。
2207.01405|v2.result: 在ImageNet上达到与浮点模型相当精度，并显著加速边缘推理。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段HOI检测器因旧骨干网络和缺乏对人类交互感知过程建模而性能低于一阶段方法的问题，本文提出ViPLO，基于ViT的姿态条件自环图。方法包括适用于ViT骨干的MOA（masking with overlapped area）特征提取模块，解决patch量化问题；以及姿态条件自环图结构，用人体关节局部特征更新人体节点编码，使分类器聚焦特定关节以识别交互类型。相比已有两阶段方法，ViPLO在HICO-DET等基准上取得更优性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告超越现有两阶段检测器。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap of two-stage HOI detectors caused by outdated backbones and lack of human interaction perception modeling. ViPLO proposes a ViT-based pose-conditioned self-loop graph, including an MOA module for ViT feature extraction and a pose-conditioned self-loop structure that updates human node encoding with joint local features. It outperforms existing two-stage detectors on HICO-DET.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 将ViT与姿态条件图结合用于HOI检测，思路新颖，但领域相关性对自动驾驶感知较弱。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出ViPLO，基于ViT的姿态条件自环图用于人-物交互检测。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: MOA模块解决ViT patch量化问题，姿态条件自环图聚焦人体关节。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HICO-DET等基准上超越现有两阶段HOI检测器。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于距离投影的LiDAR点云3D语义分割方法长期依赖2D CNN、未受益于ViT最新进展的问题，本文提出RangeViT，探索ViT在投影式3D语义分割中的应用。方法保留与RGB图像相同的ViT骨干以利用大规模图像预训练知识，并通过替换为定制卷积等补偿ViT缺乏的归纳偏置。相比已有投影式方法，RangeViT在SemanticKITTI等基准上取得state-of-the-art结果。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告结合图像预训练ViT后性能显著提升。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether projection-based 3D semantic segmentation can benefit from Vision Transformers. RangeViT preserves the same ViT backbone as for RGB images to exploit large-scale image pre-training, and compensates for ViT's lack of inductive bias with tailored convolutions. It achieves state-of-the-art results on SemanticKITTI, demonstrating the effectiveness of image-pretrained ViTs for LiDAR segmentation.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 将图像预训练ViT成功迁移到LiDAR投影分割，对自动驾驶3D感知有直接参考价值，实验扎实。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，将图像预训练ViT应用于投影式LiDAR 3D语义分割。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 保留RGB ViT骨干并定制卷积补偿归纳偏置，利用图像预训练知识。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI等基准上取得state-of-the-art分割性能。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT自注意力方法（稀疏全局或窗口注意力）牺牲局部特征学习或依赖手工设计、且局部注意力模块使用低效Im2Col或特定CUDA内核难以泛化的问题，本文提出Slide Attention，一种基于通用卷积操作的高效局部注意力模块。方法从行视角重新解释Im2Col并用Depthwise Convolution高效替代，进而提出deformed shifting模块。相比已有局部注意力，Slide Attention在效率、灵活性和泛化性上更优，在分类与检测任务上取得有竞争力的结果。摘要未给出具体数值。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of existing ViT self-attention methods that either compromise local feature learning or rely on inefficient Im2Col/CUDA kernels. Slide Attention reinterprets Im2Col from a row-based perspective, substitutes it with Depthwise Convolution, and introduces a deformed shifting module. It achieves high efficiency, flexibility, and generalizability, with competitive results on classification and detection.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 为ViT局部注意力提供了一种基于通用卷积的高效实现，工程实用性强，但理论创新有限。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出Slide Attention，用通用卷积操作实现高效局部注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重新解释Im2Col并用Depthwise Convolution替代，提出deformed shifting。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在分类与检测任务上取得有竞争力的精度-效率表现。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中标注成本高、纯卷积或纯Transformer半监督方法在局部细节与全局上下文之间难以兼顾的问题，本文提出SemiCVT半监督卷积视觉Transformer。方法将卷积与自注意力混合的骨干网络嵌入半监督分割框架，利用少量标注与大量无标注图像联合训练，通过一致性正则与伪标签提升分割精度。相比纯CNN或纯ViT半监督基线，SemiCVT在标注稀缺时能更有效地利用无标签数据。摘要未给出具体数值，但作者声称在多个分割基准上取得了优于已有半监督方法的性能。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised semantic segmentation where pixel-level annotations are scarce. It proposes SemiCVT, a hybrid convolutional vision transformer backbone integrated into a semi-supervised segmentation framework that exploits both labeled and unlabeled images via consistency regularization and pseudo-labeling. Compared with pure CNN or pure ViT semi-supervised baselines, SemiCVT better balances local detail and global context, yielding improved segmentation accuracy under limited supervision.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 将卷积与ViT混合用于半监督分割的思路对自动驾驶场景中标注昂贵的分割任务有参考价值，但创新性偏中等。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer分割框架SemiCVT，融合卷积局部建模与Transformer全局建模。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 在半监督分割中引入卷积-Transformer混合骨干，兼顾局部细节与全局上下文。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 在标注稀缺条件下取得优于已有半监督分割方法的性能。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督小样本分类与分割中缺乏像素级标注的问题，本文利用自监督预训练的ViT，通过自注意力产生的token相关性同时完成分类与分割。方法用自监督ViT生成的注意力图作为像素级伪标签，仅使用图像级标签训练，并进一步提出伪标签增强器以支持少量真值像素标签的混合监督设置。在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上，该方法在多种监督设置下均取得显著性能提升，尤其在几乎没有像素级标签时优势明显。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This work tackles weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by exploiting a self-supervised pretrained ViT. Token correlations from self-attention are used to produce classification and segmentation predictions, with attention maps serving as pixel-level pseudo-labels trained only on image-level labels. A pseudo-label enhancer further supports a mixed-supervision setting, and experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show significant gains, especially when little-to-no pixel-level supervision is available.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 将自监督ViT的注意力先验用于弱监督小样本分割，思路新颖且实验充分，对开放集/小样本感知有启发。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出基于自监督ViT的弱监督小样本分类与分割框架，并引入伪标签增强器支持混合监督。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 利用自监督ViT自注意力图作为像素级伪标签，实现仅图像级标签下的分割。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i多种监督设置下取得显著性能提升。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer中注意力机制容易过拟合、训练正则化不足的问题，本文提出DropKey正则化方法。方法在注意力计算中对key进行随机丢弃，等价于对注意力图施加结构化dropout，从而缓解注意力过度集中并提升泛化能力。相比标准dropout或DropPath，DropKey更贴合注意力机制的特性。摘要未提供具体数值，但作者声称在图像分类等任务上带来稳定提升。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper targets overfitting and insufficient regularization in Vision Transformers by proposing DropKey, a regularization that randomly drops keys in the attention computation, effectively applying structured dropout on attention maps. Compared with standard dropout or DropPath, DropKey better matches the attention mechanism and is reported to yield consistent improvements on tasks such as image classification.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: 作为ViT正则化技巧，方法简单通用，可迁移到检测/分割骨干训练，但单独重要性有限。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出面向Vision Transformer注意力机制的DropKey正则化方法。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 在注意力计算中对key进行随机丢弃，实现注意力图的结构化dropout。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 在图像分类等任务上带来稳定的性能提升。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有音视频模型依赖大规模音频预训练和外部音频编码器、微调成本高的问题，本文研究冻结的纯视觉预训练ViT能否泛化到音视频任务。提出LAVISH适配器，在冻结ViT的每一层注入少量可训练参数，并用一组latent token构成注意力瓶颈来融合视觉与音频，避免标准交叉注意力的二次复杂度。在多个音视频任务上，该方法以更少可调参数、无需音频预训练和外部编码器，取得与模态专用方法相当甚至更好的性能。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This work investigates whether a frozen, visually pretrained ViT can generalize to audio-visual tasks without finetuning its original parameters. It proposes the LAVISH adapter, which injects a small number of trainable parameters into every layer of a frozen ViT and uses latent tokens as an attention bottleneck to fuse visual and audio cues, avoiding the quadratic cost of standard cross-attention. Across several audio-visual tasks, LAVISH matches or surpasses modality-specific methods while using fewer tunable parameters and no audio pretraining or external audio encoders.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 参数高效的多模态适配思路对自动驾驶中冻结大模型+多传感器融合有直接借鉴意义。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的LAVISH适配器，使冻结视觉ViT泛化到音视频任务。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 用latent token注意力瓶颈替代标准交叉注意力，实现高效音视频融合。
2212.07983|v2.result: 以更少可调参数在多个音视频任务上达到或超过模态专用方法。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Vision Transformer推理速度受内存低效操作（如MHSA中的张量重排和逐元素函数）限制、难以实时应用的问题，本文提出高效ViT系列EfficientViT。方法设计三明治结构的building block，在高效FFN之间放置单个内存受限的MHSA以提升内存效率并增强通道通信；同时发现注意力图在多头间高度相似，提出级联组注意力，将完整特征的不同划分送入不同注意力头，既节省计算又提升注意力多样性。实验表明EfficientViT在速度与精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，例如EfficientViT-M5在保持竞争力的精度下显著提升吞吐。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the memory-inefficient operations, such as tensor reshaping and element-wise functions in MHSA, that bound the inference speed of Vision Transformers. It proposes EfficientViT, featuring a sandwich-layout block with a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFN layers, and a cascaded group attention module that feeds different feature splits to different heads to reduce redundancy and increase attention diversity. Experiments show EfficientViT outperforms existing efficient models in the speed-accuracy trade-off, e.g., EfficientViT-M5 achieving competitive accuracy with substantially higher throughput.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 面向实时部署的高效ViT设计，对自动驾驶感知的实时性需求有较强实用价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出高效Vision Transformer系列EfficientViT，优化内存效率与注意力冗余。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 三明治布局的MHSA/FFN结构与级联组注意力机制。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，EfficientViT-M5取得显著吞吐提升。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: 针对标准Vision Transformer在欧几里得平面上建模、难以处理球面信号（如全景/鱼眼图像）的问题，本文提出HEAL-SWIN，将Swin Transformer的层次化窗口注意力机制迁移到二十面体球面网格（HEALPix）上。方法通过球面窗口划分与移位操作实现旋转等变与尺度一致性，相比直接在球面像素上应用ViT的方案更高效。在球面图像分类与分割任务上取得优于球面CNN与平面ViT的精度，同时保持较低参数量。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between standard Euclidean Vision Transformers and spherical signals such as panoramic or fisheye imagery. It proposes HEAL-SWIN, which ports the hierarchical shifted-window attention of Swin Transformer onto the icosahedral HEALPix spherical grid, enabling rotation-equivariant and scale-consistent processing. Experiments on spherical classification and segmentation show improved accuracy over spherical CNNs and planar ViTs at moderate parameter cost.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 为球面视觉感知提供了可扩展的Transformer骨干，对全景/鱼眼自动驾驶感知有潜在价值，但当前任务与BEV/3D检测尚有距离。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出首个基于HEALPix球面网格的层次化窗口注意力ViT。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 将Swin的移位窗口机制推广到球面二十面体网格，实现球面旋转等变注意力。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.result: 在球面分类与分割基准上超越球面CNN与平面ViT，参数量可控。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对医学图像可变形配准中卷积网络感受野受限、难以建模长程形变的问题，本文提出H-ViT，一种层次化ViT配准框架。方法在多个尺度上交替使用窗口注意力与可变形注意力，并引入跨尺度特征交互模块以估计稠密形变场。相比纯CNN配准网络，H-ViT在公开配准基准上取得更低的形变误差与更高的Dice指标，同时保持可接受的计算开销。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper targets deformable image registration, where CNNs struggle with long-range deformation due to limited receptive fields. It proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical ViT that alternates window and deformable attention across scales with cross-scale feature interaction to predict dense deformation fields. It achieves lower registration error and higher Dice than CNN baselines on public benchmarks.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 层次化ViT用于稠密预测的思路对BEV/占据预测有借鉴意义，但应用场景偏医学，与自动驾驶直接相关度有限。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出层次化ViT可变形配准框架H-ViT。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 在多尺度上融合窗口注意力与可变形注意力并做跨尺度交互。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.result: 在公开配准基准上形变误差与Dice均优于CNN方法。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: 针对ViT在长尾数据集上训练时尾部类别性能严重退化的问题，本文提出DeiT-LT，重新审视蒸馏在长尾ViT训练中的作用。方法采用双分支设计：CNN教师分支在长尾数据上训练以提供局部归纳偏置，ViT学生分支通过蒸馏吸收该偏置，并引入针对尾部类别的蒸馏加权与自蒸馏策略。在iNaturalist、CIFAR-LT等长尾基准上，DeiT-LT显著提升尾部类别精度，整体精度超过此前SOTA若干百分点。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe degradation of tail-class performance when training ViTs on long-tailed datasets. It proposes DeiT-LT, a dual-branch scheme where a CNN teacher trained on long-tailed data distills locality inductive bias into a ViT student, with tail-aware distillation weighting and self-distillation. On iNaturalist and CIFAR-LT it substantially improves tail-class accuracy and surpasses prior state of the art.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 把蒸馏重新定位为长尾ViT训练的关键手段，方法简洁有效，对自动驾驶中长尾目标检测的骨干训练有直接参考价值。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出面向长尾ViT训练的双分支蒸馏框架DeiT-LT。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 用CNN教师注入局部归纳偏置并设计尾部感知蒸馏加权。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 在多个长尾基准上整体与尾部类别精度均超越此前SOTA。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: 针对ViT在稠密预测任务（检测、分割）中缺乏多尺度特征交互、局部细节建模不足的问题，本文提出ViT-CoMer，一种融合卷积多尺度特征交互的ViT骨干。方法在ViT各阶段并行引入CNN多尺度特征金字塔，并通过双向跨尺度交互模块将卷积局部特征注入ViT token，同时保持ViT的全局建模能力。在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上，ViT-CoMer在同等骨干规模下取得优于Swin、ConvNeXt等SOTA骨干的精度，且可直接替换现有检测器。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of multi-scale interaction and local detail modeling in plain ViTs for dense prediction. It proposes ViT-CoMer, which augments a ViT backbone with a parallel CNN multi-scale pyramid and a bidirectional cross-scale interaction module injecting local features into ViT tokens. On COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation it outperforms Swin and ConvNeXt backbones of comparable size and is drop-in compatible with existing detectors.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 面向检测/分割的通用骨干改进，可直接用于自动驾驶2D/3D检测器，实用性强。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出融合卷积多尺度交互的稠密预测ViT骨干ViT-CoMer。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 双向跨尺度交互模块将CNN局部多尺度特征注入ViT token。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 在COCO与ADE20K上以同等规模超越Swin/ConvNeXt骨干。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: 针对ViT训练后量化（PTQ）在低比特下精度骤降、且依赖原始训练数据的问题，本文提出CLAMP-ViT，一种无数据的对比学习自适应PTQ框架。方法通过对比学习在生成器合成的样本上区分量化敏感与不敏感参数，并据此自适应分配比特宽度，同时用对比损失约束量化前后特征一致性。在ImageNet上，CLAMP-ViT在无数据条件下达到与有数据PTQ相当的精度，W4A4设置下精度损失明显小于现有无数据方法。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy collapse of post-training quantization for ViTs at low bit-widths and its reliance on original training data. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a data-free contrastive learning framework that identifies quantization-sensitive parameters on synthetic samples and adaptively allocates bit-widths while enforcing feature consistency. On ImageNet it matches data-driven PTQ and reduces W4A4 accuracy loss versus prior data-free methods.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 无数据量化对边缘部署有价值，但属于模型压缩方向，与感知算法本身相关度中等。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比学习自适应ViT训练后量化框架CLAMP-ViT。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 用对比学习区分量化敏感参数并自适应分配比特宽度。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: ImageNet上无数据PTQ精度追平有数据方法，W4A4损失显著降低。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: 针对高光谱等信号采集带宽受限、数据量过大阻碍实时检测的问题，本文提出LUM-ViT，通过预采集调制降低采集数据量。方法在ViT中嵌入可学习的欠采样掩码，在光学采集前决定采样哪些像素，并配合核级权值二值化与三阶段微调策略以适配光学硬件计算。在ImageNet分类上仅采样10%像素时精度损失控制在1.8%以内，在真实光学硬件上实现接近原始精度，验证了实用性。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper targets bandwidth-limited signal acquisition, where huge data volumes such as hyperspectral imagery hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a ViT variant with a learnable under-sampling mask applied before acquisition, plus kernel-level weight binarization and a three-stage fine-tuning strategy for optical hardware. Sampling only 10% of pixels incurs under 1.8% accuracy loss on ImageNet, and near-original accuracy is maintained on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 预采集调制与可学习掩码的思路新颖，对带宽受限的传感前端有启发，但与主流自动驾驶感知管线关联较间接。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出带可学习欠采样掩码的预采集调制ViT框架LUM-ViT。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将可学习欠采样掩码与核级二值化结合，实现采集前像素级调制。
2403.01412|v2.result: 仅采样10%像素时ImageNet精度损失<1.8%，真实光学硬件上接近原始精度。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态大模型在视觉编码阶段缺乏问题感知能力、视觉特征与文本问题交互不足的问题，提出一种问题感知的视觉Transformer（Question Aware Vision Transformer），让视觉编码过程直接以文本问题为条件进行特征提取。方法上通过将问题嵌入注入ViT的注意力或token处理流程，使视觉token在编码时即与问题语义对齐，而非仅在后续融合阶段交互。相比先独立编码图像再与文本拼接的常规VLM流程，该方法提升了视觉表征对问题的针对性。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需进一步核实其定量提升。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of question-awareness in the visual encoding stage of multimodal large models, where visual features are extracted independently of the textual query. It proposes a Question Aware Vision Transformer that conditions visual token encoding on the question embedding, enabling early cross-modal interaction rather than late fusion. Compared with conventional pipelines that encode images independently and concatenate text afterwards, the method yields more query-relevant visual representations, though quantitative results are not specified in the abstract.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 面向VLM中视觉编码与文本问题早期交互的方向，思路清晰，对多模态推理与自动驾驶中的视觉问答场景有潜在参考价值。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出将文本问题注入视觉编码过程的问题感知ViT架构，实现视觉与语言在编码阶段的早期对齐。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 把问题条件化从后融合阶段前移到视觉token编码阶段，改变VLM的视觉特征提取范式。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与数值指标，定量效果需查阅正文验证。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本学习（ZSL）中视觉特征与语义属性对齐困难、ViT在未见类上泛化不足的问题，提出渐进式语义引导的视觉Transformer（Progressive Semantic-Guided ViT）。方法通过多阶段渐进地将类语义信息注入ViT的特征提取过程，引导模型学习语义一致且判别性强的视觉表征。相比仅在分类头或后处理阶段引入语义的已有ZSL方法，该工作实现了语义与视觉在编码层的深度融合。摘要未列出具体数据集与精度数值，需正文确认其相对基线的提升幅度。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of aligning visual features with semantic attributes in zero-shot learning and the limited generalization of ViTs to unseen classes. It proposes a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer that injects class semantics into ViT feature extraction in multiple progressive stages, encouraging semantically consistent and discriminative representations. Unlike prior ZSL methods that introduce semantics only at the classifier or post-processing stage, this work fuses semantics and vision at the encoding level, though concrete benchmark numbers are not reported in the abstract.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 将语义引导与ViT结合用于零样本识别，方法思路对开放词汇/开放集检测中的语义对齐问题有一定借鉴意义。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的ViT框架，用于零样本学习中的视觉-语义对齐。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 以多阶段渐进方式将类语义注入ViT编码过程，而非仅在分类阶段使用语义。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与精度数据，效果需依据正文实验判断。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在下游任务微调时参数量大、全量微调成本高的问题，提出低秩重缩放（Low-Rank Rescaled）微调方法，并采用残差设计视角进行建模。方法将权重更新分解为低秩分量与重缩放因子，并以残差形式与预训练权重组合，从而在极少可训练参数下逼近全量微调的性能。相比LoRA等固定缩放的低秩适配方法，该工作通过可学习的重缩放提升了适配表达能力。摘要未给出具体精度与参数节省比例，需正文核实。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full fine-tuning for ViTs by proposing a low-rank rescaled fine-tuning method formulated from a residual design perspective. The weight update is decomposed into a low-rank component and a rescaling factor combined residually with pretrained weights, approximating full fine-tuning with far fewer trainable parameters. Compared with fixed-scaling low-rank adaptation such as LoRA, the learnable rescaling improves adaptation capacity, though specific accuracy and parameter-efficiency numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 参数高效微调方向的工作，对需要在自动驾驶大模型上做低成本适配的研究者有实用价值。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出基于残差设计的低秩重缩放ViT微调方法，以少量可训练参数实现高效适配。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 在低秩适配中引入可学习的重缩放因子，并以残差形式与预训练权重结合。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 摘要未报告具体精度与参数节省比例，定量效果需查阅正文。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT对对抗扰动敏感、鲁棒性不足的问题，提出随机纠缠token（Random Entangled Tokens）机制以增强ViT的对抗鲁棒性。方法通过在token层面引入随机纠缠/混合操作，破坏对抗扰动的结构化传播路径，从而提升模型在对抗攻击下的稳定性。相比传统对抗训练或输入变换防御，该方案在架构层面引入随机性，可能兼顾干净精度与鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体攻击方法与鲁棒精度数值，需正文确认。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper targets the adversarial vulnerability of Vision Transformers and proposes Random Entangled Tokens to improve robustness. By introducing stochastic entanglement/mixing at the token level, the method disrupts structured propagation of adversarial perturbations, enhancing stability under attack. Unlike conventional adversarial training or input-transformation defenses, it injects randomness at the architectural level, potentially balancing clean accuracy and robustness, though concrete attack settings and robust accuracy are not reported in the abstract.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: ViT鲁棒性方向的工作，对自动驾驶感知模型的安全性与对抗防御研究有参考意义。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠token机制，从架构层面提升ViT的对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 在token处理中引入随机纠缠操作，破坏对抗扰动的结构化传播。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 摘要未提供具体攻击方法与鲁棒精度数据，效果需正文验证。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）在视觉任务中难以兼顾ResNet式高效结构与Transformer式全局建模能力的问题，提出SpikingResformer，将ResNet与ViT的设计思想融合到脉冲网络中。方法结合残差脉冲卷积与脉冲自注意力模块，构建多阶段脉冲骨干，在保持SNN低能耗特性的同时提升表征能力。相比纯脉冲CNN或纯脉冲Transformer，该结构在精度与能耗之间取得更好折中。摘要未列出具体ImageNet精度与能耗数值，需正文核实。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of combining ResNet-style efficiency with Transformer-style global modeling in spiking neural networks, proposing SpikingResformer that bridges the two designs. It integrates residual spiking convolutions with spiking self-attention in a multi-stage backbone, improving representation capacity while preserving the low-energy nature of SNNs. Compared with purely spiking CNNs or Transformers, it achieves a better accuracy-energy trade-off, though specific ImageNet accuracy and energy figures are not given in the abstract.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: SNN与ViT结合的前沿方向，对低功耗视觉感知与车载边缘部署研究有潜在价值。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出融合ResNet与ViT思想的脉冲神经网络骨干SpikingResformer。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 将残差脉冲卷积与脉冲自注意力统一到多阶段架构中，兼顾效率与全局建模。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 摘要未给出具体精度与能耗数值，定量效果需查阅正文。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT可解释性方法中归因结果不忠实（faithfulness）的问题，提出关注token变换过程的事后解释方法。方法通过分析ViT中token在各层的变换与交互，构建更忠实反映模型决策依据的归因图，而非仅依赖注意力权重。相比直接使用注意力图作为解释的已有做法，该工作强调token变换对解释忠实度的影响。摘要未给出具体忠实度指标与数据集结果，需正文确认。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of faithfulness in post-hoc explanations for Vision Transformers and proposes an explanation method centered on token transformations. By analyzing how tokens are transformed and interact across layers, it constructs attribution maps that more faithfully reflect model decisions rather than relying solely on attention weights. Compared with attention-map-based explanations, it emphasizes the role of token transformation in faithfulness, though concrete faithfulness metrics and datasets are not reported in the abstract.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: ViT可解释性方向的工作，对自动驾驶感知模型的可解释性与安全验证有参考意义。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出以token变换为核心的事后解释方法，提升ViT归因的忠实度。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 从token变换而非注意力权重出发构建解释，强调变换过程对忠实性的影响。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 摘要未提供具体忠实度指标与数据集结果，效果需正文验证。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实度（faithfulness）问题展开研究，即现有归因/解释方法是否真实反映模型决策依据。作者系统性地评估了多种ViT解释技术，并提出衡量忠实度的新指标或分析框架，揭示了注意力图等常见解释与模型真实行为之间的偏差。相比已有工作，该研究首次对ViT解释的忠实度进行系统量化，指出广泛使用的解释方法可能产生误导。实验表明部分主流解释方法的忠实度显著低于预期，为后续可解释性研究提供了重要基准。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper investigates the faithfulness of explanation methods for Vision Transformers, questioning whether prevailing attribution techniques truly reflect model decisions. The authors systematically evaluate multiple ViT explanation methods and introduce metrics or an analysis framework to quantify faithfulness, revealing discrepancies between popular explanations such as attention maps and actual model behavior. Experiments show that several mainstream explanation methods exhibit notably low faithfulness, providing an important benchmark for future interpretability research.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 可解释性对自动驾驶感知模型的验证与安全认证日益重要，该工作为ViT解释的可靠性提供了批判性视角。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统量化并揭示了Vision Transformer解释方法的忠实度缺陷。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 提出针对ViT解释忠实度的评估框架与指标。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 实验表明主流ViT解释方法的忠实度显著低于预期。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT计算开销大、内存效率低的问题，提出SHViT——一种单头Vision Transformer架构，通过宏设计（macro design）实现内存高效。作者重新设计了ViT的整体架构，采用单头自注意力机制替代多头注意力，并结合高效的宏观结构设计来降低内存占用和计算量。相比已有高效ViT（如MobileViT、EfficientViT等），SHViT在保持或提升精度的同时显著降低了推理内存和延迟。在ImageNet等基准上，SHViT以更少的参数量和FLOPs达到竞争性甚至更优的精度，适合边缘部署。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory overhead of Vision Transformers by proposing SHViT, a single-head ViT with a memory-efficient macro design. The authors redesign the overall architecture, replacing multi-head attention with a single-head mechanism and adopting an efficient macro structure to reduce memory footprint and latency. Compared with prior efficient ViTs such as MobileViT and EfficientViT, SHViT achieves competitive or superior accuracy on ImageNet with fewer parameters and FLOPs, making it suitable for edge deployment.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 高效ViT对自动驾驶车载部署有直接价值，SHViT的单头设计与宏架构思路简洁有效，值得关注。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出单头内存高效Vision Transformer架构SHViT。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 用单头注意力与宏设计替代多头注意力以降低内存开销。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.result: 在ImageNet上以更少参数和FLOPs达到竞争性或更优精度。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi._arxiv_id: SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer with Memory Efficient Macro Design.

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD），目标是在标注样本极少的新领域中训练准确的目标检测器。作者首先用风格（style）、类间方差（ICV）和模糊边界（IB）三种度量分析域差距，发现现有基于Transformer的开放集检测器（如DE-ViT）在跨域场景下泛化能力不足，并据此建立了CD-FSOD基准。针对这些问题，提出可学习实例特征对齐和实例重加权等模块来增强模型。实验表明所提方法在CD-FSOD基准上显著优于现有方法，有效缓解了域差距带来的性能下降。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper studies cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), aiming to build accurate detectors for novel domains with minimal labeled examples. The authors analyze domain gaps using style, inter-class variance (ICV), and indefinable boundaries (IB), showing that transformer-based open-set detectors like DE-ViT fail to generalize across domains, and establish a CD-FSOD benchmark. They propose learnable instance feature alignment and instance reweighting modules to address these issues, achieving significant improvements over existing methods on the benchmark.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 跨域少样本检测对自动驾驶新场景快速适配极具价值，该工作的问题分析与基准构建扎实，方法针对性强。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立CD-FSOD基准并提出增强开放集检测器跨域泛化的方法。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 用风格、ICV、IB度量域差距并设计实例特征对齐与重加权模块。
2402.03094|v2.result: 在CD-FSOD基准上显著优于现有方法，缓解域差距导致的性能下降。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文系统研究了旋转位置编码（RoPE）在Vision Transformer中的应用，填补了RoPE在视觉领域影响未被充分探索的空白。作者针对2D视觉数据实现了实用的RoPE方案，并进行了全面分析，发现RoPE具有出色的外推能力，即在推理时增大图像分辨率仍能保持精度。将RoPE应用于ViT后，在ImageNet-1k分类、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割任务上均取得性能提升。该研究为在ViT中应用RoPE提供了详尽指南，且额外计算开销极小。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) applied to Vision Transformers, addressing the underexplored impact of RoPE in vision. The authors implement practical 2D RoPE for vision data and show impressive extrapolation performance, maintaining accuracy when increasing image resolution at inference. Applying RoPE to ViTs improves performance on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation with minimal extra computational overhead, offering thorough guidelines for RoPE in ViT.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: RoPE在检测与分割上的稳定增益对多尺度感知任务有实用价值，且开销极小，易于集成到现有ViT骨干。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统分析并验证了RoPE在Vision Transformer中的有效性与外推能力。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 为2D视觉数据实现RoPE并揭示其分辨率外推优势。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均取得性能提升。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer易受对抗攻击的问题，提出SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）增强鲁棒性。作者首先为自注意力层建立了局部Lipschitz界，然后提出MSVP来精确控制这些界，将MSVP融入ViT注意力层以提升鲁棒性且不牺牲训练效率。在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上的实验表明，SpecFormer在防御对抗攻击方面优于其他最先进模型。该工作为ViT鲁棒性提供了理论支撑，弥补了现有方法缺乏理论基础的不足。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Vision Transformers to adversarial attacks by proposing SpecFormer, which enhances robustness via Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP). The authors establish local Lipschitz bounds for the self-attention layer and apply MSVP to precisely control these bounds within attention layers without compromising training efficiency. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet show that SpecFormer outperforms state-of-the-art models in adversarial defense, providing theoretical grounding lacking in prior empirical approaches.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 对抗鲁棒性对安全关键的自动驾驶感知有意义，但该工作聚焦分类任务，向检测/分割的迁移尚待验证。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出基于最大奇异值惩罚的鲁棒ViT模型SpecFormer。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 为自注意力层建立局部Lipschitz界并用MSVP精确控制。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上对抗攻击防御性能优于现有最先进模型。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在不同推理成本下部署时需重新微调的问题，提出Token Compensator，能够在不重新调参的情况下改变ViT的推理成本。作者设计了一种补偿机制，使得模型在改变token数量或计算预算时仍能保持性能，无需额外的微调过程。相比已有需要针对每种计算预算单独训练或微调的方法，Token Compensator提供了更灵活高效的部署方案。实验表明该方法在多种推理成本设置下均能维持有竞争力的精度。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the need to re-tune Vision Transformers when deploying at different inference costs by proposing Token Compensator, which alters inference cost without re-tuning. The authors design a compensation mechanism that maintains performance when the number of tokens or computational budget changes, eliminating per-budget fine-tuning. Compared with prior methods requiring separate training for each budget, Token Compensator offers a more flexible and efficient deployment solution, maintaining competitive accuracy across various inference cost settings.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 动态调整推理成本对自动驾驶多平台部署有实用价值，免微调特性降低了工程落地成本。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出无需重新微调即可改变ViT推理成本的Token Compensator。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.innovation: 通过token补偿机制实现推理成本灵活调整而无需微调。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.result: 在多种推理成本设置下维持有竞争力的精度。

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: ①传统音视频方法依赖独立的音频和视觉骨干网络，参数开销大且难以扩展。②本文提出AVSiam，用单个共享ViT骨干处理音频和视觉输入，并采用对比音视频匹配目标与多比例随机掩码策略进行预训练。③相比已有方法，AVSiam能用单一共享骨干同时处理音频、视觉及音视频输入，参数效率更高、显存占用更低，可扩展到更大数据集和模型。④在AudioSet和VGGSound的音视频分类与检索任务上取得与先前方法相当甚至更好的结果。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: Traditional audio-visual methods rely on independent audio and visual backbones, which is costly and not scalable. This work proposes AVSiam, an audio-visual siamese network that uses a single shared ViT backbone with a contrastive audio-visual matching objective and multi-ratio random masking for efficient pretraining. Despite sharing the backbone across modalities, AVSiam achieves competitive or better results than prior methods on AudioSet and VGGSound for audio-visual classification and retrieval.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作对多模态共享骨干的ViT设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶/3D感知领域关联较弱，主要贡献在音视频预训练效率。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出用单一共享ViT骨干进行可扩展音视频预训练的AVSiam框架。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 通过共享ViT骨干与多比例随机掩码实现参数高效的音视频对比预训练。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在AudioSet和VGGSound上取得与独立骨干方法相当或更优的分类与检索性能。

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在超低比特后训练量化(PTQ)下精度大幅下降的问题，现有基于重建的PTQ方法在ViT上因输出重要性估计不准和post-GELU激活量化困难而失效。本文提出APHQ-ViT，通过改进的平均扰动Hessian(APH)损失进行重要性估计，并设计MLP重建(MR)方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并在小型无标签校准集上用APH损失重建。实验表明该方法在超低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，有效缓解了ViT量化精度损失。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant accuracy degradation of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization, where existing reconstruction-based PTQ methods fail due to inaccurate output importance estimation and difficulty in quantizing post-GELU activations. The authors propose APHQ-ViT, which introduces an improved Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction (MR) method that replaces GELU with ReLU and reconstructs it using the APH loss on a small unlabeled calibration set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that APHQ-ViT substantially outperforms prior PTQ methods under ultra-low-bit linear quantization.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT量化部署的实际痛点提出了有针对性的改进，APH损失和MLP重建的设计思路清晰，对边缘部署场景有实用价值。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出了基于平均扰动Hessian的PTQ方法APHQ-ViT，解决了ViT在超低比特量化下post-GELU激活难以量化的问题。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 改进了Hessian损失的重要性估计，并通过将GELU替换为ReLU的MLP重建策略实现更精确的量化。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在超低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，有效缩小了量化ViT与全精度模型之间的精度差距。
