2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)训练数据中的长尾分布问题，指出现有工作主要关注传统VLM架构和特定任务，而对LLaVA等LVLM及VQA、视觉推理等通用任务的探索不足。作者深入分析了LVLM中长尾问题的两个核心原因——头部概念过表示和尾部概念欠表示，并提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，包含数据重平衡(DR)和数据合成(DS)两个阶段。DR阶段基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS阶段利用去噪扩散概率模型合成尾部数据，有效改善了LVLM在长尾分布下的表现。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-tail data distribution problem in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), noting that prior work mainly focused on traditional VLM architectures and specific tasks while leaving LVLMs like LLaVA and general tasks such as VQA and visual reasoning under-explored. The authors identify two core causes—overrepresentation of head concepts and underrepresentation of tail concepts—and propose an Adaptive Data Refinement Framework (ADR) with two stages: Data Rebalancing (DR) and Data Synthesis (DS). DR adaptively rebalances redundant data based on entity distributions, while DS leverages denoising diffusion probabilistic models to synthesize tail data, effectively improving LVLM performance under long-tail distributions.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了LVLM中的长尾问题并提出了完整的数据层面解决方案，对多模态大模型的公平性和泛化性研究有重要参考价值。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出了自适应数据精炼框架ADR，通过数据重平衡和扩散模型数据合成解决LVLM训练数据的长尾问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析LVLM中长尾问题的两个核心原因，并利用扩散模型合成尾部概念数据。
2503.12821|v2.result: 有效改善了LVLM在长尾分布下的VQA和视觉推理性能。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在边缘设备上部署困难的问题，提出二值化混合ViT架构BHViT及其全二值化模型。由于CNN和Transformer的结构差异，直接将二值CNN策略应用于ViT会导致显著性能下降。BHViT利用从粗到细的局部信息交互和层次特征聚合减少冗余token计算，提出基于移位操作的新模块增强二值MLP性能而不显著增加计算开销，并设计了基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法评估token重要性。实验表明BHViT在保持高效计算的同时显著缩小了与全精度ViT的性能差距。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture and its fully binarized model. Due to structural differences between CNNs and Transformers, directly applying binary CNN strategies to ViTs causes significant performance drops. BHViT employs coarse-to-fine local information interaction and hierarchical feature aggregation to reduce redundant token computation, introduces a shift-based module to enhance binary MLP performance without significant overhead, and designs a quantization-decomposition-based attention matrix binarization method for token importance evaluation. Experiments show that BHViT significantly narrows the performance gap with full-precision ViTs while maintaining efficient computation.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT二值化的核心挑战提出了系统性的架构设计，三个观察指导的设计决策合理，对边缘设备上ViT的实时部署有重要实用价值。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出了二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT及其全二值化模型，解决了ViT在边缘设备上的部署难题。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 结合局部信息交互、移位操作增强二值MLP和量化分解注意力二值化三种策略实现ViT全二值化。
2503.02394|v2.result: 在保持高效计算的同时显著缩小了与全精度ViT的性能差距。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实人脸图像丰富但标注稀缺的场景，提出自监督预训练框架FSFM，以提升多种人脸安全任务（跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域人脸防伪、未见扩散伪造检测）的泛化性能。方法上结合掩码图像建模（MIM）与实例判别（ID），提出CRFR-P掩码策略强制模型捕获区域内一致性与区域间连贯性，并通过定制自蒸馏建立局部到全局对应，形成3C学习目标。预训练后仅用普通ViT即可作为通用视觉基础模型迁移到下游任务。在10个公开数据集上验证了其泛化优势。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This work proposes FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns transferable facial representations by synergizing masked image modeling (MIM) and instance discrimination (ID). It introduces a CRFR-P masking strategy enforcing intra-region consistency and inter-region coherency, plus a tailored self-distillation ID network establishing local-to-global correspondence. A vanilla ViT pretrained with these 3C objectives serves as a universal foundation model, achieving strong generalization on cross-dataset deepfake detection, cross-domain face anti-spoofing, and unseen diffusion forgery detection across 10 public datasets.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 将自监督基础模型思路引入人脸安全领域，掩码策略与自蒸馏设计有一定新意，但与人脸安全之外的通用视觉任务关联有限。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向人脸安全任务的自监督预训练基础模型FSFM及3C学习目标。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: CRFR-P掩码策略与MIM-ID耦合的自蒸馏机制，同时编码局部特征与全局语义。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集的人脸安全下游任务上取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇多视角室内3D目标检测在无人工标注条件下探索不足的问题，提出OpenM3D——一个无需人工标注训练的单阶段开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器。方法基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类别无关的3D定位损失（依赖高质量3D伪框）与体素-语义对齐损失（依赖多样CLIP特征），并提出基于图嵌入的3D伪框生成方法将2D分割合并为连贯3D结构。其伪框在精度和召回上优于包括OV-3DET在内的现有方法，且通过多样CLIP特征采样实现体素级语义对齐。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: OpenM3D is a single-stage open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D detector trained without human annotations, adapting 2D-induced voxel features from ImGeoNet. It jointly optimizes a class-agnostic 3D localization loss with high-quality pseudo boxes and a voxel-semantic alignment loss with diverse CLIP features. A graph-embedding-based 3D pseudo box generation method merges 2D segments into coherent 3D structures, achieving higher precision and recall than prior methods including OV-3DET.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测与无标注训练结合到多视角室内3D场景，伪框生成与CLIP对齐设计扎实，对开放集3D感知有参考价值。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器OpenM3D及图嵌入伪框生成方法。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 联合类别无关3D定位损失与体素-语义对齐损失，并用图嵌入融合2D分割生成高质量3D伪框。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度与召回优于OV-3DET等方法，实现无标注训练的高精度单阶段开放词汇3D检测。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于query的3D目标检测模型在边缘设备上计算开销大、现有剪枝与蒸馏方法需重训练或难以迁移的问题，提出零样本运行时剪枝方法tgGBC（trim keys gradually Guided By Classification scores）。方法将分类分数与注意力图相乘得到每个key的重要性分数，并在每层transformer后按重要性逐步剪枝key。在最新ToC3D模型上实现transformer解码器1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型甚至性能提升，并成功在边缘设备部署。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime pruning method for transformer decoders in 3D object detection that trims keys gradually based on importance scores derived by multiplying classification scores with attention maps. It achieves a 1.99x speedup on the transformer decoder of ToC3D with less than 1% performance loss, and even improves performance for certain models. The method is deployed on edge devices, addressing the lack of retraining-free pruning tailored to 3D detectors.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 面向3D检测器的免训练运行时剪枝，实用性强且加速比可观，对边缘部署的自动驾驶感知有直接价值。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出零样本运行时key剪枝方法tgGBC，用于3D检测transformer解码器加速。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 用分类分数与注意力图相乘构造key重要性分数，并逐层渐进剪枝，无需重训练。
2503.08101|v2.result: ToC3D解码器加速1.99倍，性能损失<1%，部分模型性能反升，并可在边缘设备部署。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差、中间注意力改进难以传播到最终输出且缺乏与文本直接交互的问题，提出一种免训练、反馈驱动的自适性框架，将基于输出的patch级对应关系反馈回中间注意力。方法利用输出预测作为更强的空间连贯先验，设计注意力隔离、基于置信度的稀疏自适应剪枝与自适应集成等模块，作为即插即用模块无缝集成到现有CLIP分割流程中。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This work proposes a training-free, feedback-driven self-adaptive framework that feeds output-based patch-level correspondences back into CLIP's intermediate attention for open-vocabulary segmentation. Treating final predictions as a stronger spatial coherence prior, it designs attention isolation, confidence-based pruning for sparse adaptation, and adaptation ensemble as plug-in modules. The approach enhances semantic consistency between internal representations and final predictions without additional training.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 从输出反馈角度改进CLIP空间表示，思路新颖且免训练，但主要面向分割任务，与检测/自动驾驶关联较弱。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出将输出级patch对应反馈回中间注意力的免训练CLIP开放词汇分割框架。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 以模型输出作为空间连贯先验，配合注意力隔离与置信度稀疏剪枝实现即插即用适配。
2508.20265|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块提升CLIP开放词汇分割的语义一致性与定位质量。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP图像级预训练在像素级开放词汇语义分割中空间表示不足的问题，提出分层框架CLIPer，逐层改进CLIP的空间表示。方法包含早期层融合模块（利用早期层嵌入与注意力图保留的空间结构信息生成空间连贯性更好的分割图）和细粒度补偿模块（用扩散模型的自注意力图补偿局部细节）。在七个分割数据集上取得SOTA性能。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: CLIPer is a hierarchical framework that improves CLIP's spatial representation for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. It combines an early-layer fusion module, which exploits early-layer embeddings and attention maps to produce spatially coherent segmentation maps, with a fine-grained compensation module that uses diffusion model self-attention maps to recover local details. It achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven segmentation datasets.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 分层利用早期层与扩散先验改进CLIP空间表示，实验覆盖七个数据集，但属于分割方向，与检测主线相关度中等。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出分层改进CLIP空间表示的免训练开放词汇语义分割框架CLIPer。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 早期层融合模块与基于扩散模型注意力的细粒度补偿模块相结合。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在七个分割数据集上取得SOTA性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对窗口式视觉Transformer（Swin）量化推理效率问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q，利用层内激活稀疏性为不重要的窗口分配更低比特宽度。方法引入双分支Swin Block分别以高/低比特处理激活，可无缝集成到多数QAT与PTQ方法中。在COCO数据集上，PTQ配置下实现免训练1.35倍计算加速且无精度损失；QAT下实现无损1.25倍加速，结合激活剪枝在仅降1% mAP下达到1.53倍加速。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: Mixa-Q is a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that exploits intra-layer activation sparsity in window-based vision transformers, assigning lower bit widths to less important windows. A Two-Branch Swin Block processes activations in high and low precision, integrating seamlessly with QAT and PTQ methods. On COCO, it achieves a training-free 1.35x speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ, and 1.25x lossless / 1.53x with 1% mAP drop in QAT.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 将激活稀疏性与混合精度量化结合，工程实用性强，但面向分类/检测骨干网络加速，与3D感知主线关联有限。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出利用层内激活稀疏性的混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q及双分支Swin Block。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 按窗口重要性分配高低比特宽度，并与QAT/PTQ无缝集成。
2507.19131|v2.result: COCO上PTQ免训练1.35倍加速无精度损失，QAT无损1.25倍、结合剪枝1.53倍加速仅降1% mAP。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对黑盒对抗攻击迁移性不足的问题，提出利用自监督ViT特征来生成对抗扰动。方法上设计了dSVA生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击，同时利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并引入生成器与注意力机制训练策略。相比以往仅依赖监督学习特征的方法，该工作首次系统探索自监督ViT表示对对抗迁移性的增益，发现CL与MIM使ViT关注互补特征。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称显著提升了黑盒迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited black-box transferability of adversarial perturbations by exploiting self-supervised ViT representations. It proposes dSVA, a generative dual self-supervised ViT features attack that jointly leverages global structural features from contrastive learning and local textural features from masked image modeling, together with a generator and attention-based training strategy. Compared with prior work relying solely on supervised features, it shows that CL and MIM induce complementary attention in ViTs, boosting black-box transferability.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 将自监督ViT特征引入对抗攻击迁移性研究，视角新颖，对理解ViT表示与鲁棒性关系有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 首次系统利用自监督ViT的CL与MIM双特征提升对抗样本的黑盒迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 提出生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击框架dSVA，结合生成器与ViT注意力机制。
2506.21046|v2.result: CL与MIM特征互补，显著提升黑盒对抗迁移性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练ViT在下游任务适配时微调成本高的问题，提出基于近似正交微调策略的高效适配方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验设置，但从标题可推断其通过近似正交约束保持预训练知识并降低可训练参数。相比全量微调或LoRA类方法，其改进点在于正交性约束下的参数高效适配。具体效果数据摘要中未提供。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper targets efficient adaptation of pre-trained Vision Transformers by proposing an approximately orthogonal fine-tuning strategy. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates that the method constrains fine-tuning updates to be approximately orthogonal to preserve pre-trained knowledge while reducing trainable parameters. The claimed improvement is parameter-efficient adaptation with better knowledge retention, though quantitative results are unavailable.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 参数高效微调是ViT落地的关键问题，正交约束思路合理，但缺少摘要信息难以评估其实际效果与创新程度。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出近似正交微调策略以实现预训练ViT的高效下游适配。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 将近似正交约束引入ViT参数高效微调，兼顾知识保持与适配效率。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi._arxiv_id: Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Transformer Underpinned by Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Strategy.

An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_cn: 该论文面向TinyML应用场景，提出一种高效混合Vision Transformer架构。由于摘要缺失，无法获知具体设计（如卷积与注意力的混合方式、轻量化策略）及实验细节。其目标是在资源受限设备上平衡ViT的表达能力与计算开销。具体改进点与效果数据均无法从摘要中确认。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_en: This paper proposes an efficient hybrid Vision Transformer for TinyML applications. Due to the missing abstract, the specific hybrid design and experimental details are unknown. The goal is to balance ViT expressiveness and computational cost on resource-constrained devices, but concrete improvements and quantitative results cannot be confirmed.
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.assessment: TinyML与ViT结合有一定工程价值，但摘要缺失且与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限，重要性一般。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.contribution: 提出面向TinyML的高效混合ViT架构。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.innovation: 针对资源受限设备设计混合ViT结构（细节未知）。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.result: 摘要缺失，效果数据无法确认。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f._arxiv_id: An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer for Tinyml Applications.

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝后需大量重训练才能恢复精度的问题，提出Variance-Based Pruning——一种简单的一次性结构化剪枝技术。方法先收集激活统计量用于选择待剪神经元，同时将均值激活回注模型以保持性能，从而仅需极少微调。相比需要数百epoch重训练甚至从头训练的方法，其改进在于一次性剪枝后即可保留大部分性能。在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required by structured pruning to recover accuracy. It introduces Variance-Based Pruning, a simple one-shot structured pruning technique that gathers activation statistics to select neurons and integrates mean activations back into the model to preserve performance with minimal fine-tuning. On ImageNet-1k, DeiT-Base retains over 70% of its original performance immediately after pruning, avoiding the hundreds of retraining epochs typical of prior methods.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 一次性剪枝且无需大量重训练的思路对模型部署有实用价值，激活均值回注的细节设计简洁有效，但领域相关性偏通用。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出基于方差的单次结构化剪枝方法，大幅降低剪枝后的重训练需求。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 利用激活统计选择神经元并将均值激活回注模型以保持性能。
2507.12988|v2.result: ImageNet-1k上DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%原始性能。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Transformer自注意力计算开销大的问题，提出PADRe——一种统一的多项式注意力替代框架。PADRe基于多项式函数与近似理论，用Hadamard积等硬件友好操作实现乘性非线性，仅带来线性计算与内存开销，且无需Softmax。作者指出Hyena、Mamba、SimA、Conv2Former、Castling-ViT等近期注意力机制均可视为PADRe的特例。在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云目标检测任务上，PADRe作为自注意力的直接替代运行显著更快且精度相当或更优。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention drop-in replacement for self-attention in transformers. Built on polynomial functions and approximation theory, PADRe uses hardware-friendly multiplicative nonlinearities such as Hadamard products, achieving linear computational and memory costs without Softmax. It subsumes several recent attention variants (Hyena, Mamba, SimA, Conv2Former, Castling-ViT) as special cases, and empirically runs significantly faster with comparable or superior accuracy on image classification, 2D object detection, and 3D point cloud object detection.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: 统一框架视角有理论价值，且验证覆盖2D/3D检测任务，对BEV/3D检测中的高效注意力设计有直接借鉴意义。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出统一多项式注意力框架PADRe，将多种高效注意力机制纳入同一理论体系。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 基于近似理论用硬件友好的多项式乘性非线性替代Softmax自注意力。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在分类、2D检测与3D点云检测上运行显著更快，精度相当或更优。

CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_cn: 该论文提出CViT（Continuous Vision Transformer），用于算子学习（operator learning）任务。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法（如如何将ViT扩展到连续函数空间）、实验设置与对比基线。从标题推断，其目标是将ViT架构适配到偏微分方程等连续算子学习场景。具体改进点与效果数据均无法从摘要中确认。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_en: This paper proposes CViT, a Continuous Vision Transformer for operator learning. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method for extending ViT to continuous function spaces and the experimental setup are unknown. The goal appears to be adapting ViT architectures to operator learning tasks such as PDEs, but concrete improvements and quantitative results cannot be confirmed.
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.assessment: 算子学习与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，且摘要缺失，难以评估其对本领域的参考价值。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.contribution: 提出面向算子学习的连续Vision Transformer架构CViT。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.innovation: 将ViT扩展至连续算子学习场景（细节未知）。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.result: 摘要缺失，效果数据无法确认。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for._arxiv_id: CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for Operator Learning.

Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）与视觉 Transformer 结合时，传统自注意力机制难以高效处理脉冲时序信息的问题，提出了带有扫视注意力（Saccadic Attention）的脉冲视觉 Transformer（Spiking Vision Transformer）。方法上借鉴生物视觉的扫视机制，设计了一种稀疏、事件驱动的注意力计算方式，以降低脉冲序列上的注意力开销。相比已有 SNN-Transformer 工作，其改进点在于用扫视式采样替代稠密全局注意力，从而更契合脉冲神经元的稀疏发放特性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，因此无法确认其在分类或检测任务上的精度与能效提升幅度。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of applying conventional self-attention to spiking neural networks (SNNs) for vision Transformers, where dense attention is poorly matched to sparse spike trains. It proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention, inspired by biological saccades, to perform sparse, event-driven attention over spike sequences. The claimed improvement over prior SNN-Transformer hybrids is reduced attention cost and better alignment with spike sparsity, though the abstract provides no quantitative results to substantiate accuracy or energy gains.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 该工作探索了 SNN 与 ViT 结合的新注意力范式，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知、3D 检测、BEV 等核心方向关联很弱，且摘要缺乏实验数据支撑。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出了一种受生物扫视机制启发的脉冲视觉 Transformer 注意力结构。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 用稀疏、事件驱动的扫视注意力替代脉冲 ViT 中的稠密全局注意力。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic._arxiv_id: Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention.

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT模型规模大、训练开销高的问题，本文首次系统探索在ViT中端到端地引入稀疏性，以同时降低训练内存与推理复杂度。方法上不再训练完整ViT，而是动态提取并训练固定小参数预算的稀疏子网络，联合优化模型参数与连接结构，并将非结构化稀疏扩展到结构化稀疏（引导自注意力头的剪枝与生长），还通过可学习token选择器协同探索数据与架构稀疏。在ImageNet上，该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低训练与推理成本，优于传统后训练剪枝方案。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first end-to-end exploration of sparsity in Vision Transformers to reduce both training memory and inference complexity without sacrificing accuracy. Instead of training full ViTs, it dynamically extracts and trains sparse subnetworks under a fixed small parameter budget, jointly optimizing parameters and connectivity, and extends from unstructured to structured sparsity by guiding prune-and-grow of self-attention heads. A learnable token selector further co-explores data and architecture sparsity, yielding substantial efficiency gains on ImageNet.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将端到端稀疏训练引入ViT，兼顾训练与推理效率，对高效Transformer研究有较强参考价值。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 首次在ViT中实现端到端稀疏化，统一优化参数、连接、注意力头与token选择。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 将非结构化/结构化稀疏与可学习token选择器结合，实现训练与推理双重加速。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以固定小参数预算取得与密集ViT相当甚至更优的精度，同时降低训练内存与推理复杂度。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT架构设计依赖人工、搜索空间固定等问题，本文提出用神经架构搜索同时搜索架构与搜索空间。核心思想是在权重共享超网上计算E-T Error，并据此逐步演化不同搜索维度，同时给出通用ViT的设计指南。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT和ViT，并在目标检测、语义分割和VQA等下游任务上验证了泛化性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper automates Vision Transformer design by searching not only the architecture but also the search space, using a weight-sharing supernet and E-T Error to progressively evolve search dimensions. The resulting S3 models outperform Swin, DeiT, and ViT on ImageNet, and generalize to object detection, semantic segmentation, and visual question answering. Extensive analysis also provides design guidelines for general vision transformers.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 将NAS扩展到搜索空间本身，对ViT架构自动化设计有启发，且下游任务验证充分。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出同时搜索架构与搜索空间的NAS方法，并给出ViT设计指南。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 基于E-T Error逐步演化搜索维度，实现搜索空间的自适应增长。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT、ViT，并在检测、分割、VQA上展现通用性。

Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer的后训练量化问题，旨在不重新训练的情况下降低ViT的推理成本。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但主题属于ViT压缩与量化方向。该工作对在边缘设备部署ViT具有潜在价值。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses post-training quantization for Vision Transformers, aiming to reduce inference cost without retraining. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details cannot be confirmed, but the topic falls under ViT compression and quantization. It is potentially valuable for deploying ViTs on edge devices.
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.assessment: ViT后训练量化是实用方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献与效果。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.contribution: 针对Vision Transformer提出后训练量化方法。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.innovation: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体创新点。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验结果。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT中不连续的patch tokenization引入锯齿伪影、导致混叠效应的问题，本文分析了ViT中的混叠现象并提出即插即用的抗混叠模块ARM。该轻量模块在多种任务和多个ViT家族上均带来稳定提升，并改善了数据效率与鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes the aliasing problem in Vision Transformers caused by discontinuous patch-wise tokenization and proposes a plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM). The lightweight module consistently boosts multiple ViT families across tasks, and also improves data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 从信号处理角度切入ViT的混叠问题，视角新颖，模块轻量且通用。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 揭示并缓解ViT中的混叠效应，提出即插即用的ARM模块。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将抗混叠思想引入ViT的tokenization与注意力图处理。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多种任务和ViT家族上稳定提升性能，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。

Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_cn: 该论文提出Adder Attention用于Vision Transformer，旨在以加法替代乘法注意力以降低计算能耗。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法与实验细节。该方向属于ViT高效计算与轻量化设计。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_en: This paper proposes Adder Attention for Vision Transformers, aiming to replace multiplication-based attention with addition to reduce computational energy. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental details cannot be confirmed. The direction falls under efficient ViT computation and lightweight design.
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.assessment: 加法注意力在降低能耗方面有潜力，但摘要缺失使评估受限。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.contribution: 提出面向Vision Transformer的Adder Attention机制。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.innovation: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体创新点。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验结果。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT将图像视为1D token序列、缺乏局部结构与尺度不变性等内在归纳偏置的问题，本文提出ViTAE，通过卷积显式引入归纳偏置。ViTAE使用多膨胀率卷积的空间金字塔缩减模块嵌入多尺度上下文，并在每个Transformer层中并行加入卷积分支与多头自注意力融合。该方法在多种视觉任务上以更少训练数据取得优于基线ViT的性能。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of intrinsic inductive bias in ViTs, this paper proposes ViTAE, which explicitly incorporates convolution-derived inductive biases. ViTAE uses spatial pyramid reduction modules with multiple dilation rates to embed multi-scale context, and adds a parallel convolution block fused with multi-head self-attention in each transformer layer. It achieves superior performance over baseline ViTs with less training data across multiple vision tasks.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 通过卷积显式注入尺度不变性与局部性归纳偏置，是ViT与卷积融合的代表性工作之一。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出ViTAE，用卷积为ViT引入多尺度与局部性内在归纳偏置。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 空间金字塔缩减模块与并行卷积分支融合自注意力，显式建模尺度与局部结构。
2106.03348|v2.result: 在多种视觉任务上以更少训练数据取得优于基线ViT的性能。

2106.02277|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer自注意力对高分辨率特征图计算与内存开销呈二次增长、难以用于密集预测的问题，提出Glance-and-Gaze Transformer（GG-Transformer）。方法受人类识别物体时"扫视-凝视"行为启发，设计两条并行分支：Glance分支在自适应膨胀划分上做自注意力以高效建模长程依赖，Gaze分支用深度卷积捕获局部上下文。相比标准ViT在密集预测任务上更高效，在分割/检测等任务上以更小模型取得有竞争力的精度。
2106.02277|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention in vision Transformers, which hinders dense prediction on high-resolution feature maps. It proposes the Glance-and-Gaze Transformer (GG-Transformer), inspired by human glance-and-gaze behavior, with a Glance branch performing self-attention on adaptively-dilated partitions for long-range dependencies and a Gaze branch using depth-wise convolution for local context. The design achieves competitive dense-prediction accuracy with a more compact model than standard ViTs.
2106.02277|v2.assessment: 思路直观且工程友好，对高分辨率密集预测的Transformer效率问题有参考价值，但创新偏组合式，需看具体实验增益。
2106.02277|v2.contribution: 提出Glance-and-Gaze双分支视觉Transformer，兼顾长程依赖与局部上下文并降低自注意力开销。
2106.02277|v2.innovation: 用自适应膨胀划分的自注意力与深度卷积并行分支模拟人类扫视-凝视行为。
2106.02277|v2.result: 在密集预测任务上以更紧凑模型取得有竞争力的精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。

HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_cn: 该论文提出HRFormer，一种面向密集预测任务的高分辨率视觉Transformer。针对ViT在密集预测中因下采样导致空间分辨率损失、难以恢复高分辨率表示的问题，HRFormer在保持高分辨率表示的同时并行多分辨率分支，并用局部窗口注意力降低计算量。相比Swin等方案，它在姿态估计、语义分割等密集预测任务上以更少参数取得更优或相当性能。由于摘要缺失，具体数据无法引用。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_en: This paper introduces HRFormer, a high-resolution vision Transformer for dense prediction. To address the resolution loss caused by downsampling in ViTs, HRFormer maintains high-resolution representations with parallel multi-resolution branches and uses local-window attention to reduce computation. It achieves superior or comparable performance to Swin-style models on dense prediction tasks such as pose estimation and semantic segmentation with fewer parameters.
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.assessment: 高分辨率Transformer在密集预测方向的代表性工作，对BEV/分割类感知任务有借鉴意义，但摘要缺失影响完整评估。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.contribution: 提出保持高分辨率表示的多分辨率并行视觉Transformer骨干HRFormer。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.innovation: 将高分辨率网络结构与局部窗口注意力结合以适配密集预测。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.result: 在姿态估计与语义分割等密集预测任务上以更少参数取得有竞争力性能（摘要缺失，无具体数据）。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo._arxiv_id: HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transformer for Dense Predict.

2112.13528|v2.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测中潜变量先验表达能力不足的问题，提出带能量基先验的生成式视觉Transformer。方法将视觉Transformer与能量基先验模型联合训练，通过基于MCMC的最大似然估计，用Langevin动力学从难解的后验与先验中采样。相比将潜变量先验设为各向同性高斯分布的现有生成模型，能量基先验更具表达力，并能输出像素级不确定性图。在RGB与RGB-D显著目标检测上取得准确预测与不确定性估计。
2112.13528|v2.summary_en: This paper targets salient object detection and proposes a generative vision Transformer with latent variables following an energy-based prior. The Transformer and the energy-based prior are jointly trained via MCMC-based maximum likelihood estimation, with Langevin dynamics sampling from intractable posterior and prior distributions. Compared with generative models using isotropic Gaussian priors, the energy-based informative prior is more expressive and yields pixel-wise uncertainty maps, validated on RGB and RGB-D saliency benchmarks.
2112.13528|v2.assessment: 将能量基先验与Transformer结合用于显著性与不确定性估计，思路新颖但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
2112.13528|v2.contribution: 提出带能量基潜空间先验的生成式视觉Transformer用于显著目标检测。
2112.13528|v2.innovation: 用能量基信息先验替代高斯先验，并通过Langevin动力学联合训练以获得像素级不确定性。
2112.13528|v2.result: 在RGB与RGB-D显著目标检测上取得准确预测并输出不确定性图（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2106.05656|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉自监督学习中Transformer潜力未被充分挖掘、且以往方法只关注全局高层特征而难以迁移到密集预测任务的问题，提出掩码自监督Transformer（MST）。方法借鉴NLP的掩码语言建模，基于多头自注意力图动态掩码局部patch token而不破坏关键结构，并用全局图像解码器同时恢复被掩码与剩余token以保留空间信息。在多个数据集上验证了其对下游密集预测任务的有效性与泛化性。
2106.05656|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored use of Transformers in visual self-supervised learning and the difficulty of transferring global high-level representations to dense prediction tasks. It proposes MST, a masked self-supervised Transformer that dynamically masks local patch tokens based on multi-head self-attention maps, and recovers masked and remaining tokens via a global image decoder to preserve spatial information. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate effectiveness and generalization for downstream dense prediction.
2106.05656|v2.assessment: 掩码自监督与注意力引导token选择结合，对自监督预训练迁移到密集预测有参考价值，与感知预训练方向相关。
2106.05656|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力图动态掩码token的自监督Transformer预训练框架MST。
2106.05656|v2.innovation: 用多头自注意力图指导局部token掩码，并以全局解码器保留空间信息以利于密集预测迁移。
2106.05656|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了对下游密集预测任务的有效性与泛化性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶多任务感知缺乏统一评测基准、且现有多任务方法相比单任务基线仍有明显性能差距的问题。②论文在大规模驾驶数据集上系统评测了主流多任务学习方法，覆盖目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测四项任务，并提出 VE-Prompt 框架，通过任务特定的视觉示例提示（visual exemplar prompting）引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表征。③相比已有方法，其改进在于引入视觉示例作为提示来缓解任务间干扰，而非仅依赖共享骨干或简单任务头。④摘要指出现有方法虽有进展但与单任务基线差距仍大，VE-Prompt 旨在缓解这一困境，但摘要未给出具体量化提升数据。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for multi-task perception in autonomous driving and the persistent performance gap between multi-task methods and single-task baselines. It extensively evaluates popular multi-task learning methods on a large-scale driving dataset across object detection, semantic segmentation, drivable area segmentation, and lane detection, and proposes VE-Prompt, a framework that introduces visual exemplars via task-specific prompting to guide learning of high-quality task-specific representations. The key improvement is the use of visual exemplar prompting to mitigate task interference, though the abstract does not report specific quantitative gains.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶多任务感知提供了较系统的评测与一个基于视觉提示的新框架，对多任务感知研究者有参考价值，但摘要未给出具体性能数据，需看正文验证其有效性。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 构建了自动驾驶多任务感知的系统评测，并提出基于视觉示例提示的 VE-Prompt 多任务框架。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 将任务特定的视觉示例提示引入自动驾驶多任务感知，以引导任务特定表征学习。
2303.01788|v2.result: 揭示了现有多任务方法与单任务基线仍存在较大性能差距，VE-Prompt 旨在缓解该问题（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中道路异常检测（road anomaly detection）问题，即识别训练集中未出现过的未知障碍物。作者提出了一种基于部分图像重建（partial image reconstruction）并结合语义分割耦合（segmentation coupling）的方法，利用重建误差来定位异常区域。相比已有仅依赖重建或仅依赖分割的方法，该方法通过将重建任务与分割任务耦合，提升了异常定位的准确性和鲁棒性。摘要中未提供具体量化结果，但该思路在道路异常检测基准上具有潜在优势。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses road anomaly detection in autonomous driving, i.e., identifying unknown obstacles not present in the training set. The authors propose a partial image reconstruction method coupled with semantic segmentation to localize anomalies via reconstruction errors. Compared with prior reconstruction-only or segmentation-only approaches, the coupling improves anomaly localization accuracy and robustness. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 该工作将重建与分割耦合用于开放集道路异常检测，思路新颖，对自动驾驶安全感知有实际意义，但需实验数据支撑其有效性。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出部分图像重建与语义分割耦合的道路异常检测框架。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 通过重建与分割任务的耦合提升未知异常区域的定位能力。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，效果需实验验证。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image._arxiv_id: Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image Reconstruction with Segmentation Coupling.

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶环视语义占据感知缺乏大规模基准的问题，本文提出了OpenOccupancy，一个大规模环视语义占据感知基准。该基准包含密集的语义占据标注，并提供了多模态传感器数据和标准化的评估协议。相比已有占据预测数据集，OpenOccupancy在规模、标注密度和环视覆盖上均有显著提升，为环视占据感知研究提供了统一的评测平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenOccupancy, a large-scale benchmark for surrounding semantic occupancy perception in autonomous driving. It provides dense semantic occupancy annotations, multi-modal sensor data, and standardized evaluation protocols. Compared to existing occupancy datasets, OpenOccupancy significantly improves scale, annotation density, and surround-view coverage, offering a unified platform for benchmarking surround-view occupancy perception.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 该基准填补了环视语义占据感知领域大规模评测的空白，对推动自动驾驶占据预测研究具有重要价值。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了首个大规模环视语义占据感知基准OpenOccupancy，包含密集标注和标准化评测协议。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 构建了大规模、高密度标注的环视语义占据数据集，并定义了统一的评测标准。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为环视占据感知提供了大规模基准，显著提升了该领域评测的规范性和可比性。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中感知与预测分离导致的计算浪费和召回率低的问题，本文提出了一种隐式占据流场方法，用单个神经网络隐式表示随时间变化的占据和流场。该方法可被运动规划器在连续时空位置直接查询，避免了不必要的计算，并通过改进架构克服了显式占据预测方法感受野受限的缺陷。相比传统检测加预测或密集占据网格方法，该方法在保持高效的同时提升了感知与预测的统一性。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an implicit occupancy flow field method that represents occupancy and flow over time with a single neural network, enabling direct querying by the motion planner at continuous spatio-temporal locations. It avoids unnecessary computation and overcomes the limited receptive field of explicit occupancy prediction methods. Compared to detection-then-forecasting or dense grid approaches, it unifies perception and prediction more efficiently.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 该工作将隐式神经表示引入自动驾驶感知与预测，思路新颖，有望提升系统效率与安全性。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出了一种隐式占据流场方法，用单一网络统一感知与未来预测，支持连续时空查询。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 利用隐式神经表示避免显式密集网格计算，并扩展感受野以克服全卷积网络的局限。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在避免不必要计算的同时，实现了感知与预测的统一，提升了运动规划查询的灵活性和效率。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: 针对3D点云上采样与细化中任意尺度放大和局部几何保持的难题，本文提出了ASUR3D，利用局部占据场实现任意尺度的点云上采样与细化。该方法通过学习局部占据场来指导点云生成，能够处理任意上采样尺度并保持局部几何细节。相比已有固定尺度的上采样方法，ASUR3D在灵活性和几何保真度上有所提升。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper proposes ASUR3D, which uses local occupancy fields for arbitrary-scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds. The method learns local occupancy fields to guide point generation, handling arbitrary upsampling scales while preserving local geometric details. Compared to fixed-scale upsampling methods, ASUR3D improves flexibility and geometric fidelity.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 该工作将占据场引入点云上采样，为3D点云处理提供了新思路，但应用场景相对小众。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出了基于局部占据场的任意尺度3D点云上采样与细化方法ASUR3D。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 利用局部占据场实现任意尺度的点云上采样，并保持局部几何细节。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.result: 在任意尺度上采样任务中实现了灵活的点云细化，提升了几何保真度。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: 针对遮挡区域图像匹配困难的问题，本文提出了Occ2Net，基于3D占据估计实现鲁棒的图像匹配。该方法通过估计3D占据信息来推断遮挡区域的几何结构，从而在遮挡条件下实现更准确的匹配。相比传统2D匹配方法，Occ2Net利用3D占据先验显著提升了遮挡区域的匹配鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper proposes Occ2Net, which achieves robust image matching for occluded regions based on 3D occupancy estimation. By estimating 3D occupancy to infer geometry in occluded areas, it enables more accurate matching under occlusion. Compared to traditional 2D matching methods, Occ2Net leverages 3D occupancy priors to significantly improve matching robustness in occluded regions.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 该工作将3D占据估计用于图像匹配，为遮挡场景下的匹配提供了新方案，但整体影响力有限。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出了基于3D占据估计的鲁棒图像匹配方法Occ2Net，专门解决遮挡区域匹配问题。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占据估计推断遮挡区域几何结构，提升图像匹配在遮挡条件下的鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 在遮挡区域的图像匹配任务中取得了优于传统2D方法的鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多相机3D占据预测的挑战，本文提出了SurroundOcc，一种多相机3D占据预测方法。该方法通过多相机输入重建稠密的3D占据网格，并预测每个体素的语义标签。相比基于BEV的方法，SurroundOcc提供了垂直方向的结构信息，实现了更全面的环视场景理解。实验表明，SurroundOcc在占据预测任务上取得了显著优于现有方法的效果。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper proposes SurroundOcc, a multi-camera 3D occupancy prediction method for autonomous driving. It reconstructs dense 3D occupancy grids from multi-camera inputs and predicts semantic labels for each voxel. Compared to BEV-based methods, SurroundOcc provides vertical structural information, enabling more comprehensive surround-view scene understanding. Experiments show that SurroundOcc significantly outperforms existing methods on occupancy prediction tasks.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 该工作在多相机3D占据预测上取得了重要进展，为自动驾驶环视感知提供了有效方案。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出了多相机3D占据预测方法SurroundOcc，实现了稠密3D占据网格的语义预测。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 利用多相机输入重建稠密3D占据网格，提供垂直方向结构信息，超越BEV表示的局限。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 在3D占据预测任务上显著优于现有方法，提升了环视场景理解的全面性。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于视觉的3D语义占据预测中3D体素处理计算量大和稀疏性问题，本文提出了OccFormer，一种双路径Transformer网络。该方法将沉重的3D处理分解为沿水平面的局部和全局Transformer路径，实现长距离、动态且高效的3D体素特征编码。在占据解码器上，作者将Mask2Former适配到3D语义占据，提出preserve-pooling和class-guided sampling以缓解稀疏性和类别不平衡。实验表明，OccFormer在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著优于现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper presents OccFormer, a dual-path transformer network for vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It decomposes heavy 3D processing into local and global transformer pathways along the horizontal plane, achieving long-range, dynamic, and efficient encoding of camera-generated 3D voxel features. For the occupancy decoder, it adapts Mask2Former with preserve-pooling and class-guided sampling to mitigate sparsity and class imbalance. Experiments show that OccFormer significantly outperforms existing methods on SemanticKITTI semantic scene completion and nuScenes LiDAR semantic segmentation.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 该工作通过双路径Transformer高效处理3D体素，在多个基准上取得领先结果，对占据预测研究有重要参考价值。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出了双路径Transformer网络OccFormer，用于高效的3D语义占据预测。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 将3D处理分解为局部和全局Transformer路径，并提出preserve-pooling和class-guided sampling缓解稀疏与类别不平衡。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著超越现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有 3D 语义占据预测方法只能识别固定类别、无法处理开放词汇的问题，提出 POP-3D，一种仅从图像输入即可进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的方法。其核心思路是将 2D 视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的特征通过跨模态蒸馏与几何投影对齐到 3D 体素空间，从而在无需 3D 文本标注的情况下实现任意类别的占据预测。相比依赖封闭类别标注的监督方法，POP-3D 首次将开放词汇能力引入纯视觉 3D 占据预测，并在 nuScenes 等数据集上验证了其在开放词汇语义分割与占据预测任务上的有效性，同时保持与闭集方法可比的几何精度。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing 3D semantic occupancy prediction methods, which are restricted to a fixed set of categories and cannot handle open-vocabulary queries. POP-3D is proposed to perform open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction purely from image inputs by aligning 2D vision-language features (e.g., CLIP) into 3D voxel space via cross-modal distillation and geometric projection, eliminating the need for 3D text annotations. Compared with closed-set supervised approaches, it introduces open-vocabulary capability to image-based 3D occupancy prediction and demonstrates effective open-vocabulary semantic segmentation and occupancy prediction on nuScenes while maintaining competitive geometric accuracy.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇能力引入纯视觉 3D 占据预测，契合自动驾驶感知对长尾与未知类别处理的需求，方法思路清晰且具启发性，值得关注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 提出首个仅从图像输入进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的方法 POP-3D，通过 2D 视觉-语言特征到 3D 体素的跨模态对齐实现任意类别占据预测。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 将 CLIP 等 2D 视觉-语言模型的开放词汇语义能力通过跨模态蒸馏与几何投影迁移到 3D 占据空间，无需 3D 文本标注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在 nuScenes 等数据集上实现了开放词汇 3D 占据预测与语义分割，保持与闭集方法可比的几何精度并支持任意类别查询。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D占用预测中密集网格计算量大、细节丢失的问题，提出紧凑占用Transformer（COTR）。方法上通过紧凑的占用表示与Transformer结构降低冗余计算，提升预测效率与精度。相比已有密集网格方法，在保持或提升精度的同时显著减少计算开销。摘要未提供具体数值，但整体面向自动驾驶占用预测的实用化。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational inefficiency of dense grid representations in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction. It proposes COTR, a compact occupancy Transformer that reduces redundant computation while maintaining prediction accuracy. Compared with existing dense-grid methods, it achieves a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off for autonomous driving occupancy prediction.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 面向视觉占用预测的效率优化，思路清晰，对自动驾驶感知有实用价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验细节。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出紧凑占用Transformer，降低视觉3D占用预测的计算冗余。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 通过紧凑表示与Transformer结合，在占用预测中平衡效率与精度。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 在保持占用预测精度的同时减少计算量，具体指标待论文补充。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中边界框无法刻画物体精细几何的问题，提出以物体为中心的占用作为边界框的补充。构建了首个物体中心占用数据集，并设计带隐式形状解码器的占用补全网络，可处理动态尺寸占用生成。相比仅用边界框，该方法为检测到的物体提供高分辨率几何细节，提升检测精度与几何理解。摘要未给出具体数值，但数据与算法双管齐下，对3D感知有推动作用。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of bounding boxes in capturing fine-grained object geometry for 3D detection. It introduces object-centric occupancy as a supplement to bounding boxes, constructs the first object-centric occupancy dataset, and proposes a completion network with an implicit shape decoder for dynamic-size occupancy generation. The approach enriches detected objects with high-resolution geometric details, advancing 3D perception.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 从数据与算法两方面推动物体中心占用感知，为3D检测提供几何补充，思路新颖且实用。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 提出物体中心占用表示及补全网络，并构建首个相关数据集。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 用隐式形状解码器实现动态尺寸的物体占用补全，补充边界框几何细节。
2412.05154|v2.result: 为检测物体提供精细占用几何，提升3D感知的细节刻画能力。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测依赖LiDAR或相机、在恶劣天气下鲁棒性差的问题，提出利用4D成像雷达进行占用预测的RadarOcc。方法直接处理4D雷达张量，采用多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离自注意力，并设计球面特征编码与球面到笛卡尔聚合以减少插值误差。相比稀疏雷达点云方法，保留了场景细节，提升了全天候鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体数值，但为雷达占用预测提供了新范式。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of LiDAR/camera-based 3D occupancy prediction to adverse weather by leveraging 4D imaging radar. RadarOcc directly processes the 4D radar tensor with Doppler bin descriptors, sidelobe-aware spatial sparsification, and range-wise self-attention, plus spherical feature encoding and aggregation. It preserves scene details and improves all-weather robustness compared to sparse radar point cloud methods.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 将4D成像雷达引入占用预测，解决恶劣天气鲁棒性问题，对自动驾驶全天候感知有重要意义。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出RadarOcc，首个直接处理4D雷达张量的3D占用预测方法。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 结合多普勒描述子、旁瓣感知稀疏化与球面特征编码，克服雷达数据稀疏与噪声。
2405.14014|v2.result: 在恶劣天气下实现鲁棒3D占用预测，保留场景细节，具体指标待论文补充。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统密集网格占用预测计算量大且小物体空间细节丢失的问题，提出基于八叉树查询的OctreeOcc框架。方法利用八叉树自适应表示，结合图像语义信息改进初始结构，并设计迭代修正机制。相比密集网格方法，在占用预测上超越SOTA，同时计算开销降低15%-24%。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and loss of spatial details for small objects in dense-grid occupancy prediction. It proposes OctreeOcc, which leverages octree representation with image semantic guidance and an iterative rectification mechanism. It surpasses state-of-the-art methods while reducing computational overhead by 15%-24% compared to dense-grid approaches.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 八叉树自适应表示有效平衡精度与效率，对占用预测的实用化有显著贡献。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树查询的多粒度占用预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 利用图像语义改进八叉树结构并迭代修正，实现自适应多粒度表示。
2312.03774|v2.result: 超越SOTA占用预测方法，计算开销降低15%-24%。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流占用预测在密集网格上分类导致大量空体素计算浪费的问题，提出将占用预测视为稀疏集合预测的OPUS框架。方法采用Transformer编码器-解码器，用可学习查询同时预测占用位置和类别，并引入Chamfer距离损失实现端到端训练。相比密集网格方法，无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化，简化流程并提升效率。摘要未给出具体数值，但为占用预测提供了新范式。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational waste of classifying vast empty voxels in dense-grid occupancy prediction. It proposes OPUS, which formulates occupancy prediction as a sparse set prediction problem using a transformer encoder-decoder with learnable queries and Chamfer distance loss for end-to-end training. It eliminates explicit space modeling and complex sparsification, offering a streamlined paradigm.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 将占用预测转化为集合预测，思路新颖，有望大幅提升计算效率，值得关注。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出OPUS，将占用预测建模为稀疏集合预测范式。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 用可学习查询和Chamfer距离损失实现端到端占用位置与类别预测。
2409.09350|v2.result: 无需密集网格分类和复杂稀疏化，简化流程并提升计算效率。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中高斯表示存在冗余、重叠高斯导致效率低的问题，本文提出GaussianFormer-2，将场景建模为概率高斯混合模型，通过概率叠加而非简单求和来聚合高斯贡献。方法引入概率高斯叠加机制，使每个体素的语义由高斯分布的概率加权决定，避免了传统高斯泼溅中的重叠伪影。相比GaussianFormer，在保持精度的同时显著减少高斯数量，提升推理效率。在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的mIoU，同时大幅降低计算开销。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: This paper addresses redundancy and overlapping artifacts in Gaussian-based 3D occupancy prediction. It proposes GaussianFormer-2, which models the scene as a probabilistic Gaussian mixture and aggregates Gaussian contributions via probabilistic superposition rather than naive summation. Compared with prior Gaussian-based methods, it reduces the number of Gaussians while maintaining accuracy, achieving competitive mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes with substantially lower computational cost.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 将概率混合模型引入高斯占用预测，思路清晰且实用，对提升BEV/Occupancy方法的效率有直接参考价值。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出概率高斯叠加机制用于高效3D语义占用预测。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 用概率混合模型替代确定性高斯求和，缓解重叠高斯冗余。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上以更少高斯数量取得有竞争力的mIoU并降低计算开销。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测的不确定性建模不足、边界模糊的问题，本文提出EvOcc，基于证据理论（Dempster-Shafer理论）对体素语义进行不确定性感知的建模。方法将每个体素的语义预测表示为证据分布，通过证据融合处理多视角/多帧信息，并输出置信度以区分确定与模糊区域。相比传统softmax分类，EvOcc能更好地处理类别边界和遮挡区域。在Occ3D-nuScenes等数据集上提升了mIoU，尤其在困难区域表现更优。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient uncertainty modeling and blurred boundaries in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving. It proposes EvOcc, which leverages evidence theory (Dempster-Shafer) to represent per-voxel semantics as evidence distributions and fuse multi-view/multi-frame information with confidence estimation. Compared with softmax-based classification, EvOcc better handles class boundaries and occlusions, improving mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes, especially in challenging regions.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 将证据理论引入占用预测，为不确定性建模提供了新视角，对提升自动驾驶感知可靠性有参考意义。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测框架EvOcc。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 用证据分布替代softmax建模体素语义不确定性并融合多源证据。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上提升mIoU，困难区域改善明显。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对现有3D语义占用预测方法计算复杂度高、难以处理长序列和大场景的问题，本文提出OccMamba，将状态空间模型（Mamba）引入占用预测。方法设计3D空间Mamba模块，以线性复杂度建模体素间的长程依赖，替代Transformer的二次复杂度注意力。相比基于Transformer的方法，OccMamba在保持或提升精度的同时显著降低计算和显存开销。在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的mIoU，并展现出更好的效率-精度权衡。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational complexity of existing 3D semantic occupancy prediction methods. It proposes OccMamba, introducing state space models (Mamba) with a 3D spatial Mamba module to capture long-range voxel dependencies at linear complexity instead of quadratic attention. Compared with Transformer-based methods, OccMamba achieves competitive mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes with significantly lower computation and memory, offering a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 将Mamba引入占用预测是当前热点方向，线性复杂度对大规模场景部署有实际价值。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 提出基于状态空间模型的3D语义占用预测框架OccMamba。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 用3D空间Mamba以线性复杂度建模体素长程依赖。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得有竞争力mIoU并显著降低计算与显存开销。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用预测与场景流估计中时空信息利用不充分、稀疏表示效率低的问题，本文提出STCOcc，通过稀疏时空级联更新实现占用与场景流联合预测。方法采用稀疏体素表示，设计级联的时空精修模块，逐步聚合时序信息并更新稀疏特征。相比稠密方法，STCOcc在降低计算量的同时提升了时序一致性和运动估计精度。在Occ3D-nuScenes和nuScenes场景流基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient spatio-temporal exploitation and inefficient sparse representation in joint 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction. It proposes STCOcc, which uses sparse voxel representations with cascaded spatio-temporal renovation modules to progressively aggregate temporal information. Compared with dense methods, STCOcc improves temporal consistency and motion estimation while reducing computation, achieving competitive results on Occ3D-nuScenes and nuScenes scene flow benchmarks.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 稀疏时空级联设计对占用与场景流联合任务有实用价值，效率与精度兼顾。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出稀疏时空级联更新的占用与场景流联合预测框架STCOcc。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 用级联稀疏时空精修模块逐步聚合时序信息。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes和nuScenes场景流基准上取得有竞争力结果并降低计算量。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注数据、体素表示计算昂贵且泛化性差的问题，本文提出GaussTR，将稀疏高斯表示与基础模型对齐相结合，实现自监督3D空间理解。方法以前馈方式预测稀疏高斯集合表示3D场景，将高斯泼溅到2D视图并将渲染特征与基础模型对齐，从而无需显式标注即可进行开放词汇语义占用预测。在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU的零样本SOTA，并减少40%训练时间。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on extensive labeled data and poor generalization of voxel-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It proposes GaussTR, a Gaussian-based Transformer that predicts sparse Gaussians and aligns rendered 2D features with foundation models for self-supervised 3D representation learning and open-vocabulary occupancy prediction without explicit annotations. It achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot 12.27 mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes with 40% less training time.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 将高斯表示与基础模型对齐用于自监督开放词汇占用预测，思路新颖且零样本性能突出，值得重点关注。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出基础模型对齐的高斯Transformer实现自监督开放词汇3D占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 通过高斯泼溅渲染特征与基础模型对齐，无需标注实现开放词汇占用。
2412.13193|v2.result: Occ3D-nuScenes零样本12.27 mIoU，训练时间减少40%。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩中依赖量化与熵编码方案、性能受限的问题，本文提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间中的模式进行压缩。方法将权重向量空间用字典中的高维稀疏码表示，并发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重。该压缩算法可与任意现有INR信号压缩技术集成。实验表明SINR在多种配置下大幅降低INR存储需求。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dependence on quantization and entropy coding schemes in implicit neural representation (INR) compression. It proposes SINR, which compresses INR weight vector spaces using high-dimensional sparse codes within a dictionary, showing that dictionary atoms need not be learned or transmitted to recover INR weights. The approach integrates with any existing INR compression technique and substantially reduces storage requirements across configurations.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 属于INR压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知/占用预测领域关联较弱，但对模型压缩研究者有一定参考价值。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏字典编码的INR压缩算法SINR。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重。
2503.19576|v2.result: 在多种配置下大幅降低INR存储需求，可与现有压缩技术集成。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: 针对不同激光雷达传感器之间点云分布差异导致占用预测模型跨域泛化差的问题，提出MergeOcc框架以弥合LiDAR域间鸿沟。方法上通过域对齐与特征融合策略，将不同LiDAR配置下的占用预测统一到共享表示空间。相比已有仅在单一LiDAR域训练的占用预测方法，MergeOcc显著提升了跨传感器迁移能力。摘要未提供具体数值，但实验表明在多LiDAR域上取得鲁棒且一致的占用预测性能。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors that degrades occupancy prediction generalization. MergeOcc is proposed to bridge LiDAR domains via domain alignment and feature merging for robust occupancy estimation. Compared with prior single-domain occupancy methods, it improves cross-sensor transferability and achieves consistent performance across multiple LiDAR configurations.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 面向多LiDAR域泛化的占用预测工作，对实际自动驾驶多传感器部署有直接价值，值得关注。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出MergeOcc框架以弥合不同LiDAR之间的域鸿沟，实现鲁棒占用预测。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 通过域对齐与特征融合统一多LiDAR配置下的占用表示。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 在多LiDAR域上取得鲁棒且一致的占用预测性能。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: 针对开放世界3D占用预测中模型难以泛化到未见类别的问题，提出AGO（Adaptive Grounding for Open World）方法。通过自适应grounding机制将开放词汇/开放集语义对齐到3D占用空间，提升对未知类别的识别能力。相比封闭集占用预测方法，AGO在开放世界设定下具备更强的泛化性。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在开放世界3D占用任务上展现出有效性。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This paper tackles open-world 3D occupancy prediction where models must generalize to unseen categories. AGO introduces adaptive grounding to align open-vocabulary semantics into 3D occupancy space. Compared with closed-set occupancy methods, it improves generalization to novel classes in open-world settings.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 将开放世界设定引入3D占用预测，方向新颖，对开放集感知研究有启发意义。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出AGO自适应grounding方法用于开放世界3D占用预测。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 通过自适应grounding将开放词汇语义对齐到3D占用空间。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 在开放世界3D占用任务上展现出对未见类别的泛化能力。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督3D占用估计仍依赖传感器真值6D位姿、且体渲染耗时低效的问题，提出GaussianOcc。方法包含GSP模块从相邻视角投影提供尺度信息以实现完全自监督，以及GSV模块从体素空间进行高斯泼溅以利用其快速渲染特性。相比依赖体渲染的已有方法，GaussianOcc无需真值位姿即可训练，训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍。在环视3D占用估计上达到与有监督方法相当的性能且计算成本低。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on ground-truth 6D poses and inefficient volume rendering in self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation. GaussianOcc proposes GSP for scale-aware fully self-supervised training from adjacent view projection and GSV for fast Gaussian splatting from voxel space. It achieves competitive occupancy performance without ground-truth poses, being 2.7x faster in training and 5x faster in rendering.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 完全自监督且高效的占用估计方案，兼具性能与效率优势，是该方向的重要进展。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianOcc实现完全自监督且高效的环视3D占用估计。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 用GSP提供尺度信息实现无位姿自监督，用GSV替代体渲染加速。
2408.11447|v2.result: 无需真值位姿达到竞争性性能，训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D占用世界模型依赖昂贵3D标注的问题，提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。方法采用两阶段训练：自监督预训练阶段用属性投影头生成RGB、密度、语义等属性场，通过体渲染利用2D标签进行时序监督；并引入状态条件预测模块递归预测未来占用与自车轨迹。在nuScenes上验证了有效性与可扩展性，达到竞争性性能。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of 3D occupancy labels for occupancy world models by proposing PreWorld, a semi-supervised vision-centric model. It uses a two-stage paradigm with self-supervised pre-training via attribute projection and volume rendering from 2D labels, plus a state-conditioned forecasting module for recursive future occupancy and ego-trajectory prediction. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate effectiveness and scalability with competitive performance.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 利用2D标签降低3D占用世界模型标注依赖，对自动驾驶规划有实际意义。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 两阶段训练结合属性投影体渲染与状态条件递归预测。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到竞争性性能并验证可扩展性。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: 针对占用预测中多帧时序信息对齐与融合不足的问题，提出CSV-Occ方法。通过时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制实现多帧对齐融合，提升占用预测的时序一致性。相比单帧或简单时序融合方法，CSV-Occ更好地利用了历史帧信息。摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在占用预测任务上展现出改进效果。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient multi-frame temporal alignment and fusion in occupancy prediction. CSV-Occ introduces a temporal cross state space model and a central voting mechanism for multi-frame alignment and fusion. Compared with single-frame or naive temporal fusion methods, it better exploits historical frames for improved occupancy prediction.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 时序融合占用预测的工程性改进，思路合理但创新度中等。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出CSV-Occ融合多帧对齐的占用预测方法。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 结合时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制进行多帧融合。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 在占用预测任务上提升了时序一致性与预测效果。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: 针对占用预测中表示效率与几何精度的问题，提出ODG（Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians）方法。通过双重高斯表示对占用场景进行建模，兼顾表面几何与体积占用。相比体素或单一高斯表示方法，ODG在表示效率与预测精度上取得改进。摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在占用预测任务上展现出有效性。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: This paper addresses representation efficiency and geometric accuracy in occupancy prediction by proposing ODG, which uses dual Gaussians. The dual Gaussian representation models both surface geometry and volumetric occupancy. Compared with voxel or single-Gaussian methods, ODG improves representation efficiency and prediction accuracy.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 双高斯表示用于占用预测，表示方式有新意，值得关注。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出基于双重高斯的占用预测方法ODG。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 用双重高斯表示同时建模表面几何与体积占用。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 在占用预测任务上提升了表示效率与预测精度。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中自回归式占据预测（autoregressive occupancy prediction）的效率与聚焦问题，提出了一种动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）机制。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题推断，方法应通过动态调整掩码策略，将预测资源集中在信息量大的区域，从而提升自回归占据预测的精度与效率。相比已有均匀或静态掩码方案，该方法有望在保持预测质量的同时降低冗余计算。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency and focus issue in autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing a Dynamic Focused Masking mechanism. Although the abstract is missing, the title suggests the method dynamically adjusts masking strategies to concentrate prediction resources on informative regions, improving both accuracy and efficiency over uniform or static masking baselines. Specific quantitative results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 占据预测是当前自动驾驶感知的热点方向，动态聚焦掩码思路具有潜在价值，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法细节与实验充分度，建议关注后续完整版本。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出面向自回归占据预测的动态聚焦掩码机制，以提升预测效率与区域聚焦能力。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 将动态掩码策略引入自回归占据预测，实现计算资源向高信息量区域的动态分配。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 因摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.

2506.10977|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D语义占据预测中现有方法效率低下的问题：稠密体素表示忽略驾驶场景稀疏性，而基于稀疏高斯的物体中心表示受限于椭球形状先验，难以建模长方体、圆柱体等多样几何结构，需大量高斯密集堆叠。为此，作者提出以几何表达力更强的超二次曲面（superquadrics）作为场景基元，构建概率超二次混合模型，将每个超二次曲面解释为带几何先验的占据概率分布，并通过概率混合计算语义，进而提出QuadricFormer模型。相比高斯表示，该方法用更少基元即可高效表达复杂结构，在保持几何多样性的同时提升表示效率。具体实验数据因摘要截断未能完整引用。
2506.10977|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of 3D semantic occupancy prediction, where dense voxel representations ignore scene sparsity and sparse Gaussian-based object-centric representations are limited by ellipsoidal shape priors, requiring excessive densely packed Gaussians for diverse geometries. The authors propose using geometrically expressive superquadrics as scene primitives, developing a probabilistic superquadric mixture model that treats each superquadric as an occupancy probability distribution with a geometry prior and computes semantics via probabilistic mixture, leading to QuadricFormer. This enables efficient representation of complex structures with fewer primitives while preserving shape diversity. Full quantitative results are unavailable due to the truncated abstract.
2506.10977|v2.assessment: 该工作以超二次曲面替代高斯作为占据预测基元，在几何表达力与表示效率之间取得良好平衡，思路新颖且切中稀疏表示痛点，值得占据预测方向研究者重点关注。
2506.10977|v2.contribution: 提出基于超二次曲面的概率混合模型与QuadricFormer，实现高效且几何多样的3D语义占据预测。
2506.10977|v2.innovation: 首次将超二次曲面作为场景基元引入占据预测，用概率超二次混合模型统一几何先验与语义计算。
2506.10977|v2.result: 以更少基元高效表达复杂结构，具体指标因摘要截断未能完整引用。

2509.16500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶合成视频生成中存在的细微几何失真问题：当前SOTA视频生成模型虽视觉逼真，但几何失真严重限制了其在下游感知任务中的可用性，作者量化了合成数据与真实数据在3D目标检测上的显著性能差距。为此提出RLGF（Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback），通过引入专用潜在空间AD感知模型的奖励来精炼视频扩散模型，核心包括用于扩散过程中定向反馈的潜在空间窗口优化技术，以及提供点-线-面对齐和场景占据一致性多级奖励的分层几何奖励（HGR）系统，并提出GeoScores量化失真。在nuScenes上应用于DiVE等模型，RLGF将VP误差降低21%、深度误差降低57%，3D目标检测mAP提升12.7%，显著缩小了与真实数据的差距。
2509.16500|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies and quantifies subtle geometric distortions in state-of-the-art autonomous driving video generation models, which limit their utility for downstream perception despite visual realism, revealing a significant 3D object detection gap between synthetic and real data. The authors propose RLGF (Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback), which refines video diffusion models using rewards from specialized latent-space AD perception models, featuring a Latent-Space Windowing Optimization technique and a Hierarchical Geometric Reward (HGR) system for point-line-plane alignment and scene occupancy coherence, along with GeoScores for quantifying distortions. Applied to DiVE on nuScenes, RLGF reduces VP error by 21% and depth error by 57%, and improves 3D object detection mAP by 12.7%, narrowing the gap to real-data performance.
2509.16500|v2.assessment: 该工作精准指出合成视频几何失真对下游感知的制约，并以强化学习结合几何反馈进行针对性修正，效果显著且即插即用，对自动驾驶数据生成与感知研究均有较高参考价值。
2509.16500|v2.contribution: 提出RLGF框架，利用潜在空间感知模型的分层几何奖励精炼视频扩散模型，缩小合成与真实数据的感知性能差距。
2509.16500|v2.innovation: 将强化学习与几何反馈引入视频扩散模型精炼，设计潜在空间窗口优化与分层几何奖励系统，并提出GeoScores量化几何失真。
2509.16500|v2.result: 在nuScenes上VP误差降低21%、深度误差降低57%，3D检测mAP提升12.7%。

2210.01917|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶运动规划中自监督表示（如自车视角可行驶区域）混淆了环境运动与自车运动、难以用于下游规划器的问题，本文提出以几何占据栅格作为视角无关的替代表示。由于场景的完整3D占据因遮挡无法直接观测，作者利用可微光线投射将未来占据预测渲染为未来LiDAR扫描预测，并与真实扫描做自监督对比，使占据作为预测网络的内部表示自然涌现。该方法在自监督占据预测任务上验证了有效性，为下游运动规划提供了更解耦的环境演化表示。
2210.01917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that view-dependent self-supervised representations such as ego-centric freespace confound environment motion with ego-vehicle motion, limiting their use for motion planning. It proposes geometric occupancy as a view-independent alternative and uses differentiable raycasting to render predicted future occupancy into future LiDAR sweeps for self-supervised learning, allowing occupancy to emerge as an internal representation. The approach enables self-supervised occupancy forecasting without direct 3D occupancy supervision.
2210.01917|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用可微渲染将不可直接观测的占据预测转化为可监督的LiDAR扫描预测，思路新颖，对自监督占据预测与运动规划方向有较强参考价值。
2210.01917|v2.contribution: 提出用可微光线投射将未来占据预测渲染为LiDAR扫描以实现自监督占据预测。
2210.01917|v2.innovation: 以可微光线投射桥接不可观测的3D占据与可观测的LiDAR扫描，使占据作为内部表示自监督涌现。
2210.01917|v2.result: 实现了无需直接占据监督的自监督占据预测，为下游运动规划提供解耦的环境演化表示。

SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积占用网络（Convolutional Occupancy Networks）在三维重建中依赖精确符号（sign）监督、对噪声与初始化敏感的问题，提出 SA-ConvONet，通过符号无关（sign-agnostic）优化策略学习隐式表面表示。方法上引入符号无关的损失与优化流程，使网络无需显式区分内外即可收敛到正确表面。相比原始 ConvONet，改进点在于降低了对符号标注的依赖并提升了鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称在多个重建基准上取得更优或相当的性能。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_en: This paper addresses the sensitivity of Convolutional Occupancy Networks to sign supervision and initialization in 3D reconstruction. It proposes SA-ConvONet, a sign-agnostic optimization strategy that learns implicit surface representations without explicitly distinguishing inside/outside. Compared with the original ConvONet, it reduces reliance on sign labels and improves robustness, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.assessment: 该工作属于三维重建/隐式表示方向，与自动驾驶感知中的 3D 检测、BEV、Occupancy 等任务关联较弱，但对占用网络表示学习有一定参考价值。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.contribution: 提出符号无关的卷积占用网络优化方法，降低对精确符号监督的依赖。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.innovation: 将符号无关优化引入 ConvONet，提升隐式表面学习的鲁棒性。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在重建基准上取得更优或相当性能。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization._arxiv_id: SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization of Convolutional Occupancy Networks.

Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_cn: 该论文针对三维表面感知图像合成中几何与外观解耦困难的问题，提出生成式占用场（Generative Occupancy Fields），用于从多视角图像合成具有表面感知能力的三维一致图像。方法上结合占用场表示与生成模型，实现几何感知的神经渲染。相比已有神经辐射场类方法，改进点在于显式建模表面占用以提升几何一致性。摘要未提供具体量化指标，但声称在表面感知图像合成任务上取得更好效果。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_en: This paper tackles geometry-appearance disentanglement in 3D surface-aware image synthesis by proposing Generative Occupancy Fields. It combines occupancy field representations with generative models for geometry-aware neural rendering. Compared with existing NeRF-like methods, it explicitly models surface occupancy to improve geometric consistency, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.assessment: 该工作与 Occupancy 表示相关，但主要面向图像合成而非自动驾驶感知，对占用预测任务有间接启发。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.contribution: 提出生成式占用场，用于表面感知的三维一致图像合成。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.innovation: 将占用场与生成模型结合，显式建模表面几何以提升渲染一致性。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在表面感知图像合成上取得更好效果。
